To serve, layer crispy papdi with chutneys, curd, onion, roasted cumin powder, chat masala, and sev bhujia.

name: Corn Meal Dhokla
instructions: Mix corn meal, gram flour, wheat flour, fresh fenugreek leaves, and coriander leaves. Add crushed green peas and spices (carom seeds, ginger green chilli paste, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, asafoetida). Combine with curd. Pour into greased pan and steam. Prepare tadka with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, sesame seeds, red chilli powder, and ghee. Pour tadka over steamed dhokla.

name: Aloo Fried Rice
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Add diced potato and cook until soft. Add onion, tomato, green peas, and green chilli. Add boiled rice and mix well. Season with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and salt. Stir fry until all ingredients are well combined and heated through.

name: Hummus
instructions: Grind soaked and boiled chickpeas with garlic cloves. Add sesame seeds and grind until smooth. Mix in cumin powder, paprika powder, and salt. Slowly add olive oil while blending until creamy. Add lemon juice and blend again. Adjust consistency with more oil if needed. Serve with pita or vegetables.

name: Veg Club Sandwich
instructions: Mix mayonnaise and tomato ketchup in a bowl. Add chilli flakes, oregano, black pepper powder, and chat masala powder. Toast bread slices with butter. Layer bread with the prepared sauce, then add sliced cucumber, tomato, onion, carrot, capsicum, and green chilli. Place another bread slice and repeat layers. Toast the sandwich on a griddle until golden. Cut diagonally and serve.

name: Rasam
instructions: Boil tomatoes and soak tamarind. Grind cumin seeds, black peppers, green chilli, and garlic into a paste. Cook tomatoes with tamarind extract. Add the ground paste and bring to boil. Season with asafoetida, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, jaggery, and salt. In a separate pan, heat oil and add mustard seeds, curry leaves, and dry red chilli for tadka. Pour tadka into rasam. Simmer for a few minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Coconut Burfi
instructions: Remove and grate fresh coconut meat after cleaning. Heat ghee in pan and roast desiccated coconut for 5 minutes. Add condensed milk and cook while stirring continuously until thick consistency. Add cardamom powder and mix well. Spread on greased plate, garnish with chopped pistachios and press them in. Mark cutting lines, cool completely, then heat plate bottom slightly to remove pieces easily.

name: Radhaballavi with Aloo Curry
instructions: Prepare roasted masala powder with cumin seeds, fennel seeds, and dry red chilli. For stuffing: cook soaked urad dal, add green chillies, ginger, fennel seeds, asafoetida, sugar, salt, roasted masala powder, and cook oil. For dough: knead all purpose flour with salt, sugar, oil, and warm water. Divide into balls and stuff with dal mixture. For aloo curry: boil and cube potatoes, add to sauteed dry peas with green chillies, asafoetida, panchforon, turmeric, and masala powder. Fry stuffed radhaballavi until golden and serve with aloo curry.

name: Mini Veg Thali
instructions: Dahi Aloo: Boil potatoes and mix with curd and spices. Paneer Sabzi: Stir-fry paneer with onion, capsicum and spices. Kheer: Cook rice in milk with sugar and cardamom. Poori: Make dough with flours and semolina, rest 30 mins, roll and fry until puffed. Serve all components together as a complete thali.

name: Cheese Paneer Toast
instructions: Mix grated paneer with finely chopped vegetables and spices. Spread on bread slices and top with cheese. Toast in oven or on tava until cheese melts and bread becomes crispy. Serve hot.

name: Ilish Bhapa
instructions: Clean and cut hilsa fish into pieces. Mix curd with mustard seeds paste, green chillies, turmeric and salt. Coat fish pieces with mixture. Wrap in banana leaves or foil and steam for 20-25 minutes until cooked through. Serve hot with mustard oil drizzle.

name: Bread Dahi Vada
ingredients: red chilly powder less than 1/4 tsp
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash. Soak bread slices and squeeze out excess water. Mix mashed potatoes, bread, coriander leaves, green chillies, ginger paste, coriander powder, red chilly powder, mango powder, salt, and raisins. Form into vada (ball) shapes. Deep fry in ghee until golden brown on all sides. Serve vadas in chilled buttermilk or dahi (yogurt) as a cool snack.

name: Cold Coffee and Kit-Kat Freakshake
instructions: Pour milk into a glass. Add instant coffee and sugar. Mix well. Add ice cubes. Crush kit-kat bars and rim the glass edge with crushed pieces. Pour the coffee mixture. Top with whipped cream and garnish with more crushed kit-kat pieces. Serve immediately with a straw.

name: Sooji Nasta
instructions: Mix sooji with curd and let it rest for 15 minutes. Add baking soda and mix well. Finely chop green chilli, garlic, and onion, then add to the mixture. Add cumin seeds, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder, and salt. Mix to form a thick dough. Let rest for 10 minutes. Heat oil in a deep pan. Take portions and shape into small balls or oblong shapes. Deep fry on medium heat until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

name: Pizza Paratha
instructions: Mix flour with salt and make soft dough. Divide into portions and roll out thin circles. Spread schezwan chutney and tomato ketchup on one half. Top with grated cheese, mixed peppers, onions, and pizza seasoning. Fold dough in half. Roll gently to seal. Cook on hot tava with oil until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Urad Dal Kadhi Pakoda
instructions: Soak moong and urad dal. Grind with ginger, green chilli and spices to make pakoda batter. Deep fry until golden. For kadhi, mix gram flour and yogurt with water. Temper mustard and cumin seeds in oil, add to gram flour mixture. Bring to boil, add turmeric and asafoetida. Add fried pakodas to kadhi and simmer until cooked.

name: Crispy Gobi Manchurian
instructions: Boil cauliflower florets until 80% cooked. Make a batter with corn flour, all purpose flour, water, salt and spices. Coat cauliflower in batter and deep fry until golden and crispy. In a separate pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, spring onion and capsicum. Add soy sauce, vinegar, ketchup and chilli sauces. Add fried cauliflower, toss well and serve hot.

name: Veg Korma
instructions: Soak poppy seeds and grind with cashews and coconut to paste. Cut vegetables into small pieces. Heat oil and add curry leaves and bay leaf. Add sliced onions and green chillies. Cook until onions are golden. Add tomatoes and all spices. Add vegetables and paste. Cook until vegetables are tender. Serve hot.

name: Jeera Kalimirch Poori
instructions: Mix all purpose flour, sooji and rice flour. Add black pepper, cumin seeds, red chilli powder, salt and 2 tbsp oil. Knead with water to make soft dough. Let rest for 10 minutes. Roll out thin circles. Deep fry in hot oil until puffed and golden brown. Serve hot.

name: Ragi Pizza
instructions: Prepare dough with ragi flour, all purpose flour, yeast and salt. Let it rise. Spread pizza sauce on dough. Top with onion, mushroom, peppers, jalapeno, olives, corn and cheese. Bake in oven using auto cook menu until golden.

name: Veg Handi
instructions: Cut vegetables into medium pieces. Temper whole spices in oil, add chopped vegetables and cook. Add tomato paste, powder spices, cream and water. Cook covered on low flame until vegetables are tender, approximately 20-25 minutes. Stir occasionally and adjust seasoning.

name: Coconut Sweets
instructions: Mix milk powder and desiccated coconut in a bowl. Add condensed milk and mix well. Add food color while mixing. Add milk gradually to get a moldable consistency. Knead the mixture. Shape into small balls using your hands. Garnish each sweet with dry nuts on top. Refrigerate if desired before serving.

name: Veg Manchurian Gravy
instructions: Prepare grated cabbage, carrot, onion, spring onion, green chilli, ginger, and bell peppers. Mix vegetables with corn flour, all purpose flour, and salt to make a paste. Heat oil in a pan. Form balls from the vegetable mixture and deep fry until golden brown. In another pan, heat oil and sauté onions. Add tomato ketchup, soy sauce, green chilli sauce, red chilli sauce, and spices. Add the fried manchurian balls to the gravy and simmer until coated.

name: Chilli Garlic Bhindi Fry
instructions: Clean and dry the bhindi thoroughly. Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds. Add bhindi and stir fry on high heat initially to remove moisture. Add minced garlic, green chillies, turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, and dry mango powder. Continue frying on medium heat until bhindi becomes crispy and tender. Stir frequently to avoid sticking.

name: Palak Kofta Curry
instructions: Blanch spinach and puree. Mix spinach with grated paneer and mashed potatoes, shape into round koftas, keep aside. Sauté onions till golden. Add ginger and garlic paste, cook till fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and cook till soft. Add all spices, turmeric, coriander and red chilli powder. Simmer the gravy. Gently drop koftas into gravy, cover and cook on low flame for 10-12 minutes. Add cream and garam masala. Cook for 2 more minutes and serve hot.

name: Tandoori Gobhi
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets. Mix curd with ginger garlic paste, besan, all dry spices, and salt to make a marinade. Coat cauliflower florets in the marinade and let sit for 15-20 minutes. Heat oil in a pan or skillet on medium-high heat. Place marinated cauliflower florets on the hot surface and cook until they get a charred appearance, turning occasionally. Continue cooking until cauliflower is tender and well-cooked. Serve hot garnished with coriander leaves.

name: Cheesy Chicken Tikka with Loaded Fries
instructions: Mix curd with paprika powder, garlic powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chilli powder, black pepper, salt and lemon juice. Add boneless chicken and mix well. Rest for 20 minutes. Heat 3 tbsp oil and add marinated chicken. Cover and cook on medium flame for 15-17 minutes, stirring in between. Heat 1/3 cup milk, add 2-3 cheese slices, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1/2 tsp oregano. Cook for 1 minute to make cheese sauce. Fry readymade french fries. Arrange chicken tikka on serving plate, add french fries, pour cheese sauce on top, and garnish with olives and chilli flakes. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Balls
instructions: Crumble paneer and chop capsicum, carrot and onion into fine pieces. Mix crumbled paneer with chopped vegetables, chilli flakes, oregano, lemon juice and salt. Take portions of the mixture and shape into balls. Coat each ball with rice flour on all sides. Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the balls until golden brown on all sides. Remove with slotted spoon and drain excess oil on paper towels. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Satay
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes. Make coating batter by mixing corn flour, all purpose flour, salt and a little water to a smooth consistency. Dip paneer cubes in the batter and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Remove and drain excess oil. Make sauce by combining schezwan chutney, white vinegar, tomato ketchup, soy sauce, ginger garlic paste, chopped garlic, red chilli powder and honey. Heat oil, add the sauce and toss the fried paneer cubes in it. Garnish with roasted peanuts. Serve hot.

name: Dabeli
instructions: Toast all spices including fennel seeds, dry coconut, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, black peppers, dry ginger, bay leaf, cloves, sesame seeds, nutmeg, star anise, cinnamon stick, dry red chilli together to make dabeli masala powder. Grind to fine powder and mix with turmeric powder, red chilli powder and dry mango powder. Make tamarind chutney by cooking tamarind pulp with red chilli powder, sugar and salt. Make chilli garlic chutney by grinding garlic cloves, soaked dry red chillies with roasted peanuts, lemon juice and salt. Prepare mashed potatoes mixed with dabeli masala, chat masala powder, salt and oil. Toast roasted peanuts with dabeli masala and chat masala. Assemble dabeli using bread/pav, potato filling, chutneys and masala peanuts. Serve hot.

name: Instant Potato Chips (Aloo Chips)
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices. Soak in water briefly and drain well. Heat oil in a deep pan until very hot. Add potato slices in batches and fry until crispy and golden brown, about 5-7 minutes per batch. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Season with salt to taste. Serve hot as a crispy snack.

name: Kadhi Pakoda with Jeera Rice
instructions: For kadhi: Heat oil, add cumin and mustard seeds. Add hing and fenugreek seeds. Fry dry red chillies, add garlic and green chilli. Add turmeric. Mix besan with curd and water, add to tempering. Cook until thickened. For pakora: Mix chopped onion, besan, green chilli, coriander, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt and baking soda. Add water to make thick batter. Deep fry until golden. For jeera rice: Cook rice with water, add tempering of cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon, and black cardamom. Serve kadhi with pakora and jeera rice together.

name: Green Moong Appam
instructions: Soak moong beans for 1-2 hours. Drain and grind with chopped ginger and green chilli to a coarse paste. Add chopped onion, cumin powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder, garam masala powder and salt. Heat appam pan on medium heat. Add 1/2 tbsp oil in each cavity. Pour batter into the pan cavities. Cover and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy on outside. Flip and cook other side. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Jackfruit Curry
instructions: Heat oil. Add cumin seeds, cardamom, bay leaves and cinnamon. Saute until fragrant. Add onion slices and cook until caramelized. Add ginger and garlic, cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add turmeric and kashmiri red chilli powder. Add cubed kathal pieces. Add cumin powder, coriander powder and garam masala. Mix well. Cover and cook on medium heat for 20-25 minutes until jackfruit is tender. Finish with roasted kasuri methi. Serve hot.

name: Street Style Veg Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Slice bread. Layer with green chutney, tomato ketchup, and schezwan chutney. Add boiled potatoes, diced paneer, capsicum, onion, tomato, and cucumber slices. Top with cheese slices. Season with chaat masala, salt and black pepper. Butter the outer bread slices. Heat tawa (griddle) on medium-high heat. Cook sandwich on tawa with pressure until bread is golden and crispy and cheese melts. Flip and cook other side. Serve hot immediately.

name: Dhaba Style Kadai Chicken
instructions: Cut chicken into medium pieces. Coarsely crush cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cinnamon, black cardamom, dry red chilli and cloves. Heat oil. Fry bay leaves and whole spices briefly. Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown. Add minced ginger and garlic, cook for 1-2 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add turmeric and red chilli powder. Add chicken pieces and mix well. Cover and cook on high heat for 15-20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and oil separates. Serve hot in a kadai (wok) for presentation.

name: Party Style Crispy Chana Chilli
instructions: Drain boiled chickpeas. Mix corn flour and all purpose flour. Finely chop ginger, garlic, capsicum, onion, cabbage, green chilli, carrot and spring onion. Combine chickpeas with vegetables, ginger, garlic and schezwan chutney. Coat with flour mixture and red chilli powder. Deep fry in oil at medium-high heat until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel. Make sauce with green chilli sauce, red chilli sauce, tomato ketchup and soy sauce. Toss fried chana chilli in sauce. Serve immediately with fresh spring onion garnish.

name: Bombay Masala Toast Sandwich
instructions: Make aloo masala by heating oil, adding mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add green chilli and turmeric, then add boiled potatoes. Season with garam masala, salt, and lemon juice. Prepare green chutney by blending garlic, green chilli, and coriander with lemon juice. Layer bread slices with aloo masala, cucumber, onion, tomato, and beetroot. Spread green chutney on sides. Toast on stove toaster or tawa until golden.

name: Indian Style Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente and drain. Heat oil and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add green chilli, then add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add carrot and french beans, cook until tender. Add mixed herbs and red chilli flakes. Add boiled pasta, pasta mix, and schezwan chutney. Toss well to combine.

name: Egg White Omelette
instructions: Separate egg whites from 6 eggs. Whisk egg whites with finely chopped green chilli and black pepper powder. Season with salt. Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Pour egg white mixture. Optionally add onion and tomato on top. Cook on medium heat until edges set, then fold gently. Serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Manchow Soup
instructions: Heat oil and butter. Add grated ginger and minced garlic, cook until fragrant. Add spring onion and onion, sauté briefly. Add french beans, cabbage, mushroom, green peas, and carrot. Cook vegetables until tender. Add tomato ketchup, green chilli sauce, soy sauce, black peppers, and sugar. Season with salt. Add water as needed for soup consistency. Simmer for 5-10 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Milk Peda
instructions: Take 1 liter full cream milk in a wok. Cook on high flame while stirring continuously at intervals. Stir touching spatula to bottom to prevent burning. Cook until milk reaches thick consistency. Reduce flame to medium. Scrape sides using spatula. Add 1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 tsp cardamom powder. Stir and cook for 5 minutes on low-medium flame. Cool mixture on separate plate. Grease palms with ghee. Lift portion of mixture and roll. Press center to form peda shape. Prepare all pedas similarly. Leave open for 3-4 hours to set. Store in refrigerator for 8-10 days.

name: chocolate cookies
instructions: Mix powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and baking powder in a bowl. Add softened butter and ghee and mix well. Add wheat flour and milk gradually to form a stiff dough. Shape into small round cookies. Heat ghee in a kadhai over low heat and place cookies carefully. Fry on medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and cool on a paper towel. Store in an airtight container.

name: cheese tawa pulao
instructions: Heat oil in a large tawa or flat griddle. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add chopped onions and stir-fry until golden. Add tomato pieces, capsicum, and green chilli. When vegetables are half cooked, add the cooked rice and mix well. Sprinkle turmeric, red chilli, garam masala, and pav bhaji masala. Toss everything together. Add cheese cubes and spring onion, mix gently. Finish with lemon juice and salt to taste.

name: Pressure Cooker Chicken Curry
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd for 30 minutes. Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, add bay leaves, cumin seeds, cloves, black cardamom, green cardamom, anise, and cinnamon stick. Once fragrant, add sliced onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and chopped green chilli, sauté for 1 minute. Add marinated chicken and mix well. Pour the curd marinade, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, and salt. Add chopped tomato. Close the cooker lid and pressure cook on high for 6-7 whistles until chicken is tender. Release pressure, open cooker, and garnish with fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot with rice or bread.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala Quesadilla
instructions: Marinate chicken with curd, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, garam masala, red chilli, and black pepper for 30 minutes. Grill or pan-fry the marinated chicken until cooked. Sauté capsicum, onion, tomato, and corn. Place grilled chicken in tortilla wrap, add vegetables and cheese, fold and pan-fry until crispy.

name: Egg Biryani
instructions: Fry onions until golden brown. Boil rice with whole spices. Layer rice, eggs and potatoes in cooker. Add curd mixed with ginger garlic paste and spices. Layer with saffron soaked in milk. Cook in pressure cooker for 10 minutes.

name: Jaggery Tea
instructions: Boil water in a pot. Add tea leaves and bring to a boil. Add boiled milk. Add jaggery pieces and ginger. Simmer for 2-3 minutes. Strain and serve hot.

name: Chatpata Masala Aloo
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle. Add cumin seeds and coriander seeds. Add dried red chillies (slightly crushed). Add chopped garlic and cook briefly. Add boiled potatoes cut into pieces. Sprinkle turmeric, red chilli powder, and black pepper. Toss and cook on high heat for 3-4 minutes until potatoes are well coated and slightly crispy.

name: Paneer Gulab Jamun
instructions: Crumble paneer finely. Mix paneer with all purpose flour, powdered sugar, sooji, baking powder, and baking soda. Knead into a smooth dough. Form small balls. Heat ghee and deep fry the balls until golden brown. Prepare sugar syrup by dissolving sugar in water and bringing to a boil. Add fried gulab jamuns to the hot sugar syrup. Let them soak in the syrup for at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: Rasgulla Kheer
instructions: Heat milk in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add sugar and bring to a boil. Gently cut rasgullas into pieces and add to the milk. Add cardamom pods and crushed saffron. Let the mixture simmer on medium heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it thickens slightly. Roast almonds, cashews, and pistachios in ghee until golden. Pour the kheer into serving bowls and garnish with roasted dry fruits.

name: Biscuit Pancake
instructions: Crush biscuits into fine crumbs. Mix with milk powder and powdered sugar. Add milk gradually to form a smooth batter. Heat oil or ghee in a pan. Pour batter and cook on medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve warm.

name: Rajma Masala Curry
instructions: Soak rajma overnight. Pressure cook with bay leaves, black cardamom, cinnamon until soft. Heat oil, add cumin seeds. Fry onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add tomato puree. Cook until oil separates. Add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala. Mix in cooked rajma with its water. Simmer for 10-15 minutes. Add ghee, coriander leaves. Serve hot with rice or bread.

name: Hash Browns
instructions: Peel and grate potatoes. Squeeze out excess moisture. Mix with all purpose flour, corn flour, chilli flakes and salt. Heat oil in a non-stick pan. Take portions of the mixture and flatten into patties. Fry on medium-high heat until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Drain on paper towel and serve hot.

name: Bengali Nimki
instructions: Mix all purpose flour with salt and sugar. Add ghee and mix well. Add carom seeds and nigella seeds. Add water gradually to form a stiff dough. Knead well until smooth. Roll out thin and cut into diamond shapes. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel. Store in airtight container.

name: Choco Chunk Peda
instructions: Crush biscuits into fine crumbs. Mix with milk powder. Heat butter and add cocoa powder to it. Mix cocoa butter with biscuit mixture. Add condensed milk gradually. Mix well until it forms a dough. Add crushed pista. Take portions and roll into balls or pedas. Optional: coat with cocoa powder. Chill for 30 minutes and serve.

name: Cheese Chilli Uttapam
ingredients: eno 1/4 tsp or baking soda 2 pinch
instructions: Mix rava with curd and let rest for 5 minutes. Add chopped onion, capsicum, coriander leaves, green chilli, and chilli flakes. Add salt to taste. Just before cooking, add eno or baking soda and mix gently. Heat griddle with oil. Pour batter and spread into a circle. Cook until edges turn golden, flip and cook other side until light brown. Serve hot.

name: McVeggie Burger
instructions: Boil potatoes, carrots, and peas. Mash boiled vegetables with paneer, ginger garlic paste, spices, and herbs. Form into patties and coat with flour-cornflour mixture. Fry patties in butter until golden on both sides. Toast burger buns with butter. Spread mayonnaise and sauces on buns. Layer with fried patty, cheese slice, lettuce, and tomato. Serve immediately.

name: Rajasthani Missi Roti
instructions: Mix gram flour and wheat flour. Add finely chopped green chilli, ginger, garlic, onion, and coriander leaves. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, dry mango powder, carom seeds, and asafoetida. Add curd and knead into a soft dough with water. Let rest for 10-15 minutes. Divide into portions and roll into thin circles. Heat griddle, place roti, and cook until light brown spots appear on both sides. Brush with ghee. Serve hot.

name: aloo chop
instructions: Make thin batter with chickpea flour, water, salt, and spices. Boil and mash potatoes. Heat oil, add cumin seeds, then spices, green chillies and ginger. Add mashed potatoes, cook with spices. Add green coriander and peanuts. Cool the mixture. Shape into flat rounds. Dip in batter and deep fry on high flame until golden, then fry on medium heat until crispy.

name: Aloo Pakoda
instructions: Mix shinghara flour with grated raw potato, minced ginger, chopped green chilli, and rock salt. Heat oil and drop spoonfuls of mixture into hot oil. Deep fry until golden and crispy on all sides. Serve with green chutney and lassi.

name: Paneer Cheese Cutlet
instructions: Mix crumbled paneer with mashed boiled potato, cheese, finely chopped onion, capsicum, coriander leaves, pepper, chilli flakes, oregano, and salt. Form mixture into oval or cylindrical shapes. Coat with breadcrumbs on all sides. Heat oil in pan and shallow fry cutlets until golden brown on both sides.

name: Bombay Halwa
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and roast corn flour on medium flame for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Add water and stir continuously to avoid lumps. Cook until water is mostly absorbed. Add sugar and continue cooking while stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Mix in cardamom powder and lemon juice. Add chopped nuts and melon seeds. Spread on greased surface and cool. Cut into desired shapes once set.

name: Veg Sandwich
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Apply green chutney on one slice. Layer sliced cucumber, capsicum, and tomato. Sprinkle chat masala powder and salt. Add cheese slice on top. Spread tomato ketchup on the other bread slice and close the sandwich. Toast on a tawa or griddle over medium heat until cheese melts and bread is golden. Serve warm.

name: Stuffed Baingan Masala
instructions: Cut brinjals lengthwise and scoop out the inside. Grind onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, green chillies into a paste. Temper cumin and mustard seeds in oil, add paste and cook until soft. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and garam masala. Stuff this mixture into brinjal halves. Cook covered on medium heat until brinjals are tender and well-cooked.

name: Fried Rice and Schezwan Paneer
instructions: For fried rice: heat 2 tbsp oil, add green chilli and garlic, then add capsicum, carrot, french beans and onion. Stir fry 2-3 minutes. Add cooked rice, soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper and salt. Toss until combined. For schezwan paneer: heat 4 tbsp oil, fry paneer cubes until golden, remove and set aside. In same oil sauté onion until golden, add tomato and ginger garlic paste, cook 2 minutes. Add schezwan chutney, red chilli powder, black pepper and salt. Add paneer back, mix well and simmer 2 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Raw Rice and Moong Dal Breakfast Crepe
instructions: Soak rice and moong dal together for 15 minutes. Grind to a thick batter with ginger and green chilli. Add chopped carrot, onion, capsicum and coriander leaves. Mix well. Add cumin powder, coriander powder, chilli powder and salt. Just before cooking, add eno powder and mix gently. Heat oil on griddle, pour batter and spread thin. Cook until golden on both sides. Flip and cook other side. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

name: Cabbage Dum Aloo
instructions: Chop cabbage and potatoes into small pieces. Heat oil in a pot, add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add bay leaves and black cardamom. Add chopped onion and cook until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and cook 1 minute. Add tomato and green chilli, cook 2 minutes. Add turmeric, red chilli, cumin powder, coriander powder and garam masala. Mix well. Add cabbage and potatoes, mix thoroughly. Cover and cook on high heat for 2 minutes until steam forms, then reduce heat to low. Cook covered for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Veg Puff Patties
instructions: Make dough with flour, salt, oil and water. Knead well and keep aside. Prepare aloo masala by mashing potatoes, mix with sautéed onion, green chilli, turmeric, red chilli, cumin and coriander powders, garam masala, dry mango powder and salt. Prepare paneer filling by mixing crumbled paneer with sautéed onion, tomato, capsicum, spices. Roll dough thin, cut into squares. Place filling in center, fold into triangle, seal edges with water. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Serve hot with sauce or chutney.

name: Noodles Samosa
instructions: Make dough with flour, salt, oil, water and knead well. Prepare filling by mixing cooked noodles with sautéed onion, capsicum, garlic, green chilli, schezwan chutney, carom seeds, black pepper and salt. Roll dough thin, cut into squares. Place noodle filling in center, fold into triangle and seal edges well. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot with green chutney or sauce.

name: Basundi Sundae
instructions: Simmer milk on medium-high heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until reduced to half and becomes thick. Add condensed milk and mix well. Add cardamom powder. If using cornflour, dissolve in 2 tbsp milk and add to thickened milk for extra richness. Dry roast cashews, pista and almonds, coarsely chop half and keep half for garnish. Add chopped nuts to the basundi. Pour into serving glasses. Top with Kwality Wall's Kesar Pista Dessert and crumbled rusk. Garnish with whole nuts and optional rose syrup. Chill before serving.

name: Paneer Bhurji Curry
instructions: Heat oil and ghee, temper with cumin seeds. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté. Add onions and tomatoes, cook until soft. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander and cumin powder. Add crumbled paneer and garam masala. Cook on high heat until paneer is well coated and slightly browned. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Tomato Poori
instructions: Mix wheat flour with tomato paste, spices and salt. Knead into a soft dough using water. Let rest for 15 minutes. Divide into balls, roll into small circles. Heat oil, deep fry each poori until it puffs up and turns golden. Remove and serve hot.

name: Street Style Momo Chutney
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes and garlic. Combine all ingredients in a mixer or blender. Blend to a coarse paste consistency. Transfer to a serving bowl. Adjust salt and spice to taste. Serve with momos or parathas.

name: Dhaba Style Dum Aloo
instructions: Peel and prick potatoes. Deep fry until 70% cooked. Heat ghee and oil, temper with cumin seeds and cardamom. Add ginger-garlic paste and roast. Add onions until golden. Add tomato paste, then all spice powders. Add roasted cashews and fried potatoes. Stir well. Cover and cook on high heat for 2-3 minutes until potatoes are fully cooked and glazed. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Oreo Brownie Cheesecake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies for crust. Prepare brownie batter by mixing flour, cocoa, coffee powder, sugar, melted chocolate and butter. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Prepare cream cheese mixture by beating cream cheese with sugar and egg. Spread brownie batter in baking pan, pour cream cheese mixture on top, sprinkle crushed Oreos. Bake at 175°C for 35-40 minutes until set.

name: green chilli garlic ginger pickle
instructions: Wash and chop ginger and green chillies. Peel garlic cloves. Dry roast all spices together. Mix chopped vegetables with roasted spices, salt, vinegar. Warm mustard oil and pour into the mixture. Store in glass jar.

name: dahi vada chaat
instructions: Mix sooji with curd, ginger, green chilli, coriander leaves and baking soda. Let rest 15 minutes. Heat oil and fry spoonfuls of mixture until golden. Soak vadas in curd for 30 minutes. Top with papdi, sev, onions, chutneys and spice powders.

name: chana saag pakoda
instructions: Chop chana saag and onion finely. Mix with ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add gram flour and rice flour with all spices and salt. Make a thick batter. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden and crispy.

name: masala aloo katli
instructions: Cut potatoes into medium pieces. Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add onions and cook until golden. Add garlic and green chillies. Add potatoes and fry for 5 minutes. Add tomato paste and all spices. Add water and simmer until potatoes are cooked. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: kathal kofta curry
instructions: Cook and shred jackfruit and potatoes. Mix with gram flour and spices to form koftas. Fry koftas until golden. For curry: sauté onions, add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and spices. Add water and simmer. Add fried koftas and cook for 5 minutes.

name: Indian Style Macaroni Pasta
instructions: Boil macaroni and drain. Heat oil, sauté green chilli and onion. Add capsicum, carrot, mushroom, green beans, tomato and sweet corn. Add cooked macaroni and all dry masalas. Mix well and add tomato ketchup. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Garnish with spring onion.

name: Masala Aloo
instructions: Cut potatoes into cubes. Heat oil and temper with mustard seeds, cumin seeds and coriander seeds. Add green chilli and garlic. Add potatoes and fry for 2 minutes. Add crushed tomatoes and all dry masalas. Cover and cook on medium heat until potatoes are tender. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Hariyali Dum Aloo
instructions: Crush boiled potatoes lightly. Make paste of coriander leaves, green chilli and garlic. Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Sauté onion until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Add crushed potatoes and the herb paste. Add all dry masalas and mix. Cover and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: Veg Momos Manchurian
instructions: Make dough with flour, oil and water, let rest 15 minutes. Chop vegetables fine and mix with soy sauce and black pepper for filling. Divide dough into small portions, roll thin and fill with vegetable mixture, fold into momo shape. Steam in steamer for 8-10 minutes. For gravy: heat oil, add garlic and ginger, add chopped peppers and onion, add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce and ketchup. Simmer until thick. Serve momos in manchurian gravy.

name: Puran Poli with Aamti
instructions: Make dough with both flours, turmeric and salt. Cook chana dal until soft, add jaggery and cardamom powder, mash into puran. Roll dough thin, place puran in center, seal edges and roll gently into poli. Cook on griddle with ghee on both sides until light brown spots appear. For aamti: heat oil and temper with mustard seeds and cumin seeds, sauté onion until golden, add garlic-ginger paste, add coconut paste, add goda masala and other spices, simmer with dal stock. Serve hot puran poli with aamti.

name: Eggless Bread Pudding
instructions: Cut bread slices into small cubes or chunks. In a bowl, mix milk, custard powder, milk powder, and sugar. Whisk until custard powder and milk powder are completely dissolved. Add bread cubes to the milk mixture and let them soak for a few minutes, stirring gently so they absorb the liquid evenly. Pour the mixture into a greased baking dish or saucepan. Cook on low heat on the stovetop, stirring occasionally, until the pudding becomes creamy and thick, about 10-15 minutes. The bread should be soft and well integrated. Remove from heat, cool slightly, and serve warm or chilled.

name: Tandoori Roti with Garlic
instructions: In a bowl, mix wheat flour with curd, sugar, salt, and add water gradually to form a soft dough. Let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Add Eno powder to the dough and mix gently. Divide dough into equal portions. On a floured surface, roll each portion into a thin circular disc. Brush the rolled disc with butter and sprinkle minced garlic, coriander leaves, nigella seeds, and dry kasuri methi on top. Heat a tawa or griddle on high heat. Place the rolled roti on the hot tawa and cook for about 20-30 seconds until light brown spots appear. Flip and cook the other side until golden brown spots appear and the roti puffs up slightly. Remove from tawa and serve hot.

name: Indian Style White Sauce Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in water with salt and oil until cooked. Make white sauce: heat butter, add maida and roast for 2 minutes. Add milk gradually while stirring to avoid lumps. Add black pepper, salt, chilli flakes and oregano. Heat oil and butter separately. Add garlic, onion and sauté. Add capsicum, carrot and broccoli. Season with spices. Add tomato ketchup and cheese. Mix in white sauce with cooked pasta. Mix well and serve hot.

name: Chana Dal Palak
instructions: Soak chana dal for 1-2 hours. Heat oil and ghee together. Add bay leaf, black cardamom and cinnamon stick. Add chopped onion and fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add tomato and cook until soft. Add chana dal with water. Pressure cook until dal is soft. Add chopped spinach. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and garam masala. Mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Kerala Crispy Onion Vada
instructions: Slice onions thinly. Mix gram flour, all purpose flour and rice flour. Add sliced onions, finely chopped ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, coriander leaves, asafoetida, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Mix with minimal water to form a thick batter that coats the onions. Heat oil in a pan for deep frying. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture and fry until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

name: Oreo Dry Fruits Laddoo
instructions: 1. Grind the Oreo cookies into fine powder. 2. Roast the dry nuts (cashews, almonds, walnuts) in ghee and coarsely grind them. 3. Mix the cookie powder and roasted nut mixture with ghee or butter. 4. Shape into laddoos and coat with sesame seeds. 5. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container.

name: Aloo Gobi Matar
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, bay leaves and cinnamon. Once fragrant, add chopped onions and cook until golden. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add diced potatoes and cauliflower florets. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, sabzi masala and garam masala powder. Mix well and cook covered until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Veg Soya Biryani
instructions: 1. Soak soya chunks in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry. 2. Cook rice separately until 80% done. 3. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot, add onions and cook until golden brown. 4. Reserve half the fried onions for garnish. 5. Add ginger-garlic paste to remaining onions and cook for 1 minute. 6. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. 7. Add all spices and soya chunks, stir well. 8. Add curd and mix. 9. Layer cooked rice on top of the soya-spice mixture. 10. Layer remaining fried onions and mint on rice. 11. Dissolve saffron in warm milk and pour over rice. 12. Cover and cook on high heat for 2 minutes until steam forms, then cook on low heat for 8-10 minutes. 13. Let rest for 3 minutes before serving.

name: Poha Uttapam
instructions: UTTAPAM: 1. Mix poha and sooji and grind to a coarse powder. 2. Add curd and water to make a semi-thick batter. 3. Rest for 15 minutes. 4. Add salt to taste. 5. Just before cooking, add Eno and mix well. 6. Heat a non-stick pan and grease with oil. 7. Pour batter and spread into a round shape. 8. Optional: add chopped vegetables, chilli flakes, and oregano on top. 9. Cover and cook for 2-3 minutes on medium heat. 10. Flip and cook the other side until golden. CHUTNEY: 1. Heat 1 tbsp oil. 2. Add urad dal and chana dal, roast for 30 seconds. 3. Add minced garlic and dry red chilli. 4. Add diced onions and cook until translucent. 5. Add tomato pieces and salt. 6. Cook for 3 minutes. 7. Cool and blend until smooth. 8. Serve uttapam with chutney.

name: Chocolate Thandai Gujiya
instructions: Make thandai masala by grinding almonds, cashew, pista, fennel seeds, peppercorns, watermelon seeds, poppy seeds, cardamom, rose petals, saffron and nutmeg. Prepare flour dough with maida, powdered sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, milk, butter, vanilla and water. Fill dough with khoya mixed with sugar and thandai masala. Shape into gujiya and deep fry until golden. Can also prepare instant thandai by mixing masala with milk and sugar.

name: Potato Grilled Sandwich
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes and mix with grated beetroot, capsicum, carrot, cheese, chilli flakes and oregano. Spread green chutney and tomato ketchup on bread slices. Layer with potato mixture between two slices. Butter the outside. Grill on a tawa or sandwich maker until golden and crispy on both sides.

name: Crispy Bread Pakora
instructions: Mix all purpose flour and rice flour with tomato sauce, schezwan chutney, salt and chopped vegetables. Cut bread slices into triangles or desired shapes. Dip bread pieces in the batter coating evenly. Heat oil in a pan and deep fry the coated bread until golden and crispy on all sides. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

name: Instant Chole Bhature
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, mace and black cardamom. Add finely chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates. Add all spice powders and salt. Add boiled chickpeas and mix well. Cook for 8-10 minutes on medium heat. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot with bhature.

name: Gujarati Stuffed Green Chilli
instructions: Dry roast besan for 2 minutes in a pan. Wash green chillies and carefully cut them lengthwise. Remove seeds with a knife or spoon. Grind sev bhujia into fine powder. Mix besan, bhujia powder, turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt and lemon juice. Stuff this mixture into the hollowed green chillies. Heat oil in a pan and fry stuffed chillies for 4-5 minutes, flipping occasionally until cooked and edges are crispy.

name: Oreo Mango Shrikhand
instructions: Crush oreo cookies into coarse powder, reserving some for topping. Blend ripe mango chunks into puree. Whip yogurt until smooth. Mix mango puree with yogurt and cardamom powder. Gently fold in crushed oreo cookies. Divide into serving glasses or bowls. Top with remaining crushed oreos. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

name: pista kulfi
instructions: Reduce milk by half on medium heat. Add sugar and crushed pista to milk. Add green food colour and rice flour. Pour into kulfi moulds and freeze for 6-8 hours. For ice cream: whip fresh cream, add condensed milk and pista, freeze for 4 hours.

name: sooji paneer paratha
instructions: Mix fine semolina with crumbled paneer, onion, coriander leaves and green chilli. Add coriander powder, cumin powder, red chilli powder, cumin seeds and salt. Bind with water to form dough. Knead well. Roll into parathas and cook on hot griddle with oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: chole paneer masala
instructions: Pressure cook soaked chole with water, bay leaves, cinnamon, black cardamom and tea bag. Roast cumin, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, black pepper, nutmeg, green cardamom, dry red chilli and mace to make bhuna masala. Grind the spices. Cook onion paste and tomato paste with ghee, ginger, garlic and green chilli as tadka. Add bhuna masala powder. Mix in cooked chole and simmer until gravy thickens. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Cheese Burst Pizza
instructions: For pizza dough: Mix refined flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, and salt. Add water and curd, knead soft dough, then add oil and knead well. Cover and set aside. For cheese sauce: In a pan add milk, cornstarch, and half the cheese, heat and melt cheese until thick. Add remaining cheese and mix until combined, then refrigerate. Prepare pizza toppings by mixing diced vegetables and salt. For pizza sauce: Heat oil, sauté garlic and onion until translucent, add tomato puree, sugar, vinegar, salt, oregano, and chilli flakes, cook until most water evaporates. Assemble pizza: Take 2 portions of dough, roll thin and cook on flat pan from both sides. Make two more portions, roll thin but 1-2 inches larger. Oil a tray and place larger uncooked dough. Spread cheese sauce on it (avoid edges). Place smaller cooked roti where cheese is spread, fold uncooked edges over it. Spread pizza sauce, add toppings, sprinkle pizza cheese, oil the uncooked sides. Bake in preheated kadai or oven at 200°C for 15 minutes until cheese melts and becomes golden. Serve warm.

name: oats besan chilla with vegetables
instructions: Grind or blend oats coarsely. Mix oats with gram flour, turmeric powder and salt. Add water to make thick batter. Add all chopped and grated vegetables. Mix well. Heat griddle and lightly oil. Pour batter and spread evenly. Cook on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes until golden. Flip and cook other side for 1-2 minutes until crispy.

name: aloo laccha pakora
instructions: Peel and wash potatoes. Mix gram flour, rice flour, and spices. Shred potatoes. Combine shredded potatoes with gram flour mixture and water to form a batter. Heat oil and fry spoonfuls of batter until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels.

name: egg tawa burger
instructions: Slice boiled eggs. Toast burger buns lightly with butter. Heat oil and temper with cumin seeds. Add eggs with spices and mix gently. Place spiced eggs and cheese on bun halves. Serve hot.

name: prawn malai curry
instructions: Heat oil and ghee, add bay leaves, dry red chilli, cloves, and cinnamon. Add onion paste and cook until golden. Add ginger paste, turmeric, and chilli powder. Add cleaned prawns and cook until done. Add coconut milk and green chilli. Simmer until oil separates and curry thickens. Season with sugar and salt.

name: aloo palak vada
instructions: Blanch spinach briefly and chop fine. Mix mashed potato with gram flour and spices. Add spinach, ginger garlic paste, green chilli, lemon juice, and chopped onion. Form into cutlets or patties. Coat with sesame seeds. Heat oil and fry until golden on both sides.

name: tandoori coffee
instructions: Prepare coffee in usual Indian way by boiling milk, adding coffee powder and sugar, and straining. Heat a clay pot in tandoor or over flame until very hot. Pour prepared coffee into the hot clay pot to absorb smoky flavors and impart tandoor aroma.

name: biscuit choco log
ingredients: good day choco chips biscuit - 2 packs
instructions: Crush biscuits into fine crumbs. Melt dark chocolate with water and coffee powder. Mix melted chocolate with biscuit crumbs and melted butter. Combine powdered sugar and cocoa powder. Line mold with plastic wrap, add chocolate biscuit mixture, press down, and chill. Dust with cocoa-sugar mixture, unmold, and slice.

name: Double Cheese Chilli Sandwich
instructions: Sauté garlic, green chilli, cabbage, onion, and capsicum in butter with chilli flakes, mixed herbs, and black pepper. Spread mixture on bread slices and toast until golden. Serve hot.

name: Atta Chilla
instructions: Mix wheat flour with curd and chopped vegetables (onion, carrot, capsicum, beans, cabbage, tomato, green chilli, coriander leaves). Add carom seeds, turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, ginger garlic paste, and salt. Make a thick batter. Pour on a greased skillet or griddle and cook until golden on both sides.

name: Chole Pulao
instructions: Heat oil and ghee; temper with cumin seeds. Add chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add boiled chickpeas and all powdered spices. Stir well. Add rice and mix gently. Add water (1.5-2 cups), salt, and bring to boil. Cover and cook on low heat until rice is tender and water is absorbed.

name: Aloo Gobhi Ki Sabzi
instructions: For masala mixture: In a bowl add water, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, asafoetida, cumin powder and mix. For aloo gobi sabzi: In a kadai heat ghee and add cumin seeds, ginger, green chillies, garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add prepared masala mixture and saute till ghee starts separating. Add cauliflower, potatoes, salt and water, mix well. Cover and cook on low heat for 10-12 minutes. Remove lid and stir in coriander leaves. Switch off flame, cover and keep for 2-3 minutes. Serve in a bowl garnished with coriander leaves.

name: Pink Forest Cake
instructions: Mix maida, sugar powder, milk powder, baking powder, and baking soda. In separate bowl, mix warm milk, vanilla essence, and cooking oil. Combine wet and dry ingredients until smooth. Pour into greased baking pan. Bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely. Layer with whipped cream and white chocolate. Add pink food colour to whipped cream layer. Top with sprinkles and white chocolate shavings.

name: Wheat Pizza (Atta Pizza)
instructions: Mix wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar to make a dough. Let it rest for 10 minutes. Roll out the dough and cook on a tawa. Once the bottom is cooked, add pizza sauce, cheese, and vegetable toppings. Cover and cook until cheese melts.

name: Domino's Style Veg Pizza
instructions: Activate yeast with sugar and warm water. Mix with flour and oil to make dough. Let it rise for 2-3 hours. Knead again and shape into pizza base. Top with pizza sauce, vegetables, and cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 200°C for 15-20 minutes until golden and cheese is melted.

name: Besan ka Halwa
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add besan. Roast the besan on medium heat, stirring continuously, until it becomes light brown and fragrant. In another pan, dissolve sugar in water and bring to boil. Add the roasted besan to the sugar syrup gradually, stirring constantly. Keep stirring until well combined and the mixture thickens. Add saffron and serve warm.

name: bread pizza
instructions: Spread tomato sauce on bread slices. Top with sautéed onions, garlic and mixed vegetables. Add grated cheese evenly. Toast in oven or on a pan until cheese melts and bread is golden brown.

name: Mint Poori and Paneer Sabzi
instructions: For mint poori: Mix wheat flour, finely chopped mint leaves, spices, and salt. Add water and knead into a stiff dough. Let it rest for 15 minutes. Roll into thin circles and deep fry until puffed and golden. For paneer sabzi: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, then onions. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add paneer cubes and remaining spices. Cook until paneer is coated with the masala. Serve poori hot with paneer sabzi.

name: Vegetable Quesadilla
ingredients: cooking oil or olive oil 2 tbsp
instructions: Mix wheat flour, all purpose flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Add ghee and knead with water to form soft dough. Let rest for 15 minutes. For filling: combine chopped onions, all capsicums, tomato, corn, olives, cheese, chilli flakes, and salt. Divide dough into balls, roll out into thin circles. Place cheese and vegetable filling on one half, fold in half and seal edges. Cook on griddle or tawa with oil until tortilla is golden and cheese melts. Serve hot.

name: Aloo Matar Curry
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Add turmeric and coriander powder, cook for 30 seconds. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add cubed potatoes and peas, mix well. Add 1/2 cup water and salt. Cover and cook on medium heat until potatoes are tender (about 15 minutes). Add garam masala and cook for 2 more minutes. Garnish with green coriander.

name: Aflatoon Paratha
ingredients: cooking oil or ghee for cooking
instructions: Make dough: mix wheat flour with salt and 1 tbsp oil, knead with water to form soft dough. Let rest for 15 minutes. Prepare filling: combine grated cauliflower, carrot, cabbage, chopped capsicum, garlic, tomato, grated cheese, schezwan chutney, and salt in a bowl. Divide dough into 4 equal portions. Roll each into a thin circle, spread filling in center, fold edges and seal. Roll gently to flatten without breaking. Cook on a hot griddle with ghee or oil, pressing gently, until both sides are golden brown and cooked through. Serve hot with pickle or yogurt.

name: Semiya Fruit Custard
instructions: Prepare custard: mix custard powder with 1/2 cup milk to form paste. Heat remaining 1.5 cups milk with sugar until hot. Pour milk mixture into custard paste slowly while stirring to avoid lumps. Cook on medium heat for 3-5 minutes until thickened. In a separate pan, dry roast semiya until light golden, then add to boiling water and cook until soft. Drain and cool. Combine cooked semiya with custard sauce. Chop mixed fruits (apple, banana, grapes). Fold fruits into custard-semiya mixture. Chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours. Serve cold.

name: Egg Burger
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Chop onion and tomato finely. Add to oil and fry lightly. Beat eggs and pour into the pan, scrambling until cooked through. Season with salt. Toast pav on a griddle with butter until warm and slightly crispy. Spread mayonnaise and tomato ketchup on the bottom pav. Add the cooked egg mixture. Top with onion slices, tomato slices, green chutney. Garnish with sev bhujiya. Cover with top pav half and serve hot.

name: Soupy Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta and set aside. Heat butter in a pan, add finely chopped vegetables (tomato, carrot, capsicum, mushroom, cabbage) and sauté until softened. Pour pasta sauce into the pan, add boiled pasta and mix well. Dissolve corn flour in water and add to create a soupy consistency. Season with black pepper powder and salt. Garnish with mint or coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Paneer Tikka Dosa
instructions: Prepare dosa batter from MTR dosa mix as per package instructions. Cut paneer into small pieces and marinate in a mixture of ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, and salt for 10 minutes. Heat a non-stick tawa or griddle on medium heat, spread dosa batter to form a thin crepe. Once semi-cooked, place marinated paneer pieces on one half of the dosa, fold or roll, and cook until golden and crispy. Serve hot with sambar and chutney.

name: Bread Chilla
instructions: Soak bread slices in water and squeeze out excess water. Mix soaked bread with semolina and curd to form a thick batter. Add finely chopped onion, capsicum, tomato, ginger, green chilli, and coriander leaves to the batter. Season with red chilli powder, garam masala, dry mango powder, and salt. Just before cooking, add baking soda and mix gently. Heat oil on a griddle, pour batter to form a thick pancake (chilla) and cook until golden on both sides. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

name: Cheese Corn Toast
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Finely chop capsicum and onion. Mix grated cheese with finely chopped vegetables, mixed herbs, oregano, chilli flakes, black pepper, chat masala, and salt. Spread this mixture generously on the buttered bread slices. Place on a heated tawa or griddle and cook until the cheese melts and the bread becomes golden and crispy. Serve hot immediately.

name: Coconut Laddoo
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine desiccated coconut with condensed milk and mix thoroughly until well combined. The mixture should hold together easily. Take small portions of the mixture and roll between your palms to form smooth, round balls (laddoos). Arrange on a plate and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving. No heat required.

name: Veg Pizza
instructions: Make dough by mixing all-purpose flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, sugar, cooking oil, and water. Knead into a soft dough and let rest for 5 minutes. Divide into 2 portions and roll out into pizza bases. Heat ghee or oil in a large kadhai (wok), carefully place pizza base in it. Spread pizza sauce, schezwan chutney, and tomato ketchup on the base. Layer with finely chopped tomato, capsicum, sweet corn, onion, and olives. Sprinkle grated cheese generously over toppings. Cover kadhai with a lid and cook on medium-low heat until cheese melts and the base becomes golden and crispy. Finish with chilli flakes and oregano. Carefully remove from kadhai and serve hot.

name: Egg Omelette in Tomato
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a pan. Chop onion and chilli finely and sauté until softened. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they become soft and pulpy. Beat eggs in a bowl with salt and chopped coriander leaves, and add grated cheese if desired. Pour beaten eggs into the tomato mixture and stir gently to combine. Cover and cook on medium heat until eggs are cooked through and omelette is set. Fold and serve hot.

name: Aata Laddoo
instructions: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan on medium heat. Add wheat flour gradually and roast it continuously for 8-10 minutes until it turns light golden in color and gives a nutty aroma. Add chopped cashew, almonds, raisins, and lotus seeds, and fry for 2-3 minutes. Add edible gum pieces and fry for 1 minute. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Add powdered sugar and mix well. Once cooled to handleable temperature, shape into laddoos. Store in an airtight container.

name: Besan Ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat cooking oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, cloves, and bay leaves and let them crackle. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Mix gram flour with water to create a smooth paste and add to the pan. Stir continuously to avoid lumps. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, carom seeds, and black pepper powder. Add water gradually to achieve desired curry consistency. Cook on medium heat for 5-7 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with bread or rice.

name: bhatura
instructions: Take refined flour and add semolina, salt, sugar, and oil. Mix well. Knead soft dough with freshly opened soda water. Grease hands with oil and knead for 3-4 minutes. Cover and rest dough for 30 minutes. Break lemon-sized lumps from dough and shape into balls with dry flour. Press and roll out evenly with rolling pin, keeping slightly thick. Heat oil in wok and fry bhatura until puffy and golden brown on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Fried Masala Maggi
instructions: Boil maggi noodles according to package instructions and drain. Heat oil in a wok, add garlic and green chilli. Add chopped onion and stir-fry. Add all vegetables and cook until tender. Add cooked noodles and sauces (red chilli, soy, ketchup, vinegar). Toss everything together until well combined and serve hot.

name: Desi Style Paneer Tacos
instructions: Mix multigrain flour with water and salt to make a soft dough. Divide into portions and roll out thin sheets. Heat oil in a pan and cook the sheets until done. Prepare paneer filling by mixing crumbled paneer, chopped onion, capsicum, and sauces with oregano and chilli flakes. Top the cooked sheets with paneer mixture and fold into taco shape. Serve with mayonnaise or green chutney.

name: Healthy Soya Cutlet
instructions: Soak soya chunks in warm water for 10 minutes and squeeze out excess water. Mince or blend the soaked chana dal. Mix soya chunks, chana dal, gram flour, finely chopped onion, coriander leaves, green chilli, ginger, garlic, and spices. Form into cutlet shapes. Shallow fry in oil until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Egg Maggi
instructions: Boil maggi noodles according to package instructions and drain. Heat oil in a pan and scramble the eggs lightly. Remove eggs and set aside. In the same pan, add onions, capsicum, and green chilli, stir-fry briefly. Add all spice powders and mix. Add cooked noodles and toss well. Gently fold in the scrambled eggs. Top with grated cheese and serve hot.

name: Spicy Veg Toast
instructions: Mix gram flour with chopped vegetables (onion, carrot, french beans, tomato), add coriander leaves, chilli flakes, garam masala, turmeric powder and salt. Spread mixture on bread slices, shallow fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: Dragon Paneer
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes and coat with corn flour and all purpose flour mixture. Deep fry until golden. In a wok, sauté garlic, onion and capsicum in hot oil. Add paneer, mix in schezwan chutney, chilli sauce, soy sauce, ketchup and spices. Toss well and serve hot with spring onion garnish.

name: Chilli Bread
instructions: In hot oil, sauté minced garlic and green chilli. Add chopped onion and capsicum, cook until soft. Add tomato and cook for 1-2 minutes. Mix in schezwan chutney, ketchup, vinegar and soy sauce. Cube the bread slices and add to the mixture, toss gently until bread is coated. Serve hot garnished with spring onion.

name: Vegetables in Hot Garlic Sauce with Garlic Rice
instructions: Blanch all vegetables. Make a sauce by stir-frying ginger and garlic, add vegetables, then add soya sauce, vinegar, ketchup, green chilli sauce and schezwan sauce. Thicken with cornflour slurry. Season with black pepper. For garlic rice, heat oil and butter, add crushed garlic, then add boiled rice and mix well. Season with black pepper and salt. Serve vegetables over or alongside garlic rice.

name: potato cheese nuggets
instructions: Boil water with ginger and green chillies. Add semolina, capsicum, black pepper, mango powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cover for 5 minutes then turn off flame. Grate boiled potatoes. Cut mozzarella cheese into small pieces. Once semolina has puffed up, add to potato bowl with green coriander and mix well. Grease palms with oil, pinch out dough, place cheese cube inside, and shape into oval nugget. Fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serve hot with green coriander chutney or tomato sauce.

name: Aata ka Halwa
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan. Add wheat flour and roast on medium heat, stirring continuously until it turns golden brown and fragrant. In a separate pot, dissolve sugar in 2 cups water and bring to boil. Carefully add the sugar syrup to the roasted flour while stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Continue cooking until the mixture becomes soft and moist, resembling butter. Add crushed almonds and cashews if desired. Serve warm in bowls.

name: Tomato Pulao with Raita
instructions: For pulao: Heat oil, add mustard seeds. When they splutter, add onions and cook until golden. Add green chillies, curry leaves and ginger-garlic paste. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add peas, peanuts and all spice powders. Add cooked rice and toss gently. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves. For raita: Mix curd with finely chopped cucumber, tomato, onion and green chilli. Season with salt and red chilli powder. Serve pulao with raita.

name: Til Chikki
instructions: Dry roast sesame seeds until golden. Heat jaggery until it melts and turns into a thin syrup at hard ball stage. Add roasted sesame seeds and salt, mix quickly. Pour onto greased parchment paper or marble slab. Press with oiled hands to flatten. Cool completely and break into pieces.

name: Paneer Tikki Burger
instructions: For patties: crumble paneer and mash boiled potato together. Mix with flours, bread crumbs, chopped vegetables, spices and ginger-garlic paste to form a dough. Shape into 5 patties. Heat oil and deep fry patties until golden brown. Drain on paper. Toast buns lightly with butter. Spread mayonnaise and tomato ketchup on lower bun. Layer with lettuce, tomato slices, capsicum slices, fried paneer tikki patty, and cheese slice. Season with black pepper. Close with upper bun. Serve hot.

name: Vanilla Ice Cream
instructions: Simmer milk in a vessel. Mix cornflour with milk in another bowl to dissolve lumps. Place cream in a bowl over ice cubes and whip for 2 minutes. Once milk boils gently, add cornflour mixture and stir. Simmer for 5-6 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent browning at base, until thick and dense. Turn off flame and cool. Add vanilla essence to whipped cream and whip for 1 minute. Add powdered sugar and whip for 1 minute more. Add cooled milk to cream mixture and stir well. Deep freeze for 1.5-2 hours. Remove and whip for 3-4 minutes. Place back in freezer for 5-6 hours. Garnish with dry fruits or fresh fruits when serving. Serve immediately.

name: English Breakfast
instructions: Boil or steam vegetables: cut carrots into batons, cut broccoli into florets, trim french beans. Steam all vegetables for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp. Toast brown bread slices and apply butter. Heat a non-stick pan with 1 tsp butter and crack the egg into it. Cook until whites are set while yolk remains runny (sunny side up). Arrange steamed vegetables on a plate. Place toasted buttered bread on the side. Place fried egg in the center. Season with salt and black pepper. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the vegetables. Serve immediately.

name: Ragada Patties
instructions: Boil dried white peas until soft and cook with spices (turmeric, red chilli, dry mango powder, asafoetida). Set aside. Boil and peel potatoes, then mash. Mix mashed potatoes with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, dry mango powder, and asafoetida. Form into oval patties and dust lightly with cornflour. Heat oil and shallow or deep fry patties until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot on a plate. Top with cooked white peas. Garnish with chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, and coriander. Drizzle with green and tamarind chutneys. Add a dollop of yogurt and sprinkle sev bhujiya on top. Serve immediately.

name: Shimlamirch Ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds, black cardamom, and cinnamon stick. Add finely chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add turmeric, red chilli, cumin, coriander, and garam masala powders. Cut capsicums into pieces and add to the curry. Cook on high heat with lid on for 3-4 minutes. Stir in curd and cook for 2-3 minutes more. Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Aloo Parval Ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a pot. Add cumin seeds and bay leaves. Once they crackle, add finely chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute. Add tomato paste and cook until oil separates. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Mix well. Cut potatoes and pointed gourds into pieces and add to the curry. Cover and cook on medium heat for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add maggi masala and salt. Cook for 2-3 more minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Aloo Imli Ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and mustard seeds and let them crackle. Add curry leaves. Add finely chopped onion and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli, cook for a minute. Add tomato pieces and cook until soft. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Mix well. Add boiled and peeled baby potatoes. Add tamarind juice and mix gently. Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring carefully so potatoes don't break. Add salt to taste and cook for another minute. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Makhanwala
instructions: Heat butter, temper with cinnamon and black cardamom. Sauté sliced onions until golden. Add ginger garlic paste, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander, cumin, and garam masala. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates (about 5-7 minutes). Add fresh cream and paneer cubes. Sprinkle dry fenugreek leaves and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Garlic Masala Paratha
instructions: Mince garlic cloves finely. Mix wheat flour with minced garlic, red chilli, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, and salt. Add oil and knead with water into soft dough. Let rest 10-15 minutes. Divide into portions, roll out into thin circles. Cook on hot griddle/tawa with oil on both sides until light brown spots appear.

name: Raw Banana Chips
instructions: Peel raw bananas and slice very thinly. Mix salt and water, coat banana slices. Heat oil for frying. Fry banana slices in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

name: Jackfruit Masala
instructions: Heat oil in pressure cooker, temper with cumin seeds and bay leaves. Add black cardamom and cinnamon stick. Slice onions and sauté until golden. Make paste of ginger and garlic, add to onions along with green chilli. Add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander, cumin, and garam masala powders. Cook for 2 minutes. Add jackfruit pieces and salt, mix well. Add 1 cup water, close cooker and cook for 3-4 whistles on high heat. Let pressure release naturally. Open, add ghee and fresh coriander leaves. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

name: Sooji Pizza
instructions: Mix semolina with curd and let sit for 5 minutes. Add rice flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, and salt. Mix well to form thick dough-like batter. Heat ghee on tawa/griddle, spread batter evenly to form pizza base about 1/4 inch thick. Cook for 2 minutes on high heat. Spread pizza sauce over the base, top with chopped jalapeno, capsicum, tomato, corn, and mozzarella cheese. Cover and cook for 3 minutes until cheese melts and base is crispy on bottom. Slice and serve hot.

name: Shahi Chicken Kabab
instructions: Toast cumin and coriander seeds, then grind with dry red chillies, black pepper, ginger, and garlic into a paste. Combine with boneless chicken, add soaked chana dal, green chilli, egg, coriander and mint leaves, salt. Mix well and refrigerate. Shape into kababs and fry on oil until golden brown.

name: Ghughra Sandwich
instructions: Make a paste of green chillies, coconut, garlic, ginger, coriander leaves, salt, and lemon juice. Mix in grated cheese. Spread this mixture on bread slices and cook on a hot tava with butter until golden. Sprinkle chaat masala and chilli flakes.

name: Gond Laddoo
instructions: Dry roast wheat flour in ghee until golden. Roast edible gum separately until it puffs up. Chop nuts finely. In a pan, heat remaining ghee, add roasted flour, roasted gum, chopped nuts, poppy seeds, lotus seeds, fenugreek leaves, and sugar. Mix well and cook on low heat until combined. Cool slightly, then roll into laddoos.

name: Maggi Burger
instructions: Boil and cook Maggi noodles as per package, then remove and cool. Chop onion, tomato, and green chilli. Mix cooled noodles with chopped vegetables, spices, and tastemaker. Shape into patties and pan-fry in oil until golden. Toast burger buns with butter. Assemble with ketchup, noodle patty, cheese, and vegetable slices.

name: vegetable frankie
instructions: Mix wheat flour and all purpose flour with salt and water to make a stiff dough. Roll out into thin sheets and cook on griddle. Boil potatoes and mash with chopped garlic, green chilli, spices, dry mango powder. Shred cabbage, carrot, capsicum and tomato. Spread potato filling on cooked sheet, add vegetables and cheese, apply ketchup and mayo, roll tightly and wrap with flour paste. Shallow fry or deep fry until crispy.

name: double stuffed aloo paratha
instructions: Make dough with wheat flour, salt and water. Let rest. Boil and mash potatoes with ginger, green chilli, garlic, coriander leaves and spices. Roll dough thin, fill with potato mixture using stuffing technique to prevent cracking, seal well, roll gently. Cook on hot griddle with oil until golden spots appear on both sides.

name: vegetable spring roll
instructions: Make spring roll sheets: Mix all purpose flour with salt, oil and water to make thin dough. Cook thin sheets on griddle. Prepare filling: Finely chop onion, garlic, ginger. Stir fry vegetables with spices and sauces. Place filling on sheet, roll tightly, seal edge with flour-water paste. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.

name: dahi bhindi
instructions: Chop bhindi into small pieces. Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add finely chopped onion and fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and fry. Add bhindi pieces and cook on high heat until moisture evaporates. Add spices, turmeric and red chilli powder. Stir in yogurt and cook on medium heat until bhindi is tender and creamy.

name: masala moong dal khichdi
instructions: Wash rice and moong dal. Heat ghee and oil, add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add diced onion and fry until golden. Add diced vegetables and tomato, stir fry. Add washed rice and dal, bay leaves, cinnamon, curry leaves. Add water and salt. Cook in pressure cooker or pot until rice and dal are tender. Prepare tadka by frying garlic and dry red chillies in ghee. Pour tadka over cooked khichdi and serve hot.

name: bread pockets
instructions: Chop vegetables finely. Mix vegetables with tomato sauce and schezwan chutney. Place filling on bread slices, fold to form pockets. Seal edges by pressing. Heat oil in pan, fry pockets until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with sauce.

name: jaggery cake with wheat flour
instructions: Mix wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In another bowl, combine melted ghee, grated jaggery, milk and curd. Mix wet and dry ingredients until smooth batter forms. Pour into greased pressure cooker vessel. Cook in pressure cooker for one whistle or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool and serve.

name: Cheesy Masala Pav
instructions: Make cheese sauce: boil water in stock pot, place bowl over it (water not touching), add cheese, butter, and milk to bowl, mix well until melted. Use blender for smooth consistency. Alternatively microwave in 30-second intervals. Cut pav into 9 equal cubes. Heat pan, add butter and jeera, sauté 1 minute. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add red chilli paste and garlic paste, cook until oil releases. Add capsicum, tomatoes, salt, and pav bhaji masala, cook 4-5 minutes until tomatoes are mushy. Add pav cubes, mix gently with light hands to coat masala. Add coriander leaves and lemon juice. Pour fresh cheese sauce over masala pav. Serve hot.

name: Navratri Fasting Thali
instructions: Prepare three components: 1) Sabudana Vada: Mix soaked sago with boiled potato, peanut powder, green chilli, coriander, cumin, rock salt. Shape into vadas and deep fry. 2) Sama ka Pulav: Cook sama rice with cumin seeds in ghee, add boiled potato and green chilli. 3) Singhare ke aate ki poori: Make dough with singhara atta, potato, spices and water, roll and fry. Serve together with aloo ki sabzi and accompaniments.

name: Chana Dal Pakora
ingredients: chilli flakes or chilli powder 1/2 tsp
instructions: Grind soaked chana dal coarsely with ginger, garlic, and green chillies. Mix in onion, coriander leaves, curry leaves, and spice powders. Make batter of dropping consistency. Heat oil and drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil. Fry until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Serve with green chutney.

name: Naankhatai
instructions: Cream together ghee and powdered sugar until light. Mix in sifted flour with baking powder and baking soda. Add cardamom powder and milk. Mix to form a soft dough. Shape into balls or discs. Bake in kadhai on low heat for 15 minutes until golden, turning occasionally.

name: Bombay Aloo Toast
ingredients: tandoori or mayonnaise or green chutney 2 tbsp
instructions: Mix boiled potatoes with red chilli powder, chaat masala, and coriander leaves. Toast bread slices. Spread butter or mayonnaise on each slice. Apply the potato mixture on two slices. Top with capsicum, tomato, onion, and grated cheese. Place another slice on top. Toast in a griddle until cheese melts.

name: Aloo Cheela
instructions: Grate potatoes and mix with onion, gram flour and spices. Make thin pancake-like crepes in oil on medium flame until golden brown on both sides.

name: Methi na Dhebra
instructions: Mix wheat, bajra and jowar flours with chopped greens (spinach, methi, spring onion), green garlic, chilli and spices. Add curd and water to form dough. Roll and cook as paratha or griddle bread.

name: Aloo Chips
instructions: Slice potatoes thin. Soak in water, pat dry thoroughly. Deep fry in hot oil on high heat until golden and crispy. Drain on paper and season with salt to taste.

name: Cabbage Manchurian
instructions: Mix grated cabbage with onion, peppers, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder and flour (corn, all purpose, rice). Form into balls and deep fry until golden. Toss fried balls with sauces (soy, green chilli, red chilli, schezwan) and vinegar until well coated.

name: bathua paratha
instructions: For mixed paratha: Grind chopped bathua with green chili and ginger paste into paste. Mix with wheat flour, salt, mango powder, turmeric, coriander, garam masala, red chili and asafoetida. Knead into soft dough with water. Rest 15-20 minutes. Roll into thin square parathas and cook on oiled pan until brown spots appear. For stuffed paratha: Cook bathua with spices as filling. Stuff into dough portions, seal, roll, and cook until golden and crispy.

name: Stuffed Rava Appe
instructions: Mix sooji and curd together. Add eno, chilli flakes, and chopped vegetables including onion, carrot, capsicum, green chilli, and french beans. Mix in coriander leaves and salt. Heat appe pan with oil. Pour mixture into appe molds and cook on medium-high heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Dahi Baingan
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped onion and sauté until golden. Cut brinjal into pieces and add to the pan. Mix curd with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Pour this mixture over brinjal. Add hing, salt and mix well. Cover and cook on medium heat until brinjal is tender, about 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Oreo Biscuit Cake
instructions: Crush oreo biscuits finely into powder. Mix with powdered sugar and baking powder. Add milk and mix to form a smooth batter. Grease a pressure cooker or cake tin, pour batter into it. Place on medium heat for about 40 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Allow to cool before turning out.

name: Mustard Sponge Gourd Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped onion and cook until translucent. Add minced garlic and chopped green chillies, sauté for 1-2 minutes. Cut sponge gourd into medium pieces and add to the pot. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, and salt. Mix well. Cook on medium-high heat for 15-20 minutes until sponge gourd is tender and oil separates. Serve hot.

name: Egg Paratha
instructions: Make a soft dough from all purpose flour, water and salt. Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Scramble eggs with finely chopped onion, green chillies, coriander leaves and salt. Divide dough into balls, roll each into a thin circle, place egg filling in center, gather edges and roll again into a paratha shape. Cook on a hot griddle with oil until golden and crispy on both sides.

name: Drumstick and Potato Curry
