instructions: Heat oil in a large pan. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, sauté for 1 minute. Add chopped green chillies and cook for another minute. Cut drumstick and potatoes into medium pieces and add to pan. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin seeds, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Mix well. Add chopped tomatoes and salt. Cover and cook on medium heat for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and oil separates. Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Tricolour Rava Appe
instructions: Mix rava with curd and let it rest for a few minutes. Add carrot paste and spinach paste for color and nutrition. Add finely chopped onion, grated ginger, hing, mustard seeds, salt, and optional green and red chillies. Add eno or baking soda just before cooking and mix gently. Heat appe pan with oil. Divide batter into three parts: pour plain (white) in first section, carrot (orange) in second section, and spinach (green) in third section to create tricolour design. Cook on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Serve hot.

name: Strawberry Cake
instructions: Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. In another bowl, combine condensed milk, melted butter, strawberry essence and powdered sugar. Mix milk into dry ingredients. Combine wet and dry mixtures. Pour into greased pressure cooker, cover, place over low heat for 40 minutes. Let cool completely. Whip the cream with sugar and strawberry essence. Frost cake, top with fresh strawberries and chocolate sprinkles.

name: Cabbage Pancake
instructions: Chop cabbage finely. Mix besan, green chilli, onion, coriander leaves, all spices and salt in a bowl. Add finely chopped cabbage and mix well with water to form pancake batter. Heat oil in pan. Pour batter and spread into pancake shape. Cook on both sides until golden brown. Serve hot with chutney or yogurt.

name: Besan Katli
instructions: Make besan dumplings: Mix besan with ginger garlic paste, all dry spices, salt and water. Boil in water until dumplings float. Remove and set aside. Make curry: Heat oil, add onion paste, tomato paste, ginger garlic paste and all spices. Cook until oil separates. Add curd, mix well. Add cooked besan dumplings and coriander leaves. Simmer for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Caramel Banoffee Laddoo
ingredients: nestlé milkmaid sweetened condensed milk - 1 tin
instructions: Place condensed milk can in pressure cooker filled with water up to 3/4th height of can. Pressure cook on high till first whistle, then on lowest flame for one hour. Cool completely. Transfer caramelized milk to bowl. Powder biscuits coarsely, keeping 1/2 cup aside for coating. Mix caramelized milk, powdered biscuits and vanilla essence to form dough. Shape into laddoos, coat with powdered biscuits and serve.

name: Jackfruit Sabzi
instructions: Peel jackfruit and remove seeds. Chop into medium pieces. Chop potatoes. Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds. When crackle, add onion paste and cook until golden. Add tomato paste, green chilli paste and ginger garlic paste. Cook until oil separates. Add all dry spices and jackfruit pieces. Stir well. Add potatoes and water. Cover and cook on medium heat until jackfruit and potatoes are tender. Add maggi masala and coriander leaves. Cook for 2 more minutes. Serve hot.

name: Black Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes, carrots, cauliflower and peas together. Roast fennel seeds, black pepper, cardamom, clove, cinnamon and mace. Grind roasted spices and mix with dry coconut. Add spice-coconut mixture to cooked vegetables and cook with oil, red chilli powder and pav bhaji masala until well combined. Serve hot with toasted pav and butter.

name: Spicy Garlic Potato
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add finely minced garlic cloves and cook until golden. Add boiled and cubed potatoes. Sprinkle red chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder. Mix well and cook until potatoes are coated. Add lemon juice and salt. Toss well and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: French Fries
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2 cm thickness. Soak in water for 15 minutes to release starch. Par-boil in simmering water at 80-85°C until about 20% cooked. Spread on flat tray and deep freeze for 1-1.5 hours. Heat oil to 130°C and fry potatoes for 80% doneness, remove to paper towel. Heat oil to 170°C and fry until completely crispy. Drain on paper towel, season with salt, sprinkle paprika powder and parmesan cheese. Serve hot.

name: Dal Fry with Jeera Rice
instructions: For dal: Pressure cook dal with turmeric and salt. Heat oil with cumin seeds and bay leaf. Add chopped onion and cook. Add minced garlic and chopped tomato. Cook until soft. Add cooked dal, red chilli powder, garam masala and asafoetida. Simmer until well combined. Add fried dry red chillies and garnish with coriander. For jeera rice: Heat ghee and oil. Add cumin seeds, bay leaves, cinnamon and cardamom. Add rice and stir. Add water and salt. Cook covered until rice is tender. Serve dal fry with jeera rice and papad.

name: Sooji Appe
instructions: Mix semolina with curd and let rest for 10 minutes until it absorbs the moisture. Add baking soda and mix gently until bubbly. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, let them crackle and pop. Add the hot oil with seeds to the semolina mixture. Finely chop and add ginger, green chilli, curry leaves, and coriander leaves. Fold in chopped onions and capsicum. The mixture should have a thick, dropping consistency. Heat an appe mold or frying pan on medium-high heat, lightly oil it. Pour the semolina batter into the mold cavities or create small mounds in the pan. Fry until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 4-5 minutes. Serve hot with coconut chutney or any preferred dipping sauce.

name: Veg Masala Momos
instructions: Make dough: Mix all purpose flour with water and knead into a smooth dough. Cover and rest for 15 minutes. Prepare filling: Finely chop cabbage, capsicum, and onion. Add minced garlic, chopped green chilli, salt, and sugar to the vegetables. Mix well. Make chutney: Blend tomatoes, 12 garlic cloves, and dry red chilli into a smooth paste. Heat oil in a pan and add the chutney paste. Cook until it reduces and oil separates from the masala, about 5-7 minutes. Add soy sauce, white vinegar, schezwan chutney, red chilli powder, and garam masala. Simmer for 2-3 minutes. Assemble momos: Divide dough into small portions and roll each into a thin circle. Place a spoonful of filling in the center. Gather the edges and pleat to form a momo shape. Steam the momos in a steamer or momo maker with water below for 8-10 minutes until the dough is cooked through. Serve hot with the prepared schezwan chutney.

name: punjabi chole masala
instructions: Soak kabuli chana for 6-8 hours. Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with water and 2 tea bags until tender. Heat oil in a large pan, add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add ginger paste and green chilly paste, sauté for 1 minute. Add finely chopped tomatoes, cook until soft. Add coriander powder, red chilly powder and turmeric. Mix well. Add cooked chickpeas with their water, diced potato, dry pomegranate seeds, fenugreek leaves and salt. Cook covered on medium heat until potato is tender (about 10-15 minutes). Add garam masala. Garnish with fresh green coriander. Serve hot.

name: Soya Chana Curry
instructions: Soak bengal gram overnight. Heat oil in a pressure cooker, add cumin seeds. Add chopped onions and fry till translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste and fry for a minute. Add chopped tomato and cook till soft. Add soaked bengal gram, soya chunks, water (about 2 cups), turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt. Close the lid and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles. Once done, open cooker, mix well and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Ghee Roast
instructions: Dry roast red chillies for 2-3 minutes. Dry roast other whole spices until fragrant. Blend roasted chillies and spices with garlic, ginger, and tamarind water into fine paste, adjust consistency with water. Heat ghee, shallow fry paneer cubes until golden brown. Heat ghee in wok, fry chopped onions until translucent. Add masala paste, stir and cook on low 1-2 minutes. Add curd, stir continuously. Increase heat, cook until ghee separates. Add salt and sugar/jaggery to taste. Cook another 2-3 minutes. Add fried paneer and curry leaves, coat with masala, cook 3-4 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Hariyali Paneer Tikka
instructions: Blend garlic cloves, green chilli, mint leaves, coriander leaves and dill leaves with curd and salt to make a smooth green marinade. Add mustard oil to the marinade. Cut paneer, onion and green capsicum into cubes. Coat paneer cubes with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, tandoori masala powder and garam masala powder. Add paneer to the green marinade and mix well. Let it rest for 10 minutes. Thread marinated paneer cubes alternately with onion and capsicum pieces onto skewers. Brush with oil and roast on a gas stove, turning occasionally until paneer is cooked and has charred edges. Serve hot with lemon wedges.

name: Mix Veg Pakoda
instructions: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Mix gram flour and rice flour together. Add ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, sabzi masala, lemon juice and salt to the flour mixture. Add chopped vegetables and mix well with your hands to form a thick, chunky batter. Heat oil in a deep pan or kadhai to medium-high temperature. Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil carefully. Fry on one side for 2-3 minutes, then flip and fry the other side until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Chicken Momo
instructions: Mix all-purpose flour with salt and cooking oil. Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough. Let it rest for 15 minutes, covered. Mince boneless chicken finely. In a bowl, combine minced chicken with salt, soy sauce, black pepper powder, chopped spring onion, chopped green chilli, chopped garlic and 1 tbsp oil. Mix well to make the filling. Divide dough into small balls. Roll out each ball into thin circles. Place a spoonful of chicken filling in the center of each circle. Fold and pleat the edges to create a dumpling shape, leaving a small opening at the top. Arrange momos in a steamer lined with damp cloth or parchment paper. Steam for 10-12 minutes until the dough is cooked and translucent. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Bhajjiya Pav
instructions: Slice onions thinly and separate layers. Mix turmeric, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, and salt. Add ginger garlic paste and chopped green chilli and coriander leaves to the spice mix. Coat onion layers with the spice mixture. Prepare a batter of gram flour and water or use the spiced onions directly. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Serve hot with pav bread and green chutney.

name: Sooji Uttapam
instructions: Mix semolina with curd and let rest for 5 minutes. Add baking soda and mix gently. Add ginger, coriander leaves, chilli flakes, diced capsicum, onion, paneer cubes, and schezwan chutney. Add salt to taste. Heat oil in a pan and pour the batter onto it, spreading evenly. Cook until edges are crispy and bottom is golden. Flip and cook the other side until done. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Chilli Idli
instructions: Mix cornstarch, refined flour, vinegar, salt, water to make a batter. Dip idli pieces in batter and deep fry until half done. Heat oil in wok, add ginger, garlic, onion, green chilli and saute for a minute. Add soya sauce and caramelize on high heat. Add tomato ketchup, red chilli sauce, capsicum and saute. Add water and cornstarch slurry, then add fried idlis and toss in sauce. Cook for a minute and garnish with spring onion.

name: Paneer Sabzi
instructions: Cut paneer into small cubes. Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Add finely chopped garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add sliced onions and cook until translucent. Add chopped green chilli and diced capsicum, stir fry for 2 minutes. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Add diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes. Add paneer cubes and mix gently. Cook for 3-4 minutes until paneer is heated through and vegetables are tender. Adjust seasoning and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Veg Soya Keema
instructions: Soak soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry and crumble coarsely. Heat oil in a pan and add cinnamon, black cardamom, and star anise. Add finely chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add turmeric and cook for 30 seconds. Add crumbled soya chunks and stir fry for 2 minutes. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Add chopped ginger and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add ghee and mix well. Cook for another 2 minutes. Adjust seasoning and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Sweet Samosa
instructions: Mix refined flour with salt, add melted ghee and water to form smooth pastry dough. Cover and rest for 15 minutes. Prepare filling: cook soaked chana lentils until soft, crush coarsely. Mix with powdered sugar, crushed cardamom, chopped cashews, raisins and almonds. Roll dough thin, cut into circles or squares. Place filling in center, fold into triangle, seal edges. Heat ghee in deep pan, deep fry samosas on medium heat until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towel and serve.

name: Fish Fry
instructions: Cut fish into pieces. Mix rava with turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, lemon juice and salt. Coat fish pieces with ginger garlic paste, then coat with rava mixture. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy on all sides.

name: malpua
instructions: Mix plain flour and milk powder together. Add milk and mix to form a batter. Prepare sugar syrup by heating sugar with water until it reaches one-string consistency. Heat ghee in a deep pan or wok. Drop small balls of batter into hot ghee using a spoon. Fry until golden on both sides. Dip fried malpuas into hot sugar syrup. Arrange on a plate and garnish with chopped almonds and pistachios. Sprinkle ground green cardamom. Serve warm.

name: Dudhouri
instructions: Boil rice and milk together to make a thick paste. Knead the mixture with maida and ghee. Shape into small balls. Deep fry until golden brown. Soak in warm sugar syrup flavored with cardamom. Serve warm or cold.

name: Paneer Kofta Curry
instructions: Mix crumbled paneer with chopped vegetables, flour, spices and lemon juice. Form into kofta balls and deep fry. For curry: sauté onion, ginger and garlic. Add tomato and ground spices. Add cream and cashew paste. Simmer and add fried koftas. Cook until gravy thickens.

name: Mango and Watermelon Milkshakes
instructions: For mango milkshake: blend ripe mango with sugar, cardamom powder and chilled milk. Add a scoop of mango or vanilla ice cream and blend again. Pour into glasses. For watermelon milkshake: blend watermelon chunks with sugar and chilled milk. Add vanilla ice cream and blend. Serve immediately.

name: Bread Pakoda
instructions: Prepare green chutney by blending green chilli, ginger, garlic, coriander leaves with curd and water. Mash boiled potatoes and mix with coriander leaves, garlic-green chilli paste, tomato ketchup and salt to make filling. Prepare gram flour batter with ajwain, turmeric, red chilli powder, baking soda and salt. Spread potato filling on bread slices, stack, cut into pieces. Dip in gram flour batter. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Macaroni Pakora
instructions: Boil macaroni until cooked. Mix boiled macaroni with gram flour and rice flour. Add ginger-garlic paste, chopped green chilli, onion, coriander leaves, turmeric, red chilli powder, salt and maggi masala. Form into balls or patties. Heat oil and deep fry pakoras until golden and crispy on all sides. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

name: Veg Fried Momos
instructions: Make dough with all purpose flour, salt and water. Let it rest. For filling: chop cabbage, onion and garlic. Stir-fry with green chillies, spring onion, black pepper, soy sauce and sugar. Cool filling. Roll dough into thin circles. Place filling in center and fold into momos shape. Heat oil and deep fry momos until golden. For chutney: chop tomato, onion and ginger. Sauté in oil. Add sugar, salt and vinegar. Simmer until thick. Serve fried momos with chutney.

name: Dalgona Coffee
instructions: Mix instant coffee, sugar, and hot water together and whip vigorously until frothy and light brown. Pour milk into a glass with ice cubes and top with the whipped coffee mixture.

name: Cheese Paneer Sandwich
instructions: Spread butter and mayonnaise on bread slices. Layer with crumbled paneer, onion, capsicum, and spring onion. Add shezwan chutney, tomato ketchup, and oregano. Press and grill on tawa until golden and crispy.

name: Dhaba Style Paneer Lamba
instructions: Cut paneer into finger-like pieces. Mix flours, garlic, green chilli, spring onion, and coriander. Coat paneer pieces in this mixture. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Rava Kesari
instructions: Roast rava in ghee until fragrant and light golden. Add water gradually, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Add sugar and stir until the mixture reaches a pudding-like consistency. Add saffron threads and food colour. Fold in dry fruits. Pour into a greased pan and serve warm.

name: louki paratha
instructions: Grate louki and squeeze out excess water. Mix grated louki with wheat flour, chopped green chilli, garlic, onion, and all spices. Knead into a soft dough adding water as needed. Let rest for 15 minutes. Divide into portions, roll out into thin parathas. Cook on hot griddle, applying ghee or oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: jowar dosa with red chutney
instructions: For dosa: Mix jowar flour with chopped green chilli, onion, coriander leaves, ginger, and salt. Add water to make a thick batter. Heat a griddle and pour batter in circular motion, spread thin. Cook until edges are crispy and flip to cook the other side until golden. For red chutney: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add roasted urad dal and chana dal, then add tomato, garlic cloves, and dry red chilli. Cook until soft, then grind with tamarind juice and sugar. Serve dosa hot with red chutney.

name: aloo laccha namkeen
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes. Cut into very thin strips using a knife or vegetable slicer. Soak cut potatoes in water for 5 minutes and drain well. Pat dry with a cloth. Heat cooking oil in a deep pan. Fry potatoes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally. Add raw peanuts midway through frying. In the final minute, add curry leaves. Remove from oil, drain on paper towel, sprinkle salt to taste. Serve as a crunchy snack.

name: chilli mushroom
instructions: Wash and cut mushroom. Mix with cornflour, maida, salt, red chilli powder, and pepper powder. Fry coated mushroom in hot oil on medium flame until golden brown. In separate pan, heat oil and add chopped ginger and garlic, then onion and peppers. Add red chilli sauce, green chilli sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, tomato ketchup and black pepper. Mix cornflour with water and add to the sauce. Add water and bring to boil on high flame. Add fried mushrooms, mix on high flame, add green chilli and spring onion. Turn off flame and serve hot.

name: chinese macaroni
instructions: Boil macaroni and drain. Heat oil and add garlic, then onion. Add mushroom, capsicum and carrot. Stir fry briefly. Add vinegar, soya sauce, tomato ketchup and red chilli sauce. Mix well and add cooked macaroni. Toss on high heat until well coated. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: tandoori chai
instructions: Heat water in a pot and add ginger and cardamom. Bring to boil and add tea leaves. Steep for 2-3 minutes. Add milk and sugar. Strain the tea. Heat clay pot (traditionally in tandoor or on flame). Pour prepared tea into hot clay pot and pour back into cup. Serve hot.

name: burnt garlic laccha paratha
instructions: Knead wheat flour and maida with salt and oil into soft dough. Let rest for 15 minutes. Burn garlic cloves in ghee until dark. Roll dough into thin sheet and brush with burnt garlic ghee. Fold into layers and roll into paratha. Cook on hot griddle with ghee on both sides until golden brown. Sprinkle coriander leaves and chilli flakes. Serve hot.

name: sevai fruit custard
instructions: Heat ghee and roast sevai for 2-3 minutes. Add milk and bring to boil. Add sugar. Mix custard powder with little water and add to milk. Stir continuously until custard thickens and vermicelli is cooked. Remove from heat and let cool completely. Refrigerate for one hour. Serve in glass and top with chopped fruits, almonds and pistachios. Serve chilled.

name: Kulcha
instructions: Mix 2 cups refined flour with 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt. Add lukewarm water and knead soft dough. Apply oil on palms and knead well for 4-5 minutes. Cover and let rise in warm place for 1-1.5 hours until doubled. Punch and divide into lumps, coat with dry flour, cover. Heat pan on low flame. Flatten each lump into oval kulcha using rolling pin, sprinkle dry fenugreek. Grease pan with butter and oil, place kulcha on it, cover and cook 2 minutes on low flame. Flip and cook until semi-cooked.

name: Protein Salad
instructions: Soak mung beans, bengal gram, and chickpeas for 4-6 hours. Boil each separately until tender but not mushy. Drain and cool. Dice all vegetables (carrot, cucumber, onion, beetroot, tomatoes) into small pieces. Crumble paneer. Chop green chilli and lettuce. In a large bowl, combine all sprouts, vegetables, paneer, and lettuce. Season with lemon juice, black pepper, chat masala, and rock salt. Toss everything together until well mixed. Serve immediately.

name: Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup
instructions: Wash and halve tomatoes. Arrange tomatoes and garlic cloves on a baking tray. Roast in oven at 200C for 15-20 minutes until soft and slightly charred. Transfer to a pot with bay leaf and cinnamon stick. Add water (about 2-3 cups). Bring to boil and simmer for 15-20 minutes. Remove bay leaf and cinnamon. Blend soup until smooth or leave chunky as preferred. Strain if desired. Add butter and black pepper. Heat through. Stir in fresh cream if using. Serve hot.

name: Rohu Fish Curry
instructions: Clean and cut fish into pieces. Marinate with salt and turmeric powder for 10 minutes. Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped onion and cook until golden brown. Add ginger and garlic paste, cook for 1-2 minutes. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Mix well. Add about 1 cup water. Bring to simmer. Gently add fish pieces. Cook for 15-20 minutes until fish is cooked through. Add garam masala and adjust salt. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and slit green chilli. Serve hot with rice.

name: Egg Cutlet
instructions: Boil eggs and potatoes separately. Peel and chop eggs finely. Boil and mash potatoes. In a bowl, mix boiled eggs, mashed potato, chopped onion, green chilli, and coriander leaves. Add cumin powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, chat masala, and salt. Mix well until combined. Divide into 8 equal portions. Shape each into an oval cutlet. Mix all purpose flour and corn flour with a little water to make a coating paste. Coat each cutlet first in flour-corn flour mixture, then roll in bread crumbs, pressing gently. Heat oil in a deep pan. Fry cutlets on medium-high heat until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with ketchup or chutney.

name: Til Gud Paratha
instructions: In a large bowl, mix wheat flour and salt. Add 1 tbsp oil/ghee and rub in. Gradually add water and knead into soft dough. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes. In another bowl, mix sesame seeds, roasted peanuts, jaggery, and cardamom powder for the filling. Divide dough into 4-5 equal portions and roll into thin circles. Spread filling on each circle, fold edges to enclose, and gently roll into a paratha of desired thickness. Heat a griddle or tawa. Place paratha on hot griddle, cook for 1 minute, then brush with ghee. Flip and cook until golden spots appear. Flip again and press gently until fully cooked. Transfer to a plate and brush with ghee. Serve warm.

name: crispy chicken tenders
instructions: Marinate boneless chicken fillets in curd mixed with turmeric, chilli powder, ginger powder, and salt for 30 minutes. Mix bread crumbs with all purpose flour, mixed herbs, black pepper, and remaining spices in a bowl. Coat the marinated chicken pieces in the flour-breadcrumb mixture, ensuring even coating. Place coated chicken in Philips air fryer at 180°C for 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until golden and crispy.

name: no bake oreo strawberry cheesecake
instructions: Crush Oreo cookies and mix with melted butter. Press mixture into base of springform pan. Blend cream cheese with whipping cream, vanilla essence, lemon juice, and powdered sugar until smooth. Dissolve agar agar powder in milk and mix into cream cheese mixture. Pour filling over crust. Top with fresh strawberries. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set.

name: instant mixed pickle
instructions: Dice carrot, radish, and green chilli into medium pieces. Dry roast mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, fenugreek seeds, coriander seeds, and carom seeds separately until fragrant. Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and temper with the roasted seeds. Add the diced vegetables and mix well. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, dry mango powder, and salt. Toss everything together. Allow the pickle to rest for 10-15 minutes so flavors blend. Serve as a condiment with meals.

name: mixed sprouts paneer cheela
instructions: Grind mixed sprouts with green chilli, ginger, and half the coriander leaves into a coarse paste. Transfer to a bowl and mix with grated paneer, remaining coriander leaves, chilli flakes, salt, and optional eno. Heat oil on a non-stick griddle or dosa pan over medium-high heat. Pour small portions of the mixture and spread into thin cheela shape. Cook for 2-3 minutes until light brown, flip and cook the other side. Serve hot with mint chutney or yogurt.

name: Hariyali Chicken Tikka
instructions: Grind coriander leaves, mint, green chilli, ginger, and garlic into a paste. Coat chicken pieces with this paste and salt. Heat oil in a pan. Cook chicken on medium-high heat until cooked through and golden. Serve hot.

name: Chilli Garlic Samosa
instructions: For dough: Mix flour, ghee, carom seeds, salt and water to make a stiff dough. Rest for 15 minutes. For filling: Crush coriander seeds and finely chop garlic and green chillies. Mash boiled potatoes and mix with garlic, chilli, turmeric, garam masala and green peas. Divide dough into balls, roll into thin circles, cut in half, and form cone shapes. Fill with potato mixture and seal edges. Fry in hot oil until golden on all sides.

name: KFC Style Fried Chicken
instructions: Mix curd with ginger powder, red chilli powder, and salt. Marinate chicken drumsticks in this for 30 minutes. Crush corn flakes finely. Beat eggs and mix with spices. Combine all purpose flour and corn flour in another bowl. Dip marinated chicken in egg mixture, then coat with flour mixture, and finally press into crushed corn flakes. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy on all sides.

name: Aata Malpua
instructions: Mix wheat flour, sooji, powdered sugar, milk, water, cardamom powder and crushed fennel seeds. Let batter rest for 30 minutes. Prepare sugar syrup by boiling 1 cup sugar with 1 cup water for 10 minutes. Heat oil in a pan and drop spoonfuls of batter, flattening slightly. Cook on low-medium heat until both sides are golden brown. Dip each malpua in warm sugar syrup and let soak for 2-3 minutes. Serve warm or cold.

name: Chole Paneer Biryani
instructions: Layer boiled rice with cooked chole, paneer, and potatoes. Add sautéed onions and tomatoes with ginger-garlic paste and all spice powders. Close pressure cooker and cook on high pressure until rice is tender.

name: Kerala Style Fish Curry
instructions: Heat oil and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Sauté onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook briefly. Add chopped tomatoes and spice powders. Cook until tomatoes soften. Add fish pieces, tamarind juice, and kokam. Simmer until fish is cooked through. Add coconut milk at the end and adjust seasoning.

name: Cheese Corn Sandwich
instructions: Spread butter on bread slices. Mix boiled corn with chopped onion, capsicum, tomato, coriander leaves, and mayonnaise. Spread mixture on bread and place cheese slice on top. Close sandwich and cook on tava over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

name: Aloo Potol
instructions: Heat oil in pressure cooker and add cumin seeds. Add chopped onions and cook until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes, cook until tomatoes soften. Add pointed gourd and potatoes cut into chunks. Add all spice powders and salt. Close pressure cooker and cook for 3-4 whistles until vegetables are tender.

name: Milk Powder Modak
instructions: Mix milk powder with ghee and cook on low heat until fragrant. Add milk and cook until thick. In separate pan, melt jaggery and mix with coconut and cardamom powder. Combine the two mixtures. Shape into modak using mold or by hand. Garnish and serve.

name: Instant Pasta
instructions: Heat oil in pan and add chopped green chilli and onion. Sauté until onion is translucent. Add french beans, capsicum, and carrot. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Add boiled pasta and pasta sauce. Mix well and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add butter and salt to taste. Serve hot.

name: Khandeshi Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast green brinjal over flame until soft. Scoop out flesh. Heat oil and add cumin and mustard seeds. Add chopped onions, spring onions, green chilli, and garlic. Cook until fragrant. Add peanuts and roast briefly. Add brinjal flesh and coriander leaves. Mix well and cook until all flavors are well incorporated.

name: Hyderabadi Mirchi ka Salan
instructions: Roast peanuts, cumin, dry coconut, poppy seeds, sesame seeds, and coriander seeds separately until fragrant. Grind into fine paste. Heat oil and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and curry leaves. Add sliced onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and tomato paste. Add green chillies and cook briefly. Add the ground paste and cook on low heat. Add tamarind juice and spice powders. Simmer until oil separates from the mixture. Add jaggery if desired and salt to taste.

name: Chana Dal Fara
instructions: Soak chana dal overnight. Mix wheat flour, soaked chana dal, ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Knead into dough. Let it rest. Heat oil in pan, add cumin and mustard seeds for tadka. Add curry leaves and green chilli. Shape dough into fara and fry until golden. Serve with chaat masala.

name: Garlic Chicken Lollipop
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and prepare drumsticks. Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, salt for 30 minutes. Mix corn flour and maida into a paste. Coat chicken pieces in the flour mixture. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Toss with red chilli sauce, ketchup and schezwan chutney. Garnish with spring onions.

name: Methi ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add finely chopped onion and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic and tomatoes, cook until soft. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander and cumin powder. Add washed methi leaves and roasted peanuts. Mix well and cook on medium heat for 8-10 minutes until leaves are tender but not bitter. Season with salt.

name: palak paneer pulao
instructions: For rice: Boil water with salt, green cardamom and ghee. Add soaked basmati rice, cook on medium heat until 70% done. Drain and reserve rice water. For spinach: Blanch spinach in boiling salted water for 1 minute, dip in ice water, strain and puree. For paneer kofta: Crumble paneer, add roasted cumin seeds, ginger, green chilli, coriander, salt and ghee. Mix with bread crumbs. Deep fry in oil until golden. Fry cashews light golden. For pulao: Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, splutter. Add garlic, saute until light brown. Add onion, saute well. Add spinach paste and saute well on medium flame. Add sugar, salt, ghee and black pepper, saute until raw smell goes. Add cooked rice and toss well, sprinkle water, cover and cook. For tadka: Heat ghee and oil, add dry red chilli, ginger, green chilli, saute. Add tomato, fried cashews, paneer kofta, salt, chaat masala, chilli powder, water, coriander and mix. Top rice with tadka and serve hot.

name: Mix Veg Restaurant Style
instructions: Cut all vegetables into uniform pieces. Heat oil in kadhai, add chopped onions and garlic, cook until golden. Add ginger and fry briefly. Add onion paste or ground onion. Add tomato pieces and cook until mushy. Add all dry spices and masala. Add all cut vegetables and mix well. Cover and cook on medium heat for 10-12 minutes. Add cream, fenugreek leaves and butter. Stir and cook for 2-3 more minutes.

name: Punjabi Tadka Maggi
instructions: Boil water in a pot. Add maggi noodles and cook as per packet instructions. In a separate pan, heat oil and add onions, cook until translucent. Add capsicum, tomatoes and green peas. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes. Add the cooked maggi noodles to the pan with vegetables. Mix well with the tastemaker and stir fry for 2 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Handi Paneer
instructions: Heat oil in a clay pot. Add cumin seeds, cinnamon, and mace. When fragrant, add minced garlic and ginger paste. Add finely chopped onion and cook until soft. Add diced tomatoes and cook until tender. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook until oil separates. Add curd and mix well. Add paneer cubes and capsicum. Add garam masala. Simmer covered until paneer absorbs flavors. Garnish with kashmiri red chilli.

name: Paneer Cheese Momos
instructions: For dough: Mix wheat flour, all purpose flour, salt, and oil. Add water gradually and knead into soft dough. Let rest for 15 minutes. For stuffing: Crumble paneer and finely chop onion and green chillies. Mix with red chilli powder, chaat masala, garam masala, and oil. Roll dough thin, cut circles, fill with paneer mixture. Fold and seal into momo shape. Steam in steamer or kadhai with water until cooked, about 10-12 minutes. Serve hot with sauce if desired.

name: Cheese Chilli Maggi
instructions: Boil water and cook maggi noodles as per package instructions. Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant. Add finely chopped onion and cook until soft. Add diced capsicum and green chilli. Cook vegetables for 2-3 minutes. Add cooked maggi noodles to the pan. Add chilli flakes, oregano, and grated cheese. Mix well until cheese melts and coats the noodles. Serve hot.

name: Sweet Boondi
instructions: Make a thin batter with chickpea flour and water. Heat ghee in a deep pan. Using a boondi maker (perforated spoon), fry small round droplets of batter until golden. Prepare sugar syrup by dissolving sugar in water with cardamom powder. Drain fried boondis and soak in sugar syrup. Mix and serve.

name: Fasting Thali
instructions: Prepare sabudana cheela by mixing boiled potato, sabudana, peanut powder, singhara aata, salt, curry leaves, ginger, green chilli, lemon juice and cook in ghee. Prepare shakarkand chaat by mixing boiled sweet potato with peanut powder, salt, lemon juice and coriander leaves. Make green chutney by grinding ginger, green chilli, coriander leaves, lemon juice, roasted peanuts and salt with water.

name: Palak Paratha with Red Chilli Chutney
instructions: For chutney: grind red chilli, ginger, green garlic, garlic cloves, coriander leaves, lemon juice, roasted peanuts and cumin seeds with salt. For paratha: blanch spinach and mix with wheat flour, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala and salt, knead, roll and cook on griddle with ghee.

name: Aloo Soyabean Curry
instructions: Soak soya chunks and boil potatoes. Heat oil and add cumin seeds and black cardamom. Add ginger garlic paste, tomato paste, soya chunks and boiled potatoes. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander and cumin powder. Add curd and salt. Cook in pressure cooker for 10 minutes.

name: Spicy Cabbage Peas
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Once they splutter, add chopped onion and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli, then add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add the chopped cabbage and peas with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and coriander powder. Mix well, cover and cook on medium heat for 10-15 minutes until cabbage is tender. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

name: Green Chilli Fry
instructions: Slit green chillies lengthwise and remove seeds if desired. Mix gram flour with turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, dry mango powder, and salt. Coat the chillies with this mixture. Heat oil in a pan and fry the coated chillies until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove and sprinkle lemon juice before serving.

name: Chutney Paneer Tikka
instructions: Make a chutney by blending coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chillies, garlic cloves, and lemon juice with salt into a smooth paste. Cut paneer into cubes. Mix curd with the chutney and spice powders (coriander, cumin, garam masala). Marinate paneer cubes in this mixture for 15-20 minutes. Heat oil on a griddle or tawa and cook the marinated paneer cubes until light brown on all sides. Serve hot as a starter.

name: Tandoori Pomfret Fish
instructions: Clean and pat dry the pomfret fish. Make slits on both sides. Mix curd with ginger-garlic paste, gram flour, and all the spice powders (turmeric, red chilli, cumin, coriander, tandoori masala, chaat masala) along with lemon juice and salt. Coat the fish thoroughly with this marinade, including inside the slits. Let marinate for 15-20 minutes. Brush with mustard oil and cook in an air fryer at 200°C for 15-20 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the coating is lightly charred.

name: Raw Banana Curry
instructions: Peel and cut raw bananas into pieces. Heat oil with cumin seeds and add bay leaves, black cardamom, and dry red chilli. Add chopped onion, garlic, ginger and fry until golden. Add spice powders, then banana pieces, mix well. Add besan and cook until bananas are tender and curry thickens.

name: Mongolian Paneer
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes and coat with corn flour. Deep fry until golden and set aside. In a wok, heat oil and stir-fry dry red chilli and garlic cloves. Add ginger garlic paste, then soy sauce, sugar, and seasonings. Toss in fried paneer and spring onion, mix quickly to coat evenly.

name: Egg Manchurian
instructions: Boil eggs and peel them. Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and ginger paste. Sauté onion and capsicum until cooked. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, tomato ketchup, vinegar, and schezwan chutney. Mix well. Add the boiled eggs and toss gently to coat with sauce. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Semolina Handvo
instructions: Mix semolina, yogurt, and baking soda. Add finely chopped vegetables and all spices. Let the batter rest for a few minutes. Heat oil and tempering mustard seeds and curry leaves, add to batter. Pour into a greased pan or pressure cooker vessel. Steam or bake for 20-25 minutes until done. Serve hot.

name: Panchratna Dal
instructions: Soak all five dals together. Cook in pressure cooker with water and turmeric until soft. Prepare tadka with ghee, cumin, asafoetida, cardamom, cloves, pepper and curry leaves. Pour tadka over cooked dal. Add ginger, tomato, coriander powder and chili powder. Simmer 2-3 minutes. Garnish with green coriander.

name: Pad Thai Noodles
instructions: Cook pad thai noodles according to package instructions, drain and set aside. In a bowl, mix tamarind pulp, soy sauce, brown sugar, chilli flakes, and vinegar to make sauce. Heat peanut oil in a wok or large pan, add chopped garlic and green chilli. Add onion and carrot, stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add broccoli, peppers, mushrooms, and sprout beans. Stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes. Add cooked noodles and tofu/paneer cubes. Pour sauce over and toss everything together for 2-3 minutes. Top with roasted peanuts and fresh lemon juice. Serve hot.

name: Crispy Egg Fingers
instructions: Beat eggs with finely chopped onion, coriander leaves, chilli flakes, corn flour, all purpose flour and salt. Shape mixture into finger-like pieces. Coat each piece thoroughly with bread crumbs. Deep fry in hot oil until crispy and golden brown. Serve hot.

name: Bread Mango Barfi
instructions: Soak bread slices in boiled milk. Blend soaked bread with ripe mango pulp to a smooth paste. Mix in milk powder, desiccated coconut, sugar and cardamom powder. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add mango mixture and cook over medium heat, stirring continuously until thick and mixture leaves the sides of pan. Pour onto greased surface. Allow to cool and set completely. Cut into squares and serve.

name: Rice Thali
instructions: Boil rice until fluffy and cooked through. Cook toor dal with turmeric until soft. Prepare vegetable curry by tempering mustard seeds and cumin seeds in hot oil. Add onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli. Add potatoes, tomatoes and other vegetables. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add spice powders and curry leaves. Arrange rice, dal, vegetable curry, and papad on a plate to form a complete thali.

name: Instant Gajar Halwa
instructions: Add grated carrots, water and boiled milk to pressure cooker. Close lid and pressure cook for 1 whistle on high flame. Turn off heat and allow pressure to release. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add cooked carrot mixture. Add sugar and stir continuously over medium heat until halwa thickens and leaves the sides of pan. Add green cardamom and condensed milk if desired. Top with roasted mixed dry fruits. Serve warm.

name: Potato Manchurian
instructions: Cut potatoes into small cubes or balls. Coat with corn flour, all-purpose flour, black pepper, and red chilli powder. Deep fry until crispy and golden. In a separate pan, saute garlic, ginger, onions and bell peppers. Add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce, and ketchup. Add fried potatoes and toss well. Serve hot.

name: Kadha
instructions: Boil water in a pot. Add sliced ginger, crushed cardamom, cloves, and bay leaves. Simmer for 5-10 minutes on low heat. Add fresh basil leaves (tulsi) and black peppercorns, simmer for another 2-3 minutes. Strain and serve hot.

name: Chutney Paneer Paratha
instructions: Mix wheat flour with paneer, coriander leaves, lemon juice, ginger, garlic and green chillies. Add spices and salt. Knead into dough. Roll into thin layers with ghee between each layer. Cook on griddle until golden and crispy.

name: Dahi Chicken
instructions: Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook. Add chicken pieces and sear. Mix yogurt with spices and add to chicken. Simmer on low-medium heat until chicken is cooked through and gravy thickens. Adjust seasoning and serve.

name: Masala Poori with Aloo Curry
instructions: For poori: Mix flour, sooji, kasuri methi, spices and salt. Make dough with water. Roll into thin rounds and deep fry until puffed and golden. For curry: Cube boiled potatoes. Heat oil, add ginger and green chilli. Add tomato paste and spices. Add potatoes and cook until well coated. Serve poori with aloo curry.

name: Pizza Style Omelette
instructions: Dice potatoes and lightly fry until semi-cooked. Chop onion and tomato. Beat eggs with salt. Pour eggs over potatoes in oiled pan. Add onion, tomato and chilli flakes. Top with cheese. Fold omelette in half when eggs are set. Cook until cheese melts and omelette is golden.

name: Instant Jalebi
instructions: Mix all purpose flour, curd and rice flour. Add orange food colour and water to make smooth batter. Heat sugar with water to make medium syrup. Heat oil in pan. Fill jalebi mold with batter and squeeze directly into hot oil in circular shape. Fry until golden. Remove and immediately dip into warm sugar syrup. Drain and serve.

name: Protein Pulao
instructions: Heat ghee and add cumin seeds, black cumin seeds and whole spices. Sauté until fragrant. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook. Add onion and cook until golden. Add green chillies, tomato and other vegetables. Stir in soya chunks and chickpeas. Add boiled rice and mix gently. Season with salt and turmeric. Cook until all ingredients are well combined and flavors meld. Serve hot.

name: Banana Poori
ingredients: cooking oil or ghee for frying
instructions: Make dough with wheat flour, milk, and salt. Mix ripe bananas with some flour. Roll into small balls, flatten and fry in hot oil until golden brown.

name: Mughlai Paratha
ingredients: 1 tbsp tender coriander stems finely chopped
1/2 tbsp fresh mint leaves finely chopped
instructions: Make a coarse paste of green chillies and ginger in a mortar pestle. Mix mutton kheema with curd, ginger-green chilli paste, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric, tender coriander stems. Heat oil in pressure cooker, add marinated kheema, green cardamom, cloves, black peppercorns, black cardamom and saute. Add mint leaves and mutton bones, saute well. Add water, cover and cook 2-4 whistles. Open and saute kheema until water reduces. Make soft dough from refined flour, salt, sugar, oil and water. Rest 10-12 minutes. Mix degi red chilli powder, dry mango powder, garam masala and salt. Mix coriander leaves, green chillies, ginger, tomato, onion with prepared kheema and eggs and prepared masala. Roll thin sheets of dough, place egg-kheema mixture, fold like a pocket and cut edges. Fry in hot oil on medium heat until golden brown. Serve with coriander and lemon.

name: Egg Mayonnaise Sandwich
instructions: Boil eggs, peel and chop. Mix chopped eggs with mayonnaise, salt, and black pepper powder. Spread on bread slices and press together. Cut diagonally if desired.

name: Khara Pongal
instructions: Cook rice and moong dal together until soft. Meanwhile, prepare tadka: heat ghee, add cumin seeds, dry red chilli, curry leaves, ginger. Add to cooked rice-dal mixture. Season with salt, turmeric, and sugar.

name: Tawa Egg Fry
instructions: Cut boiled eggs in half or slice. Heat oil on tawa, add chopped onion and garlic. Add curry leaves, green chilli. Add egg pieces and spices. Toss gently until well-coated and heated through.

name: Garlic Pepper Mushroom
instructions: Heat oil and butter. Add chopped garlic and cook briefly. Add sliced mushrooms, black pepper, oregano, and chilli flakes. Cook until mushrooms are tender and golden. Finish with coriander leaves.

name: Zunka Bhakri
instructions: For zunka: Heat oil in a pan, add onions and cook until light golden. Add garlic, green chilli, and curry leaves. Add gram flour and cook while stirring continuously. Add turmeric, red chilli powder and salt. Cook until gram flour changes color and oil separates. Finish with coriander leaves. For bhakri: Mix jawar flour, wheat flour and salt. Add water gradually to make a stiff dough. Roll into thin rounds. Cook on a hot tawa until both sides have brown spots. Serve zunka with hot bhakri.

name: Murmura Laddoo
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add peanuts, roast for 1-2 minutes. Add puffed rice to the pan and mix well. In another pan, melt jaggery on low heat until it becomes syrupy. Add cardamom powder to jaggery. Pour the jaggery syrup over the puffed rice and peanuts mixture. Mix quickly before it cools. Once warm enough to handle, grease your palms and roll into round balls (laddoos). Let cool completely before storing.

name: Egg Masala Pasta
instructions: Boil water with salt and cook macaroni until al dente, then drain. In a separate pan, scramble 3 eggs, set aside. Heat oil in a large pan or wok. Add onions and cook until golden. Add garlic and green chilli. Add tomato and cook until soft. Add all the powders (cumin, coriander, garam masala, red chilli). Add diced capsicum and carrot, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add cooked macaroni and scrambled eggs. Add tomato ketchup and mix well. In a small bowl, beat 1 egg and pour over the pasta while stirring to coat. Finish with spring onion. Serve hot.

name: Tawa Veg
instructions: Heat oil on a high flame (tawa or large pan). Add cumin seeds. Add diced onion and cook until light golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli paste, cook for a minute. Add tomato paste. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander, cumin and garam masala powders. Add all the diced vegetables (potato, okra, mushroom, pointed gourd, brinjal). Stir-fry on high heat for 8-10 minutes until vegetables are cooked. Add MAGGI masala packet and mix well. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Rava Dosa
instructions: Mix rava, rice flour, all purpose flour and salt in a bowl. Add curd and mix well. Let sit for 5 minutes. Add chopped onion, ginger, green chillies and curry leaves. Add cumin seeds. Add water gradually to make a thick batter (similar to dosa batter consistency). Heat a non-stick or cast iron tawa over medium-high heat and grease with oil. Pour a ladle of batter in the center and spread in circular motions to form a thin round. Drizzle oil around the edges. When the bottom is golden and crispy, flip and cook the other side until light golden. Serve hot with sambar or chutney.

name: Poha Chikki
instructions: Dry roast peanuts and poha separately. Melt jaggery with oil/ghee on medium heat, stirring constantly. Mix roasted peanuts and poha into melted jaggery. Spread the mixture on an oiled surface to cool. Once cooled, cut into pieces and serve.

name: Cheese Corn Balls
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Mix mashed potatoes with boiled corn, grated cheese, finely chopped onion and capsicum. Add bread crumbs, all purpose flour, corn flour, herbs and spices. Mix well. Shape into small balls. Roll in bread crumbs for coating. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.

name: Sooji Nuggets
ingredients: all purpose flour or cornflour - 1.5 to 2 tbsp
instructions: Boil and mash potato finely. Mix sooji, all purpose flour, mashed potato together. Finely chop green chilli, onion and coriander leaves, add to sooji mixture. Add chilli flakes, mixed herbs, black pepper and salt. Mix well with a little water to make a thick batter. Shape into bite-sized nuggets. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.

name: Aata Dosa
instructions: Mix wheat flour, sooji, gram flour and salt. Add curd and mix well. Add water gradually to make a thick batter similar to dosa batter consistency. Just before cooking, add eno and mix lightly. Heat a non-stick griddle or dosa pan, grease with oil. Pour batter and spread into a thin circle. Cook until golden on one side, flip carefully and cook other side until crispy.

name: Sooji Namakpara
instructions: Mix sooji, ghee, mixed herbs, chilli flakes and salt in a bowl. Add water gradually to make a soft dough, knead well. Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness on a greased surface. Cut into diamond or square shapes. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

name: Bread Omelette Pizza
instructions: Whisk eggs with chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, and coriander leaves. Place bread slices on a pan with melted butter. Pour egg mixture over bread. Top with cheese slices and grated cheese. Cook on medium heat until eggs are set and cheese melts. Garnish with tomato slices, chilli flakes, and oregano. Serve hot.

name: Aloo Soya Chunks Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and bay leaves. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies. Add soaked soya chunks and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add tomato paste and all dry spices. Mix well. Add diced potatoes. Cook covered on medium heat until potatoes are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Cheese Garlic Bread
instructions: Mince garlic finely and mix with softened butter. Slice bread into half-inch thick pieces or lengthwise. Spread garlic butter generously on each bread slice. Layer cheese slices and sprinkle grated cheese on top. Add chilli flakes and oregano. Heat a kadahi or griddle on medium heat, place bread pieces carefully, cover with lid, and cook for 2-3 minutes until cheese melts and bread is warm. Alternatively, wrap in foil and heat in pressure cooker or oven at 200°C for 5-7 minutes until golden. Serve hot with schezwan sauce or plain.

name: Tawa Paneer Burger
instructions: Finely mash paneer with a fork. Mince green chilli, onion, garlic, tomato, and spring onion. Mix all minced vegetables with mashed paneer, salt, and red chilli sauce. Shape mixture into round patties. Heat oil on a tava (griddle) and cook paneer patties for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and firm. Toast burger buns with butter and minced garlic on the tava until lightly golden. Spread schezwan chutney and tomato ketchup on the bottom bun. Place the cooked paneer patty. Top with tomato slices and onion slices. Add a layer of cheese if desired. Cover with the top bun. Serve hot.

name: Dal Bafla with Churma
instructions: Make baati dough with wheat flour, semolina, gram flour, baking soda, carom seeds, cumin seeds, curd, ghee, turmeric and salt. Shape into balls and bake or steam until cooked. Once baked, crush the baati and mix with edible gums, crushed nuts, ghee, and powdered sugar to make churma.

name: Tandoori Dum Aloo
instructions: Boil and peel potatoes, prick them with fork. Mix yogurt, ginger garlic paste, and all spices to make tandoori marinade. Coat potatoes with marinade. Heat oil in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot, add potatoes and cook on high heat until they get a golden crust (dum cooking). Cover and cook until potatoes are tender and infused with flavors. Serve hot.

name: Aloo Parwal Masala
instructions: Cut parwal and potatoes into medium pieces. Heat oil in a cooker or heavy pan, add cumin seeds, bay leaves, and black cardamom. Add crushed black peppers and let crackle. Add onions and fry until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add parwal and potato pieces with salt. Cook in cooker for 5-7 minutes or simmer in pan until vegetables are tender.

name: Mushroom Biryani
instructions: Soak rice for 30 minutes. Cut mushrooms into pieces. Heat oil and ghee, add bay leaves and cinnamon. Add onions and fry until golden, reserve some for garnish. Add ginger garlic paste and green chilli. Add turmeric, red chilli, cumin, coriander, garam masala, and shahi biryani masala. Add mushrooms and tomato, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add yogurt and mix well. Parboil rice and layer it over the mushroom mixture in the cooker. Sprinkle reserved onions, coriander, and mint leaves. Cover and cook in pressure cooker for 5-7 minutes until rice is cooked.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
instructions: Crush chocolate cream biscuits, add milk, mix well. Pour into a mug and microwave for 2 minutes on high. Serve warm.

name: Vegetable Paneer Pulao
instructions: Soak rice and toast it. Temper ghee with whole spices, add finely chopped vegetables and paneer cubes, stir-fry. Add toasted rice, mix well. Add water in 1:2 ratio, bring to boil. Cover and cook on low heat until rice is tender and water is absorbed. Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Kofta Curry
instructions: Finely chop capsicum, cabbage, carrot, cauliflower, and paneer. Mix with gram flour, ginger-garlic paste, and spices. Form balls (koftas). Make a tomato-based curry using onion, tomato, and remaining spices. Cook koftas in the curry on low heat until well incorporated. Serve hot.

name: Amritsari Chole
instructions: Soak chole for 2-3 hours. In a pressure cooker, add oil, add spices (cardamom, cinnamon, cloves), add diced onions and ginger-garlic paste. Add tomato paste and cooked chole with water. Pressure cook until soft. Finish with ghee tadka with garlic and ginger.

name: Aloo Moong Dal Pakode
instructions: Soak moong dal for 30 minutes. Boil and mash potatoes. Mix soaked moong dal with mashed potatoes, chopped onion, green chilli, ginger. Add all spices and salt. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

name: Masala Bhat
instructions: Heat ghee and add cumin seeds, black caradamom, green cardamom, mace, bay leaves, and cinnamon stick. Let spices crackle. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute. Add onions and tomatoes, sauté until soft. Add chopped vegetables (cauliflower, brinjal, peas, tindora) and fry briefly. Add rice, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and salt. Add water in appropriate ratio and cook in pressure cooker until rice is tender.

name: Sooji Dhokla
instructions: Mix sooji with curd and ginger-garlic paste. Add red chilli powder, salt, and coriander leaves. Add eno just before steaming. Pour into greased container and steam for 10-15 minutes. For tadka: heat oil, add hing, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Pour tadka over steamed dhokla and serve.

name: Besan Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil and add whole spices (cumin seeds, bay leaves, black cardamom, cinnamon, black peppers). Add chopped ginger-garlic paste. Sauté until golden. Add chopped onions and tomatoes, cook until soft. Add besan slowly, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Cook until curry thickens. Add ground spice powders. Simmer until done. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Peanut Barfi
instructions: Roast peanuts and cashews lightly. Cool and grind into powder. Mix ground peanut-cashew powder with powdered sugar and ghee. Spread on a greased tray and press firmly. Cool completely. Cut into pieces. Garnish with chopped almonds and pista.

name: Stuffed Onion Masala Curry
instructions: Blanch onions briefly and peel layers. Grind roasted peanuts finely and mix with spices to make filling. Stuff onion layers with peanut mixture. Heat oil, add cumin seeds, bay leaves, black cardamom and cinnamon. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook until fragrant. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add stuffed onions carefully. Add remaining spice powders and salt. Simmer gently until onions are tender. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Rabdi
instructions: Pour 1 litre of milk into a heavy-bottomed pan. Simmer on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the milk reduces to about 1/3 of its original volume (approximately 40 minutes). Add sugar and stir well. Add crushed almonds, cashews, and cardamom powder. Mix thoroughly and remove from heat. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: Carrot Broccoli Soup
instructions: Chop carrots and broccoli into small pieces. Chop onions and garlic. Heat butter in a pan, add onions and garlic, sauté until fragrant. Add carrot and broccoli pieces along with cinnamon stick and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover vegetables. Bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are very soft (about 15-20 minutes). Remove cinnamon and bay leaf. Blend the mixture until smooth. Return to pan, add fresh cream, salt, and black pepper. Dissolve corn flour in a little water and add to thicken if needed. Add sugar and adjust seasonings. Simmer for 2-3 minutes and serve hot.

name: Sooji Aloo Patties
instructions: Mix sooji with salt and water to form a dough. Boil and mash potatoes until smooth. Finely chop onion and green chilli. Mix mashed potatoes with chopped onion, green chilli, cumin seeds, all spice powders, dry mango powder, and salt. Combine sooji dough with potato mixture. Divide into 8 portions and shape into patties. Heat oil in a pan or deep fryer. Deep fry patties until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Aloo Bread Patties
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Mix with chopped onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, all spice powders, and salt. Cut pav bread into slices and hollow out the centers slightly. Stuff each bread slice with the potato mixture and press gently. Mix besan with water and salt to form a thick batter. Heat oil in a deep fryer. Dip each stuffed bread slice in the besan batter and deep fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot with green chutney, tomato ketchup, and sev bhujiya.

name: Aloo Cutlet
instructions: Boil and peel potatoes. Mash them in a bowl. Add chopped onion, coriander leaves, green chilli, rice flour, chat masala powder, garam masala powder, red chilli powder, roasted cumin powder, and salt. Mix well until evenly combined. Divide into 8 portions and shape into oval cutlets. Roll bread crumbs in a shallow dish. Coat each cutlet with bread crumbs, pressing gently. Heat oil in a deep fryer. Deep fry cutlets until golden brown and crispy. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot with ketchup and lemon wedges.

name: Palak Egg Curry
instructions: Heat 5 tbsp oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add tomato paste and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently. Add bay leaf and cinnamon stick. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, and garam masala powder. Mix well. Add spinach and salt. Cook until spinach is fully cooked and oil separates. Halve the boiled eggs and add to the curry. Stir in fresh cream and black pepper. Simmer for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with rice or bread.

name: Cabbage Onion Pakoda
ingredients: green chilli and garlic paste 1 tbsp
instructions: Mix onion, cabbage, coriander leaves, green chilli-garlic paste with turmeric, carom seeds, and gram flour to form a batter. Heat oil and deep fry spoonfuls of batter until golden and crispy on all sides. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with green chutney made from green chilli, ginger, garlic, coriander, salt, and curd.

name: Kaju Roll and Rasmalai Fudge
instructions: For Kaju Roll: Roast cashews, grind into smooth paste with sugar and yellow food colour. Roll mixture into cylindrical shapes. For Rasmalai Fudge: Melt white chocolate compound, add condensed milk and butter, cook until thickened. Spread fudge on parchment, top with cashew rolls and crushed pista. Drizzle rasmalai essence, garnish with rose petals. Cool and cut into pieces.

name: Paneer Tikka Open Sandwich
instructions: Make green chutney from coriander, garlic, ginger, green chilli, salt, and curd. Mix paneer with curd, ginger-garlic paste, besan, red chilli, kashmir red chilli, and garam masala for tikka marinade. Marinate 30 minutes. Cube paneer and grill or pan-fry until golden. Toast bread slices, spread green chutney. Top with paneer tikka cubes and onion-capsicum-tomato cubes. Add cheese slice, toast until cheese melts. Serve hot.

name: Quick Veg Thali
instructions: Jeera Rice: Temper cumin, bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon in ghee. Add rice and water (1:2 ratio), cook in pressure cooker. Dal Fry: Boil dal with turmeric. Sauté onion-tomato, add ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, add cooked dal. Garnish with coriander. Aloo Fry: Cube potatoes, fry with cumin seeds, dry red chilli until crispy. Paneer Masala: Sauté onion, add tomato, paneer cubes, spices, simmer till done. Roti: Make dough with atta and water, roll and cook on griddle. Raita: Mix curd with onion, tomato, coriander, spices. Arrange all on plate.

name: Pizza Flavoured Mathri
instructions: Mix wheat flour and rice flour in a bowl. Add mixed herbs, chilli flakes, oregano, and salt. Rub in ghee until breadcrumb texture forms. Add water gradually to make a stiff dough. Knead well for 2-3 minutes. Roll small portions thin, cut into squares or diamond shapes. Heat oil and deep fry mathri on medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides. Drain on paper towel. Serve hot with tea.

name: Corn Pakoda and Aloo Pakoda
instructions: Corn Pakoda: Mix corn, gram flour, chopped green chillies, onion, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and salt. Add water to make thick batter. Heat oil, drop spoonfuls of batter, deep fry until golden crispy. Aloo Pakoda: Slice potatoes thin. Mix gram flour, rice flour, ginger-garlic paste, spices, salt, and water to make batter. Dip potato slices in batter, deep fry until crispy. Drain both on paper towel. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Indian Style Vegetable Cheese Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente and drain. Heat oil, add chillies and garlic. Saute onions until translucent. Add carrots, beans, and capsicum. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add spice powders and tomato ketchup. Toss in pasta and mix well. Top with melted mozzarella cheese.

name: Cheese Garlic Toast
instructions: Make garlic butter paste by crushing garlic cloves with butter. Spread the garlic butter mixture on bread slices. Top with grated cheese. Toast on a tawa or grill until cheese melts and bread is crispy. Sprinkle chilli flakes if desired.

name: Chilli Paneer Gravy
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes and coat with cornflour and all purpose flour mixture. Deep fry until golden. In another pan, heat oil and add garlic. Add onions and cook until golden. Add tomato and cook until soft. Add all sauces and chutneys. Toss in fried paneer and mix well. Garnish with spring onion and chillies.

name: Instant Paneer Burger
instructions: Mash paneer and mix with mayonnaise, tomato ketchup, red chilli powder, garam masala, ginger garlic paste, and black pepper. Butter the burger buns and toast lightly. Spread paneer mixture on bottom bun. Top with a cheese slice and other bun. Serve hot.

name: Milk Powder Gulab Jamun
instructions: Mix milk powder and all purpose flour. Add ghee and knead with milk to form soft dough. Let it rest for 5 minutes. Roll small balls from dough. Prepare sugar syrup with water, sugar and cardamom. Heat oil in deep pan and fry gulab jamun until golden brown on medium heat. Immediately immerse fried jamuns in hot sugar syrup. Let them soak for at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: Street Style Aloo Tikki Chaat
instructions: Boil soaked white peas until soft. Boil and mash potatoes. Mix mashed potatoes, cooked peas, turmeric, red chilli powder, cumin, coriander, garam masala, and ginger garlic paste. Form into tikki patties. Heat oil in a tawa and shallow fry tikkis until golden brown on both sides. Prepare topping with chopped onions, tomatoes, tamarind paste, and lemon juice. Place cooked tikkis on a plate and top with onion-tomato mixture. Sprinkle roasted cumin powder and serve hot.

name: Pan Roasted Chicken with Vegetables
instructions: Marinate boneless chicken with curd, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, ginger garlic paste and salt for 15 minutes. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a pan on high heat. Pan roast marinated chicken on both sides until cooked through and golden. Keep aside. In the same pan, add olive oil and stir fry all vegetables (tofu/paneer, zucchini, broccoli, carrot, french beans, mushroom, bell pepper) for 3-4 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper. Plate the roasted chicken and arrange stir fried vegetables around it. Garnish with roasted sesame seeds and serve hot.

name: Bread Malai Roll
instructions: Prepare mawa by mixing 1/4 cup milk with milk powder and ghee. Let it thicken on medium heat, stirring occasionally. Prepare rabdi by boiling 1 litre milk with sugar and dry nuts until it reduces to thick consistency. Remove crusts from bread slices and cut into round shapes. Stuff each bread round with mawa mixture. Immerse stuffed bread rolls in warm rabdi. Let them soak for 5-10 minutes. Garnish with saffron threads and additional nuts. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: No Bake Chocolate Pops
instructions: Crush chocolate biscuits into fine crumbs. Mix crushed biscuits with 4-6 tbsp condensed milk to form a wet mixture. Roll small balls from this mixture. Melt milk chocolate compound in a microwave-safe bowl at 30-second intervals, stirring between each interval until smooth. Dip each biscuit ball into melted chocolate coating using a fork or stick. Place on parchment paper. Top with sprinkles while chocolate is still wet. Let chocolate set at room temperature for 2-3 hours or refrigerate for 30 minutes. Serve.

name: Cheese Poha Cutlet
instructions: Crumble poha into fine texture. Mix with boiled and mashed potato, minced onion, capsicum, green chilli, and mixed herbs. Add red chilli powder and salt. Shape mixture into cutlets. Coat each cutlet with corn flour and all purpose flour mixture. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy on all sides.

name: Sooji Aloo Nasta
instructions: Mix sooji with curd and let sit for 10 minutes. Add baking soda and mix gently. Finely chop boiled potatoes, green chilli, curry leaves, and onion. Add chopped vegetables to sooji mixture along with ginger garlic paste. Season with turmeric powder, garam masala powder, and salt. Mix well. Heat oil in pan and drop spoonfuls of mixture. Fry on both sides until golden and crispy.

name: Chilli Garlic Maggi
instructions: Boil water in a pan. Add maggi noodles and cook according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. Heat oil in another pan or wok. Add chopped garlic and green chilli, sauté for a few seconds. Add chopped onion and capsicum, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add cooked maggi noodles, schezwan chutney, red chilli sauce, and salt. Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: Kurkura Karela
instructions: Slice bitter gourd into thin rounds. Soak in salt water for 15-20 minutes to reduce bitterness. Drain thoroughly. Mix gram flour with turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, dry mango powder, and salt. Toss bitter gourd slices in the gram flour mixture to coat evenly. Heat oil in deep pan or wok. Deep fry coated bitter gourd slices in batches until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels before serving.

name: Hot Spicy Veg Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles and drain. Heat oil and butter, add garlic and cook briefly. Add onions and peppers, stir-fry until softened. Add noodles, dark soy sauce, ketchup, schezwan chutney, red chilli sauce, chilli flakes, red chilli powder, black pepper, and salt. Toss everything together over high heat until well coated and hot. Serve immediately.

name: Schezwan Fried Veg Momos
instructions: Make momos dough with flour, salt, oil and water; knead until soft. Prepare filling: chop garlic, green chilli, spring onion, onion, cabbage and mix with soy sauce, dry mango powder, and salt. Fill dough portions, wrap into momos shape. Fry in hot oil in kadhai over medium flame until golden. For sauce: mix schezwan chutney, ketchup, minced green chilli, garlic, and spring onion. Serve hot momos with sauce.

name: paneer khurchan
instructions: Make paste of 2 tomatoes and 1 green chili. Heat oil and butter, add cumin powder and turmeric. Add ginger paste and coriander powder. Add tomato-chili paste and red chili powder, roast until oil separates. In another pan sauté diced capsicum with salt until tender. Combine capsicum with masala, add garam masala and chopped coriander. Add crumbled paneer and cook for 2-3 minutes.

name: Gulab Jamun Mousse
instructions: Prepare sugar syrup by boiling 1 kg sugar with water; remove from heat, add crushed cardamom, let cool. In a bowl, combine flour, grated paneer, sooji, milkmaid, baking powder, and baking soda; mix gently to form soft dough. Divide into 30-35 portions and gently roll into round balls. Fry at low flame until golden brown. Immediately place fried gulab jamuns into cooled sugar syrup. Bring syrup to boil and remove from heat. For mousse assembly: layer melted chocolate on glass base, add whipped cream layer, arrange gulab jamun slices, add cream again, top with whole gulab jamun, garnish with roasted almond slices. Serve chilled.

name: Matar Nimona
instructions: Heat oil and temper with cumin seeds and bay leaves. Add chopped onions and cook until soft. Add minced garlic, then add tomato and cook until dissolved. Add turmeric, coriander, and garam masala. Add diced potatoes and peas. Cook until potatoes are tender. Adjust salt and serve.

name: Strawberry Mousse
instructions: Whip the whipping cream until stiff peaks form. Fold in strawberry crush gently. Crush jim jam biscuits into smaller pieces. Layer crushed biscuits and mousse mixture in serving glasses. Top with mousse and garnish with basil leaves. Chill before serving.

name: Mixed Sprouts Cheela with Palak
instructions: Mix together mixed sprouts, finely chopped ginger, green chillies, red chilli powder and garam masala. Heat oil in a non-stick pan, pour the mixture and spread evenly. Cook on medium heat until golden brown, then flip and cook the other side until crispy. Serve hot.

name: Besan Pudla Sandwich
instructions: Make a thin batter with gram flour and water. Add chopped onion, cabbage, capsicum, turmeric powder, red chilli flakes, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala powder, lemon juice and salt. Dip bread slices in the batter to coat both sides. Heat oil on a griddle and cook the coated bread slices until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Soya Kabab
instructions: Soak soya chunks in hot water, squeeze out excess water and grind finely. Add finely chopped onion, ginger, green chillies, garlic and fresh coriander leaves. Mix in gram flour and spices including red chilli powder, garam masala, chat masala, salt and lemon juice. Form mixture into kabab shapes. Cook on a hot griddle with minimal oil, turning occasionally, until golden brown on all sides. Serve hot.

name: Aloo Sandwich
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Finely chop all vegetables including green chilli and mix with mashed potatoes. Season with coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder and salt. Place one cheese slice on a bread slice and spread the potato-vegetable mixture on top. Top with another cheese slice and a second bread slice. Heat oil and butter on a tawa. Cook the sandwich on the tawa, pressing gently, until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Bread Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with chopped onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, chilli powder, garam masala and salt. Dip bread slices in the egg mixture, coat with cheese slices, and fry in oil until golden brown.

name: Poha Aloo Nasta
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into thin strips. Soak poha briefly in water. Mix gram flour with water to make a coating batter. Toss potato strips in besan batter, add ginger, onion, coriander, green chilli and all spices. Deep fry in oil until crispy and golden brown.

name: Cheesy Veg Puff
instructions: Make a dough with flour, salt and oil. Roll into thin sheets. Mix grated cheese with finely chopped vegetables and schezwan chutney. Fill dough with mixture, seal edges properly. Bake in oven until golden or deep fry until crispy.

name: dhaba style paneer masala
instructions: Marinate paneer with chilli powder, turmeric and salt. Fry paneer cubes until crisp and set aside. Heat oil, add dry red chillies, cloves, peppercorns and cumin, let them splutter. Add chopped onions and saute until translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute well. Add chilli powder, turmeric and coriander powder, saute until raw smell goes away. Add tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes. Add paneer masala and fried paneer, mix well. Serve hot with pickled onions.

name: Masala Mushroom
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add black cardamom. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden. Add tomato and all spices. Add mushroom pieces cut into chunks and cook until tender.

name: Aloo Cheese Paratha
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash them. Mix with grated cheese, chopped carrot, capsicum, coriander leaves, oregano and chilli flakes. Make a soft dough with wheat flour and oil. Roll a portion of dough, place filling in center, seal edges and flatten into paratha shape. Cook on hot griddle with oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: non-fried sabudana vada
ingredients: rock salt or sendha namak to taste
instructions: Soak sago for 6-8 hours or overnight. Boil potatoes and mash. Mix mashed potato with soaked sago, roasted peanuts powder, chopped coriander, green chilli, ginger and lemon juice. Add salt to taste. Shape into vadas. Cook in appam pan or griddle with minimal ghee until edges turn golden.

name: vanilla mug cake sundae
instructions: In a microwave-safe mug, mix all purpose flour, condensed milk, melted butter, baking powder, baking soda and milk. Stir well to combine. Microwave on high for 2 minutes until cake is cooked. Top with Kwality Wall's Cadbury Crackle dessert and roasted nuts if desired. Serve immediately.

name: street style veg chowmein
instructions: Boil noodles according to package directions and drain. Heat oil in a wok or large pan. Add chopped garlic and green chilli. Stir-fry cabbage, carrot, onion, capsicum and spring onion for 2-3 minutes. Add boiled noodles. Mix in soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup, vinegar and black pepper. Toss everything together until well coated with sauces. Cook for 1-2 minutes and serve hot.

name: Oreo Choco Bar
ingredients: chocolate compound milk and dark (2 bars)
instructions: Mix crushed oreo cookies with milk. Pour mixture into molds. Dip in melted chocolate compound. Refrigerate until set.

name: Schezwan Moong Dal Dosa
instructions: Soak and grind moong dal into batter. Mix in schezwan chutney and chopped onion. Add cheese. Heat griddle with oil/ghee. Pour batter and spread thin. Cook until golden on both sides.

name: High Protein Pista Salad
instructions: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Cut paneer into cubes. Toast pistachios and peanuts lightly. In a bowl, combine vegetables, paneer, chickpeas, nuts. Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, black pepper, and salt. Toss well and serve immediately.

name: Lasooni Aloo Palak
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds, black peppers, cinnamon stick. Add chopped onions and cook until golden. Add chopped garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Add all spice powders and mix well. Add cashews and butter. Simmer for 10 minutes until potatoes are tender. Season with salt.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Cake
instructions: Grind roasted peanuts into fine flour. Beat eggs with sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla essence. Fold in peanut flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder. Add white vinegar and mix gently. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool and decorate with nuts.

name: Aloo Cheese Kachori
instructions: Mix flour with carom seeds and salt. Knead with water to make dough. Let rest for 20 minutes. Mash boiled potatoes and mix with cheese, corn, onion, capsicum, and all seasonings. Divide dough into balls, flatten, stuff with potato-cheese mixture, seal and flatten. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

name: Mix Veg Dal
instructions: Heat oil and ghee in a pressure cooker. Sauté cumin seeds, asafoetida, garlic, and ginger. Add all three dals and stir. Add all chopped vegetables and tomatoes.
