Add turmeric powder and stir well. Add water and salt to taste. Close the lid and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles until dals are soft. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Maharashtrian Egg Curry
instructions: Heat oil and temper with cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add finely chopped onions and sauté until golden brown. Grind garlic, ginger, and dry coconut into a paste. Add this paste to the onions and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and garam masala. Cook the masala for 3-4 minutes. Add boiled eggs and enough water to make a gravy. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until flavors blend. Serve hot with rice or bread.

name: Onion Tomato Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. When they crackle, add chopped onions and sauté until softened. Add chopped tomatoes and green chilli. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and asafoetida. Mix well and cook on high heat until tomatoes break down and oil separates. Add jaggery or sugar and salt to balance flavors. Cook until the sabzi becomes dry and thick. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

name: Onion Chilli Laccha Paratha
instructions: Mix wheat flour and all purpose flour with salt and water to make soft dough. Let it rest for 30 minutes. Chop onions, green chilli, and coriander leaves. Divide dough into 4 portions. Roll out each portion into a thin circle. Spread chopped onions, green chilli, coriander, red chilli powder, garam masala, and chat masala on the surface. Fold the edges and roll out gently into a paratha. Heat tawa/griddle and cook paratha with oil/ghee on both sides until golden brown and crispy. Serve hot.

name: Chocolate Brownie
instructions: Beat eggs and powdered sugar until light and fluffy. Add melted ghee/butter and mix well. Sift all purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and baking soda. Fold dry ingredients into wet mixture until just combined. Pour batter into a greased container or baking tin. Cook in pressure cooker on low flame for 20-25 minutes (or bake in oven at 350°F for 25-30 minutes). Check with a toothpick - it should come out with moist crumbs. Cool and cut into pieces. Serve.

name: chilli garlic khichdi
instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker or pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped garlic and saute for a minute. Add onion and cook until soft. Add chopped tomato and cook until it becomes mushy. Add rice and moong dal along with turmeric powder and asafoetida. Stir well. Add water (about 2 cups). Close the pressure cooker lid and cook on high heat until 2 whistles. Turn heat to low and cook for 2 minutes. Turn off heat and let pressure release naturally. Open and serve hot.

name: aloo tamatar ki sabzi
instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker or pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add grated ginger and slit green chilli, saute briefly. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they become soft and mushy. Add chopped potatoes and mix well. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, and cumin powder. Stir everything together. Add a little water if needed. Cook in pressure cooker for 2 whistles or cook covered on low heat until potatoes are tender. Turn off heat and garnish with fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: paneer paturi
instructions: Make a paste by grinding black mustard seeds, yellow mustard seeds, poppy seeds, fresh coconut, and green chillies together. Mix this paste with turmeric powder and mustard oil. Cut paneer into thin slices or rectangular pieces. Apply the mustard paste on all sides of paneer pieces. Take banana leaves (blanch them slightly to soften), place a paneer piece on the leaf, wrap it securely, and tie with twine if needed. Arrange wrapped paturi in a steamer or pressure cooker. Add water to the bottom. Steam or pressure cook for 15-20 minutes until the banana leaf wrapping is cooked and paneer absorbs the flavors.

name: samak rice upma
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add chopped potato and carrot if using. Saute for 2-3 minutes until they start to soften. Add samak rice and roasted peanuts. Dry roast for 1-2 minutes. Add water and rock salt. Cook covered on medium heat for about 15-18 minutes until rice is done and water is absorbed. In a small bowl, prepare a mixture of curd and roasted peanut powder. Once rice is cooked, fold in the curd-peanut mixture gently. Serve hot with optional curry leaves as garnish.

name: Amritsari Aloo Kulcha
instructions: Prepare dough with flour and yogurt. Stuff with spiced mashed potatoes. Cook on tawa until golden, flipping occasionally to cook both sides evenly.

name: Green Chilli Kadhi
instructions: Chop green chillies finely. Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds to crackle. Add curry leaves. Mix gram flour (besan) with curd to form a smooth paste. Add this mixture to the oil along with chopped green chillies. Stir well. Add water to get desired kadhi consistency. Add all spice powders and salt. Simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes until flavors are well combined. Serve hot.

name: Spicy Curry Maggi
instructions: Boil water and cook maggi noodles according to package instructions, drain and set aside. Heat oil and butter in a pan. Add chopped green chillies and onions, sauté until golden. Add diced tomatoes and cook until soft. Add green peas and all the dry spice powders. Mix well. Add the cooked maggi noodles and toss to combine. Season with lemon juice, tomato ketchup, pickle and salt. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve hot.

name: Bengali Mishti Doi
instructions: Put curd in cotton cloth and hang for 15-20 minutes to make hung curd. Caramelize 1/2 cup sugar in a pan on low flame. Add boiled milk and sugar, mix well. Boil for 5-7 minutes on low flame while stirring. Turn off flame and let cool slightly. Whisk hung curd in a bowl and add to cooled milk mixture. Gently mix and pour into earthen pot or any pot. Cover and let rest overnight to set. Next day, bake for 15 minutes. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours before serving.

name: Manchurian Toast
instructions: Finely chop onion, carrot, cabbage, and capsicum. Mix vegetables with minced green chilli and garlic. Add oregano, soy sauce, green chilli sauce, tomato ketchup, and schezwan chutney. Mix in corn flour and all purpose flour to bind. Apply mixture evenly on bread slices. Butter both sides and toast on griddle or pan until golden and crispy.

name: Raw Mango Pickle
instructions: Cut raw mangoes into pieces. Heat mustard oil and toast mustard seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, black pepper, methi, and dry red chillies until fragrant. Add chopped ginger-garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add mango pieces and stir well. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, asafoetida, carom seeds, and nigella seeds. Mix thoroughly with salt to taste. Let the pickle rest and infuse flavors.

name: Sooji Gulab Jamun
instructions: In a kadai, add milk and heat slightly, then slowly add semolina and stir continuously. Add saffron and cardamom powder, mix well and cook on medium heat until doughy consistency. Remove to a bowl and cool. Once cooled, knead on a flat surface until smooth, apply ghee, add baking soda and mix well to form soft dough. Take small lemon-sized portions and roll into cylindrical shapes. Deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Remove and soak in sugar syrup for at least 2 hours or overnight. For sugar syrup: boil sugar and water until one-string consistency, cool slightly, add rose water and mix. Serve chilled, garnished with sliced pistachios and fresh rose petals.

name: Aloo Masala Toast
instructions: Boil potatoes and mash with spices, garlic, and ginger. Mix in grated cheese. Spread mixture on bread slices and toast in a pan with oil until golden brown.

name: Moong Palak Cheela
instructions: Soak moong dal. Grind dal with garlic, ginger, and green chilli. Mix in finely chopped spinach, onion, and spices. Add eno for fluffiness. Cook cheelas on griddle with minimal oil until golden.

name: Street Style Masala Maggi
ingredients: maggi noodles - 2 packets with taste makers
instructions: Boil water and cook maggi noodles. In separate pan, heat oil and sauté onions. Add tomatoes, peas, and green chilli. Add spices and schezwan chutney. Mix in cooked noodles and toss well.

name: Amla Ka Achar
instructions: Wash and dry gooseberries. Cut into halves or quarters. Heat mustard oil and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, and other spices. Add gooseberries and green chilli. Mix well with salt and dry mango powder. Store in airtight jar. No sun drying needed.

name: Turkish Flat Bread
ingredients: olive oil or cooking oil - 2 tbsp
instructions: Mix yeast, sugar, and warm water. Let sit 5 minutes. Mix flour and salt. Add yeast mixture, milk, and oil. Knead into smooth dough. Let rise 1 hour. Divide into portions and roll thin. Cook on griddle over medium heat until puffed and golden, flipping halfway.

name: Churros with Thandai Dip
instructions: Prepare churro dough with butter, eggs, milk, flour and water. Heat oil and fry churros until golden. Prepare thandai dip by mixing cream, thandai mix and cornflour. Serve churros with the dip.

name: Basic Coconut Curry
instructions: Heat coconut oil. Temper with mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds and dry chilli. Add curry leaves. Sauté ginger and garlic. Add onions and cook until soft. Add tomatoes and spices. Add water and thin coconut milk. Simmer. Add thick coconut milk and tamarind water. Cook until flavors meld.

name: Veg Khao Suey
instructions: Prepare burmese curry with spices and paste. Cook noodles separately. Mix noodles with the curry sauce. Top with fried garlic, chilli paste and other garnishes as desired.

name: Khad Cooked Mutton
instructions: Marinate leg of mutton with bhang ke beej and local kumaoni spices. Wrap marinated meat in leaves. Dig a pit and light fire inside. Bury the wrapped meat in the hot pit for slow cooking. Allow to cook until tender. Dig out pit and remove meat.

name: Chocolate Caramel Fudge
instructions: Mix condensed milk and dark chocolate chips together. Beat the mixture while it cools to achieve smooth creamy consistency. Add vanilla extract. Mix in roasted almonds. Set into pieces and allow to cool completely.

name: Chilli Cheese Toast
instructions: In bowl add chopped green chillies, chopped red bell pepper, chopped garlic, chopped coriander leaves, butter, and processed cheese. Mix everything properly until mixture is smooth. Heat pan and toast bread from one side. Remove bread and apply cheese mixture on toasted side. Put bread back in pan on non-toasted side. Cover and cook on medium heat until cheese has melted. Remove, cut in triangles and serve warm with tomato ketchup.

name: Plum Pudding
instructions: Soak dried fruits in rum, honey and orange juice. Mix dry ingredients separately. Cream butter and sugar, add egg and orange zest. Combine wet fruit mixture with dry mix and butter mixture. Pour into buttered moulds, cover with foil and thread, steam in boiling water for 2-3 hours until cooked.

name: Homemade Paneer
instructions: Boil milk in a heavy-bottomed vessel. Add lemon juice or vinegar to curdle the milk, stirring gently. Strain through cheesecloth. Press the paneer for soft paneer or for longer duration to make firm paneer blocks.

name: Kemenya Roti
instructions: Soak rice overnight, drain and pound into a paste. Season with salt. Place a lump of pounded rice between oiled plastic film and press flat. Deep fry until golden. Dust with powdered sugar if desired or serve with local Naga pickles.

name: Kosha Mangsho
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds and bay leaves. Add sliced onions and fry until golden. Add ginger and garlic paste, cook for 2 minutes. Add mutton pieces and cook on high heat until browned. Add chilli powder and turmeric, mix well. Cook on high heat uncovered until mutton is tender and gravy is semi-dry, about 45-60 minutes.

name: Stuffed Kurkuri Bhindi
ingredients: oil 2 tbsp for stuffing plus oil for frying
instructions: Clean and slit bhindi lengthwise. Make stuffing by roasting hing, cumin seeds, add chopped dry fruits and sev. Stuff bhindi with this mixture. Make a batter with maida, cornflour, rice flour and club soda. Coat stuffed bhindi in batter and deep fry until golden and crispy. Make amchoor chutney by mixing amchoor powder, sugar, salt and black salt. Serve crispy bhindi with amchoor chutney.

name: mixed vegetable pickle
instructions: Boil vinegar, water, sugar, salt, bay leaf and cloves together. Add mustard seeds and let cool slightly. Add all vegetables (cauliflower, carrot, cucumber, garlic, ginger, chillies) and let them soak. Store in a jar for preservation.

name: heeng jeera dal tadka
instructions: Boil dal until soft. Temper ghee with cumin seeds and asafetida. Add onion, garlic, ginger and cook until golden. Add boiled dal with turmeric and salt. Finish with the heeng jeera tadka and chillies. Serve hot.

name: white onion curry
instructions: Boil onions until soft and blend into smooth paste. Heat butter and add ginger garlic paste. Add ground spices (cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf). Add boiled onion paste and cook for 2-3 minutes. Stir in cream and simmer. Season with salt and pepper. This white curry base is used for various dishes like malai paneer, navratan korma.

name: Baby Corn Pakora
instructions: Mix besan, rice flour, cornstarch, salt, coriander powder, turmeric, cumin powder, chilli powder, green chilli, ginger, curry leaves, and coriander in a bowl. Add water to make a thick batter. Coat baby corn pieces evenly in the batter. Heat oil and deep fry the coated baby corn until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle chaat masala before serving.

name: Chocolate Mango Cups
instructions: Prepare chocolate coating by melting chocolate. Use mango pieces and fresh fruits to fill cups. Coat the exterior with melted chocolate. Chill until set. Serve cold.

name: Korma (Fried Onion Curry)
instructions: Deep fry sliced onions until golden brown and crisp. Reserve fried onions. In oil, add ginger and garlic paste, cook until fragrant. Add yogurt and spice powders (turmeric, coriander, cumin, chilli). Mix well. Add water to achieve gravy consistency. Simmer until oil separates. Finish with crispy fried onions.

name: Paneer Popcorn
instructions: Cut paneer into small cube pieces resembling popcorn size. Season with salt and chilli powder. Heat oil to high temperature. Deep fry paneer cubes until golden and crispy on all sides, 2-3 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot as a crunchy starter.

name: Baked Mango Yogurt
instructions: Mix yogurt, mango pulp, and sugar together. Pour into baking dish. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 20-25 minutes until set. The top may brown slightly. Cool completely before serving chilled.

name: Crispy Fried Spinach (Kurkuri Palak)
instructions: Toss shredded spinach with cornstarch and salt. Heat oil to high temperature. Deep fry spinach in small batches until very crispy, 2-3 minutes. Drain on paper towels. In a wok, heat 2 tbsp oil, add ginger and garlic, then green and red chilli. Add soya sauce and vinegar. Toss crispy spinach in this dressing. Garnish with sesame seeds. Serve hot.

name: Restaurant Style Dal Makhni
instructions: Soak urad dal and rajma separately. Cook dal and rajma together with water until soft. Prepare tomato puree. Make a tempering with oil and garlic. Add kashmiri chilli powder to the dal. Stir in tomato puree and cook until combined. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook. Finish with butter, cream, and dried methi leaves. Simmer until flavors develop. Serve hot.

name: Mumbai Style Vada Pav
instructions: Make besan batter with salt, chilli powder, turmeric and water. Prepare potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, heeng, then adding green chilli, curry leaves, ginger, turmeric to boiled diced potatoes. Season with salt. Make garlic chutney by cooking garlic with peanuts, sesame seeds, spices and coconut. Heat oil for deep frying. Dip potato balls in batter and deep fry until golden. Stuff fried vada in soft pao. Serve hot with garlic chutney.

name: Punjabi Chole Bhature
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight. Boil chickpeas with whole spices (cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf, amla) and baking soda until tender. For bhature: mix maida, semolina, salt, baking soda, baking powder, sugar, curd and water to make dough. Let it rest for 2 hours. For masala: heat oil, add carom, garlic, ginger, then onions. Add turmeric, chilly powder, coriander, cumin. Add tomato puree and cooked chickpeas. Add fenugreek powder and dry mango powder. Simmer until flavors blend. Roll dough and deep fry bhature until puffy and golden. Serve hot with chole masala.

name: Anda Paratha
instructions: Make dough with flour, salt and water. Knead well and let rest for 20 minutes. Divide into 3 portions and roll out thin circular discs. Crack an egg on half of the disc. Fold the other half over the egg. Seal the edges by pressing gently. Heat ghee on a tawa or skillet. Place paratha on the hot surface and cook until light brown spots appear on one side. Flip carefully and cook the other side until golden. Press gently while cooking to ensure the egg cooks properly. Serve hot.

name: Moong Dal Namkeen
instructions: Soak moong dal in water for 20-30 minutes. Drain completely and spread on a cloth to dry. Grind to a coarse powder consistency, keeping texture slightly grainy. Add salt, turmeric, chilli powder and asafoetida. Mix well. Heat oil in a deep pan. Make small pellets or sieve the mixture directly into hot oil for thin sev. Fry until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Cool completely and store in an airtight container.

name: Baingan Chutney
instructions: Cut aubergines into medium pieces. Heat olive oil and add kalonji seeds. When they splutter, add curry leaves. Add red chilly powder and turmeric. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add cut aubergines and cook until tender. Stir in tamarind pulp and let flavors blend. Add grated jaggery and mix well. Cook until the mixture reaches a chutney consistency. Add roasted peanuts and salt to taste. Adjust flavors with more tamarind, jaggery or salt as needed. Cool and store in an airtight container.

name: Choco Lava Cake
instructions: For wet ingredients: In a bowl add chilled water, oil, lemon juice, powdered sugar, vanilla essence and mix. For dry ingredients: In another bowl add salt, cocoa powder, maida, baking soda and mix. For dusting mould: Apply butter to mould, keep in freezer to set, then dust maida on sides and freeze. For choco lava cake: Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and combine without over-mixing. Remove mould from freezer, add 2-3 spoons batter, then small cube dark chocolate and 1-2 spoons batter. Repeat in all moulds. Keep in freezer for a minute. Place in hot steamer and steam for 4-5 minutes. Remove cake gently and serve warm.

name: Bhat Ke Dubke
instructions: Soak bhat dal for several hours. Cook the soaked dal in plenty of water with salt, turmeric, and spices over low heat for an extended period until completely tender and soft. The dal takes a long time to cook but the rich earthy flavor makes it worthwhile.

name: Eggless Mug Cake
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder in a mug. Add milk, oil, vanilla extract and stir well. Fold in cinnamon powder and chocolate chips. Microwave for 3 minutes. Dust with icing sugar if desired.

name: Soya Sattu Kebab
instructions: Soak soya chunks in water until soft. Mix with boiled mashed potato, sattu, and all spices. Add chopped ginger, green chilly, onion, mint, and coriander. Shape mixture onto skewers or form into patties. Drizzle with oil and cook over barbecue or on a tawa/griddle until golden and cooked through.

name: Paneer Vegetable Cutlet
instructions: Mix grated paneer with mashed potato. Add chopped ginger, green chilly, onion, and all bell peppers. Add coriander, cumin, and ketchup. Mix well and let it rest. Shape into cutlets, insert cheese cube in center if desired. Coat with bread crumbs and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: Vegetable Seekh Kebab
instructions: Mince or chop vegetables finely. Mix with onion, ginger-green chilly paste, herbs, and all spices. Add lemon juice and salt. Mold mixture onto skewers or shape into patties. Cook over barbecue on medium heat, rotating occasionally, or cook on a tawa/griddle with oil until golden and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.

name: Onion Paratha
instructions: Make a soft dough with whole wheat flour, salt, and water. Let it rest for 15 minutes. Prepare filling by mixing chopped onion, ginger, green chilly, coriander, cumin, chilly powder, coriander powder, and salt. Divide dough into balls, roll out, fill with onion mixture, fold and roll again gently. Cook on preheated tawa/griddle with ghee on both sides until golden and crispy.

name: Ghee Roast Chicken
ingredients: lemon juice or tamarind pulp 2 tbsp
instructions: Marinate chicken drumsticks in curd, salt and turmeric. Toast kashmiri chillies, peppercorn, coriander seeds, cumin and fennel seeds. Grind with garlic, ginger and lemon juice into a paste. Heat ghee in a pan and fry onions until translucent. Add the ground masala paste and cook. Add marinated chicken and cook covered until tender. Add jaggery and curry leaves for final tempering.

name: Vegetable Pakora
ingredients: green chilli long and thick 3 nos
instructions: Mix besan with salt, ajwain, turmeric, chilli powder, ginger and water to make a batter. Chop potatoes, onions and spinach. Dip vegetables in batter and deep fry in oil until golden and crispy. Sprinkle chaat masala and serve hot with chutney.

name: Cheese Onion Grilled Sandwich
instructions: Slice onion thinly. Butter both bread slices. Place cheese and onion slices between bread. Heat a griddle or pan and place the sandwich on it. Toast until golden brown and cheese melts on one side, about 2 minutes. Flip and toast the other side. Serve hot.

name: Thandai Kheer
instructions: Soak rice and grind thandai masala ingredients (melon seeds, almonds, cardamom, fennel if present). Heat ghee and lightly roast chopped almonds and pistachios. Boil water and add rice, cook until three-quarter done. Add milk and bring to a boil. Add ground thandai masala and crushed cardamom. Simmer for 10-12 minutes stirring occasionally. Add sugar and roasted nuts. Simmer for another 2-3 minutes. Serve warm or chilled.

name: rum balls
instructions: Crumble chocolate cake or muffins and mix with chopped candied fruits and nuts. Add spice powders and rum to form a paste. Shape into balls and coat with melted dark chocolate. Set in refrigerator until firm.

name: aloo jeera
instructions: Heat ghee and temper with cumin. Add ginger and green chilli. Add diced boiled potatoes and sauté. Season with turmeric, red chilly powder, salt and amchur powder. Add onion and tomato if using the second method. Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: badi ki subzi
instructions: Soak sun-dried badis if needed. Heat mustard oil and add chopped garlic and coriander. Add the badis and arbi leaves. Cook on medium heat until badis soften and flavors meld. Season with salt to taste. Serve hot with madua roti or regular roti.

name: cream of chicken soup
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces and cook in boiling broth with onion, garlic and ginger until tender. Shred or blend the cooked chicken. Strain broth and combine with shredded chicken. Add cream and butter. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer gently and serve hot.

name: oats fingers with quick kimchi
instructions: Mix oats with Saffola Masala to prepare crispy fingers and serve with quick kimchi.

name: mulled wine
instructions: Pour red wine into a pot. Add cloves, star anise, cinnamon stick and nutmeg powder. Add orange peel and lemon peel segments. Add orange juice and sugar. Heat gently without boiling. Add brandy. Simmer for 5-10 minutes to infuse flavors. Serve warm.

name: vegetable masala pulao
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds, then whole spices like cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and bayleaf. Add chopped onions and cook until golden. Add washed rice and stir to coat in oil. Add vegetables and salt. Add water in 1:2 ratio and bring to boil. Cover and simmer until rice is cooked and water is absorbed. Fluff with fork.

name: red velvet cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one by one and beat well. Mix in curd and red food colour. In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda, and cocoa powder. Fold dry ingredients into wet mixture. Add vanilla extract. Pour into prepared pan and bake at 180C for 30-35 minutes. Cool completely. For frosting, beat cream cheese with powdered sugar, fold in whipped cream. Frost cooled cake and refrigerate.

name: barley salad
instructions: Combine boiled barley with chopped cucumber, onion, and halved cherry tomatoes. Add pomegranate seeds and toasted walnuts. In a separate bowl, whisk together lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, mango puree, olive oil, salt and pepper. Pour dressing over salad and toss well. Add orange segments and assorted lettuce chunks. Toss again and serve immediately.

name: Shahi Dum Aloo
instructions: Fry baby potatoes until golden. Temper cumin, bay leaf, and whole spices in oil. Add sliced onions and cook until translucent. Add ginger and garlic paste, cook briefly. Add fried potatoes and roast. Mix cashew paste with curd and cream. Add to potatoes with turmeric, chilly powder, and coriander powder. Add green chilly and kasoori methi. Simmer on high heat until potatoes are tender and curry is creamy. Finish with a generous pinch of sugar and chopped coriander.

name: Dal Tadka Punjabi
instructions: Mix all three dals and wash well. Cook dals with water, turmeric, ginger, and salt until soft. In a separate pan, heat ghee and temper with cumin. Add chopped onions and cook until golden. Add garlic and red chilly powder, then add chopped tomato and cook briefly. Pour this tadka over the cooked dal and mix well. Garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Seekh Kebab
instructions: Mix ground meat with minced onion, ginger, garlic, and green chilly. Add spices including red chilly powder and cumin. Add chopped coriander and bind with egg. Divide into portions and shape into kebabs without using a seekh. Pan-fry on both sides until cooked through and golden. Serve hot with chutney and lemon.

name: Cheese Pakora
instructions: Mix besan with turmeric, red chilly powder, ajwain, coriander seeds, and salt. Add chopped ginger, green chilly, and coriander seeds. Prepare a batter with water. Dip rocket leaves, spinach leaves, sliced onions, and cheese cubes in the batter coating well. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy on all sides. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot with chutney.

name: Rawa Dosa
instructions: Mix rava, flour, and rice flour in a bowl. Add salt and roast if desired. Add chopped ginger, green chilly, coriander, cumin, and curry leaves. Add water gradually to form batter with pouring consistency, thinner than normal dosa batter. Heat tawa or griddle and oil lightly. Pour batter and spread into thin circle. Cook on high heat until golden and crispy on edges. Flip and cook other side until done. Serve hot with sambhar or chutney.

name: Eggless Tutti Frutti Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar together. Add vanilla extract. In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Fold dry ingredients into the creamed mixture. Fold in tutti frutti and mixed dry fruits. Pour into a greased pan and bake at 180°C for 40-45 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool and serve.

name: Cheese Parantha
instructions: Mix flour and salt. Add water gradually and knead into a soft dough. Let it rest for 15 minutes. Divide into balls. Roll out a circle, place cheese in the center, fold edges and seal. Roll gently into a paratha. Cook on a hot griddle with butter until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Dhaba Style Egg Masala Curry
instructions: Boil eggs and set aside. Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add onions and cook until golden. Add ginger, garlic, and green chilly. Add turmeric and chilly powder. Sauté for a minute. Add bayleaf and boiled eggs. Simmer for 5-7 minutes. Serve hot with parantha or rice.

name: Penne Arrabiata
instructions: Cook penne pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. In a pan, heat olive oil and add chilli flakes and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss well. Garnish with fresh parsley and black pepper. Serve hot.

name: Set Curd
instructions: Heat milk to remove impurities, cool to body temperature, add starter culture, keep in warm place for 6-8 hours until set, refrigerate before serving

name: Veg Kathi Frankie Rolls
instructions: Prepare and slice vegetables, warm phulka on griddle, place vegetables on phulka, add spices, roll tightly, wrap in paper, serve hot

name: Mango Stuffed Kulfi
instructions: Reduce milk by half on medium heat, add mango pulp and sugar, stir well, cool completely, pour mixture into mango halves, garnish with crushed pistachios, freeze for 6-8 hours until set

name: Peanut Chikki
instructions: Heat jaggery on medium heat until it melts and reaches 160C, add roasted peanuts and mix quickly, pour onto greased tray, cool slightly, cut or break into pieces with oiled knife

name: Chicken Porcupine Dimsums
instructions: Mix minced chicken with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, cornstarch, spring onion, and chillies. Shape mixture into balls, stick boiled noodles on top to create porcupine effect, steam or fry until chicken is cooked through, serve hot with sweet chilli sauce

name: tomato puree
instructions: Wash and chop fresh tomatoes. Cook on high heat until soft and pulpy, stirring occasionally. Puree or blend until smooth. Store in containers and refrigerate or freeze.

name: besan chilla pancakes with oats
instructions: Mix besan with oats and water to form a smooth batter. Season with salt and chopped green chilly. Pour onto hot griddle and cook like pancakes until golden on both sides. Serve hot.

name: eggless vanilla ice cream
instructions: Caramelize condensed milk. Mix caramelized milk with crushed cardamom, desiccated coconut, and vanilla extract. Pour into freezer-safe container and freeze for 4-6 hours until firm.

name: hara bhara kebab
instructions: Blanch spinach and mint in iced water, squeeze dry. Heat ghee, add garlic, then add spinach mixture. Cook until dry. Mix in besan, spices, mashed potato, and nuts. Shape into patties and shallow fry until golden on both sides.

name: achari pulao
instructions: Heat oil, add garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant. Add sliced onions and cook until translucent. Add red chilli stuffed pickles and stir. Add soaked basmati rice and mix well. Pour water, add salt to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 15-18 minutes until rice is cooked and water is absorbed. Garnish with spring onions and coriander before serving.

name: caramel bananas with ice cream
instructions: Heat butter in a pan over medium heat. Add sugar and let it caramelize. Add sliced bananas and coat with the caramel sauce. Cook for 2-3 minutes until bananas are soft. Transfer to a plate or bowl. Top with ice cream and serve immediately.

name: chocolate banana sandwich
instructions: Spread nutella on one slice of bread. Layer sliced banana on top. Drizzle caramelised condensed milk over bananas. Sprinkle cinnamon powder. Spread salted butter on the other bread slice and place on top. Toast in a pan over medium heat until golden brown on both sides, approximately 2-3 minutes per side. Serve hot.

name: makhni gravy
instructions: Toast cinnamon, black cardamom, cloves, and green cardamom briefly in a dry pan. Heat butter, add toasted spices and let them crackle. Add minced garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant. Add sliced onions and cook until golden. Add diced tomatoes and bay leaf. Add kashmiri chilli powder and water. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until tomatoes are completely soft. Blend the gravy to a smooth consistency. Return to heat, add soaked and blanched cashew nuts. Simmer for another 5 minutes. Adjust salt and spices to taste.

name: veg fried rice
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Add garlic, ginger, and green chilli. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add chopped onions and cook for 1 minute. Add all chopped vegetables - carrots, cabbage, beans, and capsicums. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until vegetables are partially cooked but still crisp. Add boiled rice, breaking any lumps. Stir continuously for 2-3 minutes. Add soya sauce and vinegar. Season with salt and black pepper powder. Add a dash of water if needed. Mix well for another 1-2 minutes. Garnish with spring onions and serve hot.

name: Gur ka Parantha
instructions: Mix wheat flour with water to make dough. Melt jaggery and mix with sesame seeds, fennel seeds, and cardamom powder to create filling. Roll dough thin, fill with jaggery mixture, fold and seal. Roll into paratha shape. Cook on hot griddle with ghee until golden brown and crispy on both sides.

name: Chana Dal Paratha
instructions: Prepare cooked chana dal as filling. Make dough with wheat flour and water. Roll dough thin, fill generously with chana dal, fold and seal. Roll into paratha shape. Cook on hot griddle with butter, flipping frequently until golden brown and crispy. Serve hot with a dollop of butter and curd or raita on the side.

name: Easy Sambhar
instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add cumin and curry leaves, then turmeric and coriander powder. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft. Add boiled toor dal, baby brinjal, and other vegetables. Add asafoetida, fenugreek, and dry red chilly. Season with chilly powder and salt. Pour tamarind water to sour the dal. Simmer until vegetables are cooked through. Adjust seasoning and consistency as needed.

name: Tibetan Bread
instructions: Prepare dough with flour and water. Roll dough in sugar coating. Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Baked Churros with Chocolate Sauce
instructions: Prepare choux pastry with flour, water, butter and eggs. Pipe into churro shapes on baking tray. Bake until golden. Make dark chocolate sauce. Dip baked churros in chocolate sauce and dust generously with cinnamon powder.

name: Pineapple Chicken Wings
instructions: Clean and marinate chicken wings with spices. Cook wings until done. Caramelize with onions and garlic. Toss with pineapple chutney until sticky and well coated.

name: Malai Kulfi
instructions: Boil milk in a heavy-bottomed pan and reduce until it becomes thick and creamy (malai forms on top). Add sugar and cardamom powder. Mix well and let cool. Crush pistachios roughly and add to the mixture. Pour into kulfi molds. Insert sticks. Freeze until solid. Dip molds in warm water briefly to remove kulfis.

name: kadai paneer
instructions: Grind tomatoes, green chili and cashews into fine paste. Roast paneer cubes in oil until lightly browned. Roast capsicum cubes until crunchy. Temper cumin seeds in oil with asafoetida. Add turmeric, coriander, fenugreek leaves and ginger paste. Add tomato-cashew paste and red chili powder. Saute until oil separates. Add salt and garam masala. Add 1/2 cup water and mix. Add roasted paneer and capsicum. Cover and cook on low heat for 4-5 minutes. Serve hot with bread.

name: Aamras Aloo
instructions: Temper mustard and cumin seeds. Add onions and ginger-garlic paste. Add chopped potatoes and cook. Add mango puree. Simmer until potatoes are tender. Add coconut milk and spices. Cook for 5 minutes.

name: Paneer Tikka Sashlik
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes and vegetables with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, salt and spices for 30 minutes. Thread onto skewers alternating paneer and vegetables. Prepare mustard oil dip with carom seeds, green chilly, ginger and gram flour. Grill on tava or gas flame for 8-10 minutes, turning and basting with dip. Serve hot.

name: Shahi Shakarpara
instructions: Make a soft dough with flour, ghee, milk and salt. Knead well and let rest 15 minutes. Roll thin and cut into diamond shapes. Deep fry until golden and crispy. Prepare sugar syrup with cardamom. Dip fried shakarpara in syrup. Garnish with dry fruits. Store in airtight container.

name: Lauki Chana Dal Kebab
instructions: Grate lauki and squeeze out excess moisture. Cook chana dal until soft. Mix lauki, cooked dal, green chilly, ginger and spices. Add gram flour and bread crumbs to bind. Shape into kebabs. Deep fry until golden on both sides. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Vudikina Thokku
instructions: Mash raw or semi-ripe mangoes. Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Add mashed mangoes, salt and red chilly powder. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes. Add turmeric and fenugreek seeds. Cook until thick and dry. Cool and store in airtight jar.

name: Banana Appam
instructions: Mash ripe bananas. Mix with rice flour, jaggery, cardamom powder, and salt. Pour batter into appam pan. Cook on medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

name: Khichdi Kebab
instructions: Mix leftover khichdi with besan, minced ginger, chopped green chilly, and salt. Shape into kebabs. Deep fry or shallow fry until golden and crispy on all sides.

name: Punjabi Dal Tadka
instructions: Wash and cook the mixture of masoor, moong, and toor dal with water, salt, green chilly, ginger, and turmeric until soft. In a separate pan, heat ghee/oil and add cumin seeds. Add chopped garlic, onion, green chilly, cook until fragrant. Add red chilly powder and chopped tomatoes. Cook until tomatoes soften. Pour this tadka over the cooked dal and mix well.

name: Tomato Soup with Garlic Bread
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add whole spices and allow them to crackle. Add sliced onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger and garlic, cook for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and simmer until soft. Blend the mixture smooth. Adjust seasoning. For garlic bread, toast bread slices and brush with garlic-infused butter.

name: Bread Rolls with Cheese Burst and Potato Filling
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Mix with chopped onion, coriander seeds, ginger, green chilli, chilli flakes, pepper and salt. Take bread slices and place potato mixture on one edge. Roll the bread and add cheese in the center to create a burst. Toast or fry until golden and crispy.

name: Punjabi Lassi Variations
instructions: For sweet lassi: blend curd with sugar and khoya, add cardamom powder, ice cubes and malai. For mango lassi: blend curd with mango, sugar, kewra water, add ice and cardamom. For salted lassi: blend curd with salt, roasted cumin, ginger and green chilli, add ice. Garnish with pista and serve chilled.

name: Kada Prasad / Atte Ka Halwa
instructions: Roast flour in ghee until fragrant, add sugar and water, stir continuously until halwa reaches desired consistency and begins to separate from the pan.

name: Bread Pakora / Tawa Bread Pakora
instructions: Mix boiled mashed potato with cumin, ginger, green chilly, coriander and red chilly powder. Prepare besan batter with salt, ajwain, turmeric and water. Dip bread slices in batter and cook on tawa with oil until golden. Prepare amchoor chutney by mixing dry mango powder, sugar, salt, red chilly powder and cumin powder with water.

name: Chinese Style Chicken Wings / Sesame Chicken Wings
instructions: Prepare chicken wings and coat with sticky spicy Chinese-style sauce made from soy sauce, ginger, garlic and red chilly. Cook until wings are coated and caramelized. Garnish with sesame seeds.

name: Rajasthani Junglee Maas / Mutton Curry
instructions: Heat desi ghee in a pan. Add crushed garlic and dry red chillies. Add mutton pieces and cook on high heat for a few minutes. Add water and salt to taste. Reduce heat and simmer until mutton is cooked through and tender, approximately 30-45 minutes.

name: Chicken & Cheese Kebab
instructions: Mix minced or finely chopped chicken with grated cheese and spices. Shape into elongated kebab form. Grill or pan-fry until chicken is cooked through and exterior is golden brown.

name: Egg Fried Rice Manchurian
instructions: For rice: In sauce pot add water and bring to boil. Add soaked rice, salt and oil, cook on high flame 2-3 minutes. Cover with lid and cook on moderate heat 7-8 minutes. Strain rice and transfer to tray to rest. For fried rice: In wok heat oil, add garlic and ginger, sauté briefly. Add carrot, cabbage, salt and sugar, sauté on high flame. Add green chilli and vinegar, mix well. Add eggs and combine. Add french beans and cooked rice, mix thoroughly. Add soy sauce and white pepper, stir well. Add spring onion and sesame seeds, toss. For sauce: Mix vinegar, soy sauce, ketchup, green chili sauce, water and sugar. In wok heat oil, add green chilli, capsicum, onion, ginger and garlic, sauté for a minute. Add sauce mixture and stir well. For omelette: Whisk eggs with water, salt and coriander leaves. In pan heat oil, pour mixture and make thin omelette. For assembly: Place omelette, add fried rice in center and close edges, transfer to plate, cut through middle and pour sauce over. Serve hot.

name: Airfryer Modak
instructions: For stuffing: Preheat airfryer at 180C for 5 min. Toast coconut, cashews, almonds, sesame seeds in baking tray for 3-4 min at 180C. Mix with jaggery and cardamom. For dough: Knead flour, salt, sugar, ghee, water into stiff dough, rest 10 min. Divide into balls, flatten, apply water on edges, add filling and shape. Preheat airfryer at 185C for 5 min. Cook modak 10-12 min at 185C after brushing ghee. Serve hot.

name: Boondi Barfi
ingredients: oil or ghee for deep frying
instructions: For batter: Mix gram flour, salt, ghee with saffron water and water to make dosa-consistency batter, rest 10 min. For syrup: Heat milk with sugar until dissolved, add rose water and cardamom powder. Heat oil/ghee in kadai, use perforated spoon to drop small batter rounds until golden and crisp, drain on tissue. Add fried boondis to syrup, fold gently. Mix almonds, cashews, pistachios, saffron, mawa into boondi mixture. Transfer to greased pan, spread evenly, press with palm to set, rest 20 min at room temperature or refrigerator. Cut into pieces, garnish with pistachios, saffron, silver varq, rose petals, serve.

name: Aloo ka Cheela
instructions: Crush garlic, green chilli, ginger and salt in mortar pestle. Heat oil and sauté the paste, then add onion, tomato and paneer. Finish with coriander. Grate potato, add salt, turmeric, oil and coriander leaves. Cook potato mixture in a pan on medium heat until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Serve with stuffing, curd, tamarind chutney, carrot and beetroot julienne.

name: Lal Mirch Chicken
instructions: In a bowl add smoked spices (cinnamon, bay leaf, cloves, cardamom). Roast degi red chilli powder and add to bowl with ginger, garlic, soaked red chillies, salt and mustard oil. Grind into smooth paste. Marinate chicken with coriander stems, ginger garlic paste, salt and mustard oil for 15-20 minutes. Heat mustard oil and regular oil, add cloves, then add paste and sauté. Add marinated chicken and curd. Cover and cook on low flame for 9-10 minutes. Add water and tempering. Apply smoke with coal and cinnamon stick. Serve hot with roti.

name: Pizza Burger
instructions: For filling: In a bowl add grated potato, paneer, oregano, chilli flakes, mayonnaise, salt, green chilli, ginger, carrot and mix well. For topping: Heat oil in a pan, add onion, tomato, capsicum and toss. Add salt, oregano, chilli flakes and toss well. Toast burger buns with butter until golden. Assemble: Place toasted bottom bun, spread filling on it. Keep toasted top bun, spread ketchup. Add pizza cheese blend, prepared toppings, then more cheese blend. Heat oil in pan, place burger pizza, cover with another pan to melt cheese. Garnish with cheese slices, black olive and cherry tomatoes. For butter corn: Heat butter, add corn, oregano, chilli flakes, coriander leaves, salt, sugar and cherry tomatoes. Serve hot.

name: Chapli Kebab
instructions: Mix minced mutton with salt. Squeeze grated onions and add to mixture. Add chopped tomato, green chillies, coriander leaves, and beaten egg. Toast spices (coriander seeds, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, black cardamom, salt) until fragrant and grind coarsely. Add spice blend with chilli flakes, dry pomegranate seeds, carom seeds to meat. Mix in roasted gram flour, grated boiled eggs, ginger, and pomegranate pearls. Wet hands and form patties directly onto heated tawa with oil. Shallow fry until golden crust forms on both sides. Fry tomato slices and green chillies separately. Garnish kebabs with tomato, fried green chillies, pomegranate pearls, and mint leaves. Serve hot with mint chutney.

name: Crispy Aloo Chaat
ingredients: fennel seeds 1/4 tsp + 1 tbsp for masala
instructions: For potato mixture: boil and grate potatoes and sweet potato. Add chopped green chillies, ginger, coriander leaves. For masala: dry roast fennel, cumin, coriander seeds, peppercorns, black cardamom and salt. Grind coarsely and add red chilli powder, dry mango powder, asafoetida, sugar. For tempering: heat ghee and oil with cumin, fennel, carom seeds. Add grated potato mixture and cook 4-5 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Make slurry with refined flour, salt, red chilli powder, water. Coat potato balls with poha-sesame mixture. Deep fry until golden brown in heated oil. Double fry for extra crispness. Sprinkle masala on fried nuggets. Assemble on plate with curd, tamarind chutney, fried nuggets, mint chutney, pomegranate, sev, masala, grated cheese and coriander. Serve hot.

name: Palak Dal Tadka
instructions: For dal: In pressure cooker add oil, cumin seeds and let splutter. Add garlic cloves, asafoetida, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, split urad dal and mix. Add spinach, water, salt and cook 3-4 whistles. For tempering: In kadai add ghee, cumin seeds, dry red chillies and splutter. Add asafoetida and ginger-garlic paste, saute 1 minute. Add turmeric powder, onion and saute until golden. Add degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, saute. Add tomato, salt, roasted papad, ghee and cook 2-3 minutes on low flame. Add spinach, salt, boiled dal, water and simmer until thick. Add lemon juice and prepare tadka (oil with dry red chillies and chilli powder). Add tadka to dal, mix well. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with fried dry red chillies and coriander sprig. Serve hot with rice.

name: keema samosa
instructions: Make ginger-garlic-chilli paste. Cook mutton mince with curd and spices. Smoke with charcoal and cloves. Cool and mix with chopped onion, mint and coriander. Knead dough with refined flour, ghee, salt and egg. Rest 10-15 minutes. Roll thin, cut in half, fold into cone, stuff with keema, seal edges. Deep fry samosas in hot oil until golden and crisp. Serve hot with mint chutney and onion rings.

name: honey malpua
instructions: Mix whole wheat flour, banana, curd, crushed roasted fennel seeds, crushed roasted peppercorns, salt, saffron and water into batter. Rest for 1 hour. Make honey syrup by mixing honey with hot water. Heat ghee in pan to medium hot. Add small portions of batter with spoon and shallow fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove from ghee and dip directly into honey syrup. Let soak 4-5 minutes. Serve on plate with extra syrup and mint leaves garnish.

name: paneer bhuna kathi roll
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste from green chilli, ginger, garlic and salt. Dry roast shahi jeera, coriander seeds, black peppercorns, cloves, cardamom with salt until aromatic. Grind coarsely for bhuna masala. For paneer bhuna: heat ghee, add shahi jeera and ginger-garlic paste, sauté onion until light brown. Add red chilli powder and curd. Mix in bhuna masala and water. Cover and cook 4-5 minutes. Add capsicum and paneer, cook 5 more minutes. Finish with coriander and ginger. For dough: knead refined flour, whole wheat flour, salt, sugar, oil and water. Rest 5 minutes. Roll thin, press mint leaves and roast on pan with oil until light brown. Assemble: spread hung curd on roti, sprinkle bhuna masala. Heat pan with ghee, place roti, add paneer bhuna, roll tightly. Garnish with tomato, chilli and lemon.

name: shakarkandi chaat
instructions: For red chutney: Heat oil, splutter fenugreek seeds, add cumin, fennel, cardamom, onion, ginger, garlic and saute for 1 minute. Add soaked red chillies and cook 5 minutes. Add jamun vinegar, salt, mustard oil, jaggery powder, water and cook 5 more minutes until chillies soften. Cool and grind into smooth paste. Roast parboiled sweet potato on hot coal until crispy, peel and dice. Heat ghee in shallow pan, fry sweet potato until crisp on all sides. In same pan add red chutney and saute 1 minute. Add little water and salt, add fried sweet potato and toss. Mix in chopped onion, green chilli, coriander, puffed rice. Garnish with puffed rice and coriander sprig and serve warm.

name: anda bhurji
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add ginger and green chillies and saute for few seconds. Add onion and saute until translucent, then add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add salt, turmeric powder and red chilli powder, saute until raw fragrance of turmeric goes away. Now add beaten eggs and continue cooking until desired consistency is reached. Finish with coriander and mint leaves and serve hot with sliced bread.

name: hyderabadi egg curry
instructions: Make green paste by grinding coriander leaves, mint, garlic, ginger, green chillies and salt with oil. Heat oil, add cumin seeds and chopped onion and saute until translucent. Add green paste and cook well. Add curd and coriander powder, mix well. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add sugar and adjust salt. Add hard-boiled eggs and simmer. Garnish with degi red chilli powder and coriander sprig. Serve hot.

name: sindhi saibhaji
instructions: For Sai Bhaji: Heat oil in pressure cooker, add ginger garlic paste and saute 1 minute. Add onions and saute till translucent. Add tomatoes, saute 3-4 minutes. Add green chillies and saute 2 minutes. Add spinach, fenugreek and soya leaves and mix well, saute 1 minute. Add chana dal and water, add salt, cover and cook until 6 whistles. For Bugha Rice: Heat oil, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and saute till fragrant. Add onions and saute till translucent. Add bay leaves and saute 2 minutes. Add water, salt and red chilli powder. Add rice, mix well, cover and cook until rice is done. Serve hot together.

name: sooji chaat
instructions: Roast sooji in a pan on medium heat until golden and fragrant. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add onion and saute until translucent. Add tomato and green chillies and cook for 2 minutes. Add roasted sooji and mix well. Add water gradually and cook stirring continuously. Add salt, chaat masala and amchur powder. Mix in puffed rice and peanuts. Finish with coriander leaves and lemon juice. Serve warm.

name: kerala sambhar
instructions: Soak and cook dal until soft. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add fenugreek seeds, red chillies, curry leaves and asafoetida. Add onion, garlic and ginger and saute till translucent. Add tomatoes and cook till soft. Add all chopped vegetables and cook till half done. Add cooked dal, sambhar powder, tamarind pulp, salt and water. Simmer till vegetables are done and flavors are well blended. Adjust salt and spice. Serve hot with rice.

name: achari chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, pickle oil and curd for 5 minutes. Prepare ginger garlic paste with chilli and salt. Dry roast fennel, cumin, fenugreek, mustard and nigella seeds with kashmiri chillies on low flame until aromatic. Add dry mango powder and sugar. Grind coarsely. Slit green chillies and stuff with achari masala, fry in mustard oil until golden. In same pan add mustard oil, heat, add onions and cook till light brown. Add ginger garlic paste and marinated chicken, saute well. Add coriander powder and saute till roasted. Add tomato puree, achari masala, red chilli powder, pickle oil and mustard oil, mix well. Add water, fried stuffed chillies and mango pickle. Cover and cook till chicken is tender. Garnish with achari masala and coriander sprig. Serve hot with paratha.

name: schezwan frankie roll
instructions: Make dough with refined flour, salt, vinegar and water, knead and add oil. Deseed kashmiri chillies and soak. Make chilli paste with soaked chillies, garlic, ginger and salt. Make schezwan chutney by sauteing chilli paste with oil, vinegar, sugar, tomato ketchup and salt. Make frankie masala by dry roasting coriander seeds, cumin, peppercorns, cardamom, cloves until fragrant, then add turmeric, chilli powder, mango powder, asafoetida and garam masala, grind coarsely. Prepare schezwan sauce by cooking prepared chutney with onion, capsicum, green chillies and coriander leaves with water and salt. Make filling by cooking potatoes with sauce and cornstarch slurry. Prepare dough portions, roll thin, toast on hot pan with oil. Fill with schezwan potato mixture, top with cheese and coriander leaves. Roll tightly and toast till golden on both sides. Serve hot with extra schezwan chutney.

name: Egg Mayonnaise
instructions: In a clean bowl add egg yolks, salt, mustard sauce and whisk together. Add oil in a thin stream and keep whisking continuously at the same speed in the same direction until smooth and thick. Remove to serving bowl, sprinkle black pepper powder and garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Mutton Boti Masala with Chur Chur Naan
instructions: Marinate mutton with coriander powder, turmeric, chili powder, salt, curd, ginger-garlic paste, chilies and herbs for 30-40 minutes. Prepare dough with flour, salt, curd, water and oil. For naan: roll dough, grease with ghee, pleat, stretch and roll. Rest 10 minutes, dust with flour and roll thin circle. Apply topping of semolina, chili flakes, carom seeds and sesame seeds. Heat tawa with ghee and cook naan until golden on both sides, then crush to form layers. For boti masala: heat oil and ghee, fry onions until golden, add marinated mutton and cook covered on medium flame 35-40 minutes until tender. Dry roast whole spices for masala powder. Finish with kewra water and coriander leaves. Serve with salad and naan.

name: Raswale Aloo
instructions: Heat ghee in pan and fry wadi until golden brown. Remove and let cool, then grind into fine powder. Heat ghee again and add ginger, garlic, green chili and onion, saute until translucent. Add turmeric powder and asafoetida, saute for 30 seconds. Add potatoes and water, cook until soft. Add fried wadi powder and cook on medium heat until thickened. Finish with coriander leaves and lemon juice. Serve hot.

name: Vegetable American Chop Suey
instructions: Mix boiled noodles with salt and corn-starch. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and set aside. Heat oil in wok and add ginger, green chili, garlic, saute for 30 seconds. Add onion, carrot, cabbage, capsicum, bell peppers and baby corn, saute for 1 minute on high heat. Add soya sauce and let caramelize. Add tomato ketchup, red chili sauce, black pepper powder, water and sugar, mix well and bring to boil. Add corn-starch slurry and coriander stems, mix well and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot by placing fried noodles on plate first, then pour sauce over it and garnish with spring onion.

name: Anjeer Khajoor Roll
ingredients: poppy seeds 0.5 cup roasted for coating
instructions: Heat ghee in kadai, add dates paste and figs paste, cook on medium flame until water evaporates and mixture leaves sides of pan. Transfer to bowl and let cool to room temperature. Prepare filling: grind walnuts, almonds, cashew nuts and pistachios coarsely. Mix with chopped figs, saffron strands, cashew powder and a spoon of dates-khajur mixture. Flatten the cooled mixture on clean surface. Add prepared filling and roll into long cylinder shape. Coat with poppy seeds and gently roll to make uniform shape. Let set for 10-15 minutes. Cut and serve.

name: Vrat Idli and Dosa
instructions: Soak barnyard millet and sago. Grind soaked millet with sago and curd into smooth paste. Add coriander, fruit salt and oil. Grease idli mould with peanut oil, fill with batter, steam 10-12 minutes. For peanut mixture: heat oil, add cumin seeds, peanuts, green chilli and ginger, toast and grind coarsely. For dosa: grind millet and sago to fine powder, add ginger, green chilli, coriander, water and sugar. Heat skillet, pour batter, spread thin, drizzle ghee, cook until golden.

name: Dal Palak Tadka
instructions: Cook mixed dals with spices until tender. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, garlic, onion, green chilli and spices. Saute, add tomato puree, then spinach. Cook until dal is done, add second tadka of tempering on top. For pulao: heat oil, add cumin seeds, tadka (without spinach), fenugreek, cooked rice, green chilli and coriander. Mix well and serve together.

name: Vegetable 65
instructions: Mix boiled banana, yam and pineapple cubes with salt and spice powders. Coat with ginger-garlic paste and corn starch. Deep fry on high flame until crisp. Heat oil in separate pan, add mustard and cumin seeds, curry leaves, garlic and green chilli. Add chilli paste and curd. Toss fried vegetables in this mixture and serve garnished with coriander.

name: Allahabadi Christmas Cake
instructions: Melt ghee with jaggery powder. Mix refined flour with baking powder, ginger powder, clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, crushed black peppercorns. Combine melted ghee-jaggery with flour mixture. Beat eggs separately, add to mixture with marmalade and vanilla essence. Grease and line cake tin. Pour half batter, layer with candied ash gourd, add remaining batter, layer with more ash gourd. Bake at 170°C for 40-45 minutes. For sugar syrup: melt sugar in water, add rum. For icing: mix icing sugar, lemon juice and warm water to semi-thick consistency. Cool cake, coat with icing, dust with coconut, top with candied cherries.

name: Kolhapuri Egg Curry
instructions: For Kolhapuri masala: dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, mustard seeds, sesame seeds, carom seeds, poppy seeds, stone flower and bay leaf. Roast dry red chillies separately. Heat oil, fry dry coconut with cardamom, peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, nutmeg, black cardamom, fenugreek leaves, cloves, mace and trifal until golden. Drain oil, combine all toasted ingredients, add asafoetida, turmeric and degi chilli powder, grind to fine powder. Boil eggs in salted water 12 minutes, cool in ice water. Heat oil, add ginger-garlic paste and onion until translucent. Add Kolhapuri masala, saute 1 minute. Add water, salt and cook. Add boiled egg yolks and whole eggs, simmer until gravy thickens. Finish with coriander leaves and lemon juice.

name: Dahi Kebab
instructions: For filling: heat ghee in a pan, roast cashew nuts until golden, chop and set aside. In a bowl mix roasted cashew nuts, fried onion, fennel seeds, green chilli, coriander leaves, salt, red chilli powder, roasted cumin powder and hung curd. For kebab: in a large bowl mix salt, black pepper, bread crumb, nutmeg and roasted gram flour. Take a spoonful of hung curd mixture, stuff with filling, seal into a ball, coat with bread crumb. Refrigerate 5 minutes. Heat oil in kadai, fry kebabs on medium heat until golden and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. For tomato chutney: grind halved tomatoes, ginger, green chilli, cashewnut, salt, red chilli powder, jaggery, oil and lemon juice into smooth paste. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Chicken Chopsuey
instructions: For sauce: mix tomato ketchup, red chilli sauce, light soy sauce, green chilli sauce, sugar and water. Boil noodles in salted water for 6-7 minutes, drain and toss with oil. Fry noodles in wok until golden brown, transfer to absorbent paper. Fry chicken strips until par cooked, set aside. Heat oil in wok, add ginger garlic and onion, sweat for 1 minute. Add carrots, babycorn and saute 1 minute. Add bell peppers, yellow peppers, cabbage and dark soy sauce. Add fried chicken, toss well, add sauce mixture and water, boil quickly. Add cornstarch slurry and cook 1 minute until gravy thickens. Finish with green chilli, spring onion and coriander. Fry egg in omelet pan. Assemble: place fried noodles on plate, top with chicken chop suey, spring onion and fried egg. Serve hot.

name: Mixed Pakora Non Veg
ingredients: chicken breast 450 gms boneless cut into bite size
basa fish 500 gms cut into finger size
instructions: For chicken pakora: mix chicken breast with salt, curd, carom seeds, ginger garlic paste, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander seeds and coriander leaves. Add gram flour and mix well. For fish pakora: mix fish with salt, carom seeds, lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, fenugreek leaves, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, green chillies, rice flour and gram flour. Add mustard oil. For chicken liver pakora: mix liver with salt, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, black peppercorn, lemon juice, curry leaves, coriander leaves, rice flour and gram flour with water. Add oil and baking soda. For egg pakora: mix gram flour, asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger garlic paste. Add curd, water and salt, make smooth batter. Dip boiled eggs and coat well. For coating: mix degi red chilli powder, salt and gram flour. For masala: roast coriander seeds, black peppercorns, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds and salt until aromatic. Grind into coarse powder. For frying: heat oil in kadai, add chicken pakora one by one and fry until half done. Transfer to absorbent paper. Fry fish pakora until half done. Dip boiled eggs in batter and fry until crispy. Fry chicken liver pakora until half cooked. Finally fry all half-cooked pakoras together until golden and crispy. Remove to absorbent paper, transfer to serving dish with green chutney. Garnish with masala and serve hot.

name: Egg Malai Masala
instructions: For gravy: heat ghee and oil in handi, add garlic and ginger, saute 2-3 minutes on medium flame. Add bay leaf, cinnamon stick, onion and salt, cook 5-6 minutes until translucent. Add curd and cook well. Add cashew nuts, salt and water, let simmer. Grind into smooth paste with hand blender. Strain gravy, add water, green chilli, salt and sugar, let simmer until thick. Transfer to serving dish. For masala: dry roast salt, black cardamom, black peppercorns and dry fenugreek leaves 2-3 minutes. Grind into fine powder. For sauteing eggs: heat ghee and oil in pan, add caraway seeds and let splutter. Add boiled eggs and saute 1 minute. Add degi red chilli powder, salt and tender coriander stems, toss well. Place sauteed eggs in gravy. Garnish with masala, chili oil, fresh cream and coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti.

name: Crispy Chicken Popcorn
ingredients: chicken breast 3 cut into small cubes
instructions: For marination: in large bowl add chicken cubes, salt, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, asafoetida, vinegar, coriander leaves and ginger garlic paste. Mix well. Add egg white and cornstarch, mix everything well. For coating: in another bowl add cornflakes and crumb well. Add bread crumbs and mix. Coat chicken cubes in cornflakes crumb properly. For frying: heat oil in kadai until medium hot. Gently slide pieces one after other to oil. Fry in batches on medium flame until golden. Drain on absorbent paper. For dip: blend garlic, green chilli, coriander leaves and olive oil with blender. Transfer to bowl, add mayonnaise and black pepper, mix well. Garnish chicken with coriander sprig and lemon wedge. Serve hot with dip.

name: Potato Tornado Chaat
ingredients: degi red chilli powder a pinch
instructions: Cut potatoes in tornado shape using wooden skewer and knife. Soak in mixture of salt and water for 5-10 minutes. Deep fry in medium hot oil until half done. Before serving, fry again in medium-high hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Prepare dry green chutney: grind coriander leaves, green chillies, toasted chana dal, dried mango powder, cumin powder into fine powder. Prepare curd: mix curd with salt and powdered sugar. Assemble chaat: spread curd on serving plate, place fried potato, add tamarind chutney, sprinkle dry green chutney, degi red chilli powder, roasted cumin powder. Garnish with mint leaves, coriander leaves, onion rings, lucknowi masala and pomegranate pearls, serve immediately.

name: Shenganchi Amti
instructions: For goda masala: heat pan on low heat, dry roast grated coconut until golden brown. In same pan, dry roast red chillies and coriander seeds until fragrant. Heat oil and saute remaining spices one by one, add to roasted ingredients, let cool and grind to semi-coarse powder. For amti: heat peanut oil and add mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, let crackle. Add turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, drumstick pieces and saute properly. Add water and cover with lid to cook through. Once cooked, add tamarind water, jaggery, salt, goda masala and mix well. Add cooked dal and boil for 5 minutes, then add coriander leaves and grated fresh coconut. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Masala Pulao
instructions: Prepare ginger green chili paste: crush ginger and green chillies with salt in mortar pestle. Heat ghee and oil in handi, add peppercorns, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, bay leaf, cumin seeds and splutter well. Add onions and saute until light golden brown. Add ginger green chili paste and saute for 1-2 minutes on moderate heat. Add potatoes, carrots, cauliflower and saute briefly. Add curd, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder and saute for few minutes. Add salt, cashewnuts, kewra water and mix well. Add water, salt, french beans, green peas and mix. Add soaked sella basmati rice and water, mix well. Cover with lid and cook on moderate heat for 15-20 minutes until rice is cooked. Turn off flame and rest. Prepare tadka: heat ghee, add green chili, tomato, cashewnuts, degi red chilli powder and salt, saute well. Pour tadka on pulao. For raitas: bottle gourd raita - mix beaten curd with grated bottle gourd, green chili, coriander leaves, salt, sprinkle chilli powder. Papad raita - mix curd with chopped tomato, green chili, salt, roasted cumin powder, chilli powder, top with crushed roasted papad. Serve pulao hot with raitas, garnish with coriander sprig.

name: vegetable momos
ingredients: salt 1/4 tsp plus 1/2 tsp to taste
instructions: Mix flour with salt and oil, knead with water into soft dough, cover and rest 30 minutes. Meanwhile, heat ghee and fry chopped vegetables until tender. Add black pepper, red chili, salt, and coriander. Mash paneer into coarse powder and mix with vegetables. Flatten dough portions into thin discs, fill with vegetable mixture, fold edges inward to seal. Steam in stacked bamboo steamer for 10 minutes until cooked.

name: Dhaba Style Mixed Vegetables
instructions: Prepare ginger garlic paste: crush garlic, ginger, green chilli with salt in mortar pestle into smooth paste. Heat oil in shallow kadai or handi, add cumin seeds and splutter. Add ginger garlic paste and saute well. Add onions and stir for 10-12 seconds on high flame, then add ghee and saute until golden brown. Add coriander powder, turmeric powder and saute for a minute. Add kashmiri red chilli powder and tomatoes and saute well. Once masala is cooked, add water and cook for 5 minutes. Add carrots and saute. Once carrots are cooked, add green peas, mushroom, french beans, cauliflower, water and mix well. Cover with lid and cook until vegetables are cooked. Add paneer, dried fenugreek leaves, butter and mix well. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with grated paneer, dried fenugreek leaves and coriander sprig, serve hot with roti.

name: turai sabji
instructions: Heat ghee in kadai and add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, asafoetida, ginger, garlic, and green chillies; saute for a few seconds. Add sliced onion and saute until light brown, then add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and coriander powder; saute until fragrant. Add sliced ridge gourd and saute for a minute, add water and cover, cook for 6-8 minutes. Remove lid and stir, add chopped tomatoes and cook for another minute. Finally add coriander leaves and mix well. Serve hot, garnished with fresh coriander leaves.

name: chhena poda
ingredients: lemon juice 1-2 or vinegar 2 tbsp in 1/2 cup water
instructions: In a large sauce pot add milk and bring to boil. Add lemon juice and keep stirring - the milk will get curdled. Once curdled, pour into a bowl lined with thin cotton napkin or muslin cloth. Gently squeeze out remaining whey from it. In a parat or bowl, add prepared chenna and mash slightly, making texture uniform. Add sugar and green cardamom powder and mix well until sugar melts completely. Add all dry fruits and semolina and mix well. In a small bowl mix oil and baking soda together, transfer to parat and mix well. Add little remaining whey water and prepare smooth cake batter consistency. Preheat oven at 200C. Grease a cake mould with oil and place sal leaves into it. Pour chenna poda mixture into the mould and tap twice. Cover the mould with a lid. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour or 50 minutes in pressure cooker until top crust gets dark golden color. Remove from oven and check with bamboo skewer - it should be clean. Let chhena poda cool completely in the pan, then remove. Cut into pieces and transfer to serving plate.

name: vegetable peri peri pasta
ingredients: red bell pepper 1 medium roughly diced
degi red chilli powder 1 heaped tbsp
instructions: For boiling pasta: In saucepot add water and salt to taste, once roaring boiled add macaroni pasta and oil, cook for 4-5 minutes or until al dente on high flame. Strain excess water and coat pasta with oil to avoid sticking. Keep aside. For peri peri sauce: In bowl add garlic cloves, green chillies, onions, chilli flakes, salt to taste, oil, red bell pepper, tomato, and vinegar. In saucepot heat oil, add all vegetables and degi red chilli powder and cook for 6-7 minutes until cooked well. Add water and blend into smooth paste with hand blender. Add more water and keep aside. For vegetable pasta: In pan heat oil, add garlic cloves and onion and saute for a minute. Add mushrooms and toss for 1-2 minutes on high flame. Add prepared peri peri sauce and cook well. Add water and let simmer for a minute. Add boiled pasta and toss well. Finish with fresh cream, cheese, extra virgin olive oil, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves; mix well. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with lemon zest, cheese and basil leaves. Serve hot.

name: punjabi rajma
ingredients: ginger garlic paste 1 tbsp coarsely ground
instructions: Add a pinch of salt to overnight soaked rajma and add required water; boil in pressure cooker for 3-4 whistles. Meanwhile prepare the masala: heat ghee in pan and add cumin seeds and saute for a minute. Add coarsely ground ginger garlic and saute till fragrant. Add onions and saute till they turn brown. Add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala; mix well. Saute for 3-4 minutes. Add tomato paste, mix well and saute until it starts leaving oil. Drain the rajma and reserve the water. Add boiled rajma to prepared masala and saute for 3-4 minutes. Add reserved water as required, mix well and simmer on medium flame for 4-5 minutes. Garnish with ginger julienne and coriander sprig. Serve hot with rice.

name: schezwan triple fried rice
instructions: For boiling rice: In sauce pot add water; once it starts boiling add soaked basmati rice, cover with lid and cook on medium flame. Once done, strain the rice and keep aside. For schezwan chilli paste: In grinder jar add soaked dry red chillies, garlic cloves and grind into smooth paste. Heat oil in pan, add ginger and saute for a minute. Add prepared red chilli paste and coriander stem; saute well. Add vinegar, tomato ketchup, salt to taste; mix well and cook on medium flame for 5 minutes. Transfer to bowl and keep aside. For manchurian balls: In bowl add cabbage, carrot, green chilli, french beans, soya sauce, ginger garlic paste and mix well. Add cornstarch, gram flour, baking soda and mix everything well. Make lemon-sized balls and keep aside. Heat oil in kadhai on medium heat and deep fry balls until golden brown and crispy. For sauce: In pan heat oil and add ginger, garlic, spring onion white part and saute for a few seconds on high heat. Add prepared schezwan paste, tomato ketchup, soya sauce, water, salt, sugar and bring to boil. Add cornstarch slurry and thicken; add fried manchurian balls and cook for half a minute. Finish with coriander leaves and set aside. For assembly: In wok or pan heat oil on high heat and add ginger, garlic, carrot, green chillies, french beans, capsicum; saute for a minute on high. Add soya sauce, black pepper powder, sugar, prepared schezwan paste and saute for a few seconds. Add boiled noodles and rice and toss properly until everything is mixed well. Add salt and finish with spring onions; stir once and switch off flames. Serve hot in bowl, pour manchurian sauce with balls and garnish with fried noodles and coriander leaves.

name: Cheese Masala Pav
instructions: Roast and grind pav bhaji masala spices into powder. Sauté capsicum and tomato in butter, add pav and chilli powder. Add masala and mash with prepared potato filling, cook with water. Top with cheese and cover to melt. Make parcel filling with vegetables, potatoes, ginger garlic paste and spices. Fill bread slices with mixture, seal edges, and shallow fry until crispy. Serve hot with garnish.

name: Shalgam Ka Bharta
instructions: Peel turnips and reserve skin for achaar. Sauté peeled turnips in ghee until light golden. Add white part of green garlic, turmeric, chilli powder and water. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles and cool. Mash cooked turnips into smooth mixture. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and mashed turnips, sauté for a minute and add cream. For achaar, combine turnip skin, green garlic, mustard oil, salt, lime juice and crushed red chilli, rest 10-15 minutes.

name: Mini Idli with Semolina
instructions: Heat ghee, add mustard seeds, water, sugar, salt, turmeric. Add semolina and cook until soft dough forms. Add curd and mix well, knead into dough. Pinch portions, flatten, press center. Boil water with sugar, salt, ghee. Add gulgule and cook 2-3 minutes. Cool in fridge 2-3 minutes. In kadai, heat ghee, add dal and seeds, ginger, curry leaves, chillies, peanuts. Add cooked gulgule, sprinkle water, salt, sugar. Add coriander, mint, lemon juice. Serve hot.

name: Chili Paneer with Tempeh
instructions: Marinate tempeh cubes with salt, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, oil and lime juice for 10-15 minutes. Shallow fry in oil until golden, drain excess oil. In same wok, heat fried tempeh oil, sauté ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add onions, capsicum, sauté well. Add fried tempeh, sugar, coriander stems. Add sauce mixture and cook 2-3 minutes. Add cornstarch slurry, salt, spring onion. Mix well and serve hot.

name: Meen Pollichathu
instructions: Marinate pomfret with lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, salt, red chili and turmeric for 10 minutes. Prepare spice water by mixing water, turmeric, red chili and coriander powder. Heat coconut oil in pan, add ginger, garlic, green chili, curry leaves and onions, sauté until translucent. Add tomato, salt and sauté 2-4 minutes. Add spice water and curry leaves. Sear marinated fish on both sides. Run banana leaf over fire 2-3 seconds to soften. Add masala to banana leaf center, place seared fish, cover with masala. Fold into pocket. Cook on pan 5 minutes seam side down first. Sprinkle water, cook both sides. Garnish with cashew nuts, coriander and serve hot.

name: Kadhai Mushroom Masala
instructions: Prepare ginger garlic paste by grinding garlic cloves, ginger and green chili. Heat oil in kadai, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add onion and sauté until translucent, add ginger garlic paste and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add turmeric, red chili and coriander powders, sauté 1 minute. Add fresh tomato and tomato puree, cook until soft. Prepare kadhai masala by dry roasting cumin, coriander, fennel seeds, black peppercorns and green cardamom, cool and grind to powder, add red chili flakes and fenugreek leaves. In kadai, heat oil, add mushrooms and sauté on high flame, drain water. Add onion, capsicum and salt, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add tomato and sauté, add onion tomato masala. Add water, fenugreek leaves, simmer until thick. Add coriander leaves and kadhai masala, mix well. Serve hot with roti.

name: Paneer Kali Mirch Pasanda
instructions: Prepare gravy: heat oil and ghee, add cinnamon, cardamom and cloves, sauté until fragrant. Add ginger and garlic, sauté well. Add bay leaf and white onions, sauté. Add green chili and cashew nuts, sauté. Add curd and water, mix well. Cool, remove whole spices, transfer to grinder and make smooth paste. Strain and set aside. Prepare stuffing: mix grated paneer, cashew nuts, raisins, mint, green chili, ginger, coriander leaves, salt and red chili powder. Make slurry with refined flour, cornstarch, salt, vinegar and water. Stuff paneer slices to make sandwiches. Coat with dry cornstarch then dip in slurry. Deep fry in hot oil at medium heat until cooked. Transfer to paper. Prepare tempering: heat ghee, add green cardamom and green chili. Add gravy and cook well, add water and bring to boil. Season with salt. Serve paneer pasanda garnished with pepper, mint, chili oil and cardamom powder with paratha.

name: sarson wale aloo
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a kadai and add fennel, cumin, and nigella seeds to splutter. Add turmeric powder, ginger, and garlic and saute well. Add baby potatoes, green chillies, and salt and toss. Add water, cover with lid and cook on medium flame for 10-15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Garnish with spring onion, green chilli, and mustard oil. Serve hot.

name: curry leaves chicken
instructions: Make green paste with curry leaves, green chillies, garlic, ginger, curd, salt, lemon juice, and oil in grinder. Marinate chicken with green paste. Temper with oil, cinnamon, black cardamom, curry leaves and let splutter. Add shallots and saute until translucent, add marinated chicken and saute. Add crushed black peppercorns and water, cover and cook. Add tomatoes, cover and cook on medium heat. Add masala paste, water, salt, and sugar. Serve garnished with curry leaves and dried red chillies.

name: chicken pahadi kebab
instructions: First marination: mix chicken with salt, ginger-garlic-green chilli paste, and lemon juice for 15-20 minutes. Squeeze out excess water. Make green paste from coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chillies, fenugreek leaves, oil, and salt. Second marination: mix green paste, hung curd, mustard oil, salt, ginger-garlic paste, cardamom powder, and carom seeds. Add squeezed chicken and marinate 10-15 minutes. Add roasted gram flour and mustard oil to marinated chicken. Thread on skewers and cook on hot grill pan with oil from both sides until golden and cooked. Serve hot with chaat masala, black pepper powder, coriander leaves, and lemon wedges.

name: toffee bananas
instructions: Make batter by mixing refined flour, salt, water, and baking powder. Let rest 5-10 minutes. Dust banana pieces with dry refined flour, dip in batter, and deep fry in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
