In a pan, heat sugar with little water and cook until golden brown caramel forms. Add fried banana to hot caramel and coat well, then immediately put in ice cold water for a few seconds. Remove on absorbent paper and sprinkle sesame seeds. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream garnished with mint leaves and sesame seeds.

name: italian chatpate aloo
instructions: Heat oil in kadai and add ginger, garlic, green chillies, saute for half a minute. Add baby potatoes, chilli flakes, dried oregano, crushed coriander seeds, salt, and turmeric powder, mix well. Sprinkle water and cover, cook on medium heat until potatoes are completely cooked. Once cooked, add mint leaves, dried oregano, and lemon juice and mix well. Serve garnished with mint leaves and lemon wedges.

name: chilli paneer roll
instructions: Heat oil and fry cornstarch-marinated paneer strips until crisp and brown. Prepare salad with carrot, cabbage, chilli vinegar and sugar. Roll thin roti dough and cook on both sides with oil until light brown. Heat oil, add ginger, onion, capsicum, saute well. Add red chilli sauce, soy sauce, fried paneer and toss. Add coriander and spring onion. Assemble roll by heating roti, spreading mayonnaise and green chilli sauce, adding salad, chilli paneer, mayonnaise and spring onion. Roll tightly and garnish with coriander and chilli sauce.

name: shanghai chili paneer
ingredients: spring onion bulb (1/4 cup, roughly chopped)
instructions: Make paneer balls by mixing paneer with coriander stems, schezwan sauce, degi chilli powder, ginger, salt, cornstarch and bread crumbs. Form lemon-sized balls, coat with cornstarch and deep fry until golden. In wok with hot oil, add ginger, onion, carrots and saute 1 minute on high flame. Add dry red chillies, bell pepper, capsicum, spring onion bulb, sesame seeds, peppercorns and fried paneer balls. Toss well on high flame. Add prepared sauce (mixed red chilli, schezwan, green chilli, soy sauce, ketchup, sugar and water). Cook 4-5 minutes until thickened. Finish with spring onion. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with sesame seeds and coriander. Serve hot.

name: butter chicken meatballs
ingredients: kasuri methi (1/4 tsp, dried fenugreek leaves, crushed)
instructions: For sauce: In thick-bottom pan, add butter, oil, ginger, green chilli, onion, salt, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder and saute well. Add tomato and little water, cook on medium flame. Add dry fenugreek leaves and mix. Remove spoonfull prepared masala separately. In remaining masala add cashew nut, ketchup, butter, sugar, degi red chilli powder and mix. Cool and blend into smooth puree. For meatballs: Mix chicken mince, bread crumbs, salt, prepared masala, degi red chilli powder, garam masala, poha powder, coriander leaves. Heat oil in kadai, make bite-size balls and deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Remove on absorbent paper. For butter chicken: In pan, add butter, let melt, add fried balls, fresh cream, coriander leaves and saute well. Serve with prepared gravy.

name: aloo keema masala
ingredients: coriander stems (1/2 tbsp, tender, roughly chopped)
instructions: For ginger-garlic paste: In mortar pestle, add garlic, ginger, green chilli and make coarse paste. For aloo keema: In lagan/handi, add oil and saute mutton bones on high flame for 8-10 minutes until golden brown. Add mutton mince, prepared paste, salt, coriander powder, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, coriander stems, onions and mix well. Cover with lid, add water on top, cook 10-15 minutes on moderate heat until partially cooked. Add water and curd, mix well, cover and cook 7-8 minutes. Add water and potatoes, cover and simmer. Add coriander leaves, green chilli, prepared masala and mix. Transfer to serving dish and garnish. For chutney: Roast tomato and green chilli on gas range. In bowl, add roasted tomato, green chilli, dry pomegranate seeds, salt, sugar, oil, mint, ginger, coriander leaves and grind into smooth paste. For masala: In pan, dry roast cumin seeds, black peppercorns, black cardamom, cloves, cinnamon stick and salt on moderate heat. Transfer to grinder and grind into fine powder. Serve hot with roti/chapati and chutney.

name: tomato soup with basil pesto and garlic bread
ingredients: extra virgin olive oil (2-3 tbsp, for finishing)
extra virgin olive oil (1 tbsp, for finishing)
instructions: For tomato soup: Heat oil in sauce pot, add garlic, onion, carrots and saute 2-3 minutes until translucent. Add salt and sugar, saute well. Add tomato and saute 1 minute. Add water and salt, simmer covered 10-15 minutes on low-medium flame. Add degi red chilli powder and grind with hand blender. Strain soup into bowl. In same pot, add olive oil, pour strained soup and simmer. For basil pesto: Boil water with salt and cashew nuts, then strain. In bowl, add cashew nuts, garlic cloves, olive oil, basil leaves, green chilli, parmesan cheese and chill. Transfer to blender, add olive oil and grind coarsely. Add finishing olive oil to bowl. For garlic bread: Cut baguette into thick slices, apply olive oil and toast golden on both sides. Add basil pesto, cheese and cook 2-3 minutes until cheese melts. To serve: Add oregano and chilli flakes to soup bowl, pour hot soup, top with basil pesto, garnish with basil leaves. Serve with garlic bread.

name: gajar matar ki sabzi
ingredients: winter carrots (3, peeled & cut into small cubes)
instructions: For paste: In pan, add onion, tomatoes, ginger, green chillies and water. Blend into smooth paste. For sabzi: In kadai, add ghee and cumin seeds, let splutter. Add prepared paste and saute 4-5 minutes until raw aroma leaves. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, degi red chilli powder and saute well 2-3 minutes on low flame. Add asafoetida and adjust salt, mix well. Add chopped winter carrots and green peas, mix well and cook on low flame until vegetables are cooked. Give final touch with spoonful of ghee for better taste. Garnish with coriander leaves and sprinkle lime juice. Serve hot with roti.

name: fusilli pasta with capsicum masala
instructions: Cook fusilli pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain. For sauce: Heat olive oil in pan, add garlic and onion, saute until golden. Add diced capsicum and saute 2-3 minutes. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until sauce thickens. Season with salt, degi red chilli powder and italian herbs. Add cooked pasta to sauce and toss well. The recipe combines traditional napoletana base with a dash of Indian masala to create a fusion dish.

name: batata vada pav
instructions: For green chilli-garlic paste: In mortar pestle, add green chilli, garlic cloves, salt and make smooth paste. For batata vada: Heat oil in deep pan, add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add curry leaves and green chilli-garlic paste, saute well. Add turmeric powder and degi red chilli powder on medium flame for 1 minute. Add little water and saute. Cool, add boiled mashed potatoes and coriander leaves, mix well. Make medium balls and keep aside. For batter: In bowl, add gram flour, salt, baking soda, degi red chilli powder, water, sugar and oil, rest 10 minutes, then mix well. Dip each potato ball in batter until coated, deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. For garlic chutney: In pan, add fresh coconut and roast on low flame until light golden. Add garlic cloves with skin and dry roast well. Add dry red chillies and roast. Add asafoetida and mix. Cool and grind coarsely. Classic vada pav assembly: Slice pav in half, apply green chutney on both sides, sprinkle dry garlic chutney, place fried batata vada in center with fried green chilli. Serve hot. (Additional variations shown: cheese vada pav, schezwan vada pav, burger vada pav, chura pav.)

name: Eggless Omelette
instructions: Prepare batter by mixing trimmed bread, gram flour, refined flour, salt, sugar, saffron water, milk, water and baking soda. Let rest 15 minutes. Heat butter in pan, pour ladle of batter and rotate to spread evenly. Cook until underside is done and edges loosen. Add grated cheese on one side and roll. Sauté onion, green chilli, ginger, tomato with coriander separately. Serve hot with charred tomatoes and potatoes.

name: Mutton Chop Masala
instructions: For yakhni: Heat ghee and oil, add cloves, peppercorns, cardamom, bay leaf, cinnamon. Add mutton, ginger-garlic paste and sauté 4-5 minutes. Add salt, chilli powder, coriander powder. Add water and simmer 10-12 minutes. For paste: grind onions, ginger, garlic, green chillies with oil and spices into smooth paste. In gravy pot, sauté paste until light brown and releases oil. Add ghee, curd mixture, mutton yakhni and cooked mutton. Cook 10-15 minutes. Finish with coriander, mint, sugar, lemon juice.

name: Lucknow Style Mutton Korma
instructions: Prepare curd mixture by mixing curd with ginger-garlic paste, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander and cumin powder. For masala: dry roast black cardamom, peppercorns, coriander seeds, cloves, green cardamom, bay leaf, cinnamon, shahi jeera, mace and salt. Cool and grind to fine powder. In a deep pot, heat ghee and oil with cinnamon, bay leaf and black cardamom. Add mutton and sauté 2-4 minutes. Add onions and salt, sauté until light brown. Add curd mixture and sauté 5-10 minutes until masalas are cooked. Add water, cover and cook until mutton is tender. Add saffron water, kewra water and cashew paste. Finish with prepared masala and coriander leaves. Serve hot with roti.

name: Veg Frankie
instructions: For dough: mix maida, wheat flour, water and oil into semi-soft dough, knead well and rest 30 minutes. For frankie masala: lightly roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, then add turmeric, chilli powder, asafoetida, garam masala, mango powder and salt. Grind to powder. For chilli vinegar: mix chopped green and red chillies with salt and vinegar. For filling: heat oil, add garlic paste, ginger, green chilli and sauté 1 minute. Add coriander powder, chilli powder, asafoetida and sauté 30 seconds. Add tomato ketchup and puree, sauté until cooked. Add mashed potatoes, frankie masala and coriander leaves. For assembly: heat flat pan with butter and oil, place half-cooked roti on one side and potato mixture on opposite side. Cook both sides. Remove roti, add hot potato mixture to one side, top with chopped onion, coriander, masala, chilli vinegar and cheese. Roll tightly and wrap.

name: Stuffed Tomato
instructions: For stuffing: heat oil, add cumin, fennel, coriander seeds, ginger and green chillies. Sauté 30 seconds. Add potatoes with salt and spice powders, add water and cover. Cook until 70-80% done. Add paneer and sauté 1 minute. Mash lightly and add green peas, coriander and mint leaves. For gravy: heat oil, add cumin seeds, ginger, green chilli, turmeric, coriander powder, asafoetida and chilli powder. Sauté 30 seconds. Add tomato puree, salt and butter. Boil 1 minute and keep aside. Marinate hollowed tomatoes with oil, salt, chilli powder and dried fenugreek leaves. Stuff tomatoes tightly with prepared filling. Place in gravy and simmer 10-12 minutes on low heat. Finish gravy with fresh cream. Serve tomatoes in gravy, garnished with coriander leaves, cream and fried cashews.

name: Crispy Shanghai Chilli Chicken
instructions: Mix egg with ginger garlic paste, salt, and red chilli powder. Mix cornstarch, refined flour, salt, and white pepper powder in a bowl. Dip chicken in egg mixture, coat with flour. Heat oil and deep fry chicken slices until golden. Remove and cut into strips. In a wok, heat oil and sauté cinnamon, star anise, dry red chilli, and fresh chilli. Add carrot, sesame seeds, brown sugar and fried chicken strips, toss well. Add red chilli powder and sugar. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with spring onion.

name: Chocolate Ice Cream with Brownie
instructions: For brownie: Add softened butter to bowl, mix with melted dark chocolate. Add refined flour, baking powder, baking soda, candied orange, milkmaid and water to make smooth batter. Transfer to mold and microwave 3 minutes. Cool and cut into cubes. For ice cream: Warm fresh cream with melted dark chocolate. In another bowl, mix whipped cream, milkmaid, and cocoa powder. Combine mixtures, add brownie bits, transfer to airtight container and freeze 2-4 hours. Scoop and serve garnished with brownie bits, milkmaid and melted chocolate.

name: Rose Halwa
instructions: In a large bowl, add rose syrup and salt. Add ghee, cornstarch and water and whisk well. Transfer to kadai and stir constantly. Cook on medium flame, add ghee and mix until absorbed. Add mixed nuts and combine well. Transfer to greased tray and level. Rest 30 minutes until set. Cut into pieces and garnish with pistachios and rose petals.

name: Mango Shahi Tukda
instructions: For rabdi: Mix peeled cubed mangoes with milk powder and saffron. Cook with sugar for 1 minute. Add milk and cook 2 minutes on medium flame. Add baking soda and cook 2-3 more minutes. Add cardamom and cool. For milk: Add a ladle of rabdi to room temperature milk. For bread: Trim bread slices into triangles, heat ghee and shallow fry until light golden. Immediately soak in prepared milk for 20-25 minutes. Before serving: Arrange soaked bread slices, pour rabdi over top, garnish with mango cubes and mint.

name: Spicy Tawa Idli
instructions: Heat butter in kadai and sauté onion until translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste and red chilli-garlic chutney, sauté 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add capsicum, green chilli, red chilli powder and pav bhaji masala, sauté 1 minute. Add water and salt, mix well. Add idli pieces and toss gently, cover and cook 5-6 minutes. Uncover and mix. Finish with butter, lemon juice and coriander leaves. Serve hot garnished with coriander and pav bhaji masala.

name: Crispy Baby Corn Salt and Pepper
ingredients: 4 fresh green chillies cut in 1 inch pieces
instructions: Blanch baby corn in boiling water with salt and sugar for 5-6 minutes. Toss blanched corn with salt, black pepper powder, refined flour and corn-starch. Deep fry in medium hot oil until light golden. Heat oil in wok and saute ginger, garlic, onion until translucent. Add green chillies and coriander stem and saute 2-3 minutes. Deep fry baby corn again in hot oil until golden and crispy. Add to wok with salt, black pepper powder and powdered sugar. Toss well and cook 1 minute. Finish with spring onion and coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: Cornflakes Chivda
ingredients: 2 dry red chilli cut into pieces
instructions: Dry toast corn flakes for a minute and add salt and sugar. In a bowl mix salt, sugar, red chilli powder, dried mango powder and coat corn flakes. Heat oil in kadai and add green chilli, dried red chilli, curry leaves. Saute and add cashew nuts, peanuts, coconut flakes, raisins, dried cranberries. Saute for some time. Add corn flakes mixture and mix well. Do final seasoning with dried mango powder, sugar and black pepper. Store in airtight container.

name: Rawa Uthappam Pizza
instructions: Mix rawa, curd, water and salt, keep aside for 1 hour. Heat oil in pan and saute onions, broccoli, bell peppers with salt for 2-3 minutes. On flat pan add rawa mixture and spread evenly. Cook until base sets. Flip and apply tomato ketchup, add sauteed veggies and grated cheese. Cover and cook on low heat until cheese melts. Remove and serve warm.

name: Chicken Cafreal
instructions: Make smooth paste in grinder with coriander leaves, mint, garlic, ginger, vinegar, salt, sugar, onion, cumin seeds, black peppercorns, coriander seeds, green cardamom, clove, cinnamon and green chili. Marinate chicken thighs with turmeric powder, salt, onion, black peppercorns, ginger, garlic, vinegar and prepared paste for 10-15 minutes. Add olive oil and rest further. In pan add oil and cook marinated chicken covered from both sides until tender. Add onion, tomato, capsicum and leftover marinade and stir fry. Serve on vegetable bed with lemon wedges and coriander. Serve hot with pao.

name: Rava Uttapam
instructions: Mix semolina, curd, salt and water to get dropping consistency. Add oil and baking soda and mix well. Heat non-stick pan and pour ladle of batter in round shape. Sprinkle onion, coriander, tomato, green chilli and red chilli powder on top. When base is firm flip and cook other side on medium flame. For chutney heat sesame oil and add mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves to splutter. Add dry red chilli and ginger, saute well. Add sliced onion and saute 2 minutes. Add tomato and cook 2-4 minutes on medium flame. Add tamarind pulp, red chilli powder and jaggery, saute well. Cool and grind to smooth paste. Serve uttapam hot with chutney.

name: bread omelette lollies
instructions: In a bowl, whisk eggs with salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, ginger, and coriander leaves. Heat butter in a pan, saute onions until translucent, add half the egg mixture and scramble. Add boiled potatoes and mix well. Add salt, green chillies, coriander leaves, and cheese to the mixture. Trim bread slice edges, place filling on one slice, close with another slice, cut in half. Mix remaining egg mixture with milk and cheese for coating. Dip bread halves in egg mixture, coat well. Heat butter and oil in a pan, place lollies and cook until golden. Serve hot with tomato ketchup, mayonnaise, and sev.

name: soya keema masala
instructions: Soak soya mince in water with salt for 20 minutes. Heat ghee, add soya mince and saute for 3-4 minutes. Mix red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, and garam masala in curd, add to keema and cook well. Add soaked masoor dal and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add minced cauliflower and ghee, saute. Add another curd mixture with red chilli powder and coriander powder, cook and remove. For tempering: heat ghee, add cumin seeds and asafoetida, add red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, and water. Add tomato puree and green chillies, cook until oil separates. Add keema mixture and cook for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: peri peri egg curry
instructions: Boil eggs in water with vinegar and salt for 6 minutes for soft-boiled. Cool in chilled water and peel. For peri peri paste: grind red bird eye chillies, garlic cloves, salt, oil, tomatoes, and red chillies into smooth paste. In a saucepan, saute peri peri paste with water for 2-3 minutes on medium flame. Add seasoned oil and mix well. Add sugar and mix. Add boiled eggs, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Bring to boil, add cornflour slurry and coriander leaves. For peri peri seasoning: heat oil, add garlic cloves and saute until light brown. Add chilli flakes and oregano, cook for 1 minute. Strain flavored oil. Garnish curry with peri peri seasoning and coriander sprigs. Serve hot with rice.

name: railway wali aloo ki sabji
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, boiled and roughly cut
instructions: Heat oil in a kadhai, add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add green chillies and cook for a minute. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, and coriander powder, mix well. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften or leave oil. Add salt and mix well. Add boiled potatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring to avoid sticking. Add water as required to make gravy and cook for another 5 minutes. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with puri.

name: cooker wale dum aloo
instructions: In a bowl, add onion, ginger, green chilli, oil, and coriander leaves. Grind into a smooth paste. In a cooker, add ghee and oil, once hot add cumin seeds and fennel seeds and let them splutter. Add prepared paste and saute until raw smell goes away and paste thickens. Add baby potatoes and saute well. Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, and degi red chilli powder and saute. Add a little water and saute until masala becomes thick. Add tomato puree and salt, mix well on medium flame. Cover with lid and cook until potatoes are done. Add coriander leaves and mix. Garnish with coriander sprigs and tomato wedges and serve hot.

name: instant sooji cutlet
instructions: For tandoori curd mixture: mix curd, salt, sugar, black pepper powder, cardamom powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida, cumin powder, ginger garlic paste, and water. Add semolina and mix well. For tadka: heat oil, add cumin seeds, ginger, carrot, french beans, and green chillies. Saute for 2-4 minutes. Add prepared tandoori curd mixture and mix. Cook until semolina absorbs water. Transfer to bowl and cool to room temperature. Add coriander leaves and mix. Divide mixture into portions, make a dent, stuff with cheese, close from all sides. Mix refined flour with water and salt for slurry. Dip cutlet in slurry and coat with breadcrumbs. Heat oil in kadai, slide cutlet into hot oil. Fry on medium flame until golden on both sides, cooked from inside. Drain on kitchen tissue. Garnish with coriander sprigs and serve hot.

name: dry fruits ice cream
instructions: For condensed milk: in a sauce pot, add milk and sugar and mix well. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes. In a bowl mix milk powder and baking soda, transfer to sauce pot. Keep stirring continuously on medium flame until mixture thickens and becomes frothy and silky smooth. Turn off flame and cool completely. For ice cream: in a pan, add almonds, cashews and salt, slightly roast on medium flame. Take chilled whipping cream in a bowl and whisk for about 10 minutes until soft peaks form. In a large bowl, mix prepared condensed milk and whipped cream, mix well. Add chopped dry fruits and mix properly. Transfer to container and freeze for 4-6 hours until set. Scoop with scooper into serving bowl. Garnish with chocolate syrup, rose syrup, crushed parle g, and fresh mint leaves. Serve chilled.

name: Egg Pakoda Fingers
instructions: Mix 8 eggs with salt, black pepper, chopped green chillies, ginger, coriander leaves, and oil. Grease a mould with oil and pour egg mixture. Steam for 8-10 minutes until cooked completely. Cool and demould, cut into finger shapes. In a bowl, mix gram flour, ginger-garlic paste, salt, asafoetida, red chilli powder, turmeric, carom seeds, 1 egg, and curd. Coat cooled egg fingers in gram flour and insert a wooden skewer. Dip in batter and deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crispy. Remove on absorbent paper. For salad: mix diced bell peppers with chopped coriander leaves, lemon juice, salt, and salad oil. Serve pakoda fingers with salad and garnish with coriander and lemon wedges.

name: Wheat Flour Kheer
instructions: Heat ghee in a kadhai. Add whole wheat flour and roast on low flame, stirring continuously to avoid lumps from forming. Roast until the flour turns medium brown in colour. Add a pinch of salt to enhance taste. Once flour is brown enough, add milk and mix well while stirring continuously to combine and avoid lumps. Add sugar and stir continuously until it dissolves, ensuring no lumps form. Allow the kheer to boil for a few minutes until it begins to thicken. Remove from flame and serve hot.

name: South Indian Style Dal Tadka
instructions: In a pressure cooker, add water, toor dal, urad dal, salt, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, and asafoetida. Cook for 2-3 whistles until dal is soft. Mash with ladle. In a mortar pestle, make a coarse paste with ginger, garlic, and green chillies. In a pan, heat oil and add fenugreek seeds and ginger-garlic paste, cook for 1 minute. Add chopped shallots and cook for 2-3 minutes until translucent. Add curry leaves and cook. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, chopped tomatoes, and water. Cook well. Add cooked dal, salt, and curry leaves. Simmer. Transfer to bowl. For second tadka: heat ghee, add cumin seeds and let splutter, add button chillies, asafoetida, red chilli powder. Pour tadka over dal and serve hot with tadka rice.

name: Govind Gatta Curry
instructions: For stuffing: mix dried fig, almonds, cashew nuts, green chillies, coriander leaves, khoya, and salt. For dough: mix gram flour, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, carom seeds, ghee, and beaten curd. Take small dough portions, spread in hand, add stuffing, and close. In a pot, heat water with salt, sugar, dry red chilli, and carom seeds. Add prepared gattas and poach until they float. Remove and set aside. Heat ghee in pan and shallow fry poached gattas until light golden from all sides. For curd mixture: mix beaten curd with turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida, and optional cumin powder. In a kadai, heat ghee and add bay leaf, dry red chillies, ginger, garlic, green chilli, and asafoetida. Sauté for seconds. Add curd mixture and stir for 5-6 minutes until fragrant. Add water and bring to boil. Add fried govind gattas and cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes. Serve hot garnished with coriander leaves.

name: Kesar Phirni
instructions: Grind soaked rice into smooth powder. Boil 3/4 milk separately. Mix rice powder into remaining milk and add to boiling milk. Stir continuously until thick. Add sugar and kesari milk masala, cook 2-3 minutes. Transfer to serving dish, cool to room temperature 30-35 minutes, then refrigerate. Garnish with silver vark, saffron strands and fresh rose petals. Serve chilled.

name: Chicken Dhaba Masala
instructions: Dry roast all whole spices (peppercorns, mace, cumin, coriander, cloves, cardamom) on low flame until aromatic. Grind into fine powder. Marinate chicken with salt, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, lemon juice and oil for 10-15 minutes. In a heavy pan, heat ghee and oil, add cumin seeds to splutter. Add onions and sauté until translucent. Add marinated chicken and cook 5-10 minutes. Add green chillies, mint, and spice powders. Add tomato purée and water, cover and cook 15-20 minutes on medium flame. Add prepared chicken masala and kasuri methi. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Masala French Toast
instructions: Prepare beetroot chutney by cooking puree with chilli powder, salt, sugar and vinegar until thickened. Make egg mixture with eggs, milk, coriander, green chillies, flour and salt. Apply beetroot chutney and green chutney on bread slices, add cheese, dip sandwich in egg mixture, heat pan with butter, place coated sandwich and cook from both sides until light brown.

name: Desi Lasagna
instructions: Make batter with gram flour, refined flour, water, curd, salt, sugar and spices. Cook on non-stick pan to make thin sheets. For filling, saute garlic and onion, add tomatoes, spices and mash vegetables, cook with water. Layer filling with lasagna sheets and cheese, add water between layers, cover with another pan and cook on medium flame until cheese melts.

name: Egg Masala
instructions: Roast coriander, cumin, fennel seeds, peppercorns, cloves and cardamom, cool and grind. Saute boiled eggs in ghee and oil until golden. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, chillies, then onion until golden, add spices and tomato, cook until soft, add salt, water, sugar and prepared masala, finish with lemon juice and coriander. Serve with sauteed eggs on top.

name: Carrot Halwa Cake
instructions: Make gajar halwa by cooking grated carrots in ghee, adding milk and cooking until evaporated, add sugar. For cake, make dry mix with semolina, sugar, baking powder, flour, cardamom. Add butter, oil, gajar halwa, pistachios, condensed milk. Add milk and curd, grease cake tin, bake in pressure cooker at medium-low for 40-45 minutes. Make compote with strawberry, sugar and julienned carrot. Garnish with compote, mint and icing sugar.

name: Sesame Masala Bread Toast
instructions: For filling: Mix crushed sweet corn, chopped carrot, french beans, green chillies, ginger, toasted sesame seeds, salt, coriander leaves, and grated potatoes. For ketchup: Heat oil, sauté garlic until fragrant, add sesame seeds, saute briefly, add chilli powder. Switch off flame, add water and tomato ketchup, mix well. To assemble: Sprinkle water on bread slices, spread vegetable mixture evenly, apply sesame seeds, shallow fry in medium hot oil until golden and crispy from both sides. Remove and cut edges, serve with sesame garlic ketchup.

name: Rawa Idli
ingredients: 1 tbsp red and green chilli chopped
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, gota urad, asafoetida, red chilli, green chilli, and broken cashew, saute well. Add salt and ginger, add semolina and roast well on medium flame. Transfer to bowl, add curd and water, mix properly and keep aside for 20 minutes. Add fruit salt and mix well. Grease idli mould, pour batter and place half cashew on each. Steam at higher temperature for 3-4 minutes. Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Dragon Chili Chicken
instructions: For marinade: Mix chicken breast strips with salt, eggs, white pepper powder, cornstarch, baking soda, ginger garlic paste. Marinate 15-20 minutes, then add cornstarch and oil. Fry in hot oil until half done, transfer to absorbent paper. Refried until crispy. For sauce: Mix degi red chilli powder, vinegar, oil, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, coriander stems, tomato ketchup, water, sugar. Simmer 8-10 minutes until semi-thick, blend with hand blender. For dragon chicken: Heat oil in wok, add garlic and ginger, saute 1 minute. Add onion, capsicum, red pepper, toss 2-3 minutes. Add prepared sauce, spring onions, fried chicken, toss well. Garnish with coriander and spring onion. Serve hot.

name: Bread Pakoda Chaat
instructions: For filling: Heat oil, add ginger, green chillies, french beans, carrot, saute well. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, salt, saute 1 minute. Add boiled mashed potatoes, mix well. Add prepared masala and coriander leaves, mix and keep aside. For masala: Dry roast cumin seeds, fennel seeds, coriander seeds, black peppercorns, salt on medium flame, transfer to mortar pestle, grind coarsely. For burger buns: Toast with butter, degi red chilli powder, garam masala on both sides. For batter: Mix gram flour, semolina, degi red chilli powder, asafoetida, curd, carom seeds, baking soda, salt, add water for thick consistency. Add filling to burger buns, close, dip in batter, deep fry until golden brown and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper, cut into pieces, transfer to plate. Drizzle yogurt, tamarind chutney, green chutney on top. Sprinkle nylon sev, pomegranate pearls, fried boondi. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: Chili Chicken Burger
instructions: For sauteed veggies: Heat oil, add onion, carrot, ginger, green chillies, saute 1 minute until onions translucent. Add light soy sauce, cook until mixture is dry. Set aside. For patty: Mix chicken mince, boiled potatoes, sauteed veggies. Add salt, black pepper powder, coriander leaves, mix well. Divide into equal parts, dip in beaten egg, coat with bread crumbs. Shallow fry in medium hot oil until golden brown. Set aside. For relish: Heat oil, add onion, capsicum, ginger, green chillies, saute. Add dark soy sauce, tomato ketchup, saute 1 minute until onions soft. Set aside. For burger: Toast buns with butter, spread mayonnaise on bottom bun, layer tomato, relish, lettuce, patty, cheese slice, relish. Close with top bun. Prick with skewer for hold. Garnish with cherry tomato, lemon slice, coriander sprig. Serve with fries.

name: Whole Wheat Modak
instructions: For filling: Heat ghee in non-stick pan, add sesame seeds, grated coconut, broken cashews. Mix for 1 minute. Add jaggery, cook on medium flame 2-3 minutes until it comes together. Add cardamom powder, pinch of salt, mix well and cool. For dough: Add whole wheat flour, semolina, hot oil in a bowl. Add sufficient water and knead into stiff dough, keep aside 10 minutes. Divide dough into 7 equal balls. Roll each into thin roundels. Form cup by making folds gently, fill with cooked mixture, pinch folds together to form modak. Heat oil in deep kadai, add modak, fry on medium heat until crisp and golden brown. Drain on tissue paper and serve hot.

name: Dahi Wala Mutton
ingredients: 1 tbsp tender coriander stem roughly chopped
1 tbsp fresh mint leaves roughly chopped
2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves roughly chopped
instructions: For ginger garlic paste: In mortar pestle, add ginger, green chilli, garlic, salt. Make coarse paste and set aside. For tempering: Heat ghee in handi, add cloves, black cardamom, black peppercorns, bay leaf, let splutter well. Add onions, saute well. Add mutton, ginger garlic paste, salt, saute on medium flame. Add dry red chillies, saute. Add coriander stem, mix, add asafoetida, coriander powder, saute well. Add curd, mix continuously on medium flame. Add water, mix. Transfer to pressure cooker, take 5-6 whistles. Remove from flame, rest, open lid. Add mint leaves, coriander leaves, sugar, mix. Add prepared masala, mix. Place on flame again. Add cashew paste to thicken. Get one quick boil, remove from flame. Transfer to serving plate. Garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot. For masala: Dry roast black peppercorns, black cardamom, green cardamom, fennel seeds, salt on low flame until aromatic. Transfer to grinder, grind into fine powder.

name: Mexican Chicken Burrito
ingredients: 1/2 cup wheat and refined flour dough
instructions: For marinating chicken: Add chicken, salt, ginger-garlic paste in bowl, mix, keep aside 15-20 minutes. For chicken gravy: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, let crackle, add green chillies, onion, saute until light golden. Add coriander powder, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, saute until fragrant. Add curd, mix, saute 2-3 minutes on medium heat. Add marinated chicken, mix, add salt, water, kidney beans. Cover, cook 15-20 minutes until chicken cooked. Remove lid, finish with coriander leaves. For roti: Take small portion of dough, roll into thin roti. Half cook on flat pan. For salad: Mix chopped onion, tomato, green chillies, salt, coriander leaves, lemon juice. For rice: Mix cooked rice, roasted cumin powder, melted butter. For assembling: Roast half-cooked roti from both sides. Place on plate, spread mayonnaise on lower part. Add rice, chicken with gravy, salad, grated cheese. Fold both sides in, roll tightly from near side to far side. Ready to serve with mayonnaise or chutney and nachos.

name: dhaba mutton curry
instructions: Heat oil and ghee, add black cardamom, cloves, and peppercorns. Add ginger-garlic paste and onions, sauté until brown. Add salt and coriander powder, then marinated mutton. Add water and cover to pressure cook for 5-6 whistles. Once cooled, add onion-tomato masala and cook covered for 5-7 minutes. Garnish with fenugreek leaves, ginger, and coriander.

name: vrat fruit chaat
instructions: Dice sweet potato, apple, kiwi, and pineapple. Mix with oil, sendha namak, cumin powder, black pepper, and honey. Thread on wooden skewers alternating fruit pieces. Roast skewers on pan until light golden. Prepare spicy honey by mixing honey, salt, cumin, and black pepper. Spread curd on plate, place skewers, drizzle spicy honey, garnish with pomegranate and coriander.

name: bhuna gosht
instructions: In pressure cooker, heat oil and ghee, add bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon, green chilli, and onions. Add mutton and sauté 3-4 minutes. Add coriander powder, chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste. Add water and cook 7-8 whistles. Add kewra water and curd, simmer. Add coriander, mint, and prepared masala until gravy thickens. Serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: cone papdi chaat
instructions: Knead tight dough with refined flour, salt, carom, oil, gram flour, baking soda, curd, and water. Make filling by boiling and mashing potatoes, add ginger, green chilli, coriander. Temper with oil, seeds, add spices and green moong. Roll dough thin, apply oil, roll like swiss roll, rest 5 minutes, roll again thin. Pan-fry briefly both sides, form into cones using silver foil support. Deep fry until golden. Fill cones with potato mixture, tamarind chutney, green chutney, sev, curd mixture. Garnish with pomegranate and coriander.

name: crispy pav bhaji balls
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, green chillies, onion, tomato. Add pav bhaji masala and chilli powder, cook 4-5 minutes. Add pav bread pieces, butter, cook 2 minutes. Add grated potatoes, paneer, coriander, cook 1 minute. Cool and grind to thick paste. Form into bite-size balls and deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper. Mix cheese and mayonnaise for dip. Serve hot with cheesy mayonnaise.

name: karahi gosht
instructions: Pressure cook: Heat ghee, add cinnamon and bay leaf. Add onions, then mutton, salt, garlic, tomatoes, green chilli, and cook. Pressure cook 10-12 whistles. Dry roast masala spices and grind coarsely. In kadhai, sauté cooked mutton 5-6 minutes. Add water, turmeric, and chilli powder. Add beaten curd and cook 5-6 minutes. Add prepared masala, chilli flakes, fenugreek, tender coriander stems, cook 5-6 minutes. Add water, ginger, bhavnagri chillies. Once cooked, transfer to serving plate and garnish with coriander and ginger.

name: Tomato Upma
instructions: Roast bombay rava in ghee on medium heat until dry, set aside. In a small pan, heat ghee, add peanuts and fry half minute, then add cashew nuts and fry until light brown, set aside. In kadai, heat ghee and oil, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, chana dal, gota urad, curry leaves and saute until light brown. Add ginger, green chillies, onion and saute until translucent, then add salt, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, tomato puree and saute for 2-3 minutes. Add sugar, water, chopped tomatoes, lemon juice and bring to boil. Add bombay rava slowly while stirring continuously to avoid lumps. Add fried nuts, sprinkle water on top, cover and cook for 2 minutes. Remove lid, switch off flames, add chopped coriander & mint leaves and green chilli, give final mix. Serve hot garnished with mint leaves and papad.

name: Crispy Veg Nuggets
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add green chillies, ginger, carrot, french beans, cauliflower, walnut, dried oregano, black pepper powder and saute for 3-4 minutes. Let cool slightly, then add potatoes, salt and crushed poha, mix properly and keep aside for 5-8 minutes. Make small bite-size portions and shape as desired. Make slurry in bowl with refined flour, salt and water, consistency should be medium thick. Dip shaped nuggets in slurry then in crushed poha, coat properly from all sides. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Serve immediately with tempered mayonnaise. For tempered mayonnaise: Add ghee, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, salt, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder in pan and saute for a minute. Take mayonnaise in bowl and add tempering, mix properly.

name: Himachali Kadhi Pakoda
ingredients: 1 tbsp tender coriander stems, finely chopped
1 small bunch spinach leaves, cleaned, washed & chopped
instructions: For curd mixture: Add curd, water, gram flour, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder in bowl and mix well, set aside. For Himachali Kadhi Pakoda: In handi, add mustard oil and once smoky hot, add fenugreek seeds, dry bedgi red chillies, cumin seeds, crushed coriander seeds, ginger, tender coriander stems and cook for a minute. Add prepared curd mixture, water, salt to taste and let simmer. Add fried palak pakoras and cook for another 2-3 minutes until cooked. Finish with ghee and mix well. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with chilli oil and coriander sprig. Serve hot with steamed rice. For palak pakoda: Add spinach, crushed coriander seeds, gram flour, curd, carom seeds, salt, asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, water as required in bowl and mix well. Heat oil in kadai, drop pakodas one by one into oil and fry until golden brown and crispy. Transfer to absorbent paper.

name: Mutton Beliram
ingredients: 1 fresh green chilli, slit in half
instructions: For marinating: In bowl add mutton, onion, ginger-garlic-green chilli paste, green chilli, bay leaf, black peppercorns, cloves, black cardamom, curd, coriander powder, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, salt and mix properly, keep aside for at least 1 hour or overnight in fridge. For gravy: In kadai heat ghee and add cumin seeds, ginger, green chilli, onion and saute until golden brown. Add marinated mutton and saute properly until mixture thickens and oil separates. Add salt, crushed coriander seeds and saute for a minute. Add water or mutton stock and cover with lid, cook until mutton is completely cooked (stir in between). Remove lid, add chopped fresh coriander leaves and stir once. Switch off flames and serve hot in serving plate, garnish with ginger julienne and coriander leaves.

name: Momo Chaat
instructions: For dough: Add whole wheat flour, refined flour, salt, water in bowl and knead semi hard dough. Add oil and knead again properly, cover and keep aside for 12-15 minutes. For filling: Add boiled & mashed sweet potato, potatoes, black pepper powder, salt, ginger-green chilli, fresh coriander leaves in bowl and mix properly. For chana dal chutney: Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds, ginger-green chilli and saute half minute. Add soaked split bengal gram and saute a minute, then add water and cook 50%. Add salt, tomato puree, cinnamon stick, mix and cook until 80%. Add sugar, vinegar, black pepper and cook on high flames for 4-5 minutes, cool down. For masala: Dry roast fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black peppercorns until lightly golden, remove and crush coarsely. For mint powder: Place mint leaves on microwave safe plate and microwave on highest setting until dried completely. Cool and crush by hand into powder. For mint curd: Add curd, mint powder, salt, sugar, black pepper powder in bowl and mix properly. For assembly: Mix chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, salt, lemon juice, coriander leaves together, set aside. Take two small dough portions and roll thin. Place small filling portion shaped as tikki in centre of first rolled dough, place second dough on top, trim edges and fold in wave pattern. Heat pan with little water, place momo, cover and cook 2-3 minutes. Remove water, add 1 tsp oil to fry momo from both sides until golden brown. Serve by adding mint curd on plate, then chana dal chutney, fried momo, repeat, finish with onion tomato mixture and prepared masala and mint powder.

name: Irani Chicken Korma
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste from green chillies, ginger, garlic, salt and coriander stems. Marinate chicken drumstick with salt and ginger-garlic paste. Dry roast walnuts for 7-8 minutes on moderate heat, then grind into smooth paste with curd. Cook marinated chicken in hot oil for 10-15 minutes on medium flame. In a handi, heat oil with cinnamon and bay leaves, sauté onions until golden brown. Add curd and cooked walnut paste, sauté on moderate heat. Season with coriander powder, turmeric and chili powder. Add water and tamarind pulp, bring to boil. Add roasted chicken and cook for 10-12 minutes on moderate heat. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with roasted walnuts, pomegranate pearls and coriander. Serve hot with roti.

name: Gujarati Khandvi
instructions: In a bowl, add gram flour, curd, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt. Mix water with ginger paste separately. Add water gradually to flour mixture and whisk until smooth with no lumps. Cook mixture in kadai on medium flame, stirring continuously until it becomes smooth and thick. Spread mixture quickly over greased thalis as thinly as possible while hot. When cool, cut into 2-inch wide strips and sprinkle grated coconut and coriander leaves, then roll tightly. For tempering: heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and sesame seeds to splutter. Add asafoetida, green chillies and salt. Pour tempering over prepared khandvi and serve hot.

name: Russian Cutlet
ingredients: 320g chicken breast cut into medium cubes
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste using mortar and pestle. Heat oil in pan, add ginger-garlic paste and sauté. Add chicken breast, carrot and french beans, sauté well. Add water and cook until chicken is tender and cooked well. Strain and shred the cooled chicken. Transfer shredded chicken to tray with processed cheese, coriander, mint, chillies, crushed peppercorns, grated potato, eggs and white sauce. Mix everything well and divide into equal portions. Roll each portion between palms and flatten into disc shape. For white sauce: melt butter, add refined flour and cook until smooth and bubbly. Gradually add chicken stock and milk, heat to boiling, stirring constantly for 1 minute. Add melted butter and cool. For coating: mix vermicelli and breadcrumbs. Coat cutlets in flour, dip into slurry, then roll in vermicelli-breadcrumb mixture. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden brown. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Kathal Korma
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and temper with onions, cook until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and coriander powder, cook well. Add jackfruit pieces and cook for 5 minutes. Add yogurt and water, mix well and bring to boil. Cover and simmer on low heat until jackfruit is tender, about 15-20 minutes. Add salt and sprinkle garam masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Vrat Fruit Custard
instructions: In a bowl, mix 80ml milk with powdered sabudana and keep aside. In a kadai, heat 1 liter milk and as soon as it's hot, add vanilla essence, saffron water and sabudana-milk mixture. Cook properly until mixture thickens. Use a hand blender to blend until smooth. Continue cooking for 2 minutes, then add sugar and cook for 5 minutes until the mixture is smooth and shiny. Strain through a strainer into a bowl, add butter and keep aside to cool down completely. Dice apple, banana and pear, halve the red grapes. In a serving bowl, add the fresh fruit pieces, then pour the prepared custard over the fruits. Garnish with pomegranate pearls, silver warq and rose petals. Serve chilled.

name: Irani Berry Chicken Pulao
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice soaked for 20 minutes
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt and ginger-garlic paste. In a pot, add water with salt, ghee and soaked basmati rice, cook on medium heat until 80% cooked. Strain rice and keep aside, saving the rice water. For chicken: heat ghee in large pan, add onion slices and green chillies, sauté on medium flame. Add ginger, salt, marinated chicken, saffron strands and rice water, mix well. Add prepared masala powder and tomato puree, cook until chicken is done completely. For masala powder: grind together dry rose petals, black peppercorns, cloves, green cardamom, coriander seeds and cumin seeds into fine powder. For layering: mix fried brown onion with dried cranberries, pistachios and mint leaves. In a pot, add ghee and layer sliced potato at bottom. Transfer cooked rice with cranberry mixture on top, add saffron strands and sugar water. Cover and let it dum on low heat for 5-10 minutes. Switch off flame and serve hot with prepared chicken, garnished with fresh mint leaves.

name: Bhuna Keema
instructions: In a bowl add mutton keema, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, curd, salt, ginger garlic paste, green chilli, whole nutmeg and mutton bones. Mix everything well. Transfer to cooker, add ghee, cover and cook until 2-3 whistles. For tempering: Heat oil and ghee in saucepot, add bay leaves, cloves, black peppercorns and black cardamom until they splutter. Add onion and sauté until light golden brown. In a bowl mix curd, ginger garlic paste, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder and asafoetida. Transfer to saucepot and sauté well. Remove mutton bones and whole nutmeg and mix well. Put keema in saucepot and mix. Add chopped coriander stems and green peas, then prepared masala and mix well. Cover and cook for 2 minutes. Finally add chopped coriander, mint and green chilli. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with roti or pav.

name: Tendli Ki Sabji
instructions: In a kadai heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, ginger, green chillies and curry leaves. Sauté for half a minute. Add peanuts and sauté for half a minute on medium heat, then add grated coconut and sauté for a minute. Add asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder and coriander powder and sauté until fragrant. Add ivy gourd (tendli) and salt, mix everything properly, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes on medium heat. Remove lid and add coriander leaves, grated coconut and lemon juice, give final mix. Serve hot in serving plate and garnish with coriander leaves and fresh grated coconut.

name: Shahi Paneer Makai
instructions: For gravy: In a shallow pan add ghee, once hot add cinnamon, bay leaf, black cardamom, ginger, garlic, onion and saute until translucent. Add tomatoes and saute, add degi red chili powder and curd. Add cashew nuts and saute well. Add water, salt and sugar, cook 4-5 minutes on moderate heat until onions are soft. Cool and grind into smooth paste. For finishing gravy: In the same pan add prepared gravy and water, cook 4-5 minutes on medium flame. Once boiling add prepared tempering and water. Add salt, paneer and sweet corn, simmer 2-3 minutes. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander, sweet corn and fresh cream. Serve hot with roti.

name: Idli 65
instructions: For fried idli: In a bowl add idlis, salt, degi red chili powder, cumin powder, rice flour and curd. Mix well to coat everything. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden and crispy. Remove and keep aside. For tempering: In a kadai heat oil, add mustard seeds, fennel seeds, ginger, garlic, curry leaves, dry red chillies and saute for a minute. Add curd and saute until it leaves oil from the sides. Add coriander powder, degi red chili powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder and salt, saute until fragrant. Toss in fried idlis and coat well, finish with black pepper powder. Serve garnished with coriander leaves.

name: Chili Chicken
ingredients: chicken breast, 450 gms cut into strips
instructions: For first marination: Cut chicken into strips, add sesame oil, salt, black peppercorns, white pepper powder, red chili sauce, ginger garlic paste and egg. Mix well and rest 10 minutes. For second marination: Add cornstarch, refined flour, baking soda, egg, salt and oil. Mix well. For frying: Heat oil in kadai on medium flame, fry marinated chicken on slow to medium flame until golden and cooked through. For sauce: Mix dark soy sauce, tomato ketchup, red chili sauce, green chili sauce, vinegar, water, sugar and black pepper powder. For tempering: In wok add oil, add dry red chillies and let splutter. Add ginger, garlic, green chili, red chili and saute. Add onion and saute well. Add sauce mixture and salt, mix well. Add cornstarch slurry, red and green bell peppers. Add fried chicken strips and toss well. Add spring onion and toss. Serve garnished with coriander.

name: Mango Curry
ingredients: fresh green chilli, 1 slit into half
instructions: For curd mixture: In a bowl add curd, asafoetida, gram flour, tamarind paste and coconut milk. Mix well to avoid lumps. Peel mangoes and set aside. Squeeze mango skins and collect juice in another bowl. In a large sauce pot heat ghee, add mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and let splutter. Add green chilli and ginger, saute well. Add curd mixture and cook 2-3 minutes. Add peeled mangoes, salt and jaggery, cover with lid and cook 4-5 minutes. For tempering: In a tadka pan heat ghee, add curry leaves and red button chilli and splutter well. Add degi red chilli powder and mix. Pour tadka over curry and serve hot with steamed rice.

name: cheesy nachos with salsa
instructions: For nachos dough: Mix maize flour, refined flour, whole wheat flour, salt, ginger-garlic water, vinegar and water to form semi-soft dough. Rest for 10-15 minutes. Roll thin, half-cook on hot pan from both sides, cut into strips then triangles. Deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Remove on absorbent paper, season with nacho spice. For salsa: Mix chopped tomatoes, onion, tomato ketchup, green chillies, coriander leaves, salt, lemon juice, corn kernels and pickled chillies. For cheese sauce: Heat butter with turmeric, add milk and cheese, mix until melted. Add corn-starch slurry, cook until semi-thick, add chilli oil. Assemble nachos with salsa, cheese, mayonnaise, spice and sauce. Serve immediately.

name: junglee sandwich
instructions: For salsa: Mix chopped green chillies, onion, tomato, capsicum, salt, lemon juice and degi red chilli powder. For masala mayonnaise: Mix mayonnaise with garam masala, chaat masala and degi red chilli powder. For masala: Mix chaat masala, degi red chilli powder, cumin powder and asafoetida. Assemble sandwich: Apply butter on bread slice, add green chutney, salsa, sev, paneer, sweetcorn, prepared masala, grated beetroot, crushed potato chips and cheese. Add second bread slice with butter and masala mayonnaise, add mustard and schezwan sauce on other side. Grill both sides until golden with grill marks. Garnish with mayonnaise, ketchup, chips and cheese. Serve hot with ketchup and green chutney.

name: methi paneer bhurji
instructions: Heat ghee in deep handi, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add ginger and onion, saute on medium flame until translucent. Add tomato and saute well. Add curd mixture (prepared separately with curd, fenugreek leaves, turmeric, chilli powder, asafoetida and coriander powder) and saute for 4-5 minutes. Add water and keep sauteing. Add crumbled paneer and mix well. Add chopped tomato and green chilli, mix and cook for 2 minutes. Add butter and coriander leaves, mix well. Garnish with coriander leaves and green chilli. Serve hot with paratha.

name: lehsuni paneer
instructions: For gravy: Heat ghee and oil, add cinnamon, bay leaf, cumin seeds, splutter well. Add ginger and garlic, saute. Add onion, saute until translucent, add tomato. Add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder, saute well. Add beaten curd and cook on moderate heat, add salt. Add cashew nuts and saute well. Add water and crushed garlic, cook. Cool to room temperature and grind to smooth paste. For paneer marination: Mix paneer with salt, dry fenugreek leaves, chilli powder, oil and marinate. Fry marinated paneer in oil until crisp. For finishing: Add fried paneer oil to gravy bowl, mix well. Add prepared gravy to sauce pot and cook. Add water and cook 7-8 minutes, add salt and mint. Place fried paneer into gravy, garnish with tossed garlic and mint sprig. For tossed garlic: Fry sliced garlic in oil until golden brown.

name: mumbai bhel puri
ingredients: byadgi dry red chillies 15-20 soaked deseeded
instructions: For tamarind chutney: Boil strained tamarind pulp, water, dry red chilli, jaggery, dates, salt and asafoetida for 15-20 minutes on medium heat. Grind using hand blender and keep aside. For garlic chilli chutney: Grind soaked byadgi dry red chillies and garlic into fine paste. For dry green chutney: Grind coriander leaves, green chillies, salt, mint leaves and roasted brown chana into fine powder. For bhel mixture: Mix puffed rice, peanuts, fried masala dal and chana jor garam. For sukhi bhel: Mix bhel mixture with coriander, onion, tomato, potato, green chilli, chilli powder, mango powder, lemon juice and dry green chutney. Put in paper cone, garnish with sev and puri. For geli bhel: Add garlic chilli chutney and tamarind chutney also to sukhi bhel mixture. Garnish with sev and puri.

name: pav bhaji bunny chow
instructions: For boiling vegetables: Add cauliflower, carrots, peas, potatoes, capsicum, salt, butter and water in pressure cooker. Cover and cook for 4-5 whistles until done. Mash with masher and keep aside. For pav bhaji: Heat oil, add onion and saute for 3-4 minutes until translucent. Add green chillies and coriander stems, saute for a minute. Add tomatoes and capsicum, cook for a while. Add ginger-garlic paste, kashmirilal chilli powder, pav bhaji masala, salt, water and mix well. Add boiled mashed vegetables and simmer until cooked well. Finish with butter. For bunny chow: Scoop out bread from burger bun or bread loaf to make hollow cavity. Add prepared pav bhaji, grated cheese and toast in pan with butter for 2-3 minutes on medium flame. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with onions and coriander sprig. Serve hot with lemon wedges.

name: papad ki sabzi
instructions: Roast or fry papads on flame or microwave for 2 minutes. Take curd in bowl and add 1/2 cup water, whisk. Heat oil in pan, splutter cumin seeds. Add asafoetida, turmeric, coriander powder and fenugreek leaves. Add tomato-ginger-chilly paste and red chilly powder. Let masala simmer until oil leaves sides. Add 1 cup water, cover and simmer. Gradually add curd while stirring gently to avoid coagulation. Add salt, green coriander and papad chunks. Cover and simmer 2 minutes on low flame. Serve hot.

name: Fruit Cake
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add butter, sugar, and tutti frutti, mix well until butter changes color. Add vanilla essence and flour, mix well, then add eggs and mix. Add almonds, walnuts, and tutti frutti, fold everything together using cut and fold method. Grease a mould with butter and place butter paper. Pour batter into the mould and bake at 165-170°C for 40 minutes. Dust icing sugar over the cake, let cool a bit, cut and serve.

name: Sama Chawal Dhokla
instructions: Mix sama chawal flour with milk and yogurt. Add chopped ginger, green chillies, salt, and sugar. Let batter rest for 30 minutes. Add baking soda to the batter and mix gently. Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add curry leaves and green chillies, then pour the batter. Cover and steam on medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. The dhokla should be soft and spongy. Cut into pieces and serve warm, optionally with green chutney.

name: puliyogare
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add gota urad, chana dal, coriander seeds, sesame seeds, fenugreek seeds, black peppercorns, and dry red chillies; sauté until fragrant and grind into powder. In another pan, heat oil and add mustard seeds, gota urad, chana dal, dry red chillies, and curry leaves; sauté for a minute. Add chilli powder, turmeric powder, water, and tamarind pulp; bring to a boil. Add jaggery and the prepared powder masala and cook until ketchup consistency. Mix the tamarind sauce into cooked room temperature rice and serve.

name: tomato pasta soup
instructions: Heat oil in a sauce pot and sauté garlic, onion, celery, carrot, and coriander stems for 4-5 minutes. Add cabbage, french beans, and tomato puree; cook for 4-5 minutes. Add macaroni pasta, tomato ketchup, and water; cook for 10-15 minutes until pasta is cooked. Prepare a mixture of chopped tomatoes, basil, and olive oil and add to the soup. Season with black pepper powder. Serve hot garnished with cheese, red chilli flakes, oregano, and fresh basil.

name: dhaniya chicken
instructions: Make a coarse paste with garlic, ginger, and roasted peanuts. Grind fresh coriander leaves, roasted peanuts, salt, oil, and green chillies into a smooth green paste. Marinate chicken with the prepared paste, green paste, and curd. In a shallow pot, heat oil and add marinated chicken; cook for 10-15 minutes. Add water, cover, and cook until chicken is tender. Add more oil and cook for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot garnished with coriander sprig and chilli oil.

name: halwai style aloo sabji
instructions: Crush green chillies and ginger with salt. Heat mustard oil in a cooker and add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, and asafoetida; let them splutter. Add crushed chilli and ginger and sauté. Add turmeric, chilli powder, and coriander powder; sauté for a minute. Add tomato and potatoes; stir well. Add water, salt, and sugar. Cover and cook for 2 whistles until potatoes are tender. Remove lid, mash some potatoes, boil for a minute, and finish with ghee. Serve hot.

name: bhindi dahi masala
instructions: Marinate ladyfinger with green chilli, chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, mustard oil, oil, and salt. Sauté in a pan and add tomato. Prepare a curd mixture with spices and gram flour. Make a ginger-green chilli paste. Heat oil and mustard oil in a deep pan; add cumin, fennel, and coriander seeds and let them splutter. Add ginger paste and sauté. Add curd mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add fenugreek leaves and water; mix well. Add sugar and sautéed ladyfinger. For tadka, fry cashew, raisins, and button chilli in oil and ghee until golden; add crushed coriander seeds. Pour tadka on top and serve garnished with coriander.

name: Dahi Paneer Subzi
instructions: 1. Mix all marination ingredients and add paneer. 2. Sear paneer lightly and keep aside. 3. In the same oil, add ginger, sweat, add spices and sauté for a minute. 4. Add yoghurt mixed with spice powders and cashew paste, simmer for 15 minutes. 5. Add paneer to the gravy and garnish with mint, mint powder and beaten yoghurt. Serve hot.

name: Dhaba Style Anda Masala
ingredients: ½ tsp ghee for egg cake
instructions: 1. Grind ginger, garlic, green chillies into paste. 2. Heat ghee and oil, add ginger-garlic paste and cumin seeds. 3. Add onions, sauté until translucent. 4. Add coriander, red chilli, turmeric powders and sauté. 5. Add tomatoes, sugar, salt and cook covered. 6. Add water and cook 5 minutes. 7. Add fenugreek leaves and coriander. 8. Whisk eggs with salt, turmeric, chilli powder and ghee. 9. Steam egg mixture 10 minutes, demould and cut. 10. Place egg cake on gravy and serve hot.

name: Schezwan Aloo Chaat
instructions: 1. Boil red chillies with garlic until soft. 2. Grind into smooth paste. 3. Heat oil, add ginger, garlic, sauté well. 4. Add coriander stems and red chilli paste, green chilli. 5. Add oil, tomato ketchup, sugar, salt and vinegar, cook on medium flame. 6. Cut potatoes into batons. 7. Mix potatoes with salt, refined flour and cornstarch. 8. Deep fry potatoes until crisp and golden. 9. Toss fried potatoes with ginger, coriander stem and schezwan chutney. 10. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Penne Aglio e Olio
instructions: 1. Heat olive oil and add garlic, sliced olives, sauté for a few seconds. 2. Add red bell pepper, corn kernels, red chilli flakes, sauté for half a minute. 3. Add pasta water and boil for a few seconds. 4. Add boiled rigatoni and sauté until properly mixed. 5. Add extra virgin olive oil and black pepper powder, stir. 6. Switch off flame and finish with lemon juice and basil leaves. 7. Mix everything together. 8. Serve immediately and garnish with parmesan cheese, black pepper powder, basil sprig and extra virgin olive oil.

name: Crispy Paneer Balls
ingredients: ½ tsp degi red chilli powder
instructions: 1. Heat oil, add cumin and fennel seeds to crackle. 2. Add ginger, green chillies, onion, sauté until translucent. 3. Add dried coconut, sauté for a minute. 4. Add spices and sauté until fragrant. 5. Add salt, coriander and mint leaves. 6. Cool down and mix in paneer and bread crumbs. 7. Form small balls from mixture. 8. Coat balls with refined flour, then slurry, then sev. 9. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden and crispy. 10. Heat oil, add curry leaves and dry red chilli, add to tomato ketchup. 11. Serve fried paneer balls on bed of fried noodles with tempered ketchup.

name: Saag Meat
ingredients: ½ tsp degi red chilli powder
instructions: 1. Marinate mutton with onions, fenugreek leaves, curd, spices and ginger-garlic paste. 2. Heat oil in pressure cooker, add bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cumin seeds to splutter. 3. Add marinated mutton, sauté 6-7 minutes. 4. Add salt and fenugreek leaves. 5. Add water, close lid and cook 5-6 whistles until tender. 6. In kadai, heat oil and ghee, add ginger, garlic, onion, green chillies, sauté a minute. 7. Add dry red chillies, sauté well. 8. Add spinach, amaranth, salt, water and sauté well. 9. Add butter, close lid, cook 3-4 minutes. 10. Add cooked mutton and simmer. 11. Finish with unsalted butter and mustard oil. 12. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with roti.

name: Chicken Bhujing
ingredients: ⅓ cup dry coconut roughly chopped
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken and potatoes with oil, spices, ginger-garlic paste and lemon juice for 15-20 minutes. 2. Grind green chillies, ginger, garlic, coriander leaves, coconut and spices into smooth paste. 3. Dry roast black cardamom, green cardamom, cumin seeds, cloves, coriander seeds, peppercorns, mustard seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon and red chillies, grind to fine powder. 4. Dry roast poha for 5-6 minutes until crispy. 5. Skewer and roast marinated chicken and potatoes on medium flame until 60-70% cooked. 6. Heat oil, add onions, sauté a minute. 7. Add chicken bones, sauté until golden. 8. Add prepared paste, sauté well, add water and simmer. 9. Add coriander leaves and turn off flame. 10. In another handi, heat oil, add onions, sauté until golden. 11. Add roasted chicken and potato with prepared paste, cook 5-6 minutes. 12. Add water and cook well. 13. Add burnt coal with ghee for dhungar, cover lid. 14. Add coriander leaves, masala powder and roasted poha, mix well. 15. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander sprig and serve with onion and lemon salad.

name: masala chicken quesadilla
instructions: Marinate chicken breast with curd, turmeric, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for at least 30 minutes. Add marinated onions and bell peppers to the marinade. Make tomato salsa by mixing tomato puree, ketchup, ginger, garlic, green chilli, lime juice, salt, sugar, fresh tomato, onion and coriander leaves. Heat oil on a grill pan, place marinated chicken and vegetables, cook both sides and cover with lid for 10 minutes on medium flame. Prepare filling by mixing grilled chicken and vegetables with coriander leaves, butter, mozzarella cheese, crushed black peppercorns and garam masala. For tortilla dough, knead refined flour, whole wheat flour, salt, sugar and water into semi-soft dough, apply oil and let rest. Roll thin dough portions and cook half-done on hot pan. Heat oil on flat pan, place half-cooked tortilla and cook until light brown. Add filling, mozzarella cheese and prepared salsa on half of tortilla, fold and press lightly. Add butter and cook until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Cover with lid to melt cheese, remove and cut in half. Serve with fresh salsa and coriander sprig.

name: tandoori cheela
instructions: Roast cumin seeds, coriander seeds, black cardamom, cloves, black pepper, mustard seeds, and kasuri methi in a pan. Cool and grind to fine powder with salt. Add degi red chilli powder, dried mango powder, asafoetida, and chaat masala to ground spice powder and mix. Prepare tandoori marination by mixing prepared tandoori masala, curd, ginger-garlic paste, and mustard oil. Burn coal on flame, place in small bowl with cloves and ghee, place in marination bowl and cover for 5-6 minutes. Chop all vegetables and mix with prepared marination, keep aside for 10 minutes. Heat pan and saute marinated vegetables for 4-5 minutes, char them lightly. Make cheela batter by mixing besan, prepared marination, water, baking soda, and oil. Heat flat pan on medium heat, add batter and spread evenly, add ghee and cook until golden brown. Add filling and grated cheese on one side and fold. Serve with green chutney and veggies salad.

name: crispy besan french fries
instructions: Mix gram flour, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, water, and oil to make thick runny batter. Keep aside for at least 30 minutes. Pour batter into medium sized pan and place on low heat. Cook from both sides until light golden. Remove and cool down completely. Once cooled, cut into strips like french fries. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Remove and set aside. For tempered ketchup, heat oil and add mustard seeds, ginger, curry leaves, and green chillies, saute for a minute. Switch off flames, add little water and mix, then add tomato ketchup and bring together. Serve fries with tempered ketchup garnished with tomato wedges and coriander leaves.

name: street style veg fried rice
instructions: Soak sella basmati rice for 20 minutes. Boil water with salt and oil, add soaked rice and cook on medium heat until 70% done. Strain rice and keep aside. Heat oil in wok, add garlic, ginger, green chillies and saute well. Add carrot, salt, sugar, dark soy sauce and cook for 2-4 minutes. Stir fry on high flame without overcooking vegetables. Add cooked rice and saute well. Add ginger and green chilli, toss well. Add cabbage if using. Stir-fry until sauce combines well. Add french beans, capsicum, vinegar, green chilli sauce, white pepper powder and mix well. Add spring onion and coriander leaves and toss everything well. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

name: kathal rara
instructions: Apply mustard oil on hands, knife and chopping board. Cut jackfruit into halves, remove inner white core. Separate pods from skin and cut into cubes. Marinate jackfruit cubes in mustard oil, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, and salt for 20-25 minutes. In pressure cooker, add water, salt, bay leaf, cloves, marinated jackfruit and cook for 2-3 whistles until tender. In a handi, heat mustard oil and oil, add dry red chillies, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black peppercorns, bay leaf and let splutter. Add onions and cloves, saute for 3-4 minutes till translucent. Add turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add coriander stems, green chilli, add curd and cook well. Add tomato puree and water, mix well. Add cooked jackfruit, salt, sugar, water and simmer until cooked well. In a kadai, heat oil and fry cooked jackfruit until golden brown. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti.

name: Chole Murgh
instructions: For ginger garlic paste: Grind ginger, garlic, green chillies and salt into smooth paste. For cooking chickpeas: In pressure cooker add bay leaf, cloves, ghee, chicken bones and saute. Add chickpeas, salt, water and pressure cook for 4-5 whistles. For masala: Dry roast bay leaf, cinnamon, black peppercorns, black cardamom, green cardamom, coriander seeds, mace and salt, then grind to powder. For chole murgh: Heat ghee or oil, add green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf and onions, saute till golden. Add marinated chicken with spice powders and cook well. Add tomato puree, yogurt, cooked chickpeas and stock. Add coriander stems, ginger, coriander leaves and slow cook on medium for 15-20 mins till chicken is tender. Garnish with coriander, ginger and green chillies. Serve hot with roti.

name: Banarasi Kaddu Ki Sabzi
instructions: In a kadai heat mustard oil and add bay leaves, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, onion seeds, ginger, green chillies, dry red chilli and saute for a few seconds. Add pumpkin and saute for a minute then add turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and mix well. Cover and cook for 10 minutes. Remove lid and stir once, adjust salt, add jaggery and water, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add dried mango powder and cook for another minute. Finish with coriander leaves, stir once and serve hot with puri.

name: Keema Masala
instructions: For marination: In a bowl add mutton mince, dried fenugreek leaves, yogurt, mint leaves, nutmeg, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, ginger garlic paste and mix well. For ginger garlic paste: Grind ginger, garlic, green chillies into rough paste. For sauteing kheema: In handi add ghee, add bay leaf, black cardamom and splutter. Add marinated kheema and saute for 5 minutes. Cover and cook for 20-25 minutes. Remove bay leaf. For masala: Dry roast black cardamom and black peppercorns on low flame till aromatic, grind to powder. For kheema masala: Heat ghee, add onions, saute till light brown. Add ginger garlic paste and saute. Add spice powders and saute well. Add tomato and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add tender coriander stem, saute well. Add sauteed kheema and water, cook for 10-15 minutes. Add coriander leaves, mint leaves, cook for 5 more minutes. Add green chillies and butter. Add prepared masala. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander, ginger, sliced egg. Serve hot with pav.

name: paya soup
instructions: Clean paya: In sauce pot, add water, vinegar and salt. Bring to boil. Add lamb trotters and boil for 2 minutes. Remove and keep aside. Make soup: In pressure cooker, heat ghee and oil. Add bay leaf and black peppercorns and splutter. Add green and black cardamom, cloves. Add onion, garlic, ginger, green chilli and coriander stems. Sauté well until onions turn pinkish. Add lamb trotters and sauté until light brown. Add curd mixture (curd + coriander powder + turmeric + red chilli powder mixed well). Add salt, turmeric powder and water. Cover and take 4-5 whistles on medium flame. Once cooked, turn off flame. Strain soup into a large bowl. Pour prepared tadka (ghee heated with cloves and asafoetida) over strained soup and stir. Pour soup back into handi and cook 5 minutes till it boils. Transfer to soup bowl with lamb trotters. Garnish with coriander stem, fried onion, julienned ginger, green chilli, lemon wedge and mint leaves. Serve hot.

name: handi mutton
instructions: Fry onions: Cut onion into thin slices of same thickness. Heat oil in kadai and deep fry onion slices until crisp and golden. Transfer to absorbent paper. Marinate: In a large bowl, add green chillies, mint leaves, ginger garlic paste, curd, coriander powder, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, coriander leaves and fried onions. Mix well. Add fried onion oil and mix again. Add mutton and marinate well. Add ghee, fried onion oil and whole garlic. Prepare handi: Season handi with ghee on hot coal. Add dry red chilli, bay leaf and cinnamon stick. Add marinated mutton and cover with lid. Attach wheat dough across pot rim to seal properly. Place sealed pot on hot coal. Cook until meat is tender, making small hole to dum properly. Once done, open lid and stir gently. Remove whole garlic. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: lalla mussa dal
instructions: Boil dal: In pressure cooker, add chana dal, masoor dal, urad dal, water, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder and salt. Cover with lid and cook 2-3 whistles until cooked well. Prepare masala: In a pan, add cumin seeds, black peppercorns, salt and ghee. Roast well. Transfer to grinder and grind into fine paste. Temper: In handi or deep kadai, add oil and ghee. Once hot, add onion and sauté 2-4 minutes until golden. Add garlic cloves and sauté well. Add curd and cook. Add cooked dal and mix everything well. Add salt to taste. Mash the dal and let it cook on medium flame for 5-10 minutes until thick. Add prepared masala and mix well. Add coriander leaves. Finish with melted ghee and give it a boil. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot with naan.

name: chocolate stuffed coconut ladoo
instructions: Make ladoo base: In non-stick pan, add desiccated coconut and poha powder. Dry roast for 1 minute. Add ghee and cook for 1 minute on medium flame. Add milk powder and mix well. Add Nestlé milkmaid and cook 5-6 minutes on low heat until mixture leaves sides of pan. Finish with ghee and remove from heat. Divide mixture into two bowls. Add cocoa powder to one bowl and mix well. Divide the other bowl into four parts. Make filling: In bowl, add mixed dried fruits, caramel syrup and mix. Shape: Make lemon-sized balls, stuff with desired filling and coat well. Coat truffles: Dip in chocolate sprinklers or coat with cocoa powder. Drizzle tempered chocolate or coat with desiccated coconut. Garnish with desired coating and serve chilled.

name: Shakkar Pare and Namak Pare
instructions: For Namak Pare: Mix refined flour, whole wheat flour, salt, ajwain, and ghee until breadcrumb consistency. Add semolina, sugar, baking soda, curd, and water; knead semi-hard dough. Rest 20-30 minutes. Roll and cut into desired shapes. Deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crispy. For Shakkar Pare: Mix refined flour, semolina, whole wheat flour, ghee, and milk until breadcrumb consistency. Add sugar and milk; knead semi-hard dough with semolina. Rest 20-30 minutes. Roll, cut, and deep fry. Coat in jaggery syrup (made by cooking jaggery with water until soft-ball consistency; add sesame seeds). Cool and set.

name: Champaran Style Egg Curry
instructions: Prepare masala by grinding green cardamom, cloves, black peppercorns, cumin seeds, mace, and coriander seeds into fine powder. For marination: mix grated onions, ginger, green chilies, garlic, oil, salt, curd, degi chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Add fenugreek seeds, black cardamom, cloves, bay leaf, diced potatoes, and hard-boiled eggs; marinate well. In a handi, heat mustard oil until smoky. Add marinated eggs and seal with dough; cover with lid. Cook on low-medium heat for 20-25 minutes. Open, sprinkle masala powder and coriander stems; cook 1 more minute. Serve hot with pulao.

name: Kolhapur Style Misal
instructions: Prepare vatan: In a shallow pan heat oil and sauté coriander seeds, cumin seeds, dry coconut. Add green cardamom, star anise, cloves, stone flower, bay leaf, cinnamon, dry red chilies, garlic, and sauté 6-7 minutes. Transfer to bowl; add degi chilli powder, asafoetida, roasted coconut, roasted onions, poppy seeds, and oil. Grind to smooth paste. Boil moong and moth sprouts with water; add salt when 50% cooked. Cook 7-8 minutes; drain and reserve water. Prepare aloo bhaji: heat oil, add ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves; sauté. Add turmeric and boiled potatoes; cook with water. For tari: heat oil, add green chillies and prepared vatan paste; sauté 2-3 minutes. Add asafoetida, turmeric, degi chilli powder. Add boiled sprout water and cook 30-35 minutes on moderate heat. Add jaggery and boil. Assemble: layer aloo bhaji, boiled sprouts, farsan in a bowl. Pour tari on top; garnish with onion, coriander, lemon wedge. Serve with ladi pav and curd.

name: Paneer Shawarma Roll
instructions: For paneer: Apply salt and degi chilli powder to paneer slices. Mix mayonnaise, hung curd, salt, ginger-garlic paste, tomato ketchup, coriander leaves, and oregano. Apply to paneer; marinate 15-20 minutes. For pickled veggies: In a pan add bay leaf, garlic, salt, sugar, water, vinegar; boil 2-3 minutes. Cool and add carrots, beetroot, cucumber, green chillies. Marinate 5-6 hours. For roti: Mix refined flour, salt, powdered sugar, baking soda, baking powder, water, curd; knead semi-soft dough with oil. Rest 10-15 minutes. Roll thin portions and cook on hot flat pan on both sides. For spread: Mix mayonnaise, salt, and garlic paste. To assemble: Heat grill pan with oil and cook marinated paneer on both sides; cut into thin strips. Heat roti on grill pan; apply spread, add paneer strips, french fries, pickled veggies, sliced onions, tomatoes, coriander leaves. Roll tightly and wrap in butter paper. Serve warm.

name: Vegetables in Hot Garlic Sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and add garlic; sauté until light golden brown. Add dry red chillies. Add cauliflower, carrot, and mushroom; sauté for 1 minute. Add soya sauce and red chilli sauce; toss with vegetables for 1 minute. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Add red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, onion, and french beans. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Add corn-starch slurry and adjust consistency. Switch off flame and serve hot in a bowl. Garnish with sesame oil and spring onion.

name: pav bhaji waffle
instructions: Boil and mash vegetables with butter and spices. In a shallow pan, heat butter and oil, saute onions until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste, green chillies and tomatoes, saute well.
