Add pav bhaji masala and chilli powder, then add mashed vegetables and mix. Put bhaji between two bread slices, add cheese and butter on top. Place in waffle maker and toast until crisp and golden. Cut in half and serve hot with mayonnaise, onion rings, tomato and lemon.

name: moong dal pakora
ingredients: 2 cups green moong dal with skin soaked 6-7 hours
instructions: Grind soaked green moong dal coarsely to make dal paste. In a parat, mix dal paste with chopped ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves, roasted peanuts and salt. Make small lemon-sized balls and drop into hot oil. Fry on medium flame until golden brown. Transfer to paper towel. Sprinkle chaat masala and red chilli powder and toss well. Serve with peanut chutney and pakode wali kadhi.

name: samosa pinwheel
instructions: Dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, peppercorns and black cardamom seeds. Cool and grind coarsely. Heat oil, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add ginger and green chilli, saute well. Add mashed potatoes and salt, mix well. Add prepared masala and mix. Add sugar, mango powder and coriander leaves. Prepare dough with flour, carom seeds, salt, ghee and water. Knead semi-soft dough and rest for 10 minutes. Roll dough into rectangle shape, spread potato filling evenly, press gently and roll tightly. Seal edges with water. Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Cut into half-inch slices and flatten slightly. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown, stirring occasionally. Remove on absorbent paper. Serve with green chutney and tamarind chutney.

name: cheese chili toast
instructions: Prepare the sauce by sautéing garlic, ginger, and onion, then adding spices, ketchup, water and vinegar. Char with coal and butter. Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, mayonnaise, green chili and lemon juice. Sear the chicken and shred. Prepare cheese mixture with coriander, green chilies, garlic, capsicum and cheeses. Toast bread, spread cheese mixture, add chicken mixture and cheese again, then pan-fry. Garnish with spring onion and serve with mayonnaise dip.

name: vrat kheer and singhada puri
instructions: Toast barnyard millet in ghee until fragrant, add chopped sweet potato and sauté. Add milk and cook until thickened, then add more milk and bring to boil. Add sugar and cook 2-3 minutes, finish with cardamom and fried nuts. For puri: mix mashed potato, water chestnut flour, and sendha namak into soft dough, apply ghee to small portions, flatten and deep fry until golden. Serve kheer hot with puri.

name: Chicken Sukka
instructions: Dry roast whole spices until aroma releases, cool. Dry roast red chillies for 4-5 minutes, cool. Heat ghee, cook onions and garlic for 4-5 minutes. Roast fresh coconut until light golden, cool and divide in two equal parts. Blend roasted spices, roasted chillies, cooked onion and garlic, half roasted coconut, tamarind pulp and turmeric into fine paste. Grind remaining coconut coarsely. Heat ghee and oil in kadhai, cook onions and garlic until light golden. Add chicken and salt, cook 4-5 minutes. Add masala paste and curry leaves, cook 4-5 minutes. Cover and cook 10-12 minutes until chicken is cooked. Add coarsely ground coconut and cook 4-5 minutes. Serve hot with neer dosa or roti.

name: toffee elaichi modak
instructions: For nougat: cook sugar with water until caramelized, add baking soda, cook 1 minute, transfer to silicon mat to set, then crush. For toffee modak: pressure cook milkmaid tin for 3-4 whistles. In pan, melt butter with biscuit crumbs for 1 minute, add more butter and mix. Add prepared toffee milkmaid and cook 5-6 minutes, add cardamom powder and roasted crumbs. For stuffing: sauté almonds and pistachios in ghee, add half the nougat. For chocolate and dryfruit versions: mix milkmaid with biscuit crumbs and respective ingredients. Shape modaks by rolling toffee mixture into balls, stuff with dried fruit mixture, shape, or use mold with ghee. Garnish with melted white chocolate, silver varq, dry fruits, nougat and rose petals.

name: mushroom matar masala
instructions: For stock: sauté mushroom stems in butter, add peppercorns, coriander seeds, cardamom, water and boil 5-10 minutes. Add curd and boil. For masala: in deep pan, sauté garlic, ginger, green chili in butter. Add onion and sauté 1 minute. Add raisins, turmeric, degi chili, coriander powder and sauté 2-3 minutes. Add butter and sauté 2 minutes. Add tomato puree and butter, cook on medium heat until paste thickens. Add mushroom quarters and sauté well, cover and cook 2 minutes. Strain mushroom stock and add to pan. Add green peas and cook on low heat, add butter and mix. Add mint, spring onion and coriander leaves. Grind green cardamom, peppercorns and fenugreek leaves to powder. Garnish with coriander sprig and prepared masala powder. Serve hot with roti.

name: strawberry boondi laddoo
instructions: For batter: in bowl, add gram flour, water, salt and mix. Add rose pink color to make smooth lump-free batter. Let sit 10 minutes. Heat ghee in kadai to medium hot. Using perforated spoon, drop small rounds of batter into ghee, deep-fry until cooked. Remove and transfer to sugar syrup. For sugar syrup: add sugar and water to large sauce pot, melt completely. Add strawberry crush and mix well. Cook until 1-string consistency. Add prepared boondi to syrup, mix gently with spatula until syrup is absorbed. Remove soaked boondi to thali while still warm. Mix well and shape into round balls. If mixture doesn't hold, add 1-2 tablespoons more ghee for binding. Garnish with blanched chopped pistachios and silver varq, then serve.

name: Chicken Rezala
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, ginger-garlic paste, yogurt, and white pepper for 15-20 minutes. Blend white onions with salt and oil into smooth paste. Blend soaked poppy seeds and cashew nuts into smooth paste. Heat oil and ghee in handi, add cloves, bay leaf, cinnamon, and dry red chillies to splutter. Add butter and onion paste, saute for a minute. Add yogurt and marinated chicken, mix well and cover. Cook until chicken is tender. Add saffron strands, kewra water, and cashew-poppy paste. Simmer and finish with ground masala (roasted black peppercorns, cardamom, mace, coriander seeds, and salt ground to powder). Garnish with masala and coriander sprig. Serve hot.

name: Cheela Nachos
instructions: Make smooth batter with gram flour, turmeric, asafoetida, degi red chilli, carom seeds, salt, sugar, ginger-garlic paste, yogurt, water, and semolina. Add oil and rest 4-5 minutes. Heat non-stick pan, pour batter, spread evenly, cook on low from both sides. Cut into triangular shapes. Deep fry in medium-hot oil until crispy golden. Make fresh salsa by combining tomato, green chillies, onion, coriander stem, garlic, lemon juice, salt, crushed roasted cumin, tomato ketchup, coriander leaves, and corn kernels. Dry roast cumin seeds, crush coarsely. Assemble nachos on plate with salsa, green chutney, mayonnaise, crushed roasted cumin, degi red chilli powder, and grated cheese. Serve immediately.

name: Suran Vada
ingredients: 2 cups semolina soaked in 1 cup yogurt
instructions: Boil yam with water, vinegar, chana dal, ginger, and salt until soft. Strain and mash with wooden spoon. Mix in green chillies and coriander leaves. Add soaked semolina, lemon juice, and castor sugar. Mix well. Prepare tadka by heating oil, adding cumin seeds to splutter, then asafoetida and curry leaves. Transfer tadka to yam mixture and mix well. Apply water on hands, take some batter, shape into round with thumb, make hole in center. Heat oil to medium flame. Slide vada into hot oil and fry until slightly golden on both sides. Remove on kitchen tissue. Fry again until evenly crisp and golden. Fry third time in super-hot oil for extra crispness. Drain on tissue. Garnish with green chutney, hung yogurt, coriander sprig, degi red chilli powder, and lemon wedge. Serve hot.

name: Hara Mutton Keema
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste from garlic, ginger, green chillies and salt. Marinate kheema with salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, curd and prepared ginger-garlic paste for 5-10 minutes. Grind green chillies, ginger, mint, coriander leaves with water and oil to make green paste. Heat oil in handi, add bay leaf and cumin seeds, let splutter. Add marinated kheema and sauté on medium flame for 10-15 minutes. In another handi, heat oil, add onions and sauté until translucent. Add green paste and sauté, add green peas and cooked kheema, cook for 10-15 minutes. Add coriander leaves, green chillies, dill leaves and sauté. Finish with butter and cook until oil comes out. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with coriander sprig, sliced onions, tomato, lemon wedge and green chilli. Serve hot with pav.

name: Vrat Aloo Tikki
instructions: In bowl mix mashed potatoes with vrat ka atta and sendha namak and knead into smooth dough. In another bowl mix chopped cashew nuts, peanuts, grated coconut, sendha namak, sugar and chopped green chillies. Take portion of dough and spread in hands, add heaped spoonful of filling in centre and close up. Shape into tikki and roll in desiccated coconut. Repeat with remaining dough. Heat ghee in pan and place prepared pattice, fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides on medium heat. Remove and serve with curd or vrat chutney.

name: Pizza Cheese Bomb
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add chopped ginger and garlic, add red and green bell peppers and sauté until fragrant. Add grated potato and mix well, cook for 1 minute. Remove to bowl and add cheese, mayonnaise and dried oregano, mix everything. Refrigerate to cool. Take portion of mixture and make well in centre, place small cheese cube and tomato ketchup, close into spear shape. Repeat with remaining mixture. Take bread slice without edges and dip in water lightly. Spread it and use to cover prepared stuffing spears. Deep fry bombs in medium-hot oil until golden brown from all sides. Brown butter in pan and add dried oregano, red chilli flakes and coriander leaves. Switch off flame and add fried pizza bombs and coat them properly. Serve with mayonnaise and tomato ketchup.

name: White Sauce Cheese Pasta
instructions: For white sauce: In sauce pot add butter, once melted add refined flour and stir until creamy and lump free, cook for 1 minute. Slowly and gradually add milk, whisk continuously until smooth and creamy. Cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Transfer to bowl and add butter for coating to avoid layering. For pasta: In pot add water, bring to boil, add oil, salt, penne pasta, carrots and mushrooms, cook for 8-10 minutes at al dente stage. Strain excess water and coat pasta with oil to avoid sticking. For white sauce paste: Heat oil in pan, add garlic and salt, add corn kernels and toss for 1 minute. Add boiled pasta and vegetables, pasta water and sauté. Add white sauce and processed cheese and cook until cheese melts. Add green chillies, coriander leaves and olive oil and mix well. For garlic bread: Heat oil, add crushed garlic and cook until golden brown, add bread slices and toast until golden. Transfer pasta to serving dish, garnish with basil leaves and serve with garlic bread.

name: Mexican Potato Wedges
instructions: Mix dry oregano, corn starch, rice flour, refined flour, degi red chilli powder and asafoetida. In large pot heat salted water to boil, add potato wedges and cook until 30% done. Drain wedges into bowl, add seasoning mix and coat properly. Remove on plate or tray and cool down. Heat oil in kadai to medium-hot temperature. Deep fry cooled wedges until cooked through. Remove and keep on absorbent paper. Heat oil to high temperature and deep fry wedges second time until golden brown and crispy. Remove on absorbent paper and sprinkle salt and degi red chilli powder before serving. For Mexican cheesy topping: In bowl add chopped tomato, onion, green chillies, coriander leaves, salt, chaat masala and lemon juice, mix well. In serving plate place fried potato wedges, add salsa mixture, sprinkle grated cheese, drizzle tomato ketchup and chilli mayonnaise, layer with more wedges and garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Veg Lasagna with Chapati
ingredients: 1 inch ginger, peeled and finely chopped
instructions: In sauce pot add oil and butter, when hot add ginger, garlic and onion and sauté well. Add tomatoes and sauté for 10-12 seconds on moderate heat. Add carrot, french beans, cauliflower, tomato puree, salt, sugar and crushed black peppercorns and sauté for 10-12 seconds. Cover with lid and let cook for 4-5 minutes on moderate heat. In lasagna pan spread tomato ketchup and on top add torn basil leaves, then add pizza cheese blend. Place leftover chapati on top and repeat the process. Add prepared filling and top with pizza cheese blend, tomato ketchup, coriander sprig and sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes. Place leftover chapati on top again and add prepared filling. Finish with pizza cheese blend and butter. Bake lasagna in microwave for 3 minutes. Garnish with sliced tomato, basil leaves, crushed peppercorn and olive oil. Serve hot.

name: Lahori Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 small whole chicken with skin, cut into medium pieces
instructions: In bowl add chicken pieces with skin and salt and mix well. In kadai heat oil, add cinnamon sticks, bay leaf, cloves, black peppercorns, green cardamom and onions and sauté until light brown. Add marinated chicken and sauté until light golden brown. Add ghee, ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, degi red chilli powder and turmeric powder and sauté for 1 minute. Add water and cover, cook the chicken until at least 70% done. Add tomato puree and sauté for 1 minute, cover and cook until oil starts coming out. Remove lid, stir and add curd and sauté for 1 minute, cover and cook until oil starts separating. Remove lid and mix everything well. Serve hot in serving bowl garnished with ginger julienned, green chilli julienned and coriander leaves.

name: Pineapple Halwa
instructions: 1. Prepare pineapple paste in mixer. Chop cashews, almonds and pistachios. 2. Melt ghee in wok, add semolina and stir constantly until golden brown and fragrant. Transfer to plate. 3. Add pineapple paste to pan, add 1/2 cup sugar and finely chopped pineapple chunks. Cook until sugar dissolves and pineapple is tender. 4. Add 2 cups water and roasted semolina. Cook on low flame until semolina puffs up for 3-4 minutes. 5. Stir on medium flame, add dry fruits and cardamom powder. Cook until thick and dense. 6. Add 2 tsp ghee, mix well, transfer to plate. 7. Garnish with chopped cashews, almonds and pistachios.

name: Veg Galouti Kebab
ingredients: elephant foot yam boiled ½ cup
degi red chilli powder ½ tsp
instructions: For kebab paste: Fry cashew nuts in ghee until golden. Mix rajma, elephant foot yam, fried cashew nuts, salt, ginger-garlic paste, degi red chilli powder. Grind into paste. Add fried onion, kebab masala, salt, gram flour and mix well. Create smoking by placing hot coal in metal bowl with cloves and ghee, place in kebab mixture bowl and cover for 5-6 minutes. Shape into round kebabs. Heat non-stick pan with ghee and fry kebabs until golden from both sides. For kebab masala: Dry roast all whole spices until fragrant, cool and grind into powder. For chutney: Mix curd, chopped walnuts, fennel seeds, green chillies. Serve kebabs warm with chutney.

name: Crab Curry
instructions: For coconut paste: Heat oil, add onions and saute until translucent. Add coconut, whole red chilli, star anise, cinnamon stick, stone flower, black peppercorns, bay leaves, nutmeg, poppy seeds, shahi jeera, garlic cloves, green chillies and coriander seeds. Saute for 3-4 minutes. Add water and grind into fine thick paste. For marination: Grind ginger, green chillies, coriander, garlic cloves and red chillies into fine paste. Marinate crabs with paste, turmeric powder and malvani masala for 15-20 minutes. For juice: Grind crab legs with water and strain. Marinate claws and shells with turmeric powder and malvani masala for 10 minutes. For curry: Heat ghee in heavy bottom pan, add bay leaves, star anise, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms and asafoetida. Saute for a minute. Add onions, coriander leaves and mint leaves and saute until translucent. Add marinated crab claws and shells and mix well. Cook for 4-5 minutes. Add malvani masala, coriander leaves, prepared coconut paste, salt and crab legs juice. Stir well and cover. Cook for 5-6 minutes. Add kokum and coconut milk. Mix well and cook for last 5 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: chicken tikka sizzler
instructions: First marinate chicken thigh with salt, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice and mustard oil for 5 minutes. In a second marinade combine hung curd, salt, prepared masala, degi red chilli powder, lemon juice, fenugreek leaves, coriander and gram flour. Add chicken and mix well. Thread marinated chicken onto skewers alternating with vegetables. Grill on griddle with oil or over hot coal, brushing with ghee until golden brown. For the sizzler plate, prepare mint chutney by blending mayonnaise, ginger, mint, coriander, green chilli and curd. Sauté onion rings separately for masala pyaaz. Prepare vegetables separately. Heat sizzler plate and layer with cabbage leaves, butter rice, prepared masala, mint chutney, masala pyaaz and chicken tikka. Flambé with brandy and garnish with coriander, lemon and green chilli.

name: khaman dhokla
instructions: In a mixing bowl, add gram flour, salt, sugar, lemon juice, curd, ginger paste, turmeric water and turmeric powder with water as needed, mix into smooth batter without lumps. In separate bowl, combine oil and fruit salt, mix well and add to batter. Pour water in pressure cooker and heat 4-5 minutes. Place greased plates with batter on stand inside cooker. Cover and remove whistle, cook on medium flame for 15 minutes. Open and check with toothpick; if not done, cook 5 more minutes. For tempering, heat oil and add mustard seeds, curry leaves, asafoetida and green chilli until they splutter. Add coconut water, salt, sugar and coriander leaves, mix well. Pour tempering over cooked dhokla.

name: dora cake
instructions: In a bowl add refined flour, powdered sugar, condensed milk, baking powder, honey, vanilla essence, milk and butter. Mix well to make smooth batter. Heat a non-stick pan and pour a ladle of batter, cook until golden brown. Flip and cook the other side. Repeat with remaining batter and let cool. Spread hazelnut chocolate spread on one cake, place another cake on top and press gently. Serve immediately.

name: upma fingers
instructions: For upma: heat ghee in kadai, add green chillies, curry leaves, ginger and coriander leaves, sauté half minute. Move to one side and heat more ghee on other side, add cumin and mustard seeds to crackle. Pour in water and mix everything together. Add salt, turmeric powder, curd and roasted bombay rava, mix properly and cook until it forms a soft dough. Remove onto greased tray and even it out, refrigerate until set. Once set, cut into fingers and deep fry in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy. For salad: combine tomatoes, onion, purple cabbage, salt, green chillies, curry leaves, lemon juice and oil. For mayonnaise: mix chopped garlic, coriander leaves, red chilli flakes and mayonnaise. Serve fried upma fingers hot with fresh salad and chilli garlic mayonnaise.

name: kali gajar ka halwa
instructions: In pressure cooker add grated black carrots, milk and ghee, mix well. Cover and pressure cook until carrots turn soft. In a pan heat ghee and add slivered almonds and chopped pistachios, sauté on medium flame until done and set aside. In deep bottom kadai add ghee and pressure cooked black carrots. Stir occasionally and cook on medium flame. Add sugar and mix well until sugar melts. Add salt and mix. Add honey, vinegar, green cardamom and dry ginger powder, mix well. Cook for 3-4 minutes until mixture becomes dry. Add fried nuts and mix, cook for 2-3 more minutes. Garnish with fried nuts, silver vark, pomegranate pearls and mint leaves. Serve hot or cold.

name: pineapple jam
instructions: Add chopped pineapple to pan and sauté for 1 minute on low flame. Add water, mix well, cover and cook on medium heat until soft. Remove lid and blend with hand blender until coarse. Add vanilla essence, saffron, sugar, mix properly. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Remove lid, add salt, boil for 1 minute on high flames. Cool down completely. Store in airtight container in fridge.

name: veg shami kebab with tempeh
instructions: Marinate tempeh cubes with lemon, curd, ginger garlic paste, spices for 10-15 minutes. Dry roast whole spices and grind into powder for masala. In kadai, heat oil, add ginger, green chili, cook seconds. Add carrots and french beans, sauté. Add marinated tempeh with oil and salt, cook 5-6 minutes. Add water, cover and cook until soft. Mash mixture with wooden spatula. Add prepared masala and mix. Cool to room temperature. Make lemon-sized balls with filling. Shallow fry kebabs until golden brown on both sides. Prepare filling with green chili, coriander stem, ginger, and hung curd. Spread filling on bread, top with another slice, apply butter, toast until golden. Cut in half and serve with chutney and garnish.

name: chicken tangdi kebab
instructions: Slit drumsticks on bottom and remove excess fat. First marination: coat drumsticks with salt, green chilli, ginger garlic paste, coriander stem, curd. Keep aside. Prepare masala: toast fenugreek seeds, peppercorns, cardamom, cloves, mace, fenugreek leaves, salt and grind fine. Second marination: mix cheese spread, hung curd, lemon juice, salt, gram flour, mint, masala with marination juice. Cook first marinated chicken in ghee-lined pan covered for 70-75% doneness. Apply second marination to cooked drumsticks. Place on skewers and cook both sides on medium flame. Brush with ghee and garnish with coriander, lemon, onion, tomato.

name: eggless christmas plum cake
instructions: Soak nuts in orange juice. Heat butter with brown sugar. Mix grated carrots with soaked nuts and spices. Fold in flour, bread crumbs and soaked nut mixture. Add baking soda mixed with oil. Transfer to greased savarin mould. Steam in pressure cooker for 20 minutes. Make custard sauce separately and pour over. Top with icing and garnish with candied cherry and mint.

name: egg chilli
ingredients: red and green bell pepper 1 cup cubed
instructions: Mix eggs with soy sauce, chilli sauce, spring onion and oil. Cook egg mixture under a hot pan lid for 8-10 minutes until set. Cool and cut into cubes. Prepare sauce by mixing soy sauce, green chilli sauce, vinegar, red chilli sauce, sugar and water. Heat oil in wok, sauté ginger and red chilli, add peppers and onion for 1 minute. Add egg cubes and toss. Add sauce mixture, cornstarch slurry and cook until thickened. Add spring onion and sesame oil. Garnish with sesame seeds and coriander.

name: cheesy spring roll pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza filling with cheese, pizza sauce, sautéed vegetables. Place filling on bread or spring roll sheet. Roll tightly and seal edges. Pan fry or bake until golden and cheese melts. Serve hot with sauce.

name: mix veg cheese curry
instructions: Make ginger garlic paste. Sauté carrots, mushroom, peas in ghee and keep aside. Heat oil with ghee, add cumin, ginger garlic paste. Sauté onions until translucent. Add powders and sauté well. Add tomato puree, cook for 40-50 seconds. Add water, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add sautéed vegetables, french beans, salt. Add processed cheese cubes and bandel cheese. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander and cheese blend. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Aamras and Mango Shrikhand
instructions: For Dough: Knead wheat flour, semolina, salt and oil into smooth dough and cover for 15 minutes. For Aamras: Blend mangoes with caster sugar until smooth. For Shrikhand: Whisk hung curd smooth, add caster sugar, prepared aamras, saffron and mango cubes. For Puri: Roll dough into thin rounds, heat oil in kadai and fry until puffed and golden. Garnish shrikhand with mango cubes and almonds. Serve hot puri with aamras and shrikhand.

name: Paneer Cheese Paratha
instructions: For Dough: Mix refined flour, whole wheat flour, carom seeds and salt with water, knead soft dough and cover for 10 minutes. For Stuffing: Mix coriander leaves, ginger, onion, green chillies, chilli powder, crushed black pepper, grated paneer and cheese. Divide dough into portions, form lemon-sized balls, roll flat, add stuffing in center, form ball again and roll into round shape. Heat tawa, roast paratha on both sides for 30 seconds, flip and brush ghee, roast until brown spots appear. Serve hot.

name: Udupi Style Sambar
instructions: For Masala: Dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, urad dal, chana dal, fenugreek seeds and red chillies in oil. Add asafoetida and fresh coconut with water to make paste. Grind to smooth paste. For Sambar: Pressure cook toor dal with water, salt, turmeric and red chilli powder until done. In separate pot, add water, drumsticks, salt and pumpkin, cook 5-6 minutes. Add aubergine, okra, cooked dal and water. Add tamarind pulp, salt and sambar masala, cook 5 minutes on medium flame. For Tempering: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, asafoetida, red chillies and curry leaves, let them splutter. Pour tempering over sambar. Add grated jaggery and stir. Serve hot with rice.

name: Amritsari Urad Dal
instructions: Heat mustard oil in pan and add cumin seeds, let them crackle. Add chopped onion and saute until light brown. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder and green chillies, saute until fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and saute for half a minute. Add water and soaked split black gram with salt. Mix everything properly and cover. Cook for 12-15 minutes on medium heat until dal is soft. Remove lid and add crushed roasted cumin seeds and chopped coriander leaves. Mix together and serve hot.

name: Vrat ki Khichdi
instructions: Heat ghee in kadai, add cumin seeds and curry leaves. Saute potatoes for 2 minutes on medium heat. Add peanuts and green chillies, saute for 1 minute. Add washed barnyard millet and sendha namak, saute for another minute. Add water, mix and cover, cook on medium heat until fully cooked. Separately fry makhana and peanuts in ghee. Once khichdi is cooked, add the fried makhana and peanuts with ghee, let sit for 5-10 minutes. Serve hot garnished with fried makhana, peanuts, pomegranate pearls and sliced green chillies.

name: Sweet Potato Chaat
instructions: Take sweet potatoes and 1-2 tbsp water in a polythene bag and microwave for 7 minutes on highest temperature. Cool completely, peel and cut into 1/2 inch thick chunks. Add black salt, roasted cumin powder, green chilly sauce, sweet chutney, lemon juice and chopped green coriander. Mix well and transfer to serving plate. Garnish with black salt, roasted cumin powder, sweet chutney and green coriander sprigs.

name: Crispy Potato Pizza
instructions: Mix grated potato with oil, oregano, chilli flakes and salt. Combine capsicum, onion, tomato, baby corn, mushroom with salt and oil. Spread potato base in pan, sprinkle water and cover, cook on low heat 5-6 minutes. Flip base, spread tomato ketchup and cheese, add vegetable toppings and more cheese, add chopped green chilli. Cover and cook on medium heat until cheese melts and base is crispy. Garnish with coriander and serve immediately.

name: Aloo Masoor Dal
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and splutter. Add ginger and green chillies, saute 1 minute. Add masoor dal, prepared paste and saute. Add potatoes, degi red chili powder, ghee and mix. Add water, cover and cook until potatoes are done. Add tempering and lemon juice. Prepare paste by dry roasting coriander, fennel, cumin seeds, peppercorns, cardamom, cinnamon, then transfer to bowl with asafoetida, coriander leaves and curd, grind to smooth paste. Temper ghee, add raisins, keep aside. Garnish with curd, ginger julienne, coriander and lemon. Serve hot with roti.

name: Instant Dahi Vada
instructions: Mix soaked semolina and papad in bowl. Add cumin, fennel, salt, asafoetida, green chilli, ginger, coriander. Add paneer batter made from paneer, curd and mixture. In kadhai heat oil, wet hands and drop batter into hot oil, fry until golden and crispy. Make quenelle shapes and fry. Soak fried vadas in water with salt, asafoetida, chili powder and tamarind chutney for 10-12 minutes. Make curd mixture with beaten curd, salt, asafoetida, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder. Temper ghee with coriander seeds, fenugreek and cumin. Add curd mixture and saute, add water and sugar, add soaked vadi and toss on high flame. Serve garnished with coriander.

name: Crispy Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 cup fresh bread crumbs for coating
instructions: Mix mozzarella, processed cheese, paneer and potatoes together. Add green chillies, ginger, coriander, refined flour, degi red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt and baking soda, mix well. Take portion of mixture, make space in center, add cheese and roll into ball. Make slurry by mixing refined flour, salt and water to coating consistency. Heat oil in kadai. Dip each cheese ball in slurry then coat with bread crumbs. Deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: Chicken Lababdar
instructions: Marinate chicken with degi red chili powder, turmeric, salt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, oil for 15-20 minutes. Prepare lababdar masala by dry roasting mace, cardamom, cloves, shahi jeera, cinnamon, then add black peppercorns. Make ginger-garlic paste in mortar pestle. In sauce pot heat ghee and oil, add bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, peppercorns, ginger-garlic paste and onions, saute 10-15 seconds. Add tomatoes, degi red chili, coriander powder, water, salt and cashews, boil 10-12 minutes, cool and grind to smooth gravy. Add curd and gram flour to marinated chicken. Grill chicken pieces both sides in hot grill pan with oil until cooked. In sauce pot add butter, onion, saute until translucent, add coriander powder, degi red chili, tomatoes, saute well. Add prepared gravy, grilled chicken, fresh cream, salt, kewra water, lababdar masala and pinch of sugar. Serve hot garnished with ginger, coriander and green chilli.

name: Paneer Sizzler
instructions: Prepare BBQ sauce by heating oil with ginger, garlic, green chillies, onion, sauteing then adding black peppercorns, bay leaf, tomato ketchup, water, soya sauce, coriander stems and boiling. For paneer shashlik, coat paneer, onion, tomato, capsicum with oregano, chilli powder, salt and ginger-garlic water, then grill on hot pan. Prepare buttered rice by cooking with herbs. Assemble on hot sizzler plate with cabbage leaves, french fries, buttered rice, peas, grilled paneer shashlik, BBQ sauce, cold butter and garnish with coriander.

name: Nawabi Dal
instructions: In pressure cooker, heat ghee with garlic, saute dals for 2-3 minutes, add milk, green cardamom, cloves. Add water and salt, cook to 3-4 whistles. For tempering, heat ghee and oil with caraway seeds, add garlic and onions until golden, add cinnamon stick, asafoetida, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder. Add curd, saute, add coriander leaves, mint, cooked dal and water. Simmer 4-5 minutes. Add smoked charcoal for smokiness. Garnish with ghee, peppercorns, nutmeg, fried onions, fresh cream and coriander.

name: Mutton Seekh Kebab
instructions: Marinate half kheema with salt, ginger-garlic paste, green chillies, coriander, mint, cheese, cashew, almonds, chilli powder, coriander powder, coriander seeds, shahi jeera, cardamom seeds, peppercorns. Grind smooth, add remaining kheema and hard-boiled eggs, smoke with charcoal and refrigerate. For masala, heat oil with cumin seeds, onion, coriander seeds until golden, add turmeric, coriander powder, asafoetida, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, tomato puree, salt, green chillies, coriander leaves and water. Mold kheema into seekh kebabs on skewers, fry in seekh kabab masala. Garnish with onion rings, mint, coriander, lemon wedge, ginger julienne.

name: Mixed Pakoda
instructions: Make green chilli garlic paste with chillies, garlic, coriander stems. For vada pav filling, heat oil with mustard seeds, curry leaves, paste, turmeric, boiled potatoes and coriander. For bhajiya, mix onion, potato, coriander leaves, salt, asafoetida, chilli powder, turmeric with jackfruit. Add gram flour, carom seeds, asafoetida, turmeric, chilli powder and masala. Shape and fry half-cooked, then refry until golden. For palak pakoda, mix chana dal paste with spices, fill spinach leaves like sandwich, dip in batter and fry. For bread pakoda, layer bread with green chutney, cheese, vada pav filling, paneer, sev and dip in gram flour batter, fry half-cooked then refry until golden.

name: Tandoori Corn Chaat
instructions: Dry roast black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black cardamom, cloves, green cardamom in pan until fragrant. Cool, grind fine, add degi red chilli powder and dried mango powder. Roast corn, green chillies, tomato on hot coal or open flame until charred, cool and set aside. Mix chopped ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves, onion, roasted corn kernels, roasted chillies, roasted tomato, mustard oil, tandoori masala, salt, lemon juice, mint leaves. Serve in bowl garnished with hung curd, mint sprig and pinch of tandoori masala.

name: Dahi Bread Upma
instructions: Chop bread slices and soak in mixture of curd, water and salt. Heat oil in kadai with mustard seeds, whole urad dal, chana dal, let them crackle, add peanuts and saute for minute. Add curry leaves, ginger, green chillies, onion and saute until translucent. Add salt and water, mix, add soaked bread and mix properly. Cook for 2 minutes, add tomatoes and ghee, finish with coriander leaves. Switch off flame and serve on plate. Garnish with green chutney, sev and coriander leaves.

name: Poha Paneer Ball
instructions: In bowl, add soaked poha, boiled mashed potatoes, paneer, salt, red chilli powder, green chillies, coriander powder, amchur powder and cornflour. Mix well. Divide mixture into equal portions and form round lemon-sized balls. Coat prepared mixture with semolina. Deep fry balls until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot with green chutney.

name: mini chocobar ice cream
instructions: Boil fresh cream in a saucepot. Add milkmaid and cook for a while. Add vanilla essence and mix well. Add crushed chocolate cookies and mix. Pour prepared mixture into ice tray and freeze for at least 3-4 hours. In a chocolate bowl, add oil and place in microwave for 30 seconds or use double boiler. Once chocolate melts, dip frozen bars into melted chocolate using a stick. Garnish with chopped almonds and chocolate sprinkles. Serve cold.

name: spicy paratha quesadilla
instructions: Prepare filling: in a bowl, add boiled potatoes, onion, ginger, green chili, sweet corn, cheese, salt and coriander leaves. Mix and mash everything together. For paratha: take small dough portions and roll thin using rolling pin. Place on hot flat pan and cook till half-cooked. Transfer to plate and add filling on half side of paratha. Sprinkle degi red chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, chaat masala and place cheese slice. Fold and press lightly. Add butter to hot flat pan and place filled paratha. Cook until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Remove and serve with fresh salad.

name: restaurant style paneer masala
instructions: In a mortar pestle, add ginger, garlic, green chili and salt. Make a smooth paste. In a kadai, add ghee. Once hot, add cumin seeds, cloves and green cardamom and let splutter well. Add prepared ginger-garlic paste and saute it well. Add chopped onion and saute until light golden brown. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder and degi red chili powder. Saute until raw smell goes away. Add beaten curd and chopped tomato and saute well. Add a little water and cook for a minute. Blend the mixture with hand blender to a smooth gravy. Add more water and cook gravy for additional 5 minutes on medium flame. Add paneer cubes and cook for a few minutes. Garnish with julienned ginger, coriander sprig, beaten curd and kasuri methi. Serve hot.

name: shalgam gosht
instructions: For cooking mutton: in pressure cooker, add oil and ghee. Once hot, add bay leaf, cinnamon stick and onions and saute until translucent. Add mutton and salt to taste. Add coriander stems and leaves and saute for 1 minute. Add turmeric powder, degi red chili powder and coriander powder and mix well. Add beaten curd and ginger-garlic paste and cook on moderate heat. Add water, cover with lid and cook for 7-8 whistles. For shalgam gosht: in a handi, add ghee. Once hot, add caraway seeds and let splutter well. Add ginger, green chili and turnip and saute well. Add butter and salt to taste and cook on moderate heat. Add cooked mutton and mix well. Add butter, crushed black cardamom and coriander leaves and mix well. Mash one shalgam to thicken the gravy and cook until mutton is tender. Finish with butter and transfer to serving bowl. Garnish with coriander sprig and green chili. Serve hot with roti.

name: meethe chawal ananas zarda
instructions: Heat ghee in a pot and add raisins, almonds, cashew, saffron and mix well. Add water (proportional to rice), cardamom pods and soaked sella rice with salt. Cook the rice until done. Add sugar and mawa and cook until sugar evenly coats the rice. Do not mix it. Cover with lid and cook on medium flame for 7-8 minutes. Remove the lid - sugar crystals will start to melt. Now gently give it a stir and cover again. In another pot, place pineapple slices. Add ghee, castor sugar and cooked rice and slightly press it down. Add mawa, chopped pistachio and almonds and cook for another 10-12 minutes. Turn off the flame and serve hot.

name: chole bhature delhi style
instructions: For chole: pressure cook chickpeas with dry amla, red chili, cardamom, salt, baking soda, bay leaf and tea powder. For chole masala: dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, black cardamom and black peppercorns. Add asafoetida, degi red chili powder, mango powder and carom seeds and roast 1 minute. Grind to fine powder. For bhature with yeast: mix flour, sugar, salt, oil and yeast soaked in water and sugar, add semolina and water to make dough. For bhature without yeast: mix flour, semolina, sugar, salt, oil, water, beaten curd and baking soda. Deep fry until puffed and golden brown. For tempering chole: heat ghee, add prepared chole masala, black tamarind water and chole water. Simmer well. Add more ghee. For fried aloo: deep fry boiled and cubed potatoes and season with salt, degi red chili powder and mango powder. Serve chole with fried aloo and bhature. Garnish with sliced onion, green chili, julienned ginger, green chutney and coriander leaves.

name: Eggless Gingerbread House
instructions: Heat jaggery and brown sugar until dissolved. Add butter and stir until creamy. Add gingerbread spice and let sit 2-3 minutes. Mix in flour, baking powder, baking soda, condensed milk and vanilla essence to form soft dough. Wrap and rest dough 30 minutes. Roll to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with moulds. Bake at 160°C for 10-15 minutes. Assemble house by gluing roof and sides with icing. Dust with icing sugar for snowy effect and decorate with sweets and sprinkles.

name: Malai Kofta Masala
instructions: Mix mawa, paneer, flour, cornstarch, salt and green chili-coriander paste. Add breadcrumbs. Prepare dry fruit filling with sautéed onion, nuts and raisins. Stuff mixture with filling to make lemon-sized balls. Deep fry until golden brown. For gravy: sauté ginger, garlic, green chili and coriander stems. Add onion and tomatoes. Add curd and spice powders. Cook 2-3 minutes. Add water and cashew nuts, cover and cook 8-10 minutes. Blend gravy until smooth. Strain. In final step, melt butter with garam masala and cream. Add gravy and cook 3-4 minutes. Add fried koftas and serve hot.

name: Lucknow Special Nahari
instructions: Heat mustard oil until smoking, add garlic juice. Add bay leaves, cloves, black cardamom and sliced onions, sauté well. Add lamb, salt and ginger-garlic paste, roast well. Mix spice powders with curd and add to handi. Add water and cover, cook on low flame until mutton is tender. Prepare nihari masala by roasting green cardamom, mace, allspice, long pepper, stone flower, cumin seeds, galangal, vetiver root, cinnamon, black pepper and rose petals. Grind to fine powder. Mix wheat flour with masala, water and kewra water, add to handi. Cook until gravy thickens. For tira: heat ghee with masala, chili powder and kewra water, strain into handi. Garnish with coriander, onion and lemon. Serve hot with khamiri roti.

name: eggnog
instructions: With egg: Blend egg yolks and sugar until creamy. Add cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla extract and bourbon liquor and mix well. Refrigerate for 1 day to mature. Add milk and fresh cream and mix. Whip egg whites until soft peaks. Gently fold egg whites into mixture. Pour in glass, sprinkle nutmeg on top and refrigerate or serve warm. Without egg: Blend all ingredients in blender well. Pour in glass, sprinkle nutmeg on top. Refrigerate until chilled or serve warm.

name: Masala Puri with Onion Tomato Sabji
ingredients: ½ tsp degi red chilli powder
instructions: For dough: Mix whole wheat flour, semolina, carom seeds, salt, turmeric, asafoetida, chilli powder, cumin powder with oil and water to make semi-soft dough. Apply oil and knead again, cover with damp cloth. Prepare ginger-garlic paste by grinding ginger, garlic and green chillies with salt. For puris: Roll dough into thin rounds, heat oil in kadai until medium hot, fry puris pressing until they puff up fully, flip and fry until golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper. For sabji: Heat ghee in kadai, add cumin seeds, fennel seeds and fenugreek seeds to splutter well. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté 2-3 minutes on medium flame. Add onions and sauté until light pink. Add turmeric, coriander, asafoetida and cumin powder, sauté well. Add tomatoes and chilli powder, mix well. Add sugar and little water, let cook until tomatoes are soft. Finish with dry fenugreek leaves and coriander leaves. Transfer to serving dish and serve hot with masala puri.

name: Paneer Tikka
ingredients: ½ cup red bell peppers cubed
instructions: In bowl add yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, kasuri methi and mustard oil, mix well. Add salt and carom seeds, mix well. Add roasted gram flour and mix well. If yogurt is not sour, add lemon juice; if sour, use as is. Divide prepared mixture into two parts. In one part add degi mirch for regular paneer tikka and mix well. In other part add panchranga achaar paste along with turmeric powder for achari paneer tikka and mix well. To both marinades, add green capsicum, onions, red bell peppers and paneer cubes, mix and coat well. Skewer vegetables and paneer and set aside. Heat mustard oil on grill pan till smoking point and add butter. Roast prepared paneer tikka skewers on grill pan, baste with butter and cook from all sides. Transfer cooked tikka to serving plate. Place hot charcoal in bowl next to tikka, pour ghee on top and cover for 2 minutes for smoky flavor. Garnish with kasuri methi and serve hot with dip or sauce.

name: Mumbai Style Tawa Pulao
instructions: Heat butter and oil in pan, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add sliced onions and sauté until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté until fragrant. Add red chilli paste, mix well and cook for a few minutes. Add cabbage and cook for 3-4 minutes. Add green capsicum, tomato, potatoes and french beans, mix and cook for 5-6 minutes. Add salt, green peas and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add cooked rice and toss well. Add lime juice, butter and pav bhaji masala, mix well and cook for 1-2 minutes. Garnish with sliced tomatoes, coriander leaves and lemon wedges. Serve hot with tomato raita and papad.

name: Restaurant Style Tomato Soup
instructions: In a pressure cooker add oil and chopped tomatoes, sauté for a minute. Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger, garlic, black peppercorns, black cardamom seeds, salt and water, mix well. Close lid and give 2-3 whistles. In another kadhi heat oil and butter, add onion and sauté until translucent. Add the cooked tomato mixture and cook for 5-6 minutes. Switch off flame, add coriander stems and blend into fine puree with hand blender, then strain with soup strainer. Pour back in kadhi and boil for 15 minutes. Add sugar and mix well. Switch off flame. Serve in bowl garnished with cream, croutons, tomato slices and coriander leaves.

name: Cheese Burst Pizza Paratha
instructions: In a bowl add whole wheat flour, salt, carom seeds and ghee, mix once. Add water and knead properly, apply ghee and cover for later use. In a small bowl add green chilli, ginger, salt, chilli flake and oregano. Add processed cheese and mix well. In another bowl add sweet corn, red chilli, capsicum, chilli flakes, oregano and basil, mix well. Take two equal portions of dough and roll using rolling pin. Spread prepared filling on one paratha and place other rolled paratha on top. Apply ghee on pan and place paratha, cook slightly crisp from one side. Flip and cook from other side. Spread tomato ketchup, tomato and cheese on top. Add toppings and cover pan, cook on medium flame. Garnish with basil leaf and olive oil. Serve hot.

name: Mumbai Egg Bhurji
ingredients: coriander stems 1 tbsp tender finely chopped
instructions: On a tawa or shallow pan on moderate heat, add butter and oil. Once hot add prepared ginger garlic paste and sauté for 10-12 seconds. Add onions and sauté for 30 seconds until translucent. Add tomato, capsicum, green chilli, tender coriander stems and sauté for a minute. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and sauté. Add a little water and mix well. Add eggs and mix properly, cook for 2-3 minutes on high flame. Once eggs are cooked well, add remaining butter and mix everything well. Add salt to taste and coriander leaves, sauté for 10-12 seconds. Switch off flame and serve hot with ladi pav. Garnish with onion, tomato, coriander sprig, green chilli and lemon wedge.

name: Amritsari Fish Tikka
instructions: Slice fish fillet and marinate in first marination: salt, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, mustard oil, kasuri methi, asafoetida for 10 minutes. In second marination bowl add degi mirch powder, curd, rice flour, gram flour, carom seeds and mix well. Heat oil in kadai and deep fry marinated fish until nicely done and drain on paper. Alternatively, heat oil in grill pan, skewer marinated fish and grill until crisp and golden. Garnish with onion rings, lemon wedge, and coriander.

name: Matar Ki Kachori
instructions: Dry roast coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, then coarsely crush. Heat ghee, add fennel seeds, ginger, green peas, asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, salt, green chillies, water. Cover and cook until soft. Add coarse masala powder and black pepper powder, cook until soft, then mash and cool. For dough: mix refined flour, ghee, salt with water and knead soft dough; rest while preparing instant pickle. For instant achaar: heat mustard oil, add fennel seeds and mustard dal, add ginger, chillies, sauté 1 minute, add vinegar, salt, sugar, and transfer to bowl. Divide dough into portions, flatten, add filling, close well, roll into thick poori, and deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot with tea and instant achaar.

name: Mughlai Chicken Handi
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, green chilli, coriander stem, ginger garlic paste, curd, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, fried onions, coriander leaves, and fried onion oil. For barista: fry sliced onions in oil until golden brown. In handi, heat oil, add bay leaf and cinnamon, let splutter. Add marinated chicken, cover and cook on low flame 15-20 minutes. Add warm water, mix well, cook another 5-10 minutes until chicken is done. Add salt and prepared masala, mix well. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with toasted almonds and coriander. For masala: dry roast black cardamom, green cardamom, mace, black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf, salt until fragrant, add degi red chilli powder and asafoetida, grind to fine powder.

name: French Beans Sabji
instructions: Heat oil in kadai, add cumin seeds, ginger, green chillies, garlic, sauté a few seconds. Add onion, sauté until translucent. Add asafoetida, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, sauté until fragrant. Add soaked chana dal, salt, water, mix once, cover and cook 3-4 minutes. Add french beans, mix well, cover and cook 5-7 minutes. Remove lid, add tomatoes, sauté for 1 minute. Finish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Veg Khow Suey
instructions: Make paste: crush green chilli, garlic cloves, ginger, salt in mortar pestle. Heat oil, add paste, sauté 1 minute. Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder with little vegetable stock and sauté well. Add carrot, baby corn, onion, sauté 1 minute. Add vegetable stock, mix well, add salt and sugar, stir well. Cover and cook on medium flame 5 minutes. Add coconut milk, mix well and allow to boil. Add spring onion and coriander leaves, stir well. For serving: place boiled noodles in serving bowl, top with green onion, crushed peanuts, chilli flakes, brown garlic, brown onions, lime juice, chilli oil and coriander leaves.

name: Urad Dal ki Kachori
instructions: For dough: Add whole wheat flour, salt, and water to knead soft dough. Cover and set aside 20 minutes. For filling: Grind soaked urad dal, green chillies, ginger to coarse mixture. Add asafoetida, fennel powder, mint powder, coriander powder, red chilli powder and mix. Divide dough into portions, roll into discs, stuff with filling, roll back into balls and flatten with rolling pin. Heat oil in kadhai and deep-fry kachoris till crisp and golden. Drain on paper. For sabji: Heat ghee, add cumin seeds, let splutter. Add asafoetida, saute. Add cloves, bay leaves, saute till fragrant. Add tomatoes, cook 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander powder, mix well. Add green chillies, saute. Add potatoes, cook 2 minutes. Add water as needed, simmer 2-3 minutes. Add coriander leaves and garam masala, simmer 3-5 more minutes.

name: Nolen Gurer Sandesh
instructions: For chenna water: Mix vinegar, water, sugar, milk powder. For chenna: Boil 5 litres milk. Add chenna water and stir well. Line bowl with muslin. When milk curdles, pour into muslin and squeeze whey. Rinse with chilled water. Mash in parat for 10 minutes until soft. Divide into 3 equal parts. For jolbhora: In kadai, saute mawa, add nolen gur, cook 5 minutes on medium flame. Transfer to tray and refrigerate 30 minutes. Mix with half the chenna. Grease palms with ghee, make small balls and put between molds. For kanchagola: In kadai add 1 part chenna, cornstarch, powdered sugar. Cook 5 minutes on medium flame. Cool and blend smooth. Mix with remaining chenna and add rose water. Make balls and coat with milk powder. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Garnish with saffron water.

name: Masala Sandwich without Bread
instructions: For batter: Add gram flour, oil, salt, sugar, ginger, soaked semolina, water, curd and mix well. In another bowl mix fruit salt with oil and add to batter. Heat non-stick pan, pour ladle of batter and cook on low heat until light golden. Cover with lid and cook 3 minutes. Flip and cook till lightly crusted. Cool slightly. For filling: Add green chilli, ginger, capsicum, sweet corn, carrot, potato, pizza cheese, coriander leaves, salt, butter, chilli flakes and cumin powder. Mix well. Assemble by spreading mayonnaise and mint chutney on cake, add filling, place another cake on top and press lightly. In non-stick pan, add butter and fry sandwich on low heat from both sides. Cover with lid and cook till crisp. Cut in half. Garnish with mint leaves and tomato wedges. Serve hot.

name: Suran ki Sabji
instructions: For frying yam: Heat mustard oil in kadai, add yam cubes and fry on medium flame. Remove on absorbent paper and set aside. Remove excess oil. For tempering: In same kadai heat mustard oil, add black pepper corns, green cardamom, cloves, cumin seeds and let splutter. Add ginger and green chilli and saute. Add turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida and curd and mix well. Add fried yam, salt to taste and water and mix everything. Cover with lid and cook 5-10 minutes. Add green peas, coriander leaves and lemon juice and mix well. Garnish with coriander sprig.

name: Poha Idli
instructions: For poha mixture: In bowl add pressed rice, water and curd and mix everything properly. Keep aside 15-20 minutes. For rava mixture: In bowl add semolina, water and curd and mix everything properly. Keep aside 15-20 minutes. For tempering: In small pan heat oil, add mustard seeds, ginger, green chillies and curry leaves and saute for half minute. Set aside. For assembling: Mix soaked poha mixture vigorously with hands until mashy. In bigger bowl mix rava mixture, poha mixture, salt and tempering together. Place steamer on high flames. In poha batter add mixture of oil and fruit salt and mix with light hands. Grease idli mould with oil, add big spoonful of batter and place mould in steamer. Steam 12-15 minutes. Remove and cool slightly. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Kalakand Lassi
instructions: Blend yogurt with milk and kalakand to make a smooth mixture. Add ice and blend well. Pour into serving glasses and serve chilled.

name: Malai Chicken
instructions: Heat ghee, add cardamom and cumin seeds. Add chicken and salt, saute well. Add ginger and coriander powder, cook until chicken is tender. Add milk and almond paste, cook until soft. Add black pepper powder, kasuri methi and cream. Temper with ghee and degi mirch. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Sev Tamatar ki Sabji
instructions: Heat ghee, add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add ginger, green chilli and curry leaves, saute well. Add asafoetida, chilli powder and turmeric. Add chopped tomato and toss well. Add tomato puree and cook well. Add water, salt, ghee and jaggery. Cook for 10-15 minutes. Garnish with ratlami sev and serve hot.

name: Vegetable Bread Lasagna
instructions: Toast bread slices with butter. Prepare vegetable stuffing by sauteing garlic, onion, capsicum, corn, peas and green chillies with oregano and spices in tomato puree. Make paneer broccoli stuffing separately. Prepare tomato sauce. Marinate tomatoes with spices. Layer toasted bread with both fillings, tomato sauce and cheese. Cook in pan until cheese melts. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Combine chicken, oil, salt, red chili powder, asafoetida, black pepper, green chiles, ginger and coriander in a bowl. Grind to coarse mixture. Add boiled potatoes and salt, make lemon-sized balls. Shape and coat with breadcrumbs. Deep fry until golden. In separate bowl combine mayonnaise, oregano, chili flakes, lemon juice, garlic and ketchup for dip. Combine tomato, onion, lemon juice, salt, coriander and peppercorns for salad. Grind bread slices, salt and refined flour for breadcrumbs. Toss fried nuggets with butter, green chiles and coriander leaves. Toast ladi pav on both sides. Assemble burger with pav, salad, mint chutney, tossed nuggets, dip and grated cheese. Serve hot.

name: Kala Khatta Chuski
instructions: In a pan add kokum, water, ginger, black pepper and cumin seeds. Boil for 10-12 minutes until kokum is soft. Add sugar and continue boiling for 5-6 minutes. Add green chili and black salt, boil for a minute and cool slightly. Blend using hand blender and strain properly. Store in airtight container for 2-3 months. For serving, crush ice finely in blender. Fill glass halfway with crushed ice, insert wooden stick in centre and fill glass fully pressing firmly. Add kala khatta syrup and shikanji masala on top. Enjoy super chilled.

name: Chicken Patiala
ingredients: 900 gm chicken drumstick and thigh with bones
instructions: Make ginger garlic paste using ginger, garlic and green chiles. Marinate chicken with ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and ghee for 15-20 minutes. Soak fenugreek leaves in water. Heat ghee and oil in handi, add peppercorns, cloves, green cardamom, bay leaf and cinnamon. Let them splutter. Add onions and saute for 5-6 minutes until golden. Add marinated chicken and saute 2-3 minutes. Add soaked fenugreek leaves and cook a minute. Add tomato, coriander stems, coriander powder, red chili powder and mix well. Add water and salt, simmer for a while. Add beaten curd and cook for 7-8 minutes. Add fresh cream and crushed fenugreek leaves. Mix well and transfer to serving dish. Garnish with coriander and serve hot with roti. For Pulao variation, add cooked chicken patiala with rice, caraway seeds, ginger, onion and coriander, cover and cook 3-4 minutes on low flame.

name: thread paneer
instructions: For wonton sheet: knead flour, salt, vinegar, egg white, oil into semi-hard dough. Rest 10-15 minutes. Dust surface with cornstarch, roll thin. Fold and roll again 2-3 times until almost see-through. Cut thin strips. For paneer: mix paneer, ginger-garlic paste, black pepper, red chilli sauce, salt, refined flour. For salad: mix capsicum, carrot, bell pepper, green chilli, coriander, salt, lemon juice, oil. Assemble: place paneer on wonton strips, roll. Deep fry in low-medium hot oil until golden and crispy. Remove on absorbent paper. Serve with fresh salad, schezwan sauce, garnish with coriander.

name: shahi dal mughlai
instructions: In thick bottom pot, add 1 1/2 tbsp ghee, shah jeera, let splutter. Add sliced onion, saute. Add soaked moong dal, saute well. Add salt, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, water. Cover and cook 20-25 minutes on medium flame. For tempering: heat ghee and oil, add cloves, shah jeera, splutter well. Add ginger and garlic, saute until garlic turns brown. Add chopped onion and green chilli, saute well. Add asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, fried onions, beaten curd. Saute on medium flame until masalas cook properly. Transfer cooked moong dal into tadka, mix well. Garnish with coriander sprigs, mint sprigs, fried onions, butter cube, and silver leaf. Serve hot.

name: Chole Tikki Chaat
instructions: For cooking chickpeas: In pressure cooker add soaked chickpeas, salt, green chillies, black cardamom, black peppercorns, cloves, water, garlic, ginger. Cover and pressure cook for 2-3 whistles. Once pressure releases, strain and keep aside. For ginger-garlic paste: In mortar pestle add ginger, garlic, green chilli, salt and make paste. For tempering: Heat ghee in handi, add bay leaf, dry kashmiri chilli, cumin seeds, coriander seeds and let splutter. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute. Add water, cooked chickpeas, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, asafoetida, coriander powder and saute. Add water, tamarind pulp, jaggery and cook on medium flame for 5-10 minutes. For pattice: In bowl add boiled potatoes, bread slice, cornstarch, salt and mix well. Divide into equal portions, flatten and shallow fry in ghee until golden brown. For green chutney: In bowl add coriander leaves, mint leaves, ginger, garlic, salt, green chilli, sugar, oil. Transfer to grinder and grind into smooth paste, add curd. For masala: In non-stick pan add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black peppercorns, salt and dry roast on low flame until aromatic. Grind into fine powder. To serve: Place pattice on plate, add cooked chole on the side, add chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, green chutney, and sprinkle masala on top. Garnish with pomegranate pearls and coriander sprig. Serve hot.

name: Aloo Ki Jalebi
instructions: In grinder jar add tapioca and salt, grind into fine powder, strain and transfer to bowl. In same grinder add boiled crumbled potatoes, curd, water and grind into smooth paste. Transfer to bowl and mix everything well. Add water as required and refined flour and whisk properly. Rest for 10 minutes. Add ginger juice, degi red chilli powder, water as required and soda and whisk well. Strain mixture so there are no lumps. Pour batter into ziplock bag. Heat oil in deep pan and make round spirals with batter. When one side is partly cooked, turn over and fry other side. Fry until jalebis are light golden and crisp. Remove on absorbent paper. For tamarind chutney: In saucepot add water, tamarind and let it boil on medium flame. Add jaggery and let it boil. Once jaggery melts switch off flame and strain into bowl. For tempering: Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add dry red chilli and asafoetida. Transfer tamarind chutney to pan. Add salt and mix well. Let it reduce for 5-6 minutes. Remove from flame and let cool. For aloo chaat: In bowl add boiled cubed potatoes, red chilli powder, salt, coriander sprig, oil, ginger, lemon juice, roasted cumin powder and mix everything well. Garnish jalebi with aloo chaat, green chutney, tamarind chutney and coriander sprig on top. Serve hot.

name: Amritsari Fish Pakoda Roll
ingredients: fish fillet 1 medium cut in fingers
instructions: For marinating fish: In bowl add fish, salt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic juice and mix properly. Set aside for 10-15 minutes. For batter: In bowl add carom seeds, dried fenugreek leaves, coriander leaves, ginger-garlic paste, gram flour, mustard oil, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, water and mix properly until coating consistency. Keep aside. For roti dough: In bowl add gram flour, ginger-garlic paste, salt, mustard oil, refined flour, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, curd and knead properly until semi-soft dough. Add ghee and knead again. Keep aside. For fresh salad: In bowl add sliced tomatoes, onion, green chillies, mint leaves, salt, lemon juice and mix properly. Keep aside. For green chutney: In grinder jar add mint leaves, coriander leaves, ginger, onion, lemon juice, green chillies, salt and grind into fine paste. Keep aside. For assembling: Coat marinated fish with flour then coat with batter. Deep fry in medium hot oil until light golden and half cooked. Remove and keep aside. Take small portion of dough and roll it thin using rolling pin into small roti. Roast these rotis on hot flat pan and apply ghee. Cook until golden brown and crispy. Flash fry fish pakoda in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. For serving: On roti spread mayonnaise, place fish pakoda, fresh salad, green chutney. Garnish with coriander leaves, lemon slices, degi red chilli powder. Serve immediately.

name: Paneer Makhani Tawa Pizza
instructions: For makhani gravy: In saucepan add oil, once hot add cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon stick and let splutter well. Add ginger, garlic, onions and saute on medium flame. Add tomatoes and salt. Saute for 10-15 seconds. Add degi red chilli powder, asafoetida, water, cashew nuts and sugar. Let simmer for 15-20 minutes. Cool completely. Transfer to grinder and grind into smooth paste. Keep aside. For dough: In bowl add refined flour, semolina, salt, curd and water. Knead into loose dough. In small bowl add ghee and baking soda and mix well. Add this to dough and knead properly. Cover with muslin cloth and keep aside for 15-20 minutes. For stuffing: In bowl add pizza cheese blend, green chillies, coriander leaves. Mix well and keep aside. For paneer marination: In bowl add paneer, onion, yellow bell pepper, green bell pepper, salt, oil, degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida, coriander leaves and mix well. Keep aside. For tossing: In saucepan add oil, once hot add marinated paneer mixture and kasoori methi. Toss well for 20-30 seconds. Keep aside. For makhani sauce: In saucepan add butter and let it melt. Add degi red chilli powder, coriander powder, asafoetida and saute well. Add prepared makhani gravy, water and stir well. Add salt, sugar, fresh cream and mix well. Give one boil and switch off flame. For pizza base: Apply ghee on both palms. Take one portion of dough, add prepared cheese stuffing in center and shape into round ball. Dust semolina and roll it thin using rolling pin. Cook on flat pan slightly crisp from one side. Flip and cook from other side. For assembling: Apply makhani sauce on one side. Add prepared paneer mixture, pizza cheese blend and more makhani sauce. Cover with lid and cook on medium flame until cheese completely melts. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: Egg 65
instructions: For omelet: In large bowl add eggs, green chillies, ginger, salt, degi red chilli powder, coriander leaves, processed cheese, oil and mix everything well. In pan add oil, once hot add egg mixture and cover with lid. Cook for 4-5 minutes on medium flame. Cut into medium size cubes and keep aside. For ginger-garlic paste: In mortar pestle add green chillies, salt, garlic cloves, ginger and make coarse paste. Keep aside. For coating: In large bowl add prepared omelet cubes, ginger-garlic paste, curd, gram flour, cornstarch, rice flour, refined flour, asafoetida, degi red chilli powder, salt and coat everything well. Keep aside. For frying eggs: In kadai add oil, once hot add coated egg cubes and fry until half done. Transfer to absorbent paper. Re-fry egg cubes in smoky hot oil until golden in color and crispy in texture. Transfer to plate and keep aside. For tempering: In kadai add oil, once hot add curry leaves, dry kashmiri red chillies, ginger-garlic paste and saute it well. Add degi red chilli powder, fried egg cubes, curry leaves, tender coriander stem, crushed black peppercorns, salt, sugar, lemon juice and toss it well. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with coriander sprig and fried curry leaves. Serve hot.

name: Afghani Malai Kofta
instructions: For mawa kofta: In bowl add mawa, paneer and mix well until mushy with hands. Add boiled potato, green cardamom powder, salt, ginger, garlic, black peppercorn, coriander leaves, green chillies, raisins, almonds and knead into soft dough. Rest for 5-10 minutes. Take mixture, stuff with apricot and make lemon-sized balls or desired shape. Dust with refined flour and cornstarch. In kadai heat oil, drop kofta and fry until golden brown on medium flame. Transfer to absorbent sheet and keep aside. For paste: In bowl add fresh mint leaves, coriander leaves, cashew nuts, green chillies, oil, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cloves, black cardamom seeds, curd, onion and mix together. Transfer to grinder jar and grind into smooth paste. Add curd and mix well. Keep aside. For gravy: In kadai or sauce pot add oil, once hot add cinnamon stick, bay leaf, caraway seeds and let splutter. Add prepared paste and saute for 7-8 minutes or until cooked well. Add water and let cook for a minute. Finish gravy with green chillies. Transfer to serving dish and place fried koftas. Garnish with chili oil, fresh cream, crushed black peppercorn and coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti.

name: Lahori Malai Kofta
instructions: In large bowl add crumble paneer and potato and mash properly. Add desiccated coconut, salt, cardamom powder, black pepper powder and mix everything well to make smooth mixture. Divide into 6-8 equal portions and give each portion shape of ball. Take one ball and press gently between palms and flatten like pattie. Stuff the filling in center and wrap from all sides and give round shape ball. Prepare remaining kofta as well. Heat oil in kadai. Once hot, slide 3-4 balls and deep fry on medium hot oil. Fry until light golden in color and crisp from all sides. Drain on absorbent paper and set aside. For stuffing: In bowl add raisins, cashewnut, almonds, green chilli, ginger, coriander leaves, prepared paneer and potato mixture, salt, degi red chilli powder, roasted cumin powder, lemon juice and mix everything well. Keep aside. For cashew nut mixture: In bowl add cashew nut paste, ginger-garlic paste, oil and mix it well. Keep aside. For gravy: Heat ghee in kadai, add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves, and green cardamom. Add onion and saute on medium flame until light golden in color and soft in texture. Add prepared cashew nut mixture and keep sauting on medium flame. Add curd, turmeric powder, coriander powder, degi red chilli powder and saute it well. Add fresh tomato puree and cook on medium flame until oil starts to separate. Add salt, little water and cook for 5-7 minutes. Add koftas and mix gently. Cook on simmer for 1 minute. Transfer to serving bowl. Garnish with curd and coriander sprig. Serve hot.

name: Chinese Samosa
ingredients: bread slice sides chopped ¼ cup
coriander leaves with tender stem 3 tbsp
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add spring onion white part, green chillies, ginger and saute for a minute. Add carrot and cabbage, saute for 1-2 minutes. Add soya sauce, vinegar, sugar and mix well. Once veggies start sweating, add bread sides and saute for 2 minutes. Remove from flame and add coriander leaves and spring onion green part, mix well and let cool. Take bread slice, flatten with rolling pin, apply water. Keep filling in center, fold into triangle, seal edges and trim excess. Make rest of samosas. Fry in medium hot oil until golden brown from all sides. Serve hot with chai and tomato ketchup.

name: Mexican Style Tokri Chaat
ingredients: sweet corn kernels boiled ¼ cup
instructions: For salsa: In a bowl add green chilli, garlic, ginger, onion, tomato, salt, sugar, coriander leaves, tomato ketchup, sweet corn, rajma and mix well. For tokri: Take tortilla sheet, cut thrice at equal distance, place between two round spoons to form bowl shape, deep fry in hot oil on medium flame until golden brown. For masala: In a pan add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, dry red chilli, dry oregano, black peppercorns, salt and dry roast until fragrant. Cool and grind coarsely. For frying: Heat oil in kadai, add potato cubes, fry on medium flame until crispy and golden. Remove to absorbent paper. Transfer to bowl, add prepared masala mix well. Cut tortilla into strips, fry until crisp and golden, add to bowl with masala. For assembling: On serving plate add prepared salsa, place fried tokri on top, add curd, fried potato mixture, prepared salsa again, curd, sprinkle masala. Garnish with lemon wedge and coriander leaves.

name: Bombay Masala Sandwich
instructions: For potato masala: Heat oil in nonstick pan, add mustard seeds, curry leaves let splutter. Add boiled potato and mash well. Add asafoetida, turmeric powder, salt to taste and mix, cook few minutes. Add chopped green chilli, coriander leaves and green peas, mix well, cook 2 more minutes. Transfer to bowl. For green chutney: In grinder jar add ginger, green chilli, coriander leaves, mint leaves, ice cube, water as required and grind into smooth paste. Transfer to bowl, add salt to taste and chaat masala, mix well. For sandwich: Spread butter evenly on bread slices. Spread coriander chutney. Spread potato masala filling on bread. Place slices of onion, tomato, capsicum, beetroot. Sprinkle chaat masala, salt and cumin powder. Place cheese slice on top. Cover with slices with butter and chutney. In preheated grill pan with butter place sandwiches. Toast from both sides until crisp and golden. Remove and spread green chutney, grated cheese, sev on top. Cut into halves and serve with tomato ketchup and coriander chutney.

name: Soya Chaap Biryani
instructions: For marination: In a bowl add soya chaap, fried onion, kashmiri red chili powder, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste, curd, ghee, green chillies, shahi jeera, mint and coriander leaves. Marinate well and rest 5-10 minutes. For rice cooking: In handi add water, salt to boil. Add sella basmati rice, cook on high flame 2-3 minutes. Cover with lid and cook on low flame 8-10 minutes. Once rice is 60-70% cooked, strain and set aside. For biryani: In handi add oil, once hot add bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon, star anise, black peppercorns and let splutter. Add onions and saute until golden on moderate heat. Add ginger garlic paste, cook 1-2 minutes, add tomatoes and saute well. Add red chili powder, turmeric powder, shahi biryani masala, salt and saute masala well. Add marinated soya chaap, little water and saute on moderate heat. Layer cooked rice using flatten spoon, add mint, coriander leaves, kewra water and fried onion. Add saffron milk and seal edges with dough, cover with lid and cook on dum 10-15 minutes on low flame. Open lid, rest for few minutes before serving. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with coriander sprig, mint leaves, lemon wedge and fried onions. Serve hot with raita.

name: Masala Paneer Burger
ingredients: red chilli garlic paste soaked 1 tsp
instructions: For burger patty: In a large bowl add grated paneer, potato, ginger, garlic, green chilli. Add salt, pav bhaji masala and mix well. Add coriander leaves, cheese slice, bread crumb, sugar, mayonnaise and mix well. Refrigerate for 5 minutes. Remove and fry in hot oil from both sides until golden brown and crispy. For garlic chutney mayonnaise: In a bowl add mayonnaise and red chilli-garlic paste, mix well. For coating: In a bowl add gram flour, salt, water, curry leaves and make thick consistency batter. For toasted buns: In a pan add butter, once melted add pav bhaji masala, toast burger buns from both sides. For fresh salad: In a bowl add green chilli, onion, coriander leaves, salt, lemon juice and mix well. For assembling: Place french fries on serving plate, place toasted bottom bun. Spread garlic chutney mayonnaise. Place sliced cucumber, fresh salad, then fried patty, add more salad, green chutney, cheese slice, sliced tomato. Place top bun and secure with toothpick. Serve immediately.

name: chicken dalcha
ingredients: 250 gms chana dal, washed and soaked
instructions: Cook chana dal with turmeric, chilli powder, asafoetida, ghee and water in pressure cooker for 2-3 whistles. Make ginger-garlic paste from ginger, garlic and green chillies. Heat oil in pot, add cloves, peppercorns, cardamom, mace, bay leaf and cinnamon, let splutter. Add sliced onions, saute until translucent, add ginger-garlic paste and saute until golden. Remove half the onions. Add tomatoes, chicken, degi red chilli, coriander and cumin powders, cook 5-10 minutes. Add cooked dal, black peppers and water. Add tempering of oil, curry leaves, ginger, green chillies and coriander. Boil 2-3 minutes until chicken is cooked. Serve hot with rice or roti, garnished with fried onions, coriander and lemon.

name: high protein chana chaat
ingredients: 1/3 cup peanuts with skin, soaked overnight
instructions: Boil water with green chillies, ginger, salt, sugar, chilli powder, asafoetida, chickpeas, peanuts and soybean for 15-20 minutes with bouquet garni (tied spices). Strain and keep aside. Dry roast all spices separately for chaat masala, transfer to bowl, add asafoetida, dry mango powder, sugar, salt and dry ginger powder. Grind into fine powder. In large bowl, mix chopped ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves, onion, raw mango and tomato. Add boiled mixture, pomegranate pearls and lemon juice. Add prepared chaat masala and mix well. Add prepared tadka (oil heated with cumin seeds and button chillies). Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with pomegranate pearls, sev and coriander sprig.

name: mutton pulao
instructions: Marinate mutton with oil, degi red chilli powder, salt, dry red chillies, green chillies and onion for 30-60 minutes. Make curd mixture with curd, ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, turmeric powder, degi red chilli powder, fried onions and mint. Heat ghee in cooker, add cinnamon, cardamom, peppercorns and marinated mutton, saute on medium heat until light brown. Add curd mixture and saute until fragrant. Add water, close lid and give 3-5 whistles until 80% cooked. Cool cooker, add water, fried onions, mint and salt. Bring to boil. Add soaked basmati rice, mix once, close lid and give 2-3 whistles. Switch off, cool cooker. Remove lid, let rice rest 5-10 minutes. Serve hot garnished with mint.

name: rainbow cassata ice cream
instructions: For vanilla base: Mix hung curd and milkmaid well. Add fresh cream and fold using cut and fold method. Repeat with fresh cream. Divide into 4 equal parts. For kesar: Mix vanilla ice cream with saffron soaked in water. For beetroot: Mix vanilla ice cream with beetroot paste and tutti frutti. For pista: Mix vanilla ice cream with pistachio paste and tutti frutti. For coating: Crumb biscuits, add almonds and pistachios. For layering: In ice cream mold, layer beetroot mixture as base. Add saffron mixture as second layer. Add pistachio mixture as third layer. Top with vanilla mixture and level with spatula. Freeze overnight until set. Rinse mold with water, demold ice cream. Coat with biscuit-nut mixture on both sides. Cut into 4 parts. Serve on plate, garnish with milkmaid, whipped cream, candied cherry and mint. Serve cold.

name: liquid dough paratha
instructions: For liquid dough: Add flour, coriander leaves, ginger-garlic paste, salt, water, turmeric and ghee. Whisk well, rest 5 minutes. Heat non-stick pan, pour batter, spread evenly. Cook on low flame until colour changes, flip and cook other side. For paratha dough: Add flour, salt, water and knead semi-soft dough. Add ghee and knead. Sprinkle carom seeds, ghee, red chilli powder. Book fold and roll into square. Cook on pan 1 minute each side with ghee, press edges. Flip and cook until golden brown spots appear. Serve hot.

name: gram flour cheela
instructions: Make batter: Add gram flour, semolina, black salt, carom seeds, baking soda, oil, ginger-garlic paste, saffron water, curd. Add water, salt, oil. Make smooth batter, rest. For each cheela variation: pour batter onto heated tawa, add toppings (onion-chili, cheese, thread style, sandwich, or dosa style), cook both sides. Cheese cheela: fold at middle. Threaded: pour like net pattern. Sandwich: place two cheelas together. Dosa style: add multiple toppings, roll and cut. Serve hot with toppings.

name: dahi vade
instructions: Make batter: Blend millet, curd, sago into smooth paste. Add rock salt, sugar. Add soaked sago, green chilli, ginger, coriander, raisins. Mix fruit salt with oil, add to batter. Fry small portions in medium-hot oil until cooked inside. Dip into curd-water and soak 15-20 minutes. Make tadka: heat oil, splutter cumin seeds, add cashews, raisins, green chilli, peanuts. Arrange vades, top with curd mixture, green chutney, pomegranate, mint leaves and tadka.

name: vegetarian hot dog
instructions: Make sauce: Heat oil, sauté ginger, garlic, onion until golden. Add tomatoes, sauté until soft. Add salt, red chilli powder, vinegar, sugar, soaked chillies, water, ketchup. Cook 3-4 minutes, blend smooth. Make filling: Heat oil, sauté ginger, garlic, capsicum until charred. Add soya vadi powder, sauté until fragrant. Add soya mince, paneer, hot dog sauce. Finish with coriander. Assemble: Shape filling like sausage. Cut bun, apply mayonnaise and sauce. Heat pan with butter, cook filling until golden, toast bun. Assemble hot dog and top with cheese.

name: chicken tikka tawa pulao
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice 30 min. Make chilli paste from soaked kashmiri chillies, mustard oil, salt, garlic, ginger, coriander stem. Mix chilli paste with hung curd, spices, roasted gram flour. Marinate chicken in this mixture. Heat mustard oil and ghee in pan, fry chicken both sides until cooked. Remove chicken. Sauté vegetables with red chilli powder, garam masala, salt, add water, cook. Add vegetables to pan with chicken, cover. Place hot charcoal in katori, add butter, cover to smoke 8-10 minutes.
