Cook rice separately. Spread rice over chicken mixture, add butter, saffron, green chilli, coriander, cover. Cook 5-8 minutes. Serve on banana leaves sizzler.

name: veg crispy
instructions: Boil vegetables with salt, sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves until half done. Drain and coat with cornstarch, salt, and ginger-garlic paste. Prepare batter with cornstarch, flour, water, vinegar, and baking soda. Rest batter for 10 minutes, then add baking soda and oil. Deep fry coated vegetables in batter first until half done, remove and rest. Refry until golden and crisp. Temper sesame oil with ginger, coriander stem, and schezwan sauce, then toss fried vegetables in tempered sauce. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds, spring onion, and coriander.

name: raw mango and onion bhajiya
instructions: Roast coriander seeds, fennel seeds, and carom seeds lightly, then crush. Mix raw mango, spinach, onion with prepared masala, salt, turmeric, asafoetida, green chillies, and ginger-garlic paste. Let sit for 5-10 minutes. Heat oil in kadhai. Add gram flour, rice flour, and baking soda to mixture and mix well. Fry small portions in medium-hot oil until golden brown. Serve with chutney made from tender coriander and mint stems, raw mango, green chillies, ginger, onion, and salt.

name: gobi musallam
instructions: Remove outer leaves and trim cauliflower stem to allow it to sit upright. Boil water with salt and turmeric. Gently drop whole cauliflower in boiling water with cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, black cardamom, deggi chilli powder, and ghee. Boil for 5 minutes, flip, and boil for another 5 minutes or steam until al dente. Cool. Mix green chutney with sutta flour and stuff gaps in cauliflower. Prepare gravy by mixing curd, water, coriander powder, turmeric, deggi chilli, asafoetida, and salt. In kadai, heat ghee, add whole spices, then curd mixture and cook properly. Add cashew paste and strain. Place cauliflower on baking tray, pour gravy over, and bake at preheated oven for 15-20 minutes.

name: methi chole masala
instructions: Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with water, salt, cinnamon, bay leaf, dry red chillies, and tea leaves for 4-5 whistles. Make ginger-garlic paste by grinding ginger, garlic, and green chilli. Heat oil in kadai, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent. Add kashmiri chilli powder and coriander powder. Add tomato puree and cook well. Add chole masala and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add fresh fenugreek leaves and tomato, sauté well. Add chole water and cook until thick. Add cooked chickpeas and mix well, mash some chickpeas. Add ghee and water as needed. Add green chillies, coriander leaves, and julienned ginger. Finish and serve with onion, tomato, and lemon wedges.

name: hyderabadi baghaar e baingan
instructions: Roast peanuts for 1 minute, add grated coconut and continue roasting for 1 minute, then add sesame seeds and roast until proper. Cool and grind into fine powder. Roast coriander seeds and cumin seeds until fragrant, then grind into fine powder. Deep fry eggplants halved lengthwise in kadai with oil until light golden and cooked, remove on absorbent paper. Heat peanut oil, add curry leaves, cumin seeds, and onion seeds, let crackle and set aside. In fresh kadai, heat peanut oil, add green chillies and charred onion paste, sauté for 1 minute. Add ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, powdered masala, and curd, continue sautéing for 2 minutes. Add ground peanut-coconut-sesame powder and sauté until fragrant. Add curry leaves, salt, and water, cook for 4-5 minutes. Add tamarind pulp and jaggery, stir and cook for 1-2 minutes. Pour gravy on serving plate, place fried eggplants, and pour hot tempering over.

name: bihari fish curry
instructions: Make paste by grinding yellow mustard seeds, black mustard seeds, turmeric, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, garlic, green chillies, black peppercorns with mustard oil and water. Marinate rohu fish pieces with salt, turmeric, and degi chilli powder in mustard oil. Heat mustard oil in kadai and shallow fry marinated fish for 3-4 minutes until 70% cooked. In the same oil, add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add tomatoes and coriander leaves, sauté for 1 minute. Add prepared paste and cook well. Add degi chilli powder and turmeric, mix well. Add water and salt to taste, add green chillies, and let simmer. Add coriander leaves and tomato, add fried fish, and cook for 5-7 minutes on low flame. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with rice.

name: aloo mirch masala
instructions: Make ginger-garlic paste by grinding ginger, garlic cloves, and green chilli. Prepare curd mixture by beating curd with turmeric, degi chilli powder, coriander powder, and asafoetida. Heat oil in heavy-bottom pan, add cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, and onion seeds, let splutter. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add bhavnagri chillies slit in half with salt and sear for 2-3 minutes. Add tomato and sauté. Add water and cook well. Add prepared curd mixture and sauté well. Add boiled and peeled potatoes cut into quarters and mix. Sprinkle water, cover with lid and cook for 6-7 minutes. Finish with coriander leaves and ghee. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with roti.

name: railway vegetable cutlet
ingredients: white bread crumb 1 cup for coating
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add ginger and green chilli, saute well. Add beetroot and carrot, saute 2-3 minutes. Add french beans, salt, green peas, turmeric, red chilli powder, mix well and cook 2-3 minutes. Add mashed potatoes, mix well and cook. Transfer to bowl, cool to room temperature. Add bread crumb and coriander leaves, mix well. Divide into equal portions, shape into diamond shapes. For coating: Mix refined flour, red chilli powder, salt with water to make slurry. Coat shaped cutlets with slurry then breadcrumb coating. Heat oil in deep pan, shallow fry cutlets turning sides until golden brown and cooked. Garnish with onion rings and mint, serve hot.

name: chole puri
instructions: For masala: In large pot, heat ghee, add green cardamom, peppercorns, cumin, let splutter. Add onion, saute until light pink. Add salt, coriander powder, red chilli powder, asafoetida, turmeric, saute well. Add coriander leaves, little water, cook 2-4 minutes. Add tomato, mix well, cook until softened. Once ghee separates, cool masala and grind into smooth paste. For tempering: Heat ghee, add green chillies, ginger, garlic, saute well. Add black chana, saute 1 minute. Add sugar, salt, saute, cover and cook 5 minutes. Add fenugreek leaves, red chilli powder, asafoetida, black pepper, saute well. Add prepared masala, saute on medium flame. Add water, mix, cover and cook. Mash few chanas to thicken gravy. Garnish with coriander and pomegranate. For dough: Knead wheat flour, salt, ghee with water into tight dough. Cover and rest. Pinch lemon-size ball, roll into slightly thick round. Heat oil in kadai, fry puri pressing until puffs up, flip and fry golden. For salad: Mix onion, tomato, green chillies, lemon juice, salt.

name: pav bhaji frankie
instructions: For boiling vegetables: In pressure cooker, add cauliflower, potato, carrot, green peas, butter, salt, water, mix well. Cover and cook 2-3 whistles. Mash vegetables with masher, keep aside. For tempering: In shallow pan, add butter and oil, heat well, add onions and saute. Add ginger garlic paste, saute, add red chilli powder, saute well. Add tomato, salt, cook 1-2 minutes. Add green chilli, pav bhaji masala, saute. Add boiled vegetables, mix well. Add more pav bhaji masala, capsicum, tomato, mix. Cook well, add butter, stir. Add coriander leaves, cook 3-4 minutes. For dough: In bowl, add refined flour, oil, water, knead well into smooth semi-soft dough. Apply oil, cover with muslin cloth, rest 10-15 minutes. Divide into lemon-size balls, roll into roti. For roasting roti: Heat oil in pan, place roti, roast 50% on both sides. For salad: Mix onion, green chillies, coriander leaves, lemon juice, salt. For assembling: In pan add butter, heat, place roti, cook on both sides. Transfer to plate. Place pav bhaji filling on roti, add salad, grated cheese, sprinkle pav bhaji masala and roll. Serve on platter, garnish with coriander.

name: melting chicken burger
instructions: Pound chicken breast to even thickness. Mix with ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper and marinate 15 minutes. In shallow pan, heat oil. Pan-sear marinated chicken until cooked through and golden on both sides, about 5-6 minutes per side. Place cooked chicken between two cheese slices to allow melting. Toast burger buns in butter until golden. Spread mayonnaise on toasted bun bases. Layer with lettuce, tomato slice, onion slice, green chilli. Place cheese-topped chicken patty on prepared base. Top with coriander and close with bun top. Serve immediately while cheese is melted.

name: chicken cutlet
instructions: In a bowl mix chicken mince with ginger-garlic paste, green chillies, salt, degi red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder, mustard oil, coriander leaves, lemon juice, and fresh bread crumbs. Shape into portions. Coat with refined flour, then egg, then bread crumbs. Heat oil in pan and fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Remove and rest 3-4 minutes. Serve with fresh salad.

name: mutton kofta curry
instructions: Mix mutton mince with cashew nut paste, fried onions, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, salt, ginger-garlic-green chilli paste, roasted gram flour, and bread. Grind into fine paste. Make lemon-sized balls and deep fry until browned outside but raw inside. For curd mixture: combine curd, fried onions, spices, ginger-garlic-green chilli paste, green chillies, and mint. For curry: heat oil and add whole spices, then add ghee, ginger, chilli, garlic, onion, coconut. Add curd mixture and cook until oil separates. Add water and koftas, cook covered 10-12 minutes. Blend curry, strain. Add cashew paste, rose water, kewra water, and koftas back. Cook 5-7 minutes. Garnish with coriander and cream.

name: desi style instant noodles
instructions: Boil water in deep pan and add instant noodles. Cook 4-5 minutes. Transfer noodles to bowl, mix with oil, and set aside. In remaining broth add carrot, ginger, broccoli, spring onion, green chillies, coriander stems, soy sauce, sugar, and vinegar. Add red chilli sauce and cook 5 minutes. Add soft boiled egg and cook with broth. Add noodles and stir well. Transfer to serving dish with broth. Garnish with coriander leaves and spring onion. Serve hot.

name: eggless pineapple french toast
instructions: Apply pineapple jam to bread slice and place another slice on top to make sandwich. For batter: mix fresh cream, powdered sugar, vanilla essence, refined flour, and milk into semi-liquid consistency. Heat butter on flat pan. Dip bread sandwich in batter and place on pan. Cook on low heat until light golden or crispy as desired. Remove to plate. For caramelized banana: cut small banana lengthwise with skin, sprinkle sugar, place on hot pan with butter, caramelize both sides. Serve french toast warm with caramelized banana, fresh fruits, and garnish with powdered sugar and mint leaves.

name: Gobi Paratha
instructions: 1. Grate 300g cauliflower florets and 1 inch ginger into a bowl. 2. Mix 2 cups wheat flour with 2 tsp oil and 1/2 tsp salt, knead soft dough with water, cover for 20-25 minutes. 3. Heat pan, add 2 tsp oil, splutter cumin seeds, add asafoetida, turmeric, coriander powder, green chilly, sauté. 4. Add grated cauliflower-ginger mixture, salt, red chilly powder, garam masala, dry mango powder, green coriander. Cook 2-3 minutes, transfer to plate. 5. Grease hands with oil, knead dough, pinch portions and smoothen into peda shape, dust with flour. 6. Roll into 3-4 inch diameter circle, place 2 tsp cauliflower stuffing in center. 7. Lift edges and close filling, flatten gently by pressing. 8. Dust with flour and roll into 5-6 inch diameter parantha. 9. Heat tawa with oil, place parantha, roast until golden. Flip, apply oil, flip again, apply oil, press with spatula. 10. Roast on medium-low flame until brown spots appear on both sides. 11. Transfer to plate and repeat with remaining dough. Serve hot with pickle, chutney, raita, or sabzi.

name: Dal Meat
instructions: Marinate mutton with bones with curd, sliced onion, ginger-garlic paste, salt and mustard oil for 10-15 minutes. Heat ghee in large pot, add onion and saute until light golden. Add marinated mutton and saute for 5 minutes. Add black cardamom, bay leaf and cinnamon stick. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder and coriander powder, saute well. Cook for 5 minutes more. Add soaked chana dal, ghee and saute. Add water as required, cover and cook until mutton is completely done. Add prepared tadka and hot water, mix well. Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Add coriander leaves and mix. Garnish with coriander sprig, green chilli, lemon wedge and ginger julienne. Serve hot with paratha.

name: Potato Nuggets
instructions: Type 1: Heat butter and oil, add garlic and chilli flakes, saute. Add water and sugar with salt, add grated potatoes and cook on medium flame for 2-3 minutes. Add rice flour and butter, cook well. Add boiled grated potato and mix. Cool in refrigerator. Mix cooked mixture with boiled grated potatoes, bread crumbs, baking powder, baking soda, black pepper powder and pizza cheese. Shape into bite-size portions. Heat oil, coat shaped nuggets in seasoned flour, dip in slurry, coat with bread crumbs. Fry on medium to high until golden on all sides. Remove on absorbent paper. Type 2: Similar process with different proportions. For Schezwan style: add schezwan sauce to fried nuggets type 2 and toss with spring onion. Garnish and serve hot with ketchup.

name: Eggless Cooker Cake
instructions: Add 1 cup rock salt in pressure cooker and place wire stand in bottom. Close lid, remove whistle and heat on medium-high flame. In large mixing bowl add butter and oil, whip for a minute until mixed. Add condensed milk and whip once. Add powdered sugar and whip until thick and fluffy. Add curd and vanilla essence, mix well. Add semolina, sieve refined flour and mix everything well with air incorporated. In small bowl add oil, baking soda and baking powder, mix well and transfer to main mixture, mix. Add milk and whisk to ensure no lumps. Coating consistency batter is ready. Stick parchment paper to cake tin with butter, pour batter inside. Place tin in cooker using tongs, close lid. Adjust heat to medium-low and bake for 40-45 minutes without whistle. Check with toothpick for doneness. For soaking: mix milk, salt and toffee sauce, apply on warm cake. Spread toffee sauce evenly and garnish with fresh chopped strawberry, mint leaves and dust with icing sugar. Serve.

name: Masala Cheese Toast
instructions: Make filling by mixing chopped green chillies, ginger, tomato, coriander and grated pizza cheese with oil. Mix mayonnaise and green chutney for spread. Prepare batter by whisking besan, milk, mayo, salt and spices. Take 4 bread slices, apply mayo-chutney spread on all sides, add filling and place another slice on top to make sandwich. Heat oil in pan, dip sandwich in egg-free batter, coat with poha and place in hot pan. Cook on both sides until light brown and crisp. Serve with side salad of onion, cabbage, tomato, coriander and green chilli.

name: Purple Yam Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup purple yam, boiled and mashed
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a pan. Add mashed boiled yam and mix well. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Add sugar and mix. Add condensed milk and combine everything together. Turn off flame and add cream cheese, mix well. Let pudding cool down. For assembling, take a ramekin mould and add cream cheese at the bottom. Top with prepared yam pudding. Sprinkle biscuit crumbs on top. Garnish with kiwi slices, plum slices and mint sprig. Serve chilled.

name: Spicy Idli Chaat
instructions: Deep fry cut idlis until golden and crispy. Deep fry julienned idli until golden brown and crispy. In a pan add ghee, fried ginger, asafoetida, chilli powder, water and simmer for a minute. Mix onion, pomegranate, oil, green chilli, salt in a bowl. Mix curd, powdered sugar, salt in another bowl. Assemble by layering: soaked idlis, onion mixture, curd mixture, green chutney, sweet and sour chutney. Top with sev, chilli powder, cumin powder, crushed fried idli and coriander.

name: Veg Kimchi Fried Rice
instructions: For kimchi: dice cabbage and salt for sweating. Squeeze out water with kitchen towel. Mix with kimchi paste, vinegar, ketchup in airtight container. For rice: boil water with salt, add soaked rice and cook until 80% done. Strain and set aside. For kimchi paste: grind dried red chillies, garlic, ginger, rice flour slurry into coarse paste. For slurry: cook water with rice flour, salt, sugar until thick. For final dish: heat oil in wok, add ginger and garlic, saute well. Add baby corn and mushrooms, toss on medium flame. Add soy sauce, kimchi, ketchup and saute. Add cooked rice and toss well. Add salt and spring onion bulb and mix. Garnish with spring onion, sesame seeds, kimchi and coriander. Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Jalfrezi
instructions: In a kadai add ghee and cumin seeds. Add onion and ginger-garlic paste and cook properly. Add tomato and cook until soft, add water and continue cooking. Add carrot, cover lid and cook until half done. Add cabbage and cook. Add butter, salt, black pepper, cumin powder, red chilli powder and saute well. Add all vegetables (french beans, tomato cubes, onion cubes, capsicum) and cook properly. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, green peas, paneer and toss well. Finish with coriander leaves. Serve with roti or rice.

name: Bohri Kaju Chicken
instructions: In a grinder, add green chillies, ginger, garlic, salt and water, grind into a smooth thin paste. Marinate the chicken and keep in the refrigerator for 10-15 minutes. In a pan, heat oil and add garlic and cloves, mix well. Add marinated chicken, mix well and cook for 5-6 minutes. Add ¼ cup water and cook the chicken about 90%. As water reduces, add kaju paste, mix well. Add water as required for the gravy. Garnish with boiled egg slices and coriander leaves.

name: No Bake Cheesecake
instructions: In a large bowl, add cream cheese, hung curd, whipping cream and half the sugar. Beat using electric blender at medium-high speed until smooth. Add lemon zest and mix well. Soak agar agar in water for 5 minutes. In a pan, add water and soaked agar agar and mix well. Add sugar and mix, then add strawberry puree and switch off flame. Let cool to room temperature. Pour into cream cheese mixture and mix well. Pour over biscuit crust and refrigerate for 1-1.5 hours until firm. Remove from refrigerator and place on cooling rack. Place OHP sheet in center and pour melted chocolate evenly over cheesecake, covering all sides. Garnish with dragon fruit, fresh mint leaves, cocoa powder, icing sugar and pomegranate pearls. For base: crush biscuits, melt butter, mix with crumbs until coated, press into cake tin, chill for 10 minutes.

name: Kolkata Style Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 1 cup saffron water or yellow colour
instructions: For marinating: Mix chicken with curd, ghee, ginger-garlic paste, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, fried onion, green chilli and salt. Rest for 10 minutes. For frying: Heat oil, add green cardamom and mace, fry soaked potatoes and hard-boiled eggs until crisp and golden, keep eggs separate. For biryani masala: Dry roast shahi jeera, black peppercorns, green cardamom, black cardamom, mace, cloves, cinnamon stick, fennel seeds, nutmeg until fragrant, cool and grind. For chicken: Heat remaining oil, sauté onion until light golden, add marinated chicken and fried potatoes, sauté for 4-5 minutes. Add water and cook until 80% done, strain gravy. For rice: Boil water with spice potli (cinnamon, fennel, cardamom, star anise, peppercorns), add soaked rice and cook until 70% done, strain. For layering: In heavy-bottom pan, layer chicken, potatoes with gravy, boiled rice, saffron water, fried onion and biryani masala. Cover with lid and dum-cook for 15-20 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Kung Pao Chilli Potato
ingredients: 2 dry red chillies cut and deseeded
½ tsp pink peppercorns or sichuan peppercorns
instructions: In a bowl, add diced boiled potatoes, corn-starch, black pepper powder and salt, toss well with light hands. Keep for 5-10 minutes. Heat oil on medium heat and fry potatoes until golden brown on all sides, drain on absorbent paper. In a wok, heat oil and add ginger, garlic, star anise, dry red chillies and pink peppercorns. Sauté until translucent. Add cashew nuts, soya sauce, capsicum, red chilli sauce and tomato ketchup, cook for a minute. Add water and corn-starch slurry gradually, cook until semi-thick. Add fried potatoes and toss for 2-3 minutes. Switch off flame and finish with diced spring onion. Serve hot immediately.

name: Makai Moong Dal
ingredients: ¼ tsp degi red chilli powder
¼ tsp degi red chilli powder
instructions: In pressure cooker, add moong dal, salt, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ghee and water. Cover with lid and cook for 2 whistles or until dal is cooked well. In mortar-pestle, add green chillies, ginger and salt, grind into smooth paste. In deep pot or handi, add oil, once it's hot, add coriander seeds, cumin seeds and onion seeds and let them splutter. Add beaten curd and mix well, add ginger-green chilli paste and asafoetida and sauté well. Add turmeric powder and degi red chilli powder and stir well. Add sweet corn kernels and salt to taste, mix well. Add water and boiled dal and cook on medium flame for 5-10 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl. For tempering: In tadka pan, heat oil and ghee, once hot, add dry red chillies, chopped coriander leaves and degi red chilli powder and mix well. Pour the prepared tadka into the dal. Serve hot with steamed rice, garnished with coriander sprigs.

name: Iced Tea
instructions: For black tea base: Boil water with peppercorns, fennel seeds, mint stems and salt. Add tea leaves and boil a few minutes. Add sugar and let boil. Cool to room temperature or chill. For oolong tea: Boil water and pour over oolong tea leaves in a jar, let brew, then cool. For green tea: Same as oolong. For lemon iced tea: In a glass, add lemon juice, sliced lime, mint leaves and sugar, muddle well. Add ice cubes and brewed black tea. Garnish with mint and lemon slice. Serve chilled. For peach iced tea: Muddle lemon juice, peach and sugar. Add ice and brewed black tea. Garnish with peach and mint. For watermelon iced tea: Muddle ginger and sugar, then add watermelon and honey, crush well. Add lemon juice, basil seeds, watermelon, ice and brewed oolong tea. Garnish and serve.

name: Dahi Vada Papdi Chaat
instructions: For fried bread masala: Cut bread edges and fry until golden. Toss with red chili powder, asafoetida, chaat masala and salt. For dahi bhalle: Soak bread slices in water, apply curd, shape into balls and flatten. Fry until golden. For papdi: Apply curd and green chutney to one bread slice, sprinkle spices on another, close like sandwich, roll slightly and cut into halves. Fry until crisp. For chaat masala: Dry roast spices, cool and grind coarsely. Assemble by spreading curd and chaat masala in a dish, add papdi, dahi bhalle, chutneys. Garnish with sev, pomegranate and coriander.

name: Kaju Paneer Masala
instructions: Blanch cashews for 4-5 minutes. Grind blanched cashews with salt, curd and green chili into smooth paste. Heat ghee and oil, fry paneer cubes until light golden. In same oil, fry cashew nuts until golden. In a pot, heat ghee and oil, add bay leaf, cloves, peppercorns and green cardamom. Add onion and sauté until light golden. Add green chili and ginger-garlic paste, sauté 4-5 minutes. Add turmeric, coriander powder and sauté. Add chopped tomato and sauté. Add cashew paste and water. Add salt, sugar and kasuri methi. Cover and cook 7 minutes on low. Add fried cashews and paneer, give one boil. Serve hot with roti or naan.

name: Eggless Cupcakes
instructions: For vanilla cupcakes: Mix refined flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add milk maid, melted butter, water, vanilla essence and lemon juice. Whisk until smooth. Pour into lined muffin tray. For chocolate cupcakes: Mix flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda and baking powder. Add melted butter, milk maid, lemon juice, vanilla and water. Whisk until combined. Pour into lined muffin tray. Bake at 180°C for 12-15 minutes. For filling: Prepare mango, strawberry and coffee fillings by mixing each with milk maid. Cut cupcake tops and scoop centers. Pour fillings into cupcakes. For icing: Mix water, icing sugar and lemon juice and whisk well. Top cupcakes with icing. Decorate with crumbled cupcake, melted chocolate, chocolate sprinkles and whipped cream.

name: Poha Vada
instructions: In a bowl, add pressed rice and water, wash well. Transfer washed rice to a large bowl and mash. In a tadka pan, add oil, chana dal and mustard seeds, let splutter. Add fennel seeds, urad dal and curry leaves, pour into the bowl. Add onion, ginger, green chili, sugar and salt. Mix well. Add a little curd and mix. Take a spoonful mixture, make a tikki and flatten slightly. Heat oil in a shallow pan. Once hot, slide vada into oil. Once slightly golden, turn over. Fry on medium flame until cooked through. Remove on kitchen tissue. Fry again until evenly crisp and golden. Drain on kitchen tissue. For chutney: In a grinder, add raw mango, ginger, spring onion, coriander leaves and oil, grind smooth. Add curd, black pepper and sugar, mix. Serve vada with green chutney and fresh salad.

name: tandoori paneer cutlet roll
ingredients: ghee 0.5 tsp and 1 tsp for frying
instructions: Make paneer cutlet by mixing crumbled paneer, mashed potatoes, spices, green chillies, ginger and fenugreek leaves. Form into rectangle shapes. For paratha, take dough portion, roll out, cut halfway, apply ghee and flour, roll into cone shape, close bottom, dust flour and roll into small roti. Half-cook on greased hot pan. Make salad with sliced onions, lemon juice, coriander leaves, green chillies, chilli powder and salt. Mix hung curd with chilli powder, cumin powder and salt for spread. Blend coriander, mint, onion, ginger, green chillies and salt for green chutney. Heat oil and fry paneer cutlets until golden and crispy. Cook paratha on hot pan with ghee until golden and crispy. Assemble by placing paratha on plate, spread curd spread in centre, place fried paneer cutlet, add salad, green chutney, coriander leaves and poha chivda, then roll and serve immediately.

name: cheesy hasselback potato
instructions: Slice potatoes as thinly as possible but not all the way through, leave 0.5 inch on bottom. Blanch potatoes in boiling water for 2 minutes. Remove and let cool, then insert sliced cheese between potato slices. Place on baking tray and add sliced green chillies between slices, add coriander and mint leaves. Sprinkle red chilli flakes and more sliced cheese. Bake in preheated oven at 175°C for 20-25 minutes until cooked. Remove and let rest. Spread mayonnaise on serving plate, place baked potato, spread more mayonnaise on top, place salad on it and garnish with chilli powder. For salad, mix onion rings, bell peppers, coriander leaves, chaat masala and chilli powder. Serve immediately.

name: sindhi dal pakwan
ingredients: ghee 0.5 tbsp for cooking dal and 3-4 tbsp for finishing
oil 1 tsp and 2 tbsp for tempering
instructions: For dal: In pressure cooker add chana dal, salt, ghee, green chilli, black peppercorns and water. Cover and cook 3-4 whistles on moderate heat. For dough: Mix refined flour, semolina, salt, cumin seeds, carom seeds and oil. Add water and make smooth dough, rest covered. Apply oil and knead well. Divide into lemon-size balls and roll thin rotis. Dock with fork. For green chutney: Add green chilli, ginger, mint, coriander, raw mango, jaggery, oil, asafoetida, dry mango powder and salt, grind to smooth paste. For tempering: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, green chilli, ginger, dry red chillies and coriander stems, saute 1 minute. Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, chilli powder, mix well and pour onto cooked dal. For finishing: Add dal to kadai with warm water, salt and cook 7-8 minutes. Add dry mango powder and ghee. For frying: Heat oil in kadai, fry rotis until golden on both sides. Serve dal with pakwan, green chutney, tamarind chutney and onion tomato salad.

name: pasta pizza
ingredients: degi red chilli powder 1 tsp and pinch
pizza cheese blend 0.25 cup and extra
instructions: Boil water with salt, add pasta and cook 11 minutes stirring occasionally. Strain and keep aside. Add olive oil and mix well. In a bowl, add grated tomatoes, oregano, chilli flakes and tomato ketchup, mix well. Heat olive oil in pan, add garlic and onion, saute until translucent. Add tomato mixture with chilli powder and cook on medium flame 4-5 minutes. Add salt and mix well. In bowl add sweet corn, bell peppers, salt, chilli powder, green chilli, oregano and olive oil, mix well. In non-stick pan add oil and spread boiled pasta evenly. Cover with lid and cook 3 minutes to form crust. Spread tomato sauce over base. Add cheese blend. Add tomato sauce and spread evenly, cover and cook 2-3 minutes. Add cheese, topping and more cheese on top. Cover and cook until cheese melts on low flame, place another hot pan on top to melt cheese. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: veg seekh kebab
ingredients: chana dal 1 cup soaked and boiled
ghee 1 tbsp and as needed for brushing
instructions: For kebab masala: Add black cardamom, green cardamom, mace, black peppercorns and salt to blender and blend to smooth powder. For kebab mixture: Blend soy granules into fine powder. Blend chana dal into smooth paste without water. Heat ghee in non-stick pan, add ginger and green chilli, saute 1 minute. Add chopped vegetables, turmeric, coriander powder, cumin powder and saute 2-3 minutes. Add grated boiled potato, adjust salt and mix well. Transfer to mixing bowl, add soy granules powder and kebab masala, mix well. Keep aside 30 minutes. Shape mixture into long flat tubes onto ice-cream sticks or wooden skewers. Place on hot greased grill pan and cook 2-3 minutes on medium flame until golden brown and crisp on all sides. Brush with ghee if required. For chutney: In blender add cucumber, capsicum, onion, green chilli, mint, coriander, salt and lime juice, blend to smooth paste. Arrange cooked kebabs on serving plate. Serve with chutney, onion rings and mint, coriander leaves.

name: aloo palak masala
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add coriander seeds, garlic and saute until golden. Add potatoes and saute 3-4 minutes. Add turmeric, salt, red chili powder and water. Cover and cook 4-5 minutes. Add green garlic leaves and gram flour. Add water, spinach paste and ghee, simmer until blended. Prepare tadka separately: heat oil, add cumin, garlic, dry red chillies, fenugreek leaves, tomatoes and salt, cook 1 minute. Add tadka to curry, transfer to serving bowl and serve hot with roti.

name: masala omelette with potato fries
instructions: For potatoes: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and splutter. Add ginger and garlic, saute on medium flame. Add potatoes, salt, turmeric and saute well. Add green chilli, cover with lid and cook on medium flame until done. For omelette: Break eggs and beat well. Add coriander leaves and mix. In pan, add butter, onion, green chili and saute. Add tomatoes and beaten eggs, mix well and cook medium flame on both sides. For charred tomato: Cut tomato in half, season with salt, add oil to pan and cook until brown.

name: french fries chaat
instructions: Cut potatoes into square shape. Using chopsticks or pencils, cut potatoes into thin fries. Soak in salt water 5-10 minutes. For alternate method: slice potatoes into rectangles, cut 3-4 pieces lengthwise with skewers on sides, make crosswise cuts without cutting through, flip and make diagonal cuts. Stretch potatoes with forks. Sprinkle cornstarch evenly, tap to remove excess. Heat oil in shallow pan, fry wedges until golden and crisp. Fry cut potatoes until golden. Plate wedges, add mayonnaise, ketchup, oregano, chili flakes, cheese and prepared potato. Sprinkle black pepper, chili flakes, cheese, degi chili powder, green chili and coriander. Serve hot.

name: khandeshi kala masala chicken
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thigh and drumstick cuts
instructions: Char onions over direct flame until dark. Char dry coconut until dark. Dry roast coriander seeds on low flame, add spices and roast until aromatic. Add charred coconut and roast well. Blend roasted onion, coriander leaves, roasted spices, garlic, ginger, tomato with salt, turmeric and chili powder into smooth paste. Marinate chicken with chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, salt and oil. Heat oil, add wet masala and saute until oil separates. Add gram flour and water, cook until oil separates. Heat oil in large pot, add bay leaf, onion, green chili and saute. Add salt and marinated chicken, cook on medium. Add water and cover 5 minutes. Add cooked masala and hot water, bring to boil. Cover and cook until chicken is tender. Simmer until gravy releases oil on top. Garnish with coriander and serve hot with jowar bhakri.

name: masala potato shakshuka
instructions: Heat oil, add ginger garlic paste and saute 1 minute. Add onion and curry leaves, saute well. Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder and mix. Add fresh tomato puree, cook 5 minutes. Add frying potatoes and mix well. Add water and cover, cook on medium flame. Add salt and mix. Heat butter in small non-stick pan, add potato mixture. Add cheese blend and whole eggs, cover with lid and cook 5-8 minutes until eggs are done. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: cooker wali aloo ki sabji
instructions: In mortar pestle, crush green chillies and ginger with salt. In cooker, heat ghee and add cumin seeds, crushed chilli-ginger, asafoetida, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and saute 1 minute. Add tomatoes and saute until fragrant and soft. Add potatoes, ghee and water, stir once and put lid on. Give 2-3 whistles then switch off and let cool. Remove lid and mash some potatoes with masher. Boil for 1 minute. Add coriander leaves and lemon juice. Switch off flames. Serve hot in bowl, garnish with coriander and lemon wedges.

name: kathal masala sabji
ingredients: 1 ½ tbsp byadgi red chili powder
instructions: Apply mustard oil on hands, knife and board. Cut jackfruit in half, remove white core and separate pods from skin, cut into cubes. Keep in salted water to prevent discoloration. Rinse well before use. In sauce pot, add water, salt and turmeric, bring to boil. Add jackfruit pods and cook 10-15 minutes until half done. Drain and keep aside. In mortar pestle, crush ginger, garlic and green chili into coarse mixture. In kadai, add oil and fry boiled jackfruit until light golden brown. In handi, add oil and bay leaf, add ginger-garlic paste and saute 5-10 seconds. Add onion and saute until translucent. Add curd, coriander powder, byadgi red chili powder and mix. Add fried jackfruit and water, stir well. Add garam masala, salt, sugar and saute 1 minute. Add lemon juice and coriander leaves. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander and serve hot with roti.

name: dahi kebab sizzler
ingredients: degi red chilli powder a pinch
instructions: For dahi kebab: Mix hung curd, ginger, green chillies, brown onion, cashew, raisins, coriander leaves, paneer, roasted gram flour, black peppercorns and salt. Make lemon-sized balls and coat with bread crumbs. Shallow fry until golden. For tomato chutney: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, fennel seeds, onion seeds, ginger, green chillies, tomatoes, salt, jaggery, vinegar and degi red chilli powder. Cook 1 minute. For pea pulao: Melt butter, add cumin seeds, green peas, water, coriander leaves, cooked rice, green chilli, black pepper and salt. Toss well. For assembly: On hot sizzler plate, place cabbage leaves, pea pulao, tomato chutney, mint chutney, dahi kebab. Top with tomato chutney and coriander sprig. Garnish with butter and serve hot.

name: chicken bhuna masala
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, ghee, degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice. Dry roast coriander seeds, black peppercorns, cloves, black cardamom, green cardamom, shahi jeera until aromatic. Grind into fine powder. For seared chicken: Heat oil and ghee, add marinated chicken, sear from all sides. For bhuna: Heat oil and ghee, add bay leaf, black peppercorns, cloves, onions, sauté until light brown. Add water, seared chicken, cook 4-5 mins. Add curd and prepared masala powder, coriander leaves, mix well. Once nicely cooked, serve hot with roti. Garnish with coriander sprig, tomato wedges, green chilli.

name: imli chicken
instructions: Prepare paste: Add coriander stems, ginger, garlic, onions, salt to mixer grinder, grind into smooth paste. Marinate chicken: Add chicken to bowl with degi red chilli powder, asafoetida, turmeric powder, coriander powder, mustard oil, salt. Marinate 10-15 mins. Roast chicken: Heat mustard oil and oil, add marinated chicken and dry red chillies, cook until tender. Transfer to plate. For imli chicken: Heat mustard oil and oil, add black peppercorns, cloves, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, splutter. Add prepared paste and ghee, sauté 7-8 mins on moderate heat. Add roasted chicken, mix well. Add tamarind pulp, degi red chilli powder, sugar, water, stir well. Cover and cook 10-15 mins on moderate heat. Add coriander leaves, ginger, ghee, salt. Give quick boil. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti.

name: Amritsari Murgh
instructions: Mix and marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, dry fenugreek leaves, coriander powder, red chili powder, turmeric, ghee, salt and curd for 20-30 minutes. In a pan, roast black peppercorns, coriander seeds, cardamom, cloves, fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds and mustard seeds until fragrant, then grind into powder. In a cast iron, heat oil and roast marinated chicken until tender from both sides. In a handi, heat oil and sauté bay leaves, green chillies and chopped onions until golden. Add prepared masala powder and chopped tomatoes, sauté well. Add water, curd and salt, then add roasted chicken and mix. Cook 10-12 minutes on moderate heat. Finish with butter and coriander leaves. Serve hot with roti.

name: Corn Chaat (Multiple Styles)
instructions: For corn on cob: In a pressure cooker add water, dry red chillies, ginger, coriander roots, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, black peppercorns, coriander seeds, salt, sugar and butter with corn pieces. Close lid and give 1-2 whistles, let cool. For South Indian style: Toast cumin seeds, coriander seeds, red chillies, chana dal, urad dal until golden, add curry leaves and salt. Grind into powder. Remove corn kernels and toss with coconut, curry leaves, reserved water and butter, sprinkle gun powder powder. For Italian style: Remove corn kernels and heat with reserved water, butter, chili flakes, dried oregano, fresh oregano and black pepper. Serve with grated cheese. For regular chaat: Mix corn kernels with onion, tomato, green chillies, coriander leaves, black salt, chaat masala and olive oil.

name: Aloo Paratha Nachos
instructions: Mix grated potato, whole wheat flour, carom seeds, red chili powder and salt. Add oil and water to form soft dough, rest 10 minutes. Roll thin on board, half-cook on tawa from both sides. Cut into strips then diagonal triangles. Heat oil for deep frying and fry triangles in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper and season with salt, red chili powder and dry mango powder. For tadka dip: In a pan heat oil, add mustard seeds, chana dal, gota urad and fenugreek seeds until they splutter. Add kashmiri chillies, ginger and curry leaves and mix well. Pour tadka over hung curd. Serve aloo paratha nachos with tadka dip.

name: Anda Kheema Roll
instructions: Mix all marination ingredients (curd, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric and coriander powder) and keep aside for 1 hour with mutton mince. Add oil and spices (cumin seeds, black cardamom, green chilli, ginger) to hot ghee. Add chopped onions and sweat. Add marinated mince and cook for 30 minutes. Add coriander and mint leaves, cook for another 10 minutes. Make a thin paratha and place on top of a broken egg until the egg sticks and is cooked. Take off flame and place on a board. Add mint chutney, cooked mince and top with chopped salted onion and grated hard boiled egg. Serve with salad of choice.

name: Tandoori Broccoli
instructions: Mix hung curd with black pepper powder, black cardamom powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, lemon juice, salt, red chili powder, ginger-garlic paste, mustard oil and roasted gram flour. Clean vegetables in water with veggie wash, rinse and wipe dry. Blanch broccoli in boiling salted water for 1-2 minutes, transfer to iced water and cool completely. Remove on clean cloth and wipe dry. Cut tomato halves and season with salt and black pepper. Apply tandoori marination to blanched broccoli and tomato halves. Heat two grill pans with oil and mustard oil. Place broccoli in one pan and tomatoes in another. Cook on all sides until golden brown on medium-high heat. Remove and serve hot with curd, garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Chicken Kali Mirch
instructions: In a pan roast black peppercorns, salt and shahi jeera for 20-30 seconds until fragrant. Transfer to mortar pestle and grind into coarse powder or use grinder jar. In a bowl combine chicken breast, ginger-garlic paste, curd, salt, green chillies and coriander stems. Add black peppercorn powder and mayonnaise, marinate 10-15 minutes. Add egg, refined flour, cornstarch, baking soda, egg white and oil, mix well. Heat oil in kadai on medium flame. Fry marinated chicken on slow to medium flame until golden and cooked inside. Remove on absorbent paper. For tempering: Cut fried chicken in half. In saucepan add oil, sauté fried chicken. Add green chillies, ginger, coriander leaves and sprinkle prepared masala. Toss well. For mint dip: Mix curd, mint leaves, prepared masala, salt and sugar. For cheese dip: Mix mayonnaise, grated cheese and chili flakes. Serve hot with dips and garnish.

name: Shahi Dal Maharani
instructions: Make crushed paste of ginger, garlic, green chillies and salt. In pressure cooker add dals, crushed paste, salt, water, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and butter. Give 3-4 whistles. In heavy pot heat ghee, add cloves and cumin seeds. Add onions and sauté until translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until light brown. Add spices and sauté until fragrant. Add tomato purée and cook until ghee separates. Pour cooked dal and mix well. Cover and cook on low heat 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add butter and fresh cream and boil. Serve garnished with cream and coriander.

name: Special Mutton Curry
ingredients: degi red chilli powder ½ tbsp
instructions: Marinate mutton with mustard oil, salt, ginger-garlic paste, onion paste, chilli powder, turmeric and coriander powder, green and black cardamom and cloves for 10-15 minutes. Marinate potatoes with mustard oil, salt, turmeric and chilli powder. Roast whole spices (coriander seeds through bay leaf) for 20-30 seconds until fragrant and grind to fine powder. Crush garlic, ginger and green chillies in mortar pestle. In sauce pot, add mustard oil and refined oil with cinnamon, bay leaf and dry red chilli. Sauté ginger-garlic paste for 5-10 seconds. Add sliced onions and sauté 2-3 minutes until golden. Add marinated mutton and sauté 5-10 minutes. Add curd and mix well. Add mint leaves, cover and cook 2-3 minutes on low flame. Add water, cover and cook 20-25 minutes. Add marinated potatoes and mix well. Transfer to pressure cooker and cook 2-3 whistles. Add mutton masala powder, coriander leaves, ginger and lemon juice. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Crispy Soya Chilli 65
instructions: In bowl add warm water, salt, ginger-garlic paste, curd and mix. Add chilli powder and asafoetida. Add soya nuggets and soak 10-15 minutes. In pan cook soaked soya nuggets, then strain and transfer to bowl. Mix soaked nuggets with salt, curd, chilli powder and asafoetida. Add rice flour and ginger-garlic paste to coat. Add rice flour or cornstarch before frying. Heat oil in kadhai on low to medium heat. Add marinated nuggets and fry on medium flame until light golden. Remove on absorbent paper. Heat oil on high flame again, add nuggets and fry until crisp. Heat oil in pan or wok on medium heat. Add mustard seeds and fennel seeds and let splutter. Add garlic and ginger, sauté briefly. Add curry leaves and green chilli, sauté nicely. Add fried soya nuggets and toss well. Add black pepper powder and chilli powder, toss everything. Add lemon juice and toss again. Garnish with coriander sprig and lemon wedge and serve hot.

name: Besan Ki Sabji
ingredients: degi red chilli powder ½ tsp
degi red chilli powder ½ tsp
instructions: In small bowl add curt, turmeric powder, chilli powder and asafoetida. Add gram flour, salt to taste and mix well without lumps. Add oil and mix well. Grease steamer mould or plate, pour batter and steam 10-12 minutes on high heat. Cool slightly and cut in desired shape. In bowl add curd, ghee, salt, green chilli, ginger, turmeric, chilli powder, asafoetida, coriander powder and gram flour. Mix everything well. In kadai heat ghee, add fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds and fennel seeds, let splutter. Add dry red chillies and asafoetida, add curd mixture and mix well. Stir slowly on medium flame. Add water and cover with lid until one boil. Stir until gravy boils properly. Add prepared besan wadi, cover and cook on low flame 3-4 minutes. Heat oil in non-stick pan, add carom seeds, onion seeds, white sesame seeds and let splutter. Add chilli powder and mix well. Pour tadka over sabji. Garnish with fresh mint leaves and serve hot with chapati.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi
instructions: In pressure cooker add ghee and moong dal, roast well. Add rice, salt, carrots, water, turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Mix well, cover and cook 2-3 whistles. In separate kadai heat ghee and oil, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add chopped ginger, green chilli and onion, sauté until translucent. Add salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder and asafetida, sauté well. Add french beans and green peas, sauté well on medium flame. Add cooked dal and rice and mix well until combined. Add some water, cover and cook 4-5 minutes. Garnish with coriander and drizzle extra ghee on top. Serve with papad, pickle and yogurt on the side.

name: paneer naan sandwich
instructions: Prepare naan dough with refined flour, salt, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, water, curd and oil. Rest for 10-15 minutes. Make peri peri sauce by sauteing onion-tomato-garlic paste with ketchup, vinegar and sugar. Prepare filling with paneer, corn, capsicum, green chillies, oregano, coriander and peri peri sauce. Roll dough into oval flatbread, cook on tawa with water and lid for 3-4 minutes per side. Assemble sandwich by spreading mayonnaise and filling on naan, top with cheese and pepper. Cover with another naan. Grill on butter until golden brown with grill marks. Serve hot.

name: matar ki tikki chaat
instructions: Heat ghee in kadai, add ginger and green chillies, then add green peas, asafoetida and cover. Cook for 10 minutes on medium heat. Mash cooked peas with spoon, cool down. Add chaat masala, amchur powder, coriander and mint leaves. For chaat masala: dry roast coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black peppercorns, dry red chillies and salt, then grind coarsely. Shape mashed pea mixture into tikkis. Heat ghee and fry tikkis until golden and crispy. Garnish with curd, tamarind chutney, green chutney, red chilli and sev. Serve hot.

name: dak bungalow chicken curry
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, curd, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder and ginger garlic paste. For masala paste: heat oil and toast cardamom, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, peppercorns, cinnamon, bay leaf. Cool and add coconut, ginger, garlic. Make smooth paste with chilled water. For red chili paste: grind garlic, ginger and dry red chillies. In handi, heat mustard oil and oil, brown onions. Add red chili paste, sautee potatoes and tomato. Add marinated chicken and brown. Add water and prepared paste. Cover and cook until chicken is done. Fry hard-boiled eggs and add to curry. Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice.

name: Eggless Chocolate Truffle Cake
instructions: Make caramelized milkmaid by boiling tin in water for 2 hours. Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, cocoa powder. Add oil, vanilla, then beaten curd and milkmaid. Bake in kadai on low-medium flame for 35-40 minutes. For truffle: heat cream and caramelized milkmaid, add chopped chocolate and mix. Layer sponge with truffle and caramelized milkmaid. Pour hot truffle over chilled cake and garnish with whipped cream, gold leaf and cocoa powder. Serve cold.

name: Handi Chicken Curry
instructions: Fry onion slices until golden and crisp. Marinate chicken with salt. Mix curd with spices, fried onions and marinated chicken. Pour marinated chicken into handi, seal with dough. Place coals on top and cook on low flame 30-40 minutes. Open seal, add mint and coriander leaves, ginger julienne. Mix well and serve hot with roti.

name: Sunday Mutton Curry
instructions: Grind onion, spices, turmeric, chilli powder, salt, ginger, garlic and chillies into paste. Marinate mutton with salt, ginger garlic paste and peppercorns. Sauté marinated mutton, add paste, mustard oil and curd. Simmer until cooked. Boil water in pressure cooker with salt, add cooked mutton and pressure cook 2-3 whistles. Dry roast black peppercorns, cardamom, cloves, mace and fenugreek, grind fine. Add masala and simmer 4-5 minutes. Garnish with coriander and serve with roti.

name: Paneer Tikka Kathi Roll
instructions: Marinate paneer with mustard oil, chilli powder and asafoetida. Add bell peppers and onion. Mix hung curd with mayonnaise, spices, gram flour and ginger garlic paste. Add paneer mixture to curd and rest 10 minutes. Knead dough with refined flour, whole wheat flour, curd, water and ghee. Rest 10 minutes. Roast spices and grind. Mix onion salad with chilli, salt and lemon. Skewer marinated paneer and vegetables. Roast on grill pan with ghee. Make thin rotis and roast with ghee. Assemble: layer salad, mint chutney, paneer tikka and masala on roti. Roll up and garnish.

name: Mumbai Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil cauliflower, capsicum, ginger, garlic, potato, carrot, peas with salt and butter. Mash vegetables. Heat butter and oil, sauté onion until translucent. Add tomato, chilli, ginger garlic paste and salt until soft. Add tomato puree and cook 6-8 minutes. Add capsicum and cook 2 minutes. Reserve 2-3 tbsp. Add chilli powder, butter and masala, sauté 1 minute. Add mashed vegetables, butter, masala, water and sugar. Cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with coriander. Toast pav in hot pan with butter. Serve bhaji with onion, lemon wedges and toasted pav.

name: Andhra Style Spicy Paneer Masala
instructions: Make ginger garlic paste with ginger, garlic, green chilli and salt. Dry roast fennel, cumin, cinnamon, cloves on medium flame 2-3 minutes. Cool and grind into fine powder. Heat oil and ghee, add star anise, curry leaves, cumin seeds and splutter. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté until light brown. Add onion and sauté well. Add coriander powder and Guntur chilli powder, keep sautéing until aromatic. Add tomato and green chilli, sauté until soft. Add water and cook 5 minutes. Add ground masala and curry leaves. Marinate paneer with asafoetida, turmeric, chilli powder and oil. Fry paneer until all sides cooked. Add fried paneer to gravy, simmer 5 minutes. Add coriander leaves and garnish with fried curry leaves.

name: Onion Tomato Gravy
instructions: Heat oil in a kadai and add cumin seeds. Saute chopped onions until golden brown and completely cooked. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, ginger-garlic paste and saute until fragrant. Add tomato puree, chopped tomato, salt and cook on medium heat until properly cooked. Finish by adding vinegar, cook for a minute and switch off flames. Cool and store in an airtight container.

name: Aloo Tikki Roll
instructions: Blend ginger, mint, coriander, oil, garlic, green chillies, salt with 1/2 cup mayonnaise to a smooth paste. Mix in remaining mayonnaise. Heat oil, crackle fennel seeds, add ginger and green chillies, saute briefly. Add grated potatoes, salt, pepper, coriander, mix well and cool. Add bread crumbs to the mixture. Shape into tikkis and roll in bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Make a thin roti from the dough, roast on both sides with butter. Mix tomatoes, capsicum, onion, salt, pepper, oil, lemon juice for salad. Place roti on hot pan, apply butter and spread, add salad, place tikki, roll tightly and serve.

name: Chicken Angara
ingredients: 2 heaped tbsp degi red chilli powder
instructions: In a sauce pot, heat oil and saute onions until light brown. Add salt and continue. Add tomatoes and cook on medium flame until well cooked. Set aside. In a large bowl, add curd, ginger garlic paste, bay leaf, cloves, green cardamom, black cardamom, peppercorns, mace, cinnamon, degi red chilli powder, turmeric, asafoetida, coriander powder, cumin powder and the onion-tomato mixture. Add chicken drumsticks, salt and almonds, marinate for 10-15 minutes. In a saucepot, add marinated chicken mixture, cover and cook 5-10 minutes on low flame. Heat a charcoal on gas stove. Place hot charcoal in steel bowl with cloves, add oil from chicken, place bowl in the pot, cover and cook 15-20 minutes. Transfer to serving dish, garnish with coriander. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Hyderabadi Paneer
instructions: Heat oil and saute tomatoes, coconut, green chillies, sesame seeds, peanuts for 2-3 minutes. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric and cook for a minute. Add water, sugar, cover and simmer. Add tender coriander stems and cook 2-3 minutes. Cool and grind into smooth paste. In a pot, heat oil, add cumin seeds, kashmiri chillies, garlic and saute until golden. Add prepared gravy, water, tamarind pulp, jaggery and cook until tamarind rawness is gone. Add paneer and green chillies, simmer until thickened. Heat oil with onion seeds and pour into gravy. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with coriander. Serve hot with roti.

name: Dapka Kadhi Pakora
ingredients: 1 heaped tsp degi red chilli powder
1 tsp degi red chilli powder for pakora
instructions: In a large bowl, add curd, water, salt and whisk well. Add degi red chilli powder, turmeric powder, gram flour and whisk to remove lumps. Transfer to kadai and stir on medium flame. Once kadhi boils, make small balls from pakora batter and drop gently into boiling kadhi. Cook on medium flame until dapkas float on top. In a pan, heat ghee and add fenugreek seeds, dry red chillies, crushed coriander seeds, let them splutter. Add ginger and asafoetida, mix well. Transfer tadka to kadhi when it gets thick. Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot with rice.

name: turai gravy sabji
instructions: Marinate ridge gourd with red chilli powder, turmeric, asafoetida, coriander powder, oil and salt for 5-6 minutes. Make ginger-green chilli paste by grinding in mortar pestle. Mix paste with curd and set aside. Roast cashew nuts and raisins in oil until golden and keep aside. Heat oil in handi/kadai, add marinated turai and cook covered on low flame for 3-4 minutes until tender. Add curd mixture, cover and cook. Add roasted nuts, finish with coriander leaves and milk, swirl gently. Serve hot with roti.

name: rogan josh
instructions: Heat saucepan, add mustard oil, cloves, green cardamom and mutton, saute well. In bowl mix curd, saffron, dried ginger powder, fennel powder, asafoetida, kashmiri red chilli powder. Add this mixture to saucepan with salt and let cook covered. Add mutton stock gradually and cook until meat is tender. In separate pan, heat ghee with ratanjot until color releases, strain and add to saucepan, mix well. Serve hot with naan.

name: fauji mutton curry
instructions: Crush ginger, garlic, green chillies, salt in mortar pestle. Mix mutton, onions, mint leaves, crushed paste, curd, spices and marinate overnight or 1-2 hours. Heat ghee in heavy kadai, add cardamom, cloves, pepper, bay leaf, cinnamon and let crackle. Add sliced onions and saute until browned. Add marinated mutton and saute 5-8 minutes until light brown. Add water or stock, cover and cook 20-25 minutes until 80% cooked. Make green paste from coriander leaves, sugar, oil, green chillies. Add green paste and continue cooking until fully done. Serve hot with coriander garnish.

name: masala bread upma
instructions: Heat oil in kadai, add mustard seeds, gota urad, chana dal and let crackle. Add curry leaves, ginger, chillies, onion and saute until translucent. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add turmeric, chilli powder, curd and saute on medium heat for 1 minute. Add water and salt, bring to boil. Add toasted bread slices, cover and cook for half minute, then toss until everything is coated. Finish with fresh coriander leaves and mix well. For fried nuts: heat ghee, add cashew nuts and peanuts, fry until light golden, keep aside. Serve hot bread upma garnished with fried nuts and coriander leaves.

name: andhra chilli chicken
instructions: In bowl add chicken, salt, onions, green chillies, oil, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and mix properly, keep aside for half hour. For green paste: grind coriander leaves, green chillies, salt, oil into fine paste and keep aside. In heated kadai add marinated chicken, cover and cook on medium heat 20-25 minutes until 85% cooked. Remove lid, stir properly and add green paste, continue cooking until fully done. Finish with lemon juice and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: gobi 65 roll
instructions: For frying gobi: Mix cauliflower with ginger-garlic paste, salt, cornstarch, refined flour, chilli powder, curd and water until coated properly. Deep fry in medium hot oil until golden and crispy, keep aside. For tempering: Heat oil, add mustard seeds, ginger, garlic, green chillies, curry leaves, salt, ketchup, chilli powder and black pepper, saute for 1 minute. Add fried gobi and toss until coated, finish with coriander leaves. For paratha: Take dough portion, roll thin, apply oil and salt with flour, fold like fan, roll again end to end tucking last part. Rest covered 5 minutes, then roll into roti and roast on hot pan. Apply oil when half cooked, cook both sides until golden. For assembly: Apply hung curd on paratha, add fried gobi, sliced tomato and onion, coriander leaves, then roll up. Serve immediately.

name: Galawati Kebab
instructions: Combine minced mutton and kidney fat, mince twice in mixer grinder. Prepare galawat ka masala by grinding roasted whole spices. Combine minced meat with spice mix, ginger garlic paste, raw papaya paste, kewra, rose water and salt. Marinate minimum 2 hours or overnight. Heat ghee in pan on medium heat. Wet hands and shape meat into patties directly on pan. Fry until golden crust forms on both sides. Remove on absorbent paper. Serve with mooli aur alsi ki chutney, laccha onion, lemon wedge and mint leaves.

name: Veg Momo Curry
instructions: Make dough by adding refined flour, salt, oil and water. Knead semi-soft dough. Cover and rest 8-10 minutes. Prepare filling by combining spring onion, cabbage, green chili and corn. Let sit 5-10 minutes to release water, squeeze out water. Add processed cheese and coriander. Roll thin dough rounds, apply water on edges, place spoonful of filling and fold into desired shape. Heat oil in kadai, add cumin seeds. Add chopped onions until translucent. Add green chili and saute. Add turmeric, red chili powder and tomatoes, saute 4-5 minutes. Add cumin and coriander powder until raw aroma disappears. Add szechuan peppercorn, water, salt and sugar. Add prepared momos to curry. Cover and cook on low flame 2 minutes. Add coriander leaves. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: Pink Gujiya
ingredients: beetroot juice 0.33 cup for colored dough
instructions: Prepare stuffing by heating ghee, adding semolina and roasting until light golden brown. In same pan boil water with sugar, add roasted semolina and cook until liquid absorbed. Add grated coconut, pistachio, almonds, cashew nuts, rose water and saffron. Roast until fragrant and cool completely. Prepare plain dough by kneading refined flour, ghee, salt and water into semi-hard dough. Prepare colored dough by kneading refined flour, ghee, beetroot juice and lemon juice. Rest both doughs. Take both rested doughs and roll thinly. Apply water on one and place other on top, flatten again. Roll like swirl roll tightly and cut into small portions. Roll one portion using rolling pin, place in gujiya mold, add spoonful of stuffing and pinch of raw sugar. Close mold to give gujiya shape. Deep fry in medium hot oil until light golden brown and crispy. Cool and serve.

name: Chutney Wale Aloo
instructions: Prepare green chutney by grinding green chilies, mint, coriander, ginger and cashew nuts into smooth paste. Prepare masala by dry roasting black peppercorns, white sesame seeds and flax seeds, then grinding into fine powder. In heavy bottom pot, heat ghee and oil. Add cumin seeds, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds and let splutter. Add ginger and green chilies, saute well. Add baby potatoes and toss on medium flame for a while. Add salt, cover and cook 2-3 minutes. Add beaten curd and cook on medium flame until water evaporates. Add water, cover and cook 2-4 minutes. Add salt, green chutney, sugar, dry mango powder and mix well. Finish with ghee. Transfer to serving bowl. Garnish with prepared masala, toasted flax seeds and coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti.

name: Carrot and Cauliflower Pickle
instructions: Grind ginger, garlic and onions into fine paste. Boil vinegar, add jaggery and reduce to semi-thick consistency. Heat mustard oil to smoking point, add paste and cook until raw smell goes off. Add red chilli powder, salt, garam masala, par-boiled carrots and cauliflower. Add vinegar-jaggery syrup and mustard seeds. Cool and store in airtight container.

name: Rooh Afza Popsicles and Pudding
instructions: For custard: boil milk, mix cornstarch with rooh afza syrup and water, add to boiling milk, stir well. For popsicles: blend frozen bananas with custard, add rooh afza syrup and basil seeds, pour into moulds and freeze 5-6 hours. For pudding: blend bread slices with rooh afza syrup and custard, pour into mould, steam 15-20 minutes on low flame, cool and refrigerate 5-6 hours. Garnish and serve chilled.

name: Crispy Kurkure Momos
instructions: Make semi-soft dough with refined and wheat flour, salt, vinegar, water and oil. Rest for 10-15 minutes. Mix filling: cabbage, chillies, ginger, carrots, coriander, peppers, salt. Add paneer, pepper powder, schezwan chutney, mayo. Prepare slurry with cornflour, flour, chilli powder, garam masala, water, salt, vinegar. Roll dough balls thin, fill with vegetable-paneer mixture, fold. Dip in slurry then coat in crushed cornflakes-poha mixture. Rest 4-5 minutes. Heat oil in kadai and deep fry momos until light golden. Transfer to absorbent paper. Prepare dip by mixing green chillies, coriander, onion, mayo, cheese, oil. Serve hot momos topped with dip, chilli powder, and lemon wedges.

name: Bachelor's Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 kg chicken drumstick and thigh with bones
instructions: Grind tomatoes with salt, curd, and coriander stems into coarse paste. Marinate chicken with salt, chilli powder, turmeric powder, curd, and oil for 10-15 minutes. Grind ginger, garlic, and green chillies into coarse paste. Heat oil and ghee, add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom. Add ginger-garlic paste and onions, cook until golden. Add chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder and saute 2-3 minutes. Add tomato paste, salt, sugar and cook. Add marinated chicken and saute 1 minute. Add water, cover with lid and cook 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Finish with coriander leaves. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with coriander sprig. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Punjabi Pakoda Kadhi
ingredients: 1 tbsp coriander seeds, roasted and crushed
instructions: For Pakodas: In mixing bowl, add onions, ginger, turmeric powder, salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder, coriander seeds, besan and buttermilk, make thick batter. Heat oil in kadhai for deep frying. Make random small bite-size balls and fry pakodas till 70% done. Fry second time till golden brown and crisp. Remove on absorbent kitchen towel and keep aside. For Kadhi: In mixing bowl, add buttermilk, besan, turmeric and salt, whisk well to avoid lumps. In heavy bottom pan, heat ghee and oil. Splutter cumin seeds, followed by ginger and garlic, cook till raw smell goes off. Add red chilli and coriander seeds, cook a minute. Add onions, cook till translucent. Add red chilli powder and coriander powder, mix well and cook a minute. Add tomatoes and salt, mix well, cook 2-3 minutes. Add prepared buttermilk and besan mixture, whisk well to avoid curdles. Cook kadhi 5-7 minutes on low flame. Keep consistency thin. Transfer to serving bowl and add prepared pakodas. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with rice.

name: Butter Chicken Bombs
instructions: For Makhani Gravy: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and allow to splutter. Add onions, garlic cloves, ginger, green chillies, whole kashmiri red chillies, tomatoes, cashew nuts and salt. Cook 4-5 minutes. Add water, cover and cook 8-10 minutes. Cool to room temperature and grind into fine paste. Heat butter and oil, add red chilly powder and coriander powder, saute a minute. Add makhani gravy and cook 5-6 minutes. Add sugar, salt to taste, garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh cream, cook 2 minutes. Add freshly chopped coriander. Cool gravy and set in butter paper lined tray and deep freeze for minimum 5 hours. For Chicken balls: In mixing bowl add all ingredients step by step and mix well. Place live charcoal in bowl keeping in centre, add few drops of ghee, cover and smoke 3-4 minutes. Remove frozen makhani gravy and cut into cubes. Take spoonful of chicken mixture and flatten on palms, place frozen makhani cube and seal with chicken mixture. Coat with refined flour, coat with beaten eggs and finally coat with bread crumbs. Heat oil on medium high flame and fry coated balls until crisp and golden brown.

name: Paneer Bhuna Masala Bhurji
instructions: For homemade paneer: Set wok or kadhai on medium low heat, add milk, bring to light boil while stirring in intervals. Mix water and vinegar together and add to boiling milk. Milk will start to curdle and take from flame. Place muslin cloth and sieve, strain whey. Tie muslin cloth and squeeze out excess moisture carefully. For Bhuna masala: Set wok on medium heat, add ghee and oil. Add cumin and onion, cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste, chilli paste and turmeric powder, cook 3-4 minutes. Add red chilli powder and coriander powder and cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree, salt, green chillies and cashew paste, mix well and cook 4-5 minutes on low flame. Add curd and stir continuously, cook until ghee is released. Add water, mix well and bring to boil. Add crumbled paneer, mix well and cook 4-5 minutes. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh coriander, mix well and continue to cook 4-5 minutes more.

name: Aloo Chole Dum Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed and soaked
instructions: For rice: Set wok filled with water to boil, add soaked rice, salt, whole spices, lemon wedge and ghee, mix and cook until rice is 3/4 done. Strain excess water and spread rice on wide surface to cool. For aloo chole: In cooker add soaked chickpeas, garlic, whole spices, strained black tea concoction, salt and water. Fill water 2 inches above chickpea surface. Pressure cook on medium heat for 3-4 whistles. Let cooker depressurize naturally. For gravy: In deep pan add oil and onions, cook until golden brown. Add ginger and green chillies, saute. Add tomato puree and salt, cook 7-8 minutes. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder and anardana powder, mix well and add water. Add raw potatoes and cook until almost done. Lower flame and add curd, stir continuously, cook 4-5 minutes. Add cooked chickpeas with water. Increase heat to high and cook 4-5 minutes. Gravy should be thick, not runny. Add garam masala and kasuri methi. For assembly: Spread ghee on base of heavy bottom wok, spread layer of cooked rice, then layer of aloo chole, sprinkle mint and coriander, repeat layering. Top layer: spread rice evenly, add ghee, coriander, mint, fried onions and saffron milk. Place lid and apply dough on rim to seal. Put over tawa and give dum 20-25 minutes on low flame.

name: Matar Anda Masala
instructions: Remove shells from boiled eggs and poke with toothpick. Heat oil, add turmeric and shallow fry eggs until crispy. Grind tomatoes to puree. Heat ghee, add jeera and let splutter. Add onions and cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, cook 1-2 minutes. Add tomato puree, salt and cook 2-3 minutes. Add roasted besan, red chilli powder and coriander powder, cook until oil releases. Add green peas and cook 8-10 minutes, add water if needed. Add 200 ml water and bring to boil. Add fried eggs gently. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and fresh cream. Cook 4-5 minutes. Finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with roti, naan or paratha.

name: Soya Matar
instructions: Boil soya chunks for 2-3 minutes, strain and rinse with cold water. Squeeze out excess water. Heat oil in wok, add cumin seeds. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add chopped onions and cook until golden brown. Add turmeric powder and cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy and leaves oil. Add powdered spices and cook 1-2 minutes, add water if dry. Cook further 2-3 minutes. Add slit green chillies, ginger, green peas and boiled soya chunks. Cook 2-3 minutes. Add hot water and salt, bring to boil. Cover and cook 8-10 minutes. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh coriander. Serve hot with paratha, roti or rice.

name: Super Yogurt Jars
instructions: Take clean glass jars. Layer yogurt at the bottom. Add a layer of granola or cereal. Drizzle with honey. Add a layer of mixed berries. Repeat layers. Top with nuts. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

name: Homemade Mango Jam
instructions: Wash mangoes well and dry them. Chop mangoes and remove pulp from seeds, combining both chopped and pulped mango. Add sugar in 1:3 ratio to mango weight. In non-stick pan, add mangoes, sugar, salt and lemon juice. Cook on medium flame, stirring regularly. Once sugar melts and starts boiling, jam will splutter - use lid for safety. Cook for about 30 minutes, checking readiness by placing a spoonful on a plate - it should not drip when tilted. Keep jam slightly runny when hot. Sterilize glass jars by boiling with lid and spoon. Add hot jam to sterilized jar immediately. Cool completely before sealing. Can re-dip in boiling water for extended shelf life. Store in refrigerator.

name: Quinoa Fried Rice
instructions: Rinse quinoa thoroughly. Boil water with salt, add quinoa, cover and cook 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Cool completely. Heat oil in wok on medium-high heat, add ginger garlic paste and spring onion bulbs, sauté 1 minute. Add vegetables and cook 2-3 minutes on high flame. Add sauces, salt and pepper, mix and cook 1 minute. Add cooked quinoa, mix well, cook 1 minute on high flame. Add spring onion greens, mix and sauté few more seconds. Serve hot.

name: Khada Pav Bhaji
instructions: Heat pan on medium heat, add butter and jeera, sauté until jeera splutters. Add onions, cook 1 minute. Add garlic and red chilli paste, cook until oil separates. Add capsicum, cook 2 minutes. Add beetroot, cauliflower, peas, tomatoes and salt, mix well and cook 3-4 minutes. Add water, cook 1 minute. Add boiled potatoes and pav bhaji masala, cook 4-5 minutes. Add lemon juice and coriander, mix and cook 1-2 minutes. For pav: heat butter with pav bhaji masala and coriander, toast pav on all sides. Serve hot bhaji with toasted pav.

name: Veggies in Peri Peri Sauce with Herbed Brown Rice
instructions: Peri peri mix: Mix red chilli powder, garlic powder, black salt, powdered sugar, cinnamon, oregano and ginger powder. Store in cool dry place. Veggies: Grind oats into powder. Heat oil in pan on medium heat, add oats powder and cook 1 minute. Add garlic and sauté 1 minute. Add milk slowly while whisking to avoid lumps, cook 3-4 minutes. Add salt, peri peri mix, stir and cook 2-3 minutes. Add vegetables, stir and cook 5-7 minutes. Add paneer, stir gently and cook 2-3 minutes. Add parsley and serve with herbed rice. Rice: Heat oil in pan on high heat, add mixed herbs and parsley, sauté few seconds. Add cooked brown rice, stir and cook 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with peri peri vegetables.

name: Veg Triple Schezwan Fried Rice
instructions: Fried rice: Heat oil on high heat, add garlic, ginger and green chillies, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add spring onion bulbs, sauté 1 minute. Add vegetables, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add sugar, salt and pepper, continue sautéing 1 minute on high heat. Add schezwan sauce, red chilli sauce and soy sauce, mix 1 minute. Add boiled rice, mix with vegetables and toss 2 minutes on high heat. Add noodles and spring onion greens, mix and toss 1 minute. Manchurian balls: Grate cabbage and carrot, chop french beans. Mix with ginger garlic, salt, pepper, cornstarch and flour. Form into balls and deep fry on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Schezwan gravy: Heat oil on high heat, add garlic, ginger and dry red chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add spring onion bulbs, sauté 1 minute. Add carrot, cabbage and capsicum, sauté 1 minute. Add schezwan sauce, ketchup, red chilli sauce, soy sauce, salt and pepper, cook 1 minute. Add water and bring to simmer, add cornstarch mixture to thicken. Add fried manchurian balls and cook 1 minute. Add vinegar and spring onion greens, cook 1 final minute. Serve together.

name: Bun-less Mean Bean Burger
instructions: Tikkis: Soak rajma 5-6 hours or overnight, wash and drain. Pressure cook rajma with water (2 inches above surface) and salt for 3 whistles on medium flame. Let cool naturally. Drain and transfer to mixing bowl, add remaining ingredients (poha, onion, spices, herbs, lemon juice), mash and combine well. Grease palm with oil, shape mixture into tikkis. Heat pan on medium heat with oil, shallow fry tikkis on both sides until crisp and golden brown. Mint Curd Dip: Mix hung curd with mint leaves, salt and pepper. Assembly: Layer romaine lettuce, spread mint curd dip, place tikki, tomato slices, onion slices, spread dip again, top with another lettuce leaf. Consume immediately.

name: Schezwan Cheese Chilli Sandwich
instructions: Green chutney: Grind coriander, garlic, ginger, green chillies, curry leaves, lemon juice, chaat masala and salt to smooth paste. Adjust consistency with water. Store in fridge 3-4 days. Filling: Mix all vegetables (onion, capsicum, sweet corn, spring onion) with salt, pepper, schezwan sauce and grated cheese. Keep aside. Assembly: Spread butter and green chutney on both bread slices. Place spoonful of filling on one slice, spread evenly, close with another slice with chutney side in. Spread butter on top. Heat pan on medium heat, toast sandwich from both sides by applying butter until crisp and golden brown, apply pressure while toasting. Cut into triangles or squares, serve hot with ketchup or any dip, optionally with potato chips.

name: Paper Paratha
instructions: Aloo filling: In mixing bowl, add boiled potatoes and mash until smooth and silky. Add onion, ginger, green chillies, mint, coriander, all spices and salt. Mix well. Paratha dough: In mixing bowl, add flour and salt, mix together. Add water gradually and knead soft dough. Apply oil to prevent drying, cover with damp cloth and rest 30 minutes. Knead again after resting, divide into dough balls, shape into roundels. Flatten and coat with dry flour, roll into thin chapati. Make two such chapatis for one paratha. Take spoonful of filling, spread evenly over one chapati, cover with another chapati and lightly seal ends. Dust flour to avoid sticking, roll again as thin as possible. Cook paratha on hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear. Apply ghee, flip and cook on both sides until crisp and golden. Separate upper and lower layers with tongs, roll both layers with mixture inside. Top with butter and serve with curd or chutney.

name: Oil Free Chole
instructions: Soak chickpeas for 5-6 hours or overnight. Heat cooker on medium flame, add onions and salt, cook until golden brown. Add soaked chickpeas, salt, whole spices, garlic, ginger, ajwain, water and black tea concoction, cover with water. Add baking soda and pressure cook for 4 whistles. Let cool naturally. Bring to boil again, add besan, coriander powder, red chilli powder, jeera powder, green chillies, ginger and chana masala. Stir well. Add aamchur and anardana powder, cook for 8-10 minutes on low flame. Adjust consistency with hot water if needed. Add kasuri methi and cook for 1-2 minutes. Serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: Mooli Stuffed Missi Paratha
instructions: For filling: Grate mooli and mix with salt, rest for 5 minutes. Squeeze excess moisture in muslin cloth. Mix with green chillies, ginger, red chilli powder, coriander powder, anardana powder, amchur powder, and fresh herbs. For dough: Mix jowar, bajra, besan, salt, methi leaves, onion, ajwain and kasuri methi. Add water and knead into semi-stiff dough. Apply oil and rest for 15 minutes. Divide into balls, coat with dry jowar flour. Make two thin chapatis of different sizes. Spread mooli filling on smaller chapati, cover with larger one and seal edges. Lightly roll and flatten. Cook on hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear. Apply ghee, flip and cook on both sides. Serve hot with butter or yogurt.

name: Dahi Ke Angare
instructions: For batter: Mix gram flour, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and ajwain. Add water to achieve semi-thick consistency. Whisk well to remove lumps and rest for 10 minutes. For filling: Tie curd in muslin cloth for 2-3 hours to drain whey. Mix hung curd with grated cheese, paneer, onions, garlic, ginger, spices and fresh herbs. For pakora: Make slit in green chillies and remove seeds. Stuff cavity with curd mixture. Coat well with gram flour batter. Heat oil and fry on medium-high flame until golden brown. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

name: Schezwan Noodle Dosa
instructions: For schezwan noodles: Heat oil in a pan on high heat. Add spring onion bulbs, capsicum, carrots and cabbage. Sauté for a minute. Add schezwan sauce, tomato ketchup, red chilli sauce, soy sauce and salt. Cook on high flame for a minute. Add boiled noodles, mix and sauté well for a minute. Add fresh spring onion greens and mix well. Set aside. For dosa: Heat dosa tawa on medium heat. Sprinkle water and wipe with cloth. Grease with oil. Pour dosa batter and spread thin with back of spoon. Add butter and spoonful of schezwan noodles, spread evenly. Add fresh spring onion greens. Roll like frankie and cut into pieces.
