Serve hot with coconut or schezwan chutney.

name: Sprouts & Oats Dosa
instructions: Wash moong dal and soak for 4-5 hours. Drain and sprout by covering overnight. Transfer to grinding jar. Add curd, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin seeds, green chillies, ginger, fresh coriander and water. Grind to fine puree. Add oats powder (sieve for fine texture). Add salt and whisk well. Cover and rest for 15 minutes. Check consistency - should be semi-thick like dosa batter. Heat dosa tawa on medium heat. Spread 1-2 spoonfuls of batter thin or thick as desired. Drizzle oil and lower flame. Cook until golden brown, flip and cook for a minute. For tomato chutney: Heat oil, add onion, garlic, green chillies and curry leaves. Cook until onions brown. Add tomatoes, salt, amchur, red chilli powder and turmeric. Cook until mushy. Add sugar and cook 2-3 minutes more. Serve dosa hot and crispy with tomato chutney.

name: Cheesy Pizza Fries
instructions: For cheese sauce: Take grated processed cheese in a bowl. Add milk and butter. Mix with spoon and microwave for 30 seconds. Mix well. Repeat this procedure 3 more times and mix thoroughly. Blend with hand blender if smooth consistency desired. For french fries: Wash and peel potatoes. Trim edges and slice into batons. Rinse thoroughly in cold water and pat dry. Soak in ice cold water for 30 minutes. Pat dry again. Fry halfway in medium-hot oil and set aside for 15-20 minutes. Fry again in hot oil until crispy. Season with salt and pepper. Drizzle pizza sauce and cheese sauce. Sprinkle oregano and red chilli flakes. Serve hot immediately.

name: Veg Angara
instructions: Heat oil and add jeera, then add onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and red chilli paste, cook until oil separates. Add tomato puree, salt and cashew paste, mix and cook for 5-6 minutes. Add turmeric, red chilli and coriander powder, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add water and cook for 10-15 minutes. Lower heat, add curd and stir continuously for 4-5 minutes. Add veggies and paneer, cook for 4-5 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and fresh coriander. Place charcoal in center, add cardamom powder and ghee drops, cover and smoke for 4-5 minutes. Serve hot with paratha or naan.

name: Chole Samosa
instructions: Soak chickpeas for 4 hours or overnight. Pressure cook with water and salt for 4 whistles. Heat ghee with bay leaves, black cardamom, cloves and peppercorns, sauté for 1 minute. Add onions, cook until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add tomato puree and spices, cook for 5-6 minutes until ghee separates. Add cooked chickpeas with water, cook for 5-7 minutes until gravy thickens. Add coriander, kasuri methi and garam masala. For samosa: knead refined flour with salt, ajwain and ghee to make a stiff dough, rest 30 minutes. Mash boiled potatoes, add ghee, jeera, hing, saunf, ginger garlic paste, spices and green peas, cook 5-6 minutes. Roll dough thin, cut in half, fold into cone, fill with potato mixture and seal. Rest 10-15 minutes. Deep fry until golden and crisp. Break samosa and pour chole over it, serve with chutney and onions.

name: Pav Bhaji Uttapam Sandwich
instructions: In a bowl mix rava, salt and curd, add water to adjust batter consistency and rest for 30 minutes. In another bowl combine chopped veggies, mashed potatoes, grated beetroot, garlic paste, kashmiri red chilli powder, pav bhaji masala, salt, lemon juice and fresh coriander. Heat a pan and make three mini uttapam using spoonfuls of batter. Top two with pav bhaji mixture and sprinkle masala and coriander on the third. Flip all three and cook for 1-2 minutes. Top pav bhaji uttapam with grated cheese, stack all three together with the coriander-topped one on top. Cook for 30 seconds until cheese melts. Serve hot.

name: Mumbai Style Chicken Frankie
instructions: For filling: Wash and cut boneless chicken into thin strips. Marinate with salt, pepper and ginger garlic paste. Heat oil, add sliced onions with salt and cook until light golden. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add powdered spices and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add marinated chicken and water, bring to boil, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Add garam masala and fresh coriander. For roti: Knead refined flour, salt, curd and water into soft stretchy dough, add oil and rest for 30 minutes. Divide into balls and roll thick rotis, cook briefly on both sides for 20-30 seconds. For masala: Mix all spices. For chutney: Grind coriander, mint, green chillies, ginger, tamarind pulp and black salt. Assembly: Cook half-cooked roti until golden, add butter, pour whisked eggs on one side, flip and cook until cooked. Assemble frankie by adding frankie masala, chicken filling, chopped onions, tangy chutney, chilli vinegar and extra masala to the roti, then roll.

name: Sookhi Dal Ka Paratha
instructions: Wash urad dal thoroughly. Heat ghee in cooker, add jeera and splutter. Add chopped ginger, garlic, green chillies and sauté for 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy and ghee is released. Add washed dal and 0.5 cup water, mix well and pressure cook for 1 whistle on medium-low flame. Let cooker depressurize naturally, stir well. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and fresh coriander, mix and cool. For paratha: Mix salt with wheat flour and add water to knead semi-soft dough, cover and rest for 15 minutes. Divide into dough balls, coat with dry flour and roll into two thick chapatis (one slightly smaller). Apply dal filling on one and cover with the larger chapati, seal edges. Lightly roll and flatten. Cook on hot tawa until brown spots appear, apply ghee, flip and cook on both sides. Serve hot with butter and curd or chutney.

name: Chicken Club Sandwich
instructions: Prepare grilled chicken by marinating chicken breast with ginger garlic paste and seasonings, grill until golden brown, slice into strips. Make garlic mayonnaise by mixing mayo, black pepper, chopped garlic and parsley. Caramelize onions in oil and butter until soft. Toast bread slices in butter on both sides. Assemble sandwich: spread mayo on toast, layer lettuce, chicken strips, caramelized onions, place second toast, spread mayo, add lettuce and tomato, top with fried egg and final toast. Cut into triangles and secure with toothpicks.

name: Butter Chicken Paratha
instructions: Make butter chicken filling: heat butter, add garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 2-3 minutes, add tomato puree, chilli powder, sugar, cashew paste, cook 4-5 minutes, add minced chicken and cook 4-5 minutes, add cream and garam masala, finish with salt, methi, coriander and lime juice, cool completely. Prepare dough: mix wheat flour and salt, knead soft dough with water and oil, cover with damp cloth, rest 30 minutes. Divide dough into portions, flatten, place chicken filling in center, pleat and fold edges, flatten with rolling pin. Cook on hot tava with ghee on both sides until golden brown. Serve with curd and pickle.

name: Paneer Tikka Salad
instructions: For paneer tikka: marinate paneer tiles in yogurt mixed with spices and ginger garlic paste for 15-20 minutes, grill on both sides until golden, cut into strips. For bread cubes: cut bread into squares, toast in olive oil with salt and pepper until crisp. For salad: wash and chop lettuce, grind curd with mint leaves, mix with lemon zest, lemon juice, honey, vinegar, olive oil and seasonings, add chopped vegetables and mix gently. For plating: spread salad on serving platter, top with toasted bread cubes and paneer tikka strips. Serve immediately.

name: Aam Panha
instructions: Boil raw mango until soft, extract pulp and discard seed. Mix pulp in water, add salt, sugar, roasted cumin powder, minced ginger and red chilli powder. Stir well and chill. Serve cold during summer.

name: Paneer Makhani Pizza
instructions: Make pizza dough: mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, baking soda, add ghee and curd, knead with water into soft dough, apply oil, cover with damp cloth, rest 30 minutes. Make makhani sauce: heat oil, add cumin and let splutter, sauté onions until brown, add garlic, ginger, chillies, cook 4-5 minutes, add tomatoes and water, cook 8-10 minutes, cool and grind to paste, heat butter and oil, add spice powders, add paste, cook 5-6 minutes, add sugar, salt, garam masala, methi and cream, cook 2 minutes, add coriander. Prepare paneer tikka: heat butter and oil, add ginger garlic paste, add cream and cook 2-3 minutes, add spice powders, add paneer cubes, mix well, add coriander. Assemble: divide dough into 2 parts, roll into thin base with flour and semolina, prick with fork, cook on both sides 3-4 minutes each, apply makhani sauce, grate cheese, add vegetables and paneer tikka, add more cheese, cover with lid and cook 6-7 minutes until cheese melts. Serve hot.

name: Chicken Cooker Pulao
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly and soak. Marinate chicken with ginger garlic paste, salt, powdered spices and curd for 15 minutes. Heat oil in cooker, add all whole spices and slit jeera, splutter briefly. Add sliced onions and cook until they start to turn brown, add ginger garlic paste and sauté 1 minute. Add sliced tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add marinated chicken, green chillies and kasuri methi, cook 8-10 minutes on medium flame. Add water and soaked rice, give nice stir, add coriander and mint leaves, stir once. Pressure cook on medium flame for 1 whistle. Switch off flame and let cooker depressurize naturally before opening lid. Serve hot with plain curd or raita.

name: Gobi ka Paratha
instructions: Wash and grate cauliflower, mix with green chillies, ginger, mint, coriander, spices, and keep aside. Make dough with flour and water, rest for 15 mins. Divide into balls, flatten, create cavity, fill with gobi mixture, seal edges. Coat with flour and roll into thick paratha. Cook on tawa on both sides with ghee until brown spots appear. Serve hot with butter and curd or chutney.

name: Bharwan Karela Aloo
instructions: Peel karela, slice lengthwise, rub salt inside and outside, rest 5 hours or overnight, rinse, pat dry, sun dry 1 hour. Mix spices in bowl. Stuff karela with spice mixture and tie with thread. Heat mustard oil until smoke appears, shallow fry karela until cooked. In separate pan, fry potatoes and onions, add remaining spices, combine with karela, cover and cook 4-5 mins on low flame stirring occasionally. Serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Anda Bhurji Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs. Heat oil, add jeera, then onions and green chillies, cook until translucent. Add tomato, salt and spices, cook until mushy. Add eggs and stir on medium flame, add coriander leaves. Mix curd with mint leaves, salt and pepper. Slice pav, spread mint-curd dip on both slices, top with egg bhurji, press gently, add grated cheese. Heat pan with butter, toast slices until crisp, cover to melt cheese. Serve topped with mint-curd dip and fried onions.

name: Cheese Chilli Garlic Bread Sticks
instructions: Mix powdered spices, dried herbs and salt. Mix melted butter with chopped garlic and coriander. Mix capsicum, green chillies, garlic, cheese and oregano seasoning. Spread cheese chilli mixture on bread slice, top with another slice and press gently. Apply garlic butter on sandwich, place on tawa with oregano seasoning. Cook on both sides until crisp and golden brown. Apply garlic butter and seasoning on other side before toasting. Cut into sticks and serve hot with ketchup or dip.

name: Nimbu Chicken
instructions: Boil water, soak cashews and almonds for 15-20 mins, grind into paste. Mix chicken with ginger garlic paste, spices, lemon juice, salt, nut paste and curd, marinate 15 mins. Heat oil and butter in wok, add ginger, garlic, green chillies and sauté 1 min. Add marinated chicken, stir continuously, bring to boil. Cover and cook 20-25 mins on medium-low flame, stirring occasionally. Add pepper powder, spices, lemon zest and lemon juice, cook 2-3 mins. Lower flame, add fresh cream and stir. Serve hot with paratha, roti or rice.

name: Kheer Puda
instructions: For kheer: Wash and soak rice for 1 hour. Soak almonds for 1 hour, peel and cut into slivers. Cook soaked rice in milk in pressure cooker on low heat without whistling for 15-20 minutes. Add almond slivers, raisins, cardamom powder and condensed milk, cook for 1-2 minutes. For puda: Mix water, sugar and saffron, cook until sugar dissolves. Mix wheat flour and rava, add syrup gradually while whisking until smooth, add fennel seeds and peppercorns. Heat ghee in pan, add spoonful of batter, shape into mini uttapam, flip and cook until golden on both sides. Serve puda separately and pour warm kheer over or dip.

name: Peri Peri Tawa Anda
instructions: Mix all spices for peri peri seasoning and store in jar. Heat butter and oil in pan on medium flame, add onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté for few minutes. Add capsicum and tomatoes, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add sweet corn, salt and peri peri seasoning, mix well, cook for 1-2 minutes. Add water and mix. Add fresh coriander leaves. Break eggs directly into pan, sprinkle salt and pepper, grate processed cheese on top. Sprinkle peri peri seasoning and coriander. Cover and cook for 4-5 minutes on low flame. Serve hot with toasted bread.

name: Tava Burger
instructions: Heat butter and oil, add jeera and sauté. Add onions, green chillies and ginger garlic paste, sauté for 2 minutes. Add capsicum, carrots and french beans, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add tomatoes, salt, powdered spices, pav bhaji masala, schezwan sauce and ketchup, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add boiled mashed potatoes and break down ingredients with masher. Add coriander leaves and mix. For assembly: Slice burger buns in two halves, spread masala filling on one half. Top with chopped onions and grated cheese, place top half. Heat butter on tawa with pav bhaji masala, place burger and toast on both sides until crisp and golden. Serve with tomato ketchup.

name: Saagwala Mutton
instructions: Marinate mutton with salt, red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste and curd for at least 30 minutes. Blanch spinach for 2 minutes and dip in ice cold water. Grind blanched spinach with green chillies and coriander into fine paste. Heat ghee, add whole spices and sauté. Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown, add ginger garlic paste and sauté. Add powdered spices, tomato puree and salt, cook for 4-5 minutes. Add marinated mutton and cook for 10-12 minutes on high flame. Lower flame, cover and cook until mutton is done, stirring at intervals. Add hot water if masala gets too dry, or pressure cook for 3-4 whistles after adding marinated mutton. When mutton is 90% cooked, add spinach puree and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala, lemon juice and coriander, cook for 10-12 minutes on low flame. Serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: Egg Kadai
instructions: Make kadhai masala by roasting and grinding whole spices. Poke boiled eggs with toothpick and fry in ghee with spices for 2-3 minutes. In a wok, heat ghee and sauté garlic-ginger until fragrant. Add tomatoes and cook until mushy. Add turmeric, coriander, chilli powder and kadhai masala, cook 1-2 minutes. Add water and curd, simmer until ghee separates. Add fried eggs and adjust consistency. Add onion petals, capsicum, tomatoes, green chillies, garam masala and cream, cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with fresh coriander.

name: Veg Burmese Khao Swè
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water with oil for 6-7 minutes, rinse and set aside. Blend onions, garlic, ginger, turmeric and red chilli powder into paste. Heat oil and cook paste for 3-4 minutes. Add diced vegetables and cook 2-3 minutes. Add coconut milk and bring to boil. Mix gram flour with water and pass through sieve, add to soup. Boil for 8-10 minutes. Assemble by placing boiled noodles in bowl, pour hot soup, top with roasted peanuts, onion slices, fried noodles, fried onions, coriander, spring onions and lemon wedge.

name: Anda Malai Kofta
instructions: Mix boiled egg, paneer, salt, pepper, chillies, ginger, chilli powder, corn flour, mint and coriander, bind with whisked egg. Shape into tikkis and refrigerate 15 minutes. Fry until golden brown, handling carefully due to oil splattering. For puree: heat ghee, sauté jeera, cardamom and onions until light golden. Add garlic, ginger, chillies, cashews and tomatoes, cook 2-3 minutes, cover and cook 10-15 minutes. Cool and grind to fine puree. For gravy: heat ghee on low flame, add chillies, ginger, spices and sauté 1 minute. Add puree and cook 4-5 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and cook 2-3 minutes. Add fried koftas and cook 2 minutes. Add fresh cream, cook 1-2 minutes and finish with coriander.

name: Kung Pao Potatoes
ingredients: salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Par boil potatoes, peel and cut into cubes. Shallow fry cubes until crisp and golden brown, set aside on absorbent paper. Heat oil in pan on high heat, add ginger, garlic and dry chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add capsicum, spring onion bulbs, roasted peanuts, sugar and sichuan peppers, sauté for 1 minute. Add red chilli sauce, ketchup and soy sauce, mix and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add water, salt and white pepper. Mix cornstarch with water and add to thicken sauce. Add fried potatoes and toss well. Finish with fresh spring onion greens and serve hot.

name: Mini Ragda Pattice Sliders
instructions: For ragda: soak white peas overnight, drain and pressure cook with water, salt, turmeric and ginger for 2 whistles. Heat oil, add jeera, hing and ginger-garlic paste, sauté 1 minute. Add chilli powder, coriander powder, jeera powder, boiled peas, salt and garam masala, cook 3-4 minutes. Add fresh coriander. For aloo tikki: mix mashed potatoes, poha, ginger, chillies, coriander, mint, kasuri methi and all spices. Shape into mini tikkis and shallow fry until golden. Assembly: slice pav into quarters, spread garlic chutney, place mini tikki, add ragda, tamarind chutney, mint chutney, onions, tomatoes and sev. Top with pav and secure with toothpick.

name: Cheese Burst Paneer Tikka Masala Pizza Squares
instructions: For tikka masala gravy: heat oil and butter, add jeera and let crackle. Add ginger-garlic paste, sauté 1 minute. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add tomato puree, cashew paste, salt, chilli powder and coriander powder, cook 7-8 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and fresh cream. For smoked paneer: coat paneer cubes with turmeric, chilli powder, jeera powder, coriander powder, amchur, black salt and melted butter. Place live charcoal in center, add ghee drops, cover and smoke 4-5 minutes. Assembly: cut bread edges, flatten with rolling pin. Place cheese slice and another bread on top. Apply tikka masala gravy, add processed cheese, smoked paneer, capsicum and onions. Heat butter in pan and toast 4-5 minutes on medium-low heat. Cut into squares and serve hot.

name: egg masala sandwich
instructions: Set a pan on medium heat, add oil and jeera and sauté for few seconds, add onions and cook until translucent, add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté for a minute. Add tomatoes, salt to taste, red chilli powder, coriander powder and turmeric powder, mix well and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add water and mix well. Add the boiled eggs to the masala and mix well, add garam masala and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Spread butter on bread slice followed by green chutney, spread the egg masala filling, place capsicum, tomato and onion slices, sprinkle sandwich masala and grate processed cheese, spread butter and red garlic chutney on other bread slice and close. Apply butter on top and bottom and toast on a pan or griller until crisp and golden brown. Cut into triangles and serve with tomato ketchup, chutney or dip.

name: dabeli fryums
instructions: Heat oil in a wok, add jeera, hing, dabeli masala, boiled and mashed potatoes, sugar, tamarind pulp, and salt. Mix and combine well. Add freshly chopped coriander leaves and allow to cool to room temperature. Once cooled, add fresh grated coconut, crushed masala peanuts, pomegranate, onions, red garlic chutney and tamarind chutney, mix well and add freshly chopped coriander leaves. Fill dabeli mixture in a piping bag. Set oil on medium high heat for frying the fryums, fry until they puff up and remove on absorbent paper. Pipe dabeli filling in the fryums cavity and coat the ends with fresh grated coconut, sev and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Serve immediately with garlic chutney and tamarind chutney.

name: mutton kheema ghotala
instructions: Set boiling water in a wok, add salt, turmeric powder, ginger and garlic, mix well and add mutton kheema, cook for 10-15 minutes. Strain cooked kheema and reserve stock. Set a pan on medium heat, add oil and whole spices and sauté for a minute, add onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli and sauté for a minute, add powdered spices and mix well. Add tomatoes and salt, and cook until tomatoes are mushy. Add green peas and cook for 4-5 minutes, add 100 ml reserved mutton stock and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add cooked boiled mutton kheema and mix well, add reserved mutton stock as required and cook for 8-10 mins. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes. Break eggs directly over the mutton kheema, scramble the eggs and let it cook, cover and cook for a minute. Add lemon juice and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Place sunny side up and serve hot with bread or pav.

name: Egg Rolls
instructions: Prepare egg roll wrappers or use store-bought. Fill with eggs and seasonings. Roll tightly and deep fry until golden and crispy. Serve hot.

name: Anda Masala Pav
instructions: Cut pav into cubes and set aside. Heat oil and butter, add jeera and sauté, then add onions until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and red chilli paste, cook 2-3 minutes. Add capsicum, tomatoes, salt, turmeric, and pav bhaji masala, cook 3-4 minutes. Add water and cook 3-4 minutes more. Grate boiled eggs into the masala and cook 2-3 minutes. Add pav cubes and mix gently, cook 1 minute. Finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot.

name: Dal Vada with Ragda Hummus
instructions: For dal vada: Soak chana dal 4 hours. Grind soaked dal with curry leaves, coriander, jeera, garlic, green chillies, turmeric, and salt coarsely. Mix with chopped onions, green chillies, rice flour, and warm oil. Shape into roundels, flatten, and deep fry on medium-low heat until crispy and golden. For ragda hummus: Cook soaked white peas 15-20 minutes until tender. Grind cooked peas with tahini, garlic, jeera powder, garam masala, red chilli powder, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and olive oil to smooth paste, adjusting consistency with reserved chickpea water. Serve vada hot with ragda hummus and fresh salad.

name: Kung Pao Wedges
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges and rinse with ice-cold water. Par boil potatoes in salted water, don't overcook. Toss par-boiled potatoes with corn flour and baking powder in a zip-lock bag, seal and shake well. Freeze for at least 2 hours. Deep fry frozen wedges until crispy and golden. Remove and drain on tissue paper. In a pan, heat oil, add crushed garlic, whole red chillies, roasted peanuts, and spring onion whites. Add soya sauce, red chilli sauce, sugar, pepper, and salt. Add fried wedges and mix well. Top with spring onion greens. Serve hot.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Wash rice 4-5 times until starch washed out. Soak rice in fresh water 30 minutes. Boil water with salt and oil, add soaked rice and cook until almost done, about 12-15 minutes. Strain excess water and keep cooked rice aside. Reserve 1/4 cup cooking water. Heat wok on high heat, add oil, garlic, dry red chillies, and spring onion greens, sauté on high flame. Add cooked rice, sugar, salt, and black pepper, mix and toss well. Add soy sauce and vinegar, stir well. Make space in rice and break eggs directly in pan, scramble and cook eggs, then mix with rice. Add reserved starchy water and toss well. Serve hot with Chinese gravy of choice.

name: Shahi Sookhi Dal
instructions: Rinse urad dal with fresh water. Set water for boiling, add washed dal, salt, and turmeric powder. Cook on medium flame 20-25 minutes until dal is cooked and can be mashed with fingers. Strain excess water. Heat ghee in wok on medium heat, add whole red chillies and nuts, sauté few seconds, add powdered spices and sauté 1 minute. Add cooked dal and mix well, adjust salt. Finish with fresh chopped coriander leaves. Garnish with fried onions and fried nuts. Serve with roti or paratha.

name: Garlic Bread Sticks
instructions: Add warm water, sugar and yeast, let it become frothy. Mix refined flour, milk powder, salt, pepper and garlic paste. Add warm water and yeast mixture, knead soft dough for 15-20 minutes with oil. Cover and rest for 1.5 hours until doubled. Knead again and divide into 6 dough balls, rest 15 minutes. Flatten into chapati shape, sprinkle oregano and fold. Place on greased tray with oregano, brush melted butter and make incisions. Bake at 250°C for 15-18 minutes. Cut along incisions and serve hot with cheese dip.

name: Chinese Pocket Samosa
ingredients: oil 2 tbsp plus oil for frying
instructions: Shred cabbage, capsicum and carrots. Add salt and rest 2 minutes, squeeze out moisture using muslin cloth. Heat oil, sauté garlic, ginger and chillies for 1 minute. Add squeezed vegetables, beans, corn and sugar, sauté for 1 minute. Add sauces, sauté for 1 minute and finish with spring onion greens. Make flour slurry. Divide samosa patti into 4 strips, apply slurry in centre and place another strip to form plus sign. Fill with vegetables and fold, sealing with slurry. Heat oil and fry samosas until golden brown. Serve hot with sweet and sour dipping sauce.

name: Garlic Pepper Crispy Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into 1 cm dices. Boil water with salt and blanch potato dices for 2-3 minutes, cool down. Mix with corn flour, salt and pepper, rest 5 minutes. Fry on medium-low flame until light golden, cool for 5-6 minutes. Refry on high flame until crisp and golden brown. Heat 1 tbsp fried garlic oil, sauté almond slivers until golden. Add broken red chilli and spring onion bulbs, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add crispy potatoes, crushed pepper, fried garlic, spring onion greens, salt and vinegar. Toss quickly and serve hot and crispy.

name: Pasta in makhani sauce
instructions: Boil pasta in water with oil and salt until al dente, cool and coat with oil. Heat butter, sauté jeera, add onion, ginger, garlic, chillies, cashews and tomatoes with spices. Cook 6-7 minutes, cool and grind to paste. In a wok, heat butter, sauté flour, add milk slowly and whisk to avoid lumps. Add makhani paste, cook 2-3 minutes. Add capsicum, oregano, salt and cheese, stir and cook 2 minutes. Add boiled pasta, stir and cook 1 minute. Serve hot with garlic bread.

name: Paneer club sandwich
instructions: Cut paneer into 1 cm thick slabs, season with salt and pepper, marinate with ginger-garlic paste. Grill paneer on both sides, cool and slice into thin strips. Mix mayonnaise with black pepper, chopped garlic and parsley. Caramelize sliced onions with oil and butter until cooked. Toast bread slices with butter. Layer toasted bread with garlic mayo, lettuce, paneer strips and caramelized onions, add another bread slice with cheese and tomato slices topped with peri peri fries. Place final toasted bread slice with mayo inside. Slice into triangles and secure with toothpick. Serve with ketchup and potato chips.

name: Masala egg french toast
instructions: Heat oil in wok, sauté onions until translucent, add green chillies and ginger-garlic paste. Add powdered spices and salt, sauté for a minute. Add chopped capsicum and sauté. Mix in boiled and mashed potatoes, cook 2-3 minutes, add coriander and cool. Spread potato mixture on bread slice, place cheese slice, add more potato mixture on top. Whisk 5 eggs with coriander, salt and pepper. Dip potato-filled bread in egg mixture and coat well. Heat oil on tawa, cook coated bread on medium flame from all sides until golden. Serve hot with green chutney or ketchup.

name: Smoked roasted chilli chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, green chilli paste, salt, black pepper, soy sauce and vinegar. Place live charcoal in center, add oil drops, cover and smoke for 15 minutes. Roast marinated chicken in pan with oil for 15-20 minutes. Set wok on high heat, add oil, sauté garlic, ginger, green chillies and spring onion for 1 minute. Add capsicum, bell peppers, cabbage, mushroom and carrots, sauté 2-3 minutes on high flame. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt and pepper, sauté for 1 minute. Add water and cornstarch mixture, cook until sauce thickens. Add roasted chicken, stir and cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with spring onion greens. Serve hot.

name: Gajrela
instructions: Peel and grate carrots using large-hole grater. Heat pan on medium, add 1 tbsp ghee and nuts, roast until golden brown. Set heavy-bottom pan on medium heat, add milk and bring to boil while stirring at intervals. Add grated carrots and continue cooking on medium heat while stirring. Cook on medium-low heat until milk reduces and mixture thickens, about 45-50 minutes. Add sugar and cardamom powder, mix well and cook for 12-15 minutes. Add 2 tbsp ghee and cook another 5-7 minutes, stirring continuously as there is no liquid. Add roasted nuts and raisins, stir and mix well. Serve hot or warm garnished with chopped nuts.

name: Sweet and sour chicken
instructions: Slice chicken breast into thin pieces. In a bowl add chicken, salt, white pepper, ginger, garlic, soy sauce and Chinese cooking wine, mix well. Add whole egg and corn flour, mix to coat evenly. Heat oil for frying, fry chicken on medium-high heat until crisp and light golden brown. Heat oil in wok, sauté ginger and garlic for 1 minute on medium flame. Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, tomato ketchup, white pepper powder and salt. Add cornstarch mixed with water, cook until sauce thickens. Add fried chicken and toss for 1 minute. Add spring onion greens and toss again. Top with toasted white sesame seeds. Serve hot.

name: Triple schezwan maggi
instructions: Set pan on high heat, add oil, ginger and garlic with spring onion bulbs, sauté for 1 minute. Add carrot, cabbage, capsicum and mushroom, sauté for 1 minute. Add schezwan sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, light soy sauce, vinegar and salt and pepper, stir and cook for 1 minute. Add 200 ml water with cornstarch mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Add spring onion greens and set aside. Heat oil in another pan on high heat, add green chillies, garlic and sliced onions, sauté for 1 minute. Add 2 cups water and maggi noodles with maggi masala, mix well and cook until done. Place cooked maggi as base and pour freshly made vegetable schezwan sauce on top. Serve hot.

name: Tava Chicken Frankie
instructions: Season and griddle chicken pieces on tava, prepare with aromatic spices, serve with flatbread or wrapper

name: Jain Schezwan Frankie
instructions: Knead flour dough, rest 30 minutes, boil and mash raw bananas with spices for filling, prepare schezwan sauce from red chillies and aromatics, half-cook rotis, assemble with filling, sauce and toppings, finish on griddle

name: Wheat Flour Uttapam
instructions: Mix wheat flour, salt, baking powder and curd, add water to make semi-thick batter, rest 15 minutes, prepare paneer bhurji by cooking paneer with tomatoes, onions and spices, prepare peri-peri corn mix, prepare chatpata aloo with chutney and spices, heat griddle with oil, pour batter, top with chosen toppings, cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden

name: Super Oats Muffins
instructions: Mix dry ingredients of oats, flour and baking powder, combine wet ingredients of eggs, sugar and butter, fold together until combined, pour into muffin cups, bake until golden

name: Veg Cooker Pulao
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly, heat oil in cooker and add whole spices, add sliced onions and cook until translucent, add ginger-garlic paste and chillies, add powdered spices, add chopped tomatoes and salt, add carrots, potatoes, peas and cooked soya chunks, pour water and bring to boil, add soaked rice, coriander and lemon wedges, pressure cook 1 whistle on medium flame, let cool naturally

name: Paneer Lasooni
instructions: Make tomato-onion gravy: cook onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, cashew nuts with spices for 15 minutes, cool and grind to fine puree, in separate pan heat oil with jeera, add julienned ginger, chillies, onions and garlic, cook 4-5 minutes, add tomato gravy, lower heat and add whisked curd slowly, add sugar and salt, cook 4-5 minutes, add garam masala and kasuri methi, gently add paneer cubes, finish with cream and butter

name: Crispy Veg
instructions: Combine refined flour, corn flour, salt and pepper, whisk well. Add baking powder and mix. Add all vegetables and coat well. Heat oil for frying, fry at medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes, drain on absorbent paper, then refry at high heat until crisp and golden. In wok, heat oil and sauté garlic, ginger, spring onions, green chillies for a minute. Add all sauces, salt and white pepper, sauté on high heat for a minute. Add fried vegetables and toss well to coat. Garnish with spring onion greens and serve hot.

name: Vada Pav Bites
instructions: For toast: cut bread using cookie cutter into rounds and toast on both sides with butter until crisp. For potato mixture: heat oil, add mustard seeds, jeera, curry leaves. Add ginger-garlic and green chilli pastes, cook 1 minute. Add turmeric powder, mashed potatoes and salt, cook 2-3 minutes. Add coriander and lemon juice, cool to room temperature. For vadas: make batter with gram flour, ajwain, salt and water, rest 10 minutes. Shape potato mixture into balls, coat with batter, deep fry at medium-high heat until golden. For red garlic chutney: soak chillies 30 minutes, blend with garlic, black salt, cumin powder, garam masala and water. Assembly: spread chutney on toasted bread, place fried vada, serve with fried green chillies tossed with salt.

name: Chur Chur Naan
instructions: For dough: mix refined flour, curd and salt. Gradually add water to knead soft, stretchy dough. Add oil and knead until smooth. Oil surface, cover with damp cloth, rest 30 minutes. Knead again, tuck inward. Divide into equal balls, keep covered. For paneer mixture: mix all ingredients thoroughly. For naan: coat dough ball with flour, flatten by hand, roll thin with pin. Spread ghee, make pleats by overlapping fingers, roll like swiss roll. When reaching end, tuck in and form cup-like cavity. Fill with paneer mixture and close edges, roll into ball. Flatten, dust flour, roll into thick naan. Spread ghee, sprinkle red chilli powder and coriander leaves, press to stick. Lightly coat with water. Place on baking tray and bake in convection/grill mode at 180°C for 15 minutes. Serve hot, crush lightly, add butter and sprinkle chaat masala.

name: Malai Tikka Roll
instructions: Marinate chicken slices in yogurt and cream mixture with spices for 1 hour. Grill marinated chicken. Prepare egg laccha paratha by cooking paratha, then pouring whisked egg and flipping to cook. Assemble by spreading mint chutney on paratha, adding onion salad and grilled chicken, squeeze lemon and sprinkle chaat masala, then roll.

name: Baked Vegetables with White Sauce
instructions: Make white sauce by heating butter, adding flour, then gradually whisking in milk, add cheese and spices. Sauté blanched vegetables with olive oil and seasonings. Combine vegetables with white sauce, pour into baking dish, top with cheese. Bake at 180°C for 10-12 minutes until golden. Serve with toasted garlic bread.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala Mac N Cheese
instructions: Boil macaroni until al dente and coat with olive oil. In a wok, sauté onions and garlic, add capsicum and tomatoes, then tomato puree and powdered spices. Add paneer cubes and milk, then boiled macaroni and grated cheese. Add oats powder and cook for 2-3 minutes until creamy. Serve hot.

name: Sabudana Vada Bombs
instructions: Soak sabudana for 4-5 hours. Tie curd in muslin cloth for 2-3 hours to make hung curd, then mix with spices for filling. Mix soaked sabudana with boiled potatoes, sugar, lemon juice, green chillies, herbs and crushed peanuts. Flatten mixture on palm, place spoonful of hung curd filling in center, seal and shape into tikki. Deep fry on medium-high flame until golden, undisturbed for 1 minute before flipping.

name: No Onion No Garlic Paneer Makhani
instructions: Heat oil and tempering spices, add tomatoes and cashews, cook until mushy. Blend into fine paste. In another pan, heat oil and butter, add asafoetida and tomato paste. Add powdered spices and sugar, cook 4-5 minutes. Add paneer cubes and cook 2-3 minutes. Lower flame, add cream and cook 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala and kasuri methi. Smoke with charcoal for 2-3 minutes. Garnish with coriander and fresh cream. Serve hot.

name: Farali Aloo Bhajiya
instructions: Peel and slice potatoes into thin roundels. Mix potatoes with green chillies, ajwain, anardana powder, black pepper, cumin and rock salt. In separate bowl, mix rajgira flour with water to make batter and rest for 15 minutes. Coat potato slices in batter. Deep fry on medium flame until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with farali chutney made from coriander, mint, anardana, green chillies and black salt.

name: Malai Kofta with White Gravy
instructions: Make kofta filling: grate paneer and boiled potatoes, mix with salt, pepper, coriander, garam masala, cornflour, ginger and green chillies. Form balls, press center, add cashews and raisins, seal. Coat with cornstarch and fry until golden. For gravy: make onion-cashew paste by blending onions, chillies, cashews and water, then boiling and cooling. Heat oil with whole spices, add paste and cook until thick. Add cream, sugar, coriander powder, black pepper and salt. Add whisked curd, cook until oil separates. Adjust consistency with water. Add garam masala and kasuri methi. Serve kofta mixed in or topped with gravy.

name: Green Gobi Aloo
instructions: Blend onions, green chillies, garlic and fresh coriander into fine paste. Heat oil, add jeera and sauté briefly. Add ginger and paste, mix well. Add coriander powder, jeera powder and aamchur powder, cook for a minute. Add potatoes and cauliflower florets, mix well. Add salt and cook 4-5 minutes, then cover and cook 15-20 minutes while stirring occasionally. Check if potatoes and cauliflower are done, add splash of water if needed. Finish with black pepper, garam masala, lemon juice and fresh coriander. Serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Masala Bajra Khichdi
instructions: Soak bajra for 2-3 hours or overnight. Heat ghee in pressure cooker without lid, add jeera to crackle, add soaked bajra and moong dal, mix well. Add water and pressure cook on medium flame for 3-4 whistles. Allow cooker to depressurize naturally. Stir well. In a wok, heat ghee, add green chillies and ginger, sauté. Add chopped onions and cook until translucent. Add diced potatoes and cook 5-6 minutes. Add tomatoes, carrots, peas and french beans, mix well. Add powdered spices and salt, cook 3-4 minutes. Add cooked bajra and dal, stir well and cook 4-5 minutes more. Heat ghee with hing in a tadka pan, add to dal mixture. Finish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

name: Aloo Lachha Paratha
instructions: For filling: In a bowl add boiled potatoes, mash them, add fresh coriander, mint, ginger, green chillies, powdered spices and salt, mix well. Add chopped onions just before making parathas. For dough: Mix flour, ajwain and salt, add water and knead a soft dough. Oil the surface and cover with damp cloth, rest for 30 minutes. Knead again and divide into small balls. Flatten balls, dust with dry flour and roll into large chapati. Apply layer of potato filling and ghee. Fold chapati and make a roll. Cook on hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear. Apply ghee, flip and cook on both sides. Serve hot with butter and curd or chutney.

name: Punjabi Style Pinni
instructions: Grind gond granules into fine powder. Transfer nuts to grinding jar and grind coarsely. In a heavy-bottom deep pan or kadhai on medium heat, add ghee and wheat flour, stir continuously. As ghee is absorbed by flour, texture becomes sandy. Keep stirring and roast flour until light brown biscuit color. Switch off heat immediately. Add ground gond powder and let it crackle, mix and incorporate well. Add powdered sugar, dry ginger powder and cardamom powder, mix well. Finally add coarsely ground nuts, raisins and pumpkin seeds, mix and combine well. Transfer to larger vessel and beat with spatula to release ghee. Take spoonfuls of mixture and shape into ovals or desired shape. Can press halved almonds or cashews on top. Store in airtight container in cool, dry, hygienic place.

name: Broccoli Tandoori Makhani
instructions: Blanch broccoli florets in boiling water for 2 minutes, dip in ice water. Mix mustard oil, spices, ginger garlic paste and curd, marinate broccoli 15 minutes. Grill marinated broccoli on both sides. For makhani gravy: heat butter, add jeera, sauté onion, ginger, garlic, kashmiri chillies, cashew nuts and tomatoes, add spices, cook 1 minute, add water, cover and cook 6-7 minutes. Cool and grind to puree. Heat butter and oil, add ginger and gravy, cook 1 minute, add tandoori broccoli, salt, garam masala, kasuri methi, honey and cream, cook 2 minutes, add coriander. Place live charcoal in ghee, cover and smoke 5-6 minutes.

name: Delhi Style Matar Kulcha
instructions: Soak white peas 5-6 hours. Cook soaked peas with water, salt, turmeric and ginger, pressure cook 2 whistles. Heat ghee, add cumin and hing, sauté 1 minute. Add ginger garlic paste, green chillies, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add onions, sauté until golden. Add tomatoes, spices, cook until mushy. Add cooked peas, cook 2-3 minutes, add garam masala, kasuri methi, coriander. For kulchas: mix flour, salt, baking powder, milk powder, sugar, curd and oil, knead soft dough, rest 30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten, roll into oblong shape, cook on tawa until spots appear, apply ghee, flip and cook both sides. Serve with peas and tadka salad.

name: Veg Kurkure Kabab
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, sauté. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add vegetables, red chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add boiled mashed potatoes and salt, mix and mash. Add amchur powder, garam masala, kasuri methi, mint and coriander leaves, mix well. Cool mixture, add grated paneer and cheese, mix well. Freeze mixture in tray for minimum 30 minutes. Demould and cut into squares or fingers. Make slurry with maida and water. Dip fingers in slurry, coat with crushed vermicelli. Deep fry on medium high heat until crisp and golden brown.

name: Paneer Makhani Dum Biryani
instructions: Cook rice until 3/4th done with water, salt, whole spices, lemon, ghee, mint and coriander, drain excess water. For paneer makhani: heat butter and oil, add jeera. Add onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, kashmiri chillies, cashew nuts, spices and water, cover and cook 8-10 minutes. Cool and grind to fine puree. Add curd, fresh cream, kasuri methi and fried onions, mix well. Add paneer and salt, mix. For assembly: spread ghee on casserole base, layer paneer makhani, mint, coriander, fried onions, rice. Repeat layering. Top with rice, coriander, mint, fried onions and ghee. Seal with dough. Cook on low flame 15-20 minutes. Place live charcoal with ghee, cover and smoke 3-4 minutes.

name: Mutton Shahi Korma
instructions: Heat ghee, add sliced onions, cook on medium heat until brown, spread on paper towel. Soak cashew nuts in hot water 10 minutes. Grind fried onions and soaked cashews to fine paste. Marinate mutton with ginger garlic paste, salt, curd, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder and lemon juice for 30 minutes minimum. Heat same ghee, add whole spices, green chillies and ginger garlic paste, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add marinated mutton, cook on medium flame until ghee is released. Add crushed fried onions, cook. Add cashew paste, cook 8-10 minutes. Add hot water and salt, mix well. Cover and cook on low medium flame 1-1.5 hours until mutton is tender. Add saffron water, kewra water and fresh garam masala, mix well. Cover and cook 8-10 minutes on low flame.

name: Bombay Pav Bhaji Sizzler
instructions: Heat oil and butter with jeera and sauté briefly. Add onions until translucent, then red chilli and garlic paste until oil separates. Add capsicum, peas, tomatoes, potatoes, and beetroot, cook 5 minutes. Add pav bhaji masala, salt, water, and cook 2-3 minutes until tomatoes are mushy. Mash vegetables and cook 5 more minutes. Add garam masala, coriander, lemon juice. For tawa pulav: repeat base with cumin, then add cabbage, capsicum, tomatoes, peas, pav bhaji masala, water, cook 2 minutes. Add rice and cook 5-6 minutes. Add spring onions. Assembly: heat sizzler plate until smoking hot, add cabbage, place rice shaped in bowl, add pav bhaji, french fries, toasted pav, top with butter.

name: Veg Shashlik Chinese Sizzler
instructions: For grilled veggies: Mix ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, salt, pepper, oil. Coat veggies and paneer, skewer, and grill until golden. For chilli garlic sauce: Heat oil, sauté garlic, ginger, green chillies, spring onion bulbs 1 minute. Add soy sauce, water, sugar, salt, pepper. Add cornstarch slurry and cook until thickened. Add spring onion greens. For veg fortune rice: Heat oil, add star anise and garlic, sauté 1 minute. Add veggies, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add sugar and paneer, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt, pepper, sauté 1 minute. Add splash of water and rice, toss well. Add spring onion greens. Assembly: Heat sizzler plate until smoking hot, spread cabbage, place rice, grilled veggies, french fries, pour chilli garlic sauce.

name: Paneer Pav Bhaji
instructions: Heat butter and oil on medium heat, add jeera and sauté few seconds. Add onions and cook until translucent. Add kashmiri red chilli paste and garlic paste, cook until oil is released. Add veggies, salt, turmeric, coriander powder, pav bhaji masala, mix and mash well, cook 4-5 minutes. Add water and continue cooking 3-4 minutes. Grate paneer and add, continue cooking 4-5 minutes. Add garam masala, lemon juice, fresh coriander, and butter. For pav: heat butter, add red chilli paste, pav bhaji masala, fresh coriander, mix well and toast pav on all sides. Serve hot bhaji with toasted pav, top with butter, chopped onions, and lemon wedges.

name: Cheesy Pav Bhaji Masala Omelette
instructions: Heat oil, add jeera, sauté few seconds. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add garlic and red chilli paste, cook until oil separates. Add capsicum, tomatoes, turmeric, pav bhaji masala, salt, cook 2-3 minutes. Add water, mix well, mash with masher. Add lemon juice and coriander leaves. Set aside. In separate bowl, break eggs, add salt, pepper, water, whisk well until frothy. Heat pan on low heat, add butter, pour whisked eggs. Cook on low heat. Add freshly prepared pav bhaji masala on half side of omelette, add mozzarella cheese, fold into half. Cover and cook 2-3 minutes on low flame. Sprinkle pav bhaji masala powder, fresh coriander, cut into strips and serve hot.

name: Stuffed Tandoori Mushroom
instructions: Mix all paneer filling ingredients and set aside. Mix all marination ingredients in separate bowl. Remove mushroom stems and stuff cavities with paneer filling. Coat stuffed mushrooms well with marination, add capsicum and tomatoes, mix well. Skew marinated mushrooms, capsicum, tomatoes on bamboo skewers. Place live charcoal in centre, add few drops of ghee, cover and smoke 4-5 minutes. Marinate 15 minutes. For hari chutney: grind mint leaves, green chillies, spring onion bulbs and greens, garlic cloves, anardana powder, lemon juice, salt to fine paste, adjust consistency with water. For grilling: heat ghee or oil in pan on medium heat, grill marinated mushrooms from all sides until golden brown. Serve hot with freshly prepared hari chutney.

name: tandoori chicken chaat
instructions: Make incisions on chicken breast. Mix mustard oil and red chilli powder, add powdered spices, hung curd, ginger garlic paste, roasted besan and salt. Marinate chicken for 30 minutes. Heat oil in grill pan and cook marinated chicken on both sides for 4-5 minutes. Cut chicken slices diagonally and pull with fork. Place chicken pull in serving bowl, squeeze lemon, sprinkle chaat masala, pour curd. Add jeera powder, mint chutney, tamarind chutney, crushed puris, chopped tomato, onions, sev and coriander. Top with pomegranate seeds. Smoke with burning charcoal on onion slice, pour ghee, cover for 2-3 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: crunchy aloo tikki with cheese crown
instructions: Heat oil, add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add chana dal and cook 2-3 minutes. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, anardana powder, aamchur powder, jeera powder and salt, cook 1-2 minutes. Add mashed potatoes and cook 4-5 minutes. Transfer to bowl and cool. Add beetroot, fresh coriander and soaked bread, mix well. Shape into tikkis. Heat oil and shallow fry tikkis on both sides until crispy and golden. For cheese crown: grate processed cheese, spread thin layer on non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook until golden brown, immediately shape on inverted glass to cool. Make mint hung curd dip by mixing curd, mint leaves, salt and pepper. Serve tikki with cheese crown on top and mint curd dip on side.

name: toasties 4 ways
instructions: For pav bhaji toasties: Mix mashed potatoes, chopped tomatoes, onions, capsicum, garlic, pav bhaji masala powder, salt, lemon juice and coriander. Spread on bread slices and garnish. For spinach toasties: Mix blanched spinach, hung curd, onions, garlic, salt, pepper, red chilli flakes, lemon juice. Spread on bread and top with grated paneer. For corn toasties: Mix grated cheese, green chillies, boiled corn kernels, black pepper powder. Spread on bread and garnish with more chillies. For schezwan paneer: Mix grated paneer, diced capsicum, schezwan sauce, black pepper, spring onion greens. Spread on bread and top with toasted sesame seeds. Place bread slices in microwave oven, press convection + grill button, set temperature to 180C, set timer for 10 minutes. Cook until golden and crispy. Serve hot with dip of choice.

name: veg manchurian dosa
instructions: For manchurian balls: mix all vegetables with ginger garlic paste, green chillies, salt, black pepper, soy sauce, red chilli sauce and flours. Make small portions and fry on medium-high flame until crisp and golden. Remove on paper towel. For sauce: heat oil in wok, add chopped garlic, ginger and green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add onions, capsicum, cabbage, stir and cook 1 minute on high. Add salt, pepper, all sauces and cook 1 minute high. Add manchurian balls and stir. Finish with spring onion greens. For dosa batter: mix rava, salt and curd, rest 30 minutes minimum. Add water gradually, whisk to pouring consistency. Pour 1-2 spoonfuls on medium-hot tava and spread to make dosa. Drizzle oil after spreading. Add manchurian filling. Cover and cook 3-4 minutes. Add chopped spring onion greens. Serve hot and crispy with coconut chutney or schezwan sauce.

name: no onion no garlic bhindi masala
instructions: Wash lady finger well and wipe dry. Prefer small size; if big, cut in halves. Cut head and make incision in between. Heat oil in pan on medium-high and shallow fry lady finger until half cooked. Remove and keep aside. Heat 1 tbsp oil in another pan on medium, add jeera and hing, sauté 30 seconds. Add chopped tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and amchur powder, cook masala 2-3 minutes. Reduce heat, add dahi and stir continuously 1-2 minutes. Add water and cook until oil is released. Add half-cooked lady finger, kasuri methi and garam masala, mix well. Cover and cook on low flame 2-3 minutes. Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Egg & Mayo Sandwich
instructions: For filling: Chop boiled eggs, add mayonnaise, spring onion greens, salt and pepper. Mix well. For sandwich: Beat 2 eggs with salt, pepper, red chilly powder, green chilly and coriander. Heat butter on tava, pour whisked eggs. Cook omelette evenly. Add bread slices, coat with uncooked egg and flip. Cut edges and stack. Apply egg & mayo filling between bread. Cook both sides until crisp and golden. Cut into triangles and serve.

name: Mumbai Style Masala Toast Sandwich
instructions: Make green chutney by grinding coriander, spinach, green chillies, garlic, chana dal and curry leaves. Make sandwich masala by dry roasting whole spices, grinding with powdered spices and salt. Make aloo masala: temper cumin and mustard in oil, add curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste, then powdered spices, add boiled potatoes, peas, coriander and lemon juice. For assembly: trim bread, apply butter and chutney, add aloo masala on one slice, layer beetroot, onion, tomato, capsicum, season with masala, add cheese if desired, top with bread. Toast on both sides until golden. Cut, apply butter and chutney, top with sev and masala.

name: Mumbai Style Veg Frankie
instructions: For aloo patty: Heat oil and butter, temper jeera, add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add powdered spices and water, cook 1-2 minutes. Add boiled potatoes, salt, coriander and lemon juice. Cool and shape into half-foot-long patties. Apply refined flour slurry on both sides and cook until golden on tawa. For frankie roti: Knead refined flour with salt, curd, water and oil into soft stretchy dough. Rest 30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten and roll thick rotis. Cook briefly on both sides on tawa. For chutney: Grind coriander, mint, green chillies, ginger, tamarind pulp and black salt. Make masala by mixing all spices. For assembly: Heat tawa with butter, cook roti briefly, add aloo patty and flip together. Sprinkle masala, add onions, chutney, chilli vinegar. Roll. Serve hot with optional schezwan sauce or cheese.

name: Egg Manchurian Dry
instructions: Hard boil eggs, cool and peel. Cut from centre to remove yolk, chop egg whites and add to bowl. Add sliced onions and other manchurian ball ingredients. Add corn starch and refined flour in batches to avoid doughy texture. Mix well using spatula or hands. Heat oil, reduce heat slightly. Using spoon, scoop mixture and shape into roundels, add to oil. Fry on medium-low heat without stirring for first minute. Fry until crisp and golden. Remove on paper. For sauce: Heat wok, add oil, sauté onion, garlic, ginger and chilli. Add spring onion greens, coriander, soy sauce, vinegar, red chilli sauce. Add stock and season with salt, pepper, sugar. Bring to boil. Make cornstarch slurry and add to thicken. Add spring onion bulbs and capsicum. Add fried manchurian balls and stir quickly. Garnish with spring onion greens. Serve immediately.

name: Matar Kulcha Pizza
instructions: Soak white peas for 5-6 hours or overnight. Drain and pressure cook with water, salt, turmeric and ginger for 2 whistles on medium flame. Let cool naturally. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and hing, sauté for a minute. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add onions and cook until golden brown. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add powdered spices and cook 1-2 minutes. Add cooked peas, mix and cook 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and coriander leaves. Cool completely. For assembly: Spread matar mixture on kulcha, top with sliced onions, tomatoes, capsicum, ginger, green chillies and coriander. Sprinkle red chilly powder, jeera powder, chaat masala and lemon juice. Heat butter and cook kulcha pizza with topping upside down. Grate cheese on top, cover and cook until cheese melts. Cut into quarters and serve hot.

name: Veg Soya Tikki
instructions: Cook soya granules in boiling water with salt for 2-3 minutes. Strain and rinse with cold water thoroughly. Squeeze out excess water. In a mixing bowl, add squeezed soya granules, boiled and mashed potatoes, ginger-garlic paste, green chillies and all vegetables. Add powdered spices and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Mix and mash well. Take a spoonful of mixture and shape into tikki. Mix refined flour with salt and water to make smooth slurry. Dip tikki in slurry and coat with bread crumbs. Fry on medium-high heat on both sides until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup or chutney, or make a burger.

name: Paneer Schezwan Rice Bowl
instructions: For paneer schezwan: Heat oil on slow flame, add garlic, ginger and capsicum, sauté. Add schezwan sauce, ketchup, red chilli sauce, black pepper and salt. Make cornstarch slurry with water and add to thicken. Add paneer and spring onion greens, keep aside. For rice: In a pan add oil, garlic, carrot, capsicum and sweet corn. Sauté and add sugar, salt and black pepper. Add cooked rice, spring onions and vinegar. Mix well. Serve rice with paneer schezwan gravy.

name: Pav Bhaji Khichdi
instructions: Wash dal and rice, add to cooker with 4 cups water and salt. Pressure cook for 3-4 whistles on medium-low flame. Let cool naturally and stir. Set wok on medium heat, add ghee and oil, jeera and cubed potatoes. Cook until potatoes are almost done. Add onions and garlic, cook 2-3 minutes. Add red chilli paste, cook 2-3 minutes. Add all vegetables, salt, hing and pav bhaji masala, turmeric powder. Mix well and cook 3-4 minutes. Add cooked khichdi to veggie masala, mix gently with light hands. Add water to adjust consistency. Cover and cook 4-5 minutes. Add lemon juice, fresh coriander and garam masala. Stir and cook a few more minutes. Serve hot with butter.

name: Veg Chinese Chop Suey
instructions: Boil noodles for 6-7 minutes, rinse with water, coat with cornstarch and shallow fry until crispy. For sauce: heat oil, sauté ginger, garlic, spring onion and green chillies. Add vegetables and sauté on high heat for 1-2 minutes. Add sauces and water, bring to boil. Thicken sauce with cornstarch slurry. Pour hot sauce over fried noodles and garnish with spring onion greens.

name: Instant Mawa Modak
instructions: Mix milk powder with milk gradually. Heat and cook on low flame for 5 minutes stirring continuously. Add ghee, saffron and cardamom powder, continue stirring until semi-thick. Add sugar and cook until thick dough-like consistency and ghee releases. Cool slightly, then hand-shape into modak balls, pinch upper part into cone shape, and create decorative ridges with fork.

name: Khatti Meethi Gujarati Dal
instructions: Rinse toor dal thoroughly. Pressure cook dal with salt and water for 3-4 whistles. Blend cooked dal to purée. Heat ghee, add mustard seeds, jeera, methi, curry leaves, hing, turmeric, chilli powder and dry chillies. Sauté then add dal purée. Add jaggery, tamarind and ginger. Simmer for 7-8 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and coriander. Serve hot with rice.

name: Chatpati Tandoori Shakarkandi
ingredients: olive oil 2 tbsp + oil for grilling
instructions: Boil sweet potatoes, cool and peel. Slice diagonally into 1 cm pieces. Mix olive oil, garlic, chilli flakes, tamarind chutney, black salt, mint and coriander. Coat sweet potatoes in mixture. Smoke with charcoal covered for 4-5 minutes. Grill on both sides until crispy and golden. Prepare curd dip with curd, garlic juice, black salt, red chilli powder and mint. Serve hot with curd dip.

name: Sabudana Vada Poppers
instructions: Soak sabudana for 4-5 hours. Hang curd for 2-3 hours. Mix hung curd with black pepper, salt, jeera powder and coriander, stuff into bhavnagri chillies. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with sugar, lemon juice, jeera, green chillies, curry leaves, peanuts, salt and soaked sabudana. Coat stuffed chillies with this mixture. Deep fry on medium-high heat until crispy and golden brown. Serve with sauce or chutney.

name: Drumstick Aloo Sabji
instructions: Trim drumstick tips, peel and cut into 2-inch pieces. Boil drumsticks with salt and turmeric for 3-4 minutes. Heat ghee and oil, add mustard seeds, jeera, kalonji and dry chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute. Add onions until translucent. Add turmeric, red chilli and coriander powders, cook 1 minute. Add raw potatoes and salt, cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomatoes, cook covered until mushy, add boiled drumsticks with 1 cup boiling water. Cook covered for 6-7 minutes until potatoes and drumsticks are tender. Finish with garam masala and coriander. Serve hot with roti.

name: Cookies & Cream Ice-cream Cake
instructions: Mix crushed biscuits, cocoa powder, milk powder, sugar, butter and milk to make a fudge-like consistency. Set this mixture into an ice cream cake mold and level the base. In a mixer jar, blend Pediasure cookies and cream flavor. Pour the mixture on top of the base into the mold. Set the ice cream cake into the freezer for 4 hours or until set. Garnish with icing cream and mini cookies and serve.

name: Manchow Soupy Noodles
instructions: Set a wok on high flame, add oil, garlic, ginger, green chillies, coriander and spring onion greens, sauté for a minute. Add hot vegetable stock, soy sauce, green chilli paste, vinegar, sugar and salt & pepper. Mix and bring to a boil. Add chopped vegetables and raw noodles and simmer until noodles are cooked. Mix cornstarch with water and add to boiling soup, stir and cook for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Kande Pohe
instructions: Wash the poha with light hands, add salt, sugar and lemon juice, mix with light hands and rest for 5 minutes. Dry roast peanuts for 3-4 minutes. Heat oil in wok and add mustard seeds, then raw potatoes and sauté until half cooked. Add curry leaves, green chillies, onions and sugar, mix and cook until potatoes are cooked and onions are caramelized. Add turmeric powder and sauté for a minute, add soaked poha and lemon juice, salt and roasted peanuts. Cook for 2-3 minutes, adding water if needed to prevent drying. Switch off flame and cover for 2 minutes. Sprinkle fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: Chilli Paneer Rolls
instructions: Mix refined flour and salt, add water slowly and knead into soft dough. Add oil and knead for 5 minutes. Rest dough under damp cloth for 30 minutes. Clean and cut boneless chicken into strips. Add garlic paste, ginger paste, salt, pepper, corn starch to chicken and marinate for 20 minutes. Heat oil and fry chicken until crispy. In a separate pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, ginger and onions for a minute. Add sauces and seasonings, sauté for a minute. Add fried chicken and toss with sauce. Finish with spring onion greens. Prepare thin omelettes by beating and frying eggs. Divide dough into portions and roll very thin roundels. Place omelette on dough, add schezwan chicken in the middle and wrap into a roll. Heat oil in pan and fry rolls on medium heat until golden brown. Cut and serve immediately.

name: Oil Free Chicken Curry
instructions: Dry roast whole spices for 1 minute. Add sliced onions with salt and cook on medium-high until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, cook 1-2 minutes. Add tomato puree and powdered spices, stir well. Add marinated chicken and cook 3-4 minutes. Add 100 ml water, ginger, garlic, and gram flour. Add 250 ml water and stir. Pressure cook on low for 1 whistle, let depressurize naturally. Bring to boil on flame. Add kasuri methi and garam masala. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with paratha, roti, naan or rice.

name: Schezwan Paneer Spring Roll
instructions: Mix grated paneer with finely chopped onions, capsicum, tomatoes, ginger garlic paste, green chillies, schezwan sauce, and salt. Place filling on spring roll wrapper, fold edges inward, roll tightly and seal. Deep fry until golden brown or pan fry until crispy. Serve hot with sauce of choice.

name: Grilled Peri Peri Sandwich
instructions: Mix garlic paste with hung curd or mayonnaise for garlic mayonnaise dip. Combine all peri peri spices together. Mix paneer with chopped vegetables, coriander, mint, ginger garlic paste, salt and peri peri mix. Spread garlic mayonnaise on both bread slices, add filling on one slice, top with cheese if desired, close with other slice. Apply butter on outer surface of both slices. Toast on grill pan or tava on medium heat until crispy and golden brown on both sides. Cut into triangles or squares and serve with ketchup or dip.

name: Chicken Frankie
instructions: Cook and shred chicken. Mix with sautéed onions, capsicum, tomatoes, ginger garlic paste, green chillies, and coriander. Warm frankie wraps and fill with chicken mixture, season with lemon juice and salt. Roll tightly, pressing edges to seal. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

name: Paneer Cheese Burst Toast
instructions: Mix grated processed cheese with milk and butter. Microwave for 30 seconds and mix, repeat 3-4 times to make smooth cheese sauce. For thicker consistency, blend with hand blender. Spread cheese sauce on bread slice center. Cut edges of another slice and flatten with rolling pin. Place flattened slice over cheese sauce and seal edges. Spread pizza sauce, add mozzarella cheese, capsicum, sweet corn, onion, red chilli pepper, and paneer with red chilli powder. Set pan on medium flame with butter. Place cheese burst bread on pan and pan grill or bake at 250°C for 5-7 minutes. Serve hot immediately.

name: Peri Peri Veg Corn Omelette
instructions: Mix gram flour, refined flour, and salt. Add water to make pouring consistency batter. Whisk for 4-5 minutes ensuring no lumps, rest for 15 minutes. Mix all peri peri spices together. Combine boiled sweet corn with chopped capsicum, tomatoes, onions, green chillies, coriander leaves, peri peri masala, and salt to taste. Heat pan on medium heat, add 1 tsp oil and pour gram flour batter, spread evenly to thin layer. Top with peri peri corn mixture, press gently with spatula. Cover and cook on low flame until bottom is light golden brown. Flip and cook other side until golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup or chutney.

name: pudla sandwich
instructions: Mix shredded vegetables and set aside. In separate bowl combine besan, spices and salt. Add water to make semi-thick batter and rest 15 minutes. Heat oil in pan on medium heat. Dip bread slices in batter, coat both sides and place on pan. Add vegetable mixture on both slices, sprinkle chaat masala and red chilli powder. Cook 1-2 minutes on medium heat. Flip and cook 2-3 minutes more. Add optional grated cheese. Place second bread slice on top with mixture facing inward. Press gently and cook both sides until golden. Cut into triangles and serve hot with tomato ketchup or dip.

name: aam ras pani puri
instructions: For puris: Mix wheat flour, suji and salt. Add water and knead tight dough. Cover with damp cloth and rest 15 minutes. Knead again. Divide into small balls and roll thin without oil or flour. Cut into coin-size pieces with cookie cutter or bottle lid. Heat oil in wok on medium heat and fry puris gently, pressing down so they puff up. Fry both sides until golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper and keep aside. For aam ras: Heat pan on medium and dry roast pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and flax seeds for 3-4 minutes. Blend mangoes, milk and sugar into fine puree. Crack top of puris with thumb and stuff cavity with toasted seeds. Add mango puree. Garnish with mint leaf. Serve immediately.

name: gobhi manchurian
instructions: Boil water in pan with pinch of salt. Add cauliflower florets, cover and cook 3-4 minutes. Transfer to mixing bowl and coat with refined flour. In separate bowl mix refined flour, corn flour, salt and pepper. Add water to make thick batter. Coat florets with batter. Heat oil in wok on medium heat and fry florets until golden brown in batches without overcrowding. Remove on absorbent paper. Increase oil temperature to high and re-fry cauliflower until crisp and golden brown. Remove on paper towel. Heat wok on medium-high, add oil, ginger, garlic, spring onions and capsicum. Saute on high flame 1 minute. Add green chillies, coriander, sugar, soy sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, salt and white pepper. Saute 1 minute. Add water and bring to boil. Mix corn starch with water and add to sauce. Cook until thickens. Add fried cauliflower and spring onion greens. Toss well and cook 1 minute until sauce coats cauliflower. Garnish and serve hot.

name: methi murg
instructions: Marinate chicken with ginger garlic paste, curd, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and black pepper for 15-20 minutes. Blend onions, garlic cloves, green chillies, ginger and coriander into fine paste. Heat oil and ghee in kadhai. Add whole spices and garlic, saute 1-2 minutes. Add onion chilli paste and saute 2-3 minutes. Add cleaned methi leaves, cover and let wilt on low flame 1-2 minutes. Add marinated chicken, green chillies, ginger and salt. Mix well and cook uncovered 4-5 minutes. Cover and cook 15-20 minutes until chicken is cooked, stirring occasionally. Add fresh cream, garam masala and lemon juice. Remove from heat. Serve hot with paratha, roti or rice.

name: soya manchurian
instructions: Boil soya chunks 2-3 minutes, strain and rinse. Coat with cornflour, refined flour, ginger garlic paste, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Shallow fry until crisp. Heat oil in wok, add garlic, ginger, green chillies and spring onion bulbs, sauté for 30 seconds. Add capsicum and bell peppers, sauté 1 minute. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, salt and pepper, sauté on high for 1 minute. Mix cornstarch with water, add to sauce and cook until thickened. Add fried soya and cook 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar and spring onion greens. Serve hot.

name: veg fortune rice
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Dice paneer and chop all vegetables. Heat pan on high, add oil and star anise, sauté with chopped garlic for 1 minute. Add vegetables and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add sugar and sauté again 1-2 minutes. Add diced paneer and sauté gently 2-3 minutes without breaking. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt and pepper, mix and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add water, then add cooked rice and mix gently, cook 2-3 minutes. Finally add fresh spring onion greens and mix well. Serve hot.

name: smoked paneer tikka sandwich
instructions: Mix mustard oil with red chilli powder to release color. Add ginger garlic paste, jeera powder, coriander powder, garam masala, black salt, aamchur powder, hung curd, roasted besan, fresh coriander, lemon juice and salt. Add capsicum, onion, tomatoes and paneer cubes, coat well. Heat pan with ghee/oil and cook marinated paneer 8-10 minutes gently. Smoke paneer using live charcoal with ghee for 2-3 minutes. Butter bread slices, apply chutney, add paneer mixture and cheese. Close with another buttered bread slice. Toast on medium heat both sides until golden. Serve with ketchup or chutney.

name: mushroom and corn tikki pav
instructions: Mix boiled potatoes, mushroom, sweet corn, paneer, onion, ginger garlic paste, green chillies, powdered spices, mint and coriander leaves and salt. Shape into tikkis. Heat pan, add oil and shallow fry tikkis on both sides until crisp and golden. For chutney: soak red chillies 15-20 mins, grind with garlic, jeera powder, lemon juice and salt to smooth paste. For dip: mix curd, salt, pepper and basil leaves. For pav: melt butter with garam masala and coriander, toast pav on both sides. Assembly: spread basil dip on one side and red garlic chutney on other side, top with fried onions and place crispy tikki, serve hot.

name: no onion no garlic tari wale aloo with puri
instructions: For curry: Heat oil in wok, add jeera and let it splutter, add crushed coriander seeds, green chillies, ginger, hing and dry kashmiri red chilly, sauté 1 minute. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and coriander powder, mix well, add little water to prevent spices from burning. Add chopped tomatoes and salt, cook until slightly mushy. Add diced boiled potatoes, mix and cook 2-3 minutes. Add water and cook 4-5 minutes, bring to boil. Cover and cook 4-5 minutes more. Add kasuri methi and fresh coriander leaves. For puri: Mix wheat flour, semolina, ajwain, salt and oil, add water to knead firm dough. Cover and rest 15 minutes. Knead again, divide into small roundels, apply oil and roll thin. Heat oil for frying, push puri down with frying spoon to fluff, flip and fry both sides until golden and crisp. Serve curry hot with hot puris.

name: Walnut Crusted Paneer Tikka
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt and spices, coat with walnut crust, thread on skewers, grill or bake until golden and cooked through.

name: Soya Sheekh Kebab
instructions: Boil soya chunks 2-3 minutes, squeeze dry and grind. Grind onions, green chillies, garlic, ginger coarsely and squeeze dry. Mix ground soya with onion mixture, spices, herbs and ghee. Smoke with live charcoal. Shape on skewers and fry on medium-high heat until golden brown. Serve with lemon juice and chaat masala.

name: Chicken Chilli Rice Bowl
instructions: Marinate chicken in salt, pepper, egg and cornstarch. Fry until golden. Prepare sauce with garlic, ginger, chillies, spring onion, soy sauce and cornstarch slurry. Add fried chicken to sauce. Prepare fried rice with scrambled eggs, cooked rice, sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar. Top rice bowl with chilli chicken. Serve hot.

name: Peri Peri Eggs & Oats Omelette
instructions: Mix all peri peri spices in a jar. Grind oats into fine powder. Mix oats powder, salt, 1 tbsp peri peri powder, add whisked eggs and vegetables. Heat oil on tawa, pour egg mixture, sprinkle peri peri masala and cilantro, cook both sides until golden brown. Cut into pieces and serve with mint chutney.

name: Tandoori Paneer Wraps
instructions: Prepare tandoori-spiced paneer, assemble into wraps with chutney, and serve hot.

name: Chicken Hot Pan
instructions: Deep fry coated chicken strips until golden. In wok, sauté garlic, ginger, spring onion. Add sauce ingredients, bring to boil, thicken with cornflour slurry. Add vegetables and fried chicken, stir-fry on high flame. Heat sizzler plate, spread cabbage, place chicken mixture, garnish with green onions, serve hot.

name: Chicken Vadapav
instructions: Mix gram flour with ajwain and water. Grind chicken with onion, garlic, chillies, spices. Form patty and coat with gram flour batter. Deep fry until crisp. Cook eggs in pan with butter, onion mixture. Toast pav on eggs. Apply mint chutney, place fried chicken patty on top, add sliced onions, serve hot.

name: Peri Peri Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into batons. Wash thoroughly in ice water, soak 15-30 minutes. Blanch 3-4 minutes, chill, freeze 15 minutes. First fry on low 3-4 minutes, rest 10 minutes. Second fry on medium until crisp and golden. Toss with peri-peri masala or salt. Serve with ketchup or mayo.

name: Instant Rava Dhokla
ingredients: yogurt with ginger paste and green chili 1 cup
instructions: Mix semolina with yogurt, ginger paste, and green chili. Let rest for 10 minutes to puff up. Add salt, sugar, and 1 tsp water. Mix well. Add eno fruit salt and mix gently. Pour into greased container and tap to level. Steam in boiling water for 20 minutes. Cool, unmold onto plate. Prepare tempering: heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, sesame seeds, and green chilies. Pour tempering over dhokla. Serve with chutney.

name: Paneer Tikka Momos
instructions: Chutney: Boil tomatoes and red chillies 6-8 minutes, cool, grind with garlic, sugar, salt, pepper. Filling: Mix crumbled paneer with capsicum, onions, chillies, garlic, ginger, herbs, spices. Smoke with charcoal and ghee 2-3 minutes. Dough: Mix flour, salt, water into semi-stiff dough. Rest 15-30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten, dust with flour, roll thin. Cut 3-inch circles with cutter. Fill with spoonful of paneer mixture. Shape momos by pinching sides, making pleats, seal completely. Oil steaming plate. Steam 6-8 minutes. Serve hot with momo chutney.

name: Hyderabadi Khatti Dal
instructions: Wash and soak both dals for 30 minutes. Drain and add to cooker with ginger garlic paste, turmeric, tomatoes, salt and water. Pressure cook on low flame for 4-5 whistles. Soak tamarind in hot water for 15-20 minutes and strain pulp. Let cooker depressurize naturally. Blend dal with hand blender. Add green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, tamarind pulp, curry leaves and salt. Adjust consistency with water and bring to boil. Garnish with fresh coriander. For tadka: heat ghee, add mustard seeds and jeera to splutter, add garlic and dry red chilly, sauté. Pour tadka over hot dal before serving.

name: Anda Tava Masala
instructions: Blend coriander leaves, garlic, ginger, green chillies and water into fine paste. Cut boiled eggs into halves. Heat oil on tava, add cumin seeds and green chillies, add boiled eggs, salt, red chilli powder and coriander leaves. Cook both sides for 1 minute. In separate heat oil, add cumin seeds to splutter, add onions and cook until translucent. Add garlic chilli paste and cook until oil releases. Add tamarind pulp, powdered spices and salt, cook 1-2 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency and cook until oil releases. Place fried eggs over masala and cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with fresh coriander and fried garlic. Serve hot with bhakri, roti or pav.

name: Macaroni Soup
instructions: Blend tomatoes to form puree and strain through sieve. Heat oil in wok, add onion and garlic, sauté 1 minute. Add tomato puree, salt, black pepper and sugar. Cook and bring to boil. Add hot water to mixture, add all vegetables and raw macaroni. Cook 8-10 minutes until macaroni is cooked. Mix cornstarch with water and add to thicken soup. Add oregano, chilli flakes and fresh basil. Serve hot with toasted bread.

name: Garlic Breadsticks
instructions: Add warm water, sugar and yeast in cup and let stand until frothy. In mixing bowl add refined flour, milk powder, garlic paste, salt and pepper. Mix well. Add 3/4 cup warm water and yeast mixture, mix well. Knead soft dough, add oil and knead 15-20 minutes for smooth dough. Apply oil on surface, cover with damp cloth and rest 1.5 hours until doubled. Knead again to puncture, divide into equal dough balls and rest 15 minutes. Sprinkle cornmeal or flour and flatten by hand into average chapati size. Sprinkle oregano seasoning and fold in half. Grease baking tray with butter, sprinkle oregano seasoning. Place folded dough, apply melted butter, sprinkle more oregano and make incisions. Bake in preheated oven at 250°C for 15-18 minutes. Cut along incisions and serve hot with cheese dip.

name: egg masala curry
instructions: Poke boiled eggs with toothpick. Heat oil with turmeric in pan on medium heat, shallow fry poked eggs from all sides until crispy, remove on absorbent paper. For gravy: heat oil in deep pan, add whole spices and sauté for 1 minute. Add onions, cook until light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add tomato puree and green chillies, cook until oil separates. Add powdered spices, mix well, cook 2-3 minutes. Add salt and hot water if needed, cook 5-6 minutes. Add fried eggs and cook 3-4 minutes on medium flame. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and coriander leaves, mix gently and cook 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: idli chaat
instructions: Mix rava, salt and curd in bowl, rest minimum 30 minutes. Heat oil in pan, add mustard seeds until they splutter, add urad dal, green chillies, cashew nuts and curry leaves, sauté for 1 minute. Add tempering to batter, beat and mix well.
