Adjust consistency with water. Add baking soda just before steaming. Grease idli mold with oil and fill 3/4 full with batter. Steam idlis 7-8 minutes until toothpick comes clean. Cool and demold. Cut idlis into quarters. Heat oil in wok, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, chana dal, urad dal, green chillies, hing and red chilli powder, sauté well. Add diced idlis and toss for 1 minute. Pour curd mixture with powdered sugar and black salt through sieve over cooked idlis. Top with jeera powder, black salt, tamarind chutney, mint chutney, red garlic chutney, chopped onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle sev, pomegranate seeds and coriander leaves. Serve immediately.

name: shakkar para
instructions: Mix refined flour and ghee in bowl. Add warm water as required to knead semi-hard dough. Rest dough for 10 minutes. Flatten dough into 1 cm thick sheet. Cut into 2 cm squares. Deep fry on low flame until light golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper and cool. In wok, add sugar and water, cook to one string consistency. Switch off flame and add fried shakkar para. Mix carefully and lightly until sugar crystallizes. Store in airtight container.

name: punjabi kadhi pakora
instructions: For pakora: mix methi, coriander, onions, ajwain, red chilli powder, turmeric, coriander seeds, besan, baking soda, green chillies and salt. Add water to bind mixture and make pakora. Heat oil and deep fry pakoras until crisp and golden. For kadhi: whisk sour curd, besan, red chilli powder, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, salt and water. Heat oil in pan, add whole spices and stir for 1 minute. Add hing and stir. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add potatoes, cook 3-4 minutes. Whisk curd mixture again and pour into pan. Bring to boil and cook 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Adjust consistency with hot water. Add fresh coriander. Add fried pakoras 10 minutes before serving. Stir and cook 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with steaming rice.

name: masala rava uttapam
instructions: For podi masala: dry roast red chillies 3-4 minutes, transfer to bowl. Dry roast sesame seeds 3-4 minutes, add to bowl. Heat oil, roast chana dal and urad dal 4-5 minutes, add to bowl. Heat oil, sauté mustard seeds and curry leaves few seconds, add asafoetida, transfer to bowl. Mix all together, add salt, grind to fine powder. Store in airtight container. For uttapam: mix rava, salt and curd, rest 30 minutes. Heat oil in pan, add mustard seeds, jeera, curry leaves, asafoetida, onions, carrots, cabbage and capsicum, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add podi masala and salt, sauté 1 minute. Add water to rava mixture to make semi-thick batter. Mix in vegetable mixture. Heat pan with oil, add big spoonful of batter, spread evenly to 1/2 cm thick. Sprinkle coriander, podi masala and ghee. Cook 2-3 minutes, flip and cook other side. Cut into pieces and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Shahi Chicken Korma
instructions: Heat ghee, fry onions until brown. Soak cashews, grind with onions into paste. Marinate chicken with ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, salt. Heat ghee, add whole spices, add marinated chicken, sear on high flame. Lower flame. Mix curd with red chilli, coriander, turmeric powder. Add to chicken, stir continuously. Add ginger and salt, cover and cook 20-25 minutes. Add fried onion-cashew paste, cook 3-4 minutes. Cook covered for 8-10 minutes. Add saffron, kewra, garam masala, give dum for 5-10 minutes. Serve hot with roti, paratha or rice.

name: Herbed Basil Brown Rice with Grilled Chicken in Garlic Pepper Sauce
instructions: Wash and soak brown rice 1 hour. Boil water with salt, add rice, cook 15-20 minutes. Drain and cool. Heat olive oil, add garlic, herbs, basil, pepper, add rice and stir-cook 1 minute. Slice chicken in 2 halves, flatten, marinate with ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper. Grill in oil on both sides until golden. Slice into strips. Heat olive oil, add onion, garlic, green chillies, sauté on high 1 minute. Add oats powder, sauté 1 minute, add water and mix well. Add sauces, salt, pepper, cook until thickens. Add grilled chicken, mix. Serve with herbed rice.

name: Paneer Tikka Cheeseburst Naanza
instructions: Mix refined flour, milk powder, baking soda, sugar, salt. Add yogurt and warm water, knead soft dough 15-20 minutes. Add ghee and knead again, oil to prevent drying, rest 1 hour. Knead again, divide into dough balls, rest 10 minutes. For filling: mix cheese, garlic, mint, coriander, green chillies. For sauce: heat oil, add jeera, add onions until translucent, add ginger garlic paste, cook 1 minute. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, cook 1 minute. Add tomato puree, salt, sugar, cook 1 minute. Add garam masala, mint, coriander, cook 1-2 minutes. Add fresh cream, mix. Flatten dough, add cheese garlic filling in centre, close and shape as ball. Flatten and stretch. Sprinkle kalonji and coriander. Apply water and stick on pan, cook 2 minutes. Flip directly on flame, cook until golden brown. Apply butter, spread pizza makhani sauce, add cheese filling, corn, peppers, paneer tikka. Cook on medium heat covered 10 minutes until cheese melts or microwave/bake 5 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Chocolate Walnut Fudge
instructions: Roast walnuts in pan for 3-4 minutes, cool and roughly chop. On medium-low flame, add condensed milk, cocoa powder and butter in wok, stir and cook 5-6 minutes. Add chopped walnuts and cook further 5-6 minutes. Set fudge in butter paper lined tray. Top with chopped walnuts and cocoa powder. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or allow to cool. Cut into desired shapes and sizes.

name: Grilled Samosa Sandwich
instructions: Grind coriander, curry leaves, green chillies, salt, ginger, garlic, roasted chana dal, roasted cumin seeds, lemon juice and water to make chutney. Take 4 bread slices, apply butter and chutney. Layer with sliced beetroot, onion, capsicum, tomato, sandwich masala and samosa. Close sandwich, apply butter on griller and grill for 5-7 minutes. Cut into two pieces and serve hot with ketchup or chutney.

name: Corn Curry
instructions: Cut corn in 2 cm sections. Dry roast jeera, coriander seeds, fenugreek seeds and dried red chillies for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Grind roasted spices with garlic, coconut and onions and water into fine paste. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves, sauté until they splutter. Add onions and cook until soft. Add turmeric powder and cook 1-2 minutes. Add coconut curry paste and cook 7-8 minutes. Add corn sections and kernels, cook 3-4 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency, add imli water, cover and cook 8-10 minutes. Serve hot with rice.

name: Butter Chicken Biryani
instructions: Mix boneless chicken, garlic paste, ginger paste, hung curd, cashew paste, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, sugar, tomato puree, fried onions, salt, mint and coriander. Marinate 30+ minutes. Cook marinated chicken in butter until done. Boil water with ghee and whole spices. Wash rice thrice and boil until 3/4 done, drain. Layer in heavy bottom pot: potatoes at base, half of rice, herbs and onions, cooked chicken, cream, remaining rice. Mix warm milk with saffron and add. Seal with dough. Cook on low flame 15-20 minutes. Smoke with charcoal on onion for 3-5 minutes. Serve hot with curd or raita.

name: Shaam Savera
instructions: For spinach balls: Heat oil, add ginger garlic paste, green chili paste and jeera, sauté 1 minute. Add spinach puree, salt, pepper, roasted jeera and coriander powder, cook 2-3 minutes. Add cashew and besan powder, stir continuously until well combined. Cool. Mix grated paneer with salt, pepper, aamchur, cardamom and corn flour. Shape into roundels. Flatten spinach mixture, place paneer in center, seal with spinach. Coat lightly with refined flour. Fry until golden, slice in halves. For gravy: Heat butter, add jeera, onion, ginger, garlic, kashmiri chillies, cashew nuts and tomatoes, sauté 1 minute. Add salt, coriander powder, red chili powder and garam masala, sauté 1 minute. Add water, cover and cook 6-7 minutes. Cool and grind. Heat butter and oil, add bay leaf, green cardamom and ginger juliennes, sauté 1 minute. Add strained tomato-onion puree, cook 4-5 minutes. Adjust consistency, bring to boil, add salt, garam masala and kasuri methi. Add fresh cream. Serve gravy with sliced spinach balls.

name: Chilli Garlic Stir Fried Noodles
instructions: Heat oil on high heat, add garlic, ginger, green chillies and onion, sauté 1 minute. Add all vegetables and sauté 2-3 minutes on high heat. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, honey, salt and black pepper, sauté 1 minute. Mix cornstarch with water and add, cook 1-2 minutes on high flame. Add paneer cubes and mix gently. Add boiled noodles, mix well and cook 1-2 minutes on high heat. Add vinegar, spring onion greens and blanched spinach, mix well. Serve hot.

name: No Onion No Garlic Pav Bhaji
instructions: Peel raw bananas, cut in halves. Boil for 15-20 minutes. Cool and peel. Heat oil and butter, add jeera and hing, cook until oil separates. Add red chilli paste and cook. Add chopped capsicum, cook 1-2 minutes. Add remaining vegetables including boiled bananas, salt, coriander powder and pav bhaji masala, stir 2-3 minutes. Mash all vegetables well. Add water to adjust consistency, mix and mash. Cook 3-4 minutes. Add lemon juice, garam masala and fresh coriander. Toast pav halves on hot buttered tawa with pav bhaji masala and coriander. Serve bhaji hot with pav, garnish with coriander, butter and lemon.

name: Mac N Cheese Pakora
instructions: For mac & cheese: Heat butter in pan, add refined flour and cook for 1 minute. Add milk gradually while whisking continuously to avoid lumps. Add salt, pepper, oregano and red chilli powder, mix well. Add boiled macaroni and mozzarella cheese, cook until cheese melts. Set the mac & cheese in a lined baking tray, cover with butter paper and freeze for 3-4 hours. For batter: Mix gram flour, red chilli powder, coriander powder, amchur powder, ajwain, turmeric powder and salt. Add water to make a flowing consistency and rest for 10 minutes. Demold the frozen mac & cheese and cut into equal rectangles. Dip each piece in batter and coat well. Heat oil on medium-low heat and fry until golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup, chutney or any dip of your choice.

name: Vada Pav Quesadilla
instructions: For potato mixture: Set a wok on medium heat, add oil, mustard seeds, jeera and curry leaves, sauté for few seconds. Add hing, ginger garlic paste and green chilli paste, sauté until rawness disappears. Add turmeric powder, boiled and mashed potatoes and salt, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add fresh coriander and lemon juice, set aside. For sukha vada pav chutney: Set pan on medium heat and dry roast coconut, kashmiri red chillies and peanuts separately for 3-4 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Heat oil in same pan, add garlic cloves and dry roast until brown. Transfer all ingredients to grinding jar and grind to fine powder with salt. For quesadilla: Flatten dough balls and roll into thin chapati, make two per quesadilla and half-cook them. Spread mint chutney on both chapati, sprinkle sukha chutney on one, spread potato mixture and chopped onions, sprinkle chutney again. Place second chapati on top with chutney side in. Set grill on medium heat with oil and grill quesadilla on both sides until grill marks appear. Cut into quarters or 6-8 slices. Serve hot with mint chutney or any dip.

name: Smoked Paneer Sandwich
instructions: In a mixing bowl add paneer, capsicum, onion, corn, spring onion greens, eggless mayonnaise, butter, salt and black pepper. Grate processed cheese and add to the mix. Mix well all ingredients together. Place a live charcoal in a bowl in the center and add few drops of ghee. Place the paneer mixture bowl over the charcoal, cover and smoke for 3-4 minutes. Discard the charcoal after using. Spread a spoonful of smoked mixture on a bread slice evenly, top it with another bread slice and press gently. Spread butter evenly on bread and toast it on a pan set on medium heat. Cook on both sides until crisp and golden brown, pressing gently while toasting. Cut into triangles and serve hot with crispy potato chips and ketchup or any dip of your choice.

name: Chicken Bhuna Rolls
instructions: In a bowl add refined flour, salt and water. Mix well and knead a dough. Set a pan on medium flame and add oil, jeera, onion, red chilli paste, turmeric, coriander powder, ginger garlic paste, chicken, water, cashew nut paste, curd, salt, garam masala powder and fresh coriander. Mix well and cook until chicken is done, keep aside. In another pan add butter and beat egg into it, cook well, keep aside. Take a small portion of dough and flatten it into roti using a rolling pin. Place egg in it and place some bhuna chicken over it with chopped onions and fresh coriander. Drizzle some vinegar and roll the roti. Set a pan on medium flame and add oil. Shallow fry the chicken bhuna roll from each side until done. Serve hot immediately with mint chutney.

name: Veg Seekh Hot Dog
instructions: Set a pan on medium heat and add oil with jeera. Sauté for a minute. Add onions and ginger garlic paste, sauté until onions are translucent. Add carrot, french beans and sweet corn, mix well and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add powdered spices and salt, cook for a minute and transfer to a bowl to cool. Add potatoes, paneer, green chillies, fresh coriander and mint, roasted besan and processed cheese, mix well and mash to fine texture. Grease palms with oil, take 2 spoonfuls of mixture and shape like seekh on bamboo skewers. Set a grill pan on medium heat, add oil and grill seekh from all sides until golden brown. Make tandoori mayonnaise by mixing mayonnaise with tandoori masala. Prepare salad with chopped onions, cucumber, capsicum, tomatoes, salt, pepper, aamchur powder, red chilli powder, fresh mint, tamarind water and lemon juice. Toast hot dog buns with butter on both sides. Spread tandoori mayonnaise on bun, add salad, place grilled seekh and top with more tandoori mayonnaise. Serve immediately.

name: Egg Pizza Roll with Chapati
ingredients: toppings chopped vegetables or chicken chunks
instructions: Break eggs in a bowl and add salt and pepper, whisk well. Set a pan on medium heat, add ghee and whisked eggs. Pull cooked egg from one side and tilt pan to fill with uncooked egg for even cooking. Place a chapati and press gently until eggs are cooked, flip and remove from heat. Place on plate and apply homemade pizza sauce and grate cheese, add toppings of choice. Set pan on low heat and place chapati pizza, cover and cook until cheese melts (about 2 minutes). Once cheese melts, roll it like a frankie for egg pizza roll. Alternatively, make it as a pizza by continuing to cook on low heat until chapati is crisp and cheese melts. Divide into slices and serve hot.

name: Sweet Corn Dum Masala
instructions: Heat oil and butter in a wok, add cumin seeds and sauté for a minute. Add chopped onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add capsicum and green chillies, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree, salt, cashew nut paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and turmeric powder, cook for 8-10 minutes. Add sweet corn and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency. Add grated paneer, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Place live charcoal in a small bowl and pour ghee over it, cover and smoke for 2-3 minutes. Mix well and add amchur powder, kasuri methi, garam masala, and lemon juice. Finish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

name: Moong Dal Tikki
instructions: Wash moong dal thoroughly and soak for 1-2 hours, then drain. Boil soaked dal in salted water for 3-4 minutes, drain and cool. Transfer to grinding jar and grind coarsely without adding water. Transfer ground dal to a mixing bowl, add chopped green chillies, ginger, powdered spices, salt, fresh herbs, and lemon juice. Wash poha under fresh water, soak for 2-3 minutes, mash and add to dal mixture. Add curd and ghee, mix well with clean hands. Grease palms with oil and shape into flat tikkis. Heat pan on medium-low, add ghee or oil, and shallow fry tikkis on both sides until crisp and golden brown. Remove onto absorbent paper.

name: Healthy Batata Vada
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium flame. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle. Add ginger garlic paste, chopped green chillies, and curry leaves, sauté for a minute. Add red chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt, sauté for half a minute. Add boiled mashed potatoes, sweet corn, finely chopped carrots, and grated paneer. Cook for 2-3 minutes while stirring. Add lemon juice and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Set aside and let cool. In a bowl, add besan, ajwain, salt, and water to make a semi-thick batter. Apply oil to palms and shape the cooled mixture into lemon-sized balls. Heat oil for shallow frying on medium flame. Dip the shaped balls into besan batter and shallow fry from all sides until crispy and golden.

name: Bharwan Baingan Aloo
instructions: Wash baingan thoroughly and trim the green crown, leaving the stem intact. Cut almost to the end into four quadrants. In a mixing bowl add all powdered spices and salt, mix well, add oil and mix again. Fill this spice mixture into the baingan cavity and press together to seal. Coat potato wedges with remaining masala. Heat mustard oil in a wok until smoke appears. Add chopped ginger, green chilli, ajwain, and hing, sauté for 30 seconds. Add the stuffed baingan and marinated potato wedges, cover and cook on low flame for 30 minutes, stirring at intervals of every 5 minutes. Sprinkle water if masala sticks and continue to cover and cook until potatoes and eggplant are done. Add garam masala and freshly chopped coriander leaves, mix well.

name: Kanda Bhaji
instructions: Peel and wash onions. Cut them into halves and remove the stem so layers separate easily. Separate the layers. Add ginger garlic paste, green chillies, fresh coriander, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, ajwain, amchur powder, garam masala, and lemon juice to onions. Mix really well. Set oil in a wok for frying on high heat. Add a pinch of black salt for extra kick and salt to taste, mix the mixture well and allow to rest for 2 minutes. Add besan and cornflour in three batches while mixing and coating onions with the flours. The idea is to coat the onions without making a dipping batter. Adjust flour quantities as required based on moisture content. Dip fingers in water and drop flattened mixture into hot oil at 175-185°C. Lower flame to medium once added, do not touch until outer covering is set. Increase flame slightly and fry slowly until crisp and golden brown.

name: Tawa Chicken
instructions: Wash boneless chicken and make deep incisions for flavor to seep in. Transfer to mixing bowl and add garlic paste, vinegar, salt and pepper, powdered spices, and whisked curd. Mix well and coat chicken thoroughly. Place live charcoal in a small bowl, pour ghee over it, place in the side of the chicken, cover and smoke for 3-4 minutes. Refrigerate and marinate for at least an hour. Set a tawa or pan on medium-high heat, add ghee and cook marinated chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. As chicken releases moisture, continue cooking on medium-high heat to burn off water without burning the chicken. Add chopped bhavnagri chillies and lemon wedges. Separate chicken into bite-sized pieces using a spatula. Add the curd masala mixture, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes. Add garam masala and kasuri methi, mix and cook until ghee releases. Finish by adding freshly chopped mint and coriander leaves.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala Tacos
instructions: For filling: marinate paneer cubes in thick curd, ginger garlic paste, and powdered spices for 15-20 minutes. Heat oil, add cumin seeds and sauté for few seconds. Add chopped onions and cook until translucent. Add green chillies and tomato puree, cook for 3-4 minutes. Add water and salt, mix well and add marinated paneer, cook for 5-6 minutes. Add diced tomatoes, capsicum, and onions, cook for 3-4 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala, and freshly chopped coriander leaves, mix well and set aside. For taco shells: mix refined flour, salt, and baking powder. Add curd and water as required to knead smooth and soft dough. Cover with damp cloth and rest for 30 minutes. Apply oil and knead once more. Divide into small equal balls, flatten with hands, sprinkle kalonji and fresh coriander, flatten further to mini chapati. Place on hot tava, apply water on other side, press carefully and cook for half a minute, flip and cook other side until brown spots appear. Assembly: spread dahi-pudina chutney on shell, add paneer tikka filling, pour fresh cream, add onion rings and lemon wedge.

name: Manchurian Bhajji Pav
instructions: Mix grated cabbage, carrot, sliced onion, ginger garlic paste, chopped green chillies, salt, pepper, soy sauce, and red chilli sauce in a bowl, squeezing the vegetables. Mix corn flour and rice flour into the vegetable mixture. Form small balls and fry on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Remove on paper towel. Heat butter on tava and toast pav. Apply schezwan sauce, add chopped onion, place fried manchurian balls, and top with fried noodles. Serve hot.

name: Stuffed Mirchi Pakoda
instructions: Make masala aloo by mixing mashed boiled potatoes with aamchur powder, chat masala, red chilli powder, coriander powder, and fresh coriander. In another bowl, mix paneer, blanched sweet corn, processed cheese, oregano, and salt. Slit mirchi or jalapenos and deseed carefully. Stuff with potato and paneer mixture. Prepare batter by mixing gram flour, baking powder, salt, ajwain, and water. Coat stuffed mirchi with batter and deep fry in oil on medium-high heat until golden brown and crisp. Serve hot with ketchup.

name: Dal Bukhara
instructions: Wash black gram dal thoroughly 5-6 times and soak in fresh water for 5-6 hours or overnight. Drain water. In a pressure cooker, add soaked dal with water (2 inches above dal), salt, and turmeric. Pressure cook on medium flame for 5-6 whistles. Let cooker depressurize naturally. Mash cooked dal slightly with ladle. Heat ghee in a pan, add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add asafoetida and ginger garlic paste, sauté briefly. Add tomato puree and cook until oil releases. Add red chilli powder and coriander powder. Mix in cooked dal and cook on medium flame for 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently. Add hot water to adjust consistency. Add salt, garam masala, and kasuri methi. Cook another 20-25 minutes while stirring. Add butter and fresh cream. Cook for a few more minutes until desired consistency. Serve hot.

name: Tava Anda Sukka
instructions: Make sukha paste: dry roast whole spices (cinnamon, peppercorns, cloves, fenugreek, cumin, coriander seeds, poppy seeds) until aromatic. Dry roast red chillies for 4-5 minutes separately. Heat ghee in pan, cook onions and garlic for 4-5 minutes. Roast fresh grated coconut until light golden, divide into two parts. Blend roasted spices, red chillies, cooked onion-garlic, half the roasted coconut, tamarind pulp, and turmeric into fine paste. Coarsely grind remaining coconut. Boil and halve eggs. Heat oil on tava, add cumin seeds, green chillies, halved eggs, salt, red chilli powder, and coriander leaves. Cook both sides 1 minute. Heat ghee and oil in separate pan, add mustard seeds, onions, and garlic until golden. Add sukha paste and cook 4-5 minutes. Add roasted ground coconut and curry leaves, cook until ghee releases. Add water if dry. Place fried eggs and coat with masala. Cook on low flame 4-5 minutes. Give final tempering with ghee, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Serve hot.

name: Peri-Peri Paneer Sandwich Pakora
instructions: Prepare peri-peri spice mix by combining red chilli powder, black salt, cinnamon powder, garlic powder, ginger powder, oregano, and powdered sugar. Store in airtight container if making ahead. Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds. Add ginger garlic paste and chopped green chillies, sauté briefly. Add 4 tbsp peri-peri spice mix and cook 1 minute. Add mashed boiled potatoes, lemon juice, and fresh coriander leaves. Mix well and cook 2-3 minutes. Cool to room temperature. Prepare batter by mixing gram flour, ajwain, salt, and water into semi-thin lump-free batter. Let rest 10-15 minutes. Cut paneer into bite-sized cuboid slabs. Apply spoonful of peri-peri aloo filling on one paneer slab and spread evenly. Close with another paneer slab. Dip filled paneer sandwich into batter to coat well. Deep fry in hot oil on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve immediately hot and crispy with green mint chutney or ketchup.

name: Veg Hot and Sour Soup
instructions: Set a wok on high heat and add vegetable stock or hot water with stock cube. Bring to boil. Once boiling, add ginger, green chilli paste, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, vinegar, white/black pepper powder, and salt to taste. Add sugar, shredded cabbage, julienned carrots, julienned shiitake or button mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and fresh coriander leaves. Mix well and cook 3-4 minutes. Bring soup to boil. Gently add small diced paneer or silken tofu without breaking pieces. In a small bowl, mix corn flour with water to make a slurry. Bring soup to boil and slowly add cornflour-water mixture while stirring continuously. Simmer until soup thickens (1-2 minutes). Adjust thickness by varying cornstarch slurry quantity. Once thickened, add freshly chopped spring onion greens and fresh coriander leaves. Simmer 1 minute and serve hot immediately.

name: Chicken Tikka Paratha Wrap
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric and lemon juice for 30 minutes. Grill or cook the marinated chicken pieces until golden and cooked through. Warm the parathas. Layer with grilled chicken, sliced onions, cucumber, tomato and mint chutney. Roll and serve hot.

name: Mac N Cheese Eggizza
ingredients: red chilli powder or paprika powder 1/2 tsp
processed cheese or mozzarella cheese 1/2 cup
instructions: For mac and cheese: Heat butter, add flour and cook for a minute. Add milk gradually while whisking to avoid lumps. Add salt, pepper, oregano and red chilli powder. Mix well. Add boiled macaroni and cheese, cook until cheese melts. For eggizza: Heat butter in pan on low heat, add whisked eggs. Pull eggs from sides so they cook evenly. Add freshly made mac n cheese over the egg, spread evenly. Sprinkle parsley, red chilli flakes and oregano. Cover and cook for 2 minutes on low flame.

name: Chicken Schezwan Noodles
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water for 6-7 minutes, rinse with cold water and add oil to prevent sticking. Thinly slice chicken breast and cut into strips. Marinate with salt, pepper, vinegar, egg white, ginger garlic paste and corn flour. Fry on medium heat until light golden. Scramble 2 beaten eggs with oil and set aside. Heat oil, add onion, ginger, garlic and broken red chilli, sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add vegetables and sauté for a minute. Add all sauces, salt and white pepper, sauté for a minute. Add boiled noodles, fried chicken and scrambled eggs, stir and toss. Add spring onion greens and sauté for 1-2 minutes.

name: Authentic Punjabi Rajma
instructions: Soak rajma in water for 5-6 hours or overnight. Drain excess water. Pressure cook soaked rajma with water (2 inches above) and salt for 3 whistles on medium heat. Let cool naturally. Heat oil, add sliced onions and cook until brown, stirring frequently. Remove on absorbent paper and cool. Grind fried onions to a fine paste using water. Reuse the oil, add ginger garlic paste and sauté for few minutes. Add tomato puree, salt and cook covered for 5-6 minutes. Add turmeric, coriander and red chilli powders, mix well and add onion paste. Cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add precooked rajma with its water, mix and cook 15-20 minutes. Add salt, garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh coriander. Adjust consistency as needed.

name: Grilled Harissa Paneer
instructions: Cut paneer into rectangular pieces about 1 inch thick. Mix harissa dressing with lemon juice and salt. Coat paneer pieces with the harissa dressing and marinate for 15 minutes. Thread paneer pieces on skewers alternating with onion and bell pepper. Grill on a hot griddle or grill for 3-4 minutes on each side until light char marks appear. Serve hot with remaining harissa dressing on the side.

name: Mango Power Smoothie
ingredients: mango topping or alphonso mango pulp 2 tbsp
instructions: Peel and dice the mango into chunks. Add mango pieces, milk, yogurt and honey to a blender. Add ice cubes. Blend until smooth and creamy. Pour into glasses. Top with a spoonful of mango topping or alphonso mango pulp. Serve immediately.

name: No Bake Chocolate Cake
ingredients: chocolate shavings or cocoa powder for decoration
instructions: Take a zip lock bag and add glucose biscuits, crush them with a rolling pin. In a bowl add crushed biscuits, cocoa powder, powdered sugar, walnuts and soft butter, mix well. Line a bowl with butter paper or grease with butter, pour in mixture, press with spatula. Set in fridge for 10-15 minutes. Take from fridge, demould the cake, decorate with cocoa powder, chocolate shavings, chocolate syrup or fruit jam as desired. Serve cold.

name: Peri Peri Pullout Pav
instructions: Make peri peri mix by combining red chilli powder, garlic powder, black salt, powdered sugar, cinnamon powder, oregano and ginger powder in a jar and store in airtight container. For vegetable fillings: In a bowl add all veggies, paneer, garlic, mozzarella cheese, fresh coriander, peri peri masala and salt, mix well and keep aside. For garlic butter: Mix melted butter with finely chopped garlic and fresh coriander leaves. Make cut on the pav to create cavity without slicing through, refer video for better understanding. Fill cavities with vegetable fillings, apply garlic butter and bake at 170°C for 7-8 minutes. Serve immediately as an evening snack.

name: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
instructions: Set pan on medium heat, add olive oil, chopped onion and garlic, cook until onions are translucent. Add water and salt and pepper, cover and bring to boil. Add broccoli florets, mix well, cover and cook for 2-3 minutes. Check if broccoli is cooked by slitting one floret. Cool mixture to room temperature and grind into fine puree. Heat butter in another pan on medium-low heat, add flour and mix well, add salt and cook for 2 minutes. Add milk slowly and gradually while stirring continuously to ensure no lumps form. Add pureed broccoli mixture and mix well, add black pepper powder and jeera powder. Cook on medium heat and bring to simmer. Add salt to taste and garam masala. Serve hot garnished with fresh cream and sprinkle of pepper powder.

name: Noodles Spring Roll
instructions: For filling: Heat oil in wok, add ginger garlic paste and onions, sauté on high flame. Add vegetables and sugar, sauté for a minute. Add sauces, pepper and salt, sauté for a minute. Add boiled noodles, mix and cook for 3-4 minutes, garnish with spring onion. For spring roll sheets: Mix maida and salt, add water to knead soft dough. Apply oil, cover with damp cloth and rest 30 minutes. Knead again, divide into roundels, flatten and coat with dry flour. Roll thin, place noodles filling, roll into spring roll shape and seal edges with water. Fry on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Cut diagonally and serve hot.

name: Batata Vada Stuffed Idli
instructions: For batata vada: Heat oil in wok, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and curry leaves, sauté for 1-2 minutes, add ginger garlic paste and green chilli paste, sauté for a minute. Add boiled potatoes and salt, cook for 2-3 minutes, add coriander and lemon juice, cool and shape into tikkis. For idli: Mix rava, salt and curd, rest for 30 minutes, add water gradually and whisk, rest for 15 minutes, add fruit salt just before steaming. Grease idli mold with oil, fill halfway, place batata vada tikki in centre, top with batter and sprinkle chutney. Steam for 7-8 minutes until toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 1-2 minutes before removing.

name: Sev Tamatar Sabji with Jowar Bhakri
instructions: For jowar bhakri: Mix jowar, salt, onions, kasuri methi, fresh coriander and green chillies. Add hot water to knead soft dough. Shape into roundels, flatten, sprinkle dry flour and shape into bhakri with circular pressure or rolling pin. Cook on hot tawa, apply water on upper surface, allow to dry, flip and cook other side. For sev tamatar sabji: Heat ghee in wok, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, allow to crackle. Add onions and cook until translucent, add garlic and cook for a minute. Add powdered spices and cook for a minute, add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add hot water, mix and cook covered for 4-5 minutes. Add sev to gravy, bring to boil, cover and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala and optional sugar, finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with jowar bhakri.

name: Baked Palak Paneer Casserole
instructions: Blanch spinach bunch for 2 minutes, dip in ice cold water. Grind blanched spinach, fresh coriander and green chillies into fine paste. Heat oil in wok, add garlic and ginger, sauté for a minute. Add oats powder and cook for 30 seconds. Add milk and whisk well ensuring no lumps, cook until sauce thickens. Add spinach puree, salt, pepper powder, coriander powder, red chilly powder and amchur powder, mix and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add paneer cubes and mix, add garam masala and lemon juice. Pour mixture into heat-proof bowl for baking. Grate cheese over mixture, place brown bread cubes on edges. Mix melted butter with chopped garlic and coriander, pour over bread cubes. Bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 5-7 minutes. Serve hot with garlic bread.

name: Butter & Garlic Naan
instructions: Prepare naan dough with flour and yeast. Let it rise. Roll out pieces and brush with butter and garlic. Cook on high heat until golden and puffy.

name: Gholwan Karah
instructions: Soak 1 cup semolina with 2 cups water for 10 minutes. Heat 3/4 cup ghee in a wok, add 1 cup sugar and cook on medium flame while stirring until sugar dissolves and browns. Carefully pour the soaked semolina mixture into the hot ghee, stirring constantly to avoid clumping. Lower flame and keep stirring until karah leaves ghee. Add 1/4 cup almond slivers and mix well. Serve hot, garnished with almond slivers, pistachios and dry rose petals.

name: Cashew Masala Curry
instructions: For paste: Heat 1 tbsp ghee in wok, fry 1/2 cup cashews until golden. Add 2 medium sliced onions, 3-4 dry red chillies, 3 medium diced tomatoes, 4-5 garlic cloves, 1 inch ginger. Cook until vegetables are mushy. Cool and grind to fine paste with 100 ml water. For gravy: Heat 1 tbsp ghee, add whole spices (2 green cardamom, 3 cloves, 1 inch cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin). Sauté 1 cup cashews until golden. Add 1 tbsp red chilli powder, 1 tbsp coriander powder, 1 tsp fennel powder. Add tomato-onion paste, salt, cook 7-8 minutes until gravy leaves ghee. Add 200 ml hot water and bring to boil. Add 1 tsp kasuri methi, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tbsp fresh cream. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: Omelette Makhani Curry
instructions: For omelette: Break 4 eggs, add salt, black pepper, 1/4 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp green chilli. Whisk well. Heat 1 tbsp ghee in non-stick pan, pour whisked eggs. Let bottom layer cook, tilt pan to allow uncooked egg to flow to edges. Cook until set, flip once, cook other side. Roll and cut into 1 cm strips. For makhani curry: Blend 4 tomatoes, 2-3 green chillies, 1 inch ginger to fine puree. Heat 1 tbsp ghee, add 1 tsp cumin seeds. Add puree, salt, 1/2 tsp sugar. Cook until mushy. Add 2 tbsp tomato ketchup, 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp coriander powder. Cook 7-8 minutes to remove rawness. Mix 2 tbsp fresh cream with 200 ml milk, add to curry, stir well. Cook 3-4 minutes, add 1 tsp kasuri methi and pinch of garam masala. Add omelette strips, cook 1 minute. Garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Bhindi Do Pyaaza
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tbsp crushed coriander seeds, 1 inch julienned ginger, 1 tbsp chopped garlic, 1-2 chopped green chillies. Sauté on medium flame for 1-2 minutes. Add 3-4 medium sliced onions, cook until golden brown. Add 1/4 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tbsp red chilly powder, 1 tbsp coriander powder, cook 1 minute. Add 3 medium chopped tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Lower flame and add 1/3 cup yogurt, stir continuously until oil is released. Add 200 ml water to adjust gravy consistency, bring to boil. Add fried bhindi, cook 5-6 minutes. Add 1 medium diced tomato, 1 medium diced onion, 1 tsp kasuri methi, 1 tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves. Cook 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: Namak Para
instructions: In a mixing bowl add 2 cups refined flour, 4 tbsp semolina, 1 tsp ajwain, 1 tsp kalonji, 1 tsp salt. Combine with 5 tbsp ghee and flour well. Add water as required to knead a firm dough. Cover with damp cloth and rest for 10 minutes. Divide dough into two equal parts, flatten and roll into 1/2 cm thin sheet. Apply ghee and brush completely over dough sheet. Sprinkle flour, fold 1/3rd of dough by overlapping, fold remaining 1/3rd over it and press gently. Roll again and repeat process. After final rolling, cut into 1/2 cm strips. Heat oil for frying and fry on medium-low heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with tea.

name: Peri Peri Poha
instructions: Wash poha lightly and drain. Mix with salt, sugar and lemon juice; rest 5 minutes. Heat oil in wok; add mustard seeds and curry leaves; sauté briefly. Add green chillies and diced potatoes; cook until half done. Add onions; cook until translucent. Add corn and carrots; cook 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric powder, peri peri seasoning and salt; mix well. Add soaked poha; stir and cook 2-3 minutes. Garnish with coriander and peanuts. Serve hot.

name: Methi Malai Mutter
instructions: Heat ghee in pan; add methi and salt; sauté 8-10 minutes; set aside. In another pan, heat ghee; add onions; cook until golden brown. Add garlic, ginger and green chillies; add tomatoes and cashew nuts; cook 2 minutes. Add water; cover and cook 4-5 minutes; cool and grind to fine puree. Set aside. Heat pan on medium; add ghee and whole spices; sauté 1 minute. Add tomato-onion puree and coriander powder; cook 1-2 minutes. Add green peas and sautéed methi; mix well. Add water if needed; cover and cook 4-5 minutes. Add fresh cream and garam masala; cook 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with paratha, roti or Indian bread.

name: Cheesy Tandoori Onion Rings
instructions: Mix grated paneer, powdered spices, black salt, salt and coriander. Place live charcoal; pour ghee; cover and smoke 3-4 minutes. Cut onions into 1cm roundels; separate rings. Fill rings 1/4 way with paneer filling; press with spoon; add mozzarella cheese on top. Cover again with paneer; press and rest. Make refined flour slurry with water. To coat: dust with dry refined flour; dip in slurry; coat with breadcrumbs; re-dip in slurry; re-coat with breadcrumbs. Heat oil; fry on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper. Serve hot with tomato ketchup or sauces.

name: Crispy Corn with Schezwan Mayo
instructions: Boil water in wok; add salt and boil corn 2 minutes. Cool down corn; add salt and pepper. Add corn flour and rice flour; coat well. Add water if needed so flour sticks. Deep freeze for 15 minutes. In separate bowl mix mayonnaise and Schezwan sauce. Heat oil on high heat. Fry corn in batches carefully until crisp and golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper. Drizzle with Schezwan mayonnaise. Sprinkle with spring onion greens. Serve hot and crispy.

name: Hot and sweet crispy noodles with paneer
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Boil noodles, drain and coat with cornstarch, then deep fry until crisp. In a separate pan, sauté garlic, ginger and spring onion bulbs, add capsicum, carrot and baby corn. Add schezwan sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup and soy sauce with water. Thicken with cornstarch slurry. Add fried paneer and spring onion greens. Serve noodles topped with paneer gravy.

name: Masala corn burger
instructions: Heat oil and butter, add jeera, ginger garlic paste and green chillies. Sauté capsicum then onions. Add powdered spices, chilli sauce, ketchup and cook. Add tomatoes and salt until mushy. Add corn and mashed potatoes, cook 4-5 minutes. Finish with spring onion greens and coriander. Assemble burgers with filling, sliced onions, lemon juice, chaat masala and cheese. Toast on both sides until golden.

name: Aloo pyaaz ki kachori
instructions: Heat oil, add jeera, hing, coriander seeds, saunf, ginger and green chillies. Add onions and salt, sauté until translucent. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, black pepper, sugar and gram flour. Add boiled potatoes, lightly mash. Add kasuri methi and amchur powder. Cool filling. Make dough with flour, ajwain, salt, ghee and water, rest 30 minutes. Knead again, shape into balls. Flatten into cups, fill and seal. Flatten into thick disks. Fry on low heat 15-18 minutes until crisp and golden. Serve with chutneys.

name: Dabeli cheela
instructions: Heat oil, add jeera, hing, dabeli masala and mashed potatoes. Add sugar, tamarind pulp and salt. Mix in coriander leaves and cool. Soak and wash moong dal. Grind dal with green chillies, ginger and salt with water to dosa-like consistency. Pour batter on hot tawa, add ghee. Spread dabeli mixture and top with onions, peanuts, chutneys, coconut and pomegranate. Roll like dosa and serve hot.

name: Chapati pizza
instructions: Make x-cut on tomatoes, blanch 2-3 minutes in boiling water, transfer to ice water and peel. Grind to puree. Heat olive oil, sauté onions and garlic until translucent. Add tomato puree, salt, sugar, red chilli flakes and oregano. Cook 2-3 minutes, add vinegar until sauce thickens. Cool sauce. On fresh or leftover chapati, spread pizza sauce, grate cheese and add chosen vegetable toppings. Cook on medium heat on oiled pan until base is crisp and cheese melts. Cover to help cheese melt. Serve hot.

name: tandoori aloo mirchi pakora
instructions: In a mixing bowl add boiled mashed potatoes, powdered spices, salt, black salt, coriander and grated cheese, mix well. Place live charcoal in centre with ghee and smoke for 3-5 minutes. Take large green chillies, make slit, deseed and stuff with potato mixture. In another bowl mix besan, ajwain, turmeric and salt, add water and whisk to semi-thin consistency. Dip and coat chillies with batter and deep fry on medium heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup and chutney.

name: egg bhuna roll
instructions: Chop boiled eggs and set aside. Heat pan with jeera, add onions until golden brown. Add red chilli paste and ginger garlic paste, cook until oil separates. Add curd, spices and salt, cook 3-4 minutes. Add tomato puree, mix and cook 7-8 minutes. Add water and cook 4-5 minutes. Add eggs, garam masala and coriander, mix well. For omelette: whisk eggs with salt and pepper, make omelette and cut into pieces. For rolls: mix wheat flour, salt and ghee, add water to knead semi-stiff dough, rest 15 minutes. Divide into balls, roll thin, add omelette pieces, egg filling, onions, chilli vinegar and chaat masala. Fold like spring roll, fry on all sides until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with chutney.

name: pizza egg toast
instructions: In a bowl mix veggies, pizza sauce, oregano, chilli flakes, cheese and salt. In separate bowl beat eggs with salt, pepper, oregano and chilli flakes. Spread pizza mixture on bread slice, top with another slice. Dip and coat sandwich in beaten eggs. Heat butter on tawa, cook egg-coated sandwich on both sides for a minute until golden brown. Add more beaten egg on both sides, flip and cook again. Cut into triangles or squares and serve hot with ketchup.

name: cheese chilli garlic mini kulchas
instructions: Mix mozzarella cheese, garlic, green chillies and chaat masala, keep aside. In bowl add refined flour, salt, baking powder and curd, mix well. Add water to knead soft stretchy dough, cover with damp cloth and rest 30 minutes. After rest, drizzle oil and knead again, divide into small balls. Flatten and dust with flour, make small cavity in center, add cheese-chilli mixture and seal into ball shape. Flatten like paratha, add chopped garlic and coriander, press lightly. Cook on hot tava with water on back, flip tawa over flame and cook until brown spots appear. Serve hot with imli chutney or dip.

name: tawa prawns masala
instructions: Grind green chillies, garlic and ginger into fine paste, adjust consistency with water. In mixing bowl add cleaned prawns, add ginger-garlic-chilli paste, salt, lemon juice, red chilly powder, turmeric and tamarind pulp. Mix well and marinate 15-20 minutes. Heat oil on tawa, add garlic cloves and fry for a minute. Add chopped onions and cook until translucent. Add remaining ginger-garlic paste, mix well and cook until golden brown. Add red chilly powder, coriander powder and garam masala, mix and cook for a minute. Add marinated prawns, mix well and cook on medium-high flame until oil is released. Add fresh coriander leaves and mix. Serve hot with roti or bhakri.

name: Pizza Pasta Sandwich
instructions: Mix diced veggies, paneer, corn and pizza sauce. Make white sauce: heat butter, add flour without browning, gradually add milk while whisking to avoid lumps, add salt, pepper, nutmeg, boiled pasta and processed cheese. Assemble: place pizza mixture on bread slice, grate mozzarella cheese, add another bread slice, spread white sauce pasta on top, grate mozzarella, sprinkle oregano and red chili flakes. Bake on greased tray at 180°C for 7-8 minutes or cook in covered pan. Cut into shapes and serve hot.

name: Fried Chicken Won Ton
instructions: For wonton wrappers: add refined flour and salt to bowl, slowly add water and knead into very firm dough, rest 30 minutes, knead again for couple minutes, divide into portions, roll thin sheets with pasta machine or rolling pin, cut 3-inch squares, dust with flour. For chicken filling: add boneless chicken, celery, spring onion greens, spring onions, coriander, salt, black pepper and soy sauce to mixer grinder and mince. Fill wonton wrapper with chicken filling, wrap into preferred shape. For dipping sauce: combine ketchup, soy sauce, brown sugar, red chili sauce, vinegar, salt, white pepper and water in pan, bring to simmer, thicken with corn starch slurry (2 tsp corn starch mixed with 2 tbsp water), stir and simmer 2 more minutes. Heat oil in deep pan, fry wontons on medium flame until golden brown, serve with dipping sauce.

name: Paneer Corn Tikki Masala
ingredients: salt and black pepper powder to taste
ghee or oil for shallow frying
instructions: Mix paneer, sweet corn, green chillies, ginger garlic paste, amchur powder, refined flour and salt and black pepper powder, take spoonfuls and shape into tikkis. Heat ghee or oil in pan on medium heat, shallow fry tikkis from all sides until crisp and golden brown, keep aside. In same pan, add garlic paste and sauté 1 minute, add cashew paste and sauté 1 minute. Add red chilli powder, garam masala and salt to taste, mix well and cook 2-3 minutes. Add curd and brown onion paste, mix well and cook 3-4 minutes. Add fried paneer tikkis and cook 2-3 minutes, mix gently without breaking. Finish by adding fresh coriander leaves, serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Grilled Pineapple Chicken With Stir Fried Rice
ingredients: spring onion greens 1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp
instructions: For grilled pineapple chicken: divide pineapple in two halves, carefully scoop flesh from one half without damaging for plating. Grind pineapple flesh into fine puree without water, strain through sieve into bowl, add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, garlic, ginger, salt, pepper, corn starch and vinegar, mix well. Add chicken strips and marinate 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, skewer marinated chicken on bamboo skewers. Set grill pan on medium heat, add oil and grill marinated chicken on both sides until crisp and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Apply leftover marination to glaze the chicken. For stir fried rice: set wok on high heat, add oil, ginger garlic paste and spring onion greens, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add veggies and sugar, sauté 1-2 minutes on high flame. Add green chilli paste, soy sauce and salt and pepper, sauté 1 minute on high flame. Add whisked eggs, scramble and cook, add cooked rice, mix and toss well on high flame 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar and spring onion greens, mix well. Serve hot grilled pineapple chicken with stir fried rice.

name: Chicken Bhuna Frankie
instructions: Make bhuna filling: heat oil with jeera and onions until golden, add ginger garlic and red chilli paste, cook 2-3 minutes until oil separates. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander and jeera powder, cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree and curd, stir continuously 2-3 minutes until oil separates. Add boneless chicken, cook 3-4 minutes, add hot water and bring to boil, add garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh coriander. Make frankie roti: knead refined flour with salt and water to soft stretchy dough, add oil, rest 30 minutes. Shape into balls, flatten into thin chapatti, half-cook on tawa until brown spots appear. Assembly: cook half-cooked roti with butter on both sides, whisk egg with salt and pepper, add egg over roti, flip and cook. Apply hot bhuna filling, add chopped onions, sprinkle frankie masala and chilly vinegar, roll and serve.

name: Oats Baida Roti
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl, add chopped veggies (capsicum, onions, tomatoes, corn, beans), oregano, garlic powder, red chilli flakes, salt and pepper, mix well and keep aside. Grind oats to powder, transfer to bowl, add wheat flour and salt, add water to knead soft dough, rest 15 minutes. Knead again after rest and divide into small balls. Flatten into thin 8-9 inch chapati, coat with dry flour. Cook on tawa on medium heat on both sides until spots appear. Pour spoonful of egg mixture in center, fold from one side into envelope shape. Drizzle oil, flip and cook to seal, cook on low heat until crisp and golden. Remove from heat when it starts to puff. Serve hot cut into squares with ketchup or chutney.

name: Veg Combination Frankie
instructions: For aloo filling: heat pan on medium, add schezwan sauce, ketchup, garam masala, coriander powder, red chilli powder, aamchur powder and salt, mix well, add mashed potatoes and mix, set aside. For noodles filling: heat pan, add oil, onions and capsicum, saute few minutes, add schezwan sauce, red chilli sauce and boiled noodles, toss 2-3 minutes, season with salt and pepper, set aside. For frankie roti: knead refined flour with salt and water to soft stretchy dough, add oil, knead smooth, rest 30 minutes. Shape into balls, flatten into thin chapati, half-cook on tawa until brown spots appear. Assembly: cook half-cooked roti with butter on both sides, apply hot aloo filling, flip and cook, spread schezwan sauce, place noodles filling, sprinkle frankie masala, chopped onions and chilli vinegar, roll and serve.

name: Mumbai Style Sandwich
instructions: Make chutney: grind coriander leaves, blanched spinach, green chillies, garlic, curry leaves and roasted chana dal into fine thick paste, adjust consistency with minimal water. Make sandwich masala: dry roast jeera, cloves, peppercorns, fennel seeds and anardana powder until fragrant, cool, grind with amchur powder, ginger powder, hing, black salt and salt into fine powder. Assembly: trim corners and edges of 2 bread slices, apply sufficient butter, apply chutney on top. Place sliced vegetables and sprinkle sandwich masala after each slice. Place another prepared bread slice and close into sandwich, cut into 6 pieces. Spread little butter and chutney on top for street style look. Serve immediately or toast on both sides until crisp and golden, serve with ketchup or chutney.

name: Butter Chicken Spring Roll
instructions: Make spring roll sheets: mix flour and salt, add water to soft stretchy dough, add oil and knead smooth, rest 30 minutes. Knead again and divide into small balls. Make butter chicken: heat butter, add jeera, onions, ginger, garlic, cashews and kashmiri chillies, tomatoes, saute 1 minute, add salt and powdered spices, saute 1 minute, add water, cover and cook 6-7 minutes, cool and grind with kasuri methi into fine paste. Heat butter and oil, add ginger garlic paste, cook 1 minute, add diced chicken, saute briefly, add salt and powdered spices, cook 4-5 minutes, add paste, cook until gravy is thick, add cream and fresh coriander. Make spring roll: flatten dough balls with oil into thin sheets, place omelette and spoonful of butter chicken filling, top with chopped onions, fresh coriander and chaat masala, fold and seal carefully into spring roll, fry in hot oil from all sides until crisp and golden brown, cut into pieces and serve with chutney or dip.

name: Butter Chicken Pizza
instructions: Make pizza base: mix wheat flour, sugar, salt, baking powder and baking soda, add water gradually to soft dough, apply oil on surface, cover and rest 30 minutes. Make makhani sauce: heat oil, add jeera and let splutter, add onions, garlic, ginger, green chillies, kashmiri chillies, tomatoes and cashews, cook 4-5 minutes, add water, cover and cook 8-10 minutes, cool and grind into fine paste, heat butter and oil, add red chilli powder and coriander powder, saute 1 minute, add makhani gravy, cook 5-6 minutes, add sugar, salt, garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh cream, cook 2 minutes, add fresh coriander, cool. Make chicken: mix mustard oil, all powdered spices, ginger garlic paste and hung curd, add diced chicken and fresh coriander, marinate 15 minutes, place live charcoal in center, add ghee, cover and smoke 2-3 minutes, heat oil and cook marinated chicken 6-7 minutes. Assembly: divide dough into 2 parts, dust with flour and semolina, roll into half cm thick pizza base, prick with fork and cook both sides 3-4 minutes, apply makhani sauce, grate mozzarella, add vegetables and chicken tikka, grate more mozzarella, grease pan with butter, cover with lid and cook 6-7 minutes until cheese melts, serve hot.

name: Veg Manchurian Bhel
instructions: Make manchurian mixture: combine grated vegetables with seasonings and flour, form into balls, deep fry until crisp. Fry noodles: toss cooked noodles with cornstarch and salt, fry until crisp. Assemble: mix raw cabbage, capsicum, carrots, fried noodles and manchurian balls, toss with schezwan sauce and ketchup, garnish with spring onion greens and serve immediately.

name: Stuffed Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Slice bread, mix grated cheese with chopped garlic and herbs. Butter bread slices, stuff with cheese-garlic mixture, wrap in foil or bake until cheese melts and bread is toasted.

name: Cajun Spiced Potato Wedges
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges, rinse and par boil with salt, do not overcook. Toss wedges with corn flour and baking powder in a ziplock bag, freeze at least 2 hours. Mix all cajun spice ingredients. Deep fry wedges, then toss with spice mix and parmesan cheese. Serve hot.

name: Delhi Wali Khasta Kachori
instructions: Dough: Mix flour with salt, ajwain and ghee using moyan technique (rub until it holds shape), knead with water to semi-stiff dough, rest 30 min covered. Filling: Soak moong dal 4-5 hours, grind coarsely. Cook besan with oil, add spices and moong dal, add hing slurry, aamchur and black salt, cool to room temperature and shape into balls. Assembly: Make cavity in dough ball, insert filling ball, seal and flatten into semi-thick disk. Deep fry on low heat 10-12 mins until golden. For tari wale aloo: Sauté jeera, coriander seeds, peppercorns and dry chillies, add hing slurry, spices, chopped tomatoes (cook 5-7 min and mash), add boiled potatoes, water and spices, cook 5-7 min. Serve kachori broken into pieces with tari wale aloo and chutney.

name: Anda Mughlai
instructions: Make tomato masala: heat oil and butter, cook onions until golden, add ginger garlic paste, sauté 1 min, add spice powders, sauté 1 min, add tomatoes and salt, cook 3-4 min until mushy (can mash), add water and cook 4-5 min, add garam masala and fresh coriander. Prepare eggs: slice 4 boiled eggs, dice remaining 2 boiled eggs. Fry diced eggs in butter with green chillies, salt and pepper. Whisk 2 raw eggs with salt, pepper, red chilli powder and fresh coriander. Cook omelette on tawa with oil, add whisked egg mixture and arrange sliced boiled eggs on top, cook until set, flip and cook other side. Serve omelette topped with tomato masala and butter-fried boiled eggs.

name: Cheese Chilli Manchurian
instructions: Make cheese chilli balls: mix boiled mashed potatoes with grated paneer and cheese, add garlic, chopped capsicum and green chillies, season with salt and pepper, mix in corn flour and rice flour, add soy sauce and spring onion greens. Shape into small roundels, coat lightly with corn flour, deep fry on high flame until crisp and golden. For gravy: heat oil in wok, add garlic and ginger, sauté 1-2 min on high heat, add onion petals and all bell peppers, sauté 1-2 min, add green chillies and sugar, sauté, add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, ketchup, salt, white pepper and vinegar, add water and bring to boil, add cornstarch-water slurry and cook until sauce thickens, add fried cheese chilli balls and sauté well. Garnish with spring onion greens and serve hot with rice or roti.

name: Veg Manchurian Fries
instructions: Make manchurian balls: Mix vegetables, corn starch, refined flour, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Form balls and deep fry until golden brown. Make sauce: Heat oil, sauté ginger, garlic, green chillies, add spring onion, chilli sauce, soy sauce, water, thicken with cornstarch mixture, add manchurian balls. Make fries: Cut potatoes into 1cm batons, soak in ice cold water 15 minutes, double fry (3-4 min then 15 min rest then high heat until crisp). Assemble: Top fries with manchurian sauce, garnish with spring onion.

name: Cheese Burst Toast
instructions: Make cheese sauce: Grate cheese, add milk and butter, heat in microwave 2 minutes in 30-second intervals, blend for smooth texture. Mexican style: Apply cheese sauce to bread, add second bread slice flattened, spread salsa and toppings (beans, corn, capsicum, tomato, onion), pan-fry with butter on medium heat with lid until cheese melts and base is crispy. Paneer pizza style: Same process but use pizza sauce instead of salsa and add paneer plus red chilli powder.

name: Cheese Burst Vadapav
instructions: Make cheese sauce: Double boil cheese, milk and butter, blend for smooth texture. Make vada filling: Heat oil, add cumin and mustard seeds, sauté 1 minute. Add curry leaves, sauté seconds. Add ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add turmeric, cook 1 minute. Add boiled potatoes, mix 3-4 minutes. Add salt, lemon juice and coriander, cool. Make batter: Mix gram flour, ajwain, carom seeds and salt, add water to make semi-thick batter, rest 10 minutes. Assemble: Grease palms with oil, flatten potato mixture, add spoonful cheese sauce, shape into balls. Dip in batter and deep fry on medium-high heat until golden. Serve hot with pav and green chutney, with crispy chura on side.

name: French Fries with Cheese Sauce
instructions: Make cheese sauce: Heat pan, add butter, onions, green chillies and peppercorns, cook until onions soft. Add fresh cream, simmer, rest 5-7 minutes. Double boil cheese, strain and add cream, whisk until smooth silky texture. Make fries: Wash and peel potatoes. Cut into 1cm slices then 1cm batons. Soak in ice cold water 15 minutes to remove starch, pat dry. Heat oil on medium flame, first fry 3-4 minutes then rest 15 minutes. Increase heat to high, second fry until crisp and golden brown. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot with freshly made cheese sauce poured over fries.

name: Healthy Dosa
instructions: Sprouts and oats dosa: Soak green gram 4-5 hours, drain and sprout overnight. Grind sprouted gram with curd, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin seeds, green chillies, ginger, coriander and water to fine puree. Add oats powder sieved, add salt, whisk well, rest 15 minutes. Heat tawa, spread 1-2 spoonfuls batter evenly, drizzle oil, lower flame, cook until golden brown, flip and cook 1 minute other side. Rava dosa: Mix rava, rice flour, maida, salt, pepper, cumin, curd and water to smooth batter. Add chopped onions, ginger, green chillies, curry leaves and more water for flowing consistency, rest 15-30 minutes. Heat tawa, pour batter, add oil, cook until crisp golden brown. Serve both dosas hot with coconut chutney and tomato chutney.

name: Crispy Honey Chicken
ingredients: dry cornstarch as required to coat
instructions: Marinate chicken: Dice chicken breast, add salt, pepper, vinegar, soy sauce, ginger paste, mix and coat with cornstarch, marinate 15 minutes. Coat each piece with dry cornflour, dust off excess, rest 10 minutes. Fry chicken: Heat wok with oil on medium-high, first fry until light brown, rest 5 minutes, second fry on high heat until crispy golden brown, remove on absorbent paper. Make sauce: Heat pan with oil on high heat, sauté garlic and ginger 1 minute, add red chilli paste, ketchup, salt, black pepper, honey and soy sauce, sauté 1 minute. Add crispy chicken, stir well to coat with sauce. Add spring onion greens and vinegar, mix and toss. Serve hot.

name: Granola Bars
instructions: Dry roast seeds, nuts and rolled oats separately in pan for 3-4 minutes each, combine in mixing bowl and cool down together. Grind pitted dates. Add ground dates, honey, dried blueberries and dried cranberries to roasted mixture, mix well and combine thoroughly with clean hands. Pour mixture into lined baking tray, press and flatten to slab, add dried berries on top and press with back of spoon. Refrigerate 1 hour to set. Demold slab and cut into bars or squares as required. Store in airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

name: grilled harissa paneer with mashed potatoes
instructions: For mashed potatoes: Wash, peel and cube potatoes. Boil until done, drain and stir-cook for 2-3 minutes to dry. Mash and sieve for fine texture. Add melted butter, salt and pepper, fold well. Simmer fresh cream and gradually add to potatoes while mixing. For harissa paste: Char red bell pepper on flame, peel charred skin and chop. Dry roast ajwain, coriander and cumin seeds until fragrant. Soak dry chillies in hot water 15-20 minutes. Grind charred peppers, roasted spices, soaked chillies, garlic, sugar, lemon juice, salt, pepper, water and olive oil into fine paste. For grilled paneer: Coat paneer in harissa paste, marinate 15-20 minutes. Grill on medium heat 3-4 minutes per side. Stir-fry vegetables: Heat olive oil, sauté carrots, mushrooms, bell peppers and broccoli 3-4 minutes. Add mixed herbs, salt and pepper, sauté 2-3 more minutes. Add lemon juice. Serve grilled paneer with mashed potatoes and stir-fried vegetables.

name: no onion no garlic rajma
instructions: Wash kidney beans and soak in water for minimum 5-6 hours or overnight. Strain excess water and wash thoroughly. In a cooker, add soaked rajma with fresh water 2 inches above surface, add salt and pressure cook on medium flame for 1-2 whistles. Let cooker depressurize naturally and open. Set wok on medium heat, add oil, jeera, bay leaves and black cardamom, sauté for 1 minute. Add ginger and green chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, hing and turmeric powder, sauté for few seconds. Add cashew paste and sauté for few seconds, then add tomato puree and salt, cook until oil separates. Add cooked rajma with its water, bring to boil and cook for 10-15 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and lemon juice, mix well. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with rice.

name: palak chole
instructions: Wash white chickpeas and soak in water for at least 5 hours or overnight. Drain and cook in cooker with garlic cloves, whole spices, black tea concoction and salt, water 2 inches above chickpeas. Pressure cook on medium flame for 3-4 whistles. Let depressurize naturally and open. Blanch entire bunch of spinach for 2 minutes, dip in ice cold water immediately. In blending jar add blanched spinach, fresh coriander and green chillies, grind into fine paste. Heat ghee in wok, add jeera and dry red chilli, sauté for 30 seconds. Add hing and onions, sauté until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add powdered spices and sauté for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add boiled chickpeas with spices and black tea concoction. Add spinach puree and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add garam masala and lemon juice, mix well and serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: crispy oyster chilli chicken
instructions: Cut chicken diagonally into thin strips. Marinate with salt, pepper, soy sauce, vinegar and egg white. Mix well. Add cornflour and refined flour, coat well. Heat oil in pan/wok on medium-high heat, fry coated chicken strips until crisp and golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper and set aside. In same wok heat oil on medium-high, add garlic and spring onion bulbs, sauté for 1 minute. Add dry red chillies, fresh red chillies and bell peppers, sauté on high flame for 1 minute. Add oyster sauce, red chilli sauce, soy sauce and vinegar. Add salt and black pepper, sauté on high flame for 1 minute. Add fried chicken and toss well. Garnish with fresh spring onion greens and serve immediately.

name: pinwheel samosa
ingredients: green peas 1/4 cup boiled and chopped
instructions: For potato filling: Heat oil in wok, add hing and jeera, sauté for 1 minute. Add ginger, green chillies, green peas and potatoes, mix well. Add salt to taste and all powdered spices, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add freshly chopped coriander leaves, mix well and set aside. For samosa dough: In mixing bowl add refined flour, ajwain and salt, mix well. Add oil and combine together. Add water to knead firm dough. Cover with damp cloth and rest for 15-30 minutes. Knead again after resting. Divide dough into two equal portions, flatten first half into thin chapati. Spread filling on chapati and tightly roll into cylindrical shape. Cut into 1 cm disks and lightly flatten. In small bowl make slurry by mixing 1/2 cup refined flour with water. Dip pinwheel disk in refined flour slurry and deep fry in oil on medium heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot and crispy with chutney or dip of choice.

name: Peri Peri Egg Wrap
instructions: Make dough with flour, ajwain and salt, rest 30 mins. Prepare egg paratha by rolling dough, applying ghee and ajwain, rolling into cone and flattening. Cook paratha in ghee until golden. Whisk 2 eggs with salt, pepper and chillies, cook paratha over omelette. For egg bhurji, sauté jeera and green chillies in ghee, add onions and tomatoes, cook 2-3 mins, add spices, cook 1-2 mins, add 5 whisked eggs and scramble until cooked. Mix mayonnaise with peri peri spice mix. Assemble: spread peri peri mayo on paratha, add egg bhurji on half side, top with onions and coriander, fold in half. Grill on both sides until marks appear. Serve hot.

name: Khasta Samosa with Tamarind Onion Chutney
instructions: For dough: Mix flour, salt, ajwain and ghee (moyan), add water to make semi-stiff dough, rest 30 mins, knead and divide into balls, rest again. For filling: Heat ghee, add jeera, hing and saunf, sauté 1 min, add ginger garlic paste, sauté 1 min, add boiled mashed potatoes, add spices and salt, cook 5-6 mins until moisture evaporates, add jeera powder, black salt, anardana, amchur and coriander, cook 2-3 mins more. For samosa: Flatten dough, cut in half, fold to cone shape, fill with potato mixture, seal edges, rest 10-15 mins, deep fry until crisp and golden brown. For chutney: Soak tamarind in boiling water 2 hours, grind with salt, chilli, black salt, ginger, jeera and sugar, strain through sieve. Serve samosa hot with chutney.

name: Veg Kebab Masala
ingredients: fortune vivo diabetes care oil 2 tbsp
instructions: For bhuna gravy: Heat oil on medium heat, add cumin seeds for aroma, add onions and cook until golden brown. Add garlic paste and red chili paste, cook 3-4 mins. Add spices and cook 2-3 mins more. Add curd and cashew paste, cook 12-15 mins until gravy releases oil on top. Add salt and garam masala powder, finish with coriander. For kebab: Heat oil, add ginger garlic and green chillies, sauté. Add grated vegetables, anardana, chili powder, garam masala and salt. Cook 5-7 mins until ingredients combine. In bowl mix cooked vegetables with grated paneer (add breadcrumb or cornflour if mixture is too soft). Form kebabs of preferred shape and size. Grill in oiled pan on medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Assemble kebabs on gravy, garnish with fresh cream and coriander. Serve hot with parathas.

name: Veg Combination Toast
instructions: Prepare cheese chilli garlic topping: Grate cheese, add garlic, green chillies, coriander and oregano, mix and set aside. Prepare chatpata paneer topping: Crumble paneer, add tamarind and mint chutneys, onions, coriander and mint leaves, chili powder, chaat masala and salt, mix and set aside. Prepare pav bhaji topping: Mix mashed potatoes, capsicum, tomatoes, onions, parsley, pav bhaji masala, salt and lemon juice, set aside. Assembly: Slice hot dog buns in half lengthwise, apply all three toppings equally on one side of bread. Top with coriander on paneer topping, red chilli flakes on cheese topping, grated paneer on pav bhaji topping. Heat pan on medium heat, grease with butter, toast bread on one side until crisp and golden, cover and cook until cheese melts (or bake at 200°C for 7-8 mins). Serve hot with ketchup or dip of choice.

name: Crispy Schezwan Noodles Nest
instructions: Deep fry noodles in a sieve-based nest mold until crispy and golden. For filling, heat oil, sauté garlic and ginger for 1 minute. Add capsicum and sweet corn, cook 1 minute on high heat. Add ketchup, red chilli sauce, schezwan sauce, salt and pepper, mix well, add water and cook 1-2 minutes. Add paneer cubes and spring onion greens, mix well. Fill the crispy noodle nests with the schezwan filling and garnish with spring onion greens. Serve immediately before it gets soggy.

name: Garlic Pepper Crispy Corn
instructions: First prepare crispy fried garlic: heat oil for shallow fry, add chopped garlic and fry on medium flame until crispy and golden brown. Strain and drain on absorbent paper. For the corn: boil water with salt, add sweet corn and boil for 2 minutes. Cool the corn, add salt and pepper, coat well with corn flour and rice flour, adding water if needed. Deep freeze coated corn for 15 minutes. Heat oil on high heat and deep fry corn in batches until crispy and golden brown, remove on absorbent paper. In a wok, heat 1 tbsp garlic oil, add spring onion bulbs, almond slivers, dry red chilli and spring onion greens, sauté 2 minutes. Add fried corn, crispy fried garlic, vinegar, salt and pepper, toss well. Serve hot with Schezwan sauce.

name: Kutchi Dabeli Misal
instructions: For dabeli masala: roast all whole spices on low heat until fragrant, cool to room temperature, grind to fine powder. Add powdered sugar, Kashmiri red chilli powder, amchur powder, black salt, desiccated coconut and grind again. Mix in grain sugar and oil. For dabeli mixture: heat oil, add jeera and hing, sauté 30 seconds. Add dabeli masala and boiled mashed potatoes, tamarind pulp and salt, cook 1-2 minutes. Add fresh coriander and mix well. For assembly: crush kadak butter pav until chunky, add a spoonful of dabeli mixture, red chutney, tamarind chutney, chopped onions, masala peanuts and squeeze lemon. Mix everything well and serve in a bowl. Garnish with grated coconut, sev, coriander and pomegranate seeds. Serve immediately before it gets soggy.

name: Walnut Carrot Beet Cake
instructions: Grind oats to fine powder. Dry roast crushed walnuts for 2-3 minutes. Break eggs in a bowl, add powdered sugar and vanilla essence, beat well with electric beater. Add honey, oil, wheat flour, jowar flour, oats flour, baking powder, grated beetroot, grated carrot, roasted walnuts and salt, mix well. Add milk and mix until the mixture is of dropping consistency. Grease cake mold with butter, sprinkle dry flour and coat all over. Pour cake mixture into mold and top with walnut kernels and crushed walnuts. Bake in preheated oven at 175°C for 30-35 minutes. Insert a toothpick in the center; if it comes out clean, the cake is done, otherwise bake for a few more minutes. Cool before demoulding.

name: Uthappa Platter
instructions: Prepare individual fillings by mixing each set of ingredients in separate bowls (beet-carrot, cheese-chilli, sprouts chaat, paneer schezwan, potato pav bhaji, pizza filling). Heat butter in a pan on medium flame. Pour three different fillings onto the pan, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side until golden. Serve hot on a platter. Repeat with remaining fillings.

name: Spinach and Corn Rice
instructions: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, then dip in ice water. Grind blanched spinach with coriander, mint, and green chillies into fine paste. Heat oil, add cumin seeds until crackling, sauté garlic for 1-2 minutes. Add ginger and onions until translucent. Add powdered spices and sauté for 1 minute. Add spinach paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add sweet corn and cook 2-3 minutes. Add salt, then cooked rice, mix well and cook 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala and lemon juice, mix and serve hot.

name: Aloo Bhurji
instructions: Heat oil or ghee, add jeera and saunf, then sauté ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add onions and cook 2-3 minutes until light golden. Add green chillies, tomatoes, capsicum, salt, turmeric, red chilli, and aamchur powder; cook 3-4 minutes. Add boiled potatoes and break into smaller chunks with spatula, add water and mix well. Add garam masala and kasuri methi, turn off heat. Add fresh cream or curd and mix, finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: Soya Kheema Paratha
instructions: For filling: Cook soya granules in boiling salted water for 2-3 minutes, strain and rinse thoroughly, squeeze out excess water. Heat oil, add cumin seeds, sauté ginger and green chillies for 1 minute. Add onions until translucent. Add powdered spices and sauté 1 minute. Add soya granules, cook 2-3 minutes. Add coriander and mint, mix well and cool. For paratha: Mix salt and ajwain with wheat flour, add water to knead semi-soft dough, apply oil, cover with damp cloth for 30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten, create cavity, fill with soya mixture, seal, coat with dry flour, roll into thick paratha. Cook on hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear, apply ghee, flip and cook again. Serve hot with curd or chutney.

name: Chicken Hot and Sour Soup
instructions: Slice chicken diagonally into thin strips. Marinate with egg white, salt, white pepper, corn flour, light soy sauce, and vinegar. Shallow fry chicken quickly until light golden, remove and set aside. Heat same oil, add garlic, ginger, and green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add chicken stock, dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper, and salt. Bring to boil. Add carrots, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and fried chicken; bring to boil. Add corn flour-water mixture to thicken soup. Pour beaten egg in while stirring, add sesame oil and spring onion greens. Serve hot.

name: Super Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough with flour and yeast. Add sauce and cheese toppings. Bake until golden and crispy.

name: Tacos
instructions: Prepare two variations of tacos with tortillas as base. Add fillings including lettuce, tomatoes, onions and cheese toppings.

name: Creamy Cuppa Maggi
instructions: Prepare white sauce: melt butter, cook flour, add milk gradually while whisking. Add seasonings and vegetables. Cook maggi separately with ketchup and masala. Layer in microwave-safe mug: maggi, white sauce, cheese. Repeat layers, top with cheese. Microwave 30 seconds until cheese melts.

name: Masala Rava Idli
instructions: Mix rava with salt and curd, rest 30 minutes. Prepare tempering with oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, green chillies, cashews and curry leaves. Add to batter with baking soda. Grease idli mold, pour batter 3/4 full, steam 7-8 minutes. Prepare podi masala by roasting and grinding red chillies, sesame, dals, mustard and curry leaves. Make masala sauce with butter, onions, garlic, tomatoes. Coat steamed idli with masala sauce.

name: Makhana Bhel
instructions: Heat ghee in wok, add makhana and roast until crispy. Add powdered spices and mix well. Transfer to bowl. Add chopped onions, tomatoes, sweet corn, raw mangoes, peanuts, sprouted moong, green chillies, pomegranate, chutneys and salt. Mix well. Garnish with coriander, sev and pomegranate. Serve immediately.

name: Mini Soya Kheema Samosas
instructions: Prepare soya kheema filling with spices. Wrap in samosa pastry. Air fry until golden and crispy without oil.

name: Paneer Bhuna Roll
instructions: Make paneer bhuna: sauté jeera in oil, add onions, add ginger-garlic paste, add curd and spices, cook 3-4 minutes, add tomato puree, cook 7-8 minutes, add paneer cubes, cook 2-3 minutes, finish with garam masala and coriander. Make dough: knead flour, salt, ghee with water, rest 15 minutes. Roll into thin chapati, fill with paneer mixture and onions, fold and seal. Pan fry until golden brown on all sides.

name: Mutton Kheema Pattice
instructions: Wash mutton mince. Heat ghee, add whole spices, sauté 1 minute. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook until onions brown. Add mutton, cook 15-20 minutes. Add powders, cook 10-12 minutes. Add water, cover, cook 30-45 minutes until ghee separates. Add garam masala and coriander. For pattice: mash boiled potatoes, add poha, ginger-garlic paste, herbs, spices. Shape into tikkis. Shallow fry in ghee until golden. Top with mutton kheema, chutneys, onions, ginger.

name: Tandoori Paneer Masala Pav
instructions: Chop capsicum and dice paneer. Heat oil, add jeera, sauté until crackling. Add red chilli paste and garlic paste, cook until oil separates. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add capsicum and tomatoes, cook 8-10 minutes, lightly mash. Add paneer, tandoori masala, garam masala, lemon juice. Add chopped coriander. Cut pav into cubes and gently mix in, cook 1 minute. Serve hot.

name: Veg Combination Rice
instructions: Heat oil in wok on high flame. Add garlic, sauté few seconds. Add green chillies, sauté few seconds. Add all vegetables, sauté 30 seconds on high. Add sugar, salt, pepper, soy sauce, red chilli sauce. Sauté 2 minutes. Add cooked rice and boiled noodles, mix well, cook 2-3 minutes. Add spring onion greens, mix. Serve hot with Schezwan sauce.

name: Chicken Sweet Corn Soup
instructions: Add sweet corn to grinding jar with water and grind into fine puree. In a separate bowl add minced chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, fresh coriander, salt and pepper, mix well. Set pan on high flame, add oil and ginger, sauté for few seconds. Add carrots, french beans and sweet corn, sauté for 2-3 minutes on high heat. Add chicken stock, green chilli sauce, honey, salt and pepper to taste and add pureed corn, mix well and bring to boil. Remove froth or scum formed while cooking. Shape minced chicken into balls and add to soup, let cook completely for 3-4 minutes. Add cornstarch and water mixture to soup, mix well and cook until thick.
