Add whisked eggs and mix with light hands. Add vinegar and spring onion greens, mix well and serve hot.

name: Nargisi Kofta
ingredients: live charcoal and ghee for smoking
instructions: For koftas: Heat ghee in wok, add sliced onions and cook on medium heat until start to turn brown. Spread fried onions on paper towel to absorb fat. Soak cashew nuts in hot water for 10 minutes. In a mixing bowl add minced chicken, ginger, garlic, green chillies, fried onions, powdered spices, besan, ghee, salt, fresh coriander and mint leaves, mix well all ingredients. Place live charcoal in centre and add few drops of ghee, cover and smoke for 2-3 minutes. Take large spoonful of mixture and flatten on palms, place boiled egg in centre and cover completely with chicken mixture. Fry kofta on medium-high heat from all sides until chicken is cooked, crisp and golden brown. Grind remaining fried onions and soaked cashews. For gravy: Heat oil in wok, add whole spices and ginger garlic paste, cook on medium flame for 1-2 minutes. Add tomato puree and salt, cook until oil is released. Add powdered spices and cook for 1-2 minutes, lower flame, add whisked curd, cashew paste, mix well and add green chillies, stir for 2-3 minutes. Increase flame and cook until oil is separated. Add ground fried onions and add water to adjust consistency. Mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes, bring to boil. Add fried koftas, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes on low flame. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and freshly chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Chapati Sandwich
instructions: Use leftover chapati as the base. Toast the chapati on a tawa with butter, add sandwich masala, chutney, and vegetable fillings (tomatoes, onions, cucumber). Close and serve hot.

name: Tawa Anda Pulao
instructions: Heat oil in a tawa. Add minced garlic and onions, sauté until golden. Add cooked rice, scrambled eggs, and vegetables. Season with spices and mix well. Serve hot.

name: Crispy Honey Chilli Potato
instructions: Cut potatoes into small cubes and deep fry until crispy. In a pan, combine honey, chilli sauce, garlic, and ginger. Toss fried potatoes in the honey chilli sauce. Serve hot and crispy.

name: Masala Pav Sandwich
instructions: Prepare red garlic chilli paste by boiling Kashmiri chillies with garlic, cumin, and black salt. Slice pav in half. Toast on tawa with butter, masala paste, and coriander. Add vegetable slices and sandwich masala. Close like a vadapav and serve hot.

name: Grilled Harissa Paneer with Hummus
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes or slabs. Coat with harissa paste and olive oil. Grill on a hot pan or skewer until golden with charred marks. Serve with a dollop of hummus on the side.

name: Chole pav chaat
instructions: Soak raw chickpeas for 4 hours or overnight. Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with water and salt for 4 whistles, let depressurize naturally. Heat ghee in deep pan, add whole spices and sauté for a minute. Add chopped onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and slit green chillies, sauté for a minute. Add tomato puree and all powdered spices, mix well and cook for 5-6 minutes, cover until ghee separates. Add cooked chickpeas with their water and cook for 5-7 minutes until gravy thickens. Finish with fresh coriander, kasuri methi and garam masala. For assembly, slice pav in half, dip in chole gravy, place on plate, add chole, garlic chutney, tamarind chutney, sev, fresh coriander, pomegranate seeds, ginger juliennes and chopped onions. Serve immediately.

name: Healthy jeera aloo roll
instructions: Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and asafoetida, let jeera crackle. Add diced potatoes and cook for 7-8 minutes on medium flame. Add powdered spices and salt, sauté for a minute, sprinkle water, cover and cook for 3-4 minutes. Add fresh coriander leaves. For dough: mix all flours, grated bottle gourd and carrot with salt, squeeze vegetables with flour, add water to knead soft dough. Apply ghee on surface, cover with damp cloth, rest for 15-20 minutes. Divide into equal portions, flatten into balls, dust with flour and roll thin mini chapati. Cook on hot tawa on both sides. Apply ketchup on chapati, add jeera aloo filling and roll. Serve as healthy lunch box meal.

name: Achari aloo tacos
instructions: For aachari aloo: Set pan on medium heat, add mustard oil and heat until smoking point, lower flame. Add jeera, kalonji, hing and dry red chillies, mix well and cook until spices release aroma. Add boiled baby potatoes and cook until crispy. Add powdered spices, powdered sugar and salt, mix and cook for 1-2 minutes on low flame. Add water, mix well, cook for 2-3 minutes on medium flame. For salsa: In mixing bowl, add onions, cucumber, tomatoes, fresh mint and coriander, tamarind water, red chilli powder, chaat masala, salt and curd, mix well. For taco shells: Coat dough balls with dry flour, flatten with hands, roll into thin chapati. Cook on hot pan on both sides without oil. Assembly: Spread spoonful of salsa over shell, add aachari aloo filling, top with sliced onions and red chillies. Serve as party appetizer with quartered lemon.

name: Street style tava paneer frankie
instructions: Set pan on medium flame and add oil, onion paste, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, tomato puree, cashew paste, curd, salt, paneer and fresh coriander. In large vessel, add refined flour, water, oil and mix well. Knead well, cover and rest for 30 minutes. Take small dough roundel on wooden board, flatten using pin roll. Set tawa on medium flame and cook frankie roti until white spots appear only. Make multiple half-cooked rotis before serving. Cook again immediately before serving. Place frankie paratha on plate, add chopped onions, frankie masala, chilli vinegar and tava paneer. Roll the roti and serve hot immediately.

name: egg masala maggi
instructions: Heat oil in wok, add jeera and sauté. Add onions, cook until translucent. Add tomatoes, ginger garlic paste, green chillies and salt, cook until mushy. Add powdered masalas and maggi masala, cook well. Add water and maggi noodles, cook until 3/4 done. Add boiled diced eggs and cook 2-3 minutes more. Add fresh coriander and serve hot.

name: grilled broccoli babycorn mushroom skewers in chilli garlic sauce
instructions: Blanch baby corn 7-8 minutes and broccoli 2 minutes in boiling water, chill in ice water. Mix with mushrooms, ginger garlic paste, salt, pepper and soy sauce. Skewer marinated vegetables and grill on medium heat with oil until golden brown. For sauce: heat oil, add garlic and spring onion bulbs, sauté 1 minute. Add green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add bell peppers and spring onion greens, sauté 1 minute. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt and pepper. Add water and cornstarch mixture to thicken. For cabbage: heat butter, add onions and cabbage, sauté 2-3 minutes. Assemble on hot sizzler plate with cabbage layer, grilled skewers, and pour sauce over.

name: veg peri peri sandwich
instructions: Mix all spices for peri peri spice mix. Mix mayonnaise with 3 tbsp peri peri mix and divide into two halves. Make coleslaw with first half by mixing with grated cabbage and carrot. For sandwich: spread butter on bread slice, add peri peri coleslaw, grated boiled potatoes, peri peri masala, onions, tomatoes and capsicum. On another slice spread butter and peri peri mayonnaise, close sandwich. Press gently. Cut into desired pieces and grate cheese over top. Optional: toast with cheese filling until crispy and golden brown.

name: butter chicken tikka
instructions: Slice chicken breast thin from between. Mix mustard oil, powdered spices, ginger garlic paste, cashew nut paste, fresh cream, tomato puree, sugar, kasuri methi and salt. Add hung curd and roasted besan, mix well. Add chicken slices, tomatoes, capsicum and onions, coat well. Place live charcoal, pour ghee and smoke for 5 minutes. Marinate for at least 30 minutes. Fold and skewer chicken slices with vegetables. Heat oil in grill pan and brush butter, place chicken and cook 2-3 minutes on all sides. Pour melted butter over top. Serve hot with fresh cream, melted butter, chaat masala, green chutney and onion slices.

name: Veg Bread Omelette
instructions: Apply ketchup and spread over bread slice, place another bread slice and cut into triangles. In a bowl add besan, crushed alsi, salt, pepper, spices, chopped vegetables and coriander. Mix well and add water to make thick batter, whisk well with no lumps. Rest batter 10 minutes. Dip bread in batter and coat well. Heat oil in pan and cook coated bread from all sides until golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup or dip.

name: Khatte Meethe Tari Waale Aloo-Puri
instructions: Heat oil in pressure cooker, add mustard seeds and jeera, sauté. Add ginger, green chillies and curry leaves, sauté 30 seconds. Add besan and cook until light brown. Add tomato puree and salt, cook 2-3 minutes. Add powdered spices and jaggery, cook 4-5 minutes. Add diced potatoes, mix and cook 3-4 minutes. Add aamchur powder and hot water. Pressure cook for 2 whistles on medium flame, depressurize naturally. Cook further 5-6 minutes on low heat. For puri: Mix wheat flour, rava, ajwain, salt and oil. Add water to knead tight dough, rest 15 minutes, knead again. Divide into balls, apply oil, roll thin. Fry in hot oil on medium-high heat until fluffy and golden brown. Serve hot with tari.

name: Crispy Papad Fries
instructions: Wash, peel and cut potatoes into 1 cm slices then 1 cm batons. Set water for boiling with salt, add potato batons and cook 5-7 minutes. Strain and cool. Mix refined flour, rice flour, besan, garlic powder, red chilli flakes, mixed herbs, black pepper, salt and cheese in a bowl. Add water to make thick batter. Crush raw papad into small pieces. Coat par-boiled potato batons with batter, then coat with crushed papad. Freeze 10 minutes. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with pickled mayonnaise or schezwan sauce.

name: Corn Cheese Nuggets
instructions: Take a large mixing bowl, add grated processed cheese, mashed potatoes, corn and salt and black pepper, mix and combine well with spatula or clean hands, ensure smooth consistency. Transfer to baking tray and shape into slab, cut into rectangles. Make a slurry with maida, corn flour, salt, black pepper and water in a separate bowl, ensure no lumps and flowing consistency. Dip nuggets in slurry to coat well, then coat with bread crumbs. Repeat dipping and coating twice. Refrigerate 15 minutes. Deep fry in hot oil at medium heat until crispy and golden brown. Remove on absorbent paper. Serve hot with ketchup or favorite dip.

name: Hyderabadi Paneer Masala
instructions: Blanch entire bunch of spinach for 2 minutes, dip into ice cold water. Heat oil in wok, add whole spices and sauté 1 minute. Add ginger, garlic, green chillies and onion, cook until onions are translucent. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until tomatoes are mushy. Add fresh coriander and blanched spinach, mix well and cook 2-3 minutes. Add water, cool to room temperature and grind into fine paste. Heat oil in wok, add jeera and allow to splutter, add ginger and sauté 1 minute, add paste and mix well. Add powdered spices and stir, cook on low flame 2-3 minutes. Add curd 3 tbsp, stir continuously immediately after adding. Cover and cook until oil is released, stir in intervals and add water to adjust gravy consistency. Add paneer cubes and mix gently without breaking. Add grated paneer, cook 2-3 minutes. Add garam masala, kasuri methi and salt to taste. Serve hot with naan, roti or rice.

name: Street Style Egg Tava Pulao
instructions: Hard boil 3 eggs and remove shell, dice and set aside. Break 3 eggs into mixing bowl, add salt and black pepper, whisk with fork. Set pan on medium heat, add ghee, pour whisked eggs and cook few minutes, scramble the eggs without making omelette, set aside. In same pan add ghee, add jeera, green chillies, ginger garlic paste, onions and capsicum, cook 1-2 minutes. Add tomatoes with salt, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and black pepper, cook 2-3 minutes. Start mashing the veggies roughly with spatula. Add water to cook veggies properly and get moisture in masala. Add diced boiled eggs and cook 1 minute so eggs absorb flavor. Add cooked basmati rice (cooled down well), add scrambled eggs and 2 tbsp fresh coriander, mix and cook 2-3 minutes. Add lemon juice and garam masala, add fresh coriander. Mix and serve hot.

name: kung pao potato with walnuts
instructions: Boil and cube potatoes. Fry until golden. Prepare sauce with soy, chilli sauce, garlic, ginger. Toast walnuts separately. Stir-fry vegetables, add fried potatoes and walnuts, toss with sauce until coated.

name: paneer tikka popcorn
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes. Hang curd for 45 minutes to drain. Mix mustard oil with chilli powder to extract color. Combine hung curd with ginger-garlic paste, spices, coriander, and besan. Coat paneer cubes with marinade. Coat with breadcrumbs. Deep fry until golden. Serve with mint mayo dip.

name: crispy corn chilli
instructions: Boil corn 2-3 minutes, cool in tap water. Mix with salt, pepper, oil. Coat with cornflour, refined flour, baking powder. Freeze 15 minutes. Deep fry in batches until golden. In pan: sauté garlic, spring onion, capsicum. Add sugar, sauces, spices. Make cornstarch-water paste, add to pan. Toss fried corn in sauce. Garnish with spring onion greens.

name: aloo matar dhaba style
instructions: Boil potatoes, peel and cut into chunks. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds. Sauté onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, green chillies. Add tomatoes, cook until soft. Add turmeric, chilli powder, coriander, cumin. Add potatoes and peas. Cook 10-15 minutes on medium heat. Finish with garam masala. Serve hot.

name: bedmi puri with aloo sabzi
instructions: For bedmi: Soak urad dal 1-2 hours. Grind dal with ginger, chilli, spices to coarse mixture. Knead wheat flour, rava, dal mixture, oil with warm water into stiff dough. Rest 30 minutes. Shape into thick puris, fry until golden and crispy. For aloo sabzi: Heat ghee, add jeera, ginger, chillies, saunf, coriander seeds, red chillies. Add hing, turmeric, red chilli powder, soaked methi, besan. Cook 30 seconds. Add roughly mashed potatoes and water. Cook 8-10 minutes. Add amchur, kasuri methi, kala namak. Garnish with coriander and ginger juliennes.

name: Chicken Sheekh Paratha Roll
instructions: Blend onions, garlic, ginger and green chillies finely. Squeeze dry in muslin cloth. Mince chicken finely. Mix chicken with squeezed onions, mint, coriander, spices and ghee. Smoke mixture with charcoal and ghee for 3-5 minutes. Shape onto bamboo skewers and grill on medium heat with ghee until golden. Make paratha dough with wheat flour, ajwain and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Roll into thick paratha, apply ghee and fold twice into pinwheel shape. Cook on hot tawa until golden. Assemble by spreading chutneys on paratha, adding onion rings and chicken seekh. Sprinkle chaat masala and roll. Serve hot.

name: Tava Masala Idli
instructions: Mix rava, curd and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Gradually add water and whisk to pouring consistency. Rest 15 minutes. Grease idli mould and add fruit salt to batter just before steaming. Steam for 7-8 minutes. Test with toothpick until done. Cool and demould. Cut into quarters. Heat ghee, splutter jeera, add onions until translucent. Add red chilli paste and garlic paste, cook 3-4 minutes. Add capsicum, tomatoes, salt, turmeric and pav bhaji masala. Mash tomatoes and cook 3-4 minutes. Add water if needed. Add idlis and mix gently to coat. Cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with coriander and lemon juice. Serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Baked Cheesy Khichdi
instructions: Heat ghee in cooker, add jeera, turmeric, rice and tur dal with water. Mix well and pressure cook for 2 whistles on medium flame. Allow natural depressurization and open. Heat ghee in wok, add jeera and splutter. Add green chillies, ginger and asafoetida, saute 1-2 minutes. Add onions and potatoes, cook 5-6 minutes. Add water, cover and cook until potatoes almost done. Add veggies and salt, cook 4-5 minutes. Add powdered spices and cook 1-2 minutes. Add water and cook 1-2 minutes. Add cooked dal and rice, cook 3-4 minutes with veggies. Add kasuri methi and coriander, mix well. Add grated cheese and cook 1-2 minutes. Transfer to oven-friendly bowl, top with grated cheese and chopped garlic. Bake at 180°C for 10-12 minutes. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: Desi Veg Chowmein Noodles
instructions: Boil water with salt and bring to roaring boil. Add raw noodles and cook 2-3 minutes after they separate. Strain and refresh with cold water. Drizzle oil and coat noodles to prevent sticking. Set wok on high heat, add oil, chopped garlic, ginger, spring onion bulbs, slit green chillies and sliced onions. Saute 1 minute. Add capsicum, carrots and cabbage, continue sauteing on high flame 1 minute keeping veggies crunchy. Add boiled noodles and mix gently. Add soy sauce, green chilli paste, red chilli sauce, vinegar, tomato ketchup, salt, white pepper and sugar. Toss well 1 minute. Finish with chopped spring onion greens and toss once more. Serve immediately with schezwan sauce or tomato ketchup.

name: Mexican Palak Chaat
instructions: For salsa: Mix diced tomatoes, chopped onions, chopped jalapeno, black pepper, salt, coriander leaves and lemon juice. Chill. For masala beans: Heat oil, saute ginger garlic paste 1-2 minutes. Add tomato puree, salt, red chilly, coriander and amchur powders, garam masala. Cook 2-3 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency. For cheese sauce: Heat butter, add onions, green chillies and black peppercorns. Saute until onions soft. Add cream, cover and rest 5-7 minutes. Place bowl over double boiler, add cheese to bowl over hot water. Strain and add cream with onions. Whisk until smooth. For batter: Mix gram flour, rice flour, salt, red chilly powder, coriander powder, ajwain and amchur. Add water gradually with whisking. Rest 15-20 minutes. Assembly: Dip spinach leaves in batter and coat well. Heat oil for frying, fry at medium-high heat until crisp and golden. Place on plate. Top with cheese sauce, salsa, masala beans and fresh jalapeno. Serve immediately.

name: Cheese Burst Dosa
instructions: Mix grated cheese with milk and butter. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, repeat 4 times until smooth. Optionally blend with hand blender. Heat pan on medium flame, spread dosa batter in round shape, add butter. Add chopped capsicum, onions, cabbage, tomatoes, red chilli powder, schezwan chutney, and salt. Mix and cook, mash vegetables with masher. Add cheese sauce and mix, sprinkle coriander. Cook dosa, cut with pizza cutter into strips, roll and arrange. Pour cheese sauce over rolls. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Bhuna Frankie
instructions: Make frankie dough: mix refined flour and salt, add water to knead soft stretchy dough, incorporate oil and knead smooth. Apply oil to surface, cover with damp cloth, rest 30 minutes. Knead again and shape into roundels. Flatten into chapattis. Half-cook chapattis until brown spots appear, keep aside. Make paneer bhuna: heat oil, add jeera and splutter, add onions cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and red chilly paste, cook 2-3 minutes. Add powdered spices, cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree, curd, and salt, stir 2-3 minutes until oil separates. Adjust consistency with hot water, bring to boil. Add paneer cubes, cook 4-5 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala, and coriander. Assemble: cook half-cooked frankie rotis with butter on both sides. Apply hot paneer bhuna filling on roti. Add chopped onions, frankie masala, and chilly vinegar. Roll and serve hot.

name: Chicken Pahadi Kababs
ingredients: live charcoal and ghee for smoking
instructions: Cut chicken into thin slices. Marinate with salt, red chilly powder, ginger garlic paste, and lemon juice for 15 minutes. Blend fresh coriander, mint leaves, garlic cloves, ginger, green chillies, and water into fine paste. Add paste to chicken along with hung curd, besan, cumin powder, black pepper, salt, garam masala, anardana powder, kasuri methi, and ghee. Mix well and marinate minimum 15 minutes. Place live charcoal over chicken, pour ghee on charcoal, cover and smoke 2-3 minutes. Fold and skewer marinated chicken. Heat ghee on grill pan, cook from all sides until cooked with grill marks. Serve hot with chat masala sprinkled, fresh salad and chutney.

name: Kanda Bhaji Burger
instructions: Grate potato and carrot, squeeze out excess moisture. Mix with onions, salt, spices, chillies, ajwain, coriander and gram flour, squeeze well. Shape into patties. Heat oil on tawa, cook patties on medium flame until crisp and golden brown. Blend curd with coriander and mint leaves. Toast burger buns in butter. Assemble: spread dip on bun, add chutney, place bhajji patty, top with lettuce, spread dip on other bun.

name: Herbed Basil Brown Rice With Paneer and Black Pepper Sauce
instructions: Wash brown rice and soak 1 hour. Boil with salt for 15-20 minutes. Strain and cool. In wok with olive oil, sauté garlic, herbs and basil, add rice and toss for 1 minute. For sauce: heat olive oil, cook onions until translucent, add garlic and green chillies for 1 minute. Add oats powder and mix, add water with no lumps. Add soy sauce, ketchup, salt and crushed peppercorns, cook until thick. Add paneer cubes, finish with spring onion greens.

name: Paneer Chilli Frankie
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Knead soft dough with flour, salt, curd, water and oil. Rest 30 minutes, knead again. Divide into balls, flatten and roll into thick roti. Cook on hot tawa with oil for 20-30 seconds each side. Make frankie masala by mixing all spices. For paneer chilli: coat paneer cubes in cornflour-refined flour batter, deep fry until golden. In wok with oil, sauté garlic, spring onion bulbs, ginger and chillies. Add stock, light and dark soy sauce, green chilli paste, vinegar and sugar. Thicken with cornflour-water slurry. Add fried paneer, onion petals and capsicum. Cook until sauce coats paneer well. Finish with spring onion greens. To assemble: cook half-cooked roti on tawa with butter until golden, sprinkle frankie masala, add paneer chilli filling and roll.

name: Reshmi Kabab Masala
instructions: Slice chicken breast thin, marinate with salt, pepper, ginger and garlic for 15 min. In separate bowl, mix hung curd, fresh cream, almond paste, green chilli paste, garam masala, kasuri methi, white pepper, salt, coriander and corn starch. Coat marinated chicken in this mixture and marinate for 1 hour. Smoke with charcoal for 3-4 minutes. Skewer marinated chicken on bamboo skewers. Heat ghee in pan and grill chicken for 3-4 minutes on all sides. For gravy: Heat ghee, add cardamom and bay leaf. Add onion paste and cook until golden. Add cashew and almond paste, cook 3-4 minutes. Add spice powders, cook 2-3 minutes. Add water and cook 3-4 minutes. Add garlic paste, salt and pepper, cook 5-6 minutes. Lower flame, add curd while stirring continuously until oil separates. Add chicken tikka, cook 5-6 minutes. Add garam masala, kasuri methi, honey and saffron milk, cook 2-3 minutes. Add coriander and fresh cream, cook 2-3 more minutes.

name: Stir Fried Veggies with Brown Fried Rice
instructions: For brown fried rice: Heat oil in wok, add spring onions and garlic, sauté 1 minute. Add veggies, cook 2-3 minutes on high flame. Add sauces, salt, pepper and sugar, cook 1 minute. Add cooked brown rice and spring onion greens, stir and cook 2 minutes. For stir fried veggies: Heat oil in wok, add spring onions, garlic and ginger, sauté 1 minute. Add all veggies and sugar, cook 2-3 minutes. Add salt, pepper, soy sauce, vinegar and green chilly sauce, stir and add water. Mix cornstarch with water, add mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Add spring onion greens and mix well. Serve stir-fried veggies over rice.

name: Oil Free Pakora
instructions: For red garlic chutney: Soak red chillies for 15-30 minutes. Grind soaked chillies, garlic cloves, black salt and cumin powder into fine paste, adjust consistency with water. For pakora: Mix gram flour, semolina, curd, onion, grated potatoes, sweet corn, salt, red chilly powder, coriander powder, turmeric, amchur powder, ajwain, coriander and green chillies. Squeeze mixture and rest for 15 minutes, mix again. Scoop small portions with spoon, place on hot nonstick pan and flatten. Cover and cook on low flame until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with red garlic chutney.

name: Restaurant Style Dal Khichdi
instructions: Rinse basmati rice and soak 10-15 minutes. Boil water with salt and cook rice 10-15 minutes, strain. Wash all dals and soak 30 minutes. In cooker, heat ghee, add jeera, let splutter, add ginger julienne and soaked drained dals, add 5 cups water, turmeric and salt. Pressure cook 3-4 whistles on medium flame, depressurize naturally, stir. In wok, heat ghee, add jeera, let splutter, add onions and cook until translucent. Add whole red chillies, garlic, green chillies, ginger, sauté 1 minute. Add tomatoes, salt and all spice powders, cook until tomatoes are mushy. Add cooked dal and mix well. Add cooked rice, mix and cook 3-4 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency, cook 4-5 minutes. Place live charcoal, pour ghee, cover and smoke 3-4 minutes. Add kasuri methi and lemon juice, stir, garnish with coriander. For tadka: Heat ghee, add jeera, red chilli powder, asafoetida, whole red chillies and fried onions, pour over hot dal before serving.

name: Bread Rolls
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add onions, ginger garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add boiled mashed potatoes and spices, mix well, cook 4-5 minutes. Add fresh coriander, cool and set aside. Trim bread edges, lightly soak in water and squeeze excess. Place spoonful of filling in centre, seal ends to shape like egg, rest 10 minutes. Heat oil and fry rolls on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with tomato ketchup, mint chutney or dip.

name: Tawa Anda
instructions: Set pan on medium heat, add oil with onions, garlic, ginger, pav bhaji masala, tomatoes, green chillies, capsicum, sweet corn and paneer. Mix well and cook. Add salt, fresh coriander and lemon juice, then eggs. Add salt, black pepper and processed cheese. Cover with lid and cook 5-7 minutes. Cut a portion and serve hot with toasted breads.

name: Chatpata Sprouts & Oats Uttapam
instructions: Grind oats to fine powder, transfer to mixing bowl. Add salt and curd, mix well, adjust consistency with water to make semi-thick batter, rest 15 minutes. In separate bowl mix sprouts, tomatoes, onions, green chillies, red chilli powder, chaat masala, salt, mint and coriander leaves, lemon juice. Adjust consistency with water. Heat pan on medium, add spoonful of batter to make mini uttapam, top with sprout mixture, press gently, drizzle oil. Flip and cook both sides 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with coconut or green chutney.

name: Aloo Corn Tikki Roll
instructions: For filling: Heat oil, add ginger garlic paste and chillies, sauté. Add ketchup and spices, cook 30 seconds, add water and cook 1 minute. Add corn, potatoes, salt and amchur, cook 2-3 minutes, add coriander. For roti: Knead wheat flour with water to soft dough, add oil, knead smooth, rest 15 minutes, shape into balls, flatten into chapattis, half-cook until brown spots appear. Make chilli garlic spread: mix curd, chilli powder, garlic juice, black salt. Make mint spread: mix curd and mint chutney. Assembly: Cook half-cooked rotis with butter on both sides, apply spreads, add onions, frankie masala, hot tikki filling, chilly vinegar, roll and serve.

name: Kurkuri Bhindi Masala
instructions: Cut lady finger lengthwise, deseed and cut into juliennes. Mix with powdered spices, besan and rice flour with water to coat well. Fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. For gravy: heat oil, add cumin seeds, add onions until golden, add ginger garlic paste, add powdered spices and mix. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add curd, mix well, cook for 3-4 minutes on low flame. Add garam masala and coriander leaves. Top fried bhindi over masala to avoid sogginess. Serve hot.

name: Chilli Basil Prawns
instructions: Make a slit on prawn head, devein and butterfly without slicing in half. Transfer to bowl, add salt, pepper, ginger garlic paste, vinegar, egg white, lemon juice and corn starch, marinate for 10 minutes. Coat prawns with corn flour and fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. In a wok: heat oil, add garlic, ginger, spring onion bulbs, sauté for a minute. Add red chilli sauce, ketchup, soy sauce and seasonings, sauté for a minute. Add fried prawns and toss well. Tear and add basil leaves and spring onion greens, mix well. Serve hot.

name: maggi chowmein
instructions: Set boiling water in wok, add maggi and boil until half done. Strain and cool. Heat oil in wok on high flame, add spring onion bulb and ginger garlic paste, sauté 1 minute. Add cabbage, carrots, capsicum, salt & pepper, sauté 2 minutes. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, vinegar, sauté 1 minute. Add maggi masala and mix well. Add boiled maggi and 3 tbsp reserved starchy water, mix well. Finish with spring onion greens. Serve hot with Schezwan sauce.

name: grilled chicken sizzler with mushroom sauce
instructions: For mushroom sauce: heat oil and butter, add mushrooms and cook until they release moisture. Add onions and garlic, cook until mushrooms turn brown. Add salt and black pepper, then fresh cream, milk, mixed herbs and parsley, simmer. For spaghetti: boil in salted water for 8-9 minutes, drain, add olive oil, salt and pepper. For grilled chicken: slice and flatten chicken breasts, season with salt, pepper and ginger garlic paste. Grill on both sides until cooked, cut into strips. For stir-fried veggies: heat olive oil on high flame, add vegetables, ginger, garlic, salt and pepper, sauté 4-5 minutes, add lemon juice. Assembly: heat sizzler plate until smoking hot, spread shredded cabbage, place spaghetti, stir-fried veggies and potato wedges, top with grilled chicken strips and pour mushroom sauce, garnish with parsley.

name: sukka chicken with mini dosa
instructions: Roast cumin seeds, fennel seeds, coriander seeds, black peppercorns and methi seeds on medium flame, keep aside. Roast dry red chillies on medium flame, set aside. Roast grated coconut until golden brown, set aside. Sauté sliced onions and garlic cloves on medium flame. Grind roasted spices, dry red chillies and water together, add roasted coconut and turmeric powder, grind again, add roasted onion and garlic, grind with water. Heat ghee in pan, add cloves, cinnamon stick, sliced onions, garlic, chicken dices, coconut paste, salt, water, curry leaves and roasted coconut, cook until chicken is tender. Heat tava on medium flame, add small portions of dosa batter, add oil, cook on both sides. Place mini dosa on plate and top with sukka chicken, garnish with grated roasted coconut. Serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: rocket kababs
instructions: Set pan on medium heat, add ghee and ginger garlic paste, sauté 1 minute. Add grated beetroot and sauté 1 minute, add green chillies and powdered spices, sauté 1 minute on medium heat. Transfer mixture to bowl, add boiled sweet potatoes, besan and fresh coriander leaves, mix well. Grease palm with oil, scoop small spoonfuls of mixture and shape into round mini kebabs. Heat pan with ghee or oil, grill mini kebabs on both sides until crisp and golden brown. Cut capsicum sides to shape like crown and tomato sides to make triangle shape. Thread bamboo skewers with capsicum crown, two mini kebabs, and tomato triangle to make rocket shape. Serve hot to kids with vegetable goodness and taste.

name: lettuce wraps
ingredients: rice noodles or vermicelli a handful
red bell pepper ½ cup chopped
yellow bell pepper ½ cup chopped
instructions: Cut stem of lettuce and carefully separate leaves, trim them to replicate bowl shape, preserve cups in ice cold water for crunchiness. Heat pan with oil on medium flame, deep fry rice noodles or vermicelli until puffed and crisp, keep aside. Heat separate pan on medium heat, add oil, ginger and garlic, sauté for few seconds. Add vegetables and sauté on high flame for 1 minute. Add sauces and salt & pepper, mix and sauté 1-2 minutes on high flame. Add paneer and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar, tear basil leaves with hands and cook 1-2 minutes. Add spring onion greens and mix well. Remove chilled lettuce cups and drain water, add spoonful of veggie mixture, top with fried rice noodles. Serve as party appetizers.

name: chicken chilli
ingredients: spring onion bulbs ¼ cup chopped
instructions: Slice chicken breast in two equal halves, further cut into thin strips. Transfer to mixing bowl, add salt, pepper, vinegar, soy sauce, egg white and cornstarch, mix and coat chicken well. Heat oil in pan for frying, shallow fry coated chicken strips on both sides until soft or light golden, do not overcook. Remove on absorbent paper. Heat 2 tbsp oil in another pan on high heat, add garlic, ginger and green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add onions, red bell peppers, capsicum and sugar, mix well and sauté 1 minute. Add spring onion bulbs and continue sautéing on high flame. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt, pepper and water, mix well and cook 1 minute. Add cornstarch and water mixture and cook until sauce thickens. Add fried chicken strips and toss well with sauce. Add vinegar and freshly chopped spring onion greens, mix well and cook 1 minute. Serve hot.

name: moong dal pizza
instructions: Wash moong dal thoroughly and soak for at least 2 hours in fresh water. Drain excess water and transfer soaked moong to grinder, add green chillies, ginger and water, grind to fine paste, add more water if needed for thick paste consistency. Transfer moong paste to mixing bowl, add salt to taste and whisk nicely to make it fluffy, add baking soda and whisk well. In separate mixing bowl, add chopped vegetables, powdered spices and salt to taste, mix well. Add half of veggie mixture to moong batter and mix well. Heat pan on medium flame, add olive oil and enough batter to cover pan surface, top with remaining veggie mixture, lower flame, cover and cook until base is cooked completely for about 5-6 minutes, flip and cover and cook on other side for same time on low flame, add little more oil on sides if required. Slice and serve hot with ketchup, chutney or dip of choice.

name: Schezwan Chilli Potato
instructions: Wash, peel and cut potatoes into 1 cm batons. Blanch for 2-3 minutes and cool. Coat with corn flour, oil, salt and pepper. Refrigerate 15-20 minutes. Deep fry in two stages: first at medium heat for 2-3 minutes until light golden, rest 5-7 minutes, then fry again in very hot oil until crispy. In a wok, heat oil and sauté red chilli paste with celery, garlic, ginger, green chillies and spring onion bulbs. Add soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar and salt. Pour vegetable stock and bring to boil. Thicken with corn flour slurry. Add fried potatoes, diced capsicum and mix gently. Finish with spring onion greens.

name: Street Style Veg Manchurian Frankie
instructions: Mix grated cabbage, carrot, onion, ginger garlic paste, green chillies, salt, pepper, soy sauce, red chilli sauce, corn flour and rice flour. Shape into small balls and deep fry until golden. In a wok, heat oil and sauté garlic, ginger, green chillies. Add sliced onions, capsicum and shredded cabbage, cook on high heat. Add salt, pepper, red chilli sauce, soy sauce, ketchup and schezwan sauce. Add fried manchurian balls and toss. Finish with spring onion greens. For frankie: knead refined flour with salt, water and oil into stretchy dough. Rest 30 minutes. Shape into roundels, flatten and half-cook until brown spots appear. Assemble by applying butter to half-cooked frankie, spread manchurian filling, add chopped onions, spring onion greens and frankie masala. Roll and serve.

name: Eggless Mango Crepe Cake
instructions: For butter cream: cream softened butter until pale white with stiff peaks. Mix corn flour and powdered sugar. Add icing sugar in batches and blend. Add mango puree in batches using fold technique. For crepes: sift refined flour and powdered sugar. Add oil, vanilla, salt and half the milk, whisk to avoid lumps. Add remaining milk and whisk smooth. Rest 15 minutes. Pour 1/4 cup batter on 8-inch non-stick pan, swirl to spread evenly. Cook both sides until light golden. Repeat for at least 16 crepes. Assembly: layer one crepe on plate, apply thin butter cream layer. Repeat until all crepes used. Coat entire cake with remaining butter cream. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

name: Cheese Chilli Garlic Cones
instructions: Mix chopped onions, capsicum, corn kernels, green chillies, mint chutney, salt and grated cheese. Take bread slice, trim edges and cut into triangles. Flatten triangle with rolling pin. Apply water on edges to seal and shape into cones. Stuff cone with cheese mixture. Mix melted butter with chopped garlic, oregano and chilli flakes to make garlic butter. Place cone on baking tray and brush generously with garlic butter. Bake at 180°C for 8-10 minutes until crispy. Serve hot with green chutney or sauce.

name: Chicken Seekh Rara
instructions: For seekh kebab: squeeze moisture from chopped onions using muslin cloth. Mix onions with garlic, ginger, green chillies and minced chicken. Add mint, coriander, powdered spices, salt, pepper, lemon juice and ghee. Mix well for 5-6 minutes until bound. Smoke mixture with charcoal and ghee for 3-5 minutes. Dip hands in water and mold mixture onto bamboo skewers. Grill on medium heat with ghee, turning until golden brown. Cut into 3 cm pieces. For rara: heat ghee and sauté whole spices for 1 minute. Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and red chilli paste, cook until ghee releases. Add tomatoes, salt and powdered spices, cook 4-5 minutes until mushy. Add hot water. Slow heat and add whisked curd, stirring continuously. Add minced chicken, mashing and separating it, cook 4-6 minutes. Add hot water and simmer 2-3 minutes. Add grilled seekh kebab pieces gently. Finish with garam masala, kasuri methi and coriander.

name: Paneer Malai Tikka with Strawberry Chutney
instructions: For strawberry chutney: Puree strawberries, heat in pan with sugar, jeera powder, vinegar, chilli flakes, black salt, salt and red chilli powder until thickened. Cool. For paneer tikka: Mix hung curd, cream, cashew paste, cheese, corn flour, green chili paste, ginger garlic paste, jeera powder, white pepper, garam masala, kasuri methi, coriander and salt. Add paneer cubes and marinate 15 minutes. Skewer and grill on tawa over medium heat until golden. Serve hot with strawberry chutney.

name: Chilli Okra Potato
instructions: Coat lady finger with corn flour and black pepper. Coat potatoes with corn flour, salt and pepper. Deep fry potatoes until crisp and golden. Fry lady finger separately until golden. Heat oil in wok, sauté garlic and ginger 1-2 minutes. Add spring onions and green chillies for 1 minute. Add capsicum and bell peppers for 1 minute. Add red chilli sauce, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Mix cornstarch with water and add, cook until sauce thickens. Add fried potatoes and lady finger, toss well. Add spring onion greens and vinegar. Serve hot.

name: Fortune Falafel Bites
instructions: Mix chickpea flour with baking powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, chopped green chilli, ginger and onion. Add salt to taste and mix well. Form into small bite-sized balls. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot.

name: Crispy Chilli Garlic Lotus Root
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Peel and thinly slice lotus root diagonally. Toss with salt, pepper and cornstarch. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. Drain on absorbent paper. In a pan, heat oil and sauté garlic, spring onion bulbs, ginger and green chillies for 1 minute. Add capsicum and sauté for 1 minute. Add red chilli sauce, ketchup, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Sauté for 1-2 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and add to pan, cook for 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens. Add crispy lotus root and toss well. Garnish with spring onion greens. Serve immediately.

name: Paneer Makhani Coins
instructions: For gravy: Heat pan with butter, add spices (cinnamon, pepper, bay leaves, cloves), onions, garlic, ginger, green chillies and tomato purees. Cook and strain. For paneer: Mix mustard oil, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, ginger garlic paste, salt and hung curd. Add paneer and marinate 30 minutes. Bake on foil at 250°C for 7-8 minutes. Add to gravy and cook, then add fresh cream and kasuri methi. For coins: Flatten wheat dough, apply ghee and flour, make pleats, roll and flatten, cut circles. Cook on tawa until done. Serve paneer makhani over mini paratha coins with onion brista and cream.

name: Homemade Malai Paneer
instructions: Mix vinegar or lemon juice with water. Heat milk in heavy bottom wok on medium heat until boiling, stirring constantly to prevent burning. Lower flame and add fresh cream, stir gently for 1 minute. Slowly add diluted vinegar/lemon water while stirring as milk curdles. Once whey separates completely, remove from heat. Strain through muslin cloth to collect milk solids (paneer). Hang muslin to drain whey completely without squeezing. Wash paneer with fresh water to remove sour taste. Place paneer in colander with muslin, put heavy weight on top for at least 1 hour to drain excess moisture and form paneer block. Fresh soft homemade malai paneer is ready to use.

name: Anda Pakora
instructions: In a mixing bowl, grate the boiled eggs and add all the other ingredients in order, mix well, sprinkle little water so it combines and holds well. Shape it with spoon by greasing it with little oil, take a spoonful of mixture and shape into eggs. Make as many as you would wish and allow to set them in fridge for 10 mins. Set a deep pan filled with oil for frying on medium heat and fry these anda pakora until crisp and golden brown, do not overcrowd the pan while frying. Serve hot with mint chutney, ketchup or any dip of your choice.

name: Tandoori Omelette Sandwich
instructions: Prepare tandoori marinade by mixing mustard oil, ginger garlic paste, powdered spices, salt, pepper and hung curd. Smoke the marinade with live charcoal and ghee for 3-4 minutes. In a bowl, break 2 eggs and add salt, pepper, red chilli powder, chopped onions, green chillies and coriander, whisk well. Heat a pan with ghee, add the whisked egg mixture, cook for 1-2 minutes. Place bread slice over the omelette before it's cooked, coat the bread with uncooked egg, flip and cook for 1-2 minutes until golden. Fold the omelette and place one bread slice over it to make a sandwich. Apply tandoori marinade to the sandwich, pour a little ghee, flip and cook for a minute on each side. Serve hot with chutney or ketchup.

name: Homemade Pizza and Pasta Sauce
instructions: Make a cross on tomato base. Boil water and add tomatoes, boil for 2-3 minutes then transfer to ice-cold water. Peel the skin and roughly chop. Grind to a fine puree. Heat a pan, add olive oil, onions and garlic, saute until onions are translucent. Add tomato puree, salt and pepper, stir and cook for 8-10 minutes until sauce thickens. Add red chilli flakes and oregano, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar and cook further for 1-2 minutes. Cool down and transfer to a sterilized container. Store in fridge for 8-10 days or deep freeze for a month.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala Tacos
instructions: For filling: Marinate chicken with curd, ginger garlic paste, powdered spices and salt for 15-20 minutes. Heat oil, add cumin, saute onions until translucent. Add green chillies and tomato puree, cook 3-4 minutes. Add water and marinated chicken, cook 5-6 minutes. Add diced tomatoes, capsicum and onions, cook 3-4 minutes. Add kasuri methi, garam masala and coriander. For taco shells: Mix flour, salt and baking powder, add curd and water to knead smooth dough. Rest for 30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten, sprinkle kalonji and coriander, make mini chapati. Cook on hot tava on both sides until brown spots appear. Assembly: Spread chutney on taco shell, add chicken filling, pour fresh cream, add onion rings and lemon squeeze. Serve hot.

name: Tricolor Finger Toasties
instructions: Prepare paneer schezwan mixture: Mix paneer, corn, capsicum, salt, pepper, onion, schezwan sauce and spring onion greens. Prepare cheese chilli mixture: Grate cheese and mix with melted butter, garlic, green chillies and black pepper. Prepare aloo mixture: Mash boiled potatoes and mix with mint chutney, onions, pav bhaji masala and coriander. On brown bread slice, spread paneer schezwan mixture on 1/3rd of surface, cheese chilli mixture on next 1/3rd, and aloo mixture on last 1/3rd. Apply butter on pan, place bread and cook on medium heat with lid until bread is crispy and cheese melts. Alternatively, bake at 220°C for 7-8 minutes. Cut lengthwise into 4 fingers and serve hot.

name: grilled chicken lettuce wraps
instructions: Grill chicken pieces until cooked through. Slice into bite-sized pieces. Wrap in fresh lettuce leaves. Serve with teriyaki and peanut butter sauce.

name: kadai chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, ginger garlic paste and red chilli powder for 15 minutes. Prepare kadhai masala by roasting and grinding whole spices. Heat ghee, cook marinated chicken for 10-12 minutes. Add crushed garlic, ginger, powdered spices and kadhai masala, cook 1-2 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook 3-4 minutes. Add hot water and bring to boil. Add curd while stirring constantly, cook until oil separates. Add fresh cream and garam masala. Finally add capsicum, onion, green chillies and cook 2 minutes. Serve hot with naan or roti.

name: ras malai
instructions: Prepare flavoured milk: boil 1.5 litre milk with almonds, pistachio, cardamom powder, sugar and saffron for 15-20 minutes on low heat, then cool. Prepare chena: boil 2 litre full fat milk, add vinegar to curdle, drain whey through muslin cloth, knead until smooth, add corn flour. Shape chena into flat tikkis. Boil sugar syrup with water, add chena tikkis (not crowding), cover and cook 10-12 minutes on high flame until doubled. Rest 10-15 minutes in syrup, squeeze excess syrup and dip immediately into flavoured milk. Refrigerate 3-4 hours. Garnish with almonds, pistachios and saffron. Serve chilled.

name: laccha paratha egg roll
instructions: Prepare salad: mix sliced onion, carrot, cucumber, green chillies, vinegar and salt, refrigerate. Make dough: mix flour, ajwain and salt with water to soft dough. Rest 30 minutes. Divide into balls, flatten, dust with flour, roll into thick chapati. Apply ghee, salt, ajwain and flour, slit from centre, roll into cone, flatten. Roll into paratha, cook on both sides until golden, apply ghee and cook again. Whisk eggs with salt, pepper, red chilli powder and green chillies. Heat oil, pour egg mixture, place cooked paratha over omelette, cook both sides 2-3 minutes. Add salad, sauces and herbs. Roll and serve hot.

name: cheesy pizza pockets
instructions: Prepare pizza sauce: cut tomatoes with cross incision, boil 2 minutes, ice bath, peel and grind. Heat olive oil, sauté garlic until golden, add tomato puree, basil, salt and pepper, simmer 2-3 minutes. Prepare filling: mix paneer, onion, capsicum, corn, mushroom, red chilli flakes, oregano, salt and pizza sauce. Add mozzarella cheese. Trim bread slice edges, flatten with rolling pin, place spoonful filling, apply water on sides, roll and seal. Heat oil in kadhai, fry on medium high heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup or dip.

name: Tandoori Chicken Sandwich
instructions:
1. Take hung curd, add red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cumin powder, and black salt; mix well.
2. Add chicken and apply marinade; marinate for 1 hour.
3. Heat oil in grill pan and shallow fry chicken breasts.
4. Place onion and burning coal on chicken, add ghee to develop smoky flavor; cover to trap smoke.
5. Make spread with hung curd, basil leaves, salt and pepper.
6. Apply butter on bread slices, spread the curd mixture on bread.
7. Spread chicken pieces on bread and add sriracha sauce.
8. Place another bread on filling and grill the sandwich.
9. Apply spread on sandwich sides and top with fried onions.
10. Serve hot.

name: Spinach & Corn Momos
instructions:
For filling: Add paneer, spinach puree, sweet corn, green chillies, garlic, salt, pepper, and aamchur powder in mixing bowl and mix well.
For wrapper: Mix refined flour and salt, add water gradually to knead firm dough. Apply oil on surface, cover with damp cloth and rest 30 minutes. Knead again, divide into balls, flatten and roll into thin circles. Cut 3-inch circles and fill with 1 spoonful of mixture.
Fold by placing thumb in centre, pinch and seal ends.
Cooking options: Steam in preheated steamer 8-10 minutes, shallow fry 3-4 minutes, or deep fry until crisp.
For chutney: Deseed and soak red chillies 30 minutes. Boil tomatoes 5 minutes, cool, and grind with soaked chillies, garlic, sugar, and salts.
Serve hot with chutney and mayonnaise.

name: Paneer Chilli Stuffed Idli
instructions:
For filling: Heat oil, add ginger, garlic, and green chillies; sauté 1-2 minutes. Add onions and capsicum, sauté 2 minutes. Add sauces, salt, and pepper; sauté on high 1 minute. Add paneer dices and mix well. Finish with spring onion greens.
For idli batter: Mix rava, salt, and curd; rest minimum 30 minutes. Add water gradually and whisk; rest 15 minutes. Add fruit salt just before steaming.
Assembly: Grease idli mold with oil. Fill halfway, place chilly paneer mixture in centre, top with remaining batter. Steam 7-8 minutes. Check with toothpick for doneness. Cool 1-2 minutes before demolding.
Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Spicy Chicken Cheese Burst Toast
instructions:
1. Mix grated processed cheese with milk and butter in a bowl.
2. Microwave 30 seconds, mix well. Repeat 3 more times for smooth consistency.
3. Blend with hand blender if needed for smoothness.
4. Take bread slice, pour cheese sauce in centre, spread it.
5. Take another slice, cut edges, flatten with pin roll, place over cheese sauce and seal edges.
6. Apply pizza sauce over bread, add mozzarella cheese, capsicum, sweet corn, onion, red chilli pepper.
7. Mix boiled chicken with red chilli powder, garam masala, salt, and lemon juice.
8. Spread chicken mixture on toast.
9. Set pan on medium flame with butter, place cheese burst bread on it.
10. Pan grill or bake at 250°C for 5-7 minutes.
11. Serve hot immediately.

name: Masala Oats Khichdi
instructions:
For dal khichdi: Set cooker on medium heat, add ghee and jeera, sauté few minutes. Add moong dal and oats, mix well, add salt and water (2 inches above dal). Pressure cook 2 whistles, switch off, let depressurize naturally. Stir after opening lid.
For veggie masala: Set pan on medium heat, add ghee and jeera, sauté. Add onions, cook until soft, add ginger, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add tomatoes, turmeric, red chilli and coriander powders; cook until mushy. Add water, then veggies, salt and water; cook until veggies are done. Mix in dal khichdi, cook 5-7 minutes while stirring. Add garam masala and coriander leaves, cook 1-2 minutes more.
For beetroot raita: Mix curd, grated beetroot, jeera powder, and black salt; beat well with whisk. Serve chilled, can store in fridge up to 2 days.
Serve khichdi hot with beetroot raita.

name: grilled chicken burger
instructions: 1. Mince chicken finely using food processor. 2. Add salt, pepper, red chilli powder, garlic and fresh coriander to minced chicken and mix well. 3. Divide into 6 equal parts and shape into burger patties. 4. Grease grill pan with oil and cook patties on medium heat until crispy and golden brown, about 5-6 minutes per side. 5. Place cheese slice on each patty, cover and grill until cheese melts. 6. Prepare onion vinegar by soaking onion rings in vinegar and salt for 10-15 minutes. 7. Prepare coleslaw by mixing mayonnaise, red chilli sauce, ketchup, lettuce and black pepper. 8. Slice burger buns and grill for 2 minutes on both sides. 9. Assemble: spread coleslaw on bottom bun, place grilled cheese patty, add onion vinegar, spread ketchup on top bun. 10. Serve hot with french fries.

name: masala corn fries
instructions: 1. Cut corn kernels into 1cm pieces. 2. Boil corn kernels in water for 2-3 minutes and strain. 3. Cool the boiled corn. 4. Mix corn and rice flour with salt and black pepper, add 1 tsp water to coat well. 5. Deep freeze coated corn for 15 minutes. 6. Heat oil in deep fryer. 7. Fry corn in small batches on high heat until golden. 8. Remove on absorbent paper. 9. Squeeze lemon juice and sprinkle spice mix (red chilli, amchur, garlic powder, jeera, chaat masala, black pepper) to coat. 10. Serve hot with ketchup or dip.

name: ragda pattice pav
instructions: 1. Soak white peas for 3 hours or overnight. 2. In cooker heat oil, splutter jeera, add hing and ginger-garlic paste. 3. Add spices and white peas covered with water, add salt and baking soda. 4. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles on medium heat. 5. After cooker depressurizes naturally, cook for 4-5 more minutes. Add garam masala and fresh coriander. This is the ragda. 6. Boil potatoes, mash well. 7. Mix mashed potatoes with soaked poha, ginger-garlic paste, fresh herbs and powdered spices. 8. Slit pav from middle and fill with potato mixture. 9. Make gram flour batter with ajwain, turmeric, salt and water to pouring consistency. 10. Dip filled pav in batter and deep fry on medium-high heat until golden and crisp. 11. Cut into pieces, add ragda, mint chutney, garlic chutney, tamarind chutney, chopped onions, chaat masala and ginger juliennes. Serve.

name: mutton seekh kabab
instructions: 1. Grind mutton kheema finely in mixer grinder. 2. Chop onion, garlic, ginger and green chillies with knife or food processor. 3. Squeeze excess moisture from chopped mixture using muslin cloth. 4. Mix finely minced mutton with moisture-less onion mixture, powdered spices, fresh herbs, raw papaya paste, ghee and salt. 5. Marinate for 1 hour. 6. Place live charcoal in center of mixture, add few drops of ghee, cover and smoke for 2-3 minutes. 7. Dip hands in water and shape seekh kebab around skewers. 8. Heat ghee in pan on medium-low heat. 9. Place kebab skewers and cook from all sides until golden brown. 10. Serve hot with melted butter, chaat masala, chutney, fresh mint and sliced onions.

name: veg seekh kabab paratha wrap
instructions: 1. Prepare vegetable seekh kabab mixture with chopped vegetables and spices. 2. Shape onto skewers. 3. Cook on griddle or grill until cooked through. 4. Heat paratha on griddle. 5. Wrap cooked kebab in warm paratha. 6. Serve hot.

name: Crispy Paneer Pops
instructions: Cut paneer into small cubes. Prepare a batter using maida, cornstarch, salt and pepper. Coat paneer cubes in batter. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Serve hot.

name: No Onion No Garlic Matar Paneer
instructions: Soak cashew nuts and melon seeds in hot water for 20 minutes, grind into paste. Heat oil, add cumin seeds, asafoetida and green chillies, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add cashew-melon paste, cook 2-3 minutes. Add powdered spices and water, cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree and salt, cook until oil releases. Add green peas, cook 3-4 minutes. Add water, cover and cook 5-7 minutes. Add paneer cubes carefully, add garam masala and kasuri methi, cook 3-4 minutes. Finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Dabeli Sev Puri
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, asafoetida and dabeli masala. Add mashed potatoes, sugar, tamarind pulp and salt, mix well. Add fresh coriander and allow to cool. Assemble: place filling on puri, top with chutneys, onions, sev, peanuts, tutti frutti, fresh coriander, pomegranate and coconut. Serve as a get-together snack.

name: Corn Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Cook in hot oiled pan, scramble until light golden. Set aside. Heat fresh oil, sauté garlic, ginger, green chillies and spring onion bulbs for 1 minute. Add veggies and sugar, sauté 1 minute. Add sauces, salt and pepper, mix well. Add cooked rice and scrambled eggs, toss without breaking rice grains. Top with fresh spring onion greens. Serve hot with schezwan sauce.

name: Paneer Makhani
instructions: For makhani gravy: Cook cumin, cardamom, chillies, ginger, garlic, onions, tomatoes, spices, cashew nuts, salt and water for 15 minutes. Cool and grind to fine paste. For paneer: Heat butter and oil, add cumin seeds, ginger, green chillies. Add paneer cubes, lightly fry until golden, set aside. Add red chilli powder, bloom briefly. Strain makhani gravy, add to pan, cook 2-3 minutes. Adjust consistency with water, cook 2-3 minutes. Add paneer, mix gently. Add honey if desired, kasuri methi, garam masala, salt and cook 2-3 minutes. Turn off heat, add fresh cream, stir gently. Optional: add butter for richness. Finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with naan or paratha.

name: Egg Masala Dosa
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds, onions, green chillies and ginger-garlic paste. Sauté until onions are translucent. Add tomatoes and salt, cook until mushy. Add powdered spices (red chilli, coriander, turmeric, garam masala) and cook 2-3 minutes. Add fresh coriander. Heat dosa tawa, spread thin dosa batter to make crispy dosa. Pour few drops of oil and beaten egg on top, spread egg over dosa surface, cook 1-2 minutes. Flip and cook the egg side. Flip again and spread the freshly prepared onion-tomato masala over the omelette side. Sprinkle fresh coriander leaves. Roll and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Chicken Baida Roti
instructions: For dough: Mix refined flour and salt, add water and knead soft, elastic dough with oil. Rest 30 minutes covered. Knead again and divide into balls. Roll into thin chapati. For chicken: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and ginger garlic paste, sauté 1 minute. Add minced chicken and cook while breaking chunks. Add salt, coriander powder, red chilli powder and garam masala, mix well and cook until dry. Add coriander and lime juice, cook 1-2 minutes and cool. For filling: Whisk 1 egg with salt, add onions, coriander, green chillies and chicken mixture. Place filling on chapati, fold from all 4 sides into envelope. Shallow fry on medium heat with oil from all sides until crisp and golden. Serve hot with chutneys.

name: Nutri Kulcha
instructions: Boil water with salt, sugar and tea bag. Add soya mini chunks and boil 4-5 minutes. Drain and rinse, squeeze excess water. Grind tomatoes, green chillies and ginger into fine puree. Heat wok on medium, add ghee and jeera, sauté few minutes. Add onions and cook until golden brown. Add powdered spices and mix well. Add capsicum and cook 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree and cook 3-4 minutes. Add spinach and salt, cook until oil separates. Add soy sauce and boiled soya chunks, stir and cook 3-4 minutes. Add water and cook 8-10 minutes, cover and cook 5-6 minutes. Add butter, fresh cream and garam masala, stir well and finish with chopped coriander. Dip kulchas in masala and toast in butter or oil on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Butter Chicken Coins
instructions: Heat butter on medium flame. Add garlic paste and green chillies, sauté 2-3 minutes. Add tomato puree, red chilli powder, sugar and cashew paste, stir and cook 4-5 minutes. Add minced chicken and cook 4-5 minutes. Add fresh cream and garam masala powder, mix well. Add salt, kasoori methi, coriander and lime juice, cook 2-3 minutes until slightly dry. Make fan pleats in wheat dough with ghee and flour, roll and flatten, cut small circles. Cook mini paratha coins on tawa on medium flame until cooked. Place butter chicken on coins, top with onion brista, cream and coriander. Serve hot immediately.

name: Veg Akbari
instructions: Heat oil in a wok, add fried onion paste. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, sauté. Add cashew paste and sauté for 4-5 minutes. Add onion paste, jeera, coriander and black pepper, cook 2-3 minutes. Add vegetables and salt, cook 2-3 minutes. Lower heat and add curd slowly while stirring. Add paneer and cook 5-7 minutes. Finish with garam masala, kasuri methi and fresh coriander. Serve hot with roti or naan.

name: Red Velvet Brownie with Cheesecake Frosting
instructions: Sieve flour, powdered sugar and baking powder. Melt dark chocolate with butter in a double boiler. Add eggs and vanilla essence, stir well. Add flour mixture 2 spoons at a time. Add red food color. Pour into buttered baking tray and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes. Prepare frosting by mixing cream cheese, powdered sugar and whipped cream. Spread on cooled brownie. Freeze for 30 minutes. Cut into squares and top with chocolate chips. Serve chilled.

name: Khatti Meethi Gujarati Dal Khichdi
instructions: Wash dal and rice together. Pressure cook dal, rice and water with salt for 3-4 whistles on medium-low heat. Heat ghee in a wok, add mustard seeds, jeera, methi dana, curry leaves, hing, turmeric, red chilli powder and dry red chillies. Sauté briefly. Add diced tomatoes and green chillies, cook 1 minute. Add cooked khichdi and mix well. Add jaggery, tamarind water, ginger, salt and water. Cook 5-7 minutes on low flame. Squeeze fresh lemon juice, sprinkle coriander leaves and mix. Cover for 2 minutes before serving. Serve hot with ghee.

name: Aloo Tikki Chowmein Burger
instructions: Prepare chowmein by heating oil, adding ginger garlic paste and onions, sauté on high flame. Add vegetables, sugar and sauté. Add sauces, white pepper and salt, sauté for a minute. Add boiled noodles and cook 3-4 minutes, garnish with spring onion greens and cool. For aloo pattice, mix boiled potatoes with green chillies, ginger, red chilli powder, turmeric, amchur, black pepper, salt, coriander and lemon juice. Shape into tikkis and cook on tawa with oil until golden brown on both sides. Toast burger bun on tawa with butter, sprinkle coriander leaves on both sides. Apply tamarind chutney on toasted bun, place aloo tikki, top with chowmein noodles, add onion slices and place another bun on top.

name: Smoked Paneer Corn & Spinach Sandwich
ingredients: whole wheat sandwich bread as required
instructions: Boil sweet corn kernels for 2-3 minutes and keep aside. Blanch spinach in boiling water for 20 seconds, immediately transfer to ice-cold water to retain bright green color, then strain. Mix boiled corn, blanched spinach, paneer, green chillies, coriander leaves, mint leaves, hung curd, salt, pepper and red chilli flakes. Place live charcoal in small bowl, pour ghee over it, cover and smoke for 2-3 minutes to impart smoky flavor. Take bread slice, spread filling mixture evenly, close with another bread slice. Set tawa on medium heat, spread butter on sandwich and toast until crisp and golden, repeat on other side. Cut into squares or triangles and serve hot with tomato ketchup or dip.

name: Schezwan Paneer Maggi Sizzler
instructions: Mix cornflour, refined flour, ginger garlic paste, schezwan sauce, salt, black pepper and water. Add paneer cubes and mixed bell peppers, coat well and marinate 10-15 minutes. Thread bell peppers and paneer on bamboo skewers. Set grill pan on medium heat, add oil and grill paneer skewers from all sides until golden brown. For stir-fried veggies: heat oil, add garlic and sauté 1 minute. Add carrots, bell peppers and broccoli, salt, pepper, herbs, red chilli flakes, sugar and lemon juice. Sauté 2-3 minutes until cooked. For sauce: heat oil, add garlic and spring onion bulbs, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add schezwan sauce, ketchup and red chilli sauce, mix well. Add water and cornflour mixed with water, cook until thickened. Finish with spring onion greens. Heat sizzler plate until smoking hot. Place cabbage leaves over sizzler. Place maggi, stir-fried veggies and french fries over cabbage. Place paneer sticks on top and pour sauce over.

name: Oil Free Rajma
instructions: In blending jar add onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic and green chillies with water and grind into fine paste. Rinse rajma thoroughly with water. In cooker add washed rajma, onion-tomato paste and salt to taste. Add black cardamom, cinnamon stick and bay leaf, cook for 4-5 minutes. Add 1 litre water and mix well. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles on medium-low flame. Switch off flame and let cooker depressurize naturally. Switch on gas again and bring to boil. Add ginger julienne, slit green chillies and spice mix (gram flour, red chilli powder, coriander powder, amchur powder, jeera powder, garam masala and kasuri methi). Cook on medium-low flame for 10-15 minutes. Add lemon juice and freshly chopped coriander leaves, stir well. Serve hot with rice and paratha or roti.

name: Multigrain Methi Thepla
instructions: In mixing bowl add wheat flour, oats flour, besan flour, jowar flour, nachni flour, soya bean flour, maize flour, curd, ginger garlic paste, methi leaves, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, ajwain, white sesame and salt. Mix well and add water as required to knead a soft dough. Apply ghee on dough surface to prevent drying, cover with damp cloth and rest for 30 minutes. Divide dough into small equal balls, flatten with palms and coat with dry flour. Roll into thin thepla. Cook on hot tawa pan from both sides, apply ghee and cook again on both sides. Serve hot with curd, pickle or aam ka chundaa.

name: Dal Pakwan Chaat
instructions: For pakwan: in mixing bowl add refined flour, jeera, salt and oil, mix and combine well. Add water as required to knead semi-stiff dough. Apply oil over dough surface, cover with damp cloth and rest 15 minutes. Divide into small dough balls and roll into chapati. Prick with fork as many times as desired. Set oil in wok for frying on medium heat, fry pricked chapati one by one until golden brown and crisp. Remove on absorbent paper. For dal: set cooker on medium heat, add soaked chana dal, salt to taste and turmeric powder. Add water until dal is totally submerged. Pressure cook on high flame for first 5 minutes then low heat for next 5 minutes allowing one whistle only. Switch off flame and let cooker depressurize naturally. For tempering: heat oil in pan, add jeera, green chillies, red chilli powder, amchur powder and garam masala. Sauté for 1 second and top over cooked chana dal. To assemble: crush pakwan and place in serving bowl. Top with cooked dal and tempering. Add mint chutney, tamarind chutney, sprinkle garam masala, top with chopped onions, sev, pomegranate seeds and coriander leaves. Serve immediately to enjoy crispiness.

name: bromelette twisty rolls
instructions: Grind oats to fine powder, add salt and pepper. Break eggs and whisk with oat powder. Set aside. Heat oil in pan, add onions until translucent. Add garlic, sauté few seconds. Add capsicum, tomatoes, salt and pav bhaji masala, cook 3-4 minutes. Add lemon juice and coriander leaves, mix well. Spread vegetable mixture on bread slices, cut into 3 rectangular strips. Heat 1 tsp oil in pan, spread egg and oats batter, place bread sticks over batter and roll. Cook from all sides until golden brown. Serve hot with mint chutney or dip.

name: masala paneer hot dog
instructions: Heat oil in wok, add jeera, ginger garlic paste and chopped green chillies, sauté 1 minute. Add onions until translucent. Add capsicum and sauté 1-2 minutes. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and pav bhaji masala, sauté 1-2 minutes. Add tomatoes, salt, ketchup and red chilli sauce, cook 3-4 minutes. Add paneer and garam masala, cook 3-4 minutes, finish with coriander leaves. Make slit in hot dog bun, fill cavity with paneer mixture. Heat butter in pan, add pav bhaji masala and coriander leaves. Toast hot dogs 1 minute on both sides. Top with mayonnaise sauce.

name: mutton masala
instructions: Mix mutton with salt, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice and curd, marinate 30 minutes. Heat ghee in deep vessel, add whole spices and sauté few seconds. Add onions until golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and green chilli paste, cook 4-5 minutes. Add marinated mutton with remaining marinade, cook on medium high heat 10-12 minutes. Lower heat, cook 20-25 minutes stirring occasionally. Add turmeric, coriander and red chilli powder, mix well and cook 15-20 minutes on medium heat stirring occasionally. Add tomato puree and salt, cook 7-8 minutes. Add hot water, cook 10-12 minutes, cover and cook 20-25 minutes more until mutton is tender, stirring occasionally. Adjust water for desired consistency. Check seasoning. Add garam masala and coriander leaves, mix well and serve hot with paratha or roti.

name: shahi veg korma
instructions: Heat ghee in wok, add sliced onions and cook on medium heat until onions start to turn brown. Spread fried onions on paper towel. Soak cashews in hot water 10 minutes. Grind fried onions with soaked cashews into fine paste. Heat same ghee used for frying, add whole spices, green chillies and ginger, sauté 1 minute on low flame. In separate bowl, mix curd with red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and besan, whisk well. Add curd mixture to wok, stir continuously 3-4 minutes. Increase flame and cook until oil separates. Add fried onion and cashew paste with salt, cook 10-15 minutes. Add vegetables and cook 2-3 minutes. Add water to adjust consistency. Add paneer, bring to boil. Add saffron water, kewra water, kasuri methi and garam masala, mix well. Cover and cook on low flame 5-6 minutes. Serve hot with roti or paratha.

name: Tandoori Chicken Egg Roll
instructions: Marinate chicken with mustard oil, red chilli powder, spices and hung curd for 30 minutes. Cook marinated chicken on grill pan for 4-5 minutes on both sides. Cut into slices and shred with fork. Smoke with live charcoal and ghee for 3-4 minutes. Sauté green chilli, onion, capsicum and cabbage in butter for 1-2 minutes. Mix with chicken, lemon juice, chaat masala and fresh cream. For paratha: knead wheat flour with ajwain and salt, rest 30 minutes. Roll into parathas and cook on both sides with ghee. Whisk eggs with salt, pepper and green chillies. Cook omelette in oil, place paratha over it and cook both sides 2-3 minutes. Assemble: spread mint chutney on paratha, add chicken filling, garnish with coriander and chaat masala, add fresh cream, roll and serve hot.

name: Combination Tawa Pulao
instructions: Heat tawa on medium heat, add butter and oil with jeera and sliced onions, sauté until onions turn translucent. Add kashmiri red chilli paste and garlic paste, sauté until oil separates. Add water if masala gets dry. Add vegetables, salt and powdered spices, mix well and add 1 cup water. Cook masala for 3-4 minutes. Add cooked rice and boiled noodles, mix carefully without breaking rice. Cook for 2-3 more minutes. Squeeze lemon juice and add chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot with red garlic chutney and raita.

name: Soya Chaap Bhuna Masala
instructions: Cut soya chaap diagonally into 2-3 pieces. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Transfer to bowl, add curd, red chilli powder, amchur powder, salt and pepper. Smoke with live charcoal and ghee for 5-6 minutes. Heat ghee and oil in pan, add whole spices and sauté for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Add chopped onions and cook until golden brown on medium heat. Add turmeric, ginger garlic paste, green chillies and red chilli paste, stir until ghee separates. Add tomatoes, salt and powdered spices, cook for 15-20 minutes on medium-low flame. Add hot water if masala dries. Lower flame, add marinated soya chaap gently, cook for 4-5 minutes. Add hot water to adjust gravy consistency, simmer 4-5 minutes. Add garam masala and kasuri methi, cook 2-3 minutes. Finish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with garlic naan or paratha.

name: Green Thai Curry
instructions: Grind fresh coriander, lemon grass, ginger, garlic cloves, kafir lime leaves, green chillies, shallots, cumin powder and water into a thick paste. Heat oil in pan on medium heat, add all vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add brown sugar and white pepper powder, toss well. Add thai curry green paste and cook for 1-2 minutes by mixing well. Add coconut milk, water and salt, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes on medium flame. Add fresh basil leaves and continue cooking until curry is boiling. Add lemon juice and cook for 2-3 minutes. For flavoured rice: boil water in pan, add soaked rice, salt, fresh red chillies, ginger and star anise. Cover and cook for 7-8 minutes. Remove star anise and ginger when rice is cooked. Serve hot thai curry with flavoured rice.

name: Zucchini Spaghetti with Pink Sauce
instructions: For white sauce: Heat olive oil in pan on medium heat, add oats powder and cook until light golden brown. Slowly add chilled milk gradually while whisking to ensure no lumps form. Cook until it thickens. Set aside. For red sauce: Heat olive oil on medium heat, add onions and cook until translucent. Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute. Add tomato puree, sugar, red chilli powder, salt, black pepper powder and oregano. Mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Tear basil leaves and add, cook for 1-2 minutes. Set aside. For zucchini spaghetti: Trim head and tail of zucchini, cut into thin noodle-like strips with skin. Heat oil in wok on medium heat, add halved cherry tomatoes and sweet corn, sauté for 1 minute. Add white sauce and red sauce, mix well. Add julienned zucchini and cook with sauce for 1-2 minutes. Add salt to taste and cook for 1-2 more minutes. Grate cheese if desired. Serve hot and creamy.

name: paneer chilli potato cups
instructions: 1. Heat oil in pan, add garlic, ginger, and green chillies; sauté for 1 minute. 2. Add spring onion bulbs, capsicum, bell peppers, and sugar; sauté for 1 minute on high flame. 3. Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt and pepper; cook for 1 minute. 4. Add water and cornstarch mixture; cook until sauce thickens. 5. Add paneer and spring onion greens; mix gently. 6. Peel and halve boiled potatoes; scoop out cavity with spoon. 7. Shallow fry potatoes on both sides until golden brown; drain on paper. 8. Sprinkle salt and pepper; fill with paneer mixture and garnish with spring onion greens. Serve hot.

name: veg american chop suey
instructions: 1. Boil noodles in salted water for 6-7 minutes; rinse with cold water and drain. 2. Coat noodles with cornstarch and salt; shallow fry on both sides until crispy and golden brown. 3. Heat oil in wok; add spring onion, ginger, and garlic; sauté for 1-2 minutes. 4. Add all vegetables and sauté for 1-2 minutes. 5. Add sugar and cook for 2-3 minutes. 6. Add sauces and salt & pepper; cook for 1-2 minutes. 7. Add water and cornstarch mixture; cook until sauce thickens. 8. Add spring onion greens and vinegar; mix well. 9. Pour hot sauce over fried noodles and serve.

name: chole pattice burger
instructions: 1. Soak chickpeas for 5-6 hours; strain and rinse. 2. Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with water, cardamom, and bay leaf for 4 whistles. 3. Strain and mix boiled chickpeas with boiled potatoes, onion, green chillies, all spices, herbs, and grated paneer. 4. Shape mixture into patties. 5. Heat oil on tawa and cook patties on both sides until golden brown. 6. For tomato-onion salad: heat butter, add cumin seeds and green chillies, sauté for 1 minute. 7. Add sliced onions, tomatoes, salt, and spices; sauté for 1 minute. 8. Toast burger buns with butter and coriander. 9. Layer toasted bun with salad, chickpea patty, more salad, chutneys, and top bun. Serve fresh.

name: emoji smileys
instructions: 1. Boil potatoes until soft; optionally refrigerate overnight for easier handling. 2. Peel and mash potatoes thoroughly. 3. Mix mashed potatoes with bread crumbs, salt, and pepper. 4. Divide mixture into portions and roll out to 1 cm thickness. 5. Cut circles using 3-inch round cutter. 6. For simple smiley: make eyes using straw, smile using spoon. 7. For surprise smiley: make eyes and mouth using straw. 8. For love-struck smiley: press straw and make eyes and smile with spoon. 9. For heart emoji: use heart cutter. 10. Deep fry in oil until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with ketchup.

name: oriental style corn cake
instructions: 1. Heat oil in wok; add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes on medium flame. 2. Add cream corn and cornstarch; mix and cook for 3-4 minutes. 3. Add salt, white pepper, and spring onion greens; cook until mixture binds and leaves pan. 4. Brush baking tray with oil and dust with cornstarch. 5. Pour mixture into tray, level, cool, and refrigerate for 15-30 minutes. 6. Remove and cut into squares; coat lightly with cornstarch. 7. Heat oil and fry squares on medium-high flame until crisp and golden brown. 8. Serve hot topped with fried garlic, dried red chilli, and spring onion. Serve with schezwan chutney or oriental dips.

name: kairi kanda bhajiya
instructions: 1. Wash and optionally peel raw mangoes; grate using box grater. 2. Finely slice onions. 3. Mix mangoes, onions, green chillies, salt, and all spices in a bowl. 4. Squeeze mixture with hands to release moisture and help flour stick. 5. Add besan and cornstarch in batches, mixing well for balanced consistency. 6. Rest mixture for 15 minutes (do not add water). 7. Heat oil in pan on medium-high flame; test heat by dropping a small amount of batter. 8. Using fingers, flatten batter and add to oil; cook for 1 minute on medium-high heat. 9. Lower heat and cook slowly for 7-8 minutes on medium-low heat for crispiness. 10. Remove using slotted spoon when crisp and golden; drain on paper. Serve hot with mint chutney.

name: Chowmein Samosa
instructions: For filling: Heat oil in wok, add ginger garlic paste and onions, sauté on high heat for 1 minute. Add carrots, bell peppers and cabbage, sauté for 1 minute. Add sugar, soya sauce, ketchup, red chilli sauce, schezwan sauce, vinegar, white pepper and salt, sauté for 1 minute. Add boiled noodles, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with spring onion greens and cool completely. For samosa: Mix refined flour and water to form a paste for sealing. Place filling in center of samosa sheet pocket, press edges to seal, apply flour paste on flap and borders to seal completely. Dip corners in paste if gaps remain. Heat oil for frying to medium-high temperature and fry samosas until crisp and golden brown. Remove to absorbent paper. Serve hot with sauce of choice.

name: Oats Palak Khichadi
instructions: Boil water and blanch fresh spinach for 2 minutes, immediately transfer to ice cold water. Transfer blanched spinach to grinding jar, add green chillies and coriander, grind to fine puree. In pressure cooker on medium heat, add ghee and jeera, let splutter, add moong dal and oats, mix well. Add salt and water ensuring it is 2 inches above mixture. Pressure cook for 2 whistles, switch off flame and allow to depressurize naturally. Give cooked mixture a nice stir. In a wok on medium heat, add desi ghee, jeera and hing, sauté for few seconds. Add onions, garlic and ginger, cook until onions become translucent. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and coriander powder, mix well. Add tomatoes and sauté briefly. Add spinach puree and salt, mix and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add cooked khichadi mixture, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes. Add lemon juice and garam masala, mix thoroughly. Serve hot.

name: Aate Ki Kheer
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan over low flame. Add wheat flour and cook while stirring continuously. Cook until flour releases pleasant aroma and turns light brown in color.
