Add a pinch of salt and stir. Carefully add milk while whisking continuously to prevent lumps from forming. Add nuts and cook on medium heat while stirring continuously for 15-18 minutes until milk begins to thicken. Once thickened, add sugar and stir continuously, cook for 7-8 more minutes. Garnish with almond slivers, pistachios and dry rose petals. Serve warm.

name: Papad Rolls
instructions: Set wok on medium heat, add oil and jeera, green chillies, ginger and garlic, sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add capsicum and sweet corn, sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and jeera powder, sauté for 1-2 minutes on medium heat. Add mashed potatoes, paneer, amchur powder, anardana powder, garam masala, kasuri methi and salt, mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add spring onion greens, fresh mint and fresh coriander leaves, mix well and remove from flame. Cool to room temperature. Dip papads one by one in water until moist, pat dry with cloth or tissue. Place spoonful of filling in center, roll like spring roll and seal ends. Cover with another soaked and pat-dried papad for extra protection. Rest for few minutes. Heat oil for frying on medium-high heat and fry papad rolls until crisp and golden brown, avoiding crowding the pan. Remove to absorbent paper. Serve hot with green chutney, ketchup or preferred dip.

name: White Chocolate and Coconut Truffles
instructions: Melt white compound chocolate with cream and butter over gentle heat or in a double boiler. Add dry coconut powder and mix well until fully incorporated. Cool mixture to room temperature. Using a spoon or melon baller, scoop portions and roll between palms to form truffle or laddu shapes. Place on parchment paper and chill in refrigerator for 1-2 hours until firm. Serve chilled. Optional: coat with additional grated coconut or cocoa powder.

name: Lauki Muthia
instructions: Grate fresh bottle gourd and squeeze out excess water using a cloth. In a bowl, mix grated bottle gourd with gram flour. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt and oil. Add water as needed to form a thick, moldable batter that holds shape. Knead well. Using wet hands or a muthia mold, form the mixture into oval or cylindrical shapes. Place shaped muthias in a steamer basket or pressure cooker with water. Steam for 10-15 minutes until cooked through (alternatively use pressure cooker with water and steam vents). Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick - it should come out clean. Remove and serve hot with green chutney, tamarind chutney or plain yogurt.

name: Bread Paneer Rolls
instructions: Mix paneer with spices and green chilli. Spread on bread slices, roll tightly, and shallow fry until golden brown.

name: Bharwan Aloo
instructions: Scoop potatoes and fill with spiced onion-tomato mixture. Cook in tamarind or tomato gravy until potatoes are tender.

name: Instant Anarsa
instructions: Mix maida and besan with sugar and ghee. Shape into balls or diamonds and deep fry until golden. Serve cool.

name: Mixed Vegetable Rice Flour Roti
instructions: Mix rice flour with grated vegetables, green chilli, ginger and salt. Add water to form dough. Make balls, flatten into rotis and cook on hot griddle with ghee until golden spots appear on both sides.

name: Masala Khakhra
instructions: Mix wheat flour with fenugreek, cumin seeds and spices. Knead with oil and salt. Roll very thin into circles. Bake or cook on griddle until crispy. Optional: bake in oven until completely dry and crispy.

name: Sugar Coated Murmura
instructions: Heat sugar with water and cook until thick syrup forms (drop test - drop should not flow). Roast murmura if moist. Add murmura to syrup in batches, stir continuously to separate and coat evenly. Spread on plate to cool. Store in airtight container when cool.

name: Mango Poori
instructions: Mix wheat flour with mango pulp, powdered sugar and salt. Knead with oil into soft dough. Shape small portions into balls, flatten and deep fry in hot oil until puffed and golden brown on both sides. Serve hot or warm.

name: Chana Dal Tadka
instructions: Soak chana dal 3-4 hours. Pressure cook dal with water, salt and turmeric until soft (1 whistle + 5 min low heat). In another pan, temper cumin seeds in ghee, add ginger, green and red chilies, saute. Add chopped tomatoes and red chilly powder, cook till oil separates. Mix in cooked dal with 1/2 cup water, garam masala and green coriander. Simmer 4-5 minutes. Adjust consistency. Garnish with ghee and coriander.

name: Aloo Stuffed Idli
instructions: Mix boiled and mashed potatoes with green peas, chopped green coriander, oil, chopped green chilly, ginger, curry leaves, turmeric powder, coriander powder, salt, mustard seeds, red chilly powder, and garam masala to create the stuffing. Fill idli batter with this mixture and steam in idli maker until cooked.

name: Flax Seeds Sweet Paratha
instructions: Mix flour with ground flax seeds and jaggery. Add ghee and salt. Knead with water to form dough. Roll into paratha and cook on griddle with ghee until golden brown.

name: Gobi Pakora
instructions: Cut cauliflower into small florets. Prepare batter with chickpea flour, finely chopped ginger, green chilly, turmeric powder, and salt. Dip florets in batter. Deep fry in oil until golden brown and crispy.

name: Paneer Pakoda Farali
instructions: Soak and grind samo rice to make batter with water chestnut flour. Mix in finely chopped green chilly, coriander, and black pepper. Cut paneer into pieces, stuff with spice mix. Dip in batter and deep fry until golden brown on both sides.

name: Turmeric Ginger Chilli Pickle
instructions: Cut raw turmeric and ginger into bite-sized pieces. Dry roast fennel seeds and black pepper. Grind coarsely. Heat mustard oil and add mustard seeds. Add turmeric, ginger, green chillies, and asafoetida. Add salt and roasted ground spices. Stir well. Add lemon juice and mix thoroughly. Store in a jar.

name: Chana Madra
instructions: Cook soaked and boiled chickpeas. Prepare yogurt gravy by tempering oil, sautéing onions and ginger, adding spices, and mixing with yogurt. Combine cooked chickpeas with the gravy and simmer. Garnish with green coriander.

name: Milk Powder Burfi
instructions: Heat butter, add milk, and milk powder. Stir until blended. Add powdered sugar and mix until dense. Add kewra essence. Spread on greased plate. For second layer, heat butter, add saffron-soaked milk, milk powder, powdered sugar, and yellow food color. Cook until thick and dense. Layer over first mixture. Allow to set and cut into pieces.

name: Mango Kheer
instructions: Boil full cream milk. Add soaked rice and cook on low-medium heat, stirring at intervals. Once milk and rice have similar consistency, add chopped cashews and almonds. Cook for 4-5 more minutes. Add sugar and cardamom powder. Cook for 1-2 minutes. Cool and add mango pulp. Mix well. Garnish with mango pieces, cashews, and almonds.

name: til gur barfi
instructions: Roast sesame seeds lightly. Heat jaggery with ghee until melted. Mix roasted sesame seeds with jaggery, add ground cardamom and chopped almonds. Pour onto greased surface, cool and cut into pieces.

name: farali aloo paratha
instructions: Grate boiled potatoes into water chestnut flour. Add finely chopped green chillies, green coriander, rock salt and ghee. Knead into stiff dough, rest 15-20 minutes. Roll small portions into thin parathas. Spread ghee and fold multiple times. Cook on tawa over medium flame until brown spots appear on both sides.

name: crispy rice vada
instructions: Mix rice flour with curd and water slowly to make smooth batter. Add salt and grated ginger. Cook the batter over low heat, stirring continuously until it reaches dough consistency. Add chopped coriander leaves. Cool the dough. Oil palms, shape dough into rings with hole in center. Deep fry on medium-high heat until vadas float and turn golden brown.

name: khasta namak para
instructions: Mix plain flour with salt and carom seeds. Knead dough with oil and water. Rest dough covered. Roll thin, brush with oil and fold. Roll again, brush and fold multiple times for layers. Cut into pieces. Deep fry on medium-high heat until golden and crispy.

name: peanut jaggery chikki
instructions: Melt crumbled jaggery in a pan with ghee on low flame, stirring constantly. Test readiness by dropping in water - it should stretch when cool. When ready, add roasted peanuts and mix well. Pour onto ghee-greased board and spread with greased spatula and rolling pin. Once cooled slightly, mark desired portions. Store in airtight container for up to 6 months.

name: gobhi musallam
instructions: Blanch whole cauliflower. Prepare spice paste from tomatoes, ginger, green chilies, cashews, and ground spices. Temper cumin seeds and whole spices in oil, add the paste, and simmer. Add blanched cauliflower and cook covered until tender, basting occasionally. Finish with fresh coriander.

name: matar masala mathri
ingredients: spice mix (turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder)
instructions: Mix refined flour with oil, carom seeds, and salt. Knead into a stiff dough with minimal water. Roll thin, sprinkle with ground peas and spices. Cut into shapes and deep fry until golden and crispy on both sides.

name: peanut paneer khasta kachori
instructions: For dough: Mix flour, salt, crushed carom seeds, and melted ghee. Knead with lukewarm water to soft dough. Rest 15-20 minutes. For stuffing: Temper asafoetida, coriander seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, crushed spices in oil. Add chopped chillies and ginger, roast. Add grated paneer, turmeric, red chilli powder, roast 2 minutes. Add ground peanuts and salt, roast 2 minutes more. To assemble: Divide dough into 10 lumps, roll thin. Fill with stuffing, seal edges. Flatten gently with palms. Deep fry in low heat oil until golden on both sides.

name: tinda masala
instructions: Peel and cut tinda into halves or quarter pieces. Boil briefly to remove bitterness, drain. Heat oil, temper cumin seeds. Add finely chopped onions, cook until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, cook briefly. Add tomato paste and powder spices. Add tinda pieces and stir-fry on high heat until dry and well-coated with masala.

name: bread gulab jamun
instructions: Soak bread briefly, squeeze out water. Mix with milk powder and knead with 1 tbsp melted ghee into a soft dough. Shape into small balls. Heat remaining ghee and deep fry balls until golden brown. Prepare sugar syrup with water, crushed cardamom, saffron and rose water. Immediately soak fried balls in hot syrup for absorption. Chill before serving.

name: Makka Churma Laddu
instructions: Toast cornflour in ghee until fragrant, add powdered sugar, mix well, cool slightly, shape into balls or laddus, dry fruits can be added if desired.

name: Radhaballavi
instructions: Mix refined flour, salt and oil, knead to medium soft dough, cover for 20 minutes. Roast cumin, fennel, nutmeg and red chili until brown, grind to fine powder. Soak urad dal and coarsely grind, heat oil and add asafoetida, urad dal, sugar, salt and roasted spices, roast for 2 minutes. Heat oil for frying. Divide dough into portions, expand each piece, shape like bowl, fill with 1.5-2 tsp stuffing, close and flatten, roll on oiled board to 5 inch diameter. Fry in hot oil, pressing to puff, flip and fry until golden brown on both sides.

name: Lassi
instructions: For Amritsari Lassi: Add curd, powdered sugar and ice cubes to blender, blend well, pour in glass and serve chilled. For Strawberry Lassi: Add curd, powdered sugar, strawberry pieces and ice cubes, blend well and serve. For Rooh Afza Lassi: Add curd, powdered sugar, Rooh Afza syrup and ice cubes, blend and serve. For Chocolate Lassi: Add curd, powdered sugar, chocolate powder or cocoa powder and ice cubes, blend and serve chilled.

name: Yogurt
instructions: Heat milk and cool to warm temperature, add yogurt culture starter and mix well, pour into container, wrap in cloth or use yogurt maker, keep undisturbed for 6-8 hours until set. For fruit yogurt, fold in fresh fruit pieces or swirl fruit puree into set yogurt before serving.

name: Farali Poori
instructions: Mix hung curd with arrowroot in bowl, add sendha salt, black pepper and cumin seeds, mix properly to combine. Knead as regular dough, cover and keep for 10 minutes. Knead again for 3-4 minutes. Preheat ghee in deep pan. Divide dough into lumps, roll each into round ball and flatten. Spread arrowroot powder on rolling board, expand dough using rolling pin. Place expanded poori in heated ghee, press with ladle to expand. Flip and fry both sides until golden brown on medium flame. Drain on paper plate.

name: Besan Sooji Idli
instructions: Mix besan and semolina in bowl, add salt and baking soda. Add oil and mix well. Add water gradually to make a batter of idli consistency (not too thick or thin). Add ginger, green chili and curry leaves if desired. Pour batter into greased idli molds, steam for 10 minutes in idli maker or pressure cooker with water in base. Remove and serve warm with sambar or chutney.

name: Sev Tamatar
instructions: Prepare sev by kneading chickpea flour with salt, oil and water into soft dough. Fry in heated oil for 1-2 minutes until golden brown, then drain. For curry: heat oil, add cumin and mustard seeds, asafoetida, turmeric, green chilli and ginger. Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cover and cook 3 minutes. Add water and simmer. Add fried sev, garam masala and coriander, cover and cook 5 minutes on low flame.

name: Chana Saag Aloo Fry
instructions: Wash and chop chickpea leaves. Cut potatoes into small pieces. Heat oil in a pan, add mustard and cumin seeds. Add ginger and green chilli. Add chopped chickpea leaves and potatoes. Add turmeric and salt. Cook on medium flame until potatoes are soft and leaves are tender, stirring occasionally.

name: Crispy Sooji Pakoda
instructions: Mix semolina with whisked curd. Add chopped capsicum, cauliflower, green coriander, ginger and green chilli. Add salt and baking soda. Mix well to form a thick batter. Heat oil for deep frying. Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towel and serve hot.

name: Paneer Bhatura
instructions: Knead refined flour with curd, sugar, salt, baking soda and oil. Add lukewarm water gradually to form soft dough. Knead well with oil on palms. Cover and set for 2 hours to ferment. Prepare filling: grate paneer, add salt, black pepper, red chilli flakes, coriander flakes and green coriander. Divide fermented dough into 6 portions, roll into thin circles, place filling in center, seal edges well. Dust with dry flour. Deep fry in heated oil on high flame, pressing with ladle, flip and fry until golden brown.

name: Besan Meedha Ladoo
instructions: Roast chickpea flour in ghee on low flame for 10-12 minutes until golden and fragrant. Add sugar and mix well. Add dry fruit pieces and cardamom powder. Mix thoroughly until combined. Cool slightly. Roll into round balls using wet hands. Arrange on a plate and serve at room temperature.

name: Boondi Papad Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds on low flame. Add dry red chilli, green chilli and ginger paste. Saute the spices. Chop tomatoes finely and add to pan. Add turmeric, coriander powder and red chilli powder. Roast masala mixture until tomatoes mash and oil separates. Add boondi and crushed papad. Add water and salt, boil for 3-4 minutes. Add remaining boondi and papad pieces. Garnish with green coriander and serve.

name: Tinda Stuffed with Paneer
instructions: Clean and halve tindas. Scoop out centers. Mix paneer with spices and green chillies to make stuffing. Fill tinda halves with paneer mixture. Heat oil in pan, add asafoetida and whole spices. Cook stuffed tindas until tender, adding water as needed. Finish with garam masala.

name: Besan Pitor Curry
instructions: Prepare pitor: mix chickpea flour with salt, red chilli powder, turmeric, cumin seeds, chopped green chilli and water to form paste. Heat oil, add asafoetida and paste, cook while stirring until thick. Spread on plate and cool for 10 minutes. For masala: heat oil, add cumin seeds, asafoetida, turmeric, coriander powder, and ginger paste. Add tomato-green chilli paste and red chilli powder, roast until oil separates. Add water and bring to boil. Add curd gradually while stirring. Cut cooled pitor into pieces, add to gravy with salt and garam masala. Cook 3-4 minutes on low flame. Garnish with green coriander.

name: Aloo Gobhi Matar
instructions: Peel and cut potatoes into cubes. Cut cauliflower into small florets. Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add diced onions and fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add tomato paste and cook until oil separates. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, and coriander powder. Add potatoes and cauliflower, mix well. Add peas and salt. Cover and cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender. Finish with garam masala.

name: Aloo Masala Naan
instructions: Mix refined flour with curd, sugar, salt, baking soda, and oil. Knead soft dough with lukewarm water. Massage dough for 4-5 minutes. Cover and let rise 2-2.5 hours. For stuffing: crumble boiled potatoes, mix with salt, coriander powder, dry mango powder, red chilli powder, chopped green chillies and green coriander. Divide dough into portions, roll into circle, add stuffing, seal edges, flatten gently. Roll into oval shape. Apply water on one side and place on preheated tawa. Cook until brown spots appear, flip and cook second side. Apply ghee and serve.

name: Gur Atta Papdi
instructions: Mix wheat flour with salt and ajwain. Crumble jaggery and mix into flour. Add oil and mix until breadcrumb consistency. Add water gradually to form soft dough. Knead well. Roll out thin between plastic sheets. Cut into diamond or rectangular shapes. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Store in airtight container.

name: Aloe Vera Subzi
instructions: Clean and peel aloe vera leaves, cut into small pieces. Blanch briefly and drain. Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds. Add chopped onions and fry until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add tomato paste and cook until oil separates. Add turmeric, red chilli powder, and coriander powder. Add aloe vera pieces and salt. Cook on medium heat until aloe vera is tender and curry thickens. Serve hot.

name: Poppy Seeds Puri
instructions: Mix wheat flour with poppy seeds and salt. Add oil and mix. Gradually add water to form soft dough. Knead well for 5-10 minutes. Cover and let rest for 15-20 minutes. Divide into small balls. Roll into thin circles. Heat oil in deep pan until hot. Carefully place puri in oil and fry on both sides until golden and puffed. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot with potato curry or pickle.

name: Sprouted Moong Masala Paratha
instructions: Prepare dough with wheat flour, salt, and oil. Knead with warm water until soft. Let rest for 30 minutes. For filling: cook sprouted moong lightly and drain. Mix with chopped onions, green chillies, ginger, garlic, coriander powder, cumin powder, red chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, and salt. Divide dough into balls, flatten, add filling, seal and shape into disc. Roll out carefully on floured surface. Heat tawa or griddle, place paratha and cook until golden spots appear on both sides. Apply ghee. Serve hot with pickle, yogurt, or curry.

name: raw mango chutney pickle
ingredients: yellow mustard seeds 2 tbsp coarsely ground
instructions: Peel and chop mangoes finely. Heat oil in a wok, add mango pieces and cook until soft, then cool. Grind cooled mango pieces. Heat mustard oil, add cumin and mustard seeds, roast until seeds crackle. Add fennel seeds, asafoetida, fennel powder, turmeric powder, black pepper, kashmiri red chili powder, and salt. Add mango paste and cook for 1 minute. Cool slightly and add vinegar. Mix well and store in glass or food-grade plastic container.

name: shakarpara
ingredients: ghee or oil for moyan 1/4 cup (60 grams)
instructions: Mix refined flour with sugar. Add ghee and knead into a stiff dough. Roll out and cut into small diamond or square pieces. Deep fry in ghee or oil until golden brown on all sides. Cool completely and store in an airtight container.

name: raw mango pickle without oil
instructions: Peel and chop raw mangoes finely. Mix with salt and let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. In a dry pan, dry roast mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds until fragrant. Add to mango mixture along with red chili powder, turmeric powder, and asafoetida. Mix well and store in a glass jar. Can be consumed within a few months.

name: spinach corn cheese sandwich
instructions: Make white sauce: melt 2 tsp butter, add 1.5 tbsp refined flour and roast, add 3/4 cup milk slowly while stirring to avoid lumps. For stuffing: sauté 3/4 cup sweet corn in 2 tsp butter for 1 minute, add 2 cups chopped spinach and cook 2 minutes, season with salt and pepper, add white sauce and cook until thick. Cool and mix in grated mozzarella cheese. Spread stuffing between bread slices. Butter a griddle and cook sandwich 2 minutes per side on medium flame until golden brown. Alternatively use a sandwich maker/griller for 2 minutes.

name: sooji khichdi
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan, add mustard and cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add finely chopped vegetables and sauté for 2 minutes. Add sooji and dry roast for 2-3 minutes while stirring. Slowly add water while stirring to avoid lumps. Cook on low-medium heat until sooji is cooked and water is absorbed, approximately 8-10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well before serving.

name: appam manchurian
ingredients: red chilly powder less than 1/4 tsp
instructions: Preheat appam maker with oil in each mold. Place 1 tsp idli batter in each mold, cover with lid and cook on low-medium flame for 2 minutes until slightly brown on bottom. Flip and cook the other side until brown and crispy. Remove to a serving bowl. Heat oil in a pan, add ginger and sauté briefly. Add chopped capsicum and sauté for 1 minute on low flame. Add tomato sauce, salt, chilly sauce, vinegar, soya sauce, and red chilly powder. Mix well. Add the fried appams and stir gently to coat with sauce. Sprinkle black pepper powder. Garnish with green coriander and serve hot.

name: rajasthani malai ghevar
instructions: Prepare dough: Mix refined flour with 1/4 cup ghee until breadcrumb texture. Add water gradually to form a stiff dough. Let rest for 15 minutes. Roll out thin and cut into circular shapes with a mold. Deep fry in hot ghee until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Prepare sugar syrup: Combine sugar with water (equal parts) and heat until it reaches one-string consistency. Add cardamom powder and saffron strands. Soak fried ghevar in hot sugar syrup for a few seconds. Layer with rabri (reduced milk dessert) and garnish with chopped almonds and pistachios. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: sukhi palak bhaji
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Add ginger and garlic, then finely chopped spinach. Stir fry on high heat until spinach is cooked and water evaporates. Season with salt and chili powder. Serve hot.

name: dahi ke kabab rolls
instructions: Mix hung curd with grated paneer, finely chopped vegetables, green coriander, and spices. Make a paste by mixing plain flour with water. Cut bread into strips and coat with curd mixture. Roll and apply flour paste. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Drain and serve hot.

name: south indian filter coffee
instructions: Method 1 (Traditional filter): Add 2-3 tbsp coffee to South Indian filter and press. Add boiling water and cover for 15-20 minutes to prepare decoction. Add sugar to tumbler, pour decoction and boiled milk, shake well. Method 2 (Moka pot): Add water to moka pot bottom chamber, fill to valve. Add coffee powder to filter basket, attach top chamber, and screw closed. Heat on medium flame until decoction rises. Cool slightly, add sugar and milk, stir well.

name: jackfruit pakora
instructions: Peel and chop jackfruit into smaller pieces. Boil in pressure cooker with water, salt, and asafoetida for one whistle. Cool and drain. Mix chickpea flour, rice flour, and water to make batter. Add green chilies, spices, salt, turmeric powder, and boiled jackfruit to batter and mix well. Heat oil and deep fry spoonfuls of batter on medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per batch until golden brown. Drain on paper towels and serve with green coriander dip or sauces.

name: mooli ke patte ki kadhi
instructions: Whisk yogurt with chickpea flour until smooth. Heat ghee and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and fenugreek seeds. Add ginger, green chilies, and asafoetida. Add finely chopped radish leaves and cook for 2 minutes. Pour in yogurt mixture and water, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Bring to boil and simmer for 10-15 minutes until radish leaves are cooked and curry thickens. Serve hot.

name: rice fara
instructions: Boil water with ghee and salt, then add rice flour and mix well. Cover and cool slightly. Soak split chickpeas and urad dal for 3-4 hours, then grind coarsely. Mix ground dal with green chili, ginger paste, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, green coriander, and salt. Apply ghee to palms and mash dough, adding water gradually. Divide into lumps and flatten into 3-4 inch diameter discs. Coat with dry rice flour and cut using a glass rim. Place stuffing on each disc and fold to seal. Steam on greased strainer for 10 minutes. Later, fry steamed pieces in oil with mustard seeds, cumin seeds, green chili, and remaining spices for 1-2 minutes until crispy. Serve hot with green coriander chutney.

name: aloo baingan masala
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes and brinjal. Heat oil in pressure cooker, add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add ginger paste and tomato paste, then add turmeric, coriander powder, red chilly powder. Add prepared potatoes and brinjal with salt. Cook in pressure cooker quickly until soft.

name: tomato pickle
instructions: Chop pulpy tomatoes into thick pieces. Heat mustard oil and cook tomatoes with lid on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft. Remove lid, mash and cook until juice finishes. Add tamarind pulp and cook 1-2 minutes, cool and grind coarsely. Heat oil again, add mustard and fenugreek seeds, cumin, dry chilies, and asafoetida. Add ground tomato paste with turmeric and red chilly powder. Cook 4-5 minutes. Store in glass container.

name: rava toast
instructions: Mix semolina, curd, finely chopped tomato, capsicum, green coriander, green chili, and ginger in a bowl. Add salt. Dip bread slices in this mixture to coat both sides evenly. Heat ghee on a griddle or pan and shallow fry the coated bread slices until golden and crispy on both sides. Serve hot.

name: farali arbi cutlets and pakoda
instructions: Boil and peel arbi and potatoes, mash together. Roast peanuts and crush coarsely. Mix mashed arbi-potato with peanuts, green chili, ginger, cumin seeds, and rock salt. Shape into cutlets or prepare pakora batter with sendha namak flour. Deep fry in ghee until golden and crispy. Serve hot.

name: til milk powder barfi
instructions: Dry roast sesame seeds until fragrant. Heat ghee in a heavy pan, add roasted sesame seeds and milk powder. Stir continuously on medium heat. Add sugar gradually and keep stirring until mixture thickens and becomes dry. Add cardamom powder. Spread on greased surface, cool slightly, and cut into pieces.

name: shalgam bharta
instructions: Peel, chop turnips into 1-inch cubes, and wash. Pressure cook turnips with oil, cumin seeds, asafoetida, ginger paste, turmeric powder, and salt for one whistle, then simmer for 5 minutes. In a separate pan, heat oil, add cumin seeds and spices, add tomato-green chili paste and roast until oil separates. Add green peas and cook 3 minutes. Add sugar and salt. Open cooker, mash turnips well and mix with the masala. Add garam masala and coriander. Cook 2-3 minutes, then add lemon juice. Serve with chapati or rice.

name: aloo soyabean sabzi
instructions: Dice potatoes and soak in water. Heat oil, add cumin seeds, then onion-garlic-ginger paste. Cook until golden. Add green chili and tomato paste. Add turmeric, coriander powder, and red chili powder. Add diced potatoes and boiled soybean. Cook on high heat until potatoes are tender. Add garam masala and adjust seasoning. Serve hot.

name: Tawa Naan
instructions: Mix maida, oil, baking soda, sugar, salt and curd to form a soft dough. Knead well until smooth. Divide into 6-8 portions. Roll each portion into thin oval shape. Heat tawa or pan, place naan on it, cook on medium flame until bubbles form and bottom is light brown, flip and cook other side until golden. Serve hot.

name: Palak Paratha
instructions: Finely chop spinach. Mix wheat flour, chopped spinach, cumin seeds, ginger paste, green chili, salt and water to form a soft dough. Knead well. Divide into 4 portions. Roll each into thin circle. Heat oil in tawa or pan, place paratha on hot surface, cook on medium flame, spread oil on sides, flip and cook until light golden brown spots appear. Serve hot with yogurt or curry.

name: Til Sooji Barfi
instructions: Dry roast sesame seeds on medium flame for 2-3 minutes until aromatic. Roast semolina in ghee on medium flame until golden brown, stirring continuously. Melt jaggery with little water, strain and add to roasted semolina. Add roasted sesame seeds and chopped almonds. Mix well. Pour mixture onto greased plate, flatten evenly. Cool completely. Cut into desired barfi pieces. Store in airtight container.

name: Punjabi Pinni
instructions: Melt 1/2 cup ghee, add edible gums and roast on low-medium flame for 3 minutes until they expand. Add almonds and roast 2 minutes. Roast cashews on medium flame until light brown. Dry roast muskmelon seeds on high flame 2 minutes until they expand. Roast grated dry coconut for 1 minute. Filter and save ghee from roasted items. Add 1/2 cup more ghee, roast wheat flour on medium flame for 15 minutes until golden brown, stirring continuously. Cool slightly. Coarsely crush all roasted items, mix together. Add crushed items to roasted flour, add jaggery and cardamom powder, mix well while hot. Shape into round balls, place cashew piece on top. Store in container for 2-3 months.

name: Cluster Beans Curry
instructions: Trim and chop cluster beans into small pieces. Heat oil, temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add chopped cluster beans, sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric powder and salt, mix well. Add yogurt, stir gently. Cover and cook on medium flame for 8-10 minutes until cluster beans are tender and gravy coats the beans. Garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve hot with rice or roti.

name: Arbi Masala
instructions: Wash arbi and boil in pressure cooker with water until soft, about 1 whistle then 2 minutes on low flame. Cool and peel. Cut into vertical pieces. Heat mustard oil in pan, add carom seeds, asafoetida, turmeric powder, coriander powder, chopped green chili and finely chopped ginger. Roast spices lightly. Add arbi pieces, salt, dry mango powder, red chili powder and garam masala. Mix well. Spread arbi, cover and cook on low flame 2-3 minutes. Flip and cook another 2-3 minutes until crispy. Add fresh green coriander and mix. Serve hot with poori or paratha.

name: Spinach Kofta Curry
instructions: Make stiff dough of chickpea flour and chopped spinach with spices. Shape into balls and cook in appam maker or fry in oil until brown. For gravy: grind tomatoes, ginger and green chillies. Temper whole spices in oil, add ground paste, roast with powdered spices, add roasted chickpea flour and cream, cook with water on low flame for 5-6 minutes. Mix koftas into gravy and serve with bread or rice.

name: Cheese Mint Papdi
instructions: Make paste of mint leaves with green chillies. Mix wheat flour, refined flour, mint-chilli paste, oil, carom seeds, black pepper, salt and cheese. Knead into stiff dough with lukewarm water. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Roll out to 3-4 inch diameter, cut into 4 parts, poke with fork. Fry in medium hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Cool completely and store in container.

name: Roasted Poha Namkeen
instructions: Roast poha in a dry pan on low-medium heat, stirring occasionally until light and crispy, then transfer to a bowl. Roast peanuts and coconut separately until fragrant. Chop green chilly finely. Heat oil in pan, add curry leaves, green chilly and turmeric, then add all roasted ingredients. Mix in sugar powder and raisins. Cool completely before storing in airtight container for up to 2 months.

name: Bedmi Puri
instructions: Soak urad dal overnight, grind coarsely with minimal water. Mix with wheat flour, salt and little water to form dough. Let rest for 1-2 hours. Take small portions, roll into thin circles. Heat oil to medium-high temperature. Fry puri until golden and puffed on both sides. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

name: Churma Ladoo
instructions: Toast flour in ghee in microwave until light brown and fragrant. Mix with powdered sugar and milk to form a soft mixture. Add crushed dry fruits and spices. While warm, shape into ladoos. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

name: Corn Pakoda
instructions: Mix sweet corn with chickpea flour. Add finely chopped onion, green chilli, ginger, turmeric, red chilli powder and salt. Add water to form thick batter. Heat oil in deep pan. Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown on all sides. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with chutney.

name: Aloo Ring Samosa
instructions: Make dough with refined flour, carom seeds, oil and salt. For filling: mash boiled potatoes and mix with peas, green coriander, chopped green chilli, grated ginger, and all spices. Prepare ring-shaped samosas with ring cutter. Deep fry until golden and crispy.

name: Grilled Potato Sandwich
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes with salt. Spread mashed potato on bread slices. Place another bread slice on top. Heat butter on a griddle. Grill sandwich until golden and crispy on both sides.

name: Paneer Matar ka Jhol
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger and garlic paste, cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add turmeric, red chilli powder and cumin powder. Add paneer cubes and peas. Pour water to make a soup-like consistency. Simmer for 8-10 minutes. Sprinkle garam masala and serve hot.

name: Lauki Barfi
instructions: Grate bottle gourd and squeeze out water. Cook grated gourd with ghee on medium heat until juices evaporate. Add sugar and cook until thick. Mix in grated mawa and cook further. Add cashews and crushed cardamom. Spread on greased plate, top with almonds, cool and cut into pieces.

name: Achari Gobhi
instructions: Cut cauliflower into medium florets and blanch in warm salted water for 5 minutes, then wash. Coarsely grind fenugreek seeds, cumin seeds and mustard seeds. Heat mustard oil and add ground spices with asafoetida, sauté for few minutes. Add chopped green chillies, ginger, turmeric, cauliflower florets and salt. Stir for 2-3 minutes. Add water, cover and simmer on low flame for 4-5 minutes. Open lid, stir and cook 4 more minutes until cauliflower is soft. Add mango powder, garam masala and green coriander, mix well. Transfer to bowl and garnish with coriander sprigs.

name: jaggery rice
instructions: Heat ghee, add rice, toast lightly, add water and jaggery, cook until rice is tender

name: bharwan baingan
instructions: Slit eggplants lengthwise, prepare spiced gram flour filling with herbs and spices, stuff eggplants, fry in oil until soft and cooked

name: til atta barfi
instructions: Roast sesame seeds and wheat flour in ghee until fragrant, add jaggery or sugar, mix well, set on a greased tray, cut into pieces once cooled

name: besan kachori
instructions: Knead refined flour with ghee and salt, rest dough. Prepare gram flour filling with spices, cumin, green chilly and ginger. Stuff dough balls with filling, shape into kachoris, deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and puffed

name: kesar rice kheer
instructions: Soak saffron strands in warm milk. Cook soaked basmati rice in milk until soft. Add sugar, cardamom powder, and saffron-infused milk. Cook until thickened. Garnish with roasted almonds, cashews and raisins

name: aflatoon barfi
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee until light brown. Add milk powder and sugar, continue roasting until golden brown. Add mawa, milk and continue stirring on low flame until thick consistency. Add cardamom powder and dry fruits. Pour onto greased tray, garnish with chopped nuts, set for 1 hour, cut into pieces

name: Soya Chunks Stuffed Karela
instructions: Soak soya chunks for 15 minutes and squeeze dry. Chop onion, ginger-garlic, green chili finely. Sauté onion until golden, add ginger-garlic paste, then green chili. Add soya chunks and all dry spices. Prepare karela by slitting lengthwise and removing seeds. Stuff the karela with cooked soya mixture. Heat oil in pan, add stuffed karela and cook covered on medium heat for 15-20 minutes until karela is tender and slightly golden, stirring occasionally.

name: Veg Matka Biryani
instructions: Soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Boil water with spices (bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, black pepper, salt, ghee). Add rice and cook 80% till 6 minutes, drain. Heat ghee, roast cashews until brown, add cumin seeds, ginger paste, green chili, and black cardamom. Add marinated vegetables (mixed with curd and spices), cook on high then medium for 3-4 minutes. Grease mud pot with ghee. Layer vegetables and semi-cooked rice alternately. Garnish with coriander, mint, cashews, saffron milk, and ghee. Seal with kneaded dough and steam cook on low flame for 20-25 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Jackfruit Bharwan Masala Parata
instructions: Mix wheat flour with salt and oil to form a soft dough, let rest for 15 minutes. Peel and grate raw jackfruit. In a bowl, combine grated jackfruit, chickpea flour, green coriander, ginger paste, green chili, and all spices (garam masala, cumin, coriander, turmeric, dry mango powder). Mix well to form the filling. Divide dough into balls, roll out thin, place filling in center, gather edges and seal. Flatten gently and roll into a paratha. Heat oil in griddle and cook parata on both sides until golden brown, pressing gently with a spatula. Serve hot.

name: Bread Rolls with Noodles Stuffing
instructions: Boil noodles, drain and set aside. Heat oil in a wok, add minced garlic and chopped onion, stir-fry until fragrant. Add green chili, cabbage, and carrots, continue stir-frying for 2-3 minutes. Add boiled noodles, soy sauce, chili sauce, and salt. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes. Cool the filling slightly. Trim bread crusts, flatten each slice, place filling in center, roll tightly and seal edges. Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry rolls until golden brown on all sides. Serve hot with sweet and sour sauce or tomato ketchup.

name: Rajma Galouti Kebab
instructions: Soak rajma for 8-10 hours. Cook in pressure cooker with 0.5 cup water and 0.75 tsp salt until first whistle, then cook 3 more minutes. Drain and cool. Grind boiled rajma and mix with grated boiled potatoes. Add green coriander, ginger, green chili, chaat masala, coriander powder, roasted cumin seeds powder, red chili powder, garam masala, and salt. Mix well. Form into balls, flatten into cutlets. Oil palms lightly. Preheat non-stick pan with oil and fry cutlets on medium flame until golden brown on both sides. Serve with coriander chutney or tomato sauce.

name: Kaju Pista Roll
ingredients: green food color less than 0.25 pinch
instructions: Roast cashews until light golden, grind to a fine paste with sugar. Chop pistachios and almonds finely. Heat ghee in a pan, add cashew-sugar paste and cook on low heat for 3-4 minutes, stirring continuously. Add milk gradually to get a pliable consistency. Fold in chopped pistachios, almonds, cardamom powder, and food color. Cool slightly. Roll out on a sheet into a 0.25 inch thick layer. Cut into 1-inch width strips and roll tightly into cylinders. Wrap in parchment paper and refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.

name: rava meethi mathri
instructions: Mix semolina, wheat flour, sesame seeds, cardamom powder. Add powdered sugar and mix. Add oil and milk gradually to make soft dough. Rest for 20 minutes. Mash dough, divide into portions, flatten thin with rolling board, cut with cookie cutter, prick with fork. Fry in low-medium heated oil until golden brown on both sides. Drain and cool.

name: paneer sandwich
instructions: Layer paneer and vegetables between bread slices, toast or pan-fry until golden and crispy.

name: kokum juice concentrate
instructions: Soak kokum in water, extract juice, mix with sugar syrup, strain and bottle as concentrate for instant kokam sharbat drink preparation.

name: knol khol khalan curry
instructions: Cut kohlrabi into pieces. Sauté onions, add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and spices. Add kohlrabi pieces and cook until tender. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

name: bread bonda
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes with onions, green chilly, ginger and spices. Spread potato mixture between bread slices and cut. Prepare gram flour batter, coat bread pieces and deep fry until golden brown and crispy. Serve hot with chutney.

name: soya chaap curry
instructions: Boil soya chaap pieces. Sauté onions until golden, add ginger-garlic paste and cook. Add tomato puree and spices, cook until oil separates. Add cooked soya chaap and simmer to make gravy. Adjust salt and serve hot.

name: Poha Kheer
instructions: Roast poha lightly in ghee. Cook milk with sugar and khoya until thickened. Add roasted poha and cook until well combined. Top with dry fruits and serve warm.

name: Aloo Simla Mirch
instructions: Heat oil and splutter cumin seeds with spices. Add chopped potatoes, cover and cook until tender. Add capsicum, ginger and salt, cook for 3-4 minutes. Finally add tomatoes and green coriander, simmer until done.

name: Paneer Stuffed Gatta
instructions: Make soft dough with chickpea flour and curd. Roll paneer into cylinders and wrap with dough. Steam wrapped dumplings for 12 minutes. Prepare gravy with tomato paste and spices, add curd, and simmer. Place cooked gattas in gravy and garnish with tempered mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Sai Bhaji
instructions: Cook lentils until soft. Sauté onions and garlic, add ginger and spices. Add boiled potatoes and leafy greens, mash and mix well with cooked lentils. Cook until combination is thick and well combined.

name: Aloo Sengri
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add diced potatoes and cook until half done. Add radish pods, turmeric, chilly powder and salt. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender and golden.

name: Kundru Sabzi
instructions: Wash and slice kundru into halves. Heat oil and splutter cumin seeds. Add kundru pieces with spices and cook on high heat until golden and crispy on the outside.

name: Mango Kadhi
instructions: Prepare a gram flour paste with water. Heat oil and temper with cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add ginger-chilli mixture, then the gram flour paste. Simmer until cooked. Add mango pieces and cook until the curry is thick and aromatic. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves before serving.

name: Kadhi Pakoda without Dahi
instructions: Soak mango powder in water. Mix chickpea flour with water to prepare the kadhi base. Prepare pakoda batter with remaining chickpea flour, green chilli, coriander, and baking soda. Fry pakodas until golden brown. Temper oil with cumin and fenugreek seeds, add spices and ginger. Pour in mango powder mixture, then add kadhi paste. Simmer and add fried pakodas. Cook for 10 minutes on low-medium heat. Add green coriander and final tempering with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Moong Dal Barfi
instructions: Soak moong dal for 3 hours and grind into fine paste. Roast moong dal paste with ghee on medium-low heat until golden brown (25 minutes). Roast mawa separately until colour changes slightly. Prepare sugar syrup by dissolving sugar in water and boiling for 2 minutes. Add food colour to syrup. Mix moong dal, mawa, and sugar syrup together, stirring until thick. Add crushed cardamom seeds. Pour onto greased plate, spread evenly. Top with sliced pistachios and press gently. Cool for 2 hours and cut into pieces.

name: Gulab Sharbat
instructions: Boil rose petals with beetroot, tulsi, mint, and coriander leaves until the water is infused with colour and flavour. Strain the mixture. Add crushed cardamom seeds to the strained liquid. Dissolve sugar in the rose infusion on gentle heat. Add lemon juice for tang. Simmer until syrup consistency is reached. Cool and store in bottles.

name: Pizza Base on Tawa
instructions: Mix refined flour with yeast, salt, sugar, and semolina. Add lukewarm water and knead soft dough. Apply oil and knead for 6-7 minutes until smooth. Cover and place in warm location for 1-2 hours to rise. Punch down dough and divide into 4 equal portions. Flatten each portion into round shape of 6-7 inches diameter. Prick with fork. Preheat tawa on low flame. Cook each base for 2 minutes on each side until expanded and cooked.

name: Mango Vermicelli Kheer
instructions: Peel and chop mangoes finely. Chop and slice nuts as per recipe. Powder cardamom seeds. Heat ghee in pan and roast vermicelli until golden brown. Bring milk to simmer and add roasted vermicelli. Stir continuously until milk simmers again. Reduce flame and simmer for few more minutes until vermicelli is tender. Add sugar and mix well. Add chopped nuts and cardamom powder. Simmer for 1-2 minutes more. Turn off flame and cool slightly. Add finely chopped mangoes and mix well. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with mangoes and dry fruits. Serve chilled.

name: Boondi Mithai
instructions: Prepare gram flour batter, deep fry small round droplets to form boondi, prepare jaggery syrup, coat boondi with jaggery chikki preparation, cool and set.

name: Makki ka Paratha
instructions: Mix corn flour with water and salt to form dough, stuff with boiled potato mixture, roll flat, pan fry in oil until golden brown on both sides.

name: Broccoli Salad
instructions: Wash and cut broccoli florets, blanch briefly if desired, arrange in salad bowl, add dressing and toss well, serve chilled.

name: Crispy Baby Corn Fritters
instructions: Mix refined flour and corn flour with water and spices to make coating paste, cut baby corn vertically in halves, dip in paste, coat with bread crumbs, deep fry in hot oil until golden brown, serve with chutney or sauce.

name: Aam Panna Concentrate
instructions: Boil mango chunks with ginger, cardamom, and pepper for 4-5 minutes, transfer pulp to bowl, prepare sugar syrup separately, grind mint, tulsi, mango pulp, cumin, and salts to paste, mix paste with sugar syrup, simmer until thick, cool and strain through sieve, store in bottle.

name: mawa malpua
instructions: Grate 200g mawa finely. Chop pistachios and almonds into small pieces. Grind green cardamom pods to fine powder. In a mixer jar, combine grated mawa, plain flour, and gradually add lukewarm milk (about 1.5 cups total) to form smooth batter. Let batter rest for 15-20 minutes. Separately, prepare sugar syrup by boiling 1 cup sugar with 1 cup water, stirring occasionally until sugar dissolves completely. Cook for 3 more minutes until it reaches one-string consistency (syrup droplets should form a sticky thread). Mix cardamom powder into warm syrup and set aside. Heat ghee in a wok to medium temperature (ghee should be warm, not smoking). Drop spoonfuls of batter into ghee and fry on low flame. Once bottom turns golden, flip carefully. Pour ghee over malpuas with a ladle for even browning. Fry until both sides turn golden brown. Remove with slotted spoon and squeeze out excess ghee using two ladles. Dip fried malpuas into sugar syrup and soak for 2-3 minutes. Remove and place on serving plate. Repeat with remaining batter. Garnish with chopped pistachios and almonds. Serve warm.

name: Sweet Tomato Chutney
instructions: Cook tomatoes with sugar and spices until thick and chunky, cool and store

name: Dry Fruits Chocolate Bark
instructions: Chop and roast dry fruits. Melt white and dark compound chocolate separately. Layer dark chocolate, spread white chocolate, top with dark chocolate. Sprinkle roasted dry fruits. Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Break into chunks and serve.

name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta until tender. Make tomato sauce by cooking tomatoes with onion, garlic and spices. Mix pasta with tomato sauce. Serve hot.

name: Stuffed Bitter Gourd Curry
instructions: Peel bitter gourds and salt them for 15-20 minutes. Wash and drain. Roast cumin, fennel and spices to make stuffing. Stuff the bitter gourds with this mixture. Fry in hot oil until golden. Make tamarind gravy with remaining spices and pour over the fried bitter gourds. Simmer for 10 minutes.

name: Parwal Aloo ki Sookhi Sabji
instructions: Peel and chop bottle gourds and potatoes into small pieces. Heat oil/ghee in a pan, add chopped onions and garlic, sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute. Add turmeric, red chili powder, and coriander powder. Toss in the chopped vegetables and stir well. Cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender and dry, approximately 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season with salt to taste and serve hot.

name: Achari Paneer Pizza
instructions: Prepare pizza dough using wheat flour, salt, oil and water; let it rest. Knead paneer and mix with pickle, onions, and garlic for filling. Roll out dough into circular shape. Spread tomato sauce evenly. Layer paneer-pickle mixture and cheese. Heat a tawa or pizza pan with oil, place pizza on it. Cook until bottom is golden and crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Flip if needed or bake until cheese melts and edges turn golden brown.

name: Sabut Moong Dal
ingredients: whole green moong dal (sabut moong) 0.5 cup
instructions: Soak whole moong dal for 7-8 hours. Pressure cook soaked dal with 1.5 cups water and salt until single whistle, then reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes. Heat ghee in a wok, add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add turmeric, dry red chilies, cloves, and black peppercorns. Sauté ginger paste, then add tomato and green chili paste with red chili powder. Roast until ghee separates. Pour cooked dal into spices and mix well. Add water if needed, bring to boil. Add garam masala and green coriander. Boil for 1 minute. Garnish with green coriander and ghee.

name: Veg Paneer Pocket on Tawa
ingredients: red chili powder less than 0.25 tsp
instructions: Knead wheat flour with ghee and salt, add water to make soft dough, cover for 20-25 minutes. Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds, turmeric, coriander powder, ginger, green chili. Add carrots and baby corn, cook 1 minute. Add capsicum, tomato, salt, water, cook covered 2 minutes. Add chili powder, pizza sauce, cool. Grease hands, knead dough, roll into oval shape. Fill with vegetable mixture, seal edges with water, press with fork. Heat tawa with ghee, place paratha, cook until golden spots appear on both sides, approximately 3-4 minutes per side. Serve hot.

name: Makka Laccha Paratha
instructions: Mix maize flour, wheat flour, salt, cumin seeds, green chili, green coriander, oil in a bowl. Add water gradually and knead into soft dough. Cover and rest for 15-20 minutes. Grease palms with clarified butter, mash dough. Divide into portions and roll thinly. Spread ghee evenly on rolled paratha. Cut into thin slices and layer them. Roll ends and coil, then flatten into round shape. Toss to remove excess flour. Place on preheated griddle with medium flame. Spread ghee, cook until light brown. Flip and repeat on other side. Cook until golden spots appear on both sides. Serve hot with pickles or curd.

name: Malai Mirch Rajasthani
instructions: Cut a slit lengthwise on each green chili and remove seeds carefully. Prepare filling by mixing cream, finely chopped onion, garlic, ginger, and salt. Stuff each chili with the cream mixture. Heat ghee or oil in a pan on medium flame. Place stuffed chilies in the pan and cook turning occasionally until chilies are soft and skin starts to blister, approximately 10-12 minutes. Serve hot as an appetizer or snack.

name: Hari Mirchi ke Tipore
instructions: Wash and dry green chilies completely. Make a slit on each chili and deseed if preferred for less heat. Heat oil in a deep pan or wok. Add mustard seeds, let them crackle. Add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add turmeric and red chili powder. Add green chilies and stir-fry on medium heat until skin blisters slightly, approximately 10-15 minutes. Season with salt to taste. This traditional Rajasthani preparation can be stored in an airtight container and served as a side dish or snack.

name: Fruit Raita
instructions: Whisk curd until smooth. Stone grind green cardamom seeds into powder. Peel and chop pear and apple into small chunks. Add milk to whisked curd and mix well. Add pear, apple, sugar, and black salt (optional for fasting). Crush green cardamom and add to curd along with fresh mint sprigs. Mix thoroughly. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Just before serving, peel banana and chop into chunks, add to raita. Garnish with pomegranate seeds and fresh mint leaves. Serve chilled.

name: black forest cake
instructions: Prepare ice bath by placing cream-filled bowl over ice cubes. Divide sponge cake into three even layers. Whip cold cream with butter for 3-4 minutes, then add icing sugar and whip another 3-4 minutes. Add vanilla essence and whip again. Brush each cake layer with honey water. Spread whipped cream on cake stand, place first layer and brush with honey water. Add cream layer, place second cake layer, brush with honey water and add cream. Place third layer, brush with honey water and add final cream layer. Cover sides with plastic wrap. Melt chocolate and mix with remaining cream. Using piping bag with flower nozzle, pipe flowers all over cake. Sprinkle chocolate shavings. Remove wrapping and place on serving plate.

name: halwasan
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan. Add edible gum and roast until they puff up. Add daliya and roast for 2-3 minutes until golden. Pour full cream milk into the pan. Stir constantly to prevent lumps and ensure milk does not burn at the bottom. Cook on medium heat until mixture thickens and dal is cooked, approximately 20-30 minutes. Add brown sugar and mix well. Add cardamom powder and nutmeg powder. Stir in chopped almonds and cashews. Cook for another 2-3 minutes. Serve warm.

name: daliya khichdi
instructions: Wash daliya and moong dal separately and drain. Heat ghee in a pressure cooker. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add asafoetida. Add washed daliya and moong dal, stir and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add turmeric powder and salt. Pour water (approximately 3 cups for this quantity). Cover pressure cooker and cook for 2-3 whistles on high flame. Once pressure releases, open cooker and mix well. If too watery, cook uncovered for a few minutes to evaporate excess liquid. Adjust salt and serve hot with ghee.

name: suran chutney
instructions: Peel and cut suran into small pieces. Grind green chili, ginger, coconut, peanuts, and cumin seeds into a paste. Boil suran pieces until soft. Drain water. Mix boiled suran with the ground paste and salt. Grind together to form a coarse chutney. Serve with any Indian bread or as a side with meals.

name: palak poha cutlet
instructions: Wash poha and drain, leaving very little water. Keep aside for 5 minutes and stir. Peel boiled potatoes and grate them. Heat oil in a wok. Mix poha, chopped spinach, and grated potatoes. Add all spices: ginger, green chili, garam masala, red chili powder, coriander powder, dry mango powder, turmeric powder, salt, and green coriander. Mix thoroughly. Grease hands and shape mixture into balls, then flatten into round cutlet shape. Heat oil in wok and check if sufficiently hot. Deep fry cutlets until golden brown on both sides, about 5-6 minutes per batch. Drain excess oil on slotted ladle. Serve hot with chutney.

name: ginger powder laddu
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan. Add edible gum and fry until puffed. Add ginger powder and roast for 1-2 minutes. Add jaggery and mix continuously until melted and combined. Add nutmeg powder and mix well. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Once cool enough to handle, add chopped almonds and cashews and mix. Grease hands with ghee and roll mixture into small balls (laddu). Cool completely on a plate before storing.

name: Almond Cake
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one by one. Mix in vanilla extract. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Fold into wet ingredients along with ground almonds. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350F for 35-40 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Cool before serving.

name: Cheese Dosa
instructions: Rinse and finely chop capsicums and slice mushrooms. Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan, add ginger paste, sweet corn, capsicum, mushrooms, chaat masala, salt, coriander powder and black pepper. Sauté until crunchy and set aside. Add 1/2 tsp salt to idli batter. Heat non-stick tawa, spread 2 tsp batter evenly in round shape and add oil around edges. Spread butter over dosa, layer with 2-3 tsp tomato chutney, then 2-3 tsp stuffing and grate cheese. Fold dosa and roast until golden brown and crispy. Repeat for all dosas.

name: Microwave Khandvi
instructions: Mix gram flour with yogurt, ginger-green chili paste, turmeric powder and salt. Microwave for 3-4 minutes, stir well. Pour onto a greased flat surface and spread evenly. Cool and roll into a log shape. Cut into pieces. Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, let them crackle, add curry leaves and dried red chilies. Pour this tempering over the khandvi rolls.

name: Carrot Burfi
instructions: Peel and grate carrots. Chop pistachios and cashews, crush green cardamom seeds. Add grated carrots to boiling milk and cook uncovered for a few minutes. Add ghee and stir constantly for 3-4 minutes. Add sugar and mawa to mixture and stir constantly until the mixture becomes dense. Add cashew powder, chopped cashews and crushed cardamom powder, mix well. Turn off flame and transfer mixture to a greased plate, spreading evenly. Sprinkle cashews and pistachios on top and press lightly. Let set completely. Cut into desired sized pieces.

name: Kohlrabi Potato
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add finely chopped onions and cook until golden. Add ginger paste and finely chopped tomatoes, cook until tomatoes soften. Add diced kohlrabi and potatoes. Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder and salt. Mix well. Cover and cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, until kohlrabi and potatoes are tender (approximately 15-20 minutes).

name: Beetroot Halwa
instructions: 1. Wash, peel and grate 2 beetroots. 2. Heat pan, add 2 tsp ghee and roast chopped cashews and almonds for 1 minute, then set aside. 3. Pour ghee in pan, add grated beetroot and roast for 2-3 minutes. 4. Add 300ml full cream milk, mix, cover and cook on low-medium flame for 5-6 minutes. 5. Uncover and cook until dense on medium flame, stirring every minute. Meanwhile prepare cardamom powder. 6. Add sugar and raisins, turn off flame. 7. Garnish with roasted dry fruits. Cool and refrigerate.

name: Chana Dal Pulav
instructions: Prepare chana dal pulav in microwave with rice and lentils combined with spices and ghee

name: Rava Modak
instructions: 1. Soak 20-25 saffron strands in 2 tbsp milk until colored. 2. Heat pan, add ghee and roast 1/2 cup semolina on medium flame for 8-9 minutes until golden. 3. Add milk and saffron milk, stir constantly. Add 1/2 cup condensed milk and cook until dense dough forms. 4. Cool dough slightly. 5. Prepare stuffing by roasting almonds and pistachios, add cardamom powder and powdered sugar with a little dough to bind. 6. Fill modak mould with dough, add stuffing in center, close mould and press. 7. Open mould and arrange modaks on plate. Dry for 2-3 hours before storing.

name: Toffee Biscuit Pudding
instructions: Prepare pudding by layering biscuits with milk and toffee mixture, refrigerate until set

name: Palak Poori
instructions: Prepare dough with chopped spinach, besan flour, and wheat flour. Knead well, divide into portions, roll into thin rounds and deep fry until puffed and golden brown

name: poori
instructions: Take 2 cups wheat flour and 1/2 tsp salt. Add water in small portions and knead into a soft dough. Keep dough aside to rest. Heat ghee for frying in a deep vessel until it reaches proper frying temperature. Roll portions of dough into thin circular discs. Carefully place each disc into the hot ghee. Press gently with the back of a spoon until the poori puffs up. Flip and fry until golden brown on both sides. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper. Serve hot.

name: Cornmeal Poori
instructions: Mix maize flour with salt. Add water gradually to form stiff dough. Knead well. Let rest for 15-20 minutes. Divide into balls, roll into thin rounds. Heat oil and deep fry each poori on both sides until golden and crispy. Serve hot.

name: Tomato Stuffed Aloo Bonda
instructions: Boil potatoes until cooked. Mix chickpea flour with grated ginger, chopped green chili, coriander leaves, spice powders, baking soda and carom seeds. Make a stiff batter. Peel and hollow slightly cooked potatoes. Stuff tomato pieces inside. Coat potatoes with batter. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown on all sides.

name: Sweet Pongal
instructions: Wash and soak rice. Heat ghee in pan, add cashews and raisins, roast until golden. Add rice and cook with water until rice is soft and mushy. Add jaggery, stir well and cook until jaggery melts and combines. Serve warm.

name: Matar Paneer Paratha
instructions: Knead wheat flour with salt, ghee and water into soft dough. Let rest 20 minutes. Boil peas and mash with crumbled paneer, add salt to taste for filling. Divide dough into balls, roll into thin circles, place filling in center, fold edges and seal. Gently roll filled paratha. Cook on hot griddle with ghee until golden spots appear on both sides.

name: Instant Mango and Green Chilli Pickle
instructions: Heat mustard oil in pan. Add fenugreek seeds and mustard seeds on low heat. Add asafoetida. Add fennel seeds and saute spices together. Add grated raw mango, chopped green chillies and crushed yellow mustard. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, black pepper and salt. Mix well. Cook on medium heat. Add vinegar at the end. Cool and store in glass container. Can be eaten immediately or aged for 2-3 days.

name: Semolina Khoya Gujiya
instructions: Knead plain flour with ghee and water into stiff dough. Cover and rest 20-25 minutes. For filling: roast semolina in ghee until golden. Add boora, roasted cashews and almonds, roasted coconut, mawa, raisins, crushed cardamom, ground pepper and grated nutmeg. Mix well. Divide dough into portions, roll thin circles 3-4 inches diameter. Place on gujiya mould, add filling, seal edges with water, press mould closed. Carefully remove gujiya. Heat ghee, fry gujiyas until golden brown on both sides. Cool and store in airtight container for 15 days.

name: Idli Burger
instructions: Prepare rava idli batter by mixing semolina with curd and water. Add salt and eno fruit salt. Steam the batter in greased bowls for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, fry mustard seeds and cumin seeds in oil, add green chillies and ginger paste. Add mashed potatoes and peas with spices and salt. Cool and assemble by halving idlis, filling with potato mixture, and covering with another idli half.

name: Ginger Green Chilli Pickle
instructions: Clean and peel ginger. Sun-dry for 4-5 hours. Cut ginger into thin slices and green chillies into halves or quarters. Mix ginger and chilli pieces with salt, turmeric, ground mustard seeds, mustard oil, and vinegar. Squeeze lemon juice over the mixture and blend thoroughly. Transfer to a container and stir daily for 2 days for full flavor development. Ready to serve instantly but tastes better after 2 days.

name: Achari Mathri
instructions: Make dough by combining refined flour, salt, carom seeds, oil, and water. Let rest 15-20 minutes. Prepare achari masala by roasting spices in mustard oil: asafoetida, cumin, turmeric, fenugreek, ginger paste. Add coriander, fennel, mustard powder, black pepper, and red chilli powder. Roast chickpea flour separately in oil until color changes. Combine masala with roasted chickpea flour and add lime juice. Knead dough soft and divide into small portions. Flatten each into 2-2.5 inch circles, fill with 1/2 tbsp masala, seal edges, and flatten gently. Prick with fork on both sides. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Store in airtight container.

name: Nacho Chips
instructions: Mix corn meal with water and salt to form a dough. Prepare thin sheets by rolling out or flattening the dough between two parchment papers. Cut into triangular or tortilla chip shapes. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels. Season with salt if desired. Serve warm.

name: Stuffed Tandoori Potato
instructions: Peel potatoes and hollow them using a scooper. Deep fry hollowed potatoes until golden brown. For filling: saute ginger and green chillies, add cashews and raisins, add mashed cottage cheese with salt, chaat masala, and maggi masala. Mix well. Prepare tandoori marinade with hung curd, chickpea flour, ginger paste, green chilli paste, turmeric, red chilli powder, chaat masala, salt, oil, and maggi masala. Stuff the fried potatoes with paneer mixture and coat with tandoori marinade. Assemble with lemon slices between halves. Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Soya Matar Sabji
instructions: Soak soya chunks in water and squeeze dry. Chop onions. Heat oil and add onions, ginger paste, and green chillies. Saute until onions soften. Add soya chunks and peas. Sprinkle turmeric, coriander powder, and red chilli powder. Mix well and cook on medium-high heat stirring occasionally until dry and cooked through. Adjust salt and serve hot.

name: Fennel Seeds Sharbat
instructions: Soak fennel seeds in water for 5 hours. Soak cardamom pods separately. Grind soaked fennel seeds with sugar in a jar, adding water if needed to get a smooth paste. Pass through a strainer to collect juice. Repeat process with remaining fennel seeds. Strain cardamom pods and collect their juice separately. In a vessel, combine collected fennel and cardamom juices with sugar. Cook on medium heat, stirring regularly until the mixture becomes dense and syrup-like. Cool completely and strain. To serve: add 2 tablespoons of concentrated sharbat to a glass, add cold water and ice cubes.

name: Amchoor Powder
instructions: Wash and peel raw mangoes. Slice thinly using a chips cutter or knife. Soak slices in water and drain. Spread on cloth and dry in sunlight for 2 to 3 days until completely dry. Grind dried mango pieces with salt in mixer until fine powder. Sieve and store in airtight container for up to 6 months.

name: Bajra Halwa
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan. Add bajra flour and dry roast on medium heat until fragrant and lightly golden, stirring continuously. Add sugar mixed with water to achieve desired consistency. Stir well until sugar dissolves and mixture sets. Transfer to greased plate and cut into pieces once cooled.

name: Chapati
instructions: Mix wheat flour and salt in a bowl. Add oil and gradually add water to form soft dough. Knead well for 3-4 minutes, cover and rest for 20 minutes. Grease hands, knead again for 2 minutes. Divide into balls, dust with dry flour and roll into thin 6-7 inch discs. Heat tawa, place chapatti and roast on both sides until light brown spots appear. Rotate over flame to puff up. Apply ghee and serve hot.

name: Amla Ladoo
instructions: Deseed and dry amla berries in sunlight. Grind dried amla into fine powder. Mix amla powder with powdered jaggery and ghee. Knead into a dough-like consistency. Shape into small balls (ladoos). Dry for a few hours or days until firm. Store in airtight container.

name: Mango Coconut Burfi
instructions: Peel and chop ripe mangoes. Cook mangoes with desiccated coconut and sugar in a heavy-bottomed pan on low heat, stirring continuously until mixture thickens. Mix cornflour with water and add to the mixture to set consistency. Continue cooking and stirring until mixture pulls away from the pan sides. Pour onto greased plate. Cool completely. Cut into squares. Garnish with chopped cashew and pistachio pieces. Store in airtight container.

name: gajar ka gajrela
instructions: Boil 500ml full cream milk. Wash, peel and grate 4 carrots (500g). Add grated carrots to boiled milk and cook until dense. Chop almonds finely, halve cashews, grind 4 green cardamom. Heat ghee in pan and roast cashews and almonds until light brown, save some for garnishing. When gajrela reaches desired consistency, add sugar and mix well. Add roasted dry fruits and cardamom powder, mix. Serve hot or chilled, garnished with dry fruits.

name: paneer idli
instructions: Grate paneer into rice flour and urad flour mixture. Add salt, chopped green chilies and curry leaves. Mix well to form a batter. Grease idli moulds with oil. Pour batter into moulds. Steam for 15-20 minutes until cooked through. Remove from moulds and serve hot.

name: elo jhelo
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, salt and cardamom powder. Melt ghee and mix into flour mixture to form a binding dough. Add chopped almonds, cashews and grated coconut. Mix well. Shape into small balls or spirals. Deep fry in ghee until golden brown on both sides. Drain and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: raw banana tikka curry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add ginger and green chilies, saute. Add spice powders and mix. Add yogurt and cook for a minute. Cut raw banana into pieces, add to the pan. Add chopped tomatoes and salt. Cook on medium flame for 15-20 minutes until banana is soft and curry thickens. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot.

name: hara bhara pulao
instructions: Wash rice and soak for 15 minutes. Blanch spinach and mint, blend to smooth paste. Heat ghee and oil. Add cumin seeds, let splutter. Add bay leaves and cardamom. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute. Add all chopped vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes. Add rice and stir to coat with ghee. Pour spinach-mint paste and water. Bring to boil, then simmer covered for 15-18 minutes until rice is tender and water is absorbed. Fluff with fork and serve.

name: aloo laccha dry fruits namkeen
instructions: Peel, grate and wipe potatoes with cloth to remove moisture. Preheat oil and fry potato laccha in batches on medium flame until light brown, drain on strainer. Soak sago pearls with water for 2-3 minutes, then fry in moderately heated oil until they bloat, drain. Fry almonds until bloated, cashews until light brown, peanuts until they crack (6 minutes), coconut until color changes (1 minute), muskmelon seeds until bloated (1.5 minutes), lotus seeds until golden (7 minutes) - each in separate batches or carefully. Mix all fried ingredients in a large bowl. Add raisins, sendha salt and black pepper powder, mix well. Store in airtight container.

name: kadai chole
instructions: Wash and soak white chickpeas overnight. In pressure cooker add soaked chickpeas, 1/2 cup water, salt, baking soda and a tea bag. Close lid and cook until first whistle, then switch off flame. Let pressure release naturally. Remove tea bag and drain chickpeas. Heat ghee in pan on low flame, add cumin and carom seeds, let splutter. Add chopped green chilies, ginger and saute. Add boiled chickpeas with salt. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, mango powder, chopped tomatoes and green coriander. Mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot with poori or paratha.

name: Pudina Laccha Paratha
instructions: Knead wheat flour with salt and oil using lukewarm water, rest 20 minutes. Mix mint powder, coriander powder and salt. Roll dough thin, spread clarified butter and spice mixture, fold and roll. Cook on preheated pan with ghee on medium flame, flipping until golden brown spots appear on both sides.

name: Sonth Chutney
instructions: Dry ginger (sonth) based sweet chutney. Mix dry ginger with sugar to form a flavored condiment.

name: Makka Bati
instructions: Mix maize flour, wheat flour, salt, carom seeds, baking soda and oil. Knead with lukewarm water to form dough, rest 15-20 minutes. Shape into balls and roll. Place on greased plate in salt-lined pressure cooker. Cook on high flame for 16 minutes, then 6 minutes more, flip and cook 5-6 minutes until golden brown. Serve dipped in clarified butter.

name: Bread Pinwheels
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Saute ginger paste and green chilli, add coriander powder, turmeric and mashed potatoes with salt, mango powder, red chilli powder. Cook and add green coriander. Flatten bread slices. Layer bread with pizza sauce, spiced potato filling and cheese. Wrap in foil, refrigerate 30 minutes. Remove foil, cut into pieces, coat with melted butter. Bake at 190C for 15 minutes or shallow fry in butter for 2-3 minutes per side.

name: Raskadam
instructions: Make rasgullas by boiling milk, curdling with lemon juice mixture, forming chena balls and cooking in sugar syrup with saffron for 8-10 minutes. Drain rasgullas on sieve 1-1.5 hours. Dry roast paneer. Prepare dough with powdered sugar and mawa. Flatten khoya ball, place rasgulla in center, cover and coat with roasted paneer. Refrigerate 1 hour.

name: Vegetable Macaroni
ingredients: red chilly powder less than 1/4 tsp
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Chop all vegetables. Heat oil, add ginger paste and green chilli. Add capsicum, cabbage, tomato and carrot, cook until tender. Add cooked macaroni, tomato sauce, chaat masala, red chilli powder and salt. Mix well and cook until heated through. Garnish with green coriander.

name: baingan tikka masala
instructions: Marinate chopped brinjal pieces in curd, chickpea flour, and spices for 20 minutes. Fry marinated brinjal on low-medium flame for 3-4 minutes per side until light brown. Separately, heat oil and add cumin seeds, turmeric, and tomato-green chilli-ginger paste. Cook on medium flame and add coriander powder and red chilli powder. Roast until oil separates. Add fenugreek leaves and roast briefly. Add the fried brinjal tikka and water to the curry base. Simmer for 1 minute. Garnish with green coriander.

name: golgappa puri
instructions: Mix wheat flour and semolina. Add water gradually to make smooth, firm dough. Knead well and rest. Divide into small balls and roll very thin and crispy. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and puffed. Drain on paper towels.

name: soy chunks stir fry
instructions: Soak soya chunks in warm water. Heat oil in wok and stir-fry onions until golden. Add garlic, green chilli, and tomato. Add soaked soya chunks and dry spices. Stir-fry on high heat until well combined and cooked through.

name: dahi pudina chutney
instructions: Whisk curd until smooth. Finely chop fresh mint and green chilli. Mix mint, green chilli, and spices into the curd. Add salt to taste. Chill before serving.

name: eggless sponge cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F. Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In another bowl, beat sugar and oil together. Add yogurt and vanilla extract. Combine wet and dry ingredients gently until just mixed. Pour into greased pan and bake for 35-40 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before serving.

name: lauki laccha
instructions: Wash and dry bottle gourd. Using julienne peeler, peel bottle gourd horizontally to create thin strings. Tie the strings with thread and wash. Add water and sugar to wok and cook until sugar dissolves. Add peeled gourd strings and cook, stirring occasionally for 6-7 minutes. Flip and continue cooking until sugar syrup dries completely and strings become transparent. Remove from heat and cool slightly. Separate strings by cutting thread and spreading them. Once cooled, add rosewater and mix. Store in refrigerator.

name: Aloo Bhujia Namkeen
instructions: Boil potatoes and cut into desired sizes. Mix boiled potatoes with water chestnut flour, sendha salt, black pepper powder, and turmeric powder. Heat oil and fry the mixture until golden and crispy.

name: Soya Chaap Lifafa Paratha
instructions: Mix wheat and refined flour with ghee and carom seeds. Knead into stiff dough and let rest 20-25 minutes. Meanwhile, chop soya chaap and roast with capsicum, tomato, spices and pizza sauce. Cool filling. Roll dough into thin circle, spread ghee, place filling as square, fold corners with flour paste, and cook on griddle with ghee until golden brown.

name: Bharwan Tamatar
instructions: Scoop out tomato pulp carefully. Prepare filling by sauteing onion, garlic, and ginger. Add potato, green chilli, spices and tomato pulp. Mix well and stuff into tomato shells. Arrange in baking dish, bake at 180C for 20-25 minutes or fry in oil until cooked.

name: Makka Masala Aloo Poori
instructions: Mix corn flour and wheat flour. Add grated boiled potato. Add salt, red chilli powder, carom seeds, cumin seeds, green chilli, and green coriander. Mix with 2 tsp oil. Add water gradually and knead stiff dough like poori dough. Let rest 20-25 minutes. Divide into small balls, roll thick circles. Heat oil and deep fry pooris, pressing with ladle until they puff. Flip and fry until golden brown. Makes 14 pooris.

name: Achari Bhindi
instructions: Rinse okras and dry completely. Remove stalks from both ends and chop into 3-4 pieces (1/2 to 3/4 inch size). Heat mustard oil and add fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder, ginger paste and green chilly. Saute until fragrant. Add okra, fennel powder, mango powder, salt, red chilly powder and garam masala. Mix well to coat okra with spices. Cover and simmer on low flame for 12-14 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Add green coriander before serving.

name: Aloo Stuffed Bajra Paratha
instructions: Mix bajra flour and wheat flour with salt. Knead into soft dough using water. Let rest 15 minutes. Boil and mash potatoes with salt and green chilli for filling. Divide dough into balls, roll into thin circle, place potato filling in center, fold edges to seal. Roll gently into paratha shape. Heat ghee on griddle and cook paratha on medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

name: Veg Shammi Kabab
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add cumin seeds. Reduce flame and add coriander powder, ginger, green chilli. Roast spices. Add soaked chickpeas, garam masala, dry mango powder, red chilli powder, salt and 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook on low flame 3-4 minutes until chickpeas turn tender. Cool and grind finely in mixer. Add grated potato and paneer, salt and green coriander. Mix well to form dough. Shape into cutlets. Heat ghee in non-stick pan, fry cutlets on low-medium flame until golden brown on both sides. Serve with curd or coriander chutney.

name: rice flour laddus
instructions: Roast rice flour in wok on medium flame for 10 minutes until color changes. Roast sesame seeds for 2 minutes until puffy. Mix roasted flour, sesame seeds, grated coconut, and cardamom powder. Prepare jaggery syrup by dissolving crumbled jaggery in water and cooking until it reaches thread consistency.
