In a blender jar, add silken tofu, vanilla extract, remaining sugar free natura diet sugar and coconut cream. Blend till smooth. 3. Dip 2 cookies in matcha concoction and place in transparent cups. Spoon tofu mixture over. 4. Layer another set of cookies dipped in matcha concoction over tofu mixture and top with remaining tofu mixture. 5. Dust matcha powder over tiramisu. Refrigerate for an hour. 6. Serve chilled.

name: Bhaap Badi ka Salan
instructions: 1. Grind soaked dal with 1/2 cup water till fine. Transfer to bowl and add salt, coriander and onion, mix well. 2. Heat water in steamer. Grease thali with oil and add portions of ground mixture. 3. Steam for 10-15 minutes till badi is set. 4. Heat mustard oil in kadai, add cumin seeds and let them change color. Add onion paste and cook till golden brown. 5. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute. 6. Add turmeric, red chilli, coriander and cumin powders and garam masala, mix well. 7. Add 3 cups water and bring to boil. Add salt and cook for 4-5 minutes. 8. Lower heat, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes. 9. Add steamed badi and mix. Cook for 4-5 minutes on medium heat. 10. Add coriander and serve hot with rice.

name: Breakfast Trifle
instructions: 1. Finely chop red apple and transfer to bowl. Peel banana and chop finely into same bowl. Drizzle honey and lemon juice and mix well. 2. Add portion of fruit mixture to serving glasses, add layer of muesli and layer of blueberry yogurt. 3. Top with blueberries, pistachios and almonds and serve.

name: Basoondi
instructions: 1. Pour milk into Chef Magic kitchen robot for slow-cooking. 2. Allow the machine to reduce milk to velvety consistency over low heat. 3. Stop cooking once desired thickness is achieved. 4. Transfer to serving bowl. 5. Garnish with chopped nuts and saffron strands. 6. Serve as a festive dessert at room temperature or chilled.

name: Yamtar
ingredients: chicken on the bone with skin
instructions: 1. Roast chicken on direct heat till charred. 2. Boil 4-5 cups water in non-stick pan. Add salt, black peppercorns and bay leaf. 3. Add roasted chicken and cook on medium heat for 15-20 minutes. 4. Heat 3 tbsp mustard oil in kadai, add dried red chillies and sauté for 3-4 minutes. 5. Add dried bamboo shoots and sauté for 1 minute. Drain and set aside. 6. Transfer this mixture to grinder jar and grind coarsely. 7. Drain chicken pieces and shred the meat. 8. Heat remaining mustard oil in kadai. Add shredded chicken and sauté till crisp. 9. Add ground mixture, salt and sliced garlic. Sauté for 5-6 minutes. 10. Allow to cool and store in airtight container.

name: Ananas Shakarkand Chaat
instructions: 1. Peel and discard pineapple core. Cut pineapple into 1 cm pieces. 2. Heat oil in pan. Add boiled and peeled sweet potato pieces. Add red chilli powder and salt. Sauté for 3-4 minutes. 3. In a bowl, add pineapple pieces. Add pomegranate pearls, chana jor garam, masala peanuts, yellow chilli powder, chaat masala, roasted cumin powder and black salt. Mix well. 4. Add date and tamarind chutney, sautéed sweet potato and coriander. Mix gently with light hands. 5. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with coriander sprig and serve.

name: Rajgira Pecan Chikki
instructions: 1. Heat pan and roast american pecans for 4-5 minutes on medium heat. Transfer to chopping board and chop roughly. 2. Heat pan and add jaggery. Cook till it reaches hard ball consistency. 3. Grease a small mithai tray with ghee. 4. Add puffed amaranth and american pecans to jaggery and mix well. Add salt and green cardamom powder and mix well. 5. Transfer to greased tray and level evenly with rolling pin. 6. Make markings at equal distances and set aside for 35-40 minutes. 7. Cut into squares and serve.

name: Four Bean Salad
ingredients: 100 gms french beans blanched and cut
instructions: Place kidney beans, soya beans, moong beans and French beans in a bowl and mix well. Roughly chop ginger, grind with little water, pass through muslin cloth and squeeze out juice. Add 1 tsp ginger juice to beans and mix. Add red chilli sauce, mixed fruit jam, salt and vinegar. Mix well. Tear lettuce leaves and add. Mix well and transfer to serving bowl. Serve immediately.

name: MLA Dosa
instructions: Grind moong and rice with little water. Add green chillies, curry leaves and ginger and grind to coarse paste. Transfer to bowl, add water to adjust consistency and salt, mix well. For upma: heat oil in pan. Chop onion roughly. Add mustard seeds, asafoetida, cumin seeds, urad dal, curry leaves and onion to pan and sauté till fragrant. Add semolina and sauté 2 minutes. Heat non-stick tawa, pour ladle of batter to 4-inch diameter dosa. Add 1.5 cups hot water and salt to semolina and mix, let cook till done. Turn over dosa, put some upma on one side, fold other side over. Serve hot.

name: Sabz Haleem
instructions: Slow cook moong dal with fresh vegetables and wholesome grains together to creamy perfection using dum cooking method. Season with spices including garam masala and turmeric. Serve piping hot with squeeze of fresh lime juice and crispy papad on the side.

name: Pepper Garlic Rice
instructions: Heat oil and butter in non-stick pan. Add garlic and sauté 1 minute. Add spring onion bulbs and pinch of salt, mix well. Add red, green and yellow bell peppers and mix well. Cook 1 minute. Add cooked rice, spring onion greens, salt, black pepper powder, vinegar and soy sauce. Cook 1-2 minutes. Serve hot garnished with spring onion greens and burnt garlic.

name: Dum Ka Jhinga
instructions: Marinate prawns with salt, turmeric powder and lemon juice for 5-10 minutes. In another bowl, combine hung yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, green chilli paste, processed cheese, lemon juice, salt, white pepper powder, garam masala, turmeric and mayonnaise. Add marinated prawns and marinate 1 hour. For gravy: heat oil in pan. Add green cardamoms, bay leaf, black cardamom, cloves and black peppercorns and cook till fragrant. Add onion paste and cook till light golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli paste, cook 1-2 minutes. Add saffron, salt, turmeric and garam masala. Add yellow chilli powder and mix. Add 0.5 cup water and cook 2-3 minutes. Thread prawns on skewers. Brush butter in grill pan, place prawn skewers and cook 2-3 minutes on high heat. Flip and cook other side 2-3 minutes, brush butter. Place gravy back on heat. Add cashew nut paste and coconut milk. Add prawns and 0.5 cup water. Place hot charcoal in stainless steel bowl in middle of gravy, sprinkle cloves and drizzle butter. Cover and smoke infuse 1-2 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with coriander sprigs and saffron strands.

name: No Bake Chocolate Fudge Cake
instructions: Heat butter in non-stick pan. Add chocolate, coffee powder and brown sugar and let melt. Grind digestive biscuits to fine powder. Grease aluminium cake tin. Switch off heat and add ground powder along with almonds, walnuts and raisins and mix well. Pour chocolate mixture into cake tin and spread evenly. Refrigerate 1 to 1.5 hours. Remove cake from tin, cut in wedges, arrange on serving plate and serve immediately.

name: Karela and Raw Mango Curry
instructions: 1. Grind green chillies, red chilli, ginger and coconut to a coarse paste. 2. Scrape gourds, halve them, remove seeds and cut into medium pieces. 3. Heat 1 cup water in a pan, add bitter gourd pieces, salt and ¼ tsp turmeric powder and cook for 10-15 minutes. Strain and set aside. 4. Roughly slice onions. 5. Heat strained bitter gourd mixture again with 1 cup water in another pan. 6. Roughly slice raw mangoes and add to the pan, mix well and bring to boil. 7. Add the ground paste and mix well. Add salt and jaggery and mix well. 8. Heat oil in a small pan, add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add onions and sauté for a minute. Add remaining turmeric powder, coriander powder and curry leaves and mix well. 9. Add water from the gourd mixture to the tempering. Add the tempering to the gourd mixture, cover and cook on medium heat for 8-10 minutes. 10. Transfer into a serving bowl and serve hot.

name: Kesari Indrayani
ingredients: ½ cup almonds, blanched and peeled
instructions: 1. Bring milk to a boil in a deep non-stick pan, lower the heat and simmer till the milk reduces to half its original volume. 2. Add the saffron and sugar and cook till the sugar dissolves. Add the khoya to thicken the milk. 3. Squeeze the rosogullas to remove excess syrup and place them in a bowl. Pour the milk mixture over and set aside to cool. When completely cold, place in a refrigerator to chill. 4. To serve, place a few chilled rosogullas in each bowl. Drizzle fresh cream and sprinkle pistachios, almonds and pomegranate kernels on top and serve at once.

name: Fish Biryani
ingredients: a large pinch of saffron soaked in 2 tbsps warm water
2 inch ginger, cut into thin strips
instructions: 1. Transfer Basmati Rice in a bowl. Wash thoroughly 2-3 times. 2. Soak in sufficient water for 30 minutes. Drain the water. 3. Take king fish darnes in a large bowl. Add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and lemon juice and apply the masala well on all sides of each fish darne. Set aside to marinate for 10-15 minutes. 4. Heat oil in a non-stick tawa. Place the fish darnes and cook on high heat for 2-3 minutes on each side. 5. Take them off the heat. 6. To make the biryani, heat ghee in a wide non-stick deep pan. Add green cardamoms, cinnamon stick, cloves, black peppercorns, bay leaf, and cook till fragrant. 7. Add onions, mix and cook till translucent. 8. Add garlic paste and ginger paste and mix well. Cook for 1 minute. 9. Stir in the tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add salt, mix and cook for 2-3 minutes. 10. Add green chillies, mix and cook till the tomatoes turn soft and pulpy. 11. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, agri masala and coriander leaves and mix well. 12. Add ½ cup water, mix, cover and cook till the fat separates. 13. Add 1 cup water, mix and cook till it comes to a boil. 14. Arrange the fish darnes, cover and cook on low heat for 1-2 minutes. Switch the heat off. 15. To cook the rice, heat sufficient water to a boil in a deep pan. Add salt, and ghee and bring the water to a boil. 16. Add the drained rice and cook for 6-8 minutes or till ¾ done. Drain the rice and directly layer over the fish. 17. Drizzle soaked saffron, sprinkle fried onions, ginger strips, coriander leaves and drizzle some ghee. Cover the pan with aluminum foil, cover with a lid and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes. 18. Switch the heat off and allow to rest for 10-15 minutes. 19. Discard the aluminum foil and transfer into a serving plate. Serve hot with onion slices, lemon wedges, mint sprigs and sol kadhi.

name: Masala Mangodi Kadhi
instructions: 1. Put gram flour in a bowl, add yogurt and whisk till smooth. Add bhuna masala and mix well. Add 2 cups water and keep whisking till you get a lump-free mixture. 2. Heat oil in a deep non-stick pan. Add mustard seeds, dried red chillies, curry leaves and mangodi and sauté for 3-4 minutes. 3. Add yogurt-gram flour mixture, mix well and cook, stirring at intervals, till it thickens to desired consistency. 4. Transfer into a serving bowl and serve hot with steamed rice.

name: Moong Dal Puri
ingredients: 1 cup moong dal, soaked and ground
instructions: 1. Soak moong dal and grind to a paste. 2. Mix ground moong dal with all purpose flour, salt, turmeric powder and water to form a stiff dough. 3. Let it rest for 10-15 minutes. 4. Roll small portions into thin circles. 5. Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry the purris till golden brown and puffed. 6. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot.

name: South Indian Style Paneer Pakoda
instructions: 1. Grate fresh paneer in a bowl. 2. Add green chillies, fennel seeds, curry leaves, salt, ginger-garlic paste, refined flour and rice flour and mix well. Divide the mixture into small portions and roll into balls. 3. Heat sufficient oil in a kadai. Drop the balls into oil and deep fry on high heat till golden brown and crisp. 4. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot with green chutney.

name: Chicken Pecan Sandwich
ingredients: lollo rosso lettuce leaves as required
instructions: 1. Heat a pan. Add american pecans and dry roast for 5-6 minutes on medium heat. Transfer on a chopping board and chop. 2. Take boiled chicken in a bowl. Add purple cabbage, mayonnaise, crushed black peppercorns, mustard paste and salt and mix well. 3. Add chopped pecans and mix well. 4. Slit the croissants and line lollo rosso lettuce leaves on lower halves. 5. Place a portion of the chicken-pecan mixture on each half, place another lettuce leaf and cover with remaining halves of the croissants. Skewer red radish slices and cherry tomatoes and serve with potato chips.

name: Chicken Chole
instructions: Heat oil in pressure cooker. Sauté onions until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute. Add chicken mince and sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add turmeric powder, cumin powder and red chilli powder, mix and sauté. Add tomato puree and mix well. Add chickpeas and 1.5 cups chole stock. Add chopped coriander, rock salt, salt, remaining stock and garam masala powder. Cover and pressure cook for one whistle, reduce heat and cook for 10-15 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Handvo
ingredients: split skinless green gram (dhuli moong dal) soaked 1/4 cup
split skinless black gram (dhuli urad dal) soaked 1/4 cup
split bengal gram (chana dal) soaked 1/4 cup
date and tamarind chutney as required
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grind rice with soaked dals and 1.25 cups water to coarse batter. Transfer to bowl and add bottle gourd, carrots, mushrooms, corn, cabbage, zucchini, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-green chilli paste and salt. Mix well and add fruit salt. Transfer to greased and lined baking tray and bake 40-45 minutes. Cool and remove paper. Cut into rectangles. Heat oil on nonstick tawa and cook handvo rectangles 2-3 minutes per side. Pipe saffron mayo, date-tamarind chutney and green chutney on top. Garnish with cherry tomatoes, radish slices, edible flowers and microgreens. Serve.

name: Bisi Bele Bhaath
ingredients: cooked split pigeon peas (toor dal) 1.5 cups
carrot 1 medium cut into 1/2 inch cubes boiled
instructions: Heat ghee in non-stick pan. Add mustard seeds and let splutter. Add curry leaves, dried red chillies, asafoetida, turmeric powder and madras onions. Cook 2-3 minutes. Add red chilli powder and huliyana masala. Mix well. Add tomatoes, cashew nuts and salt. Cook 2-3 minutes. Add cooked toor dal and mix. Cover and cook 3-4 minutes. Remove lid and add 1/2 cup water. Mix and cook 2-3 minutes. Add cooked rice and mix well, mashing rice with spoon. Continue cooking 1-2 minutes. Add tamarind pulp, mix, cover and cook 10 minutes. Add carrot, French beans and capsicum. Mix and cook 1 minute. Transfer to serving bowl. Drizzle ghee and garnish with coriander. Serve hot with papodums and pachadi.

name: Laal Maath Moong Bhajiya
ingredients: split skinless green gram (moong dal) 1 cup
instructions: Wash and soak dal for 2 hours. Heat nonstick pan and dry roast coriander seeds, fennel seeds and cumin seeds for 1 minute. Cool and grind coarsely. Drain dal and transfer to blender and grind coarsely. Transfer to bowl and add red amaranth, salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, 3 tsps crushed seed mixture, green chillies, asafoetida, dried mango powder, onion and coriander. Mix well. Heat sufficient oil in kadai. Dip hands in water and drop small portions of mixture. Deep fry until golden brown and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: Aubergine and Walnut Roll
instructions: Heat oil in nonstick pan. Cut brinjals into long thin slices and sprinkle salt. Place in pan in single layer and cook, turning sides. Put onion, garlic, walnuts and red capsicum in chopper and chop. Transfer to bowl. Cook brinjal slices until lightly browned on both sides. Put coriander, pomegranate pearls, basil leaves, celery and coriander powder and saffron in chopper, chop and add to bowl. Add vinegar and mix everything well. Keep some mixture on one side of each brinjal slice and roll. Arrange rolls on serving plate and put some pomegranate pearls on side. Serve.

name: Masala Cheese Frankie
instructions: Heat oil in shallow nonstick pan. Add cumin seeds and when they change color, add green chillies and sauté for few seconds. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, chaat masala and salt. Mix well. Add boiled potatoes and coriander and mix well. Heat nonstick tawa and place rotis. Cook 30 seconds, flip and drizzle oil and cook other side 30 seconds more. Transfer to work top and spread schezwan chutney on top. Top with portion of potato mixture and spread lightly. Grate processed cheese and sprinkle chaat masala. Roll tightly. Serve.

name: Stuffed Chole Kulche
ingredients: 2 tbsps nutralite doodhshakti probiotic butter spread
instructions: Heat a pan, add butter spread and onion and sauté till light golden. Halve the kulchas and slit in the centre to make pockets. Add tomato to the pan and cook on medium heat for a minute. Add chole masala, cooked chickpeas and cooking liquid and mix well. Add salt and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add green chilli and cook for 2-3 minutes. Apply Tandoori Mayo in kulcha pockets, stuff prepared chole and sprinkle coriander on top. Serve.

name: Matcha Tikki Chaat
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, boiled, peeled and mashed
a pinch of yellow chilli powder
0.5 cup cooked and ground split skinless green gram (dhuli moong dal)
instructions: Take potatoes in a bowl, add salt, black salt, cornflour, garam masala, yellow chilli powder, and chaat masala and mix well. Take dhuli moong dal in a bowl, add remaining chaat masala, asafoetida, salt, and green chilli and mix well. Divide potato mixture into portions and roll into balls, make dent in centre and stuff dal filling, gather edges and seal. Heat ghee in shallow nonstick pan, place tikkis and shallow fry on both sides till golden and crisp. Take 0.5 cup yogurt in bowl, add salt and matcha paste and mix well. Spread yogurt mixture on serving plate, place tikki, drizzle remaining yogurt and chutney on top. Sprinkle cumin powder and chilli powder. Sprinkle matcha powder on top, garnish with coriander and serve chilled.

name: Laban
instructions: Put yogurt in a blender jar. Add mint leaves, salt and ice cubes and blend to a fine mixture. Add a few mint leaves and a few ice cubes in serving glass and pour the prepared mixture over it. Serve chilled.

name: Mediterranean Bowl
instructions: Take couscous in a bowl, add onion, dried mixed herbs, crushed black peppercorns, cumin powder, 1 tbsp lemon juice and salt and mix well. Take chickpeas in another bowl, add smoked paprika, crushed black peppercorns, Nutralite Cheesy Garlic Mayo, remaining lemon juice and mix well. Slice tofu. Take serving bowl, add baby spinach leaves and chickpeas. Arrange cucumber slices on the side, add couscous mixture on top. Place snow peas on one side and sliced tofu on the other. Place cherry tomatoes on one side and arrange radish slices on top. Sprinkle black sesame seeds on tofu and drizzle some more mayo. Garnish with micro greens and serve immediately.

name: Malai Pyaaz Ki Sabzi
instructions: Heat oil, add cumin seeds and onion seeds, then garlic, ginger, and green chillies; sauté onions with salt; add spice powders and cook; mix in malai and garam masala; finish with fenugreek and coriander leaves; serve hot with paranthe.

name: Moong Dal Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken strips with ginger-garlic paste and spices for 10-15 minutes; crush fried moong dal; coat chicken with flour, dip in beaten eggs with spices, then coat with crushed dal; deep fry until golden brown and crisp; drain on paper and serve with green chutney.

name: Palak Paneer Toast
instructions: Heat olive oil, sauté garlic and red chilli flakes, add spinach with salt and cook 2-3 minutes; add paneer cubes and cook 2-3 more minutes; make garlic-herb butter, spread on toasted bread; toast 4-5 minutes; top with spinach-paneer mixture, sprinkle cheese, bake 4-5 minutes until cheese melts; cut into triangles and serve with ketchup.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Breadsticks
instructions: Preheat oven at 200°C; grate mozzarella cheese, mix with cauliflower, garlic, herbs, salt, and peppercorns; add eggs and mix well; transfer to silicon baking tray; bake 10-15 minutes; demould, cut into strips, and serve.

name: Chocolate Barfi and Truffles
ingredients: nutralite doodhshakti probiotic butter spread for greasing
crushed dried rose petals for coating
instructions: Heat pan and cook khoya for 2-3 minutes. Add almond flour and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add choco spread and mix well, cook for 4-5 minutes. Grease burfi tray and transfer half mixture, sprinkle almonds, garnish with varq, cool completely and refrigerate for 1-2 hours. Cut barfi into squares. Shape remaining mixture into balls and coat with pistachio powder, rose petals, almond powder, or cocoa powder.

name: Cheesy Waffle Sandwich
ingredients: 3-4 medium potatoes boiled with turmeric powder
instructions: Mix refined flour with crushed peppercorns, salt, and baking soda. Make well in centre, add eggs and buttermilk, whisk and set for 5-10 minutes. Preheat waffle maker. Grate cheese. Grease waffle machine and cook batter for 5-10 minutes. Combine boiled potatoes with spring onion bulbs, greens, salt, chilli flakes, herbs, and peppercorns. Sprinkle cheese on waffle, add potato mixture, drizzle oil, cook 1 minute more. Cut into 4 parts and serve with ketchup.

name: Mixed Sprouts Curry
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add ginger and garlic, sauté until fragrant. Add onions and cook until translucent. Add tomatoes and cook until soft. Add mixed sprouts, turmeric, salt, and green chillies. Cover and cook until sprouts are tender, about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.

name: Tortilla Pizza Pinwheels
ingredients: 2 tbsps nutralite doodhshakti probiotic butter spread
0.5 cup boiled and crushed sweet corn kernels
nutralite cheesy garlic mayo as required
instructions: Heat butter spread in nonstick pan. Sauté onion until translucent. Add corn and red and yellow capsicum, sauté for 2 minutes. Heat grill pan and roast tortillas until warm. Add pizza sauce to vegetable mixture with herbs and chillies, mix and cook 1 minute. Place tortilla on worktop and spread cheesy garlic mayo evenly. Spread cooked vegetable mixture evenly, roll tightly, slice and serve.

name: Mozzarella Stuffed Meatballs
instructions: For sauce: Heat oil and butter, add onion and salt, cook until translucent. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and cook until soft and pulpy. Add tomato puree, chilli flakes, oregano, and sugar, cook 1 minute. Add water and cook 3-4 minutes until thickened. For meatballs: Mix chicken mince with breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, oregano, parsley, and salt. Stuff mozzarella cubes into portions and roll into balls. Heat oil and cook meatballs until golden brown. Add meatballs to sauce and cook 1 minute. Serve hot garnished with mozzarella and parsley.

name: Moong Dal Idli with Chutney
ingredients: 0.5 cup split skinless green gram (moong dal) soaked and drained
0.5 cup split skinless black gram (urad dal) soaked and drained
instructions: Blend soaked moong dal, urad dal, ginger, and water to fine paste. Transfer to bowl, add turmeric and salt, mix and ferment for 6-8 hours. Heat water in steamer and grease small stainless steel bowls with oil. Pour ladleful of batter into each bowl, sprinkle carrot, sprouted moong, and cashew nuts. Steam for 12-15 minutes. For chutney: blend coconut, salt, coriander with water to coarse paste, add yogurt and mix. Remove idlis from steamer, cool slightly, de-mould and serve with chutney.

name: Banana Leaf Seafood Kabab
ingredients: 2 boneless fish fillets cut into big pieces
3-4 dried red chillies soaked and drained
2 tbsps oil for brushing and cooking
instructions: Slice ginger and put in mixer. Add coriander roots, dried red chillies, garlic, lemon juice, fish, onion, and peanut butter, grind to smooth paste. Transfer to bowl, add salt and prawns and mix. Brush banana leaf pieces with oil. Dampen palms with water, divide fish mixture into 8 equal portions, shape into balls and flatten into tikkis. Place one tikki on each banana leaf piece and fold leaf to make packets. Heat oil in nonstick pan, place fish packets and cook until fish and prawns are fully cooked. Arrange kababs on serving plate and serve immediately.

name: Steamed Fish
instructions: 1. Transfer garlic, ginger, green chillies, salt and lemon pepper pieces in a mortar and crush coarsely. 2. Add dried bamboo shoots and torn bankoban leaves, continue crushing. 3. Sprinkle salt on fish, drizzle mustard oil and mix well. Apply crushed mixture on both sides of fish. 4. Heat water in steamer. 5. Wrap fish pieces in banana leaves and arrange in steamer basket, steam 15-20 minutes. 6. Serve hot.

name: Quick Chicken Shorba
instructions: 1. Give slits on chicken pieces. 2. Heat oil in pressure cooker, sear chicken 2-3 minutes on high heat. 3. Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, chillies, onion, coriander stems, bay leaves and peppercorns, mix well. 4. Sear 4-5 minutes on high heat. 5. Add gram flour, sauté 2-3 minutes. 6. Add 3.5 cups water and salt, cover and cook on medium heat until pressure releases 3 times. 7. Open lid, remove chicken and bay leaves, shred chicken. 8. Strain liquid back to pan. 9. Add crushed peppercorns, milk and coriander leaves, allow to boil. 10. Add shredded chicken to bowls, pour shorba over. 11. Sprinkle peppercorns and serve hot with lemon.

name: Paneer ke Tinke
ingredients: green capsicum 1 medium seeded 1 inch pieces
red capsicum 1 medium seeded 1 inch pieces
instructions: 1. Mix hung yogurt, gram flour, salt, turmeric, garam masala, peppercorns, cumin, saffron, kasuri methi, lemon juice and 1 tbsp chutney in bowl. 2. Add onion and capsicum pieces, mix well, marinate 10-15 minutes. 3. Apply marinade to paneer pieces on all sides. 4. Thread on satay sticks in order: onion, paneer, green capsicum, red capsicum, onion, paneer, red capsicum, green capsicum. Repeat for remaining sticks. 5. Heat griller or non-stick pan, brush with oil, place satay sticks and cook turning several times until cooked equally on all sides. 6. Serve hot with mint and coriander chutney.

name: Blueberry Chia Pudding
instructions: 1. Transfer blueberries to blender jar. Add oats and almond milk, blend until smooth. 2. Transfer to bowl. Add chia seeds and sugar free green, mix well. Refrigerate 3-4 hours. 3. Heat non-stick pan. Add flax seeds, pumpkin seeds and melon seeds, toast lightly. 4. To serve, transfer pudding to bowl, top with strawberries, blueberries and dragon fruit. Sprinkle toasted seeds. 5. Garnish with mint sprigs and serve immediately.

name: Roasted Pumpkin and Moong Hummus
instructions: 1. Roast pumpkin pieces until tender. 2. Cook moong dal until soft. 3. Blend roasted pumpkin with cooked moong dal. 4. Add olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and cumin powder. Blend until smooth. 5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. 6. Serve with vegetable sticks or pita bread.

name: Pistachio Ice Cream with Kunafa
ingredients: sugar free natura diet sugar 15 measures
instructions: 1. Add cornstarch to coconut milk and whisk well. 2. Heat non-stick pan, add coconut milk mixture and cook on low heat until thickened. 3. Transfer pistachios to blender, peel and add banana, blend coarsely. 4. Add sugar free diet sugar to coconut milk mixture and mix well. Allow to cool. 5. Add pistachio mixture to coconut milk mixture, mix well. 6. Pour into airtight container, sprinkle pistachio slivers and freeze 8-10 hours. 7. Scoop and transfer to ice cream cups, top with toasted kunafa. 8. Sprinkle pistachios and rose petals, serve chilled.

name: Mango Brown Rice Pudding
instructions: 1. Cook brown rice until tender, let cool slightly. 2. Blend ripe mango until smooth puree. 3. Combine cooked rice with mango puree and milk. 4. Add condensed milk, cardamom powder and sugar. Mix well. 5. Cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally. 6. Transfer to serving bowls. 7. Garnish with mango pieces and chopped pistachios. 8. Serve warm or chilled.

name: pahadi jholi
instructions: Mix buttermilk with gram flour and spices. Heat mustard oil, add whole spices and sauté briefly. Add ginger, garlic, and green chillies. Add onion and cook until golden. Pour buttermilk mixture, bring to boil, add coriander leaves, lower heat and simmer for 6-8 minutes. Serve with steamed rice.

name: bora
instructions: Wash and chop onion chives. Slice potato thickly. Mix gram flour with rice flour and spices. Add water and baking soda to form batter. Heat oil and dip potato slices in batter, deep fry until golden. Fry cauliflower florets and onion chives similarly. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot with tomato chutney.

name: stuffed mushrooms
instructions: Heat oil, sauté onion and garlic until fragrant. Add green chillies and pepper. Cool mixture and mix with cream cheese. Prepare slurry with flour and water. Stuff mushroom caps with cheese mixture. Dip in slurry and coat with breadcrumbs. Heat oil and deep fry until golden and crisp. Drain and serve hot with salad.

name: pecan chutney
instructions: Heat nonstick pan and roast pecans on medium heat for 6-8 minutes. Transfer to mortar and crush coarsely. Add garlic cloves, red chilli powder, and salt, continuing to crush. Add oil and mix well. Serve as a dip or condiment.

name: paneer tomato rice
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes. Heat ghee with peppercorns and bay leaf. Sauté onion until translucent. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies. Add capsicums and cook briefly. Add tomatoes and spices, cook for 1-2 minutes. Add paneer cubes, mix and cook. Fold in cooked rice gently and adjust seasoning. Transfer to serving bowl and garnish with coriander.

name: protein rich adai
instructions: Soak lentils and rice for 2 hours. Transfer to grinder with onion, ginger, curry leaves, chillies, whole spices, and asafoetida. Add water and grind to fine mixture. Transfer to bowl and adjust salt. Heat nonstick tawa. Spread ladleful of batter and cook for 2 minutes. Apply buttery spread and cook until underside is golden. Serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: corn and sprouts sandwich
instructions: Heat butter and oil, sauté green chillies briefly. Add green capsicum and cook. Add crushed corn and boiled sprouts, mix and cook for 1 minute. Cool mixture and mix with green chutney, cheese, and salt. Apply butter on bread slices. Spread mixture on 4 slices and cover with remaining slices. Apply butter on top. Grill until golden for 3-4 minutes. Cut diagonally and serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: Oat Milk Rice Pudding
ingredients: 10 measures sugar free natura diet sugar
instructions: Heat a nonstick pan. Add rice, oat milk and cook over low heat for a minute. Add vanilla extract and cook for 8-10 minutes until rice is cooked and milk thickens. Add sugar free diet sugar and rose petals and mix well. Transfer to individual bowls, garnish with rose petals and pistachios, refrigerate for 2-3 hours and serve chilled.

name: Gavale
instructions: Take semolina in a bowl. Add salt and warm milk and mix well. Knead to soft dough. Cover with moist muslin cloth and set aside for 10-15 minutes. Divide into equal portions and roll thinly. Shape into small grain-like portions. Air dry for 1 day. Store in airtight container.

name: Kaskol Cutlet
instructions: Make a dough from raw banana and potatoes. Shape into cutlets. Shallow fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Pecan Nut Pie
instructions: Mix flour and powdered sugar. Add salt and chilled butter, mix till breadcrumbs form. Add water and knead to stiff dough. Refrigerate 1-2 hours. Roll and line pie dish, blind bake with chickpeas at 180C for 10-15 minutes. Chop pecans. Whisk eggs with brown sugar, corn syrup, vanilla, glucose and melted butter. Add pecans to base, pour egg mixture, top with pecans. Bake 25-30 minutes. Cool and serve with whipped cream.

name: Tiramisu Cups
instructions: Cut cake into roundels with cookie cutter. Place one roundel in each cup and drizzle with coffee decoction. Mix cream cheese with nutralite choco spread. Fold in whipped cream. Pipe layer on cake, add another cake layer, drizzle coffee decoction, pipe remaining cream mixture on top. Sprinkle cocoa powder and garnish with coffee beans and chocolate triangles.

name: Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Cut garlic head and place on aluminum foil. Sprinkle salt, crushed peppercorns and dried herbs. Drizzle olive oil and seal foil. Preheat air fryer to 180C for 2-3 minutes. Air fry garlic for 20 minutes. Cool and squeeze out pulp, mix with butter. Apply mixture on loaf slices, sprinkle mozzarella cheese. Air fry for 3 minutes and serve hot.

name: Elaneer Payasam
instructions: 1. Cut tender coconut and heat its water in a non-stick pan. 2. Scoop out and chop the coconut flesh. 3. Add half the flesh to the coconut water and cook for 2-3 minutes on medium heat. 4. Add sugar-free sweetener and cook for 4-5 minutes. 5. Add green cardamom powder, raisins, and cashew nuts. 6. Add coconut milk and stir on low heat. 7. Add remaining coconut flesh and cook for 2-3 minutes. 8. Transfer to coconut shell and serve warm.

name: Pomelo and Pecan Salad
instructions: 1. Peel and cut pomelo into segments, halving each segment. 2. Halve and deseed avocado, scoop out flesh and slice. 3. Put arugula leaves in a bowl. Add iceberg lettuce, lollo rosso leaves, pomelo halves, sliced avocado, lemon juice, maple syrup, olive oil, salt, and peppercorns. 4. Roughly crush pecan nuts and add to mixture. 5. Mix well and serve immediately.

name: Tandoori Fish Kebabs
instructions: 1. Heat mustard oil in non-stick pan until smoking point. 2. Mix hung yogurt, chilli paste, salt, ginger paste, garlic paste, turmeric, and fenugreek powder. 3. Marinate fish fillets with salt and lemon juice. 4. Add gram flour to mustard oil, sauté for a minute, add to yogurt mixture. 5. Cut marinated fish into 2-inch cubes, add to yogurt mixture with garam masala and onion seeds. Marinate for 30 minutes. 6. Preheat air fryer to 190°C. 7. Arrange marinated fish in basket, sprinkle onion seeds, air fry for 8 minutes. 8. Baste with butter, reduce temperature to 180°C, air fry for 5-6 minutes. 9. Garnish with onion rings, mint sprig. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Cherry Compote
instructions: 1. Deseed and roughly chop the cherries. 2. Heat a pan and add chopped cherries, castor sugar, and salt. Cook on medium heat for 10-15 minutes until cherries soften. 3. Squeeze lemon juice and mix well. 4. Allow to cool completely. 5. Store in airtight container or serve on cream cheese toast.

name: Kardoi
ingredients: oil to drizzle and for deep frying
instructions: 1. Mix onion, carrot, carom seeds, cumin seeds, coriander, and salt in a bowl. 2. Add whole wheat flour, melted ghee, and 1/4 cup water. Knead into stiff dough. Cover and set aside 10-15 minutes. 3. Heat sufficient oil in kadai on low heat. 4. Divide dough into small equal portions. 5. Take a portion, drizzle oil, roll into thin roundel. Make lengthwise cuts at equal distance in the middle, leaving edges intact. Apply water on edges. Pleat the cuts one over the other and bring ends together, pressing to secure. Lightly twist. 6. Deep fry a few pieces at a time until golden and crisp. Drain on paper. 7. Serve or store in airtight container.

name: Italian Pasta Bake
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 180°C. 2. Heat olive oil in non-stick pan, add garlic, sauté for a minute. Add onion and salt, cook until translucent. 3. Add tomato puree, tomato concasse, salt, peppercorns, and chilli flakes. Mix and cook for 2-3 minutes. 4. Add pasta and cook for 1-2 minutes. Add black olive slices and tear basil leaves into pan and mix. 5. Grate mozzarella cheese. 6. Transfer pasta to cast iron baking dish, sprinkle grated mozzarella on top and spread evenly. 7. Bake until cheese melts.

name: Yellow Moong Pesarattu
ingredients: split skinless green gram (dhuli moong dal)
instructions: Soak split green gram and rice for 3-4 hours. Blend with chillies, ginger, cumin seeds and salt to form fine paste. Heat non-stick tawa with oil, pour batter and spread in circular motion. Sprinkle gunpowder, onion and coriander. Drizzle oil and cook until golden brown underside. Flip gently and cook 1-2 minutes. Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Uttappam Pizza
instructions: Mix salt into batter. Heat non-stick pan with oil. Pour small ladleful of batter and spread lightly to make small uttappams. Cover and cook on low heat 2-3 minutes. Flip and cook 1-2 minutes. Apply pizza sauce and toppings including basil, tomatoes, jalapenos, olives. Sprinkle oregano, chilli flakes and cheese. Cover and cook until cheese melts. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: Almond Cookie Sticks
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Beat butter with sugar until fluffy. Sift almond flour, cornflour and salt into mixture. Add chopped chocolate and mix lightly with hands. Place dough between butter paper and roll into thick rectangle. Cut into sticks. Arrange on baking tray and bake 10-12 minutes. Cool completely. Dip in dark chocolate and sprinkle sliced almonds. Set until chocolate firms.

name: BBQ Grilled Paneer Burger
instructions: Slice paneer vertically. Apply barbecue sauce and coat with bread crumbs. Heat oil in grill pan and grill paneer on all sides until golden and charred. Heat butter in same pan and grill burger buns for 1 minute. Apply mayo on bun base, layer with lettuce, grilled paneer with BBQ sauce, mustard sauce, onion and tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper. Top with mayo on upper bun. Serve immediately.

name: Moong and Chana Crostini
ingredients: split skinless green gram (dhuli moong dal)
instructions: Drain soaked moong and chana dal. Cook in pan with water, salt and peppercorns, removing scum as it rises. Toast bread slices on both sides until evenly golden. Chop spring onion and garlic. Chop cooked grams with little water. Mix gram mixture with spring onion, garlic, olive oil, salt and lemon juice. Drizzle olive oil on each toast. Top with gram mixture and garnish with red capsicum strips. Serve.

name: Broccoli Cheese Parantha
instructions: Prepare parantha dough with flour, salt and water. Blanch broccoli and chop finely. Mix broccoli with melted cheese, spices and aromatic ingredients. Divide dough into portions and roll out. Place broccoli-cheese filling on one half, fold and roll out carefully. Cook on griddle with butter/oil, flipping until golden and crisp on both sides with gooey cheesy center. Serve hot.

name: Fruit Trifle
instructions: Separate 2 egg yolks and add with remaining whole egg. Whisk in cornstarch and flour. Add sugar and cream, mix well. Cook on low heat 2-3 minutes stirring continuously. Strain through sieve, add vanilla essence and refrigerate 1 hour. Cut cake into small pieces. Chop and slice fresh fruits. Layer sponge pieces in glasses, drizzle sugar syrup. Pour custard on top, add chopped fruits and jelly pieces. Pipe whipped cream on top and garnish with kiwi slices and blueberries. Serve chilled.

name: Potato Croquettes
ingredients: 2-3 medium potatoes boiled peeled and mashed
instructions: Grate cheddar cheese, add crushed black peppercorns. Pluck oregano and thyme leaves, chop and add to cheese, mix well. Divide cheese mixture into small equal portions and shape into balls. Take potatoes in bowl, add salt and crushed black peppercorns, mix well. Take a portion of potato mixture, shape into ball, flatten, make cavity in centre, stuff with cheese ball, bring edges to centre and press to seal. Break egg in bowl and whisk. Dust worktop with refined flour and roll each potato portion into cylinder shape. Dust worktop with bread crumbs. Dip each croquette in egg and roll over bread crumbs until well coated. Roll and press edges to maintain cylinder shape. Heat sufficient oil in kadai, slide in croquettes and deep fry until golden brown and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot.

name: Chowmein Paneer Roll
ingredients: 1/2 medium red capsicum seeded and sliced
1/2 medium yellow capsicum seeded and sliced
1/2 medium green capsicum seeded and sliced
instructions: Heat oil in non-stick wok. Add ginger, garlic and green chillies and sauté until garlic turns golden brown. Add onion and sauté until translucent. Add red capsicum, yellow capsicum and green capsicum and mix well. Sauté on high heat for 1 minute. Add tomato ketchup, soy sauce, green chilli sauce, salt, crushed black peppercorns and cook for 1 minute. Add paneer cubes, boiled noodles and spring onion greens and mix well. Switch off heat and add vinegar and mix well. Heat rotis on non-stick tawa. Place stuffing on one side of roti and roll tightly. Serve hot.

name: Quick Tiramisu
instructions: Transfer cream cheese in bowl. Add condensed milk and beat until mixture is light and fluffy. Add whipped cream and mix with light hands. Cut cake slices into small pieces and transfer to individual serving bowls. Pour espresso decoction on top. Pipe out cheese mixture on top. Dust some cocoa powder on top, garnish with coffee beans and serve chilled.

name: Power Packed Dal
ingredients: 1/4 cup split green gram with skin
100 grams red pumpkin peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Take split Bengal gram in bowl. Add pigeon peas, red lentils, split green gram with skin and broken wheat. Wash thoroughly. Add fresh water and soak 30-40 minutes. Drain water and add soaked dals to deep pan. Add red pumpkin, carrot, cabbage, dried red chillies, salt, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 4 cups water and 1 tbsp ghee. Mix and allow to boil. Remove scum and cook on medium heat 25-30 minutes. Mash dal with mathni. For tempering: heat remaining ghee in pan. Add cumin seeds and once they start to change colour, add asafoetida, green chillies and curry leaves and sauté for a few seconds. Add onion and sauté until translucent. Add tomato, salt and sauté 2-3 minutes. Add remaining turmeric powder, red chilli powder and mix well. Add coriander and mix well. Transfer in serving bowl, garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: Instant Pyaaz ka Achaar
instructions: Slice onions. Halve green chillies horizontally and cut into big pieces. Transfer onions and green chillies in bowl. Add Kashmiri red chilli powder, fennel powder and salt and mix well. Heat mustard oil in small non-stick pan. Once it starts to smoke, add mustard seeds. Once mustard seeds begin to splutter, add asafoetida and mix well. Add this tempering to onion mixture and mix well. Add lemon juice and mix well. Serve instant achaar with dal and rice.

name: Moong Ussal Pav
instructions: Heat oil in non-stick kadai. Add mustard seeds and once they start to splutter, add asafoetida and curry leaves and mix well. Add onion and sauté until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes. Add sprouted green gram, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, goda masala and mix well. Add 3 cups water and mix well. Add salt, cover and cook 10-15 minutes. Add coriander and mix well. Transfer in serving bowl. Sprinkle farsan and onions on top. Garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with lemon wedge and pav.

name: Gavlyanchi Kheer
instructions: Roast vermicelli in ghee until lightly brown. Add milk and cook until thick. Sweeten with jaggery or sugar. Add ground cardamom. Top with dry fruits.

name: Mushroom and Pecan Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil and sauté garlic, onion, and celery until translucent. Add mushrooms and pecans with salt and pepper. Add water and thyme, cover and cook 10-12 minutes. Blend until smooth. Add milk and simmer for 1-2 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Shakarkand Puri
instructions: Mash boiled sweet potatoes and mix with flour, salt, and ghee. Knead into soft dough. Rest briefly. Roll into thin discs. Heat oil and deep fry until golden and puffed. Serve hot.

name: Marble Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C. Cream butter and sugar until light. Add eggs one by one. Mix in vanilla. Fold in sifted flour and baking powder. Add milk. Divide batter, add cocoa to one portion. Alternate batches in greased tin and marble with a stick. Bake 50-55 minutes.

name: Mac and Cheese Pops
instructions: Make sauce: heat butter, add flour, cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk whisking continuously until thick. Add grated cheese and mix until melted. Add macaroni and salt. Cool in refrigerator 30 minutes. Mix in parsley. Shape into balls, roll in seasoned bread crumbs. Deep fry until golden and crisp. Drain and serve.

name: Schnecken
ingredients: butter 115 grams plus 170 grams for topping
castor sugar 63 grams plus 200 grams for filling
instructions: Heat butter with milk and sugar. Cool slightly and add yeast. Add beaten eggs. Mix in flour and knead to soft dough. Proof 20 minutes. For topping: heat butter with brown sugar and corn syrup. Add pecans. Roll dough out, sprinkle cinnamon-sugar filling, roll into log and cut into rounds. Arrange over topping. Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes.

name: Moong Cheela
ingredients: 1 cup split green gram skinless soaked
instructions: Soak split green gram for 1-2 hours, drain. Grind dal with cumin seeds, green chillies, and water into fine paste. Transfer to bowl, add asafoetida and salt. Mix cottage cheese with onion, tomato, coriander, salt and red chilli powder. Heat non-stick tawa with oil, pour ladle of batter and spread into disc. Drizzle oil, cook 1-2 minutes each side. Flip again, place cottage cheese mixture on one side, fold other side over. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Moong Beans
ingredients: 1.5 cups split skinless green gram soaked
instructions: Heat oil in pan, add mustard and cumin seeds and let splutter. Slice onion, add to pan and sauté until translucent. Add soaked green gram, mix well. Cover and cook 3-5 minutes. Add turmeric powder, salt, and 2 tbsp water. Mix well, cover and cook 2-3 minutes. Add French beans and ginger pieces, cover and cook 1 minute. Roughly chop green chillies, add to pan with 2-3 tbsp water. Cover and cook on low heat until dal and beans are done. Uncover, add lemon juice and garam masala. Garnish with ginger strips and coriander. Serve hot.

name: Paneer Fingers
instructions: Take paneer in bowl, add salt, half red chilli powder, half dried mango powder and mix. In another bowl mix gram flour, cornflour, salt, remaining red chilli powder, remaining mango powder, carom seeds and 0.5 cup water to make batter. Dip paneer fingers in batter and roll in breadcrumbs. Heat oil in kadai, deep fry fingers until golden brown and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper, sprinkle chaat masala and coriander. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: Lagan Ka Keema
instructions: Dry roast poppy seeds, chironji and dried coconut until lightly browned, cool and grind with water into paste. Dry roast cloves, cinnamon, cardamoms until lightly colored, cool and grind to powder. Grind fried onions with yogurt into paste. Heat ghee, add caraway seeds and stir. Add garlic and ginger paste, cover and cook 1 minute. Add mutton and sauté on high heat, add salt, cover and cook 5 minutes. Add coriander, cumin and red chilli powder, mix and cover. Add fried onion paste and mix well. Add poppy seed paste with water, cover and cook. Add coriander and mint leaves, mix and cover. Add lemon juice and stir. Add spice powder and mix. Keep red hot coal pieces in bowl in center of keema, drizzle oil and cover 30 seconds. Remove bowl and stir. Add saffron milk and mix, cover and cook until done. Serve hot.

name: Bhuni Baingan Khichdi
instructions: Preheat oven at 200 degrees C. Soak moong dal in water for 1-2 hours. Trim brinjal top and cut into 0.5 inch cubes. Slice onions and transfer to baking tray. Add garlic, ginger, curry leaves, green chillies, lemon juice, red chilli powder, salt and drizzle mustard oil. Sprinkle kasuri methi and mix well. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Add rice and soaked moong dal to pressure cooker with salt, turmeric powder and 1 tbsp ghee. Add 6-7 cups water and cook until 3-4 whistles. Allow pressure to release completely. Add 3/4 of roasted brinjal-onion mixture to cooker with remaining ghee and mix. Transfer to plate, drizzle ghee on top and garnish with remaining brinjal-onion mixture and coriander. Serve hot.

name: Keema Korma
instructions: Mix mutton mince and yogurt in bowl, add salt, mix well and marinate in refrigerator for 4-6 hours. Heat oil in pan. Slice ginger and put in mixer with garlic, green chilli and boiled onions, grind to smooth paste. Add cardamoms, cloves, mace and ground paste to pan, mix well and sauté until fragrant. Add coriander powder and mix. Add marinated mutton with 0.25 cup water and mix well. Cover and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes. Add cashewnut paste and mix. Add saffron, white pepper powder and cardamom powder and mix. Cover and cook until mutton is done. Add rose water and fresh cream, mix well. Cook for 1 minute. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with saffron strands and serve hot.

name: Chicken Stew with Cabbage
ingredients: 300 grams chicken cut into 2 inch pieces on bone
instructions: Heat olive oil in deep non-stick pan. Add bay leaf, onion and salt, sauté 30 seconds until soft and translucent. Add chicken and sauté on high heat for 2 minutes until golden brown. Add garlic and whole wheat flour, sauté 1-2 minutes until raw smell goes away. Add carrot, cabbage and potatoes, sauté 30 seconds. Add chicken stock and mix well, adjust salt. Add French beans and mix. Cover and cook 20-25 minutes until chicken is completely cooked. Reduce heat to low, add fresh cream and mix well. Cook 1 minute. Add crushed black peppercorns and mix. Serve hot garnished with coriander sprig.

name: Farali Batata Vada
instructions: Heat ghee in non-stick kadai. Add cumin seeds and let splutter. Add green chillies and ginger, sauté 30 seconds. Add potatoes, rock salt and coriander leaves, mix well. Cook on medium heat 2-3 minutes. Switch off heat and add lemon juice, mix well. To make batter, take amaranth flour in bowl. Add ginger-green chilli paste, rock salt and 0.75 cup water, whisk well to form smooth batter. Add sago flour and 0.5 cup water, whisk well. Heat sufficient peanut oil in kadai. Divide potato mixture into equal portions and roll into balls. Dip balls in prepared batter and slide in hot oil. Deep fry until crisp. Drain on absorbent paper. Transfer to serving plate and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Crabstick and Drumstick Curry
ingredients: 4 drumsticks scraped and cut into pieces
instructions: 1. Heat water in a deep nonstick pan, add drumsticks, salt and 0.25 tsp turmeric powder, cook till soft. 2. Heat oil in another nonstick pan, slice onions. 3. Add mustard seeds to oil and let splutter. 4. Slit green chillies. 5. Add curry leaves and saute for 0.5 minute, add onions and saute till soft. 6. Put 4 tbsps coconut in grinder jar with 3-4 tbsps water and grind into smooth paste. 7. Add 0.25 cup water to onions and cook for 2 minutes, add crabsticks, coconut paste and salt, mix well. 8. Add green chillies, mix and cook for 3-4 minutes. 9. Add cooked drumsticks with liquid, kokum petals and remaining turmeric powder, mix. 10. Add remaining coconut and cook for 2 minutes. 11. Serve hot.

name: Malai Paneer Tikka
ingredients: 1 cup mixed colored bell peppers 1 inch squares
instructions: 1. Mix cream cheese, ginger-garlic-green chilli paste, roasted gram flour together. Add lemon juice and whisk till smooth mixture forms. Add salt and green cardamom powder, mix well. 2. Add mixed colored peppers and paneer, gently mix till well coated with marinade. 3. Skewer paneer pieces and pepper squares onto soaked satay sticks. 4. Heat oil in a nonstick tawa. 5. Place paneer-pepper skewer on hot tawa, cook on high heat till all sides turn golden brown, turning occasionally. 6. Serve hot with green chutney and salad.

name: Choco Spread Crepes
ingredients: nutralite choco spread crunchy as required
instructions: 1. Take refined flour in a bowl, add powdered sugar and mix well. 2. Melt Nutralite butter spread and add to the bowl. 3. Add buttermilk and mix well, add vanilla essence and mix. 4. Heat a nonstick pan, add Nutralite butter spread and once melted, add a ladleful of batter and cook on medium heat for a few minutes. 5. Add more butter along the sides while crepes are cooking. 6. Peel and slice bananas. 7. Transfer prepared crepes on plate one by one, spread Nutralite Choco Spread and place bananas in one corner, fold twice. 8. Serve on a bed of fresh raspberries and blueberries.

name: Raw Banana and Sweet Potato Pav Bhaji
ingredients: 2 medium raw bananas boiled peeled and grated
2 medium sweet potatoes boiled peeled and mashed
1 medium green capsicum seeded and finely chopped
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a nonstick pan, add cumin seeds and saute till seeds change color. 2. Add ginger and saute well, add tomatoes, mix and cook for 2-3 minutes. 3. Add Tata Sampann Pav Bhaji Masala, mix and saute for a minute. 4. Add tomato puree and mix well, add raw bananas, sweet potatoes, salt and mix. 5. Add 2.5 cups water, stir, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes. 6. Add capsicum, 2 tbsps butter, lemon juice and mix. 7. Add coriander leaves and mix well. 8. Transfer to serving bowl, top with dollop of butter, garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with pav.

name: Three Cheese Macaroni
instructions: Heat milk in pan, add cream cheese and mix well. Add fried garlic, salt, and pepper. Add cheddar cheese and herbs. Stir in boiled macaroni and half the mozzarella. Add remaining milk and cook for a minute. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella, cover and cook 2-3 minutes. Garnish with fried garlic and serve hot.

name: Tropical Smoothie
instructions: Blend fresh tropical fruits including mango, pineapple, and banana with milk or yogurt and honey. Add ice cubes and blend until smooth and creamy. Pour into a glass and serve immediately for a refreshing tropical escape.

name: Aam Aur Karele Ka Aachar
instructions: Cut raw mango and bitter gourd into pieces. Heat mustard oil and add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds for tempering. Add red chilies, turmeric, and asafoetida. Add the mango and bitter gourd pieces and salt. Mix well and preserve in sterilized glass jars for several days before consuming.

name: Murtabak
instructions: Knead flour with water and salt to make dough. For filling, cook minced meat with sautéed onions, garlic, ginger, and spices. Roll dough thin, place filling on one half, fold and seal edges. Shallow fry or cook on a griddle until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Apple Pineapple Jam with Pistachios
instructions: Heat pineapple puree in a deep pan, add apple puree, mix, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes. In another pan, heat ghee, add pistachios and toss, add half the sugar and cook for 5-6 minutes. Add remaining sugar to fruit mixture with cinnamon powder. Cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes until jam sets. Transfer to sterilized glass bottles with pistachio pieces alternately.

name: Vendakkaya Puli Kuzhambu
instructions: Heat oil, add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds for tempering. Add chopped okra and sauté. Add tamarind paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and asafoetida. Add chopped onion and tomato, mix well. Cook on medium heat until okra is tender and flavors are infused. Serve as a side curry with rice.

name: Veggie Tortilla Wraps
instructions: Mix red chilli powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce. Add mushrooms, capsicum and onion, mix well. Preheat air fryer at 200°C for 2-3 minutes. Line tray with foil and roast vegetables for 15 minutes. Cool. Spread hummus on tortillas, add mushroom mixture, top with guacamole, roll tightly and slice. Serve.

name: Podi Idli Fry
instructions: Cut idlis into half inch pieces. Heat butter in non-stick pan. Add curry leaves, coriander seeds, split black gram, Bengal gram, sesame seeds, red chilli flakes and green chillies, saute for 1-2 minutes. Add onion, cook till translucent. Add idli pieces, sprinkle idli podi, toss well, add salt if needed. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot.

name: Chicken Cheese Momos
ingredients: momos dough made with refined flour salt and hot water
spring onion bulbs with greens chopped
instructions: Grate processed cheese and add to bowl with chicken mince, spring onion bulbs and greens. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, mix well. Heat sufficient water in steamer. Divide dough into small portions and shape into balls. Flatten each ball and roll out edges to make small disc. Stuff with chicken-cheese mixture, bring edges to centre and pleat from one side to other to shape like momo. Grease steamer basket with oil, place momos inside. Steam for 10-12 minutes until translucent. Serve hot with schezwan sauce.

name: Pecan Gucchi Pulao
instructions: Heat ghee in deep non-stick pan. Add caraway seeds, green cardamoms, black peppercorns, cloves, cinnamon and bay leaves and sauté till fragrant. Add onions and sauté till light golden. Add pecans and morels and mix well. Add rice, saffron and salt and sauté for 2-3 minutes. Add vegetable stock and allow to boil. Lower the heat, cover and cook for 10-15 minutes. Set aside for 10-15 minutes. Transfer to serving plate, garnish with coriander sprigs and serve hot.

name: bruschetta
instructions: Apply butter spread on bread. Heat butter in pan and sauté onion until translucent. Chop capsicums and add to pan, cook for a minute. Grill bread slices until golden brown. Add cherry tomatoes, salt, oregano, and black pepper to the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Add pine nuts and tear basil leaves into pan. Apply mayo on toasted bread and top with vegetable mixture. Garnish with arugula leaves and serve immediately.

name: pistachio saffron crackers
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Toast saffron on low heat and crush in mortar. Heat ghee, add gum raisin and cook until puffed, then crush. Sift dry flour ingredients and cardamom. Mix in nuts, crushed saffron, gum raisin, and remaining ghee. Add milk and knead to dough. Roll between silicon sheets into thin sheet. Trim edges and cut into rectangles. Transfer to baking tray and bake for 10-12 minutes. Cool and serve with coffee.

name: pecan anjeer modak
instructions: Soak dried figs for 6-8 hours. Drain soaked figs and grind to fine paste with water. Heat ghee in kadai and sauté mawa until golden brown. Add fig paste and cook for 6-8 minutes on medium heat. Mix in powdered sugar, pecan nuts, dried figs, and cardamom powder. Transfer to plate and cool completely. Grease modak mould with ghee, fill with mixture, press well, and demould. Garnish with silver varq and serve.

name: murgh yakhani
instructions: Heat ghee in deep non-stick pan. Add bay leaf, black peppercorns, and black cardamom pods. Open green cardamom pods and add to pan, sauté for few seconds. Add fennel seeds, ginger, garlic, onion, and salt. Sauté for a minute until onion turns translucent. Add curd and saffron, sauté on high heat until most moisture evaporates. Add chicken stock and mix well. Cover and cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes. Serve hot.

name: pittu
instructions: Put rice flour in bowl, add salt and scraped coconut and 2 tablespoons water, mix well. Heat 1 cup water in bottom container of puttu steamer. Brush cylindrical mould with oil, fill with rice flour mixture. Spread evenly and cover lid. Place in steamer and steam for 12-15 minutes. Remove mould and push pittu through cylinder with wooden stick onto serving plate. Serve hot.

name: tomato mozzarella salad
instructions: Cut tomatoes into thick roundels. Cut mozzarella cheese into 1 inch squares. Arrange slices of tomatoes and mozzarella cheese alternately along with a basil leaf on a serving platter. Drizzle balsamic reduction on top. Sprinkle crushed black peppercorns and drizzle extra virgin olive oil on top. Serve immediately.

name: Matar Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Heat Wonderchef Chef Magic, add ingredients and spices, cook until mushrooms are tender and peas are cooked through, cream is incorporated for a rich gravy consistency. Serve hot.

name: Chocolate Truffles
instructions: Heat nonstick pan and add fresh cream until bubbles appear. Add chocolate and mix well until melted. Transfer to bowl and refrigerate 2 hours. Divide into equal portions and roll into balls. Spread cocoa powder, desiccated coconut and sprinklers on plates. Roll each truffle in coating of choice. Serve.

name: Caramel Sauce
instructions: Heat sugar in nonstick pan and cook until melted and caramelized to amber gold colour. Switch off heat and add cream, mix well. Add 1 tbsp butter and mix. Switch heat back on and add remaining butter, mix well. Cook 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat, strain sauce and transfer to glass jar. Serve as required.

name: Cream Cheese Kisses
instructions: Preheat oven at 180°C. Beat cream cheese using electric beater until light and fluffy. Break in eggs one at a time and beat well. Add vanilla essence and castor sugar, beat well. Add flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon powder, fold until combined. Transfer to piping bag and pipe portions onto lined baking tray, press tops gently. Bake 10-15 minutes. Cool slightly and serve dusted with icing sugar.

name: Ghavan
instructions: Place rice flour in bowl. Add 1½ tbsps oil and salt, mix well. Add 2 cups water slowly, stirring continuously to make smooth batter. Set aside 10-15 minutes. Heat nonstick tawa and spread oil with tissue. Pour ladleful of batter and spread thin round. Drizzle oil around edges and cook until underside light brown. Flip, drizzle oil, cook until other side light brown. Make more ghavan similarly. Transfer to plate and serve hot.

name: Ginger Masala Lassi
instructions: Put green chilli in blender jar. Add coriander leaves, mint leaves, ginger, roasted cumin powder, powdered sugar, black salt, chaat masala and a little yogurt. Blend to smooth paste. Add remaining yogurt and ice cubes, blend to fine consistency. Serve chilled garnished with mint leaves and roasted cumin powder.

name: Arancini
instructions: Heat oil in wok, add garlic and sauté until golden. Add onion, sauté until translucent. Add rice, sauté 1 minute. Separate thyme leaves, add to pan with saffron. Add vegetable stock and salt, bring to boil, add peppercorns. Cover and cook until rice done. Open lid, mix well, remove from heat, cool to room temperature. Grease palms with oil, take rice portion, make cavity, place mozzarella cube, seal into ball. Dip each ball in flour slurry, roll in bread crumbs. Heat oil in kadai, deep fry balls until golden and crisp. Drain on paper. Serve hot with marinara sauce.

name: Chicken Amsu
ingredients: 750 grams chicken on the bone with skin
½ cup soaked and drained sticky rice
instructions: Roast chicken on direct heat until charred. Cut into 8-10 pieces. Crush ginger, garlic and green chillies coarsely. Heat kadai, add chicken, bamboo shoots, crushed mixture and mix well. Add 3 cups water and cook 8-10 minutes. Transfer soaked sticky rice to grinder with 1 cup water, grind to fine paste. Add salt and oyster mushrooms to chicken. Chop michinga leaves roughly and add. Crush Sichuan peppercorns and add. Mix well. Add ground rice paste and mix well. Cook 6-8 minutes. Transfer to bowl and serve hot.

name: Japanese Cheesecake
instructions: 1. Prepare graham cracker base and press into springform pan. 2. Soften cream cheese and mix with egg yolks. 3. Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form. 4. Fold cheese mixture gently into whipped egg whites. 5. Pour batter into prepared crust. 6. Bake in water bath at 160°C for 50-60 minutes until golden top with soft jiggly center is achieved. 7. Cool gradually to room temperature, then refrigerate.

name: Assamese Fish Tenga
ingredients: mustard oil, 4 tbsps + to deep fry
dried bhoot jolokia chilli for garnish
instructions: 1. Marinate fish pieces with salt and 1/2 tsp turmeric for 5-10 minutes. 2. Heat mustard oil in kadai, add marinated fish and deep fry for 6-7 minutes. Drain on paper. 3. Heat 4 tbsps oil in kadai, add fenugreek seeds and sauté briefly. 4. Add green chilli and onions, sauté until golden brown. 5. Add garlic paste and sauté for 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook until pulpy. 6. Add ridge gourd, remaining turmeric and salt. Cover and cook for 5 minutes. 7. Add 3 cups water and bring to boil. Add fried fish pieces and cook covered for 5-6 minutes. 8. Add lemon juice and coriander, mix well. Garnish with Bhoot Jolokia chilli and serve.

name: Aloo Tikki Chole Chaat
ingredients: potatoes, 3 medium boiled peeled and mashed
ready made pindi chole as required
instructions: 1. Mix mashed potatoes with green chillies, garam masala, red chilli, chaat masala, coriander, cumin, salt and coriander leaves. 2. Grate cheese for filling. 3. Heat oil in non-stick pan. 4. Shape potato mixture into ball, make cavity, place cheese ball in cavity, seal edges and flatten. 5. Coat each tikki in cornflour and dust excess. 6. Shallow fry tikkis in hot oil until golden brown and crisp on both sides. Drain on paper. 7. Place chole on serving plate, center the aloo tikki, add more chole on top. 8. Sprinkle chopped onion, coriander leaves and sev. Serve immediately.

name: Khatta Moong Kadhi
instructions: 1. Soak moong dal for 30 minutes and drain. 2. Blend soaked dal with yogurt and 1 cup water until smooth using Wonderchef Chef Magic or food processor. 3. Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a kadai, add cumin seeds and mustard seeds, let them crackle. 4. Add asafoetida, ginger and green chillies, sauté briefly. 5. Add blended dal-yogurt mixture, turmeric and salt. 6. Cook on medium heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally until creamy consistency is achieved. 7. Adjust seasoning and serve hot with rice.

name: Dal Mizaz
ingredients: skinless split green gram (dhuli moong dal), 3/4 cup soaked
split pigeon peas (toor dal), 1/4 cup soaked
instructions: 1. Combine soaked moong dal, toor dal, 1/4 tsp turmeric, asafoetida and 3.5 cups water in pressure cooker. Cover and cook under pressure for 3-4 whistles. 2. Heat butter and oil in non-stick deep pan, add cumin seeds until color changes. 3. Add garlic and ginger strips, sauté for 1 minute. Add onion and cook until golden brown. 4. Add tomato and salt, mix and cook until soft and pulpy. 5. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and remaining turmeric, sauté for 1 minute. 6. Add cooked dal mixture and mix well. Add 1 cup water and cook until boiling. 7. Add garam masala powder, coriander leaves and mint leaves, mix well. Switch heat off and add lemon juice. 8. Serve hot garnished with mint sprig.

name: Matthe Wale Aloo
instructions: 1. Mash boiled potatoes and set aside. 2. Heat mustard oil in kadai, add cumin seeds and once color changes, add asafoetida and mix. 3. Add ginger and green chillies, sauté for 1 minute. Add potatoes and sauté on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. 4. Add Kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric powder and coriander powder, mix well. 5. Add buttermilk and salt, cook on medium heat for 6-8 minutes. 6. Add dried fenugreek leaves and coriander leaves, mix well. 7. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with coriander sprig and serve hot with puris.

name: Vegan Moong Kofta
instructions: Chop moong, onion, chillies, ginger and salt in a chopper to coarse mixture. Add spices and mix well. Steam portions in banana-lined basket for 10-15 minutes. Bake at 180°C for 10-15 minutes. For gravy: dry roast cumin seeds, add tomato puree with spices, add water and cooked koftas, simmer 2-3 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

name: Kiri Hodi
instructions: Heat coconut milk in non-stick pan. Add sliced onion, fenugreek seeds, turmeric, green chillies and half curry leaves. Add salt and cinnamon stick. Mix well. Add dried Maldives fish and bring to boil. Add lemon juice and remaining chopped curry leaves. Serve piping hot.

name: Cheese Toast Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread slices lightly. Place cheese between two slices. Toast on griddle or pan until bread is golden and crisp and cheese melts. Cut diagonally and serve immediately.

name: Aam Ras Ka Gosht
ingredients: mutton 1½ inch pieces on bone 750 gms
instructions: Heat oil in deep pan. Chop onions finely and saute till lightly browned. Grind almonds and melon seeds into smooth paste. Add mutton with salt, ginger-garlic paste and saute 1 minute. Add turmeric and red chilli powder, break green chillies and add. Mix well, add water, cover and cook 20-25 minutes. Add almond-melon paste, mango pulp, yogurt and raisins. Add garam masala and saffron. Cook till mutton is tender. Serve hot.

name: Mango Kulukki Sarbath
ingredients: sugar free natura diet sugar 8 measures
instructions: Soak sabza seeds in ½ cup water for 10 minutes. Peel mango and chop into ½ inch pieces, add to Boston shaker. Squeeze lemon juice and slit green chilli, add to shaker. Add sugar substitute, mint leaves, soaked sabza seeds and ice cubes. Add 1 cup water, close lid and shake well. Place lemon slices in tall glass and pour prepared sarbath. Garnish with lemon and green chilli. Serve chilled.

name: Green Moong Moussaka
ingredients: green gram (moong) sprouts boiled with salt 1 cup
olive oil 1 tsp plus for grilling
instructions: Preheat oven at 180°C. Heat olive oil in non-stick pan and in grill pan. Thinly slice eggplant and sprinkle salt. Saute onion in pan. Grill eggplant slices until evenly marked on both sides. Add garlic, ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and salt to onion, saute till tomatoes soften. Heat green gram in microwave 1 minute. Add tomato puree and green chilli sauce, cook on low heat 2-3 minutes. Add crushed peppercorns to eggplant, continue grilling. Layer in baking dish: tomato sauce, grilled eggplant, green gram, cheese. Repeat layers and top with sauce, herbs, yogurt and remaining cheese. Bake 30 minutes. Serve hot garnished with parsley.

name: Coffee Jelly Frappe
instructions: For coffee jelly: Mix agar agar powder with ¼ cup water, allow to bloom 3 minutes. Heat 2 cups water, add coffee powder and sugar substitute, bring to boil. Add dissolved agar to half the coffee decoction, mix well and chill until set. For frappe: Add ice cubes, remaining coffee decoction and oat milk to Boston shaker, shake well. Cut set coffee jelly into small pieces. Place jelly pieces in tall glass and pour frappe over. Serve chilled.

name: Prawn Biryani
instructions: Wash and soak rice for 30 minutes. Marinate prawns with salt, garlic paste, ginger paste, turmeric powder and lemon juice for 5-10 minutes. Heat ghee, add caraway seeds and spices (cardamom, cinnamon, peppercorns, cloves) until fragrant. Add ginger paste, green chillies and remaining garlic paste, cook 1 minute. Add onions and cook until golden brown. Add tomatoes, salt, tomato puree, coriander leaves, mint leaves and ginger strips, cook until fat separates. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, biryani masala and saffron, cook until fat separates again. Add marinated prawns and saute on high heat for 2-3 minutes, then cook for 6-8 minutes. Reserve half the prawns in a bowl. Boil water with salt, add drained rice and cook for 6-8 minutes until 3/4 done. Drain rice and layer half over prawns mixture. Spread reserved prawns over rice and layer remaining rice on top. Drizzle saffron, sprinkle coriander, fried onions, ginger strips, mint and green chillies, add rose petals. Cover with foil and lid, cook on low heat for 25-30 minutes. Rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.

name: Ragi Ambil
instructions: Take finger millet flour in a pan, add 2 cups water and mix well. Cook on low heat for 4-5 minutes until mixture is thick. Transfer cooked mixture to a plate and allow to cool. Add 3 cups water in an earthen pot, dip your fingers in water and divide mixture into equal portions, roll into balls and add to the pot. Cover and set aside to ferment for 8-10 hours. Remove scum from fermented mixture and mix thoroughly. Add yogurt, salt, green chillies, ginger, onion and coriander, mix well. Transfer to serving glasses and serve.

name: Russian Tea Cakes with Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 165 degrees Celsius and line a baking tray with silicon sheet. Grind together pecans and powdered sugar until mixture resembles breadcrumbs and transfer to a bowl. Cream together butter, castor sugar and vanilla essence until light and fluffy. Sieve flour into the butter-sugar mixture and beat until well incorporated. Add ground pecans and salt and mix well. Divide dough into equal portions and place on the lined tray. Bake for 15 minutes. Take out the tray and cool for a while. Coat the tea cakes with powdered sugar, put the tray back in the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Serve.

name: Green Moong Thoran
ingredients: 2 cups cooked whole green gram sabut moong
instructions: Take coconut in a grinder jar. Add turmeric powder, ginger and green chillies and grind coarsely. Heat coconut oil in a nonstick kadai. Add mustard seeds and once they start to splutter, add cumin seeds, shallots and saute until translucent. Add curry leaves, ground mixture and mix well. Add cooked green gram, salt and mix well. Cook for 4-5 minutes until the mixture is heated thoroughly. Transfer in a serving bowl and serve hot.

name: Golden Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Give slits on chicken legs and transfer in a bowl. Squeeze lemon. Add saffron, ginger-garlic paste, salt and mix well. Set aside for 10-15 minutes. For the second marinade, take hung yogurt in plate. Add yellow chilli powder, biryani masala, green chilli paste. Break egg, separate yolk and add white to the marinade. Add roasted gram flour, red chilli powder and mix well. Heat mustard oil in a small nonstick pan. Add turmeric powder and cook for 10 seconds. Add this to the prepared marinade and mix well. Add chicken to second marinade and mix well. Set aside to marinate for 1 hour. Preheat air fryer at 180 degrees Celsius. Grease the air fryer basket with butter, arrange chicken pieces on it and cook for 20-25 minutes. Brush butter on top. Transfer into serving plate. Serve with green chutney, onion rings, lemon wedge and mint sprig.

name: Coconut Parippu Payasam
ingredients: 2 tbsps split bengal gram chana dal soaked
2 tbsps split skinless green gram dhuli moong dal soaked
instructions: Heat 2 tbsps ghee in a deep non stick pan. Heat 2 tbsps ghee in another non stick pan. Add chana dal and moong dal to the deep pan and saute. Add cashewnuts to the other pan and saute over low heat. Add 1.5 cups water and milk to the dals, cover and let them cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally. When cashewnuts are golden, drain and transfer to a bowl. Saute coconut in the ghee remaining in the pan until lightly browned and fragrant. Add jaggery to the cooked dals and mix. Add coconut and mix well. Add cashewnuts, keeping some for garnishing. Add 2 tsps ghee and cook for 3-4 minutes. Serve garnished with reserved cashewnuts at room temperature.

name: Eggless Apple Upside Down Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius. Grease a cake tin with butter and dust with flour. Core apples, cut into wedges and slice. Arrange the apple slices on the base of the cake tin in layers. Sprinkle 2 tbsps castor sugar on top and set aside. Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cornstarch into a bowl and mix well. Add remaining castor sugar, vanilla essence, condensed milk and butter and mix well. Add apple juice and mix to a smooth batter. Pour batter over the apple slices in the cake tin, spread and tap a little. Place the tin in the preheated oven and bake for 45-50 minutes. Remove the tin from oven and cool down to room temperature. Place the tin upside down over a serving plate and slowly lift the tin to loosen the cake. Serve.

name: axone egg curry
instructions: Heat a deep pan. Add potatoes, axone, dried red chillies, tomatoes, bhoot jolokia chilli and 1.5 cups water. Cook for 10-15 minutes until potatoes are tender. Peel eggs and prick with toothpick. Crush ginger and chop coriander leaves. Remove and mash potatoes, mash tomatoes with spoon. Add potatoes back and mix. Add eggs, salt and crushed ginger. Cook on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. Add chopped coriander leaves, transfer to serving bowl, garnish and serve hot.

name: vegetable atta pizza
instructions: Preheat oven at 180°C. Mix whole wheat flour, yeast, sugar, olive oil, salt and water. Knead to soft dough and cover for 40 minutes. Knock back dough, roll into thin disc and place on greased tray. Cover and prove. Apply pizza sauce, spread cheese evenly. Sprinkle onion, mushrooms, capsicums, corn, oregano, chilli flakes and olives. Bake for 10-15 minutes until cheese melts. Cut and serve hot.

name: moong dal papad
instructions: Heat 0.75 cup water, add papad khar, salt and asafoetida, bring to boil and cool. Coarsely crush peppercorns. Mix flours with peppercorns, add khar water and knead. Add oil and knead to stiff dough for 6-8 minutes. Divide into portions, cover and rest 2-3 hours. Dust with urad flour and roll thin discs. Sundry for 1 day, flip and sundry for 1 more day. Roast and serve.

name: rasam rice
instructions: Heat ghee in pressure cooker. Add mustard seeds, let splutter, then add hing, dried chillies and curry leaves. Add garlic and saute until golden. Add tomato puree, turmeric and rasam powder, cook until fat separates. Add rice, dal, salt and mix. Add 4 cups water, cover and pressure cook until pressure releases 4 times. Open lid once pressure settles, mix well. Add 1 cup water, tamarind pulp and coriander, cook 2-3 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish and serve hot.

name: kasundi paneer tikka
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Mix hung yogurt with kasundi paste, ginger-garlic-chilli paste, salt and chaat masala. Squeeze lemon and mix. Heat mustard oil until smoking, add turmeric and gram flour, saute 2-3 minutes. Add to yogurt mixture and mix well. Add capsicums and paneer to marinade and mix. Marinate for 10-15 minutes. Grease baking tray with butter. Skewer capsicums and paneer pieces on steel skewers and arrange on tray. Bake for 10-15 minutes, basting with butter at regular intervals. Transfer to serving plate and serve hot with salad.

name: moong rava idli
ingredients: ½ cup split skinless black gram (dhuli urad dal)
instructions: Grind split skinless black gram with water to fine paste. Add idli rava and grind coarsely. Transfer to bowl and ferment for 6-8 hours. Add salt and mix well. Heat water in steamer. Transfer batter to idli moulds, sprinkle sprouted green gram and gun powder. Steam for 10-15 minutes. Demould and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: chilli cheese egg bites
instructions: Break eggs in a bowl, add salt, peppercorns, turmeric and ½ tsp red chilli powder, mix well. Heat non-stick tawa with oil. Dip bread slices in egg mixture and cook on both sides for 1 minute each. Grate cheese and mix with green chillies, coriander, onions, tomatoes, salt and remaining red chilli powder. Flip bread slices, top 2 with cheese mixture and cover with remaining slices. Cook until cheese melts. Cut into squares and serve hot with tomato ketchup.

name: spinach and almond soup
instructions: Heat butter in pan. Add bay leaf, garlic, onion and peppercorns, sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add almonds and mix well. Add vegetable stock and salt, cover and bring to boil. Add spinach leaves and cook for 1 minute. Discard bay leaf and cook for 1 minute more. Switch off heat and blend using hand blender until well blended. Pour into bowls, top with butter, garnish with fresh cream and almond slivers.

name: tomato dolma
ingredients: 1 cup soya granules, soaked and drained
