¼ cup short-grained rice, soaked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Heat olive oil in pan. Cut thin slices from top and bottom of tomatoes, reserve top slices and scoop out pulp to make tomato cups. Add onions and garlic to pan, sauté until lightly browned. Add carrot and salt, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add soya granules. Add tomato puree, ¼ cup vegetable stock, peppercorns, rice, parsley and butter, cook for 8-10 minutes. Stuff tomato cups with mixture and cover with reserved top slices. Place in cake tin, pour remaining stock and drizzle olive oil. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes, then 160°C for 15 minutes more.

name: aloo pyaaz kulcha
ingredients: ¾ tsp dried pomegranate seeds (anardana) powder
instructions: For dough: Mix refined flour, salt, sugar, yeast and ghee. Add warm milk and 3 tbsps warm water, knead to soft dough. Cover with muslin cloth, set aside for 1 hour. For stuffing: Heat oil, add coriander and cumin seeds, ginger and chillies, sauté for 30 seconds. Add anardana powder, onion, sauté until translucent. Add red chilli powder, garam masala and salt. Add mashed potatoes and coriander, cool. Dust flour on surface, divide dough into 8 portions, make indent and stuff. Seal edges, roll into thick disk. Spray oil, sprinkle onion seeds. Preheat air fryer at 200°C for 2-3 minutes. Air fry 4 kulchas for 7 minutes. Flip and air fry for 3 minutes more. Brush butter and serve hot.

name: rasmalai cake
instructions: Preheat oven at 180°C. Take castor sugar in bowl, add oil and beat until sugar melts. Add yogurt and beat for 1-2 minutes. Pour milk, add kewra water, rose water and soaked saffron. Sift refined flour, baking soda and baking powder, add to bowl with cardamom powder, gently fold until smooth batter forms. Divide into two greased 7x4 inch cake tins. Bake for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely and de-mould. Trim tops and cut cakes horizontally in half. Mix whipped cream with saffron strands and cardamom powder. Horizontally cut rasmalai in half. Apply whipped cream on plate base, layer cake, brush rasmalai milk, add whipped cream, arrange rasmalai halves. Layer and repeat. Top with final cake layer. Refrigerate 1-2 hours. Apply more whipped cream on sides and top. Pipe rosettes, arrange angoori rasmalai, garnish with saffron and rose petals.

name: caramel cheese toast
instructions: Take butter in a bowl, add brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Place 4 bread slices on worktop, place 1 cheese slice on each slice. Cover with remaining bread slices and apply beaten mixture. Heat non-stick tawa. Place sandwich (sugar mixture side on tawa) and apply remaining sugar mixture on upper bread layer. Cook on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. Flip and cook for 4-5 minutes more. Cut into triangles and serve hot.

name: spring onion and cheese gyoza
instructions: Mix chicken mince with spring onions, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar and salt. Add corn flour and grated cheese. Shape dough into discs, stuff with mixture, fold and pleat edges. Pan-fry on medium heat 1-2 minutes until golden. Sprinkle water, cover and steam 3-5 minutes. Serve hot with sauce.

name: waffle uttappam with veggies
instructions: Preheat waffle iron. Mix dosa batter with salt, onion, green chillies, tomato, peas, carrot, coriander and veg mayo. Grease waffle iron with butter spread. Add batter and close lid, cook 8-10 minutes. Add more butter spread, cook 2-3 minutes on high heat, then cook 2-3 minutes at base. Cut and serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: lemon herb chicken rice
instructions: Heat ghee in wok. Add garlic, celery and spring onion bulbs, sauté 1 minute until raw smell goes away. Add chicken and sauté on high heat 2-3 minutes, add salt and toss. Cook 1-2 minutes more. Add oregano leaves, red chilli flakes, lemon juice, rice and spring onion greens. Adjust salt, toss well, cook 1 minute. Transfer to plate and serve hot garnished with fresh herbs.

name: pomegranate and kiwi salad
instructions: Peel and roughly chop kiwis, add to bowl. Roughly tear all lettuce leaves and add. For dressing, grind garlic, mustard seeds, mint leaves, orange squash, lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper till smooth. Roughly crumble cottage cheese and add to bowl with pomegranate kernels and dressing, mix well. Transfer to serving plate and serve immediately.

name: tricolour sweet medley
instructions: Heat ghee, add carrot, cook 8-10 minutes. In separate pan heat ghee, grind green peas with water to puree, add to pan, cook 5-7 minutes. Combine rice powder and milk in bowl. Heat milk-rice in third pan, cook till thick. Add sugar to first pan, cook till melts, add milk and mix. Add milk and sugar to second pan, mix, add cardamom and white chocolate. Add rice milk mixture to first pan with saffron, simmer. Add sugar and cardamom to white chocolate phirni, add remaining chocolate, simmer. Layer: peas phirni, pistachios, white chocolate phirni, almonds, gajar ka halwa, saffron. Serve in shot glasses.

name: kesar pista ice cream
instructions: Boil 900ml milk in kadai. Dry roast saffron 30 seconds, crush in bowl. Grind sugar with cornflour, milk powder, cmc powder and gms flakes to fine powder. Mix powder with remaining milk. Add half crushed saffron to boiling milk, mix. Add powder-milk mixture, cook on low heat until thick. Cool completely in bowl. Transfer to airtight container and freeze 6-7 hours. Mix in fresh cream and churn until light and fluffy. Add pistachios. Layer mixture and pistachios/saffron in container. Freeze 8-10 hours. Scoop and serve chilled.

name: pecan dodha
instructions: Bring milk to boil in steel kadai. Add alum and cook on medium heat 40-45 minutes until milk becomes grainy and thickens. Reserve some pecans for garnish, grind remaining to fine powder. Grease burfi tray with ghee. Add powdered pecans and sugar to milk mixture, cook 20-25 minutes. Add cardamom powder, liquid glucose and ghee, mix well. Transfer to greased tray, arrange reserved pecans on top. Set aside 2-3 hours. Cut into squares and serve.

name: Chocolate and Pecan Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until sugar melts. Add egg and vanilla essence and whisk well. Add refined flour, cocoa powder and baking powder and mix gently. Add chopped pecans and mix well. Add dark chocolate and mix. Shape mixture into balls, flatten to cookie shape and refrigerate for 10-15 minutes. Place pecan halves on top of each cookie. Preheat oven to 180°C. Bake for 10-15 minutes until golden. Cool to room temperature and serve.

name: Paneer Bread Rolls
ingredients: ½ cup green peas boiled and crushed
instructions: Heat oil in a kadai. Crumble paneer in a bowl and mix with crushed green peas, ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves, chaat masala and salt. Dip bread slice in water, press to remove excess water. Place stuffing in centre of bread, bring edges to centre and shape into a ball, sealing all edges. Deep fry balls in hot oil on high heat until golden brown and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper and serve.

name: cheese rajma masala burrito
instructions: 1. Grate cheddar cheese and heat a tortilla on nonstick tawa. 2. Sprinkle grated cheese, chaat masala and kashmiri red chilli powder, cover with lid and cook on low heat for 2-3 minutes. 3. Transfer to work surface and spread rajma masala. 4. Top with cooked rice and salt. 5. Arrange lettuce, purple cabbage and onion slices on top. 6. Sprinkle chaat masala and chilli powder, drizzle sour cream and fold tightly. 7. Transfer to tawa and cook for 1 minute until thoroughly heated. 8. Serve hot.

name: chole papdi chaat
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in nonstick pan, add cumin seeds and let them change colour. 2. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, chole masala and boiled chickpeas and mix well. 3. Add salt and chaat masala and mix. Cover and cook until mixture boils. 4. Lightly mash using a masher and cook for 1-2 minutes. 5. To serve, add butter in earthen bowl, pour hot chole mixture. 6. Drizzle red chilli-garlic chutney, green chutney and date-tamarind chutney. 7. Sprinkle roasted cumin seeds, chopped onion, squeeze lemon juice, crush papdis and sprinkle. 8. Garnish with sev, coriander leaves and pomegranate seeds.

name: masala methi bhakri
instructions: 1. Take whole wheat flour in bowl, add khapli wheat flour, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, roasted cumin seeds, garam masala powder, asafoetida, white sesame seeds, ginger-green chilli paste, fenugreek leaves, salt and oil. 2. Mix well and add 0.5 cup water. 3. Knead to stiff dough, cover with moist muslin cloth and set aside for 10-15 minutes. 4. Roll dough into thick sheet and cut into roundels with cookie cutter. 5. Heat nonstick tawa, place rotis on tawa and cook on low heat for 4-5 minutes. 6. Flip and cook on low heat for 5-6 minutes. 7. Drizzle ghee and cook for 2-3 minutes more. 8. Cool completely and serve.

name: quick sabudana thalipeeth
instructions: 1. Transfer sago in grinder jar and grind to fine powder. 2. Transfer powder in bowl. 3. Add potatoes, peanut powder, cumin seeds, ginger-green chilli paste, salt, sugar, coriander leaves and lemon juice and mix well. 4. Add 0.5 cup water and mix well. 5. Take a portion of mixture and spread evenly on nonstick tawa. 6. Place tawa on heat and drizzle ghee all around the thalipeeth. 7. Cook on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. 8. Flip and cook for 4-5 minutes on other side. 9. Serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Subz Purda Pulao
instructions: Mix flour, ghee, sugar, salt and water to make soft dough. Sauté spices and onions in oil, add chopped vegetables and rice. Mix yogurt and water, add to rice. Once moisture is absorbed, add green peas. Cover with dough chapatti, seal sides, and bake at 220°C until chapatti is golden.

name: Falafel Pockets
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 180°C. Crush soaked red lentils coarsely. Mix with spices, onion, parsley, breadcrumbs and mayo. Divide into portions and flatten. Spray oil on falafels and air fry for 12-15 minutes. Apply mayo in pita pockets, add lettuce, vegetables, and fried falafels. Serve.

name: Cheese Pakoda Sandwich
instructions: Mix boiled potatoes with onion, cumin, salt, chilli powder and chaat masala. Mix gram flour with water and spices to make batter. Apply green chutney on bread, spread potato mixture, top with cheese. Cover with bread. Dip sandwiches in batter and deep fry until golden. Drain and serve with ketchup and mayo.

name: Pecan and Arugula Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Blend pecans, sundried tomatoes, garlic, parmesan, salt, pepper and olive oil to paste. Knead pizza dough and shape into ball. Dust with flour and roll into thin rectangle. Prick with fork and place on baking tray. Apply paste evenly and bake 8-10 minutes. Top with arugula, tomatoes, feta cheese, olives and chilli flakes. Garnish with microgreens.

name: Moong Dal Waffles
instructions: Soak moong dal, urad dal and fenugreek seeds. Grind with water to smooth batter. Ferment for 8-10 hours. Mix batter and add peppercorns, salt, curry leaves, carrot, coriander and turmeric. Preheat waffle iron and grease with butter. Pour ladleful of batter and cook 4-5 minutes. Apply more butter and cook until golden. Serve hot with green chutney.

name: Achari Paneer Sticks
instructions: Mix yogurt, pickle paste, spices, ginger-garlic paste, mustard oil and gram flour. Add paneer and marinate for 15 minutes. Heat oil in grill pan. Skewer paneer pieces and grill on all sides for 3-4 minutes until golden brown. Serve with green chutney, mint and salad.

name: Healthy Pav Bhaji
ingredients: 4 tbsps nutralite activ olive plant based butter
instructions: Heat butter spread in pan, sauté onion until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute. Add tomato puree, salt and cook 4-5 minutes. Add carrot, cauliflower, sweet potato and cook 2-3 minutes. Add water and mash. Cook 2 minutes. Add chilli paste and cook 1 minute. Add capsicum and pav bhaji masala, cover and cook 5-6 minutes. Toast pavs with butter. Add butter to bhaji and squeeze lemon. Add coriander and serve.

name: Sev Ki Burfi
instructions: Mix sev with powdered sugar and cardamom powder. Heat ghee and combine mixture. Press into a greased tray. Cut into squares and serve.

name: Kachche Sabziyon ki Biryani
instructions: Soak rice. Layer raw vegetables and parboiled rice alternately in a sealed pot with aromatics and yogurt. Cook on high heat until steam forms, then low heat for 45 minutes until rice is tender and vegetables are cooked.

name: Oats and Vegetable Thalipeeth
instructions: Mix oats, flours, vegetables, spices, yogurt, and sesame seeds. Add water and oil. Place wetted muslin cloth on worktop, spread mixture evenly, poke holes. Cook on hot tawa with oil, 4-5 minutes per side. Serve hot with yogurt.

name: Vanilla Vegan Sugar-Free Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Sift flour, baking soda, and salt. Add scraped vanilla pulp from pod. Mix in soya milk ensuring no lumps. Add sugar free natura and mix. Add oil and mix. Add vinegar and mix gently for fluffy batter. Pour into greased lined loaf tin. Bake for 40 minutes. Cool, slice, and serve.

name: Cherry French Toast
instructions: Whisk cream cheese with powdered sugar and vanilla. Fold in 1 cup whipped cream. Mix custard with remaining whipped cream. Whisk eggs with castor sugar, vanilla essence, cinnamon, and milk. Make sandwiches with brioche and custard filling. Dip sandwiches in egg mixture. Cook in hot butter 2-3 minutes per side. Top with cream cheese mixture and cherry compote. Garnish with fresh cherries and mint.

name: Air Fried Trail Mix
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 150°C. Mix peanuts, cashews, almonds, raisins, and pumpkin seeds. Spray oil, add half the red chilli powder, chaat masala, and salt. Air fry at 150°C for 35 minutes. Cool completely. Mix puffed rice and lotus seeds, spray oil, add remaining spices. Air fry for 15 minutes. Cool completely. Combine both mixtures. Store in airtight container.

name: Apple Sago Kheer
instructions: Heat milk in non-stick pan. Heat ghee, add grated apples with 1 tbsp sugar, sauté 2-3 minutes until moisture evaporates. Cool completely. Add soaked sago to apple mixture and cook until sago is translucent and cooked. Add remaining sugar and cook until dissolved. Add UHT cream and cook 1 minute on low heat. Add cashew and almond pieces. Cool to room temperature. Fold apple-sago mixture with milk-based ingredients and green cardamom powder. Transfer to serving bowl, garnish with saffron strands. Serve chilled.

name: green chilly chicken
ingredients: 750g chicken cut into 2 inch pieces on the bone
instructions: Heat oil in a kadai. Add cumin seeds and when they change colour add 20-22 light green chillies and sauté for a minute. Grind ginger, garlic, 3-4 light green chillies and onion to fine paste. Mix chicken in a bowl with ground paste. Add spicy green chillies to kadai and mix. Cover with a lid and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add marinated chicken, salt, turmeric powder and mix. Cover and cook for 6-8 minutes. Add remaining light green chillies, cover and cook for 6-8 minutes more. Serve hot.

name: aloo mimi
ingredients: 4 large potatoes boiled peeled and cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instant noodles spice mix to sprinkle
chopped fresh coriander leaves to sprinkle
instructions: Boil water in a kadai. Add garlic cloves, dried red chillies and tomatoes and boil for 6-8 minutes. Drain and remove tomato skin. Allow to cool. Transfer to grinder with 1/2 cup water and grind to fine paste. Heat oil in a shallow nonstick pan. Add onion seeds. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, crushed black peppercorns and mix. Add ground paste and 1 cup water and mix. Add salt and castor sugar and mix. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Add potatoes and mix. Cook for 4-5 minutes. Add potato gravy to serving bowl and sprinkle instant noodles, spice mix, onions, green chillies and coriander on top. Serve hot.

name: pumpkin soup
ingredients: 2 cups red pumpkin peeled and roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Take pumpkin on a baking tray and add onions, garlic, dried herbs, oregano, rosemary, salt, crushed black peppercorns and ghee. Place in oven and bake for 16-20 minutes. Remove and set aside. Heat vegetable stock in a nonstick pan. Grind together the roasted pumpkin mixture to a fine paste. Add to stock and let it boil. Adjust seasoning. Garnish with crushed black peppercorns and serve hot with breadsticks.

name: cheese mysore masala dosa
instructions: Take dosa batter in bowl and add salt and mix. To make one dosa take 1 tsp oil on a non-stick tawa and grease it. Pour a ladleful of batter and gently spread in a circular motion to make a medium sized disc. Add a portion of butter and spread on the dosa. Further add a portion of onions, tomatoes, red chilli garlic chutney, coconut chutney, coriander, carrot, beetroot, green chillies, and potato bhaji. Cover and cook for 1-2 minutes. Spread the masala evenly all over the dosa then grate cheddar cheese on top and cook for a minute. Fold the dosa and serve hot with chutney of your choice.

name: dal maharani
instructions: Soak the dals overnight. Pressure cook the dals with water and salt until soft. In a separate pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds. Add onions and garlic and sauté until golden. Add ginger and other spices. Add the cooked dal and mix well. Simmer on low heat for a long time to develop deep smoky flavour. Adjust salt and spices. Serve hot.

name: black pepper cream chicken
ingredients: 750g chicken cut into 2 inch pieces on the bone
1 cup boiled onion-cashew nut-whole spices paste
instructions: Heat ghee in a nonstick kadai. Add chicken, ginger-garlic paste and sauté on high heat for 4-5 minutes. Add boiled onion-cashew nut paste, salt and milk. Cover and cook for 8-10 minutes. Add fresh cream and dried fenugreek leaves powder and mix well. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: chicken with banana flower
ingredients: 750g chicken cut into 2 inch pieces on the bone
instructions: Chop banana flower. Take water in a bowl, add salt and 1/4 tsp turmeric powder and mix well. Add chopped banana flower and mix well. Set aside. Heat mustard oil in a kadai. Add green cardamoms, cloves, cinnamon and bay leaf and sauté till fragrant. Add onions and mix well. Break red chillies and add to pan and sauté till onions turn golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 mins. Add chicken and sauté on high heat for 4-5 minutes. Add remaining turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder and garam masala powder. Squeeze excess moisture from banana flower and add to pan. Mix well. Add salt and 1/2 cup water and mix well. Cover with lid and cook on medium heat for 10-12 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl and serve hot garnished with coriander sprig.

name: bharwan lauki with kadhi
instructions: Peel and slice bottle gourd into thick roundels, hollow out centers. Mix grated cottage cheese, mashed potatoes, khoya, salt and peppercorns. Stuff the gourd pieces. Heat oil in pan with cloves, cardamoms, cinnamon. Cook stuffed pieces covered until browned on one side, then flip and cook other side. In separate pan, whisk yogurt with amaranth flour, salt, peppercorns and water. Cook yogurt mixture stirring continuously until thick, add fresh cream. Arrange stuffed gourd pieces on serving plate, pour kadhi over and serve hot.

name: rice payasam
instructions: Soak and drain short grain rice. Heat ghee in pan, roast cashew nut halves until golden, drain and set aside. Add milk to same pan and bring to boil. Reduce heat, add rice and cook for 8-10 minutes. Add sugar, chopped cashew nuts, almonds, and green cardamom powder, mix well. Add cream and mix. Transfer to serving bowl. Garnish with roasted cashews, saffron strands and serve.

name: mughlai dal
instructions: Soak green gram for 8-10 hours. In pressure cooker add soaked gram with cinnamon, cardamoms, bay leaf, salt and 3 cups water. Cook till pressure releases twice, then open. Heat ghee and oil in pan, add cumin seeds and asafoetida. Add ginger, garlic, green chillies and sauté 1 minute. Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add spice powders and cook well. Add yogurt and cook till fat separates. Add cooked gram with 1 cup water and salt, cook 5-6 minutes. Add butter and cream, then sprinkle garam masala, fenugreek leaves and fried onions. Cook 2-3 minutes more. Transfer to bowl, drizzle cream, garnish with coriander and serve hot.

name: butter garlic mushrooms
instructions: Heat butter in non-stick pan. Add chopped garlic and sauté until golden brown. Add quartered button mushrooms and shiitake varieties with salt, toss once and cook 2-3 minutes. Add red chilli flakes, crushed peppercorns and chopped parsley, toss well. Transfer to serving plate, garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Vegan Kesar Masala Doodh
instructions: Heat plant-based milk in a pan. Add saffron strands and let them infuse. Add crushed cardamom, cinnamon stick, cloves, and a pinch of nutmeg. Simmer for 5-7 minutes to allow the spices to blend and the saffron to color the milk. Add sugar to taste. Stir well and pour into serving glasses. Serve hot and aromatic.
